original: You can give this house a once over. I hear they're fairly well-off and probably have lots of good stuff ripe for the picking. Sound good?
string: この家はちょろい仕事だよ。かなり裕福らしいから、きっと盗って下さいといわんばかりのお宝が鈴なりに並んでるはず。おいしい話じゃないか？

original: The owner of this place just got an inheritance from a relative lost in the war. Sound like something you can sink your teeth into?
string: ある家の主は戦争で死んだ親戚の遺産を相続したばかりらしいよ。かぶりつきたくなるよな？

original: Maurice said that renewal is more important than maintenance.
string: モーリスは、闇雲な保全よりも再生の方が重要だと言っていた

original: I... you're right of course. It can be hard to hear the winds of Kynareth when all you hear are the rabble in the temple.
string: ええ、そうなのです。聖堂の中の大衆の声しか聞かないのでは、キナレスの風に耳を傾けるのは難しいでしょう

original: Death feeds new life.
string: 死は新しい命の糧となります

original: I'm sure that, in time, this little sapling will grow into a new Gildergreen that will tower over Whiterun. Thank you.
string: いつかこの小さな苗木が、ホワイトランの上にそびえる新たなギルダーグリーンになると確信しています。ありがとう

original: DA03VileOffer0
string: DA03VileOffer0

original: There's an axe. An incredibly powerful axe. An axe powerful enough for me to have quite a bit of fun, indeed.
string: 斧だよ、非常に強力な力が宿っている斧。俺が手にしても十分に満足できる程に強い斧だ

original: If you bring it to me, I'll grant you my boon. No strings attached. No messy surprises. At least, not for you.
string: それを持って来てくれれば、お前の願いを叶えてやろう。無条件でな。突拍子もない悪ふざけもなしだ。まあ、少なくともお前にはな

original: As I recall, it's resting in Rimerock Burrow. Barbas can lead you right to it. The little mutt might even earn his place back at my side.
string: 確か、ライムロック窟に眠っているはずだ。バルバスが先導してくれるだろう。あのイヌっころめ、俺から力を奪う気でいるかも知れないな

original: What's your offer?
string: じゃあ、どうして欲しいんだ？

original: In Rimerock Burrow, there's an artifact called the Rueful Axe. Bring it to me, and I'll take Barbas back. Simple as that.
string: ライムロック窟に悔恨の斧と呼ばれる秘宝があるんだ。そいつを取ってきてくれ。そうしたら、バルバスを迎え入れてやる。なんとも単純だな

original: What did you want, again?
string: もう一度条件を聞かせてくれ

original: As much as I hate to say it, you're almost as powerful as I am right now. But that's just because half of my power resides in that mutt, Barbas.
string: こんな事は言いたくないが、今のお前は俺とほぼ同等の力を持っている。俺の力が半分、あのイヌっころのバルバスに奪われたせいだがな

original: Come to think of it, I know of a win-win situation for both of us.
string: そういえば、俺達がお互いに得する話があるんだが

original: The power to crush all before me!
string: 目の前に立ちふさがる者すべてを倒す力を！

original: Really? Power? You're a dragonborn; you already have more power than most people who aren't immense, fire-breathing monsters.
string: なに？　力だと？　お前はドラゴンボーンだ。火を吐く怪物よりも巨大ではない者なら、十分に倒せるだけの力を既に持っているだろうが

original: Really? Power? Haven't you already killed enough of your foes using the more mundane means at your disposal? Swords, magic, etc.? How... uninspired.
string: なに？　力だと？　もう既に十分、ありとあらゆる平凡な手段で敵を倒してきただろう？　剣や魔法とか、実に…　独創性なきやり方で

original: An end to the civil war that plagues my land.
string: 我が地を蝕む内戦を終わらせてほしい

original: Oh, if I had my full power, granting that would be trivial.
string: ふむ、俺に完全な力が戻れば、それは取るに足らない事だ

original: I'd simply snap my fingers, and everyone in Skyrim would die. War resolved.
string: ほんの少し指を鳴らすだけで、スカイリムにいる者すべてが死ぬ事になる。争いも平和的に解決だ

original: Why did Vile kick you out?
string: なぜヴァイルに放り出されたんだ？

original: Well... I guess you could say I got on his nerves. I tend to be the voice of reason and he finds that... irksome.
string: うむ…　おそらく彼の気に障ったんだろう。普段から彼の理性の声であろうとしたが、それが…　かえって煩わしかったんだろうな

original: He couldn't just kill me, you see. We're technically part of each other. But he was able to banish me from his domain.
string: かといって俺を殺す事もできなかった。互いに不可分の存在だからな。だが領域から追放する事はできた、ってわけだ

original: Of course, because of our separation, Vile is now much weaker. I guess he figured it was a small price to pay for not having to listen to me anymore.
string: もちろん、互いに離れた事でヴァイルの力はかなり弱まった。だが、うるさいのが消える事を思えば大した事ではないと考えたんだろうよ

original: Don't worry. I'll make sure he sees the light. I trusted you, now you trust me.
string: 心配すんな。必ずあいつに光を見せてやるよ。俺がお前さんを信じたように、今度は俺を信じてくれ

original: Yeah, yeah, dog gets master, master gets cosmic axe, everyone's happy. Just get over here, mutt.
string: はいはい、イヌは飼い主を得て、飼い主は魔法の斧を得ましたとさ、めでたしめでたし。さっさとこっちに来い、イヌっころが

original: I knew I could trust you!
string: お前さんの事、信じてたよ！

original: I see he's having a good influence on you.
string: 彼はずいぶんと影響を受けているようだ

original: Yeah, rub it in. Just imagine what I could get done with my full power and none of these pesky "morals."
string: ああ、言わなくても分かっている。俺がくだらん“道徳心“とやらをなしにして、全力を出せるとしたらどうなるか想像してみろ

original: Still, I've got this axe, and even if I can't use it, I'm sure someone would make a deal for it. Maybe I'll have a word with Molag Bal...
string: それでも、この斧を手に入れられた。俺はこれを使えないが、欲しがる者がいるはず。モラグ・バルの奴あたりに話を持ちかけるとするか…

original: I see he's having a good influence on you.
string: 彼はずいぶんと影響を受けているようだ

original: Maybe. For now just lay low and do your job. I have a feeling we'll be rid of the Captain soon...
string: たぶんな。今のところはおとなしく自分の仕事をこなす事だ。船長を厄介払いする日はそう遠くない気がするよ…

original: If only we could get our hands on that treasure. We could get out of here and never look back.
string: あのお宝を俺達のものにできればなあ。ここを出て、もう二度と戻らないのに

original: The Captain has it locked away in that drowned ship by his quarters. He says it's "to keep it safe" but I know he's just keeping it for himself.
string: あれは船長が自分の部屋近くの沈没船にしまいこんでしまった。口では“安全に保管するため”と言っているが、本当は独り占めするつもりなのさ

original: Where did you keep all that loot?  I've been here almost a year and haven't seen any of it.
string: これだけの盗品、どこに隠してたんだ？　ここにもう一年くらいいるのに、どれも見たことないぞ

original: Well, before that cave-in sealed our ships in here we could loot any size ship we wanted.
string: まあ、あの崩落で船団がここに閉じ込められる前なら、どんな大きさの船でも漁り放題だったろうが

original: You've been here for a while, right? What was it like back when we could still make runs out to the coast?
string: ここに来て長いんだよな？　俺達がまだ海岸までひとっ走りできた頃ってどんな感じだった？

original: I'd rather not have company right now.
string: 今はひとりがいい

original: I understand. Some journeys must be taken alone. I'll be here if you change your mind.
string: 分かった。ひとりで行かなきゃならない旅もある。気が変わったら、ここに来てくれ

original: You're welcome to join me.
string: 仲間になるのを歓迎しよう

original: I thank you for your kindness.
string: その親切に感謝する

original: Can I help you?
string: どうかしましたか？

original: I am a traveler. A pilgrim. I follow the voice of Kynareth wherever it can be heard.
string: 自分は巡礼者だ。キナレスの声を追って、旅をしている

original: I've dreamed of seeing Eldergleam for years. Might I travel alongside you? I promise not to get in the way.
string: エルダーグリームをこの目にすることを長年夢見てきた。一緒に旅をしても構わないか？　邪魔はしないと約束する

original: What did you have in mind?
string: 何か考えがあるのか？

original: Follow me. I think I can convince the tree to help us.
string: ついてこい。手を貸すよう、あの木を説得できると思う

original: I'll just take the sap. Danica was very insistent on having it.
string: 樹液は頂いていく。ダニカがどうしてもほしいらしい

original: Very well. I can't stop you. But I can't bear to watch it, either.
string: いいだろう。止めることはできない。だが、黙って見過ごすわけにもいかない

original: Do you have a better idea?
string: もっといい考えでもあるのか？

original: Well... yes. There is something.
string: ああ、そうだ。考えがある

original: It won't repair the tree back at the temple, but we could bring them a new one.
string: 聖堂の木は直せないが、新しい木を持ってくることはできる

original: Then stand aside. I have work to do.
string: なら、邪魔はしないでくれ。やるべきことがある

original: With pleasure. Nature has a way of finding vengeance, though. You walk a bleak path, friend. One that will lead to suffering.
string: 好きにすればいい。だが、自然には復讐する力がある。友よ、希望のない道を進むつもりか？　行き着く先には苦悩が待っている

original: I need sap to fix the Gildergreen.
string: ギルダーグリーンを回復させる樹液がほしい

original: You would violate this marvel of Kynareth's glory to fix that half-breed stump in Whiterun?
string: ホワイトランにある不純な切り株を回復させるために、キナレスの輝かしき驚異を冒とくするというのか？

original: That's abominable. Barbaric. I'll have no part of this. Why didn't you tell me what you intended?
string: それは忌むべき野蛮な行為だ。関わりたくない。何をするつもりか、なぜ教えなかった？

original: What's wrong?
string: どうした？

original: I had no idea you were a man of violence. What exactly are your intentions in this blessed place?
string: そんな乱暴な男とは知らなかった。この聖なる場所で一体何をしようというんだ？

original: I had no idea you were a woman of violence. What exactly are you intending to do here?
string: そんな乱暴な女とは知らなかった。この聖なる場所で一体何をしようというんだ？

original: Are you aware there's a plot to steal Frost?
string: フロストを盗み出す陰謀があるそうだが、ご存知か？

original: Don't tell me - Sibbi and Louis Letrush? Well, Sibbi is in jail and Letrush is certainly welcome to try. My hired help is more than a match for him.
string: さては…　シビとルイス・レットラッシュでしょう？　まあシビは牢の中ですしレットラッシュならきっと喜んでやるでしょうね。私がやるとすれば、もっと上手に事を運びますが

original: I'm aware of who stole Frost. And why.
string: 誰がフロストを盗んだのかは分かっています。もちろんその理由も

original: Are you aware that Letrush stole Frost?
string: レットラッシュがフロストを盗んだことに気づいているのか？

original: I'm not interested right now, thanks.
string: 今は興味ない。悪いね

original: That's a real shame. You would've fit the bill nicely.
string: 残念だな。あんたにうってつけの仕事なんだが

original: Sounds easy enough.
string: 実に簡単そうだ

original: Good man. You won't regret it.
string: 助かるよ。後悔はさせない

original: Ah, you're a smart woman. That's exactly what I wanted to hear.
string: おお、賢明な選択だ。そうこなくちゃな

original: What sort of message?
string: 伝言とはどんな？

original: Ah, well, I recently approached Sibbi Black-Briar about buying Frost, one of the finest breeding horses in Skyrim. He agreed to sell.
string: いや、実は、最近シビ・ブラック・ブライアにフロストを譲ってくれと頼んだんだ。スカイリムでも指折りの種馬でね。向こうは承知してくれたよ

original: I paid Sibbi half the cost of Frost up front, but before he could deliver, Maven had him locked up. Sibbi believes this exempts him from our deal.
string: こっちは前金で半分支払ったんだが、フロストを貰い受けるよりも先に、メイビンがシビを投獄しちまった。シビはこれで話はご破算になったと思っている

original: It does not.
string: だがそうはいかない

original: I want you to talk to Sibbi for me. Then, I want you to bring me Frost and the Lineage Papers that prove the horse's worth.
string: シビに話をつけて、フロストとあの馬の血統書を持ってきてほしいんだ

original: Go on, then. Deliver my message to Sibbi.
string: じゃあ頼んだぞ。シビに伝言を届けてくれ

original: I may not be fond of Letrush, but even I've got to admit he's got the upper hand.
string: レットラッシュは嫌いでも、奴が優位に立っている事は認めよう

original: (Sigh) Let's just kill them both, eh?
string: 両方とも殺すのか？

original: (Whimpering)
string: グスッ…　グスッ

original: (Sobbing)
string: グスッ…　グスッ

original: I… I don't know, it wasn't me. I swear!
string: し、知らん、俺じゃない。誓うよ！

original: Honest, I didn't take it!
string: 嘘じゃない。俺は盗ってない！

original: Look at me when I'm talking to you, eh?
string: 俺が話してるときはこっちを見ろ、あん？

original: You start flapping that jaw of yours or I'll start flapping it for you. You understand me?
string: 早く口を動かしな。さもなければ俺がガタガタいわせてやるぜ。分かったか？

original: Where'd you stash it?
string: どこにしまい込んだんだ？

original: Am I going have to beat it out of you? Is that what you want?
string: 手荒なことをしなきゃ口を割らないつもりか？　そうしてほしいのか？

original: What do you need, guardian?
string: 守護者よ。何が必要なの？

original: Yes, champion of Azura?
string: なにかしら？　アズラの戦士よ

original: The Twilight watches us all, guardian.
string: 守護者よ。黄昏はすべてを見ているわ

original: Just glad all that business with Malyn is over with. What did you need?
string: メイリンとの関わりあいをすべて断ち切ることができて嬉しいよ。何か必要なことはあるか？

original: I don't like doing business with Azura's faithful. Make it quick.
string: アズラの信徒を相手にするのは好きじゃない。早くしてくれ

original: No. Not like this.
string: 違う。こんなはずじゃ

original: Why is it so run down?
string: なぜこうも荒れ果てている？

original: Sad, isn't it? We can't afford to keep the place running since these attacks started.
string: 哀れだろ？　襲撃が始まって以来、管理している余裕がないんだ

original: Pirates, you see.
string: 分かるだろ、海賊のせいさ

original: Raiding all along the coast, from Hammerfell to Vvardenfell. Only the Shatter-Shields appear safe.
string: ハンマーフェルからヴァーデンフェルにかけて、沿岸地域を襲撃している。安全なのはシャッター・シールドだけのようだ

original: The pirate haven has been destroyed.
string: 海賊は壊滅させた

original: I can't express how much easier you've made my job.
string: おかげで仕事がとても楽になったよ

original: Maybe Adelaisa will finally ease up, but I expect she won't.
string: アデライサもこれで一息つけるだろう。どのみち、働くだろうがね

original: Ah, yes, your pay. The Company thanks you for your services. Should we ever be able to help you, stop by.
string: ああ、支払いだったね。尽力してくれたことに会社は感謝している。役に立てることがあれば訪ねてきてくれ

original: I know where the Blood Horkers are.
string: ブラッド・ホーカースの居場所を知っている

original: Just in time. This is Adelaisa, one of my superiors from the Company.
string: ぎりぎり間に合ったな。こちらはアデライサ。会社の上司だ

original: She's been dispatched to... eh... see to it that we get back on schedule.
string: 彼女は派遣されてきたんだ…　スケジュールを元の軌道に乗せるためにね

original: You should probably speak to her.
string: 彼女と話してみるといい

original: Have you heard of a pirate crew called the Blood Horkers?
string: ブラッド・ホーカーという海賊を聞いたことはないか？

original: Heard of them? I've been captaining a crew for 'em well on nine years now. What's it to you?
string: はは！　聞いたことがあるかって？　奴らの船長を務めて、もう9年になる。それが何だ？

original: Know about them? Lad, you're looking at them.
string: 知っている？　目の前にいるぜ

original: I hear you're a man who might know something about pirates.
string: 海賊について何か知っていると聞いた

original: Know about them? Lass, you're looking at them.
string: 知っている？　目の前にいるぜ

original: I hear you're a man who might know something about pirates.
string: 海賊について何か知っていると聞いた

original: I've got the logbook.
string: 記録簿を手に入れた

original: How did you get it? No, never mind, I probably shouldn't know.
string: どうやって手に入れた？　いや、言うな。たぶん知らない方がいいのだろう

original: I see... it looks like Suvaris has been traveling to Dawnstar to meet with a pirate crew there.
string: なるほど…　スヴァリスは海賊に会う目的でドーンスターに足を運んでるらしい

original: Get to Dawnstar and see what you can find out about these rogues. I'd wager they won't be too far from the tavern.
string: ドーンスターに行き、このならず者どもに関する情報を集めてくれ。きっと酒場の近くにいるはずだ

original: Try to find out where their fortress is. The captain, Stig Salt-Plank, has to know something.
string: 奴らの砦の場所を探ってくれ。船長のスティグ・ソルト・プランクなら何か知ってるに違いない

original: I'm glad I'll have you beside me in there. This place chills my blood, and I don't care who knows it.
string: ここに入る時に横にいてくれてよかった。この場所はゾッとするよ。恥とは思わない

original: I've returned with the courier's package.
string: 配達人の荷物を持って来た

original: I'm looking for a courier.
string: 配達人を探している

original: Seen any Stormcloak couriers lately?
string: 最近、ストームクロークの配達人を見たか？

original: Seen any Stormcloak couriers lately?
string: 最近、ストームクロークの配達人を見たか？

original: Seen any Stormcloak couriers lately?
string: 最近、ストームクロークの配達人を見たか？

original: Seen any Stormcloak couriers lately?
string: 最近、ストームクロークの配達人を見たか？

original: Seen any Stormcloak couriers lately?
string: 最近、ストームクロークの配達人を見たか？

original: Seen any Stormcloak couriers lately?
string: 最近、ストームクロークの配達人を見たか？

original: Seen any Imperial couriers lately?
string: 最近、帝国軍の配達人を見たか？

original: Seen any Imperial couriers lately?
string: 最近、帝国軍の配達人を見たか？

original: Seen any Imperial couriers lately?
string: 最近、帝国軍の配達人を見たか？

original: Seen any Imperial couriers lately?
string: 最近、帝国軍の配達人を見たか？

original: Seen any Imperial couriers lately?
string: 最近、帝国軍の配達人を見たか？

original: Seen any Imperial couriers lately?
string: 最近、帝国軍の配達人を見たか？

original: What would it take to identify the buyer? (Bribe)
string: どうしたら購入者を割り出してもらえる？(賄賂)

original: Well, now that you mention it, there is something I've been trying to get my hands on.
string: まあ、そう言うのなら。手に入れたいと思ってた物があるんだ

original: Great Malacath, we beseech you, aid us in our time of need...
string: 偉大なるマラキャスよ、どうか我らの窮地をお救い下さい…

original: What efforts would they be undermining?
string: どんなことを企んでいるんだ？

original: This! This... Orb. The Eye of Magnus, whatever you want to call it. It's clearly powerful, and no doubt they want it for themselves!
string: そうだ！　この…　オーブだ。マグナスの目だのと、何と呼ぼうとかまわんが、これは明らかに強力だ。連中もこれを欲しているに違いない！

original: I expect to be informed if they make any future attempts to contact you.
string: もし彼らが今後接触を試みてきたら、必ず私に報告しろ

original: Get to the bottom of what?
string: 真相を探れと？

original: Whatever it is those Psijics are up to. They cannot be trusted.
string: サイジックが何をやろうとしているのかは分からないが、奴らを信用する事などできん

original: For all we know, he's here to scout out the College. I'm sure they want to undermine our efforts.
string: もしかすると奴はこの大学に偵察をしにきたのかも知れない。我々の研究を妨げようとでもしているんだろう

original: I'm not sure what just happened but I assure you I will get to the bottom of it.
string: いま何が起こったのか、よくは分からんが、必ず突き止めてみせるぞ

original: I am not "up to" anything. I apologize if I have offended in any way.
string: 何も“企んで”などいない。気分を害したというのなら謝る

original: What? What trickery is this? You're not going anywhere until I find out what you're up to!
string: なに？　これは何の真似だ？　お前が何を企んでいるのか判るまで、どこにも行かせんぞ！

original: There's been a misunderstanding. Clearly I should not be here. I shall simply take my leave.
string: 誤解があったようだ。明らかにここに来るべきではなかった。立ち去るとしよう

original: Don't play coy. You asked to see a specific member of the College. Here he is. Now what is it that you want?
string: 隠し立てをするな。大学のとある在籍者に会いたいと言ったのはお前だろう。さあ、彼はここだ。一体何をしに来たのだ？

original: Don't play coy. You asked to see a specific member of the College. Here she is. Now what is it that you want?
string: 隠し立てをするな。大学のとある在籍者に会いたいと言ったのはお前だろう。さあ、彼女はここだ。一体何をしに来たのだ？

original: I'm sorry, I'm afraid I don't understand.
string: すまないが、分からないんだ

original: Well? What is the meaning of this?
string: で？　これは何のつもりだ？

original: None can stand against the Wolf Queen!
string: 狼の女王には誰も勝てない！

original: I can see to that. We'll need plenty of fresh corpses to rebuild her army, you see.
string: よく分かるよ。彼女の軍隊を再建するためには、大量の新しい死体が必要になるとね

original: You've come far, mortal. No doubt you seek to enter Potema's Sanctum.
string: よくここまで来たな、定命の者よ、長い旅だったな。ポテマの聖域に入ったんだろう

original: Did she, now? Well, as it turns out, there are a few lingering contracts we haven't had the chance to complete just yet.
string: 彼女が？　確かにちょっと手のつけられなかった仕事がいくつか残ってる

original: And more, dribbling in from time to time. I'll assign them to you as they become available. To be completed at your leisure.
string: それに、新しい仕事が時々舞い込んできたりもする。準備ができたら回そう。都合がいい時にやってくれ

original: Astrid said you'd have some work for me.
string: アストリッドから、仕事があると聞いて来た

original: So what's the plan?
string: それで、何をすればいい？

original: Head to the Riften jail and talk to Sibbi. Get him to tell you where Frost and his Lineage Papers are and bring them to me outside Riften.
string: リフテン監獄でシビと話してほしい。フロストの居場所と血統書の在処を聞いて、両方とも私に届けてほしいんだ。リフテンの街の外でね

original: You'll be well paid for your time.
string: 手間賃ははずむよ

original: But this is supposed to be your work.
string: だが、これはお前の仕事だ

original: I really don't have time to deal with you right now. Please just let me get back to my work.
string: 今は相手をしている時間がないの。仕事に戻らせてちょうだい

original: Here's the ring.
string: さあ、指輪だ

original: Excellent! Sorry it didn't work out with you and your lady. I know how excited you were for the wedding.
string: ありがとう！　これがあなた達の役に立たなくて残念だわ。結婚式をあれほど楽しみにしてたのにね

original: You kept saying it would be a huge ceremony at Morvunskar. You said you even had some magic staff there that would handle all the guests.
string: モルブンスカーでは盛大な式を挙げるって何度も言ってたわね。招待客全員に効果のある魔法の杖を使うとも

original: What was that story about my fiancee?
string: 婚約者の話とはどんな？

original: How could you forget? It was the sweetest story I'd ever heard.
string: 忘れたの？　今まで聞いた中で一番素敵な話だったわ

original: You met at the full moon, under the biggest tree in Witchmist Grove, surrounded by fireflies. It was straight out of a storybook.
string: 満月の日に、ホタルの光につつまれながら、ウィッチミスト・グローブの一番大きな木の下で出会ったのでしょう。まるで夢の世界ね

original: Yeah, I've been getting that a lot.
string: ああ、それは何度も聞いた

original: Aw, what's wrong? Did the engagement fall through? Look, how about we call it even, as long as you bring back the wedding ring?
string: どうしたの？　婚約は破棄でしょう？　結婚指輪を返してくれたら、すべてチャラにしてあげる

original: That's really a shame - I was so looking forward to the wedding. You said you'd have all the most interesting guests.
string: とても残念だわ。とても結婚式を楽しみにしていたのに。素敵な招待客ばかりと言っていたっけね

original: Okay, how much do I owe you?
string: 分かった、いくら借りがある？

original: It's not about the money, really. I wouldn't have given you the wedding ring on credit if you weren't so obviously in love.
string: 問題はお金じゃないの。見るからに恋に落ちてるように見えたから、ツケで結婚指輪を渡してあげたのに

original: But if there isn't going to be a wedding, the least you can do is give the ring back. That was one of my best pieces.
string: もし結婚式を挙げないなら、せめてその指輪を返して。とても出来のいいものなの

original: (forcegreet)
string: (強制会話)

original: So, you're finally back. Look, I've been patient, but you still owe me.
string: やっと戻ってきたのね。ずいぶん待ったわ、あなたには貸しがまだあるのよ

original: Here's your goat. Now can you help me retrace my steps?
string: さあ、ヤギだ。来た道を辿る手助けをしてくれるか？

original: Gleda! And not a scratch on her! Happy day!
string: グレダ！　しかも無傷で！　こりゃめでたい！

original: I still can't figure out why you stole her. You left a note explaining it, but half of it was gibberish and the rest had mead spilled on it.
string: あんたがなぜ盗んだのか、いまだに分からない。メモの説明は半分が意味不明で、残りはこぼしたハチミツ酒のせいで読めなくなってたからな

original: Only bit I could make out was "repaying Ysolda in Whiterun," and even that's mostly scribbles. Guess you could try there.
string: “ホワイトランでイソルダに借りを返してから”ってのはどうにか読み取れたが、それだって殴り書きだ。まあ、そこに行ってみる事だな

original: What happened with Gleda again? I'm a little fuzzy on that.
string: グレダに何が起こったって？ あまり思い出せない

original: You really don't remember stealing a goat and selling her to a Giant? Are you thick?
string: ヤギを盗み、巨人に売っ払っておきながら、まるで憶えてないだと？　頭は大丈夫か？

original: Go get her! At least she's bound to follow you back - you smell just like the fermented feed she likes.
string: 早く連れ戻してくれ！　きっとついてくるはずだ。あんたはグレダの好きな発酵飼料の匂いがするからな

original: That sounds pretty bad...
string: それはお気の毒に…

original: You're damned right it does. I'll never breed another prize-winning goat like Gleda!
string: そうとも。グレダみたいに立派なヤギは、もう二度と育てられないだろうよ！

original: And don't you think of coming back to Rorikstead until you get her back from that Giant.
string: あの巨人からグレダを取り返してくるまで、ロリクステッドに戻ってこようなんて思わないことだ

original: I have no idea what you're talking about.
string: 何の話をしているのか分からない

original: Is that so? Does the name Gleda ring a bell? The star beauty of my farm? Kidnapped by a drunk lout and sold to a Giant?
string: グレダって名に聞き覚えがないだって？　うちの看板娘で、酔っ払いにさらわれたあげく、巨人に売り飛ばされたあのグレダだぞ？

original: You'd better remember her right fast, before I call the guards and have you hauled away.
string: 今すぐグレダのことを思い出した方がいいぞ。さもなきゃ衛兵を呼んでしょっぴかせてやる

original: I'm sorry?
string: すまない

original: Sorry's not good enough! Not while my Gleda is still out there, alone and afraid. You kidnapped her and sold her to that Giant.
string: 謝ってすむか！　グレダは今も独りぼっちで怯えてるんだぞ。あんたが彼女をさらって巨人に売ってしまったばっかりに

original: (forcegreet)
string: (強制会話)

original: You! You've got a lot of nerve showing yourself in this town again. What do you have to say for yourself?
string: あんたか！　よくも顔が出せたもんだ。どんな申し開きをするつもりだ？

original: If you had to kill your own brother to be allowed back home, you'd think twice as well.
string: 再び故郷へ帰るために自分の兄弟を殺す必要があるなら、よく考えるべきだろう

original: Don't tell me you, of all people, are afraid of a battle.
string: 戦いが怖いなどと、お前ともあろう者の口から聞きたくない

original: I would need to challenge the chief, and take his head, to return home. I'd rather stay here.
string: 族長に挑まなくてはいけないだろう。そして首を取って家に戻る。ここに留まりたいからな

original: I really do apologize. I think I've picked up everything.
string: 本当に申し訳ない。すべて拾えたと思う

original: I suppose that'll do. Dibella teaches us forgiveness, after all. Even for a drunk like you.
string: それで良いわ。ディベラは許す事を教えているわけだし。あなたのような酔っ払いであってもね

original: DialogueGenericSharedInfo
string: DialogueGenericSharedInfo

original: Is someone there?
string: 誰かいるのか？

original: What was that?
string: 今のは何だ？

original: Huh?
string: んん？

original: Where are you?
string: どこにいる？

original: You can't hide from me!
string: 隠れたって無駄だ！

original: Over here!
string: こっちだ！

original: Be careful!
string: 気をつけろ！

original: Hey, watch it!
string: おい、危ないぞ！

original: Don't do that.
string: やめろ

original: What are you doing that for?
string: 何でそんな事をする？

original: You could have just asked.
string: ほしいと言えばよかったものを

original: I saw you do that, you know.
string: やるところを見たんだ

original: Ha! Found you!
string: はっ！　見つけたぞ！

original: What do you think you're doing?
string: 何をする気だ？

original: You're not supposed to be in here.
string: ここはお前のいる場所じゃない

original: Oh no! By the gods! This can't be happening!
string: 何と恐ろしい！　こんな事はあり得ん

original: You dirty thief!
string: このコソドロ！

original: Stop, thief!
string: 待て！　盗賊め！

original: I understand.
string: 分かった

original: Of course.
string: もちろんだ

original: How much?
string: いくらだ？

original: It can't be helped.
string: 仕方ない

original: Not my problem.
string: 知った事ではない

original: It would seem so.
string: そのようだ

original: It's all in this note.
string: ここに全部書いてある

original: You've done well.
string: よくやった

original: Maybe you can help me.
string: 助けてほしい

original: Thank you. Here, this is for you.
string: ありがとう。さあ、受け取ってくれ

original: Just bring it back to me.
string: ただそれを持ち帰ってくれればいい

original: I can pay you.
string: 謝礼は払う

original: Okay. Just this once.
string: いいだろう。今回だけだ

original: How can I argue with that?
string: 嫌とは言えないな

original: Okay, okay. You've talked me into it.
string: 分かった。お前には負けたよ

original: No need to get rough!
string: 手荒な真似をするな！

original: Whatever you say!
string: 何でも言うとおりにする！

original: Don't hurt me! You win.
string: 暴力はやめてくれ！　負けを認める

original: A little coin always greases the wheels.
string: ちょっとした心付けで物事は円滑に進むものだ

original: Gold solves most problems, doesn't it?
string: たいていの問題は金で解決できる。そうは思わないか？

original: For that price? Sure.
string: それが提示額か？　いいだろう

original: You expect me to believe that?
string: そんな事を信じるとでも？

original: Nah. I don't think so.
string: いいや、そうは思わない

original: That doesn't change anything.
string: それじゃ何も変わらない

original: I'll teach you to talk to me that way!
string: 口の利き方がなっちゃいないな！

original: Hope you're willing to back those words up with your fists!
string: そんな口を叩いて、やれるもんならやってみろ！

original: I don't have to take that from you!
string: お前にそんな事をされる筋合いはない

original: What? Nooo!
string: 何なんだ？　ぎゃあー！

original: We've got an assassin! Check the shadows!
string: 暗殺者だ！　影を調べろ！

original: Gods help us!
string: ああ、神よ！

original: What in the...?
string: 一体…？

original: What are you staring at, you worthless piece of gutter trash? I simply must start locking the doors again...
string: なにをジロジロ見てるのよ、この役立たずのクズ野郎！　また扉に鍵を掛けるようにしなくちゃ…

original: (Remain silent)
string: (黙っている)

original: Aretino? Why that little bastard! You tell him I'm coming for him! And when I find him, it will be the beating of his miserable life!
string: アレティノですって？　あのろくでなし！　覚悟しとけと伝えて。見つけたら、ひどい目に遭わせてやる！

original: Aventus Aretino says hello.
string: アベンタス・アレティノが、よろしく言っていた

original: The what? Why how dare you! I will not be intimidated in my own orphanage! Get out! Get out this instant!
string: なんですって！？　よくもまあ！　この孤児院で私を脅しても無駄よ。出て行け！　今すぐ出て行きなさい！

original: The Dark Brotherhood has come, Grelod.
string: 闇の一党になり代わって来たぞ、グレロッド

original: I have a family heirloom you can have. Supposed to be sort of valuable. I hope that's all right.
string: うちの家宝をあげるよ。値打ちがあるものだと思う。それで足りるといいんだけど

original: Assassinations don't come cheap, boy.
string: 暗殺ってのは安くないんだよ、坊や

original: Finally! My prayers have been answered!
string: やった！　僕の祈りが届いたんだ！

original: You've come at last! I knew you would!
string: ついに来てくれた。来てくれると思ってた！

original: Grelod is the headmistress of Honorhall Orphanage. But not for long.
string: グレロッドはオナーホール孤児院の院長だよ。でももう長くないかな

original: It's Honorhall Orphanage, in Riften.
string: リフテンのオナーホール孤児院だよ

original: Please don't kill Constance Michel. She really is kind.
string: コンスタンス・ミシェルは殺さないで。あの人は本当にいい人だから

original: Well? Is it done?
string: どう？　終わった？

original: Grelod the Kind. Is she... you know?
string: 親切者のグレロッドだけど…　どう？

original: What do you want? You have no business being in here!
string: 何しに来た？　ここに用事などないだろう！

original: Riff-raff! That's all you Riften people are!
string: ろくでなしめ！　リフテンの奴らはみんなろくでなしだ！

original: This is an orphanage, not an inn. Begone from here.
string: ここは宿屋じゃない、孤児院だ。帰りなさい

original: You don't scare me.
string: あんたなんか恐くないよ

original: You're trying to frighten me, hmm? Do your worst!
string: 脅そうって言うのかい？　えっ？　やれるもんならやってみな！

original: Contract?
string: 仕事？

original: My mother, she... she died. I... I'm all alone now. So they sent me to that terrible orphanage in Riften. Honorhall.
string: 母さんが…　死んだんだ。それで僕はひとりぼっちになって、リフテンのひどい孤児院に送られた。オナーホール孤児院だよ

original: The headmistress is an evil, cruel woman. They call her Grelod the Kind. But she's not kind. She's terrible. To all of us.
string: 院長は悪人で、ひどい女なんだ。親切者のグレロッドなんて呼ばれてるけど、親切なんかじゃない。僕らみんなをオモチャみたいに扱うんだ

original: So I ran away, and came home. And performed the Black Sacrament. Now you're here! And you can kill Grelod the Kind!
string: だから逃げ出して、家に戻ってきたんだ。それで、黒き聖餐をしたらあなたが来てくれた！　あの親切者のグレロッドを殺してよ！

original: (Remain silent)
string: (黙っている)

original: You don't have to say anything. There's no need. You're here, so I know you'll accept my contract.
string: 何も言わないでいいよ。必要ない。来たからには、仕事を受けてくれるんでしょ

original: Yes, of course... The Black Sacrament...
string: ああ、もちろん… 黒き聖餐だからな…

original: It took so long. So very long. But now that you're here, you can accept my contract.
string: 時間がかかったよ。本当に長かった。だけど来てくれたし、仕事を受けてくれるよね

original: I'm sorry boy, but I'm not who you think I am.
string: 悪いな、少年。君が思っているような者ではないんだ

original: Of course you are! I prayed, and you came, and now you'll accept my contract!
string: いいや、そうだよ！　祈ったらあなたが来たんだから。お願いだから仕事を受けて！

original: Are you all right?
string: 大丈夫か？

original: It worked! I knew you'd come, I just knew it!
string: 成功だ！　来てくれると思ってた、やっぱりだ！

original: I did the Black Sacrament, over and over. With the body, and the... the things. And then you came! An assassin from the Dark Brotherhood!
string: 黒き聖餐をしたんだ、何度も何度も。死体と…　あれを使って。そうしたら来てくれた！　闇の一党の暗殺者だ！

original: Was a man named Sam with me?
string: サムという男と一緒ではなかったか？

original: Dibella teaches love and compassion, but that doesn't mean we're just going to tell you what you want to know and let you walk away from this.
string: ディベラは愛と慈悲を教えているけど、だからと言ってただで質問に答えてもらって、そのまま帰っていいわけないでしょ

original: Pick up your mess, then apologize, and if we think you're sincere we'll consider lending you aid.
string: ゴミを拾って、それから謝ってね。あなたが真剣だと思ったら手を貸してあげてもいいわ

original: (forcegreet)
string: (強制会話)

original: Wake up!
string: 起きなさい！

original: That's right, it's time to wake up, you drunken blasphemer!
string: そうよ、さっさと起きなさい。この、飲んだくれの冒涜者！

original: Let me think about it.
string: 考えてみる

original: Thanks, I guess.
string: 一応、礼を言う

original: My pleasure. But I think it's time for you to go. No fun keeping you locked up in here with the staff.
string: 気にするな。だが、もう行ったらどうだ？　杖を持ったお前を閉じ込めても、つまらんからな

original: Why did you choose me?
string: どうして自分を選んだ？

original: Let's be honest, here. I don't always think my decisions through.  But you... you're going places.
string: 正直に言うと、いつも深くは考えたりしない。だが…　旅をしとるんだろう？

original: Maybe a little influence from your old uncle Sanguine could help adjust your course a bit...
string: お前のおじであるサングインからの影響が、進むべき道をわずかに修正する助けになるかも知れんな…

original: So all of this was just a prank?
string: それじゃ、ただのお遊びだったのか？

original: Just a prank? Just a prank? The Daedric Lord of Debauchery does not deal in mere "pranks."
string: 何？　お遊びだと？　放蕩を司るデイドラの王は、単なる“お遊び”などに興じたりはしない

original: This may have begun as a minor amusement, but it wasn't long before I realized you'd make a more interesting bearer of my not-quite-holy staff.
string: 最初は、ちょっとした楽しみだった。だが、すぐに分かったぞ。この神聖とは言えない杖を持つのにふさわしい者だとな

original: (forcegreet)
string: (強制会話)

original: I really just needed something to encourage you to go out into the world and spread merriment.
string: 世界に出て様々な喜びに触れたい、そんな気持ちにさせる何かが必要だった

original: And you did just that! I haven't been so entertained in at least a hundred years.
string: そしてそれを成し遂げたな！　ここ100年で、一番嬉しい出来事だ

original: I could sure use a staff like that...
string: 便利そうな杖だ

original: So... you were telling me a tale?
string: で… 物語を聞かせたいのか？

original: What did I do? Please, whatever it is, I'm sorry.
string: 何かまずいことをしたか？　何にせよ、悪かった

original: I don't have time for this nonsense. I've got a home to keep and children to feed. Now let me out of here!
string: こんな下らない事をしている時間はないの。家も守らなくちゃ、子供に食べさせなくちゃ。さあ、帰してちょうだい！

original: Tell you what. You release me, and I promise my associates won't hunt you down like an animal and butcher you in the street. It's a win-win.
string: こうしよう。逃がしてくれたら、仲間達がお前を動物のように狩って路上で殺すような事はしないと約束する。これはお互いにとっていい話だ

original: Who are you?
string: お前は誰だ？

original: My name is Fultheim. I'm a soldier. Well, mercenary, really. You know, a... a sellsword. I've lived in Skyrim all my life.
string: 名前はフルサイム、兵士だ。というか、実際のところ傭兵だな…　剣で生計を立ててるのさ。生まれも育ちもスカイリムだ

original: That's all! I'm a nobody, really. So can't you just let me go?
string: それだけだ！　それ以外の何者でもない。だからもう解放してくれないか？

original: None of your damned business who I am! If you're going to kill me, just do it already!
string: 誰だなんて、あんたの知った事か！　殺すんだったら、さっさと殺しなさいよ！

original: As Mara is my witness, if I didn't have this hood on right now I would spit right in your face...
string: こんな袋を被されていなかったら、アンタの顔のどまんなかに唾をかけてやるのに…

original: Ahhh... Vasha, at your service. Obtainer of goods, taker of lives, and defiler of daughters.
string: おお…　ヴァシャだ。物を取り、命を奪い、娘達を汚す者

original: Have you not heard of me? Perhaps I will have my people carve my name in your corpse, as a reminder.
string: ヴァシャを知らない？　者どもに命じてお前の死体に名を刻ませる事にするか、忘れないように

original: Would someone pay to have you killed?
string: あなたを殺すために、誰かが金を出したのか？

original: What? Oh gods, I don't want to die...
string: 何だって？　まさか、そんな、死にたくない…

original: Excuse me? What kind of question is that?
string: え、何ですって？　どういう質問なのよ？

original: Me? Ha! Are you serious?
string: 殺す？　まさか！　本気で訊いてるのか？

original: Did you ever want to return to your stronghold? Go back to your family?
string: 要塞に戻りたいと思ったことは？　家族のもとへ戻りたいと思わないか？

original: You didn't die. A battle you live through is a great honor.
string: お前は死ななかった。戦い抜いた事は大変な名誉だ

original: There you are. Look, I... I just wanted to say thanks for coming to find me. Back in Dawnstar. Crazy jester finally met his match, am I right?
string: 来てくれたか。なあ、俺は…　いや、とにかく探しに来てくれてありがとう。ドーンスターに戻ってくれ。あのイカれた道化師もついに相応の報いを受けたんだろう？

original: The anticipation is killing me. Can you figure out who has the contract? Which one will you choose?
string: 気になって仕方ないわ。誰の仕事？　あなたはどれを選ぶつもり？

original: That twisted jester will pay for what's he's done...
string: あの道化師め、必ずその報いを受ける日がくるわ…

original: I'm afraid I don't have a primary contract for you yet.
string: 悪いけど、あなたの初仕事はまだなの

original: Why am I not surprised to learn Cicero is alive? I still can't stomach the little clown, but if you've welcomed him here, I won't question it.
string: シセロが生きていると知ってもそれほど驚きがないな。あの小さな道化師はやはり我慢ならない奴だが、あいつをここに迎え入れても異議は唱えないでおこう

original: Maybe I'll make the Potage le Magnifique, hmm? You may have killed the Gourmet, but true artistry never dies.
string: ポタージュ・ル・マグニフィークを作ってやろう、な？　お前は美食家を殺したかも知れんが、真の芸術性は決して死なないんだ

original: Maybe I'll make the Potage le Magnifique, hmm? But not the way you make it! Ha ha ha. No, certainly not...
string: ポタージュ・ル・マグニフィークを作ってやろう、な？　だがお前の作り方とは違うぞ！　ハハハ、まあ、当然だがな…

original: I've been expecting you.
string: 待っていたぞ

original: Should have figured the little lunatic would completely snap.
string: あのイカれた奴が完全にイカれる事を予想しておくべきだったな

original: So, what of the old beggar, Narfi? Is it done? Has he groveled for his last septim?
string: さて、あの年老いた物乞いのナルフィの件はどうなった？　奴は最後の物乞いをしたのか？

original: How went your meeting with Ennodius Papius? Did you prove his paranoia legitimate?
string: エノディウス・パピウスとの会合はどうだった？　彼の妄想が間違いでない事を証明したか？

original: I see you're back from Dawnstar. Beitild lies dead, I hope?
string: ドーンスターから戻ってきたんだな。ベイティルドは死の床についたんだろうな？

original: You're alive. Then I guess you haven't paid a visit to the vampire yet, hmm?
string: お前が生きているという事は、まだ吸血鬼を訪問してないのだろう、な？

original: Please tell me you flayed that horrible bard alive and made a drum from his skin...
string: あのおぞましい吟遊詩人の皮を生きたままはいで、その皮で太鼓を作ったんだろう…

original: Taken care of that layabout Deekus, yet? Or does the idea of killing a fellow Argonian make your scales crawl?
string: あの怠け者のディーカスは始末したか？　それとも仲間のアルゴニアンを殺すのはやはり気が引けるのか？

original: No new boots? Does this mean the Argonian is still alive?
string: ブーツが新しくなっていないな？　という事は、あのアルゴニアンはまだ生きてるのか？

original: You smell like dead cat. Can I assume Ma'randru-jo has been taken care of?
string: 死んだ猫のような臭いがするな。という事は、マランドゥル・ジョーは始末したんだな？

original: How went your encounter with  Ma'randru-jo? Back in Hammerfell, I always loved watching two cats rip each other to shreds...
string: マランドゥル・ジョーとのご対面はどうだった？　ハンマーフェルにいた頃は、猫のケンカを見るのが好きだったな。お互いがズタズタになるまで…

original: Hmph. No arrows protruding from your skull... Can I assume Anoriath is dead, then?
string: ふむ。頭に矢が刺さってないな…　という事は、アノリアスは死んだのか？

original: Ah, back from Fort Graymoor. The old servant has been put out of her misery, I hope?
string: ああ、グレイムーア砦から戻ってきたのか。あの老いぼれ使用人は、人生の悲劇から救われたんだな？

original: So, you've returned from Mzinchaleft! A Dwarven ruin... what an exotic place for a kill. Assuming Maluril is actually... dead?
string: ムジンチャレフトからご帰還か！　あのドワーフの遺跡…　殺しの現場としては最高にエキゾチックだな。ではマルリルは…　死んだのか？

original: Back from your little vacation in Falkreath. So, did you enjoy the sights, sample the food... kill the housecarl?
string: ファルクリースへの小旅行からお戻りか。現地の景色や食事を楽しんでから…　あの私兵を殺したんだな？

original: You haven't faced that pirate captain yet, have you? Safia? I only ask because you're still alive...
string: まだあの海賊の船長と対決してないようだな。そうだろう？　名前はサフィアだったかな？　まだ生きてるから聞いてるんだが…

original: So many contracts, so little time...
string: 仕事はたくさんあるが、時間が足りない…

original: Will there ever come a time when the people of Skyrim no longer need our services? I think not.
string: スカイリムの人々が我々を必要としなくなる時が来るのか？　ありえんね

original: Still here? What's the matter, can't handle what I'm throwing your way?
string: まだここにいるのか？　何か問題でもあるのか、それとも提供した仕事が手に負えないのか？

original: I wish I had more contracts to dole out. You handled those jobs like a born killer.
string: もっと仕事を与えられればいいのだが。生まれながらの殺し屋と言うべき、見事な手際だった

original: You reek of death, my friend. I salute you.
string: 同志よ、血の臭いを漂わせる者よ。お前に敬意を表する

original: Remember the passphrase: "Silence, my brother."
string: 暗号を忘れないで。“沈黙せよ、我が同胞”よ

original: The Sanctuary is in the southern Pine Forest. Close to the road, but away from prying eyes.
string: 聖域は南のパイン・フォレストにあるわ。街道の近くだけど、人目に付かないところよ

original: Have you talked to Nazir? He's sure to have some additional contracts for you.
string: ナジルとは話したの？　彼ならきっと追加の仕事をくれるはずよ

original: I don't have anything for you just yet. Please, talk to Nazir, and see what he has available.
string: まだ何もないの。お願い、ナジルに話してみて。何かあるかも知れない

original: I'm still trying to find a suitable contract for you. Continue to work with Nazir on the, um, supplemental assignments.
string: いまだにあなたに合った任務を探しているところなの。ナジルとの仕事を続けて。その…　補足的な仕事をね

original: The Keeper will be arriving soon, with the body of the Night Mother. So many preparations to be made...
string: 番人はもうすぐ到着するわ、夜母の遺体と共にね。大変な準備になりそうだわ…

original: Go, take care of the Muiri contract. There will be plenty more, I promise you.
string: ムイリの仕事を片づけてきて。今後も仕事はたくさんあるわ、約束する

original: Why are you still standing there? Hurry, before the meeting begins.
string: なぜまだそこにいるの？　急いで、密会が始まってしまうわ

original: Speak with Nazir and see if he has any contracts available. I need time to read Motierre's letter.
string: ナジルに話して、仕事がないか聞いてみて。私はモティエールの手紙を読まなければならないの

original: What are you waiting for? My husband is out there somewhere with that lunatic. Find them! Do what you've been tasked to do!
string: 何を待っているの？　私の夫はあのイカれた奴と一緒なのよ。彼らを見つけて！　任務をしっかりと遂行するのよ！

original: Shouldn't you be out ruining someone's special day?
string: 誰かの特別な日を台なしにしていてはいけないわ

original: Ah, good to see you, brother. Gearing up to kill the Emperor? Exciting times. Exciting times, indeed.
string: ああ、よくきてくれた。皇帝を暗殺する準備か？　血が騒いで仕方がないな

original: Ah, good to see you, sister. Gearing up to kill the Emperor? Exciting times. Exciting times, indeed.
string: ああ、よくきてくれた、姉妹よ。皇帝を暗殺する準備か？　血が騒いで仕方がないな

original: Cicero is at your service, oh great and powerful Listener!
string: 偉大なる強き聞こえし者よ、シセロに何なりとご命令を！

original: Let's kill someone.
string: 誰か殺そうよ

original: Citizen?
string: 市民か

original: You must be lost. The tavern is down the road a piece.
string: 道に迷ったんだな。酒場ならその道の少し先だ

original: I'm fairly certain you wandered into the wrong building, friend...
string: 友よ、間違えてこの建物に迷い込んだのだろう

original: Yes, Listener?
string: 何だ、聞こえし者よ？

original: I am yours to command.
string: 何でも命じてくれ

original: How may I serve you, my Listener?
string: ご用は何でしょう、我が聞こえし者よ？

original: Yes, Listener? How may I serve you?
string: はい、聞こえし者？　ご用は何でしょう？

original: Listener. It is an honor to stand before you.
string: 聞こえし者。御前に立つことが出来て光栄です

original: How may I serve you, my Listener?
string: ご用は何でしょう、我が聞こえし者よ？

original: Please...
string: 頼むから…

original: What is it you want?
string: 何が望みなんだ？

original: Just... just stop. And I'll tell you where I've hidden my treasure.
string: ちょっと…　待ってくれ。宝を隠した場所を教えるよ

original: It's... in a hollowed-out rock. In the tundra. A bit west of Whiterun. Now please... please stop.
string: ツンドラの…　穴のあいた岩の中だ。ホワイトランの少し西にある。だから頼む…　頼むから待ってくれ

original: Oh gods, you've taken everything I have. Just kill me and be done with it...
string: ああ、あんたはすべてを取り上げた。さあ殺せ、そして終わりにしろ…

original: Why are you people doing this?
string: あんた達はどうしてこんな事をしてるんだい？

original: Is it information you want?
string: それが知りたい情報かい？

original: This... this is about the inheritance, isn't it? All right! I'll tell you where I've hidden it.
string: これは…　これは遺産に関する事だね？　分かった！　それを隠した場所を教えてあげるよ

original: It's in a hollowed-out tree stump. In the marsh, south of Solitude. Now please, you'll let me go now. Right?
string: それは、ソリチュードの南の沼地にある、穴のあいた切り株の中だ。さあ、もう行ってもいいだろ？

original: Why don't you be a dear and let me go now. All right? I won't say a word to anyone. Our little secret. I promise.
string: もういい加減に行かせておくれよ。いいだろ？　誰にも言わない。二人だけの秘密だ。約束するよ

original: You... you can't do this to me...
string: あなた…　どうしてそんなことを…

original: Do you have any idea who I am? When my father hears about this, he will gut you.
string: 私が誰か分からないの？　父がこのことを聞いたら、はらわたを抜かれるわよ

original: Ah, now I understand. This is about that my father's hidden cache, isn't it? The dowry for my wedding.
string: ああ、分かったわ。これは父の隠し財産に関係あるんでしょ。私の結婚持参金なのよ

original: Ha! Well it's safely hidden away, in a hollowed-out tree stump. Just outside Riften, tucked away nice and secure. You'll never find it.
string: 安全に隠してあるわ。穴のあいた切り株にね。リフテンのすぐ外の、安全な場所にたっぷりため込んでるの。見つけられっこないわ

original: Damn it. I gave it away, didn't I?
string: しまった！　ばらしちゃった

original: I'll tell you anything. Anything! Just please stop... hurting me...
string: 何でも話す。何でもだ！　だから…　助けてくれ…

original: I just...  can't take the pain. Not a second longer.
string: 痛みに…　耐えられない。これ以上は無理だ

original: I'll give you money. Treasure. I have some things hidden away. Take them all. They're yours. Just please... stop.
string: 金も、宝もやる。隠したものがあるんだ。全部やるから、持っていけ。頼む…　やめてくれ

original: Just north of Windhelm. There's a hollowed-out rock. I have some things hidden in there. Take them! They're yours.
string: ウィンドヘルムのちょうど北だ。穴のあいた岩がある。そこに隠したものがある。持っていけ！　そいつをやる

original: I've told you everything I can. I don't know what else you could want...
string: 話せることは全部話した。他に何が望みなんだ…

original: So... wait. Cicero is alive? And we're all friends again? I swear, I can hardly keep up...
string: ちょっと…　待って。シセロは生きているの？　また友達になれるの？　信じられない…

original: You know, I can still sell you some potions and such, or train you in alchemy.
string: あのね、まだポーションなんかを売ってあげることも、錬金術の訓練をしてあげることもできるわ

original: I like it here. We should have moved to Dawnstar ages ago.
string: ここが好きなの。もっと早くドーンスターに来るべきだったわ

original: I can't wait to see what the future brings.
string: これから何が起こるか、楽しみで待ちきれないわ

original: Do you need alchemy components? Or training?
string: 錬金術の素材が必要なの？　それとも訓練？

original: Hello, Listener.
string: こんにちは、聞こえし者さん

original: What do you think? Some more Nirnroot, maybe?
string: どう思う？　ニルンルートをもう少し、かな？

original: I learned to cook from my father. Ah, but that was a long time ago. Before, you know... I killed him. But let's not talk about that now.
string: 料理は父から習った。ずいぶん昔の事だ。ほら、俺が…　父を殺す前にさ。だが今その話はやめておこう

original: I'll follow you till I'm dust in the breeze. You do realize that?
string: 風に舞うほこりになるまでついて行くよ。分かるかな？

original: This place is already starting to feel like home. Must be all the bloodstains.
string: ここは早くも家のようになっている。血痕があちこちにあるせいか

original: What do you need, Listener?
string: 何の用だ、聞こえし者よ？

original: Listener, please... if Cicero is going to be a part of this Sanctuary I'll accept that. But can't you do something about the... dancing?
string: 聞こえし者よ、頼む…　シセロがこの聖域の一部になるのなら、それは受け入れよう。だがあのダンスについては…　なんとかならないか？

original: Got to admit, I find the Night Mother's presence... comforting.
string: 認めないとな、夜母の存在を…　慰めになると分かったよ

original: The new initiates are working out well. Eager, dedicated, and not afraid to get their hands wet.
string: 新入り達はうまくやっている。熱心で、献身的で、手を汚す事も恐れない

original: Things proceeding well, Listener?
string: 万事順調か、聞こえし者よ？

original: Yes, Listener?
string: 何だ、聞こえし者よ？

original: The Dark Brotherhood is on the rise again, Listener. I can feel it.
string: 闇の一党は再び隆盛を極めるぞ、聞こえし者よ。そんな気がするんだ

original: Cicero can talk for a moment. Just a moment. Then Mother must be... tended to.
string: 少しならシセロも話せるよ。本当に少しだけだよ。そしたら母の…　面倒を見ないといけない

original: Oh, I do wish to get to know you better. But I must tend to mother. Maybe we can talk for just a moment...
string: ああ、確かにお前の事をもっと知りたい。だけど母の面倒を見ないと。少しだけなら話せるかも…

original: Yes, Listener? How can Cicero be of service?
string: 何だい、聞こえし者？　どうすればシセロは役に立てる？

original: Aha! I knew you could do it! I just knew it! I knew the Dark Brotherhood would save me!
string: やった！　やってくれると思ってた！　やっぱりだ！　闇の一党が助けてくれるって信じてた！

original: Here, just like I promised. This should fetch you a nice price. And thank you. Thank you again.
string: はい、これが約束のもの。きっといい値段がつくよ。ありがとう。本当にありがとう

original: Grelod the Kind is dead.
string: 親切者のグレロッドは死んだ

original: Where would I go to join up?
string: どこへ行けば船に乗れる？

original: Well I can't just tell that to any skeever that washes up.
string: さあ、皿洗いのスキーヴァーには教えられないな

original: From the look of you, I'm guessing you're more looking to cause some trouble for the Horkers.
string: 顔つきから見て、お前はホーカーに面倒をもたらしそうだ

original: Haldyn will take my hide for this, but Skyrim's been feeling a bit confining lately.
string: ハルディンに皮をはがれるだろうが、最近のスカイリムは少し息苦しい感じだ

original: We draw council at Japhet's Folly. The fools in Windhelm won't go near it, which is fine by us.
string: 俺達はジャフェット・フォリーで会合を開く。ウィンドヘルムの間抜けどもは近寄らないから都合がいい

original: If you'll pardon me now, my crew needs gathering. Should be in Hammerfell before the other Horkers know who let slip their secret.
string: それじゃあ失礼するよ。船員を集めねばな。誰が秘密を漏らしたか、他のホーカーが気づく前にハンマーフェルへ着かないとな

original: So where are the Blood Horkers?
string: ブラッド・ホーカーの場所は？

original: You miss them? I don't know how many times I feared for my life.
string: 懐かしいか？　何度命拾いしたか分からない

original: There were many good battles, friend. I miss those days.
string: 数々の熱い戦いがあった、友よ。あの頃が懐かしいな

original: Why not fight back?
string: なぜ抵抗しない？

original: Our own security forces are limited, and all the mercenaries are tied up in this ridiculous war.
string: 自前の保安軍は戦力が限られているし、傭兵は皆、バカげた戦争につきっきりだ

original: We don't even know their base of operations, and attacking single ships won't really solve the problem.
string: 連中がどこを拠点にしてるかすら分からないし、船を1隻ずつ攻撃しても根本的な問題の解決にはならない

original: Do you remember the Legion? Fighting the Thalmor in the Great War?
string: 帝国軍を覚えているか？　大戦でサルモールと戦った？

original: I doubt the Forsworn would risk holding this mine a second time. They lost many of their warriors.
string: フォースウォーンがあえて再びこの鉱山を保有するとは思えない。多くの戦士を失ったのだから

original: Are you worried the Forsworn might return?
string: フォースウォーンが戻ってこないか心配か？

original: It's the rush of good fortune, my friend. It makes you work harder.
string: 幸運がどんどん舞い込んでいる。たくさん働いてもらうぞ

original: I feel like we're mining even more ore than before.
string: 前より多くの鉱石を掘り出しているような気がする

original: Good to see you again, friend! We've opened the mine back up. If you're here for work, I'll buy any ore you have.
string: 会えてうれしいよ！　鉱山を再開したんだ。仕事を探しに来たのなら、持ってる鉱石を買ってやろう

original: I never thought I'd see Kolskeggr again.
string: コルスケッガーに再びお目にかかれるなんて、夢のようだ

original: The mine is just how I remember it.
string: 鉱山は何も変わっちゃいない

original: It's good to be mining again.
string: 採掘を再開できてうれしいよ

original: I've never seen Pavo so happy. It's good to be back in Kolskeggr.
string: あんなに幸せそうなパボは初めてだ。コルスケッガーに戻れてうれしいよ

original: There, I cast the spell.
string: よし。呪文を唱えるぞ

original: Well done, indeed.
string: 素晴らしいですね

original: Well, you clearly possess the minimum aptitude required. Congratulations. I'll escort you up to the gate.
string: なるほど、最低限必要な素質を備えているのは間違いないわね。おめでとう。門まで案内するわ

original: You'll want to speak with Mirabelle Ervine right away. And welcome to the College of Winterhold.
string: すぐにミラベル・アーヴィンと話をしてちょうだい。そして、ウィンターホールド大学へようこそ

original: Okay, this is for the spell. (Give 30 gold)
string: 分かった。その呪文に30ゴールド払おう

original: Never mind. I'm not interested.
string: 気にしないでくれ。興味はない

original: No? Very well, it's your choice.
string: やめる？　大変結構。それも一つの選択です

original: I don't know the spell.
string: その呪文は知らない

original: I don't know that spell.
string: その呪文は知らない

original: I don't know that spell.
string: その呪文は知らない

original: I don't know that spell.
string: その呪文は知らない

original: I don't know that spell.
string: その呪文は知らない

original: I don't know that spell.
string: その呪文は知らない

original: Where can I learn more about magic?
string: 魔法を学ぶには、どこに行けばいい？

original: Nords don't care much for magic. The College in Winterhold is about the only place it's not looked down on.
string: ノルドはあまり魔法を重視しません。見下されていない場所といえば、ウィンターホールド大学だけでしょう

original: Otherwise you could talk to the Jarl's pet wizard in Solitude.
string: それか、ソリチュードの首長お気に入りのウィザードと話してみる手もあります

original: The College of Winterhold is the only place in Skyrim open-minded enough to teach magic.
string: ウィンターホールド大学はスカイリムで唯一、公に魔法を教えている場所だ

original: Although Ulfric's court wizard has been known to take on apprentices once in a while.
string: ウルフリックの王宮魔術師も、まれに弟子を取るらしい

original: Magic? Goodness, not here! Nothing dangerous like that! That's all kept to that College up in Winterhold.
string: 魔法？　勘弁してちょうだい！　あんな危険なもの！　そういうのはウィンターホールド大学におまかせよ

original: Better that than dealing with Ulfric's wizard like some do.
string: ウルフリックのウィザードに話をするより、その方がましでしょ

original: Magic is for the weak. Elves, I mean. They keep to that College in Winterhold. They know their place.
string: 魔法は弱者達、つまりエルフ達の物よ。彼らはウィンターホールド大学に閉じこもっている。身の程をわきまえてるのね

original: Of course there is Farengar. He might be the Jarl's wizard, but at least he's a Nord.
string: もちろんファレンガーはそこよ。彼は首長のウィザードかも知れないけど、少なくともノルドではあるわ

original: Pfft, I should've guessed as much. Your kind sticks to that College in Winterhold, as well they should.
string: あら、気づくべきだったわ。あなたの種族はウィンターホールド大学から離れない。当然よね

original: You'd never think to learn from a Nord like the Jarl's wizard.
string: 首長のウィザードであるノルドから学ぼうなんて思わないでしょ

original: There's a College in Winterhold that teaches magic. It's very secretive, though, and you know how people hate secrets.
string: ウィンターホールドに魔術を教える大学があるわ。でも、とっても秘密主義なの。そして人は秘密が大嫌いなものよ

original: The Jarl's court wizard was taught there. That one's full of secrets.
string: 首長の王宮魔術師が色々教わったところ。そしてあの人は秘密だらけ

original: Magic? That's dangerous. You want to learn that, go to that College in Winterhold. They teach that stuff there.
string: 魔法？　あれは危険だ。習いたいなら、ウィンターホールド大学に行くといい。そこで教えてるはずだから

original: Hey! I know. The Jarl's wizard could teach ya. He's lots closer.
string: あ、そうだ！　首長のウィザードが教えてくれるかも知れないよ。その方がずっと近いしね

original: I've got no interest in magic users. No use for their kind at all. They're way up north in Winterhold, and that's fine with me.
string: 魔法の使い手にはまったく興味はない。あの類のものは、まったく役に立たないからな。ウィンターホールドのはるか北方にいるが、俺にとってはありがたい話だ

original: I don't even like our Jarl havin' a  court wizard.
string: 首長が王宮魔術師を擁していることさえ、気に入らない

original: Bit of advice, folks here don't care for magic or those that use it. If you're intent on it, check at the College up in Winterhold.
string: 忠告しとくが、ここの連中は魔法や魔法を使う輩を好まない。どうしてもと言うなら、ウィンターホールドにある大学を訪ねるといい

original: Either that or go see the Jarl's court wizard.
string: それか、首長に仕える王宮魔術師を訪ねてもいい

original: Looking to blow yourself up? I hear that's what magic does to you. There's a College in Winterhold that teaches magic, unless that blew up too.
string: 自分をふっ飛ばしたいのか？　魔法ってそういうもんなんだろう？　ウィンターホールドに魔法を教える大学があるらしい…　自爆してなければな

original: Be a lot safer just to have the Jarl's wizard teach you a thing or two.
string: 首長のウィザードから少し教わるだけにしておいた方がずっと安全だ

original: Magic is nothing but trouble. If you're set on it, there's that College in Winterhold or Ulfric's court wizard. But don't say I didn't warn you.
string: 魔法は厄介の元。もし決意が固いなら、ウィンターホールド大学かウルフリックの王宮魔術師を訪れるといい。でも、警告はしましたからね

original: The people of Skyrim don't like magic much, so about the only place you're likely to find a teacher is the College of Winterhold.
string: スカイリムの人々は魔法を好みません。教師を探せる場所といったら、ウィンターホールド大学ぐらいです

original: That'd be the College in Winterhold. I suppose you'll be headed there, then. Well, don't let me get in your way.
string: それならウィンターホールドにある大学だろうな。と言ったら、そこに向かうんだろう？　まあ、邪魔はしないよ

original: Seen enough magic in my day to know to stay away from it. I'd stay away from the Jarl's wizard in Dawnstar too.
string: 若いころに十分なほど魔法を見てきた。近づかない方が身のためだと学んだよ。ドーンスターにいる首長のウィザードにも近づかないようにするな、俺なら

original: If you wanna be a damn fool, go to the College in Winterhold instead.
string: そんなに大ばか者になりたいなら、ウィンターホールド大学に行けばいいだろう

original: You lookin' for Falion? Why don't you go bother those mages at their College in Winterhold and leave my brother alone?
string: ファリオンを探しているのですか？　ウィンターホールド大学の魔術師にでも聞けばいいでしょう。私の兄弟にかまわないで下さい

original: Any aspiring mage would do well to look for the College in Winterhold. Head there, and you'll get what you're after.
string: 向上心に燃える魔術師ならば、ウィンターホールドの大学に行くのが一番だろう。あそこに向かえば希望が叶うはずだ

original: Although our Jarl's humble wizard might be willing to help you too.
string: もしくは、我々の首長の謙虚なウィザードが、快く手助けしてくれるかもな

original: Magic? Got no good use for that here. Mages keep to their College in Winterhold. Go bother them.
string: 魔法？　この辺じゃ役に立たないものね。魔術師はウィンターホールド大学に籠もっているわ。訪ねてみたら？

original: Wish the Jarl's wizard would up and leave with ya.
string: 首長のウィザードがいっしょに行ってくると良いんだけど

original: Head north to Winterhold. There's a College there, they teach magic. Most Nords don't care for them.
string: 北にあるウィンターホールドに行きなさい。そこのカレッジで魔法を教えてもらえるわ。ノルドはカレッジの連中を嫌ってるけど

original: Else you could go see the Jarl's wizard. Might be able to help you.
string: 首長のウィザードのところにも行ってみるといいわ。役に立つかも知れない

original: Magic? You're on the wrong side of Skyrim. You want Winterhold... that College there. They teach it.
string: 魔法？　ならばスカイリムは場違いだ。ウィンターホールド…　あそこに大学がある。そこなら教えているはずだ

original: Otherwise you can try the Jarl's wizard. I wouldn't, though.
string: もしくは、首長のウィザードに頼んでみろ。お勧めはしないが…

original: Winterhold. You want the College there. They teach quite a bit.
string: ウィンターホールドね。あそこの大学はいいわ。色々教えてくれるの

original: Oh, I think you'll find that magic is rare in Skyrim. Winterhold, though... The College there has it in abundance. Look there if you wish to learn.
string: スカイリムでは魔法が珍しいものだといずれ分かるだろう。しかしウィンターホールドでは…　あそこの大学にはいくらでもある。もし習得したいのならあそこへ行く事だな

original: Not here. Definitely not here. You want to learn, join the College in Winterhold. They'll deal with it.
string: ここでは無理よ。全然無理。もっと学びたかったら、ウィンターホールド大学に入りなさい。そこで扱っているから

original: Magic is... frowned upon in Skyrim. Only the mages at the College of Winterhold teach it freely. If you wish to learn, join them.
string: スカイリムでは魔法が嫌われています。自由に教えているのはウィンターホールド大学の魔術師だけです。そこなら学べますよ

original: A prospective student, are you? Well, I'm afraid I'm not much good at teaching. You should try your luck at the College of Winterhold.
string: 意欲的な学生というわけか？　教えるのは得意ではない。ウィンターホールド大学で運を試すといい

original: I have no time or patience for a student. Perhaps the College of Winterhold will grant you admission.
string: 生徒を教えるだけの辛抱も時間もないわ。もしかするとウィンターホールド大学が入学させてくれるかも知れない

original: That's right. College of Winterhold, just north of town. Hard to miss.
string: ああ、町の北部にウィンターホールド大学があるんだ。すぐに分かるよ

original: I overheard something about a College.
string: 大学について教えてくれ

original: Yes, you were going to demonstrate your ability, were you not?
string: どうぞ。能力を見せてくれるのでしたね、違いますか？

original: A standard spell for one skilled in Destruction magic is the Firebolt. Casting one at the seal on the ground here would be sufficient.
string: 破壊魔法に熟達している人の標準呪文はファイアボルト。この地面の上の盾に向かって放てれば十分でしょう

original: Those invested in Restoration magic find Healing Hands to be essential. Can you cast it on me? That would prove your skill.
string: 回復魔法に精進した者にとって、治癒の手の呪文は非常に重要です。私に向かって放てますか？　あなたの力を見せて下さい

original: The Fear spell has saved the life of many an Illusion mage. If you could cast it on the seal here on the ground, that would prove your skill.
string: 恐れの呪文は、幻惑魔法を使う魔術師の命を救ってきました。この地面の上の盾に向かって放てば、あなたの技量を証明できます

original: The Flame Atronach is a vital companion for anyone relying on Conjuration. Summoning one here would certainly show your skill.
string: 召喚魔法を修める者にとって、炎の精霊は頼りになる存在であり、欠かせない友です。ここに一体召喚して、あなたの技量を見せて下さい

original: The Mage Light spell is useful to any mage, not just those specializing in Alteration. Can you cast one on the seal on the ground?
string: 魔術光の呪文は、変成魔法を専門とする者だけでなく、どんな魔術師にとっても便利なものです。地面の上に向かって放てますか？

original: It would seem that you have yet to reach a level of skill that the College would find valuable, so I'm afraid I can't allow you to join at this time.
string: 大学にとって価値があると認められる技量に達していないようです。申し訳ありませんが、今回は入校を許可できません

original: Unfortunately, one needs to be able to cast at least Apprentice level spells in any school of magic before being allowed to join the College.
string: 残念ながら、大学に入学するには、いずれか一つの魔法分野で見習いレベルの呪文が使えなくてはなりません

original: And thus, you're not skilled enough to be a candidate. I'm afraid we're not interested.
string: ですので、志願者としては未熟です。興味がないと言わざるを得ません

original: You don't know what you're dealing with. There will be consequences if you harm that tree. Leave this place - you're not welcome here anymore.
string: 自分が何を相手にしているか分かってないのね。その木を傷つけたら、報いがあるわ。ここから出て行って。もう歓迎は期待しないで

original: (Growling)
string: ウゥーッ…

original: Not now. The Underforge, tonight.
string: 今はダメだ。今夜、アンダーフォージで

original: Not here. The Underforge. Come on.
string: ここではダメだ。アンダーフォージで。ついてこい

original: Thank you for coming, brother.
string: 来てくれたのか、同志

original: Thank you for coming, sister.
string: 来てくれたのか、同志

original: Ah, there you are.
string: やっと来たか

original: The blood calls, brother.
string: 血が呼ぶのか、同志

original: The blood calls, sister.
string: 血が呼ぶのか、同志

original: Speak to me, Shield-Brother.
string: 話を聞かせてちょうだい、盾の兄弟

original: Speak to me, Shield-Sister.
string: 話を聞かせてちょうだい、盾の姉妹

original: Let's make the bastards pay.
string: あいつらに思い知らせてやるわ

original: Skjor's somewhere ahead. We need to find him.
string: スコールがこの先にいるはず。見つけなきゃ

original: Less talk, more hunt.
string: おしゃべりより狩りに専念するのよ

original: The blood calls, brother.
string: 血が呼ぶのか、同志

original: The blood calls, sister.
string: 血が呼ぶのか、同志

original: Let's keep moving.
string: 先を急ぐぞ

original: You've returned.
string: 戻ってきたか

original: There you are.
string: 見つけたぞ

original: The rumors were true... I beg of you, don't harm the tree! Nothing good can come of it.
string: うわさは本当だったのね。お願いだから木を傷つけないで。ろくな事にならないわよ

original: You mean this weapon? (Show Nettlebane)
string: この武器のことか？(ネトルベインを見せる)

original: The rumors were true! You carry the one weapon Eldergleam fears - Nettlebane. I beg of you, don't harm the tree! Nothing good can come of it.
string: うわさは本当だったのね。それはエルダーグリームが恐れる武器、ネトルベイン。お願いだから木を傷つけないで。ろくな事にならないわ

original: What is it?
string: どうした？

original: Oh, I don't believe those rumors, my friend. Besides, who would ever want to harm such... Wait, it can't be.
string: そんなうわさは信じないわ。それに、一体誰がこんなに美しい物を…　待ってよ、ウソでしょ

original: Where can I find such a weapon?
string: その武器はどこに行けば見つかるんだ？

original: Welcome to Eldergleam Sanctuary, my friend. If you have any questions, speak to Asta.
string: エルダーグリーム聖域にようこそ。何か質問があるなら、アスタに聞いてくれ

original: You are in Eldergleam Sanctuary - just a small glimpse of what beauty Kynareth has to offer. Wonderful place, isn't it?
string: あなたはエルダーグリーム聖域にいる。キナレスの与える美の小さなきらめきの場。素晴らしい場所でしょ？

original: Oh, I don't believe those rumors, my friend.  Besides, who would ever want to harm such beauty?
string: そんなうわさは信じないわ。それに、こんな美しいものを傷つけたいと思う人がいるかしら？

original: He had your soft face, and that silly grin you get when you've done something wrong. That's his, too.
string: 彼はあなたに似て優しい顔をしている。悪さをしてにやっとするところも同じよ

original: I don't know. What'd he look like?
string: 知らない。どんな感じの人だった？

original: Of course, sweetie. What'd you like to know?
string: もちろんよ。どんな事を知りたいの？

original: Mama, can we talk. You know, about papa?
string: ママ、今話せる？　パパのこと、知ってる？

original: What is this place again?
string: ここはどんな場所だったかな？

original: Oh, I don't believe those rumors, my friend. Besides, who would ever want to harm such beauty?
string: そんなうわさは信じないわ。それに、一体誰がこんなに美しい物を傷つけたいなんて思う？

original: Now, if you'll excuse me, I have nothing more to discuss. I encourage you to take your time and enjoy yourself. You look like you could use the rest.
string: そろそろ失礼してもらえる？　もう話す事はないの。あなたにはのんびりと楽しむ事をおすすめするわ。休息が必要そうだもの

original: Where can I find such a weapon?
string: その武器はどこに行けば見つかるんだ？

original: As you can see, Eldergleam's roots are large and stretch far, blocking any path to her trunk.
string: 見ての通りよ。エルダーグリームの根は大きくて遠くまで伸びているから、幹に近づけないの

original: Though, believe it or not, there are rumors of a weapon that even Eldergleam herself would lift her roots for, more out of fear than respect.
string: 信じられないかも知れないけど、エルダーグリーム自身が敬意ではなく恐怖を感じるあまり、根を持ち上げるっていう武器のうわさがあるの

original: Why not?
string: なぜだ？

original: Yes, my friend. Though no one has been able to get close to her for as long as I can remember.
string: そうよ。でも私の覚えている限り、近づけた者はいないわ

original: And that tree? Is that Eldergleam?
string: あの木か？ あれがエルダーグリーム？

original: What is this place?
string: どんな場所なんだ？

original: (Invisible Continue) Location of Attack
string: (見えないまま)攻撃が行われる場所

original: Join the forces mustering at the [CAPITAL] (infos conditions on location go here)
string: ソリチュードに集結した軍と合流しろ

original: (Invisible Continue) Difficulty based on Attack Dela
string: (見えないまま)デルタアタックの課題

original: Infos conditioned on Attack Delta go here.
string: デルタアタックに必要な条件については、ここに行け

original: What's the situation?
string: 状況は？

original: The enemy is mustering for a final attack.
string: 敵は最終攻撃のために結集した

original: So you'll come to the peace council?
string: では、講和会議に出席するのか？

original: Yes. I'll give Tullius one more chance to quit Skyrim with his tail between his legs.
string: ああ。テュリウスめにもう一度、スカイリムから尻尾を巻いて逃げ帰る機会をくれてやろう

original: Tullius will look weak if he refuses, not you.
string: 断ればお前ではなくテュリウスが弱腰に見えるだろう(説得)

original: He is weak. And no doubt knows it. He's no fool, he'll come, if only to give his troops a chance to refit.
string: 弱みはあるが、恐らくはそれを承知している。奴も愚かではない。自分の部隊に立て直しの機会を与えるためにも出向いてくるだろう

original: But you're right. Victory is within our grasp. We can afford to give the Empire one more chance to withdraw.
string: だが正しい。勝利は手の届く所にある。もう一度帝国に軍を引く機会を与える余裕はあろう

original: You're right. Let Tullius be the one to insult the Greybeards by refusing their summons.
string: そのとおりだ。召喚を拒めばテュリウスはグレイビアードを侮辱することになる

original: Show up these Imperials for the foreigners they really are.
string: 帝国は実際そうであるように、よそ者と見えることになるな

original: Hmm. We could use the time to bring in new recruits. Our losses have been heavy recently...
string: ふむ…　新兵を投入する時間は稼げるか？　近頃は我が方の損害も激しいだけに…

original: General Tullius hasn't agreed to attend yet.
string: テュリウス将軍はまだ出席に同意していない

original: I can't agree to any peace council until I know Tullius will be there. The other Jarls could take that as a sign of weakness.
string: テュリウスが出ると分かるまでは、いかなる講和会議にも賛同できない。他の首長はこれを弱腰の表れだと取るだろう

original: General Tullius has already agreed to attend.
string: テュリウス将軍は出席に同意した

original: Good. Maybe he's realized he's beaten. The way things are going, we'll be knocking at the gates of Solitude itself before too long.
string: 面白い。彼も負けを悟ったようだな。この調子なら、近いうちにソリチュードの門へ手が届くというものだ

original: Good. We still hold half of Skyrim despite everything the Empire could throw at us.
string: 結構。帝国がすべてを投入しても、我が方はなおスカイリムの半分を保持しているのだ

original: I doubt the Empire has the stomach for much more bloodletting.
string: 奴らの胃はこれ以上の流血に耐えられまいよ

original: Good. They've had their victories, but Tullius is no fool. The Empire can't afford to keep this up much longer.
string: 結構。奴らは奴らなりの勝利を得たな。だがテュリウスは愚かではない。帝国には長く戦う余裕がないはずだ

original: They want to negotiate a truce until the dragon menace is dealt with.
string: 彼らはドラゴンの脅威に対処するまで、休戦協定を結ぼうとしている

original: I have the greatest respect for the Greybeards, of course. And the dragon attacks are a growing plague.
string: むろん、私とてグレイビアードには最大限の敬意を払っているし、ドラゴンの襲撃は由々しき事態になりつつある

original: But the political situation is still delicate. Not all the Jarls are fully committed to supporting me as High King.
string: しかし政情はなお危うい。すべての首長が私を上級王として支持すると約束したわけではないからな

original: I can't afford to appear weak. I can't agree to this unless Tullius himself will be there.
string: 今は弱みを覗かせる余裕がない。テュリウス自らが出るのでない限り、承諾できん

original: I have a message from the Greybeards.
string: グレイビアードから伝言を受け取った

original: It's about time they turned their gaze from the heavens, back to our bleeding homeland. What do they want?
string: 彼らもそろそろ視線を天上界から下ろし、血を流す故郷の方に目を向けてもいい頃だ。しかし、一体何がしたいのか…

original: Hmph. Suit yourself.
string: ふん、好きにすれば

original: Let's just see about that.
string: 確かめてみようか

original: *Sigh* I was part of the gang in the ruins here. Friend of mine went crazy and stole the boss' sword. They blamed me for it.
string: この廃墟にいる連中の仲間だったの。友人のひとりが気の迷いからボスの剣を盗んで、私が責められたってわけ

original: Look, I'm done here. Mop the floor with these idiots for all I care. Just get out of my way.
string: もうここに用はないわ。その間抜けどもを叩きのめそうと、どうでもいいのよ。どいてちょうだい

original: Wait, what's going on here?
string: 待った。どうなってるんだ？

original: What a waste. Fools.
string: なんて無駄なの。愚かね

original: You go speak with Muiri. I've got to deal with the Night Mother and her little... clown.
string: ムイリと話をして。私は夜母と…　あの道化を相手にしないといけないの

original: It's all up to you now... Listener.
string: すべてはあなた次第よ…　聞こえし者

original: Go. Quickly. Hide in the coffin before Cicero and the traitor meet.
string: さあ、今すぐ行って。シセロと裏切り者が会う前に棺に隠れるのよ

original: It's time we put a little kink in the Emperor's security.
string: 皇帝の警備に仕掛けをする時ね

original: Off to Solitude with you. Time to give the Emperor some real motivation to visit Skyrim.
string: ソリチュードに向かいましょう。皇帝がスカイリムに来るよう、動機を作ってやるのよ

original: Goodbye, assassin.
string: さようなら、暗殺者さん

original: You've got people to kill, my friend. Best get to it.
string: 標的が待ってるぞ、同志よ。仕事にかかってくれ

original: Go on, now.
string: 事を進めてくれ

original: Good luck. And try not to get yourself killed.
string: 幸運を祈る。死なないようにな

original: Happy hunting.
string: 狩りを楽しんでくれよ

original: Be sure and introduce yourself to your new Family members. They're all very eager to meet you.
string: 新しい家族に自己紹介するのを忘れないようにね。皆あなたに会いたがっているわ

original: Humble Cicero lives to serve.
string: 従順なシセロは仕えるために生きている

original: Damnable jester...
string: いまいましい道化め…

original: I took that prancing fool into my home, and this is how he repays me?
string: あの威張りくさった愚か者、我が家へ招き入れてやったというのに、こんな仕打ちをするなんて

original: You may go now...
string: もう行っていいぞ…

original: I am yours, master.
string: ご命令のままに、マスター

original: I am yours, mistress.
string: ご命令のままに、マスター

original: Walk always in shadow, my Listener.
string: 影と共に歩まれよ、我が聞こえし者

original: Just say the word, master.
string: 言って下さい、ご主人様

original: Just say the word, mistress.
string: 言って下さい、ご主人様

original: Ready when you need me, Listener.
string: 必要とあらば喜んで、聞こえし者よ

original: Just do whatever the contact wishes. Be professional, represent us well, and get the job done.
string: 依頼人の望むとおりにして。プロに徹する事、私達の一員として立派に務める事、そして仕事を完遂する事

original: Since it's your first contract, I'll let you keep whatever Muiri pays. She'll be generous, I'm sure. They always are.
string: 初任務だから、ムイリが支払った分だけあなたのものという事にしてあげる。はずんでくれるはずよ。皆そうなの

original: Anything else?
string: 他に何かあるか？

original: DBAstridO3GiveQuestTopic1
string: DBAstridO3GiveQuestTopic1

original: I do indeed.
string: ええ、来ているわ

original: You must go to the city of Markarth, and speak with the apothecary's assistant. You'll probably find her in The Hag's Cure, when the shop is open.
string: マルカルスの街へ行って、薬剤師の助手と話をしなさい。店が開いている時間なら、ハグズキュアにいるはずよ

original: The girl's been running her mouth, wants an ex-lover killed. She's apparently performed the Black Sacrament.
string: この娘は、昔の男を殺してほしいとふれ回っているわ。どうやら黒き聖餐を執り行ったようね

original: Her name is Muiri. I need you to talk to her, set up the contract, and carry it out.
string: 名前はムイリ。彼女と話をして、契約し、実行してほしいの

original: Do you have a contract for me?
string: 契約は来ているか？

original: Ah, there you are. Good, I was done speaking with that muttering fool anyway. We've got some business to discuss.
string: ああ、ちょうどよかったわ。あのブツブツうるさいバカの話にうんざりしていたところよ。話したい事があるの

original: You. Over here!
string: おい、こっちだ！

original: Come on, this way.
string: こっちへ来るんだ

original: Let's keep moving. That thing is still out there.
string: 急ごう。あれがまだうろついてる

original: Let me see if I can get that door open.
string: あの扉が開けられるか試してみよう

original: There you go. Take a look around, there should be plenty of gear to choose from. I'm going to see if I can find something for these burns.
string: いいぞ。周りを見てみろ。いくらでも選び放題だ。俺は火傷に効く物を探すとするよ

original: Well now. Funny you should ask.
string: あら、おかしな人ね。そんな事を聞くなんて

original: If you turn around, you'll notice my guests. I've "collected" them from... well, that's not really important. The here and now. That's what matters.
string: 振り向くと、私が招いた客が目に入るはずよ。“集めて”きたの…　どこから来たのかは重要じゃないわ。今ここにいる事、それが重要

original: You see, there's a contract out on one of them, and that person can't leave this room alive. But... which one? Go on, see if you can figure it out.
string: 奴らのうちの一人を殺すのが任務よ。そいつは生きてこの部屋を出られない…　誰がいいかしら？　さあ、あなたが選んで

original: Make your choice. Make your kill. I just want to observe... and admire.
string: あなたが選んで、殺しなさい。私はただそれを見て…　楽しみたいの

original: You want me to murder someone else? Who?
string: 他に誰かを殺してほしいのか？ 誰だ？

original: (Remain silent)
string: (黙っている)

original: I don't think I like where this is going...
string: 嫌な予感がする…

original: A problem?
string: 問題？

original: You see, that little Aretino boy was looking for the Dark Brotherhood. For me, and my associates.
string: 小さなアレティノは闇の一党を探していたのよ。私と私の仲間のためにね

original: Grelod the Kind was, by all rights, a Dark Brotherhood contract. A kill... that you stole.
string: 親切者のグレロッドは、闇の一党の仕事だったのよ。殺しのね…　それをあなたが盗んだ

original: A kill you must repay.
string: この借りは返してもらうわ

original: We need to talk.
string: 話があるの

original: Look. Something is happening here. I'm not sure entirely what that something is, but... Well, we need to find out.
string: ここで何かが起こってる。それが何なのか、私にもよく分からないけど…　とにかく、調べてみる必要があるわ

original: If the Night Mother really did give you an order to talk to a contact, we'd be mad to ignore it.
string: 本当に夜母があなたに連絡者と話をするよう命令したのなら、それを無視するわけにはいかないわ

original: And I think we'd both agree, Cicero's brought quite enough madness to this Sanctuary.
string: それに、シセロはとんでもない騒ぎをこの聖域に持ちこんだ

original: So go. Go to Volunruud. It's a crypt, pretty far to the northeast. Talk to this Amaund Motierre. And let's see where all this leads. Hmm?
string: ヴォルンルードへ行きなさい。北東の地下堂よ。アマウンド・モティエールとやらと話して。これが何につながっているのか、見ものだわ

original: Best put your other tasks aside. The real challenge is about to begin.
string: 他の仕事はとりあえず置いておいて。本当の挑戦が始まろうとしているのよ

original: With Vici's murder, you've started us down a path the Dark Brotherhood hasn't traveled in centuries. The assassination of an Emperor.
string: あなたはヴィキ殺しの一件で、闇の一党がもう何世紀も体験した事のない冒険へと私達を導いたのよ。皇帝の暗殺という冒険へとね

original: And now, your reward. A unique spell to summon a legend of the Dark Brotherhood. His soul serves us now in death, as his body once did in life.
string: そして、こっちが報酬よ。闇の一党の伝説的人物を召喚する特別な呪文なの。彼の魂は死後も闇の一党を支えているわ。生前と同じようにね

original: Ah, and of course, a bonus, for killing Vici while she addressed her guests, as instructed. Gold... simple and pure. Spend it as you will.
string: それと、指示どおり招待客との歓談中にヴィキを殺してくれた事へのボーナスよ。ゴールド…　これがすべてよね。好きなように使えばいいわ

original: Now then. Time to proceed to the next stage of the plan. Go and speak with Gabriella. She's been helping me arrange your next contract.
string: そろそろ計画の次の段階に進む時ね。ガブリエラに会って話をして。彼女は、次の仕事の準備を手伝ってくれているの

original: With Vici's murder, you've started us down a path the Dark Brotherhood hasn't traveled in centuries. The assassination of an Emperor.
string: あなたはヴィキ殺しの一件で、闇の一党がもう何世紀も体験した事のない冒険へと私達を導いたのよ。皇帝の暗殺という冒険へとね

original: And now, your reward. A unique spell to summon a legend of the Dark Brotherhood. His soul serves us now in death, as his body once did in life.
string: そして、こっちが報酬よ。闇の一党の伝説的人物を召喚する特別な呪文なの。彼の魂は死後も闇の一党を支えているわ。生前と同じようにね

original: Unfortunately, in your zeal, you failed to eliminate Vici while she addressed her guests, as directed. I'm sorry, but your bonus is forfeit.
string: 残念だけど。指示したように、招待客との会話中にヴィキを殺せなかったわね。申し訳ないけどボーナスはなしよ

original: Now then. Time to proceed to the next stage of the plan. Go and speak with Gabriella. She's been helping me arrange your next contract.
string: そろそろ計画の次の段階に進む時ね。ガブリエラに会って話をして。彼女は、次の仕事の準備を手伝ってくれているの

original: Excellent. Once again, you've proven yourself a born assassin.
string: すばらしいわ。またしても、生まれながらの暗殺者である事を証明したわね

original: Tell you what. Why don't you hold onto Shadowmere a while longer? He's a fine steed, and hasn't been ridden nearly as much as he should lately.
string: どうかしら？　もう少しシャドウメアを使ってみる気はない？　いい馬よ。もっと走らせてやるべきなのに、なかなか乗ってやれないから

original: And now that this Cicero mess has been mopped up, we can get back to the matter at hand, hmm?
string: 厄介なシセロの問題に始末が付いた今、目下の問題に戻る事ができるわね

original: You are not worthy.
string: お前は通すに値しない

original: Go now to Castle Dour in Solitude. Present the Gourmet's Write of Passage to the officer in charge, Commander Maro. I'm sure you remember him.
string: ソリチュードのドール城へと向かってほしいの。美食家の通行証を担当将校のマロ指揮官に渡して。彼の事は覚えているわよね

original: Oh yes, it is Cicero! You were a fool to spare me. What, did you think I would be grateful? Cicero should be Listener! Not you! Now you will die!
string: そう、シセロさ！　私を生かすとは、お前も馬鹿だな！　何だい、私が感謝しているとでも思ったかい？　聞こえし者になるべきなのはお前じゃない、このシセロだ！　お前は死ぬのだ！

original: Ahhh.... gotcha! Oh, Listener, you should see the look on your face! Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!
string: おっ…　騙されたね！　ハハハハハ！　今の表情をお前自身に見せてあげたいよ、聞こえし者！

original: Oh, Cicero has returned! Not to kill the kind Listener, but to serve, until one of us dies horribly, in service to our Mother! Best friends forever!
string: ああ、シセロはいま戻ったよ！　優しき聞こえし者を殺すためではなく、我らが母に仕えて片方が酷い死に方をするまで、聞こえし者に従うためにね！　ずっと親友同士さ！

original: In the meantime, I'll make myself at home in the Sanctuary. I'm sure Mother needs... tending.
string: とりあえずは聖域でくつろいでいるよ。母の…　面倒を見ないといけないだろうしね

original: You! You're responsible for the siege of Solitude! By Sithis, this undermines all our plans! Fool! Finish that mess, and only then will we speak!
string: ねえ！　ソリチュードの包囲はあなたの仕業ね！　シシスにかけて、これじゃ私達の計画が全部台なしになるわ！　馬鹿！　この混乱が治まるまでは何も話さないわよ！

original: You! You're responsible for the siege of that... city! By Sithis, this undermines all our plans! Fool! Finish that mess, and only then will we speak!
string: ねえ！　あの街の包囲はあなたの仕業ね！　シシスにかけて、これじゃ私達の計画が全部台なしになるわ！　馬鹿！　この混乱が治まるまでは何も話さないわよ！

original: Half of Skyrim knows. Old hag gets butchered in her own orphanage? Things like that tend to get around.
string: そんな事、もうスカイリムの半数が知ってるわ。老女が孤児院で殺されたなんて話はすぐに広まるものよ

original: Oh, but don't misunderstand. I'm not criticizing. It was a good kill. Old crone had it coming. And you saved a group of urchins, to boot.
string: 誤解しないで、批判しているわけではないの。あの老女の死は自業自得よ。それにあなたは子供達を助けた

original: Ah, but there is a slight... problem.
string: でも少しだけ…　問題があるわ

original: You know about that?
string: 知っているんだな？

original: Who I am really isn't as important as what I am. And what I am is an admirer. Of sorts.
string: 私が誰なのかなんて、私が何なのかに比べれば重要ではないわ。私は信奉者よ。ある種のね

original: Who are you?
string: お前は誰だ？

original: DBNazirContractSet1ReadyBranchTopic
string: DBNazirContractSet1ReadyBranchTopic

original: Well then, let's get started. I've got three available right now.
string: よろしい、では始めよう。今手元にあるのは3つだ

original: Your targets are the beggar Narfi, an ex-miller named Ennodius Papius, and Beitild, a mine boss.
string: 標的は物乞いのナルフィ、元製粉業者のエノディウス・パピウス、そして鉱山経営者のベイティルドだ

original: When you've completed all those, we'll see if I might have some more.
string: 全員片づけたら、次の仕事の話をしよう

original: I'm ready for the first set of contracts.
string: 最初の仕事の準備ができた

original: It is. These aren't particularly glamorous assassinations, I'll be honest. Don't pay much, either.
string: そのとおり。正直言って、特別派手な仕事じゃない。だから報酬も大した事はない

original: But they'll keep you busy. Just do them as you're able. There's no real time limit - the targets aren't going anywhere.
string: しかし、忙しい仕事だ。できそうならやればいい。時間制限はなし。標的は逃げないからな

original: You can turn each one in as it's completed, or wait and turn in the whole group when all the targets have been eliminated. Whichever works for you.
string: 1件終わる度に報告してもいいし、標的をすべて倒してからまとめて報告してもいい。どちらか好きな方を選べ

original: Sounds simple enough.
string: 簡単なように聞こえる

original: The prominent feature here is the Hall of the Elements. It's our primary location for lectures, practice sessions, and general meetings.
string: ひときわ目立つのが“元素の間”です。講義や実習、集会などは主にここで行っています

original: The College of Winterhold has been a fixture in Skyrim for thousands of years.
string: ウィンターホールド大学は数千年にわたりスカイリムと分かちがたい関係にあります

original: Sorry, I'm not ready for that just yet.
string: すまない。まだ準備がある

original: I see.
string: そうか

original: Well, please let me know when you are.
string: 分かりました、では案内を始めてよければ声をかけて下さい

original: I'd love to have a look around.
string: 見学ならありがたい

original: Wonderful. Please follow me, and don't wander off.
string: それは何よりです。ではついてきて下さい、はぐれないように

original: I was told to come see you.
string: あなたに会うように言われた

original: Another new student... I'm surprised at how many of you there are lately.
string: また入学志願者ですか…　最近は多くて驚くばかりですよ

original: Well, first you'll need these. While you're not required to wear them, you may find them more to your liking than your current clothes.
string: では、まずこれを渡しておきます。着用義務はありませんが、袖を通してみれば今の格好よりもしっくり来るかも知れませんよ

original: I'll give you a brief tour, and then we'll get you to your first class. Are you ready to begin?
string: 学内をひとまわり見学してもらってから、最初の授業に案内します。さあ行きましょうか？

original: Yes, just a brief overview of our facilities. Are you ready?
string: ええ、学内の施設をひととおり案内するだけですけどね。そろそろ出発しましょうか？

original: You said something about a tour?
string: ツアーについて何か言っていたな？

original: Do you know about Delphine's... activities?
string: デルフィンの行動について何か知らないか？

original: That's her business. Not mine. Probably not yours either.
string: それは彼女の問題だ。俺じゃない。あんたのでもないだろうな

original: The dragonstone was some kind of map?
string: ドラゴンストーンは何かの地図だったのか？

original: Yes. A map of ancient dragon burial sites. I've looked at which ones are now empty. The pattern is pretty clear.
string: そうよ。古いドラゴンの墓場の地図なの。どの墓が空になっているのかを確認したわ。パターンは簡単に解読できた

original: It seems to be spreading from the southeast, starting in the Jeralls near Riften. The one near Kynesgrove is next if the pattern holds.
string: どうやら南東から広がっているようね、リフテン近くのジェラールからよ。このパターンのまま行けば、次はカイネスグローブの近くのもののはずよ

original: That's none of your business.
string: あなたには関係のないことだ

original: You're wrong. It is my business. You may be the only one that can stop these dragons.
string: それは違うわ。これは私の問題よ。ドラゴンを止めることができるのはあなただけかも知れないのよ

original: But you'll understand that soon enough.
string: でも、あなたにもすぐに分かるでしょうよ

original: I absorb some kind of power from dragons. That's all I can say.
string: ドラゴンから、ある種の力を吸収する。それしか言えない

original: This is no time to play the reluctant hero. You either are or aren't Dragonborn.
string: 気乗りしない英雄を気取っている場合じゃないわ。ドラゴンボーンなのかどうか、それが重要よ

original: But I'll see for myself soon enough.
string: もうすぐ自分の目で確かめることになるでしょうね

original: Yes, that's how I first learned I was Dragonborn.
string: ああ、自分がドラゴンボーンだと分かったのは、そのせいだ

original: Good. And you'll have a chance to prove it to me soon enough.
string: 分かったわ。すぐにそれを証明する機会がやってくるわよ

original: What of it?
string: 何のために？

original: Can you do it? Can you devour a dragon's soul?
string: あなたにできるの？　ドラゴンの魂を飲み込むことが？

original: Here I am. What do you want?
string: 来たぞ。用件は？

original: Now we can talk.
string: これでやっと話ができるわ

original: Close the door.
string: 扉を閉めて

original: Come on, close the door.
string: ほら、扉を閉めて

original: You're not afraid of me, are you?
string: 私が怖いなんてことないわよね？

original: Just close the door, will you?
string: さあ、扉を閉めて

original: Follow me.
string: ついてこい
