original: We should keep moving. Come here. Let me see if I can get those bindings off.
string: 進まなきゃならないな。こっちだ。その拘束を解けるか試してみる

original: Looks like we're the only ones who made it. Was that really a dragon? The bringers of the End Times?
string: 生き残ったのはどうやら俺達だけのようだな。あれは本当にドラゴンか？　終末をもたらす者なのか？

original: Did you see that?
string: あれを見たか？

original: Well would you look at that!
string: それを見てみろ！

original: This appears to lead somewhere. Let's see where it goes.
string: どこかへつながっているようだな…

original: I'm not sure. I certainly wasn't expecting this.
string: さあ…　こんなことは予想もしなかったのだが…

original: This appears to lead somewhere. Let's see where it goes.
string: どこかへつながっているようだな…

original: What's going on?
string: 何が起こっている？

original: Someone get that thing out of here and burn it.
string: あれを持ち出し、燃やすんだ

original: Raagh!
string: 死ね！

original: Enjoy this while you can. Soon you will all be slaves.
string: 今のうちにせいぜい楽しんでおけ。まもなく奴隷となる身だからな

original: I said, on your knees, Elf!
string: エルフめ、ひざまずけ！

original: Tolfdir is likely already addressing the new Apprentices. Go on in, and if you have any problems, let one of our senior members know.
string: トルフディルはちょうど見習い新入生の出席をとっているようです。中に入って下さい。以後困った事があったら、上級会員の誰かに相談するように

original: Initially you'll be learning from Tolfdir, one of our most esteemed Wizards.
string: 最初はトルフディルが指導教官になります。ここでは大いに尊敬を受けているウィザードです

original: This is where you'll be staying. This bed and desk are yours. Please try and be considerate of others.
string: この部屋で寝起きしてもらいます。こちらのベッドと机はあなた専用です。共同生活する仲間への配慮を忘れないで下さいね

original: Now, let's go back to the Hall of the Elements, where most of the members gather for lectures and study sessions.
string: さて、元素の間へ戻りましょう。たいていの学生は講義や勉強会でそこにいますから

original: Now I'll show you to your quarters. You're going to be sharing space with your fellow Apprentices, who you'll meet shortly.
string: では宿舎に案内しましょう。施設は他の見習いと共有になります。彼らとはあとで会えますよ

original: Our newest members are housed here in the Hall of Attainment.
string: 新入生の学舎はここ“達成の間”です

original: I'll ask that you please keep your voice down while inside, as others may be working on research or... delicate experiments.
string: 中では静粛にお願いしますね。学生が勉強中だったり…　細心の注意を要する実験を行ったりしている時がありますから

original: Unfortunately, we've had to implement more stringent entry procedures, due to some problems with the local Nords.
string: 残念ながら、地元のノルドと問題が起きたため、入場手続きは以前より厳しくしています

original: We don't anticipate any real violence, but it never hurts to be prepared.
string: 実際に暴力沙汰が起きるとは思っていませんが、予防策を講じても害にはならないでしょう

original: On your knees!
string: ひざまずけ！

original: I presume you're talking to me?
string: こっちに話しかけているのか？

original: Not so fast Elf!
string: まだだ、エルフ！

original: Well, yes. Two of them. But you're reaching the end of what I have available.
string: うむ、そうだな。2つある。しかし、そろそろ提供できる仕事がなくなるな

original: Your targets are a dark elf wizard named Maluril, in the dwarven ruin of Mzinchaleft. And Helvard, the housecarl of Falkreath.
string: 標的はダークエルフのウィザードで、名前はマルリルだ。ムジンチャレフトにあるドワーフの遺跡にいる。もうひとりはヘルヴァルドというファルクリースの私兵だ

original: Kill these two, and I'll have one last contract to give you. I'm just finalizing some details now.
string: この2人を殺してほしい。それが終わったら残りは1つ。現在準備中だ

original: Are there any more contracts available?
string: まだ仕事はないか？

original: Just one right now, actually.
string: 今は1つだけだ

original: I need you to eliminate an old woman named Agnis, a servant in Fort Greymoor.
string: アグニスという名の老女を始末してもらいたい。彼女はグレイムーア砦で働いている

original: Are there any more contracts, Nazir?
string: 他に仕事はないか、ナジル？

original: Well aren't we the eager one? Sorry to disappoint, but there's nothing. Try me again later.
string: 我々はずいぶん働き者だな？　悪いが仕事は全部片付いてしまったよ。また今度来てくれ

original: Are there any more contracts available?
string: まだ仕事はないか？

original: There are indeed. Three, to be exact.
string: もちろんある。厳密には3つだな

original: There's Deekus, a shipwreck scavenger. Ma'randru-jo, a traveling caravaner. And Anoriath, a hunter.
string: 難破船漁りのディーカス、旅の行商人のマランドゥル・ジョー、それから狩人のアノリアスだ

original: Are there any more contracts available?
string: まだ仕事はないか？

original: Hmph. How about, instead of giving you another contract, I simply deride you for not finishing the one you still have?
string: ふむ。こういうのはどうだ、次の仕事をやる前に、前の仕事をまだ終わらせていないお前を笑ってやるというのは？

original: Astrid sent me for another contract.
string: アストリッドは別の仕事をさせたいようだ

original: So it would appear. Though I'd suspect she'd want you to complete your other contracts first. Do those, then we'll talk about something new.
string: そのようだな。しかし、きっと前の仕事を終わらせてほしいと思ってるんじゃないか。そいつが済んだら、次の話をしよう

original: Astrid sent me for another contract.
string: アストリッドは別の仕事をさせたいようだ

original: As a matter of fact, I do. Two of them. One rather easy assignment, and another that should prove quite a challenge.
string: 実は2つある。ひとつは比較的簡単だが、もうひとつはかなり手強いぞ

original: Your first target is an Orc bard named Lurbuk. The other is a vampire by the name of Hern.
string: 最初の標的はルーブクという吟遊詩人のオークだ。もうひとつはハーンという名前の吸血鬼だ

original: Happy hunting.
string: 狩りを楽しんでくれよ

original: Do you have any more contracts?
string: 何か仕事はあるか？

original: I'm sorry, I don't. Come see me again later.
string: 悪いが、仕事はない。また今度来てくれ

original: Do you have any more contracts?
string: 何か仕事はあるか？

original: Well then, your timing couldn't be better.
string: おお、最高のタイミングで来てくれたな

original: As it turns out, I've got two new contracts. One rather easy assignment, and another that should prove quite a challenge.
string: 新しい仕事が2つある。ひとつは比較的簡単だが、もうひとつはかなり手強いぞ

original: Your first target is an Orc bard named Lurbuk. The other is a vampire by the name of Hern.
string: 最初の標的はルーブクという吟遊詩人のオークだ。もうひとつはハーンという名前の吸血鬼だ

original: Happy hunting.
string: 狩りを楽しんでくれよ

original: Astrid wanted me to see you about some more work.
string: アストリッドに仕事をもらってくるように言われた

original: More work? My friend, you still haven't finished the last set of contracts I gave you. Why don't you concentrate on eliminating that final target.
string: 何を言ってるんだ？　同志よ、まだ前のやつが終わってないじゃないか。先を急ぐ前に、最後の標的を片づける事に集中してくれ

original: Astrid wanted me to see you about some more work.
string: アストリッドに仕事をもらってくるように言われた

original: More work? My friend, you still haven't finished the last two contracts I gave you. Let's get those done, hmm?
string: 何を言ってるんだ？　同志よ、まだ前の2つが終わってないじゃないか。先を急ぐ前にそっちを片づけてくれ、な？

original: Astrid wanted me to see you about some more work.
string: アストリッドに仕事をもらってくるように言われた

original: By Sithis, now I am truly impressed!
string: シシスにかけて、こいつは驚きだ！

original: To kill a pirate captain, on her own ship no less? Simply masterful!
string: 海賊の船長を、船の上で殺したと？　単純ゆえの絶技だな！

original: You've not only earned your payment, but my respect as well. And believe me, friend - that does not come easily.
string: 報酬だけでなく尊敬も表そう。私から尊敬される者はなかなかいないぞ

original: I'm afraid that concludes our business. You have exhausted all available additional contracts.
string: 残念ながら我々のビジネスも終わりだ。仕事はもうない。お前が全部片づけてしまったからな

original: But I'm sure you've got plenty to keep you busy right about now, hmm?
string: でも、やるべき事が他に山ほどあるはずだ。そうだろう、な？

original: Anything I can help you with? A drink or a room perhaps?
string: 何かほしい物はない？

original: Pardon me, milord. Would you care to hear me play my lute?
string: すみません旦那様、私のリュートをお聞きになりませんか？

original: Pardon me, milady. Would you care to hear me play my lute?
string: すみません奥様、私のリュートをお聞きになりませんか？

original: If you fancy a bit of music, let me know.
string: もし音楽をお望みなら言って下さい

original: I can't believe Fastred's gone. I... I should have been nicer to her.
string: ファストレッドが行ってしまったなんて信じられない…　もっと優しくしておくんだった

original: I can't believe Fastred ran off to Riften with that... that bastard.
string: ファストレッドがリフテンに逃げたなんて信じられない。しかもあんな…　ろくでなしと一緒に

original: My daughter's driving me crazy, so forgive me if I'm a bit on edge.
string: 娘に手を焼いていてね。失礼があったら許してほしい

original: If you ever settle down to have children, think twice before you do it.
string: 身を固めて子供を持つつもりなら、その前にもう一度よく考えた方がいい

original: Any idea how I can get my daughter's head out of the clouds?
string: どうしたら娘の目を覚ましてやれると思う？

original: You a pilgrim or just passing through?
string: 巡礼者か？　それともただの通りすがりか？

original: Watch yourself on High Hrothgar, I hear wolves prowl the steps.
string: ハイ・フロスガーでは注意することだ。あの階段にはオオカミが出没するらしい

original: I hope Fastred's doing well in Riften. I miss her.
string: ファストレッドがリフテンで元気だといいですが。さびしいです

original: You must be another pilgrim on the way up to High Hrothgar. No other reason to pass through here.
string: ハイ・フロスガーへの巡礼者でしょう。他にここを通る理由がありませんから

original: Pilgrim or not, if I were you, I'd move right through our backwards little town.
string: 巡礼者であろうとなかろうと、私なら自分の小さな町を通り抜けて行きますね

original: You better not be here to stir up any trouble.
string: ここでは揉め事を起こさない方が身のためですよ

original: And to think that we've been supplying the Greybeards with our own food supplies. What have they ever done for us?
string: グレイビアードには、ずっと自分達の食料を提供してきました。しかし、彼らは私達に何をしてくれたのでしょう？

original: Oh! You're a traveler! You must have so much to tell about the world outside this boring town!
string: あら、旅の方ね！　この退屈な町の外について、色々聞かせてほしいわ！

original: Have anything interesting to tell me?
string: 何か面白い話はないの？

original: I can't imagine how exciting it must be like to journey from place to place. You're so lucky!
string: いろんな場所を旅するなんて、想像しただけでワクワクしちゃう！　あなたは幸運ね！

original: Narfi's happy now. Maybe Narfi can sleep. Sleep all night. Sleep, sleep, sleep.
string: 今は、ナルフィは幸せだ。一晩中でも眠れる。眠れる、眠る、眠る

original: Narfi's sad now. Still wait for Reyda. No more sleep. No, no... no.
string: ナルフィは寂しい。レイダに会いたい。眠れない、眠れないんだ…

original: I can't see you, Reyda! I can't find you! Why are you hiding? Hiding, hide, hide, hide! Don't make me sad!
string: レイダ、見えないぞ！　どこにいるんだ！　なぜ隠れる？　隠れるなんて、寂しいじゃないか！

original: Oh Reyda! Redya! You live among the clouds now, dear Reyda!
string: ああ、レイダ！　レイダ！　今は空の彼方にいるのか、レイダ！

original: I miss Reyda. She was so nice to Narfi. Narfi's sad he can't be with Reyda.
string: レイダに会いたい。彼女はナルフィ優しくしてくれた。一緒にいられなくて、ナルフィ寂しい

original: You don't look like a pilgrim. Why bother visiting Ivarstead?
string: 巡礼者には見えない。どうしてわざわざイヴァルステッドに？

original: Hmm? What do you want?
string: ああ？　何の用だ？

original: Is it absolutely necessary for you to bother me right now?
string: 本当に今邪魔をする必要があるのか？

original: Thanks again for delivering those supplies to the Greybeards.
string: グレイビアードに供物を届けてくれた礼を改めて言わせてくれ

original: Ah, good to see you again! How did that delivery go?
string: 戻ってきたか！　無事に運び終えたのか？

original: Passing through on your way to High Hrothgar? About to make a delivery up there myself.
string: ハイ・フロスガーに向かう途中か？　俺もそこへ届け物をしに行く所なんだ

original: I wish I could make my deliveries more often, but the road's getting dangerous.
string: もっとちょくちょく持って行きたいんだが、道が危険になってきている

original: 7,000 Steps indeed... next time they need to build it closer to the ground...
string: まさに七千階段だな…　今度はもっと低い場所に作ってもらいたいよ

original: I'm going to put those pelts you gave me to good use.
string: あなたがくれた生皮は、無駄にはしませんよ

original: So, have you shown those furry menaces that I mean business?
string: あの毛むくじゃらの害獣は、どうなりましたか？

original: This has to be the worst place in Skyrim to run a mill. How am I supposed to do anything with all those bears running around?
string: スカイリムで一番工場に向かない場所なのかもしれません。クマがそこら中を走り回って、私では手に負えませんから

original: These damn bears are driving me crazy!
string: あのクマども、本当に頭にくる！

original: Can you believe it? Another pile of logs ruined.
string: 信じられない。丸太の山が、また台無しですよ

original: I swear, if one more thing goes wrong, I'm going to burn my mill to the ground!
string: 何か悪いことがあと一度でも起こったら、工場を丸焼きにしてやりますよ

original: Hello, my friend? What can I do for you on such a fine day?
string: やあ、友よ。こんな素晴らしい日に何かご用かな？

original: Miss Temba is much happier now that you took care of those bears. She may not look like she is, but I can tell.
string: テンバさんはお前がクマの世話をしてくれるんで満足しているようだ。そんな風には見えないだろうが、確かだよ

original: Those bears are making Miss Temba so angry. I hope you can do something about them.
string: クマどものおかげでテンバさんがご立腹だ。なんとかできないか？

original: Such a fine day, smell the air! Isn't it wonderful?
string: いい天気だ。空気のにおいをかいでみろよ。素晴らしいじゃないか！

original: I hope life's treating you well, friend.
string: 友よ、良き人生が送れることを願うよ

original: Oh my, a guest!
string: おっと、お客さんか！

original: Please, make yourself at home!
string: さあどうぞ、くつろいで！

original: Lone travelers can find these woods a little treacherous.
string: この辺りの森は、ひとりで旅するには少々危険かも知れないな

original: We've been looking for someone to join us in a hunt.
string: 一緒に狩りをしてくれる仲間を探してたんだ

original: Hern and I do so adore guests! These guards are such a bore.
string: ハーンも私もお客様は大歓迎よ！　あの衛兵隊はつまらない連中だしね

original: A guest, oh my!
string: あら、お客様！

original: Why don't you stay a while?
string: しばらくここに泊まったらどう？

original: The patrols never seem to give us time to be alone, the nosy pests.
string: 警備隊にはうんざりしてるの。いつもあれこれ聞いてくるのよ

original: Is Hert his sister or his wife? Or both?
string: ハートは彼の妹か妻か？　それとも両方か？

original: Hert keeps giving me this look. I don't know if she wants me or if she wants to eat me.
string: ハートにこの格好をさせられている。好きなのか、食べたいのかは分からないが

original: Just my luck, stuck in the sticks with this crazy old woman.
string: 変わり者の老夫人とこんな辺ぴな土地に縛りつけられるなんて身の不運だ

original: I grew up hearing songs about Eyldi the Bear! She wrestled a storm out of the sky!
string: クマのエイルディの歌を聞いて育った。彼女は空からやってきた嵐と戦ったんだ！

original: If you're looking for a room, you want the Four Shields.
string: 部屋を探しているならフォー・シールズがいいわ

original: You look like you've seen your share of adventure.
string: かなり危険な目に遭ってきたようね

original: It's no easy thing to make a living in the wilds of Skyrim.
string: スカイリムの原野で生きるのは大変よ

original: Don't see many travelers out this way.
string: ここらで旅人を見かけるのは珍しいわ

original: This land's tough and unforgiving, but beautiful, too.
string: この大地は厳しく無慈悲だけれど、美しいの

original: You hear all this talk about a war? I hope it never comes here.
string: 戦争の話は色々耳にしたでしょう？　ここまで戦火が広がらないといいんだけど

original: Seen some mean-spirited folk pass through lately. Thought I was rid of those sorts when I left Markarth.
string: 最近、心卑しい輩が訪れてくる。マルカルスを出た時に、ああいう連中とはおさらばできると思ったのにな

original: Welcome, traveler. Mind yourself in our town.
string: ようこそ。町では気をつける事だ

original: We aren't a big city like Solitude or Markarth, but we like it this way.
string: ソリチュードやマルカルスのように大都市じゃない。でも、それがいいんだ

original: If it weren't for Michel, I'd probably be dead in a Markarth gutter by now.
string: ミッシェルがいなかったら、自分はマルカルスの片隅で死んでただろう

original: Got a loving wife, a healthy son and a patch of land to call my own. What more could a man ask for?
string: 愛する妻、元気な息子、それに自分の土地がある。これ以上のものが望めるか？

original: Are you a soldier? One day, I'm going to be a soldier!
string: 兵士さん？　僕、いつか兵士になるんだ！

original: Pa says I'm too young to fight in the war, but I can still help by patrolling the town.
string: パパが、戦争に行って戦うにはまだ早いって言うんだ。でも町をパトロールすれば僕だって役に立てるよ

original: I wish I was a soldier! They get to travel and stay up late and have fun!
string: 僕が兵士だったらなあ！　旅も夜更かしも遊びも、たくさんできるんだ！

original: Have you met Lucky? He's my pet goat, and he helps me patrol the town.
string: ラッキーに会わなかった？　ペットのヤギなんだけど、町のパトロールを手伝ってくれているんだ

original: I'm hoping to run my own inn someday.
string: いつか、自分の宿屋を経営したいと思っているの

original: Faida's teaching me the innkeeper's trade. She runs the Four Shields.
string: ファイダには宿屋の経営について教わってるの。彼女はフォー・シールズを経営してるわ

original: Please stop looking at me like that.
string: そんな目で見るのはやめて

original: First the war and now there's talk of dragons. What's next?
string: 最初は戦争、次はドラゴン。今度は何？

original: Working hard gives a man reason for drinking hard! Well, that and putting up with a wife like mine.
string: キリキリ働けばガンガン飲める！　そうすりゃ俺んとこのみたいな女房にも耐えられるってわけだ

original: You're a well-traveled sort, I can tell just looking at you.
string: 旅慣れてるみたいだな。見れば分かるよ

original: You been to Markarth? They've got a tavern called the Silver-Blood Inn. Best ale this side of Skyrim.
string: マルカルスにいたのか？　シルバーブラッドって名前の酒場があったろ？　スカイリムのこの辺りじゃ一番うまい酒を出すんだ

original: Money's been tight since the mill burned down. My wife won't let me forget it.
string: 工場が焼けてから資金繰りは厳しいよ。女房はいつもそればっかり言うんだ

original: They say a strong drink, a sharp axe and a good woman are all a Nord needs to be happy. Two out of three's not bad.
string: 強い酒といい武器、それといい女が揃えばノルドは幸せなんだとさ。そのうち2つもありゃ悪くないと思うよ

original: Rest a spell! Can't work every minute of your life.
string: 少しは休め！　働き詰めは良くないぞ

original: Where is that lazy man?
string: あの怠け者はどこだい？

original: You going to try and sell me something? Well, I ain't interested.
string: 何か売りつけようっての？　興味ないからね

original: Did my worthless husband send you?
string: うちの旦那のお使いで来たのかい？

original: Got nothing to say to strange folk.
string: 知らない連中に話す事なんかないよ

original: Keep walking, stranger.
string: 足を止めるな、よそ者め

original: Got nothing to spare for travelers nor refugees, here.
string: 旅人にも避難民にも、やるものは何もない

original: If you're looking for handouts, look somewhere else.
string: 施しがほしいなら、他の誰かに頼め

original: You want anything in this life, you gotta take it. Just not from me.
string: ほしいものがあるなら、奪え。ただし、よそを当たれ

original: Faida's the name. I keep the inn.
string: 名はファイダです。宿をやっています

original: Something different about you, I can tell. Hope you ain't here to cause trouble.
string: 他の人とは何かが違うようですが、ここでの面倒はごめんですよ

original: The meals I serve ain't what I'd call a Jarl's feast, but they'll fill your belly.
string: 食事は、首長の晩餐とまでは言えませんが量は十分ですよ

original: Seen a lot of travelers lately. Mostly soldier, nowadays.
string: 近頃は旅行者が増えました。最近では、ほとんどが兵士です

original: You met the Lylvieves? Quiet family, but they're the heart of Dragon Bridge.
string: リルヴィエーブスに会いました？　物静かな一家ですが、ドラゴン・ブリッジの中心ですよ

original: Poor Horgeir. Everyone in town knows about his wife's affair but him. Probably better if he doesn't know.
string: 気の毒なホルジェール。奥さんの事は、この町で彼以外全員が知っています。知らない方が幸せでしょうね

original: I think the dragons are here to test us, and make sure we're still true Nords.
string: ドラゴンは私達を試しに来たのでしょう。今でも真のノルドかどうか確かめるために

original: I was a barmaid at the Winking Skeever when I met my husband, rest his soul. Wasn't for him, I'd still be working there!
string: 夫に出会ったのは、ウィンキング・スキーヴァーでバーテンをしていた時です。夫がいなければ、今でもあそこで働いていたでしょうね！

original: Respect the law, and you'll have no trouble in Dragon Bridge.
string: 法を守ることだ。そうすればドラゴン・ブリッジで面倒にあうことはない

original: Mind you don't cross Tassius. He's in charge around here.
string: タシウスとは関わるな。奴はこの辺全部を仕切っている

original: Don't start any trouble and I think we'll get along just fine.
string: 面倒を起こすなよ。そうすれば、うまくやれるはずだ

original: At least, if you're gonna cause trouble, go somewhere else, okay? Please?
string: とにかく、問題を起こすようなことがあったら、よそへ言ってもらうよ。いいな？

original: Are you a mercenary? You won't find much work here.
string: 傭兵か？ ここではあまり仕事がないだろう

original: Another quiet day.
string: 今日も静かだ

original: Another quiet day... I hope.
string: 今日も静かだ…　と願いたい

original: Heard there were wolves on the road up north.
string: 北では狼が道に出ていると聞いた

original: Those rebels better not try coming to Haafingar.
string: 反逆者どもはハーフィンガルに来ない方がいい

original: I'll bet a drunk like you sees a lot of strange things.
string: 酔っ払いには、色々不思議な物が見えるだろうな

original: I give up. What did you see?
string: お手上げだ。何を見たんだ？

original: (Remain silent)
string: (黙っている)

original: Very well. I respect your discretion.
string: いいでしょう。あなたの意思を尊重するわ

original: Now, I need your assistance with a matter of a more... personal nature.
string: そこで、あなたの手を借りたいの…　今度は少し個人的な事でね

original: Oh, very good. Very good indeed. You, my dear, are going to fit in here quite nicely...
string: まあ、すばらしいわ。その調子よ。あなた、ここにうまくなじめそうね…

original: Now, I need your assistance with a matter of a more... personal nature.
string: そこで、あなたの手を借りたいの…　今度は少し個人的な事でね

original: I live only to serve. Hail Sithis!
string: 忠誠こそすべてだ。シシス万歳！

original: Of course, dear. Of course. And, from what my little ravens tell me, you handled yourself quite well.
string: もちろんよ。そのとおりだわ。それに、レイヴンの話によると、なかなかの手際だったようね

original: Now, I need your assistance with a matter of a more... personal nature.
string: そこで、あなたの手を借りたいの…　今度は少し個人的な事でね

original: I did what had to be done. Nothing more.
string: やるべき事をやっただけだ。それ以上のものじゃない

original: Ah, you're back. So, how went your first real contract? A bit more exciting than what Nazir's been offering, I'd wager.
string: 戻ったのね。初めての本格的な任務はどうだった？　ナジルからの任務に比べれば、少しはやりがいがあったんじゃないかしら？

original: That bastard got exactly what he deserved.
string: 当然の報いね、いい気味だわ

original: But last I heard, Nilsine is still alive. So I guess you decided not to kill her as well. I have to admit... I'm disappointed.
string: 最後に聞いた話だと、ニルシンはまだ生きてるらしいわね。彼女は殺さないことにしたの？　正直…　失望したわ

original: Here's the payment for killing Alain. And nothing for letting Nilsine live. Just remember, that was your decision.
string: これがアラインを始末した報酬よ。ニルシンの分は生きてるからなしよ。自分で決めたってことは、忘れないで

original: Alain Dufont now lies dead.
string: アライン・デュフォンは死んだ

original: Thank you. That bastard got exactly what he deserved.
string: ありがとう。アイツにはふさわしい罰ね

original: And... I heard about Nilsine. You have more than fulfilled your part of the bargain. Please, take this - as payment, and a symbol of my affection.
string: それと…　ニルシンのこと聞いたわ。取り決め以上のことをしてくれたのね。報酬にこれを受け取って。感謝のしるしよ

original: I'll never forget you.
string: この恩は忘れないわ

original: Alain Dufont now lies dead.
string: アライン・デュフォンは死んだ

original: Well, what news? Is Alain...
string: それで、どうなったの？　アラインは…

original: DB03MuiriAlainWhyBranchTopic
string: DB03MuiriAlainWhyBranchTopic

original: I went to Windhelm to see the Shatter-Shields. They were old and dear friends, and... in mourning. Friga was killed recently. Murdered...
string: ウィンドヘルムに行って、シャッター・シールド家の人々に会ったわ。古くからの友人で…　喪に服していた。フリガが最近亡くなったの。殺されたのよ…

original: I met Alain in the tavern, while I was... drinking my sadness away. He was handsome, and charming. He said I was the "beautiful lily" of his dreams.
string: アラインと出会ったのは酒場よ。その時は…　飲んで悲しみを紛らわせようとしてたの。彼はハンサムで、魅力的だった。私のことを、夢の中の“美しい百合”と呼んでくれた

original: Alain made all the pain just... go away. But it was all lies! Alain used me. He ruined my name, destroyed my friendship with the Shatter-Shields...
string: アラインはすべての痛みを…　ぬぐい去ってくれた。けど、全部ウソだった！　利用しただけだったのよ！　名前を汚され、シャッター・シールド家との友情も壊された…

original: Do you know why Alain was in Windhelm? He heard about Friga's murder. He wanted to befriend the family, in their grief... and rob them blind.
string: アラインがなぜウィンドヘルムにいたか知ってる？　彼はフリガが殺されたと聞いたの。悲しみに暮れる家族を助けるフリして…　お金を巻き上げたのよ

original: Alain used me to get close to my friends. And now they all think I'm some kind of... monster. Alain Dufont took my life. And now I'm taking his.
string: アラインは、友人と仲良くなるために近づいてきたの。そのせいで私は怪物みたいに思われている。アライン・デュフォンに人生を奪われた。だから今度は奪ってやるのよ

original: Tell me the full story. Why do you want Alain dead?
string: すべて聞かせてほしい。なぜアラインに死んでほしい？

original: Excellent. Once Alain is dead, I'll pay you. In gold. I've saved up a bit. I hope that'll do.
string: 期待してるわ。アラインが死んだら報酬としてゴールドを支払うわ。少し蓄えていたの。それで足りるといいけど

original: But, well... There is one more thing. If you're interested?
string: あと…　もうひとつあるの。聞いてくれる？

original: It will be done.
string: 任せろ

original: DB03MuiriContractDetails2a
string: DB03MuiriContractDetails2a

original: I'll need more to go on than that...
string: それだけじゃ物足りないな…

original: What?
string: 何？

original: Alain is... is dead?
string: アラインが…　死んだ？

original: I... I'm grateful. It's just this... this isn't at all how I imagined things would play out. There was Alain, but I was considering more, and...
string: そう…　嬉しいわ。ただ…　こんな展開はまったく想像していなかったけど。アラインには、その、もっと何というか…

original: Ah, well. Dead is dead. Right? My thanks to you, assassin. Here's the gold I was going to pay for the job. You earned it, after all.
string: まあいいわ。本当に死んだんでしょう？　ありがとう。このゴールドは、支払おうと思っていた報酬よ。これであなたのものってわけね

original: Actually, Alain Dufont is already dead. I killed him.
string: 実のところ、アライン・デュフォンはもう死んでる。殺したからだ

original: DB03MuiriContractDetails1
string: DB03MuiriContractDetails1

original: What I need? What I need is for Alain Dufont to die! I want him hunted down and murdered like the dog he is!
string: 望み？　アライン・デュフォンの死よ！　アイツを追い詰めて、まるでイヌのように殺してほしいの！

original: Obviously. Now tell me what you need.
string: 見ての通りだ。さあ、望みを聞かせてくれ

original: DB03MuiriKillNilsineTopic
string: DB03MuiriKillNilsineTopic

original: If you can... I want you to kill someone else, as well. You don't have to - not as part of our deal. But if you do... I'll pay you even more.
string: できれば、他にも殺してほしいの。契約にはないから、その必要はないけれど。でも、引き受けてくれたら…　報酬を増やすわ

original: It's Nilsine Shatter-Shield, in Windhelm. If Nilsine dies, too... I'll make it worth your while.
string: 相手は、ウィンドヘルムのニルシン・シャッター・シールドよ。ニルシンが死ねば…　報酬を払うわ

original: I'm listening.
string: 聞かせてくれ

original: Isn't there some business you should be tending to?
string: あなたが気にかけなきゃならない用件でもあるの？

original: The Dark Brotherh... Oh. Oh! I... my goodness, you're really here! The Black Sacrament. It actually worked?
string: 闇の一党…　ああ！　驚いた、本当に来てくれた！　黒き聖餐は本当に効果があったのね？

original: The Dark Brotherhood has come, Muiri.
string: 闇の一党が来た、ムイリ

original: Why are you looking at me like that?
string: なぜそんな目で見るの？

original: We all are, my dear, but sometimes the Divines reward those who don't seem to deserve it. Call it dumb luck.
string: 皆そうさ。だが神々はその価値のない者に恩恵を与える事がある。ばかげた幸運としか言いようがないがな

original: Sometimes I'm surprised he's still the chief.
string: 時々、彼がいまだに族長でいる事が不思議に思えるよ

original: Oh, you've seen your father just trying to chase a skeever from his house. He's a bit soft.
string: 見た事があるだろう。お前の父親はスキーヴァーを家から追い払おうとしただけだ。彼は少し甘い

original: It's a wonderful house, my love. If you don't mind, I'm going to start a small store. Something to do whenever you're on the road.
string: すてきな家だな。よかったら、小さな店を始めてもいいかな？　君が出かけている間に、やりたいんだ

original: You have quite a house. I'm thinking of setting up a small store here. Sell odds and ends.
string: すごい家を持っているな。ここで小さなお店をやろうと思う。雑貨を売ろう

original: Strange house, but strong. Solid. I think I'll open a store. A task to tend to whenever you're away.
string: 変わった家だが頑丈でしっかりしているな。店を開こうと思っている。お前が留守の時もやる事があるように

original: This house of yours is wondrous, at least to these eyes. I've thought about starting a store. Something to do here when you're out.
string: お前の家は素敵だ。実は店を開きたいとずっと思ってたんだ。お前が出かけてる間に、ここでやりたい

original: This house is huge. I'll be tripping my feet all over this place. Hey, I think I'll start a little business here. Something to do, you know?
string: この家はでかい。そこら中でつまずいて転びそうだ。なら、ここでビジネスを始めてみよう。どうせ暇だしな

original: I've seen bigger houses, but it's yours, so I like it. Now, I think I need something to do if you're ever away, so I'll be opening a store.
string: 大きな家ならいくらでもあるけど、お前の家が一番好きだな。お前が家を空けている間は、店でもやろう

original: A good house. You chose well. I don't like sitting still, so I've decided to open a store. Buy and sell whatever is needed.
string: いい家だ。見る目があるな。じっとしてるのは好きじゃないから、店を始めよう。何でも売り買いできる店だ

original: Hello, my love. Back from some adventure I bet.
string: おかえり。疲れただろ？

original: It's good to see you again, dear.
string: 会えて嬉しいよ

original: It's pleasing to see you again.
string: また会えて嬉しいぞ

original: Ah, it's my love, come to visit.
string: おお、お前か。寄っていってくれ

original: Hello, dear. I haven't been drinking too much, if that's what you're thinking.
string: やあ。最近はそれほど飲んでねえ。それを聞きたかったんだろ？

original: You and I, we're the only people in Skyrim worth loving. That's what I think.
string: 愛する価値があるのは、このスカイリムでお前と俺だけ。俺はそう思う

original: Good to see you, dear.
string: 元気そうでよかった

original: Yes, my love? What do you need?
string: ああ。どうしたんだ？

original: Do you need anything, my love?
string: 何か必要か？

original: Speak. You can ask anything of me, love.
string: 何だ？　何でも言ってくれ

original: Is there anything you need, dearest?
string: 何か必要なものはあるか？

original: I love you. You know that, right?
string: 愛してるよ。分かってるだろ？

original: What do you need, love? Ask anything.
string: 何がいる？　何でも言ってくれ

original: Yes, love?
string: ん、どうした？

original: What about my father? Was he a good hunter?
string: 私の父はどうだった？　いい狩人だったか？

original: Oh of course. My mistake.
string: ああもちろん。私の間違いだ

original: That's what everyone keeps saying. But you didn't kill her. That's what I was asking.
string: 皆がずっと言っている事だ。だが、お前は彼女を殺さなかった。それを聞いていたんだ

original: They are indeed. Nothing like your mother, though!
string: まったくその通りだ。お前の母親とは似ても似つかないがね

original: They're fearsome!
string: 恐ろしい奴らだ！

original: Oh, probably a troll.
string: ああ、トロールかな

original: What's the most dangerous beast you've ever killed?
string: 今まで殺した獣の中で一番危険だったのは何だ？

original: Cough Cough
string: ゲホ、ゲホ

original: Cough
string: ゲホ

original: They are, but your mind has to be sharp, too.
string: そうだ。だが、心の目も研ぎ澄まさなければならない

original: My eyes are sharp.
string: 私は目ざといよ

original: No, just very difficult. You have to look for shift in various shades of white.
string: いや、とても難しいだけだ。白い影に浮かぶ様々な色合いの中から、変化を見いださなければならない

original: But you said that was impossible.
string: しかし、それは重要だと言っていたではないか

original: Come, child, I will tell you how to track a snow cat.
string: 来い。スノーキャットの追跡はどうやるのか教えてやろう

original: Oh, good point. I wish my head were made of rocks.
string: おお、いいところを突いてきたな。お前の頭が岩でできていたらよかったのに

original: That would be good! I could use it to smash other rocks. Easier to mine, then.
string: そりゃいい！　それで他の岩を打ち砕けるから、採掘も楽になるな

original: Sometimes I think your head is made of rocks.
string: 時々、お前の頭が岩でできているんじゃないかと思う事がある

original: Not today, we can't.
string: 今日はだめだ

original: Can we both be chiefs?
string: 二人とも族長になれるかな？

original: That's just how it is with families. When we're chiefs, you'll see how it is.
string: それが家族だろ。族長になったら、お前にも分かるさ

original: Here's the book you were looking for.
string: これが探していた本だ

original: Looks like you're still in one piece. And more importantly, so is the book. Thank you.
string: どうやらまだ生きているようだな。もっと重要なのは書も無事だという事だ。感謝するよ

original: Mauhulakh's aunts. You know... the way they're all around him all the time.
string: マウフラクの叔母達だ。ほら…　四六時中、彼の周りにまとわりついている感じがさ

original: Who has a sister?
string: 誰に姉妹がいるんだ？

original: Do you ever get a weird feeling about those sisters?
string: あの姉妹変だと思わないか？

original: You can tell it because it has lots of ebony.
string: たくさんの黒檀があるからすぐに分かる

original: So where is it?
string: で、どこだ？

original: We love you, Dark Brotherhood! Ha ha ha ha ha!
string: 闇の一党、最高！　はははは！

original: Ha ha ha ha ha! Hooray!
string: あははは！　やったあ！

original: Aventus really did it! He got the Dark Brotherhood to kill old Grelod! Ha ha ha ha ha!
string: アベンタスは本当にやったわ！　闇の一党を使ってグレロッドを殺したのよ！　あはははは！

original: Hurrah! Hurrah!
string: やった！　やった！

original: Yay!
string: やった！

original: Hooray! Grelod the Kind is dead at last! We're saved!
string: やった！　“親切者のグレロッド”がついに死んだ！　助かったんだ！

original: Grelod is dead! Aventus did it! Ha ha ha ha ha!
string: グレロッドが死んだ！　アベンタスがやった！　あはははは！

original: Someone has killed Grelod! Ha ha ha ha ha!
string: 誰かがグレロッドを殺したんだ！　あははは！

original: No, I don't need to mark it. I remember it.
string: いいや、印を付ける必要はない。ちゃんと覚えている

original: Did you mark it?
string: 印を付けたか？

original: In continuing with our theme of safety, we'll start with Wards. Wards are protective spells that block magic.
string: 魔法の安全性の続きで、シールドスペルについて話そう。これは防護の呪文で、魔法を遮断ができるものだ

original: I'll teach you all a ward, and we'll see if you can successfully use it to block spells, all right?
string: シールドスペルの一つを教えよう。呪文を遮断できるかな

original: All right, let's settle down. I suppose we can try something practical...
string: これくらいで良いだろう。実践してみようか…

original: Then help me convince her to pay.
string: ならば、彼女を説得して支払わせるのに協力しろ

original: Look, I'm only telling you this because I care for her. Don't mistake this as acceptance for what you do.
string: いいか、今からある事を教える。ただし、それは彼女を思ってるからこそだ。お前の行いを容認してるわけじゃない

original: Keerava has some family at a farm just inside of Morrowind. If you mention you know about it, she might just listen to you.
string: キーラバには、モロウウィンド内の農場に家族がいる。その事を知っていると言えば、話を聞いてくれるかも知れない

original: Just please, don't harm anyone. I couldn't bear the thought.
string: 頼むから、誰も傷つけないでくれ。それだけは耐えられない

original: You might want to talk some sense into Keerava.
string: キーラバに物事の道理を教えてやったらどうだ？

original: With the rumors going around about how poorly your Guild's been doing, she's become much too bold.
string: あんたらのギルドの評判が下がるにつれて、確かに彼女は大胆になってきている

original: I'm not that foolish. The last thing I want is a war with your people.
string: 俺はそんなに馬鹿じゃない。あんたらと争うのだけは避けたい

original: I'm finished wasting my time talking to you.
string: もういい。お前と話をしていても時間の無駄だ

original: Good, and take this little message back to your bosses.
string: 結構よ。じゃあこの伝言をボスに持って行って

original: I'm not paying any of you a single septim... ever! Now get out of my inn!
string: あなたなんかに1ゴールドだって払うもんですか！　さあ、ここから出てって！

original: It was never a request.
string: お願いしているわけじゃないぞ

original: Look around you, I'm barely keeping this rathole together. The war's seen to that.
string: 見ての通り、このあばら家を維持するだけで精一杯なの。みんな戦争のせいよ

original: Fair enough.
string: 分かった

original: Now if there are no more questions, how about following me and I'll show you what we're all about.
string: もう質問がないなら、俺に付いて来たらどうだ。俺達の事を教えてやる

original: I have a message for you from Brynjolf.
string: ブリニョルフからの言伝を預かってる

original: Look, everything was all just a misunderstanding. I didn't mean to tell Brynjolf to go jump off the pier. You'll tell him I said sorry, yes?
string: ねえ、すべてまったくの誤解だったの。ブリニョルフに桟橋から飛び降りろなんて言うつもりはなかったわ。悪かったと思ってるって彼に伝えて？

original: Take this. Every single coin I owe is there, I swear it.
string: 持って行って。借りてた分はこれだけ。本当よ

original: I'll already told that buffoon I'm not paying you people a single coin!
string: あの馬鹿に1ゴールドだって払うもんですか。言ったはずよ！

original: T03SharedInfo
string: T03SharedInfo

original: To the east of here is a hidden grove where the Eldergleam resides. It's the oldest living thing in Skyrim. Maybe all of Tamriel.
string: ここの東の秘密の森に、エルダーグリームがあります。スカイリム最古の存在と考えられていますが、タムリエル最古かもしれません

original: Our tree here in the city was grown from a cutting of that tree. You can still feel the glory of the mother tree through it.
string: その切り枝を育てたのが、私達の街の木です。母樹の荘厳さが今でも感じ取れるでしょう

original: Even its name is an echo.
string: その名声は過去の物だとしても

original: What happened here?
string: ここで何があったんだ？

original: Another girl killed. This is Susanna, from Candlehearth Hall.
string: また新たな犠牲者だ。キャンドルハース・ホールのスザンナらしい

original: Served me a drink just a few nights ago... but I can't say I knew her.
string: ついこの間の夜、お酒を出してくれた…　知り合いってわけじゃないが

original: Did you see what happened here?
string: 何が起こったんだ？

original: Eehhh... no. Sorry. But I did notice that her coinpurse was still intact, so whoever did this wasn't after gold.
string: あいにくだけど、何も見てないよ。でも小銭入れはそのままだから犯人は金目当てじゃないね

original: I'm going to keep preparing the body, if you'll excuse me.
string: すまないが、遺体の埋葬の準備をさせてもらうよ

original: Did you see what happened here?
string: 何が起こったんだ？

original: Sorry. I thought I saw a fellow running away, but didn't get a good look at him.
string: いいや、誰かが走り去ったのは見たのが、それが誰だかは分からない…

original: Did you see what happened here?
string: 何が起こったんだ？

original: I heard a scream and came running, but she was already... like this... when I got here.
string: 悲鳴を聞いて駆けつけたんですが、駆けつけたときには…　もう彼女はこんな風に…

original: I've spoken to the witnesses.
string: 目撃者に話を聞いてきた

original: Just like always -- nobody saw anything useful. The bastard's escaped again.
string: いつもと同じだ。役に立つ目撃情報はない。またしても逃げられた

original: I've been sent here to kill you.
string: お前を殺しに来た

original: Of course, sent by... what is it that she's calling herself these days? Shazra? Saadia? One of those, correct?
string: なるほど。依頼主は…　今は自らを何と呼んでいる？　シャズラか？　サーディアか？　そのいずれかだろう？

original: Did she appeal to your sense of honor? Your greed? A more... base need, perhaps? It doesn't matter.
string: 彼女が利用したのはお前の道義心か？　金欲か？　それとも…　もっと卑しい欲望か？　まあどうでもいい

original: No doubt she's convinced you that she's the victim. But, do you know why we pursue her?
string: あの女に自分は被害者だと吹き込まれたようだが、我々が彼女を追っている理由は知っているのか？

original: Perhaps. If there's money in it.
string: なるほど。金になるならやろう

original: There will be. Of that, you can be assured.
string: お支払いします。約束します

original: Maybe. What do you want?
string: なるほど。どうしてほしいんだ？

original: I am not the person that the people of Whiterun think I am. My real name is Iman. I am a noble of House Suda in Hammerfell.
string: 私はホワイトランの人々が思っているような人間ではありません。本当の名前はイマンと言います。ハンマーフェルのスーダ家の貴族なんです

original: The men who are looking for me, the Alik'r, they are assassins in the employ of the Aldmeri Dominion. They wish to exchange my blood for gold.
string: 私を探している連中はアリクル。アルドメリ自治領が雇った暗殺者です。私の血と引き換えにゴールドを手に入れるつもりでしょう

original: I need you to root them out and drive them away before they find me and drag me back to Hammerfell for an execution.
string: 見つかって、ハンマーフェルまで連行されて処刑される前に、あいつらを見つけて追い払って下さい

original: They just asked me to find you.
string: あなたを探すよう頼まれただけだ

original: You can't tell them!
string: だめよ、話さないで！

original: Please, I need your help and there isn't anyone I can trust here in the city.
string: お願い、助けて。この街で信用できる人は一人もいないんです

original: Relax, I'm not going to hurt you.
string: 落ちつけ。あなたを傷つけたりはしない

original: Then I need your help and there isn't anyone I can trust here in the city.
string: なら助けて下さい。この街で信用できる人は一人もいないんです

original: Why did they leave you here?
string: なぜここに置き去りにされた？

original: Because I was clumsy enough to be captured.
string: それは、自分がドジを踏んで捕まったからだ

original: Kematu always says we're supposed to be the best of the best. I wasn't.
string: ケマツは常に、我々は超一流でいなければならないと言ってた。自分はそうじゃなかったわけだ

original: How much to pay your fine?
string: 罰金としていくら必要なんだ？

original: 100 gold will secure my release. You can afford that, can't you?
string: 100ゴールドもあれば釈放してもらえる。それだけ払えるか？

original: I suppose you'd better hope you can, if you want the information.
string: もし持っていないなら、情報はやれない

original: Get the money into the hands of one of these guards, and I'll tell you what you want to know.
string: 衛兵のひとりにその金を掴ませろ。そしたら知りたい事を教えてやる

original: Very well.
string: 結構ですよ

original: Kematu is west of Whiterun. It's an unassuming little cave called Swindler's Den.
string: ケマツはホワイトランの西にいる。そこは詐欺師の隠れ家と呼ばれる目立たない小さな洞窟だ

original: You realize if you set foot in there, you're never coming back out. They'll kill you.
string: 分かってると思うが、あそこに足を踏み入れたら、二度と戻ってはこれない。奴らに殺されるぞ

original: But that's your problem, not mine.
string: だが、それはこっちの知った事じゃない

original: Your fine's been paid. Now tell me about Kematu.
string: 罰金は払っておいた。ケマツについて教えてくれ

original: Then we have nothing more to say to one another.
string: なら、お互い話し合うことはないな

original: I don't have that much gold.
string: そんなに手持ちがない

original: What is it that you need?
string: そっちの訳とは何だ？

original: I have dishonored my brothers by being captured, and so they have left me here.
string: 捕まった事で、兄弟達の名誉を汚してしまった。だから、ここに置き去りにされたんだ

original: My life with the Alik'r is over now, but I have no wish to die in this gods-forsaken land. If I can be released from prison, I may start over.
string: アリクルでの人生はもう終わった。だが、この神に見捨てられた土地で死ぬつもりはない。ここから出られれば、再出発できるはずだ

original: See to that, and I'll tell you what you want to know.
string: 手を貸してくれ。そうすれば知りたい事を教えよう

original: I need to find Kematu. Where is he hiding?
string: 訳あってケマツを探している。どこに隠れているんだ？

original: You have a death wish, then? If you know that name, you must know to meet him would be to meet your end.
string: ならば、死の願望があるのか？　その名を知っている以上、彼に会えば命を落とす事になると分かっているはずだ

original: But it seems we both have needs, friend. Perhaps we can help each other out.
string: だが、そちらも訳ありのようだな。互いに協力できるかも知れない

original: You buy my way out of here, and I'll tell you what you want to know.
string: 金を払ってここから出してくれれば、知りたいことを教えよう

original: Let's talk about how we can help each other.
string: 互いに協力する方法について聞かせてほしい

original: Tell me what's going on.
string: 何が起こっているのか教えてくれ

original: No. There are too many people around. Come with me.
string: いいえ。ここは人が多すぎます。一緒に来て下さい

original: I've told you, we can't talk out in the open. Come with me.
string: 人目のあるところでは話せないと言ったでしょう。一緒に来て下さい

original: So the Alik'r know where I am? What did they offer you? Gold? How many more of them are coming?
string: では、アリクルは私の居場所を知っているのですね？　どんな条件？　ゴールド？　他に何人ぐらいやってくるのです？

original: Tell me!
string: 話して！

original: Who are you looking for again?
string: 誰を探していると？

original: We're looking for a fugitive who comes from Hammerfell. A Redguard woman. She may be somewhere in this city.
string: ハンマーフェルから来た逃亡者を探している。レッドガードの女だ。市中のどこかにいるかも知れない

original: Did you know some Alik'r warriors are looking for a Redguard woman?
string: アリクルの戦士達が、レッドガードの女を探しているのを知っていたか？

original: Are you sure?
string: 本当か？

original: Oh no! They've found me? I need your help!
string: まずいわ！　見つかった？　助けて下さい！

original: Please, come with me. I need to speak to you privately.
string: お願い、一緒に来て下さい。内密に話したいことがあります

original: The who? I'm sorry, I have no idea what you're talking about.
string: 誰ですって？　ごめんなさい、何の話かさっぱり分からないの

original: Why have the Alik'r been banned from the market?
string: アリクルが市場に出入禁止にならない理由は？

original: Who are the Alik'r?
string: アリクルとは誰だ？

original: Who are you looking for?
string: 誰を探している？

original: A woman -- a foreigner in these lands. Redguard, like us.
string: 女だ…　この辺りの者ではない。我々と同じレッドガードだ

original: She is likely not using her true name. We will pay for any information regarding her location.
string: おそらく彼女は本名を隠している。居場所に関する情報なら、何であれ謝礼を出そう

original: We are not welcome here in Whiterun, so we will be in Rorikstead if you learn anything.
string: 我々はここホワイトランでは歓迎されていない。ロリクステッドにいるから、何か分かったら来てくれ

original: We're looking for information about a woman -- a foreigner in these lands. She's a Redguard, like us.
string: ある女の情報を探している…　この辺りの者ではない。我々と同じレッドガードだ

original: We believe she may be hiding in Whiterun, but we're checking everywhere to be sure.
string: ホワイトランに潜んでいると思われるが、念のため各地を捜索している

original: I can't believe it's come to this.
string: まさかこんな日が来るなんて、信じられない

original: I really thought you'd be able to save me.
string: 助けてくれると本当に思っていました

original: Please, let's hurry.
string: お願い、急いで

original: Let's get to the stables before they find me.
string: 見つかる前に馬屋に行きましょう

original: Any news of the Alik'r?
string: アリクルについて何か知らせはある？

original: Please, we need to speak in private.
string: お願い、この話は内密にしましょう

original: What are you looking at?
string: 何だその目は？

original: Can you help me find someone? There's gold in it for you.
string: 人探しを手伝ってくれないか？　この中に報酬が入っている

original: We're looking for someone. Maybe you can help.
string: 人を探している。手伝ってほしい

original: I have some questions for you. I'm trying to find someone.
string: 聞きたい事がある。人を探しているんだ

original: The Alik'r are not permitted within the city walls.
string: アリクルは壁の内側には入れてもらえない

original: You're not one of those Alik'r thugs, are you?
string: アリクル達の仲間じゃないだろうな？

original: By decree of the Jarl, the Alik'r are banned from Whiterun.
string: 首長の命により、アリクルはホワイトランから追放された

original: Do you have news of our quarry?
string: 採石場について何か知らないか？

original: Thank you for your trust. I am eager to return to my homeland.
string: 信頼に感謝する。故郷に早く戻りたいんだ

original: I found a big load of ebony at the bottom pocket in the mine.
string: 鉱山の底のくぼみで大量の黒檀を見つけた

original: There's only one chief!
string: 族長は1人だけだ！

original: The other chief!
string: もう1人の族長！

original: Which other one?
string: どっちの事を言っている？

original: What about the other one?
string: もう1つの方は？

original: Well, right. One of us will be a chief.
string: ああ、そのとおりだ。我々のどちらかが族長になる

original: But I thought there was only one chief.
string: だが、族長はたったひとりだったと思う

original: A bit longer, yet. We need more money if we want to be chiefs of our own.
string: もう少し長い。族長になりたければ金をもっと稼がないと

original: How much longer do we have to work this backwoods mine?
string: 後どれだけこの辺境の鉱山を管理しないといけない？

original: Bolar and I will tell you.
string: ボラーと私が教えてやろう

original: Sweet Mother, sweet Mother, send your child unto me, for the sins of the unworthy must be baptized in blood and fear.
string: 愛しき母、愛しき母よ。あなたの子をお送り下さい。卑しむべき者の罪は、血と恐怖で清められなければならないのです

original: Please... How long must I do this? I keep praying, Night Mother. Why won't you answer me?
string: ねえ…　いつまでやればいいんですか？　夜母にずっと祈ってるのに、どうして答えてくれないんですか？

original: Sweet Mother, sweet Mother, send your child unto me, for the sins of the unworthy must be baptized in blood and fear.
string: 愛しき母、愛しき母よ。あなたの子をお送り下さい。卑しむべき者の罪は、血と恐怖で清められなければならないのです

original: So... very tired...
string: はあ…　すごく疲れた…

original: Grelod, you old crone. You'll get what you deserve. The Dark Brotherhood will see to that...
string: グレロッド、あのくそばばあ。報いを受けさせてやる。闇の一党がやってくれるんだ…

original: Die, Grelod! Die!
string: 死ね、グレロッド！　死ね！

original: How will I know when I'm ready?
string: 準備ができたとどうやって分かる？

original: I don't think you're quite ready yet.
string: きちんと準備ができているとは思えないが

original: Well, I...
string: つまり…

original: Bolar said you had been looking for a new wife?
string: ボラーはお前が新しい妻を探していると言っていたが？

original: You wanted to see me?
string: 俺に用事か？

original: She's just worried about you. We all are. We just want you to be happy. We want to make you happy.
string: 彼女はお前を心配しているだけだ。我々皆もだ。ただお前に幸せになってほしい。お前を幸せにしたいのだ

original: Since Galka was taken from us. She's been... sad, I guess.
string: ガルカは我々から引き離されてからというもの、ずっと…　寂しがっていると思う

original: Oh? I hadn't noticed.
string: そうか？　気がつかなかった

original: Bolar has been in a bad mood for weeks, now.
string: ボラーはここ数週間ずっと機嫌が悪い

original: Just... try and keep out of our way.
string: ただ…　我々の邪魔をしないようにしていてくれ

original: What can you tell me about the "Butcher"?
string: “ブッチャー”について何か知らないか？

original: I've been following him for months now. Well, not actually following. Trying to find him.
string: もう何ヶ月も追いかけているわ。えっと、正確には追いかけているじゃないわね。見つけようとしている

original: The guards won't help. The people won't help. I'm the only one who thinks he can be caught.
string: 衛兵は助けにならない。みんなも助けにならない。あいつを捕まえられるって考えているのは私だけ

original: Can you tell me anything about the "Butcher"?
string: “ブッチャー”について教えてほしい

original: Uf. Have you been talking to Viola Giordano? She posts those all over the city, and someone keeps taking them down.
string: ヴィオラ・ジョルダノとは話したか？　彼女がその話を街のあちこちに貼って回って、誰かが片っ端からはがしている

original: Ask her about it if you want an earful.
string: 彼女に聞けば、うんざりするほど教えてくれる

original: How do I get into Hjerim?
string: ヒジェリムに入るにはどうすればいい？

original: Friga Shatter-Shield's old place? It's been abandoned ever since she was killed.
string: フリガ・シャッター・シールドの家か？　彼女が殺されて以来、廃屋になっている

original: Jorleif has granted me permission to aid in the investigation.
string: ヨルレイフから、調査に参加する許可をもらってきた

original: All right, then.
string: じゃあな

original: I noticed a trail of blood leading away from here.
string: ここからどこかへ続く血痕があった

original: Helgird's taken the body into the Hall of the Dead to prepare for burial. She's a little crazy, but if she knows anything, it's dead bodies.
string: 遺体は、ヘルグリッドが埋葬の準備のために死者の間に運んだ。彼女はちょっとイカれているが、死体のことなら何でも知っている

original: I've heard about these murders.
string: 殺人について聞いた

original: These are difficult times indeed, when men stalk their brethren like beasts.
string: 野獣のように仲間を襲う奴がいるとは、困った事になった

original: My men are stretched thin as it is. If you offer your aid, I gladly accept. The guards will be told to assist you as necessary.
string: 私の部下は忙しいんだ。手を貸してくれるなら大歓迎だ。衛兵に伝えておくから、必要なら協力しよう

original: I'm happy to lend a hand as much as I can, as well.
string: 私自身も、喜んで手助けする

original: What's it say?
string: なんて？

original: Find anything?
string: 何か見つけたのか？

original: Look here. There's something strange about this cabinet.
string: 見て。このキャビネット何か変だわ

original: Oh, no. I hadn't heard from Gorm for a while, so I'd hoped he'd given up on his little scheme.
string: 何て事だ。ゴルムからの手紙は久しぶりだ。小さな企みをあきらめていればいいんだが

original: The last time we'd discussed this issue was before this damnable war broke out. Things were different then.
string: この件に関して最後に話をしたのは、このひどい戦争が始まる前だった。それから状況は変わってしまった

original: Now, what's he's asking, it's just impossible. Even if it worked, the questions and accusations it would cause...
string: 彼の頼みは、不可能な話だ。仮にうまくいったとしても、疑問や非難が巻き起こるだろう…

original: Well, I'll take it under advisement. Thank you.
string: まあ、よく考えてみよう。ありがとう

original: I'll keep quiet about your scam, but you owe me.
string: 詐欺行為については黙っておく。貸しができたわけだ

original: Now you're speaking my language.
string: 話が分かるじゃねーか

original: Tell you what. If you need any stolen goods fenced, you bring them to me and I'll pay you good money for them.
string: いいかい、盗品を売りたいのなら、俺のところへ持ってきてくれ。いい値段で買い取らせてもらうよ

original: Consider me your new friend in the north.
string: 北の大地に友人ができたと思ってくれればいい

original: Why did Karliah purchase Goldenglow Estate?
string: なぜカーリアはゴールデングロウ農園を購入した？

original: I asked her the same thing and she wouldn't come out and tell me.
string: 同じ事を彼女に尋ねたんだが、はっきりと答えてくれないんだ

original: But now that I know who she is, I'd say she's trying to hit the Thieves Guild where it hurts.
string: だけど、彼女が何者なのかは分かったよ。盗賊ギルドに打撃を与えようとしているのかも知れない

original: It's from Gorm, in Morthal.
string: モーサルのゴルムからだ

original: Well now, that is something. Hand it over, please.
string: そうか、何かあったな。さあ、渡してくれ

original: I have a letter for you.
string: 手紙を持って来た

original: For me? From whom?
string: 手紙？　誰からだ？

original: Is there anything I can do?
string: 何かできることはあるか？

original: Yes, I suppose there is.
string: ああ、あると思う

original: There is a letter, one I have had for some time now. I think it is time it gets delivered.
string: ここに手紙がある。しばらく俺が預かってたんだが、そろそろ渡すべき時がきたようだ

original: I cannot leave Idgrod's side, so I must stay here. Could you see that it reaches Captain Aldis in Solitude?
string: イドグロッドのそばを離れることはできないから、俺はここに残らなければならない。ソリチュードにいるアルディス隊長に責任を持って届けてくれるか？

original: What's the problem?
string: どうしたっていうんだ？

original: She's so lost in her visions, and it's only getting worse.
string: 幻覚にとらわれるようになってね、ますますひどくなるばかりなんだ

original: I've looked after her safety for so long...
string: 彼女の安全を長い間見守ってきたが…

original: If she can't tell what's real and what's not, how will she continue to lead Hjaalmarch?
string: 現実とそうでない世界の区別がつかなくなったら、この先どうやってハイヤルマーチを率いていけるだろうか？

original: Is there something bothering you, Gorm?
string: 何か心配事があるのか、ゴルム？

original: There's a... A problem, yes.
string: 問題…　といえば問題だな

original: I'm worried about Idgrod, and I don't know what to do.
string: イドグロッドのことが心配なんだ。どうしていいのか分からない

original: Yes, but... not so loud!
string: ああ、でも…　そんなに大きな声で言わないでくれ

original: Will you take it to Captain Aldis?
string: アルディス隊長のところに届けてくれるか？

original: Still have that letter you need delivered?
string: まだ手紙を届ける必要があるか？

original: I... Yes, I understand.
string: 私は…　ああ、分かっている

original: It stops at once, or else there will be consequences of an unpleasant nature. Do you understand?
string: すぐにやめないと、最後には嫌な思いをする事になるよ。分かったかい？

original: It doesn't happen again, or else I'll have you thrown in jail. Clear?
string: 二度とやらないで。でないと、牢屋にぶち込む事になるわ。分かった？

original: You've been exploring places you shouldn't, and you know it.
string: いけないと知りながら、禁じられた場所を調べ歩いているね

original: I don't even want to know what it is you've been doing.
string: あなたが何をやってたかなんて、知りたくもないわ

original: What is the meaning of this?
string: これはどういう意味だ？

original: Falion, I am disappointed.
string: ファリオン、お前には失望したよ

original: I'm told that you're up to something out in the marsh, Falion.
string: この沼地で何か企んでるって聞いたわ、ファリオン

original: Never mind. It's not important.
string: 気にしないでくれ。大したことじゃない

original: I see. If something does happen, you know where I am.
string: そう。もし何かあったら、私のところに来なさい

original: Either this is some kind of a joke, or you're keeping something from me.
string: 何かの冗談のつもり？　それとも何か隠してるってことかしら？

original: Whichever it is, I don't like it.
string: どっちにしても気に食わないわね

original: He's casting spells out in the marsh in the middle of the night.
string: 彼は真夜中に、沼地に向けて呪文を使っていた

original: Ah, so it is not just dreams then. I have seen this.
string: やっぱりただの夢じゃなかったのね。見たことがあるわ

original: I will see that it is dealt with. Thank you for bringing clarity.
string: 対策を検討してみるわ。教えてくれてありがとう

original: Is that so? Well, I'll make sure that's taken care of immediately.
string: 本当に？　分かった。すぐに手を打つわ

original: It's good that you brought this to my attention.
string: 教えてくれて助かったわ

original: That's not fair, now.
string: そんな事を今言うのは卑怯だ

original: Yatul and I do all the hunting. Mul and Gadba do all the mining. It seems like all you do is find more wives to get killed.
string: ヤツールと私は狩りを、ムルとガドバは採掘を受け持っている。お前のしていることはまるで、さらに妻を見つけて殺されようとしているようだ

original: Haven't I always been a good father? A good chief?
string: 私は常に良き父親であり、良き族長ではなかったか？

original: I... I'm sorry.
string: す…　すまん

original: I thought you should know Falion's up to something.
string: 念のため伝えておくが、ファリオンが何か企んでいるようだ

original: Ah, Falion. Always looking where he shouldn't for things he doesn't need.
string: ああ、ファリオンね。いつも余計な事に首を突っ込んでばかり

original: What has he done now?
string: 今度は何をしでかしたの？

original: I've never trusted him... what has he done?
string: 信用ならない奴ね…　一体何をやったの？

original: Okay, I'll leave you alone.
string: 分かった。それではな

original: Thank you. I will not forget this.
string: ありがとう。このことは忘れない

original: If you want me to keep quiet, it's going to cost you.
string: 黙っていてほしいなら、費用がかかるぞ

original: Is that so?
string: なるほど

original: I should have expected as much. Fine, I shall give you 200 gold, and you shall leave me in peace.
string: そう来ると予測すべきだったな。いいだろう、200ゴールドやるから、そっとしておいてくれ

original: Now go, leave me to my work.
string: さあ、もう行け。仕事をさせてくれ

original: I want to know what it is you're up to.
string: 何をしていたか知りたい

original: I am under no obligation to tell you anything. Now, leave me at once and never mention that you saw me.
string: お前に話す義務はない。さあ、今すぐここから離れろ。私を見かけたことは絶対に言うな

original: Why should I keep this a secret?
string: なぜ秘密にしなければならない？

original: It is none of your concern, I assure you. Just... Forget that you ever saw me here.
string: お前には関係ない、それは確かだ。ただ…　ここで私を見たことは忘れろ

original: What are you doing?
string: 何をしてるんだ？

original: What I am doing is none of your business!
string: 何をしていようと、お前には関係ない！

original: Why are you here? Did you follow me?
string: なぜここにいる？　後をつけて来たのか？

original: I demand that you leave at once and never speak of this again.
string: ただちに立ち去れ、そしてこのことは二度と口にするな

original: Well, your ill fortune means I have no mother.
string: 悪いが、私には母親がいない

original: Nothing! I... it's ill fortune. That's all.
string: 何でもない！　ただ…　不幸としか言いようがないだけだ

original: About how the Divines cursed you. What horrible thing did you do to deserve it?
string: なぜ呪われる事になったのだ？　呪われるほどひどい事をしたのか？

original: What are you talking about?
string: 何の話だ？

original: They're not my aunts. They're your aunts. And they told me enough.
string: あの人達は私の叔母ではなく、お前の叔母だ。私に多くの事を教えてくれた

original: I don't know what your aunts told you, but...
string: お前の叔母に何を言われたか知らないが…

original: Shhh!
string: しーっ！

original: Leave me alone.
string: 構わないでくれ

original: I'm trying to pay attention.
string: 注意を払うように努力するわ

original: After I've finished showing you the grounds, we can talk.
string: 敷地内の見学がひととおり終わった後で、お話しいたしましょう

original: Welcome to the College.
string: 大学へようこそ

original: How do you think we should spend the remainder of our classroom time?
string: 昔のように授業を再現するのはどうだろう

original: If you have any further questions, can you please hold them until I've finished?
string: まだ質問の続きがあるなら、これが終わるまで待ってくれ

original: Greetings. Welcome to the College of Winterhold.
string: ごきげんよう。ウィンターホールド大学へようこそ

original: If it's true, and you do have the Voice, would you mind showing me? I've never seen it first-hand.
string: もし本当に声を持っているのなら、見せて頂けませんか？　私は見たことがないんです

original: Much knowledge lies within the College's walls.
string: 大学の壁には、多くの知識が蓄えられています

original: The College is an asset to Skyrim, even if it goes unnoticed or unappreciated.
string: 大学はスカイリムの遺産です。知られること無く、感謝されないとしても

original: Winterhold's glory days may lie behind it, but the College lives on.
string: ウィンターホールドの栄光の日々は過ぎたかも知れませんが、大学は続きます

original: No matter what, the College will endure.
string: 何があっても、大学は持ち堪えます

original: Now, if you'll just stand right over there, I'll cast a spell at you, and you block it with the ward. Here we go.
string: さあ、そこに立ってくれ。私が魔法をかけるから、シールドを張って防御するんだ。行くぞ

original: I don't know any Ward spells.
string: シールドスペルは何も知らない

original: That's all right. I can teach you a very basic ward, one that's enough for the purposes of this lesson.
string: 大丈夫だ、私が基本のシールドスペルを教えてやろう。この授業にはちょうどいい

original: I have a ward spell, but I've never really used it.
string: シールドスペルを持ってはいるが、使ったことはない

original: That's what this lesson is for. Perfect time to try it out.
string: 授業はそのためのものだ。試すにはちょうどいいだろう

original: I already know it, and already know how to use it.
string: 知っている。使い方も分かる

original: Well, then this should be no problem at all for you.
string: それでは、問題はなさそうだな

original: So we're learning about Wards?
string: シールドスペルについて習うのか？

original: Would you mind helping me with the demonstration? Are you at all familiar with ward spells?
string: この実験の実演に手を貸してくれないか？　シールドスペルについては詳しいか？

original: Your shop has a most unusual name.
string: 変わった名前の店だな

original: Catchy, isn't it?
string: 覚えやすくて人目を引く名前だろう？

original: In my youth I was a fisherman... I had a beautiful ship named "The Brawny Prawn." But the years have a way of creeping up on you.
string: 若いころは漁をしていてな…　ブローニープローン号という名のそれは美しい船を持ってたんだが。年月はいつの間にか忍び寄ってくるものさ

original: I ended up selling that ship to open this place. Seemed only fitting to name it after her. Well, changed it a bit I suppose.
string: 結局その船を売り払って、ここを開いたんだ。この店には、その船の名前以上にふさわしい名前はないと思ってな。まあ、少しだけ変えたが

original: If I had been smarter, I would have kept my boat. Coming to this city was a big mistake.
string: もう少し先見の明があれば、船は売らずにいたんだが。この街に来たことは大間違いだったよ

original: You look young for a blacksmith.
string: 鍛冶屋にしては若く見える

original: I was apprenticed to Balimund before he died. He taught me everything I know about forging armor and weapons.
string: 今は亡きバリマンドの弟子なんだ。武器や防具をこしらえるための知識は、みんな師匠から教わった

original: Balimund pulled me out of Grelod's orphanage when I was just a child. I don't know what he saw in me, but I was glad to get out of there.
string: バリマンドは幼い俺をグレロッドの孤児院から引き取ってくれた。何を見込まれたのか分からないが、とにかくあそこを出れてうれしかったよ

original: I've spent years watching his techniques and learning his tricks. Sadly, I don't think I'll ever be as talented as he was.
string: 何年も師匠の技を観察し、鍛冶のコツを学んだ。悲しいかな、とても師匠の域には到達できそうもないがね

original: Nothing.
string: 何でもないわ

original: What is that supposed to mean?
string: どういう意味だ？

original: Well someone has to provide around here.
string: さて、この辺で誰かが準備をしなくてはな

original: I'm proud of you for helping provide for us.
string: 家族を助けてくれる事を誇りに思っている

original: We are strong. We get the job done.
string: 我々は強い。やるべき事はやる

original: How is your hunting with Yatul?
string: ヤツールとの狩りの調子はどうだ？

original: It's not you I'm worried about.
string: 心配しているのはお前の事じゃないからな

original: Oh, if you're worried about me trying to meddle with you...
string: いや、もし私のおせっかいを心配しているなら…

original: I think it may have to be far away from here.
string: ここからずっと遠く離れたところかも知れないがな

original: Someday, you can have your own stronghold.
string: いつか、お前は自分自身の要塞を持てるだろう

original: I've just learned not to trust luck around here.
string: ここでは運任せにできないと気づいた

original: They're miners. Harmless.
string: ただの善良な鉱山労働者だ

original: You don't worry about two Orc men coming into your stronghold? That they might challenge you?
string: 要塞に入ってきた二人組のオークを心配しているのか。挑んでくるかもと気をもんでいるとか？

original: Sir.
string: 閣下

original: You Nords and your bloody sense of honor.
string: お前達ノルドとその道義心と言ったらな

original: Yes, sir.
string: ええ！

original: If Ulfric's making a move for Whiterun, then we need to be there to stop him.
string: ウルフリックがホワイトランへ進軍するなら、奴を食い止めなければならない

original: Draft another letter with the usual platitudes, but this time share some of your intelligence regarding Ulfric's plans. Embellish if you have to.
string: 決まり文句でいいからもう1通手紙を書け。だが今回はウルフリックの計画に関して掴んだ情報を盛り込むんだ。必要ならば多少嘘を入れても構わん

original: We'll let it seem like it's his idea.
string: それが奴の考えと見せかけるんだ

original: What about them?
string: 何があったんだ？

original: Father, I'm worried about Gadba and Mul.
string: 父さん、ガドバとムルの事が心配だ

original: I've just never heard of a midwife losing all her mothers like that.
string: ただこんなふうに、すべての母親を失った助産婦の話なんて今まで聞いた事もなかったからな

original: They are good women. They love me. You will speak no more ill of them.
string: いい人だし、よくかわいがってくれる。もう悪口を言わないでくれ

original: But your aunts don't even seem to care.
string: でもお前の叔母は気にしている様子さえない

original: All the time.
string: よくある話だ

original: Don't you ever wonder, father?
string: 今まで不思議に思わなかったのか、父さん？

original: Patience, boy.
string: 我慢しろ、坊や

original: Then they should send one they consider worthy.
string: だとしたら、それ相応の代償があってもいいはずだ

original: Perhaps it's actually a sign of their love for you. They don't want to see you with unworthy mates.
string: 要するにあれは彼らの愛情表現なんだろう。お前が不釣り合いな仲間と一緒にいるのを見たくないのさ

original: Why else have they cursed me? Killed all my wives?
string: 他にもどうして奴らは私へと呪いをかけた？　なぜ妻達全員を殺した？

original: Why do you ask me that?
string: なぜそんな事を聞く？

original: I'd rather not have company right now.
string: 今はひとりがいい

original: I understand. Some journeys must be taken alone. I'll be here if you change your mind.
string: 分かった。ひとりで行かなきゃならない旅もある。気が変わったら、ここに来てくれ

original: You're welcome to join me.
string: 仲間になるのを歓迎しよう

original: Thank you for your kindness.
string: その親切に感謝する

original: I'm heading towards Eldergleam.
string: エルダーグリームに向かっている

original: Shall we proceed, friend?
string: 行こうか、友よ

original: What needs to be done?
string: どうすればいい？

original: Eldergleam's sanctuary grove is to the east of here.
string: エルダーグリームの聖域の森は、ここの東です

original: You can use Nettlebane to retrieve some of its sap.
string: ネトルベインを使えば樹液が取れます

original: Why do we need Nettlebane?
string: なぜネトルベインが必要なんだ？

original: The hags are hateful of anything which grows from the earth. They made the weapon strong against the natural world.
string: ハグレイヴン達は大地から育つ物を憎んでいます。それで自然界に対する強力な武器を作ったのです

original: It's the only thing I've even heard of that could cut Eldergleam. Stick it in, give it a twist, and the stuff will just flow out.
string: 私の知る限り、エルダーグリームを傷つけられそうな武器はこれしかありません。突き刺せば樹液が流れ出すでしょう

original: The hags are hateful of anything which grows from the earth. They made the weapon strong against the natural world.
string: ハグレイヴン達は大地から育つ物を憎んでいます。それで自然界に対する強力な武器を作ったのです

original: It's the only thing I've even heard of that could cut Eldergleam.
string: 私の知る限り、エルダーグリームを傷つけられそうな武器はこれしかありません

original: Okay, I can do that.
string: 分かった。やってみよう

original: I look forward to it.
string: よろしくお願いします

original: Word is your outfit isn't doing well. True?
string: 噂によれば、色々問題を抱えているようだが。本当か？

original: We've run into a rough patch lately, but it's nothing to be concerned about.
string: いくつか問題も有ったが、気にする事じゃあない

original: Tell you what. You keep making us coin and I'll worry about everything else. Fair enough?
string: こうしよう。お前が金を稼いでくれるなら、それ以外の厄介事は全部俺が引き受けよう。どうだ？

original: Before we go, I have to ask...
string: 行く前に、聞きたいことがある…

original: What's on your mind?
string: 何だ？

original: What's next, then?
string: では、次は？

original: Despite your mistakes, I see more potential in you than half the snot-nosed footpads that stumble their way into the Flagon.
string: 失敗もしたが、フラゴンへすっ転びながらやってくるハナタレのチンピラ連中よりは大概期待が持てそうだ

original: I'm going to put my neck on the line. We need people like you in our outfit.
string: 俺の責任で、お前を俺達の正式な仲間に加えよう

original: Judging from how well you handled those shopkeepers, I'd say you've done more than simply prove yourself. We need people like you in our outfit.
string: あの店主共の相手をした働きから判断して、十分なくらい力を証明してくれた。俺達にはお前のような奴が要る

original: We've run out of patience.
string: もう我々の忍耐も限界だ

original: And so have I. What's the point of paying anyway? Your outfit can't even fend for itself. I could do better tossing the gold into the sewer.
string: こっちもよ。だいたいなんで払わなくちゃいけないの？　あなた達、自分で稼ぐことも出来ないのよね。お金をドブに捨てた方がましよ

original: You can't scare me with your tough talk. I'm not paying you people a single coin.
string: 強気に出ても恐くないわよ。もう少しだって払わないから

original: Are the gods angry with me?
string: 神々の怒りをかったのだろうか？

original: This isn't about the money anymore.
string: もうお金の問題じゃないんだ

original: Look, I can't make the coin appear out of thin air. Please, be reasonable. I'll... I'll pay next month.
string: ねえ、いきなりお金が湧いて出るわけじゃないの。お願い。分別を持って。お金は…　来月必ず払うから

original: I have a message from Brynjolf.
string: ブリニョルフから言伝がある

original: I know who you are. You've been terrorizing the entire city.
string: 知っているわよ。街中を怯え上がらせているのはあなたね

original: Please, there's no need for that here. Message understood. Here, I even have the payment!
string: さあ、お願い。そんなことはやめて。言伝は受け取ったわ。報酬も払うから！

original: I knew when we were married, this would come between us one day. I don't want to lose what we have, so I'll pay him gladly.
string: 結婚してからずっと、いつかこの日が来るのは知っていたわ。今の暮らしを失いたくないの。喜んで支払います

original: Darling, Brynjolf sent me. We both know what that means.
string: ブリニョルフの使いで来た。その意味は分かっているな

original: You... you have my statue! What are you going to do with it?
string: あなた…　その像は！　それをどうするつもり？

original: What does he want now? I already explained to him that you can't get blood from a stone.
string: まだ何がほしいというの？　ないものはないと言ったはずよ

original: We can protect ourselves. Trust me.
string: 自分の身は守れるさ。信用しろ

original: Don't fool yourself. It's only a matter of time before you people are run out of Riften.
string: 嘘をつくな。お前らがリフテンから追い出されるのも時間の問題だ

original: I've had enough of this.
string: もうたくさんだ

original: Likewise. Now, I have a lot to do, so I'm afraid you'll just have to leave!
string: 同感だ。さあ、やることが山ほどあるんだ、残念だがお引き取りいただこうか！

original: Simple. You don't pay, bad things happen.
string: 簡単だ。払わなければ、悪いことが起こる

original: Petty threats and fist waving are not going to sway me. You people are all talk, and everyone knows it!
string: つまらん脅しをしようが拳を振り回そうが、俺には効かないぞ。お前らみたいな奴らは口先ばっかりだ、みんな知ってることだ！

original: Pay you to protect me? You can't even protect yourselves!
string: 俺の身を守るから金を出せだと？　自分らの身さえ守れてないじゃないか！

original: I have a message from Brynjolf.
string: ブリニョルフから言伝がある

original: Oh! There's no need for that. I know why you're here. Tell Brynjolf not to worry about it anymore.
string: ああ！　その必要はない。どうしてここに来たか分かってるよ。ブリニョルフにその件はもう心配ないと伝えてくれ

original: Oh! And look, I even have the payment I owed. Here, take it.
string: ああ！　それにほら、支払いがまだ残ってただろ。これ、受け取ってくれ

original: Then I thank you for showing me mercy. Here, take this coin to him. If it keeps us together, it's worth its weight.
string: それなら情けをかけてくれたことに感謝するよ。ほら、このゴールドを持って行ってくれ。それで俺達が一緒にいられるなら、その重みの価値はある

original: Darling, Brynjolf sent me. We both know what that means.
string: ブリニョルフの使いで来た。その意味は分かっているな

original: Wha... what? Oh, it's one of you people.
string: な、何だって？　ああ、そういう類の奴か

original: So, Brynjolf doesn't even bother to show up himself anymore, eh? What's this message?
string: ということは、ブリニョルフはもうわざわざ自分の足で来ることがないってことだな？　伝言って何だ？

original: Well, that's a different matter...
string: いや、それはまた別の問題だ…

original: Are you surrendering?
string: 降参するか？

original: I surrender! I surrender!
string: 降参だ！　降参する！

original: I need more children.
string: もっと子供がほしいんだ

original: (Invisible continue)
string: (見えないまま)

original: Secondly, some rebel scouts that have seen too much are moving through the hold. Need to take them out before they report back to their leaders.
string: 次に、余計なことを知りすぎた反乱軍の斥候が要塞を移動している。上官に報告される前に、そいつらを片づけるぞ

original: Secondly, we got a couple of Imperial spies roaming through the hold. Need to put an end to that.
string: 次に、倉庫の近くでうろつく、帝国軍のスパイが2名いる。奴らを始末しなくては

original: Secondly, we got more of 'em hiding in a village, using the local populace as shields. Not to worry. We can dispatch them without harming the locals.
string: 次に、連中は地元の人達を盾にして、まだ大勢隠れている。大丈夫だ。村人を傷つけずにあいつらを片付けるぞ

original: Secondly, we plan on liberating a settlement from Imperial hands.
string: 次に、帝国軍の手から村落を解放する予定だ

original: Secondly, I need to cripple rebel production capabilities with a little sabotage.
string: 次に、ちょっとした妨害工作で、反乱軍の生産能力にダメージを与えてやらないとな

original: Next problem - Imperial thieves have, yet again, stolen an important resource.  So we're gonna take it from them permanently - by destroying it.
string: 帝国軍の盗賊達についての問題が控えている。重要な物資が、また盗まれているのだ。これを取り返し、奴らを再起不能にしてやれ

original: Soldiers win wars, but where to put them is the key. We have word of an enemy courier in the area. We aim to confiscate his documents.
string: 兵士がいれば戦争に勝てるが、大事なのは配備する場所だ。あのエリアに敵の配達人がいるらしい。そいつの書類を奪うのが狙いさ

original: And then, it seems an Imperial worm wiggles it's way back home, carrying information stolen from us. We need to steal it back.
string: どうやら、帝国軍の虫けらどもは故郷に逃げ帰っているようだ。奪われた重要な情報を、奪還しなくてはならない

original: And perhaps more importantly, I need to break one of our boys out of a rebel controlled fort.
string: 部下を1人、反乱軍が占領する砦から脱出させたい

original: And perhaps more importantly, we have a brother rotting in an Imperial prison. He won't languish in there long, will he now?
string: 帝国軍の牢獄で同志が苦しんでいるのを、このまま見過ごすことはできない。これ以上彼が獄鎖で苛まれる事は許されないぞ

original: And we have an opportunity to slay the rebel field commander. Without a clear command structure, they should fall into confusion and disarray.
string: 反乱軍の野戦指揮官を倒すチャンスさ。まともな命令系統がなければ、奴らも動揺して混乱に陥るはずだ

original: We also have the opportunity to slay an Imperial Legate. That'll put fear and confusion into those faithless dogs.
string: 帝国軍の特使を始末もできよう。荒くれのイヌどもに、恐怖と混乱を与える事ができるはずだ

original: And we understand a rebel garrison is close to abandoning the resistance. We need to send them a little encouragement.
string: それに、駐留してる反乱軍が抵抗を止めるのも時間の問題だ。ほんの少しの後押しが必要だ

original: And we hear a handful of Imperials are realizing they are Stormcloaks at heart. We need to send them a little encouragement.
string: 帝国軍の何人かが、ストームクロークに与すべきだと気づいているようだ。少しばかりその背中を押してやる必要がある

original: Next, I need a little investigating to confirm the possibility of blackmailing the Jarl's Steward.
string: それから、首長の執政を脅迫できるかどうか、ちょっとした調査が必要だな

original: Next, I need dirt on the Jarl's Steward. Heard there's blackmail potential there.
string: 首長の執政を買収しよう。脅しをかける余地があるらしいのだ

original: And then there's a tiny problem with a giant that's been raiding our supply caravans... You heard me right. A giant. Need to put a stop to that.
string: それに、味方の供給キャラバンを襲う巨人との問題もあってな…　聞き間違いじゃないぞ。巨人だ。あいつを止めなくてはな

original: And then there's a tiny problem with a giant attacking our supply caravans. A giant! As if I didn't have enough to deal with.
string: 小さな問題がある。巨人が我々の供給キャラバンを襲撃している。巨人がな！　我が物顔で振る舞っているのだ

original: I also would like to get a handle on what the rebels are planning - slip into their headquarters and steal their war plans.
string: それに、反乱軍が何を企ててるのかも把握しておきたい。奴らの本部に潜り込んで、計画を盗み出すぞ

original: Also, I need a peek inside Imperial headquarters, ideally lifting some documents detailing their plans. I need to know what to concentrate on.
string: それに、帝国軍の司令部に入り込む必要がある。書類を盗み出して、奴らの計画の詳細が分かれば理想的だ。何に集中すべきかを知らなくてはならん

original: Then there's a little matter of some recruiting. I have someone in mind I'd like to join our campaign.
string: それから、人材探しにもちょっとした問題があってな。活動に参加させたい人物がいる

original: I need to send someone out to do a little recruiting. There's someone in particular I'd like to join us.
string: 誰かを兵の補充に当てなくてはならない。仲間にしたい相手がいるんだが

original: And then there's this Orc who's been hanging around causing me headaches. Something about a vision quest he needs help with.
string: それから、オークがうろついてて目障りでしょうがない。預言のクエストのことで困ってるらしい

original: And as if that wasn't enough. I got this damn Orc hanging around, getting in the way, yapping about needing help with some kind of vision quest.
string: それだけではない。忌々しいオークがうろついていて、我々の進路の邪魔になっている。ある種の預言のクエストに関して、助けを求めて吠え続けている

original: Secondly, we're mounting an attack on the Fort. I want to gain a fortified position here before we launch our final attack on the capital.
string: 次に、砦に攻撃を仕掛ける。首都への最終攻撃を始める前に、要塞化した拠点がほしい

original: Secondly, I want to take the fort here. Having a fortified position will make it easier for us to amass men for our ultimate attack on the capital.
string: 次に、この砦を手に入れたい。拠点として抑えれば、首都への総攻撃のために人員を集めるのが簡単になる

original: (Invisible continue)
string: (見えないまま)

original: First off, we've learned the location of some rebels scouting our positions throughout the hold. Need to take them out.
string: 要塞の至るところで、反乱軍の斥候がこっちの居場所を嗅ぎ回っていることが分かった。そいつらを追い出さなくてはな

original: First off, there's a couple of Imperials skulking about the hold. Need to cut their throats so they can't make their reports.
string: まず、倉庫の付近で動き回る帝国軍が2人いる。報告ができないように、奴らの喉を切り裂いてやる必要がある

original: First off, they've got some rebels holed up in a nearby settlement. Need to clean them out so our boys can move in.
string: 近くの集落に反乱軍のメンバーが潜伏している。奴らを片づけたら、部下を送り込める

original: First off, there's a band of Imperials hiding in a nearby village. We're going to flush them out and put them to the sword.
string: そうだ、近くの村に帝国軍の一団が隠れている。奴らを見つけ出して、剣で始末するのだ

original: First, we need to limit Stormcloak capacity and send them a not so subtle message by sabotaging a resource they claim to control.
string: ストームクロークの力を削って、分かりやすい伝言を送るぞ。奴らが支配権を主張する資源を破壊する

original: First problem here is a pack of Imperial dogs drooling over resources stolen from the people. A little sabotage will sour the taste of that victory.
string: 人々から盗み出した資源に喜んでいる、帝国軍のイヌ達どもを野放しにはできない。ちょっとした破壊工作で、この勝利の味を台なしにできるだろう

original: First, we have information regarding the movements of a rebel courier. We need to intercept him and confiscate his package.
string: 反乱軍の配達人の動きに関する情報を手に入れた。捕まえて、荷物を没収するぞ

original: First, we've learnt the whereabouts of an Imperial cur fetching documents for his master in Solitude. We need to put a muzzle on that, don't we?
string: 帝国軍のイヌどもの位置を確認できた。ソリチュードの主人のために書類を運んでいる。口封じをする必要がある、そうだな？

original: First of all, one of our men was captured by rebels who refuse to surrender him. So we're going to break him out.
string: 降伏を拒否した反乱軍メンバーに、味方の兵士が1人捕らえられた。助け出してやろう

original: First of all, a son of Skyrim rots in an Imperial prison. We'll be getting him out of there soon.
string: 帝国軍の牢獄で衰弱しているスカイリムの息子がいる。何を差し置いても、すぐに救い出さなくてはならない

original: First of all, I need to sew confusion and doubt through the rebel troops. I want to assassinate their commanding officer.
string: とにかく、まずは反乱軍の混乱と懸念を解消するのが先決だ。奴らの上官を暗殺するんだ

original: First, if we can assassinate their commander, we'll be able to strike them while they're busy tucking their tails between their legs.
string: 指揮官を暗殺できれば、奴らが統率を失っている間に叩けるだろう

original: First, our intelligence suggests one of the rebel garrisons has become disaffected. If we play our cards right, we should be able to turn them.
string: 諜報部によると、反乱軍の中で不満を抱いている駐留部隊がいるらしい。うまくやれば、そいつらを寝返らせることができる

original: First off, we hear a group of Imperial legionnaires are coming around to our way of thinking. With a little encouragement they'll join our side.
string: ああ、帝国軍が我々の進路のあたりに配置されているようだな。少々おだててやれば、こちらの味方になるだろう

original: First off, seems the Jarl's Steward might be vulnerable to blackmail. Need to investigate that possibility.
string: どうやら首長の執政は、脅迫に弱そうだ。調べてみる必要がありそうだな

original: First off, it seems that we might be able to blackmail the Jarl's Steward. I need to find out for sure.
string: 首長の執政を脅迫する事が可能なようだ。事が上手に運べるかどうかを知る必要がある

original: First on my list, is a problem with our supply caravans being constantly harassed by a giant. Need to deal with that hairy brute. And soon.
string: 最初の問題は、供給キャラバンがいつも巨人に悩んでいることだ。あの毛むくじゃらのケダモノを、早く何とかしなくてはな

original: The last few supply caravans have been attacked... by a giant. As if I didn't have enough to deal with. Need that damn hairy brute straightened out.
string: ここ最近の供給キャラバンが、たびたび襲撃を受けている…　巨人によってな。我が物顔で振る舞っているこの不快な野獣を何とかする必要があろう

original: First, I need to get a handle on rebel operations. Need to discretely liberate some documents from their headquarters.
string: まず反乱軍の動きを把握する必要がある。奴らの本部から、個別に書類を盗み出さなくてはならない

original: First, I need to know what the Imperials are planning. Need to slip into their headquarters, grab plans, maps, something useful like that.
string: まず、帝国軍の計画を知る必要がある。奴らの司令部に忍び込んで、指令書、地図、そういった役に立ちそうなものを手に入れるのだ

original: First of all, I'd like to drum up some more support from the local populace. I have someone in mind.
string: 手初めに、地元住民による支援を大々的に募集したい。心当たりがある

original: First of all, there's someone in particular I'd like to win over to our cause.
string: まず、我々の大義のために勝たなくてはならない相手がいる

original: First off, there's an Orc hanging around causing me headaches. Something about a vision quest he needs help with.
string: オークがうろついてて、目障りでしょうがない。どうも彼は、預言のクエストのことで困ってるらしい

original: First off, there's a damn Orc hanging around getting in the way. He's been yammering on about needing help with some kind of vision quest.
string: 早々に、忌々しいオークが我々の進路を邪魔してくる事だろう。奴はある種の預言のクエストに関して、助けを求めて吠え続けているのだ

original: First, we're mounting an attack on the Fort. We aim to confiscate it from the rebels.
string: 砦に攻撃をかける。砦を反乱軍から取り返すのが目的だ

original: First, we're attacking the fort. I want that fort.
string: まず、砦を攻撃する。あの砦が必要なのだ

original: Oh, all things in time, my boy. All things in time.
string: ああ、坊や、いつかすべてな。いつかすべてに

original: What more do you need that Yatul and I cannot provide?
string: もう十分だろう。ヤツールと私にはこれ以上無理だ

original: Have the spirits told you where I may find a wife? One who will be safe from this curse?
string: どこに行ったら妻を見つけられるか霊魂は言っていたか？　この呪いの影響を受ける心配のない妻だ

original: Yes, child?
string: どうした？　ひよっこ

original: Bolar, I must ask you something.
string: なあボラー、聞きたい事がある

original: We're the ones he loves. Me, and you.
string: 彼が愛しているのは我々だ。私とお前だ

original: Maybe, but...
string: そうかも知れないが…

original: Let's get this over with.
string: 終わりにしよう

original: I'll lead the way, but you'd better back me up.
string: 先導しよう。だが援護はしっかり頼むぞ

original: If there's a chance this will save me, then I'm taking it.
string: 本当に役に立つなら買おう

original: What do you want me to do?
string: 何をしてほしいんだ？

original: This giant... It's not the only thing in Fallowstone Cave. Getting to it isn't going to be easy.
string: この巨人…　ファロウストーン洞窟の問題はそれだけではない。巨人の元へたどり着く事さえ一筋縄ではない

original: You're going to clear a path to the giant, so I can conserve my strength. I'll make sure you're paid for it.
string: 巨人までの道を切り開くんだ。そうすれば私は力を温存できる。報酬は保証する

original: So you meet me at Fallowstone Cave, and we'll get this over with. I can have my tribe back, and you can... You can leave us alone.
string: ファロウストーン洞窟で落ち合って、この件の肩をつけてしまおう。私は部族を取り戻せるし、お前は…　我々から手を引く事ができる

original: Fighting the giant isn't my job.
string: 巨人と戦うのはこちらの仕事ではない

original: Thanks to you, I've just been issued a challenge in front of my whole tribe, by a Daedric Prince, no less. I can't ignore that.
string: お前のおかげで、部族みなの前で挑戦を表明させられた。デイドラの王子その人によってな。知らない振りをするわけにはいかない

original: I didn't say I wouldn't fight the giant. I just said you're going to help me get to it.
string: 巨人と戦わないとは言っていない。巨人の元へ無事にたどりつけるよう援護しろと言ったんだ

original: Meet me outside Fallowstone Cave. You clear the way to the giant for me, and I'll make sure you get paid for it.
string: ファロウストーン洞窟の外で落ち合おう。巨人の元まで無事たどりつけるよう道を切り開いてくれたら、報酬は弾む

original: This is all your fault, you know.
string: これは全部お前の責任だ

original: I'm stuck fighting a giant now, thanks to you. So you're going to help me.
string: 巨人と戦う事になってしまった。おかげ様でな。だから、これから私を援護するんだ

original: You're going with me, and you're going to make sure I don't have any trouble reaching that giant.
string: 私に同行し、あの巨人の元まで無事にたどり着けるようにするんだ

original: Don't worry, I'll make it worth your while.
string: 心配するな、それだけの報酬は払う

original: Very well. You, outsider, come here! I want a word.
string: 大変結構。よそ者よ、こっちに来てくれ！　話がしたい

original: So it will be. Malacath has spoken, Yamarz. Your path is clear.
string: それでは、そのように。ヤマーズよ、マラキャスはお話し下さった。進むべき道ははっきりしている

original: You let giants... Giants!... overrun my shrine. Bring me their leader's club as an offering, and I might release you from this curse!
string: お前は巨人どもが…　巨人どもが俺様の祠を荒らすのを野放しにしたな！　奴らの親玉の棍棒を捧げ物として持ってこい。そうすればこの呪いを解いてやってもいいぞ！

original: You don't deserve to call yourself an Orc! You're weak, you're small, and you're an embarrassment!
string: お前はオークの呼び名に値せんぞ！　弱虫で小物で、そして恥さらしだ！

original: Bah. He never had a connection with any of them beyond what his loins told him.
string: フン。彼は自分の子供達に言われた以上のつながりを、誰とも持とうとはしなかったよ

original: What? What is this?
string: え、これは何なんだ？

original: You dare summon me, Yamarz?
string: ヤマーズ、よくも俺様を呼べたものだな

original: What's that?
string: これは何だ？

original: You pathetic weakling!
string: 情けない弱虫め！

original: Why are we bothering with this?
string: どうしてこんな事のために悩まなきゃいけないんだ？

original: Now, we begin the ritual...
string: さあ、儀式を始めよう…

original: Here are the things you asked for.
string: 頼まれていたものだ

original: Excellent. Now, you must come with me. You've become a part of this. You must be present for the ritual.
string: よくやってくれた。さあ、一緒に来い。お前ももう当事者だ。儀式に参加してくれ

original: In a Daedra, of course.
string: デイドラの中に決まってるだろう

original: Where do I find a Daedra Heart?
string: デイドラの心臓はどこで見つかるんだ？

original: Be careful. The spirits can speak to the living if there's a strong connection.
string: 気をつけろ。強いつながりがあった場合、霊魂は生者に話しかける事ができる

original: Good. The more time he pines for the dead wives, the less time he spends finding a new one.
string: いいぞ。彼が死んだ妻の事を想い続ける限り、次の妻を探す気にはならないだろう

original: He's been spending a lot of time at the graves again.
string: 彼はまた墓場で過ごす事が多くなった

original: Come back to me when you have something useful.
