original: Seeing as how Riften is home to the Thieves Guild, maybe we can work something out if you have trouble with the law. For the right price.
string: リフテンは盗賊ギルドの本拠地だ。法律関係で面倒を起こしたら解決してやれる。適正価格でな

original: The Thieves Guild used to run this city. Now they're nothing but braggarts and bullies, rotting to death down in their Ratway...
string: かつてこの街は盗賊ギルドが動かしていた。でも今じゃ、口先だけのごろつきだ。ラットウェイで腐って死んでいくだけだ

original: What business do College mages have in a place like Saarthal, anyway? It's a place for Nord dead... not your weird experiments.
string: 大学の魔術師がサールザルみたいなところに何の用だ？　死んだノルドのための場所だぞ。気味の悪い実験のための場所じゃない

original: One of the guards said he saw a mage appear out of thin air. Claimed it was one of those Psijic Monks. Man's been hitting the skooma, I say.
string: ある衛兵が、どこからともなく魔術師が現れたのを見たと言う。サイジック僧兵のひとりだったとか。きっとスクゥーマでもやってたんだろう

original: Imagine, blowing up an entire town. Damn College... Winterhold will never be the same.
string: 町すべてが吹っ飛ぶなんて想像できるか？　いまいましい大学め。もうウィンターホールドは元には戻らない

original: You're that Mage from the College. Right? Hear things have finally calmed down over there.
string: お前は大学の魔術師だな。あっちはようやく落ち着いたと聞いた

original: You put those Forsworn down. Good job.
string: お前がフォースウォーンを討伐したんだな。よくやってくれた

original: Gods damn those Forsworn. So many dead...
string: フォースウォーンのせいで、たくさんの人が死んだ…

original: You see those warriors from Hammerfell? They've got curved swords. Curved. Swords.
string: ハンマーフェルから来た戦士達を見たか？　曲刀を持っていた。曲がった剣だ

original: Wonder what it's like for those Thalmor, now that they've been taken down a notch...
string: サルモールはどうしているかな。高慢ちきな鼻をへし折られて

original: The people here are still plagued with nightmares. It's... unnatural.
string: ここの人々はまだ悪夢に苦しめられている。こんなのはおかしい

original: No more nightmares. Thank the gods for that.
string: もう悪夢は見ない。神々に感謝だ

original: Now I remember - you're that new member of the Companions. So you, what - fetch the mead?
string: 思い出した、お前は同胞団の新メンバーだな。じゃあ、ええと、ハチミツ酒でもどうだ？

original: Honored Companion. How can I assist you?
string: 名誉ある同胞団、何か手伝えるか？

original: Is that... fur? Coming out of your ears?
string: それは毛皮か？　耳から出ているのか？

original: I'm telling you, I heard it. Howling. Those werewolf tales are true.
string: 言ってるだろう、遠吠えを聞いた。ウェアウルフの物語は本当だったんだ

original: I find your wolfish grin... unsettling.
string: お前が歯をむき出す表情…　不安になるな

original: With respect, Companion, I'd ask that you and your friends muzzle that dog of yours. The howling coming from Jorrvaskr has gotten out of hand.
string: 敬意を持ってお願いしよう、同胞団。お前と仲間であのイヌに口輪をはめてくれ。ジョルバスクルの遠吠えは手に負えない

original: If it isn't the slayer of the Glenmoril Witches. How can I assist you, Companion?
string: グレンモリルの魔女を倒したんだな。何か手伝えることはあるか、同胞団？

original: Who would dare attack the leader of the Companions? In his own hall? There'll be blood for this, I know it.
string: 一体誰が同胞団の指導者を襲ったりするんだ？　玄関先でだなんて。報復で血が流れる事になるな

original: Kodlak White-Mane is in a better place now. For is there any place better than Sovngarde?
string: コドラク・ホワイトメインは今ではもっといい場所にいる。ソブンガルデ以上の場所があるか？

original: Thanks again for helping reopen the East Empire Company. Gonna have them import me some of that aged Breton cheese.
string: 東帝都社の再開に手を貸してくれたな。熟成したブレトンチーズを輸入してくれるといいんだが

original: I was this close to catching that killer. I swear it.
string: あの殺人者をもうちょっとで捕まえられたのに。本当さ

original: With Nurelion gone, I suppose Quintus has taken over business in the White Phial.
string: ヌレリオンが死んで、クインタスがホワイトファイアルの事業を引き継いだらしい

original: The Gildergreen blooms again. All thanks to you.
string: ギルダーグリーンは再び茂る。すべてお前のおかげだ

original: The Gildergreen will bloom again. All thanks to you.
string: ギルダーグリーンはまた茂るだろう。すべてお前のおかげだ

original: Thanks for clearing out that vampire nest. You saved Morthal.
string: 吸血鬼の巣を掃除してくれたんだな。ありがとう。お前はモーサルを守ったんだ

original: Wonder what kinds of things they've got the Dibella doing, over in the temple. Mostly praying, I reckon...
string: 聖堂でのディベラの行事ってどんな事をしているんだ？　主にお祈りだと思うが…

original: I know you had some part in Sinding's escape. Don't deny it...
string: シンディングの逃亡に関わっているな。否定しても無駄だぞ…

original: We'll protect Erikur as best we're able, but I fear the throne of Solitude is cursed.
string: 力の限りエリクールを守る。しかし、ソリチュードの玉座は呪われているのではないか

original: It is whispered that one of the Daedric Princes himself is behind the murder of Elisif. It would seem even the nobility of Oblivion favors our cause.
string: デイドラの王子の一人がエリシフ殺害の背後にいるって噂が流れている。オブリビオンの貴族ですら、私達の考えに賛成なようだ

original: Watch the skies, traveler.
string: 空に気をつけろ、旅の人

original: Stay out of trouble, Argonian.
string: 面倒を起こすなよ、アルゴニアン

original: What is it, Argonian?
string: 何だ、アルゴニアン

original: Stay out of trouble, lizard.
string: 面倒は避けろよ、トカゲ

original: Staying out of trouble, kinsman?
string: 同族か？　面倒は避けろよ

original: How can I help a brother Nord?
string: 同じノルドのために、何かできることはあるか？

original: Stay out of trouble, Nord.
string: 面倒は避けろよ、ノルド

original: Don't cross me, Elf.
string: 邪魔するなよ、エルフ

original: Stay out of trouble, Elf.
string: 面倒は避けろよ、エルフ

original: What is it, Elf?
string: 何だ、エルフ

original: Stay out of trouble, Khajiit.
string: 面倒は避けろよ、カジート

original: What is it, Khajiit?
string: 何だ、カジート

original: What do you want... cat?
string: 何がほしい、ネコ

original: Stay out of trouble, Redguard.
string: 面倒は避けろよ、レッドガード

original: What is it, Redguard?
string: 何だ、レッドガード

original: Stay out of trouble, Imperial.
string: 面倒は避けろよ、インペリアル

original: What is it, Imperial?
string: 何だ、インペリアル

original: Stay out of trouble, Orc.
string: 面倒は避けろよ、オーク

original: What is it, Orc?
string: 何だ、オーク

original: Hail, Companion.
string: 同胞団、万歳！

original: You're that one from the College. Heard about you.
string: 大学から来た奴だな。聞いているぞ

original: So you can cast a few spells. Am I supposed to be impressed?
string: そうか、少し呪文が使えるんだな。ここは感心するべきか？

original: Try to hide it all you want. I know you're in the Thieves Guild... and so do the other guards.
string: 隠したいのなら好きにしろ。盗賊ギルドの一員なのは知っている。他の衛兵隊もな

original: Psst. Hey, I know who you are. Hail Sithis.
string: ああ、お前の事は知っている。シシス万歳

original: Ugh. That armor stinks of death. You been grave robbing?
string: うっ、その鎧は死のにおいがするぞ。墓泥棒でもしてたのか？

original: Ah, now that's a fine shield. And not mere Dwarven... is it?
string: ほう、いい盾だな。ただのドワーフの盾じゃないな？

original: What manner of staff is that? Such a horror...
string: それは一体どういう杖なんだ？　なんて恐ろしい

original: You wield... Azura's Star? How... how can such a thing be possible?
string: それは…　アズラの星？　どうしてそんな物が？

original: Ah, Aegisbane. Sigil of Clan Shatter-Shield. But didn't that get stolen awhile back? Hmph. Must be rememberin' wrong.
string: エイジスベインか。シャッター・シールド家の印だな。しかし、そいつは盗まれたんじゃなかったか？　記憶違いかな

original: Fine armor you've got there. Dwarven make, am I right?
string: いい鎧を手に入れたな。ドワーフ製か？

original: Ebony armor. By Ysmir, 'tis a wondrous sight.
string: 黒檀の鎧か。まったく、驚くほど見事だ

original: Is your armor made of... dragon bones? By the gods, what I wouldn't do for a set of that.
string: お前の鎧は…　ドラゴンの骨か？　ほう、それのためなら何だってするだろう

original: Is your armor made of... dragon scales? By the gods, what I wouldn't do for a set of that.
string: お前の鎧は…　ドラゴンの鱗か？　ほう、それのためなら何だってするだろう

original: Some advice, friend. That armor won't offer much protection in a real fight.
string: 忠告するぞ、その鎧は実戦ではたいした防護になるまい

original: You come talking to me wearing Imperial armor? You got stew for brains?
string: 帝国軍の鎧を着て話しかけるなんてな。どうかしてるんじゃないか？

original: That's some fine Imperial armor you've got there.
string: 立派な帝国軍の鎧だ

original: Judging by your armor, I'd say you're an Imperial scout. If so, well met.
string: 鎧から見て、帝国軍の斥候ではないか。そうなら、お会いできてよかった

original: For your sake, I hope your took that armor from a dead Imperial scout...
string: その鎧、死んだ帝国軍の斥候から取ったのならいいんだが

original: You wear the armor of a mercenary. Now that's the life.
string: 傭兵の鎧を着てるのか。まあ、そういう事もある

original: That's good armor you've got there, friend. Iron, solid and true.
string: 友よ、なかなかいい鎧だ、鋼鉄で、頑丈で本物だ

original: Hmph. You wear that armor well. Iron may be simple, but it'll stop enough to keep you in the fight.
string: ふーむ。鎧がなかなか似合っているな。鉄は地味だが、戦いで攻撃を防ぐには十分だ

original: Fancy the leather armor, huh? Something to be said for going light.
string: 革の鎧が好みなのか？　軽いことは間違いない

original: That armor... it's like nothing I've ever seen. Like forged midnight...
string: こんな鎧…　今まで見たこともない。まるで鍛造した暗黒の…

original: Orcish armor, hmm? Had me a set of that once. Ugly and strong, like those that forged it.
string: オークの鎧か？　かつて一揃え持っていた。見かけは悪いが、鍛造者と同じく堅牢だ

original: That armor... Are you one of the Emperor's protectors? Can't say I envy you that job.
string: その鎧…　皇帝の護衛か？　うらやましい職務とは言えないな

original: That armor... Are you one of the Emperor's protectors? Not very good at your job, are you?
string: その鎧…　皇帝の護衛か？　職務を果たせていないのでは？

original: That's fine scale armor you've got on there. Shiny.
string: 素晴らしいスケールの鎧を持っているな。輝いている

original: Aye, now that's some fine armor. Good old-fashioned steel.
string: ああ、確かに立派な鎧だ。古き良き鋼だな

original: Ah, steel plate. Now that's a solid choice of armor.
string: ああ、鋼板だ。素晴らしい鎧の選択だ

original: What do you aim to do with that hammer, friend? Knock down a house?
string: その鎚で何をするつもりだ？　家でも壊すのか？

original: No.. get that accursed mace away from me...
string: やめろ…　その呪われたメイスを近づけるな…

original: You wear the armor of the bear, my friend. A fine choice.
string: クマの鎧を着ているのか。いい選択だ

original: You dare strut around here, wearing that filthy Stormcloak hide?
string: 薄汚いストームクロークの毛皮を着ているな。この辺りを気取って歩き回るつもりか？

original: That Stormcloak armor's getting on my nerves...
string: ストームクロークの鎧が神経に触ってきた

original: You wear that Stormcloak armor well, friend.
string: ストームクロークの鎧がよく似合っている

original: You wear the armor of a brigand. Best not cause any trouble on my watch.
string: 悪党の鎧を着ているのか。見ている時に面倒を起こすなよ

original: I know Thieves Guild armor when I see it. You're not fooling anyone.
string: 盗賊ギルドの鎧は見れば分かる。誰もだませるものか

original: You wear the garb of a true Nord. I salute you.
string: 真のノルドの服装だな。お前を称えよう

original: Pigsticker like that's not going to get you far. Best visit the blacksmith.
string: そんな槍じゃ先は長くない。鍛冶屋に行くといい

original: That iron sword's pretty undependable. You should try steel.
string: 鉄の剣は当てにならない。鋼鉄を勧めるよ

original: Iron sword, huh? What are you killing, butterflies?
string: 鉄の剣か？　何を殺すつもりだ？　蝶か？

original: Aye, now that there's a beautiful sword. Like a sliver of midnight.
string: ほう、きれいな剣だな。真夜中に光る銀のようだ

original: Why the Elven blade, hmm? Nord steel not good enough for you?
string: どうしてエルフの剣なんだ？　ノルドの剣じゃ不満なのか？

original: Favor a steel sword, do ya? Good choice for slashing or stabbing.
string: 鋼鉄の剣が好みか？　切りつけたり刺したりするにはぴったりだ

original: I've a lot of respect for the Restoration School. Skyrim could use more healers.
string: 回復魔法を大いに尊敬する。スカイリムにはもっと治癒師が必要だ

original: Lightly armored means light on your feet. Smart.
string: 軽装はそれだけ移動速度が速い。賢いな

original: Hey, you mix potions, right? Can you brew me an ale?
string: 薬を調合するんだろう？　エールを作ってくれないか？

original: Hands to yourself, sneak thief.
string: 触るな、盗賊め

original: I find your hand in my pocket, I'm going to cut it off.
string: 手をポケットに入れたな、切り落としてやる

original: I know your kind, always sneaking about.
string: お前みたいな連中は、いつもコソコソしている

original: Go fiddling with any locks around here, we're going to have a real problem.
string: この辺の錠前をひとつでもいじれば、厄介な事になるぞ

original: Fancy yourself an alchemist, hmm? Never could get the hang of that.
string: 自分を錬金術師だと思ってるのか？　お前には無理だ

original: You're the one casts those illusions. Impressive.
string: お前があの幻惑を？　すごいな

original: Don't think you can barter with me like I'm one of those damned shopkeepers.
string: 交渉できるなんて思うなよ。あのいやな店主達とは違う

original: Best offense is a good defense, am I right?
string: 攻撃こそ最大の防御だ。そうだろう？

original: Don't suppose you'd enchant my sword? Dull old blade can barely cut butter.
string: 剣に付呪をしてはもらえないか。古いなまくらでバターも切れない

original: Heard about you and your honeyed words...
string: お前と甘い言葉の事を聞いた…

original: Hail, summoner. Conjure me up a warm bed, would you?
string: 召喚師万歳ね。暖かいベッドを召喚してくれない？

original: Destruction magic's fine, just don't go burning down any buildings.
string: 破壊魔法は構わないが、建物を焼き払うのはやめてくれよ

original: Takes a fair bit of strength to carry a greatsword like that. But can you use it?
string: グレートソードを持ち歩くにはかなり腕力がいる。使えるのか？

original: Keep your arrows in their quiver, archer.
string: 矢は矢筒にしまっておけ、射手よ

original: Favor the bow, eh? I'm a sword man, myself.
string: 弓が好きか？　俺は剣士だ

original: The gods gave you two hands, and you use them both for your weapon. I can respect that.
string: 神々がくれた2本の手、その両方を使って武器を操る。尊敬に値するな

original: You're like me, eh? Don't fancy those clunky two-handed weapons.
string: お前は私に似ている。不格好な両手武器は気に入らないんだろう

original: No lollygaggin'.
string: 怠けるな

original: I heard the Gourmet is hiding out somewhere in Skyrim. You know, fella who wrote that cookbook.
string: スカイリムのどこかに美食家が潜んでいると聞いたぞ。あの、料理の本を書いた奴だ

original: We got a nickname for anyone who trifles with us guards here in Windhelm - "Suicide."
string: 我々ウィンドヘルムの衛兵をからかう者には、あだ名を付けてやった。“自滅志願者”とな

original: Citizen.
string: 市民か

original: I fear the night. Because the werewolves and vampires don't.
string: 夜が怖いんだ。ウェアウルフや吸血鬼が出るからな

original: Bit late to be wandering around, isn't it?
string: 歩き回るには遅い時間じゃないか？

original: Only burglars and vampires creep around after dark. So which are you?
string: 日没後に忍び歩くのは泥棒か吸血鬼だけだ。お前はどっちだ？

original: You hear that? I swear, there's something out there. In the dark.
string: 聞こえたか？　確かに何かがいる。あの暗がりの中だ

original: Let me guess - someone stole your sweetroll...
string: 当ててやろうか？　誰かにスイートロールを盗まれたかな？

original: Could sure use a warm bed right about now...
string: 暖かいベッドが今すぐに必要だ

original: I'd be a lot warmer and a lot happier with a bellyful of mead...
string: お腹いっぱいのハチミツ酒よりも、もっと暖かくて幸せになるぞ

original: Just a few more hours and I can crawl under some furs...
string: あと数時間もすれば暖かい毛皮に潜り込める

original: Disrespect the law, and you disrespect me.
string: 法を何とも思っていないようなら、私が相手になる

original: Thinking of settling in? There's a house for sale - Breezehome. You should talk to the steward up in the keep if you're interested.
string: 引っ越してくる事を考えている？　売り出し中の…　ブリーズホームがあるぞ。興味があるなら砦の執政に話してくれ

original: You're that one lives in Breezehome, right? Fine place. Almost bought it myself.
string: ブリーズホームに住んでいる人か。いい家だな、もう少しで買いそうだった

original: Hjerim is a fine house, and it's up for sale. You should talk to the steward in the keep if you're interested.
string: ヒジェリムはいい家だ。売り出し中さ。興味があるなら砦の執政に話してみてくれ

original: Don't think you'll get special treatment just because you have a house in the city...
string: この街に家があるってだけで、特別待遇を受けられると思うなよ

original: My heart goes out to Clan Shatter-Shield. Kin murdered, family warhammer stolen... There's no fairness in all that.
string: 我が心はシャッター・シールド家と共にある。親族が殺され、戦鎚が盗まれ…　踏んだり蹴ったりだ

original: Proudspire Manor, now there's a fine home. Up for sale, too. If you're interested, talk to the steward, in the keep.
string: プラウドスパイヤー邸にはいい家がある。売り出し中さ。興味があるなら砦の執政に話してくれ

original: You own Proudspire Manor, hmm? Beautiful house. At least from the outside.
string: お前がプラウドスパイヤー邸の所有者か？　きれいな家だな、外から見ただけだが

original: If you're looking to settle in Riften, there's a house for sale - Honeyside. See the steward in the keep if you want it.
string: リフテンに越してくるのなら、売り出し中の家がある。ハニーサイドだ。買うのなら砦の執政に話してみてくれ

original: Smart thing you did, buying Honeyside. Nice place, and why pay for an inn?
string: ハニーサイドはいい買い物だ。いい家だし、宿屋にお金を払う必要もないだろう？

original: Ah, Vlindrel Hall's a fine home, if you can afford it. The steward in the keep can tell you more.
string: ヴリンドリルの間は素晴らしい家だ。買えるお金があればな。詳しい事は砦の執政が話す

original: So you bought Vlindrel Hall, eh? Wish I could afford a house that nice.
string: ヴリンドリルの間を買ったのか？　あんな素敵な家を買えたらいいんだが

original: They say Ulfric Stormcloak murdered the High King... with his voice! Shouted him apart!
string: ウルフリック・ストームクロークが上級王を殺したらしい…　しかも、声で！　叫んでばらばらにしたとさ

original: What is it? Dragons?
string: 何なんだ？　ドラゴン？

original: My cousin's out fighting dragons, and what do I get? Guard duty.
string: いとこはドラゴンとの戦いに出てるんだが、こっちは警備任務だ

original: Gotta keep my eyes open. Damned dragons could swoop down at any time.
string: 油断せず見張っていなくちゃな。嫌なドラゴン達がいつ舞い降りてくるか

original: I used to be an adventurer like you. Then I took an arrow in the knee...
string: 昔はお前みたいな冒険者だった。膝に矢を受けてしまって…

original: Everything all right?
string: 何も問題ないか？

original: Trouble?
string: 問題でも？

original: Staying safe, I hope?
string: 何ごともないな？

original: I mostly deal with petty thievery and drunken brawls. Been too long since we've had a good bandit raid.
string: 主に、小さな窃盗や酔っぱらいのけんかの処理をしている。山賊の襲撃があってからずいぶん経つな

original: The Imperials think we need their laws. Pfft.
string: 帝国軍は奴らの法が我々に必要だと思っている

original: The Imperials think us all lawless beasts. I'm proof of their ignorance.
string: 帝国軍は我々を無法な獣だと思っている。この私が、奴らの無知の証拠だな

original: 'Tis a wicked axe you wield there, friend. That blade looks sharp enough to cut through a god.
string: お前の使ってる斧はすごいな。神だって切り裂けそうな鋭さだ

original: You're the one saved the Fire Festival. I remember.
string: 炎の祭を守ってくれた人だな、覚えている

original: What do you need, bard?
string: 何が必要なんだ、吟遊詩人

original: WhiterunInnkeeperRumorsBranchTopic
string: WhiterunInnkeeperRumorsBranchTopic

original: The Companions? In Jorrvaskr? They're recruiting new members, from what I hear.
string: ジョルバスクルの“仲間”については？　新しいメンバーを募集してるって聞いたわ

original: Give me the latest gossip.
string: 最新の噂を教えてほしい

original: Yes, and here's what was in the safe.
string: ああ。金庫にはこれがあった

original: At least you remembered one of the things I asked. Let me see that.
string: 頼んだ事の一つは覚えていたか。見せてみろ

original: Sorry. Here's what was in the safe.
string: すまない。金庫にはこれがあった

original: Let me take a look at what you found.
string: 見つけたものを見せてくれ

original: Why did this make you attack the girl?
string: どうして少女を襲った？

original: I had just come into Falkreath. They needed some help working the mill, and I thought that would be something safe. Something I could do.
string: たまたまファルクリースにやってきた。製材所で働き手を募集してたんで、なんとか勤まりそうだと思ったんだ。自分にもできる仕事だって

original: When I saw the little girl, I was just... I could feel it coming on. I could taste the... I needed to hunt.
string: あの幼い少女を見たとき、俺の体に…　何かが走った。味を想像し…　狩りをしなくちゃならなかった

original: But this pitiful, limited body wasn't meant for hunting. Slow. No claws. Weak, mashing teeth for chewing cud.
string: だが、この貧弱な体は狩りには向いていなかった。動きは鈍く、鋭い爪もない。肉を引き裂くための牙もないときてる

original: I held in my rage as long as I could. But it boiled inside of me.
string: 俺は懸命に衝動を抑えていた。だが、それは身の内でふつふつと煮えたぎっていった

original: She looked so fragile. Helpless prey. And then...
string: あの娘はとても華奢で、恰好の獲物に見えた。そしてとうとう…

original: I... I feel terrible about what happened. About what I did. It would probably be best for everyone if I just went away.
string: 俺は…　自分のしたことが恐ろしい。たぶん、俺なんか消えた方が皆のためなんだ

original: I'll take the ring to Hircine.
string: 指輪をハーシーンに届けよう

original: Oh my. You would do this for me? Here, take it. I don't want anything to do with this wretched thing anymore.
string: おお、頼まれてくれるか？　じゃあこれを。この忌々しい代物とは金輪際関わりたくない

original: Seek out the beast. He wanders these woods. Bring him down and... well, the Lord of the Hunt should smile on you.
string: 例の獣を探し出せ。奴はこの森をうろついてる。奴を仕留めるんだ。そうすれば…　そう、狩猟の王が微笑んでくれるだろう

original: I wish you luck, but should leave here while I still have my skin.
string: 幸運を祈る。だが、俺がこの姿でいるうちにここを離れた方がいい

original: Should our paths cross again, I will remember your kindness. Farewell.
string: 互いの道がまた交わることがあれば、あんたへの恩を思い出すだろう。達者でな

original: What kind of transformations?
string: 変身とはどんな？

original: I don't suppose there's a point in keeping the secret if I'm going to die in here anyway.
string: どのみちここで死ぬのなら、秘密を守っても意味がないな

original: I'm sure you've heard of men who shift to beasts under the influence of the moons.
string: 月の影響を受けて、獣に姿を変える者達については聞いたことがあるだろう？

original: I am one of them. A werewolf. It's my secret, and my shame.
string: 俺はそのひとりなんだ。いわゆるウェアウルフさ。人には言えない、恥ずべき秘密だよ

original: That's why I wanted the ring... it was said to give men like me control.
string: だから指輪がほしかった…　変身をコントロールできると言われていたからだ

original: Now I may look like a man, but I still feel the animal inside of me, as strong as ever.
string: 今は人間に見えるかも知れないが、身体の中にはまだ獣がくすぶっている。さらに激しくな

original: What ring?
string: 何の指輪だ？

original: This is the Ring of Hircine. I was told it could let me control my transformations.
string: これはハーシーンの指輪だ。これがあれば意のままに変身できると聞いた

original: Perhaps it used to. But I'll never know. Hircine didn't care for my taking it, and threw a curse on it.
string: おそらく以前はな。今では確かめようもない。ハーシーンは俺が指輪を手に入れたことなどお構いなく、呪いをかけた

original: I put it on... and the changes just came to me. I could never guess when. It would be at the worst times.
string: 指輪をはめると…　突然、身体に変化が起こった。それがいつ起きるかは予測がつかない。最悪のタイミングで起きるかも知れない

original: Like... with the little girl.
string: ちょうど…　あの少女といた時のように

original: Who did this?
string: 一体誰の仕業だ？

original: Sinding. Came through as a laborer. Seemed like a decent man.
string: シンディングだ。渡りの労働者らしい。至ってまともな男に見えたのに

original: He's stewing in the pit while we figure out what to do with him, if you've got the stomach to look at him.
string: 処分が決まるまで、地下牢にぶち込んである。奴の顔を拝む勇気があるなら、見にいくといい

original: What could drive a man to do something like this?
string: 一体どうしたらこんな真似ができるっていうんだ？

original: How did she die?
string: なぜ死んだ？

original: She was... he ripped her apart. Like a sabre cat tears a deer. We barely found enough of her to bury.
string: 娘は…　ずたずたに引き裂かれていた。まるでサーベルキャットに殺されたシカのように。埋葬しようにも、満足に亡骸も集められなくてな

original: Who died?
string: 誰が死んだんだ？

original: Our daughter. Our little girl. She hadn't seen her tenth winter.
string: 娘だよ。まだほんの子供だった。かわいそうに、10回目の冬を迎えられなかった

original: You take care of yourself, now. And if you ever find yourself in New Sheoth, do look me up. We can share a strawberry torte. Ta ta!
string: 元気でな。ニュー・シェオスに寄る事があったら、私を訪ねてくれ。イチゴのトルテをごちそうするぞ。一期一会のトゥルットゥー！

original: And as for you, my little mortal minion... Feel free to keep the Wabbajack. As a symbol of my... Oh, just take the damn thing.
string: 小さき者よ、お前に関しては…　ワバジャックはお前に授けよう。私からの…　まあとにかく、そいつを好きに使うがいい

original: Yes, yes, that's quite enough celebration. Let's send you ahead, shall we?
string: さて、祝福はもう十分だな。では次の仕事の話をする。よいな？

original: Master! You've taken me back! Does this mean we're going home? Oh, happy times! I can't wait to...
string: マスター！　俺を連れ戻しに！　つまり、家に戻れるってことですね？　よかった！　今すぐにでも…

original: Luggage! Now where did I leave my luggage?
string: 荷物は！？　荷物はどこに置いた？

original: Let's make sure I'm not forgetting anything. Clothes? Check. Beard? Check! Luggage?
string: 忘れ物がないか確認しよう。一張羅は？　よし！　あご髭は？　よし！　…荷物は？

original: Well, I suppose it's back to the Shivering Isles. The trouble Haskill can get into while I'm gone simply boggles the mind...
string: シヴァリング・アイルズに戻ってきたな。いない間にハスキルが抱える問題には本当にびっくりさせられる…

original: Pelagius Septim the Third, once the Mad Emperor of Tamriel, now so boringly sane. I always knew he had it in him!
string: ペラギウス・セプティム3世は、かつてタムリエルの狂乱皇帝と呼ばれていた。だが今は退屈なぐらいまともだ。本当はまともな奴だとずっと思ってたがな！

original: Care to take a look around? This is not, I dare say, the Solitude botanical gardens. Have you any idea where you are? Where you truly are?
string: 周りを見る気になったか？　あえて言うが、ここはソリチュードの植物園ではない。お前はここがどこか分かるか？　本当はどこにいるのか分かるか？

original: Welcome to the deceptively verdant mind of the Emperor Pelagius III. That's right! You're in the head of a dead, homicidally insane monarch.
string: 偽りの緑が茂った皇帝ペラギウス3世の心へようこそ。そうだ！　お前は死者の心の中にいるのだ。狂乱の中で人を殺めた王の心さ

original: Now, I know what you're thinking. Can I still rely on my swords and spells and sneaking and all that nonsense? Sure, sure. Or... you could use...
string: 考えている事は分かるぞ。剣と呪文と隠密とその他のくだらない事全部を使えばこの難局を乗り切れるのかとな…　そうだろう？　あるいは…

original: The Wabbajack! Huh? Huh? Didn't see that coming, did you?
string: ワバジャック！　どうだ？　どうだ？　こいつは予測不能だったよな？

original: Ever think of moving to Morrowind?
string: モロウウィンドに帰りたいと考えたことは？

original: Not a day goes by that I don't think about returning to the ancestral home of my people.
string: 先祖代々の故郷に帰ることを考えない日は一日もない

original: Still, even with the rough treatment we've had at the hands of Ulfric and his lot, I've got ties here.
string: だがウルフリックとその一味からひどい扱いを受けているとしても、この地で築いた絆がある

original: It's probably more trouble to pack up and leave than it is to stay. Besides, Ambarys can't run the cornerclub on his own.
string: ここに残るより荷物をまとめて去る方が、おそらく苦労が多いだろう。それにアムバリスは、一人でコーナークラブを運営できないだろうしな

original: What's the Gray Quarter?
string: 灰色地区とは？

original: Windhelm is divided into four quarters. The Gray Quarter is the one that's home to all the city's Dark Elves.
string: ウィンドヘルムは四つの地域に分かれている。灰色地区には、すべてのダークエルフが住んでいるんだ

original: If it looks to you like an impoverished slum, that's because it is. Ulfric prefers that we live in squalor.
string: 貧しい地域に見えるとしたら、それは実際にそうだからさ。ウルフリックの意向で、みじめな暮らしを強いられている

original: He has nothing but disdain for anyone who isn't a Nord. He tolerates us, but that's the extent of his hospitality.
string: ノルドでない者は誰でも見下す男だ。俺達は大目に見られているが、親切心もそこまでだ

original: I don't appreciate loiterers, if that's what you're here to do.
string: この辺をうろつかれると困るんだ

original: I hope you have coin to spend, and you're not just here to gawk at my goods.
string: 品物をじろじろ見てるだけじゃなくて、金を使う気はあるんだろうな

original: Have a look around. I buy and sell just about anything.
string: どうぞ見てって下さい。何でも売買しますよ

original: I'm always happy to see a customer, but I won't deal in stolen goods. That's trouble I don't need.
string: お客さんなら歓迎ですが、盗品は扱っていませんよ。余計なトラブルはゴメンですからね

original: Make yourself at home, please. Let me know if I can be of any assistance.
string: どうぞおくつろぎを。何かありましたら、お呼び下さい

original: Fresh fruit and vegetables for sale!
string: 新鮮野菜に果物、安いよ！

original: Fruits and vegetables, all ripe and ready for your table!
string: 完熟野菜に果物、今すぐ食卓にどうぞ！

original: Take home Windhelm's finest and freshest produce today!
string: ウィンドヘルムで一番美味しい、新鮮な農作物。お土産にどうぞ！

original: Assorted fruits and vegetables, all delicious and affordable!
string: 選りすぐりの果物や野菜だ！　安くておいしいよ！

original: Come and browse my fine selection! Everything's fresh and delicious!
string: 最高の品々を見て行ってくれ！　どれも新鮮でおいしいよ！

original: I've a little of everything for sale, come and see for yourself!
string: 色々あるよ。ぜひ見てってくれ！

original: Cookware, knives and other goods for the home, all at reasonable prices!
string: 調理器具、包丁、その他家庭用品、お安くなっていますよ！

original: Assorted wares and tools you just can't live without! Come and see for yourself!
string: 生活必需品を取りそろえています。ぜひご覧になっていって！

original: Buying and selling a wide range of assorted goods! The best selection in Windhelm!
string: ウィンドヘルムで最高の品揃えですよ！

original: Go back to Morrowind, Dark Elf maggots! You're not welcome here!
string: モロウウィンドに帰れ、忌々しいダークエルフめ！　ここはお前らの来る所じゃない！

original: Get out of our city, gray-skins! This is Nord land!
string: この街から出ていけ、灰色ネズミども！　ここはノルドの土地だ！

original: We don't want your kind here, dark elves!
string: 目障りなんだよ、ダークエルフどもめ！

original: This place reeks of gray-skin filth!
string: 灰色ネズミどものせいで、臭くてたまらん！

original: You like living in this filthy slum, dark elves? Maybe you should go back to Morrowind, where you belong!
string: そんなにこの薄汚いゴミ溜めに住みたいか？　ええ、ダークエルフ？　故郷のモロウウィンドに帰っちまえ！

original: Spare a coin for a poor old woman?
string: 哀れな年寄りにお恵みを

original: A few septims for my supper is all I ask.
string: 夕飯分のゴールドだけでいいんです

original: I ask only for a little charity.
string: 少しでいいから恵んでよ

original: Will you spare a few coins to help someone who's got nothing?
string: 持たざる者を助けると思って、お恵み下さいな

original: I ain't askin' for much, just a few septims.
string: そんなにはいりません。少しでいいんです

original: The Divines smile on those who show mercy an' charity.
string: 神々は、慈悲と施しを行う者に微笑みます

original: A few septims ain't nothing. You can spare that, can't you?
string: 数ゴールドなんて何でもないでしょ。恵んでくれてもいいじゃない、ねえ？

original: Hear my prayer, son of Akatosh, and grant peace to these departed souls.
string: アカトシュの子よ、わが祈りを聞きたまえ。旅立つ魂に安らぎを

original: Lord of Seasons, I pray to you now that you might watch over the dead with mercy and kindness.
string: 季節の神よ、慈しみと哀れみのお心で死者達を見守りくださりますように

original: Mighty Arkay, God of Mortals, hear now the prayers of your humble servant. Bless these departed souls and welcome them into the realms beyond.
string: 定命なる者の神、偉大なるアーケイよ、わが祈りを聞きたまえ。旅立つ魂に祝福を。彼らを天国に受け入れたまえ

original: Mighty Arkay, I pray that you will shepherd these souls as they pass into the realm of death.
string: 偉大なるアーケイよ，魂達を黄泉の国へ導きたまえ

original: Feast your eyes on my strange and wondrous collection of curiosities.
string: さあ、収集した世にも珍しく、素晴らしい骨董品をごらんあれ

original: For a few septims, I'll give you a brief tour that includes some of my most unusual items.
string: 少々のゴールドで、もっとも変わった品々を軽く見学させよう

original: The objects you see here might look mundane at first glance, but I assure you, behind each is an unusual tale.
string: 今見ている物は、一目ではありふれたものと映るかも知れないな。しかし、それぞれにまつわる実に面白い話があるのだ

original: Why help the dark elves?
string: なぜダークエルフに手を貸しているんだ？

original: Help the Dark Elves? Oh, you must have heard me talking to Malthyr.
string: ダークエルフに手を貸すだって？　ああ、マルシルとの話を聞いてたのか

original: The Dark Elves live in a run-down slum called the Gray Quarter. Ulfric's content to keep it that way.
string: ダークエルフは灰色地区というすたれたスラム街で暮らしている。そして、ウルフリックはそのままの状態でいいと思ってるんだ

original: I guess they think I can open Ulfric's eyes to their plight, and get him to lift a finger on their behalf.
string: どうやら俺なら、その窮状にウルフリックの目を向けさせ、エルフのために何か手を打つよう仕向けられるんじゃないかと思っているらしい

original: I'm trying, but Ulfric is set in his ways. For him, there's two kinds of people in this world -- Nords, and the folk beneath them.
string: 努力はしているが、ウルフリックは自分のやり方を変えようとしない。彼にとってこの世界には、ノルドか、それより下の輩達、の二種類の人間しかいないのだ

original: That dark elf called you a war hero.
string: ダークエルフは戦争の英雄と呼んでいるようだな

original: I killed a lot of High Elves in the Great War, and I didn't die. I guess that makes me a war hero.
string: 大戦中、多くのハイエルフを殺した。そして俺は死ななかった。だから戦争の英雄ってことになるのかもな

original: The "Great War"... there was nothing great about it. Thousands died on both sides, and where did it get us?
string: “大戦”と言うが…　そこには何も大義なんかなかったよ。敵も味方も、何千人もの人が死んだ。それで何が得られた？

original: Did we really save the Empire? Or did we just plant the seeds for Ulfric's uprising, and another war?
string: 本当に帝国を救えたのか？　それともウルフリックの反乱やまた別の戦争の種をまいただけじゃないのか？

original: You one of those "Skyrim for the Nords" types?
string: お前も、“スカイリムはノルドのために”と言う口か？

original: I think I'll make my own way from here.
string: ここからは自分の道を行こうと思う

original: If I make it back to Solitude, I'll put in a good word for you with General Tullius.
string: 無事にソリチュードに戻れたら、テュリウス将軍にお前の事を薦めておこう

original: The Legion could sure use someone like you. Good luck.
string: 帝国軍はお前のような者を必要としているんだ。幸運を祈ってる

original: I think all folk should be welcome here.
string: すべての人種がここでは受け入れられるべきだ

original: And you're right, at least as far as I'm concerned.
string: その通りだ。少なくとも俺はそう信じるね

original: Don't let Ulfric or some of these other short-sighted Nords bother you. Most of us are happy to welcome newcomers.
string: ウルフリックや他の了見の狭いノルド人達にわずらわされるんじゃないぞ。我々のほとんどは新しい者を喜んで歓迎しているんだから

original: Yes. Outsiders like me have no place here.
string: ああ。自分のようなよそ者には居場所がないようだ

original: That's just what Ulfric wants you to think.
string: それこそ、ウルフリックが持たせようとしている考え方なんだ

original: If that's what you really believe, then you're a fool. Never had much patience for fools, myself.
string: 本当にそう信じているなら、お前は馬鹿だ。俺自身、馬鹿には辛抱強くない性質なんでね

original: No. Skyrim's big enough for everyone.
string: いいや。広大なスカイリムには誰が住んでも良いだろう

original: Good. Too many Nords in this town have been listening to Ulfric's narrow-minded words.
string: それはよかった。この町に住むあまりにも多くのノルドが、ウルフリックの偏狭な言葉を真に受けている

original: He's tough, loyal to his men and a good leader, but if you're not a Nord, Ulfric will never trust you.
string: 彼は強いし、自分の部下には忠実で、良い指導者だが、ノルド人でなければ、ウルフリックは絶対に信用しないからね

original: Yes. Anyone who's not a Nord is a trespasser.
string: ああ、ノルドでない者は侵略者だ

original: Is that so? You ought to join the Stormcloaks, if you haven't already.
string: そうか？　それならストームクロークへ入るべきだな。まだ入っていなければ

original: Seems to me they're a bunch of narrow-minded bigots, just like you.
string: あいつらも了見の狭い頑固者の集まりのようだから。お前のようにね

original: Meantime, you best steer clear of me.
string: さしあたり、俺には近づかないのが身のためだ

original: I'm sorry to be such a bother. We'll talk another time.
string: お邪魔して申し訳ありません。また別の機会にお話ししましょう

original: Forget it.
string: あきらめてくれ

original: I'll take it.
string: それで構わない

original: Do you have any bedlam jobs?
string: 盗みの仕事はあるか？

original: Sometimes we like to remind a city that we mean business, so we hit it hard. Just steal whatever we can until we've made an impression.
string: たまには我々が真剣だという事を思い出させるために、街に大きな打撃を受けてもらう。強い印象を与えるまで手当たり次第に盗みを働くぞ

original: Simple right? Almost. The catch is it doesn't count if anyone sees you take it. The message needs to be clear; we work in the shadows.
string: 簡単だろう？　だが我々が影に紛れて任務を行う上で、明るみにしている事がある。誰かにお前の盗みの現場を見られたら、手柄は無効になるという事だ

original: Steal from anywhere in the hold, and you even get to keep everythin' you stole. So, you in?
string: そこら中で盗みを働くんだ。お前が盗んだものはすべて自分のものにしていい。どうだ、やるか？

original: Tell me about the bedlam jobs.
string: 盗みの仕事について教えてほしい

original: I always have bedlam jobs. Just remember to hit them fast and don't let them see you. Feel like going for it?
string: 盗みの仕事ならいつだってあるさ。大切なのは、素早くとりかかって、顔を見られない事。どうだ、やる気になったか？

original: Of course. Don't forget to keep out of sight, it doesn't count if they catch you red-handed. You ready?
string: もちろんだ。人目につかないようにするのを忘れるなよ。もし現行犯逮捕されたら無効だ。覚悟はいいか？

original: Taking an easy job, eh? Well, go and do some damage. Just stick to the shadows and keep out of sight. Want to go for it?
string: 楽な仕事がほしいのか？　では、少し被害を出してこい。影に溶け込んで、姿を見られるな。やるか？

original: (Invisible Continue)(Forced Good bye) Time Limit to Attack
string: (見えないまま)(強制的に会話終了)攻撃が始まるまでの時間

original: The attack will be launched imminently. Gather your weaponry and get to the front lines... Now, soldier!
string: 攻撃はいつ始まってもおかしくない。武器を集めて前線へ向かえ…　さあ、急げ！

original: (Invisible Continue) Location of Attack
string: (見えないまま)攻撃が行われる場所

original: Join the forces mustering outside of [CAPITAL]. (Infos conditioned on Capital location go here)
string: ウィンターホールドの周りに集結した軍と合流しろ

original: (Invisible Continue) Difficulty based on Attack Delta
string: (見えないまま)難易度はデルタアタックしだいだな

original: Infos conditioned on Attack Delta go here.
string: デルタアタックに必要な条件については、ここに行け

original: What's the situation?
string: 状況は？

original: We are ready to mount our final attack.
string: 最終攻撃を仕掛ける準備ができた

original: Halt, outlander!
string: 動くな、よそ者！

original: Surrender or die, outlander!
string: 降参するか死かだ、よそ者！

original: Clanfolk, stop the outlander!
string: 皆、そのよそ者を止めるんだ！

original: Hold, there!
string: 動くんじゃない！

original: Lay down your weapons!
string: 武器を捨てろ！

original: That'll teach you to break the law on my watch.
string: 監視下で法を破るとどうなるか、教えてやろう

original: I thought it was finally going to be a quiet day.
string: 平穏な1日になると思ってたんだが

original: You really thought you could get away with it?
string: 本気で逃げられると思ってるのか？

original: Don't get any bright ideas.
string: 変な気は起こさない事だ

original: Stop, in the name of the Jarl!
string: 首長の名において、止まれ！

original: Come quietly or taste the Jarl's justice!
string: おとなしく来ないと、首長の処罰をくらうぞ

original: By order of the Jarl, I command you to halt!
string: 首長の命令により、止まるよう命じる！

original: Sheathe your weapons and come quietly!
string: 武器をしまって、おとなしく来い！

original: You sent me a message about Wolf Skull Cave?
string: ウルフスカル洞穴についての伝言を送って来たか？

original: Yes, old friend, I'm afraid it's not good news.
string: ああ、古い友よ。残念ながら良い話じゃないが

original: When you broke up the binding Potema escaped. We've encountered some of her minions.
string: 君が拘束を解いたとき、ポテマが逃げ出したんだ。何人かの彼女の手先に遭遇したよ

original: Styrr says she's still in spirit form or we'd all be dead already.
string: スティルが言うには、彼女はまだ霊魂の状態にあるらしい。そうでなければ俺達はみな、すでに死んでいるからな

original: You've already done us a service in stopping the binding, but I need you to go talk to him, to see if Styrr can tell us what to do next.
string: この拘束を阻止する時、すでに貢献してくれたのに悪いんだが、彼と話してみてくれないか。俺達が次に何をすべきか、スティルに考えがあるかも知れない

original: I'm ready.
string: 準備はできてる

original: Very well. Empty the vessels into the sconce near the throne, then sit in the throne.
string: よろしい。玉座のそばにある壁掛け用燭台に、容器の中身を全部出してから玉座に座れ

original: When you have done so, I will unbind Hevnoraak. He will awaken in a weakened state, but the lich is still to be reckoned with. Be ready.
string: それが済んだら、ヘブノラークを解放しよう。奴は弱った状態で目を覚ますが、それでもリッチは侮れない。準備しておくのだ

original: This seems dangerous.
string: 危険に思えるが

original: More dangerous than you know. Left alone, however, he will awaken when he has grown too powerful to be stopped. This is the only way to be sure.
string: 思っているより危険だぞ。だが放っておくと、奴は強力すぎて止められないところまで成長してから目を覚ます。これが確認する唯一の方法だ

original: What am I going to do with these?
string: これをどうすればいい？

original: In life, Hevnoraak drained his own blood from his body. His goal was to transfer his power back into himself after death, becoming a powerful lich.
string: ヘブノラークは生前、自分の体から血を抜いた。目的は死後、自分の力を取り戻し、強力なリッチになる事だ

original: The vessels contain that very blood. Empty them and you remove any chance he has of regaining his former powers.
string: 容器にはその血が入っている。空にすれば、奴がかつての力を取り戻す可能性がゼロになるんだ

original: What was I doing again?
string: もう一度何をすればいい？

original: Find the three vessels within Valthume, then return to me. With these we can defeat him.
string: ヴァルスムで容器を3つ見つけて、俺の元へ戻って来るんだ。容器があれば奴を打ち負かせる

original: I was happy to help.
string: 手伝えて良かった

original: Even though the Phial was damaged, I still think your efforts deserve reward.
string: 小瓶に傷はついたが、これは報酬に値する仕事だよ

original: Now, if you'll pardon me, I'm going to tend to Nurelion. I can make his final days a bit less painful.
string: ヌレリオンの世話をしに行くから、失礼するよ。人生最期の日々を、少し楽にしてあげたいんだ

original: I have the materials you requested.
string: 探していた物を持って来た

original: Thank the gods. I'll get to work on the Phial straight away.
string: ありがたい。すぐ小瓶に取りかかるよ

original: I've brought the Phial, but it's damaged.
string: 小瓶を見つけた。だが割れてしまっているようだ

original: This... it matches every description of the Phial that I've found in lore. But if it can't hold liquid, there's no way of knowing.
string: これは…　言い伝えにある小瓶の外見そのものだ。しかし液体を納められなければ確かめるすべがない

original: How did you manage to damage it, then? This is what I get for not retrieving it myself.
string: では、どうやって壊したんだ？　これが自分で探し出さなかった事の罰か

original: What were you arguing about?
string: 何を言い争ってたんだ？

original: What are you arguing about?
string: いったい何を話しているんだ？

original: You acted as a broker for its new owner.
string: 新しい所有者のために仲介をしたはずだ

original: Maybe I did, maybe I didn't. I can't be expected to remember every deal I handle.
string: したかも知れないし、してないかも知れない。自分の扱った取引を、いちいち覚えていられないんでね

original: You can drop the act now... Gajul-Lei.
string: 下手な芝居はよせ… ガジュル・レイ

original: Oh, wait... did you say Goldenglow Estate? My apologies.
string: ちょ、ちょっと待て…　ゴールデングロウ農園と言ったか？　謝るよ

original: I'm sorry to say I know very little about that... bee farm, was it?
string: その…　養蜂園だったかな？　残念だが、あまり詳しい事は知らないんだ

original: So, what do we have here? Hmm. Let me guess.
string: それで、一体何の用なんだ？　ううむ、当ててみようか

original: By your scent, I'd say you were from the Guild. But that can't be true, because I told Mercer I wouldn't deal with them anymore.
string: 察するに、あんた盗賊ギルドの者だろ。まあ、それはあり得ないか。メルセルに、盗賊ギルドとはもう取引しないと言ってあるしな

original: East Empire Company? Who are they?
string: 東帝都社？ それはなんだ？

original: A mercantile group that has established ports all over Tamriel. They pretty much dominate the whole shipping industry.
string: タムリエル中に港を作ってきた商業集団だ。運送をほぼ牛耳っている連中さ

original: The Emperor himself supposedly backs them, which means they have fairly unlimited resources... so don't get their feathers in a ruffle.
string: 皇帝自身が支援しているという話だ。つまり資本がほとんど無限大という事になる…　だから連中をあまり苛立たせるなよ

original: If I get information from Gulum-Ei, what then?
string: ガラム・エイから情報を得たら、次にどうすればいい？

original: Just head right back to the Guild and get the information to Mercer. Nothing else is more important.
string: 真っ直ぐギルドに戻って、メルセルに情報を渡してくれ。これ以上に重要な事はない

original: If you discover Gulum-Ei's holding out on us and has more loot stashed away than he claims, we'd find that information quite valuable as well.
string: ガラム・エイが俺達に隠れて、申告していたよりも多く蓄えているのが分かったなら、その情報だけでもかなりの価値だ

original: You think Gulum-Ei will give me trouble?
string: ガラム・エイが問題になると思うか？

original: There are thieves and then there is Gulum-Ei. No honor, no code at all. He'd shake your hand and stab you in the back at the same time.
string: ガラム・エイは盗賊とは別種だ。信義も信条も全くない。握手しながら肩を抱くと同時に、背に刃を突き立ててくるような男だよ

original: The cut he's supposed to provide the Guild has dwindled as of late. He says pickings in the warehouse are slim, but I'm certain he's lying.
string: 最近、奴のギルドへの支払いが激減している。倉庫での盗みが実り少ないからだという話だが、嘘を吐いているに違いない

original: Keep your eyes on him, he's quite crafty.
string: 奴から目を離すなよ、狡賢い男だからな

original: How is Gulum-Ei an asset to the Guild?
string: ガラム・エイはギルドにとってどう重要なんだ？

original: Gulum-Ei works in the East Empire Company Warehouse. He helps maintain all of the shipments of goods that goes in and out of Solitude.
string: ガラム・エイは東帝都社の倉庫で働いている。ソリチュードを出入りする貨物を維持する手伝いをしているんだ

original: That means he has the pick of the litter from some of the finest goods to grace Skyrim's shores.
string: つまりスカイリムの岸にご上陸された優美な物品の数々から、好きな物を選べるという訳だよ

original: He isn't exactly in the Guild, but he pays us a cut of all the stuff he lifts from the warehouse.
string: 奴は正確にはギルドの人間ではないが、倉庫からくすねた品の一部を俺達に納めている

original: If he's betrayed us, I'll kill him.
string: もし裏切ったのなら、殺してやろう

original: No, no. Mercer wants him alive, for now.
string: いや、だめだ。メルセルはそいつを生け捕りにしたいらしい。今の所はな

original: Stubborn or not, he's the only contact we've got at the East Empire Company.
string: 頑固だろうとなんだろうと、奴は俺達にとって東帝都社との唯一の繋ぎ役だ

original: Just keep on his tail and he's bound to step into something he can't scrape off his boot.
string: 後を尾けていれば、必ずボロを出すはず

original: Think he'll give me trouble?
string: 彼は問題になると思うか？

original: Trouble? He's one of the most stubborn lizards I've ever met! You have your work cut out for you.
string: 問題？　俺が会った中でも一番強情なトカゲだよ、あいつは！　これは簡単にいくような仕事じゃないぞ

original: I can't believe Gulum-Ei's mixed up in all this; that Argonian couldn't find his tail with both hands.
string: ガラム・エイがこんな事に関わっているとは思えんな。あのアルゴニアンは両手を使っても自分の尻尾が見つけられんような奴だ

original: Don't get me wrong, he could scam a beggar out of his last septim... but he's no mastermind.
string: 勘違いしないでくれ、あの男は物乞いからでも金貨を最後の一枚まで騙し取るが…　黒幕なんて柄じゃあない

original: I was told you wanted to see me right away.
string: すぐに会いたいと聞いて来たんだが

original: Ah, there you are.
string: やっと来たか

original: I've consulted my contacts regarding the information you recovered from Goldenglow Estate, but no one can identify that symbol.
string: お前がゴールデングロウ農園から持ち帰った情報について、関係者に当たってみた。だがあのシンボルが何なのか誰にも分からなかった

original: Come on inside. Sigrid will get you something to eat and you can tell us what happened.
string: 中に入ってくれ。シグリッドに何か食べるものを持ってこさせるよ。何が起こったのか話してくれ

original: Okay, okay. Come inside, then. Sigrid will get you something to eat and you can tell me all about it.
string: 分かった、分かった。それじゃあ中に入ってくれ。シグリッドに何か食べるものを持ってこさせるよ。その後話してくれ

original: He's a friend. Saved my life in fact. Come on, I'll explain everything, but we need to go inside.
string: 彼は俺の友達だ。それに命の恩人なんだよ。ほら、全部説明する。まず中に入ろう

original: She's a friend. Saved my life in fact. Come on, I'll explain everything, but we need to go inside.
string: 彼女は俺の友人だ。それに命の恩人なんだよ。ほら、全部説明する。まず中に入ろう

original: What's going on? And who's this?
string: 何事だ？　それにこれは誰だ？

original: Shh.. Uncle, please. Keep your voice down. I'm fine. But we should go inside to talk.
string: シー…　頼むよおじさん。静かにしてくれ。俺は大丈夫だから。とにかく、話は中でしよう

original: Are you in some kind of trouble?
string: 何か困ってるのか？

original: Shor's bones, what happened to you, boy?
string: ショールの骨にかけて、何があったんだ？

original: Hadvar, thank Talos! Your friend told me about Helgen...
string: ハドバル、ああよかった、タロスよ。友達からヘルゲンのことは聞いたよ…

original: Hadvar? What are you doing here? Are you on leave from...
string: ハドバル？　ここで何をしているんだ？　今休暇中じゃ…

original: Uncle Alvor! Hello!
string: アルヴォアおじさん！　どうも！

original: It's nice to be back in a friendly spot, huh?
string: 自軍の土地に戻るのはいいもんだ、だろ？

original: Listen, I'm going to lay up here for a while. You can make your own way to Solitude from here.
string: なあ、俺はしばらくここで休む事にする。ここからソリチュードまではひとりで行ってくれ

original: I'd recommend heading to Whiterun, just down the road from here. From there you can take a carriage to Solitude.
string: ここから道なりにホワイトランに行くといい。そこからソリチュードまで馬車で行ける

original: I hope I'll see you in Solitude. Good luck.
string: ソリチュードでまた会おう。幸運を祈る

original: Come on. I'll feel better once we're under cover in Riverwood.
string: 行こうじゃないか。リバーウッドに隠れれば、一息つけるだろう

original: I hope that dragon isn't still flying around here somewhere.
string: ドラゴンがまだこの辺りを飛び回ってなきゃいいんだが

original: I still almost can't believe it... a real, live dragon...
string: まだとうてい信じられない…　本物の、生きたドラゴンだなんて…

original: What do you need?
string: 何が必要だ？

original: Yeah? What is it?
string: うん？　それは何だ？

original: Did you really see a dragon?
string: 本当にドラゴンを見たの？

original: Make yourself at home.
string: どうぞゆっくりなさって下さいね

original: Take what you need, my friend. Within reason, of course.
string: 好きなものを持っていけ。もちろん、常識の範囲内でな

original: Namira grind your bones for my bread!
string: ナミラが私のために骨を砕いてくれるわ！

original: I will drink your blood and feast on your flesh!
string: お前の血肉を食らってやる！

original: I will feast on you!
string: 楽しませてもらうよ！

original: Glory to Namira!
string: ナミラに栄光あれ！

original: Glory to the repulsive!
string: 不快に栄光あれ！

original: Not here. We will meet at Reachcliff Cave.
string: ここではだめ。リーチクリフ洞窟で会いましょう

original: Bring Verulus here. The Lady of Decay will do the rest.
string: ヴェルラスをここに。あとは廃滅の女公がして下さいます

original: Go ahead. Eat.
string: さあどうぞ

original: Soon, Namira's blessing will be yours.
string: すぐにあなたにもナミラの祝福があります

original: We will sate the hunger together.
string: 一緒に餓えを満たしましょう

original: Don't fear the unknown, the hidden, the wretched.
string: 未知のもの、隠されたもの、哀れなものを恐れるなかれ

original: I'd like to know more about Azura.
string: アズラについて、もっと詳しく知りたい

original: She is the Goddess of Dawn and Dusk. Azura sees into the Twilight of the future, and guides her followers through it.
string: アズラは暁と黄昏の女神。未来の黄昏を見通して信者を導くの

original: You're my... friend....
string: と…　友達だろう…

original: Priest of Arkay. I'm your friend.
string: アーケイの司祭です。あなたの味方ですよ

original: Who... who are you? What's going on?
string: だ…　誰なんだ？　一体どうしたんだ？

original: Why did she kill him?
string: なぜ彼女は彼を殺したんだ？

original: Greed? Jealousy? Spite? Who can say what drove her to such an iniquitous act.
string: 欲望か？　嫉妬か？　それとも憎しみ？　何が原因であんなひどい事ができたのか、誰にも分からんだろう

original: One thing's certain. I intend to find out before she draws her last breath.
string: 一つ確かな事は、彼女が死ぬ前に俺が突き止めてやるってことだな

string: そして、ガルスは？

original: The last thing I saw was Karliah dumping his body into a opening atop the ruins; an unceremonious end for a remarkable man.
string: 最後に見たのは、カーリアがあいつの死体を遺跡に空いた穴に捨てる光景だ。優れた男の最後にしては、えらく簡単だったな

original: To this day I've regretted allowing her to escape, even if it meant I had died trying. I owed Gallus that much.
string: 今日まで彼女を逃がした事をずっと後悔している。たとえ命を失ったとしても、あの場で捕まえるべきだった。ガルスには世話になっていたってのに

original: So Karliah took on both of you alone?
string: では、カーリアは1人で2人を倒したのか？

original: Karliah was a master marksman and her greatest weapon was the element of surprise. I was lucky... she missed my heart by mere inches.
string: カーリアは弓の達人だからな。それに不意打ちは彼女の最大の武器だった。幸い…　矢は俺の心臓からほんのちょっとずれたところに当たったんだ

original: I staggered away from the ruins and my vision began to blur. It's then that I realized the bitch had poisoned her arrows.
string: よろめきながらどうにか遺跡を離れた。視界がかすみ始めた時、矢に毒が塗られていた事にようやく気づいたよ

original: How did Gallus die?
string: どうしてガルスは死んだんだ？

original: Twenty-five years ago I was standing outside these very same ruins. Gallus told me to meet here but he wouldn't say why.
string: 25年前、まさにこの遺跡の外に俺はいたんだ。ガルスとここで落ち合う約束をしてね。奴は目的を言わなかったが

original: When I arrived, Gallus stepped from the shadows. Before he uttered a sound an arrow pierced his throat.
string: 到着すると、暗がりからガルスは出てきた。だが何も言わないうちに、1本の矢が奴の喉を貫いたんだ

original: Before I could even draw my blade, her second arrow found its mark in my chest.
string: 次の瞬間、2本目の矢が俺の胸に刺さった。剣を抜く暇すらなかったよ

original: So, they had a relationship.
string: 彼らの間には関係があったのか

original: If you want to call it that, yes. Me? I think she was softening him for the kill.
string: そういう言い方をするなら、答えはイエスだ。俺の意見かい？　彼女は奴を殺すためにたらし込んだんじゃないかな

original: Gallus would call her his "little nightingale." He was absolutely smitten by her.
string: ガルスは彼女の事を“かわいいナイチンゲール”と呼んでいた。完全に骨抜きだったな

original: Tell me about Karliah.
string: カーリアについて教えてほしい

original: She was a stubborn Dunmer... always had to do everything her way.
string: 彼女は頑固なダンマーでね…　何でも我を通さなきゃ気が済まなかった

original: But she was also the best... bringing in more coin a month than some thieves heist in a year.
string: でも腕は確かで最高だった…　数人の盗賊が1年で稼ぐ金を、1月もかからずに稼いでしまうような奴だったよ

original: Gallus trusted her too much and let her get too close.
string: ガルスはカーリアを信用しすぎた。彼女をあんなに近づけるべきじゃなかったんだ

original: Understood.
string: 分かった

original: Just make certain you keep your eyes open. Karliah is as sharp as a blade.

original: The last thing I need is you blundering into a trap and warning her that we're here.
string: 罠にかかってこちらの存在を知らせるなど、言語道断だ

original: You want me to lead?
string: こっちが先導するのか？

original: I'm sorry, I was under the impression I was in charge.
string: 悪いが、指示する立場にあるのはこっちじゃなかったかな

original: You're leading and I'm following. Does that seem clear to you?

original: You saw her?
string: 彼女を見たのか？

original: No, I found her horse. Don't worry, I've taken care of it... she won't be using it to escape.
string: いや。でも彼女の馬を見つけた。もう始末したから心配するな…　馬を使って逃げられる事はない

original: Let's get moving, I want to catch her inside while she's distracted. Take the lead.

original: Good, you're finally here.

original: Lucky for you that was just sitting there for the taking.

original: Hrrrmm.

original: Then you are fool, and will die for it.
string: 愚か者だったとはな。なら死ぬがいい

original: I'm not apologizing. And I'm not afraid of you.
string: 謝るつもりはない。あなたのことも恐れない

original: Honor may mean nothing to you, but it means much to me. Your apology, or your life.
string: 名誉なんてお前にとってはどうでもいいかも知れないが、俺にとっては重要だ。謝罪か命か、どちらかだ

original: Only your death or an apology will restore my family's honor. Last chance.
string: 死ぬか謝るか、他に家族の名誉を挽回する道はない。最後のチャンスだ

string: 謝るつもりはない

original: Then I guess we're done talking.
string: ではおしゃべりはここまでのようだな

string: 謝るつもりはない。あなたのことも恐れない

original: Perhaps I haven't made myself clear. Your best and least painful course of action is to apologize and promise to leave my family in peace.
string: はっきりと伝わっていないようだな。謝罪し、俺の一族の邪魔をしないと約束しろ。お前にとって最善で、最も苦痛の少ない道だ

original: No? You sure? 'Cause we're reaching the point of no return here...
string: 何だと？　本気か？　そろそろ手遅れになるぞ…

original: I'm not going to apologize.
string: 謝るつもりはない

original: Annnddd... Point of no return reached.
string: ほう…　もう手遅れだな

original: I'm not apologizing. And I'm not afraid of you.
string: 謝るつもりはない。あなたのことも恐れない

original: Sorry.
string: すまない

original: I trust this is the last I'll hear of your violent outbursts.
string: あなたの暴言もこれが最後だと信じるわ

original: Stay away from my family if you value your life.
string: 命が惜しいなら、家族には近づかないで

original: Good. But know that further dishonor to my family will mean your death.
string: いいわ。でも今後一族を侮辱する事があれば殺す。それだけは覚えておいて

original: You stay away from my family. Or you die. Be smart. Stay away.
string: 家族に近づくな。命が惜しければな。近づかない方が賢明だぞ！

original: This had better be the last I hear of you disrespecting my family.
string: 今後は二度と家族に手を出すんじゃないぞ

original: Mark these words carefully, fetcher. Stay away from my family, or I will paint the ground with your blood.
string: 言葉の使い方には気をつけろよ。もし俺の家族に近づいたりしたら、お前の血で地面を真っ赤に染めてやるぞ

original: Any further dishonor done to my kin, and I'll put you in the ground.
string: 俺の一族をまた侮辱することがあれば、お前を葬ってやる

original: That wasn't so hard, now was it.
string: それほど難しい事じゃなかったろう

original: What's the problem?
string: どうしたっていうんだ？

original: You assaulted one of my family members. I've come to accept your apology.
string: 私の家族を襲ったくせに。謝るなら許してやってもいいわ

original: You! Fetcher! I should kill you for assaulting my family. But I will accept your apology...
string: あなたよ、クソ野郎！　家族を襲った罪で殺してやるんだから。でも、謝るっていうなら聞いてやらない事もないわよ

original: You know who I am? You attacked one of my clan. I've come to accept your apology... or your death.
string: 私が誰だか分かる？　あなたは私の一族を襲った。ここで謝罪するか…　死んでもらうわ

original: You! You hurt my family. I don't like when my family gets hurt. Say you're sorry. Or say goodbye.
string: あんた！ あんたが家族を傷つけたんだ！ 絶対に許せない。謝れ、さもなくば死んでもらう

original: You attacked one of my family. What do you have to say for yourself?
string: 俺の家族を襲ったくせに。どんな言い訳をするつもりだ？

original: You can't attack my family and get away with it, fetcher! I will have an apology, or your head on a spike. Choose.
string: 俺の家族を襲っておいてタダで済むと思うな！　謝罪してもらおう、さもなくばさらし首にしてやる。さあどうする？

original: Dishonorable dog. You attacked one of my kin. So now you're going to apologize... or I'm going to lop off your head.
string: 卑劣なイヌめ。俺の家族を攻撃したな。謝ってもらおうか…　さもなければ首を切り落とすぞ

original: Here's the situation. You attacked my family. So now you're going to apologize.. or I'm going to kill you. I hope we understand each other...
string: こういう事だ。お前は俺の一族を攻撃した。今から謝るんだ…　さもないと殺すぞ。言いたいことは分かったな…

original: I'm sorry to hear that.
string: 残念だ

original: As am I.
string: そうだな

original: You acted very nobly in helping my master realize his life's work. Thank you for that.
string: 先生が仕事をやり遂げられるよう、立派に力を貸してくれたな。感謝してるよ

original: As for myself, I've always been content to simply be an alchemist.
string: 自分はただの錬金術師でいられれば満足なんだ

original: I fear keeping the Phial would just remind me of Nurelion's obsession, and how it consumed him.
string: 小瓶を持つと、ヌレリオンがどれほどこれに執着し、消耗させられたかを思い出してしまう

original: Here, keep it. You are as much a part of its legend now as Curalmil was. I hope it brings you the happiness that my master desired.
string: 取っておいてくれ。あんたは今やクラルミルと同じぐらいに伝説の一部だ。先生が望んだような幸福が得られればいいな

original: What happened to Nurelion?
string: ヌレリオンはどうした？

original: He is gone.
string: 死んだよ

original: But thanks to you, he died knowing his life's work was not in vain.
string: でもあんたのおかげで、一生の仕事が無駄じゃない事を知って死ねた

original: Marvelous.
string: すごいな

original: It doesn't matter. Look, it's refilling with your tonic as we speak.
string: そんなことは、どうでもいい。ほら、ここで言うトニックのお替わりだ

original: What? How?
string: なに？　どうやって？

original: Master, look. It's the Phial.
string: 先生、見て下さい。小瓶です

original: You want a real fight, eh?
string: 真剣勝負がしたいんだろう？

original: Don't let him get away with this!
string: 逃がすんじゃないぞ！

original: Don't let her get away with this!
string: 逃がすんじゃないぞ！

original: Get him!
string: やっちまえ！

original: Get her!
string: やっちまえ！

original: Come on, he's not so tough.
string: どうした、相手はそんなに強くないぞ

original: Come on, she's not so tough.
string: そら、相手はそんなに強くないぞ

original: Twelve septims on the big one!
string: でかい方に12ゴールド！

original: Fight! Fight!
string: やれ！　やれ！

original: Drive that snowback to the ground. Come on!
string: その臆病者をやっちまえ！

original: You just going to stand there and take it? Fight back.
string: ただやられっぱなしか？　やり返せ！

original: Who taught you to fight? Keep those hands up!
string: 誰に戦いを教わったんだ？　腕を下ろすな！

original: Get him!
string: やっちまえ！

original: Get her!
string: やっちまえ！

original: Come on. Let's see what you're made of.
string: さあ、本気を見せてもらおう

original: I'm not paying you a bribe.
string: 賄賂を出すつもりはない

string: 分かった。ほら(50ゴールド払う)

original: See, that wasn't so difficult, was it.
string: そら、簡単な事だろう

original: You have.... But I don't care.

string: そうか？　独房でひと月ばかり過ごすのも知ったことじゃないかな？

original: I'm sorry.
string: すまない

string: 時たま、商店主達にここを仕切ってるのが誰なのかを思い出させてやる必要があるんだよ

original: If that means breaking into their strongboxes and stealing something valuable from them, then so be it.
string: 金庫を破って貴重品を盗み出してやらないと分からないってんなら、そうしてやるまでだ

original: Feel like doing a bit of shopping... the Guild way?
string: ちょいと買い物してくるって感じだな…　ギルド流のやり方で

original: Tell me about the heist jobs.
string: 強奪の仕事について教えてほしい

original: Got a shop owner with a very choice item a client wants to get his hands on if you do the dirty work.
string: ある店の品をどうしても手に入れたいって依頼人がいるんだが、汚れ仕事をする気はあるかい？

original: Got a good one here involving a shop, a waylaid shipment of goods and an angry client. You fill in the blanks. You want in?
string: いい話があるよ。登場するのはある店と、待ち伏せに遭った貨物と、腹を立てた依頼人。この舞台の役者と演出と幕引き、あんたが全部やってみないか？

original: I have just the place. The owner likes to stash some lovely trinkets in his strongbox like this beauty. Can you get it for us?
string: ある屋敷の主は、美しい装身具を金庫に貯めこむのが趣味らしい。ちょいといただいてきてくれないか？

original: The owner of this place just inherited an heirloom from a relative. You want in?
string: ある屋敷の主は親戚から遺産を相続したばかりらしい。やってみるか？

original: Sure. A client's relative lost this item in a gambling match and they're paying us to get it back. So much for fair play, huh?
string: もちろん。依頼人の親戚が賭け試合でこの品をなくしちまって、取り戻してくれたら金を払うってさ。獲物として不足はないよな？

original: The owner of this shop stiffed us on their last protection payment, but we're taking it anyway. You want to help us on this one?
string: ある商店主は所場代の支払いが滞っているんだが、とにかく取り立てないとな。手を貸す気はあるか？

original: 'Jiit caravan brought this shop a nice piece from Elsweyr. Think you can break into their strongbox and get it for us?
string: カジート・キャラバンがエルスウェーアから運んできた逸品が、ある店に入荷された。金庫を破って盗んできてくれないか？

original: Got a client in desperate need for this item. He won't say what it's for, and we don't care. Can you take this one?
string: ある品を死ぬほどほしがってる依頼人がいるんだ。何のためかは言いたがらないんだが、そこんところは別に興味はない。引き受けてくれるか？

original: An excellent question. Vittoria Vici is the first cousin to our dear Emperor, Titus Mede II.
string: いい質問ね。ヴィットリア・ヴィキは、我らが皇帝タイタス・ミード2世の従姉妹なの

original: Vici has obvious Imperial connections. Her husband has ties to the Stormcloaks. Their union is a step toward reconciliation.
string: ヴィキは明らかに帝国側の人間だし、彼女の夫はストームクロークと繋がりがある。この結婚は和解への一歩なの

original: So if there's a murder at the wedding... Not only will it stall the peace process - it will send shockwaves throughout the entire Empire.
string: だから、結婚式で殺人が起きれば…　和平交渉が行き詰まるだけじゃなく、帝国に衝撃が走る事は間違いないわ

original: The Emperor's hand will be forced. He'll have to travel to Skyrim to deal with the aftermath... and he'll find the Dark Brotherhood waiting.
string: そうなれば、皇帝が直接手を下さざるを得なくなる。後始末のためにスカイリムへと来るでしょう…　そこへ闇の一党が待ち構えているというわけ

original: What's Vici's connection to the Emperor?
string: ヴィキと皇帝はどういう関係なんだ？

original: Soon. I'm not exactly sure when. But not to worry - the ceremony itself is being followed up by a public banquet that will last for several days.
string: もうすぐよ。はっきりとは分からない。でも心配ないわ。式の後、市民も参加しての祝宴が数日間続く予定なの

original: Both Vittoria and her husband will be there for the duration, and everyone in Solitude is invited to attend. You'll have plenty of opportunity.
string: ヴィットリアも新郎もずっと出ずっぱりだし、ソリチュードの全員が招待されてる。チャンスはいくらだってあるわ

original: When does the wedding start?
string: 結婚式はいつ始まるんだ？

original: DB05PlayerWeddingResponse
string: DB05PlayerWeddingResponse

original: Well, more like the public reception. It should be a lovely affair. You'll mingle with the guests, eat some cake... stab the bride.
string: 披露宴に近いわね。素敵な行事になるはずよ。招待客とおしゃべりして、ケーキを食べて…　花嫁へ入刀よ

original: Oh yes. You've got to kill the bride. At her wedding.
string: そう、花嫁を殺すの。結婚式でね

original: And they say romance is dead.
string: よく言うでしょ、ロマンスは死んだ、って

original: A wedding?
string: 結婚式？

original: Splendid. Then we're ready to begin. Or, more specifically, you're ready to begin. After all, you're the one the Night Mother spoke to.
string: すばらしいわ。これなら始めてもよさそうね。あなたにやってもらうわ。何といっても、夜母が話をしたのはあなただから

original: But by Sithis, I hope I'm making the right choice here. You may be an effective killer, but your command of guile leaves much to be desired.
string: シシスに誓って、私の判断に間違いがない事を祈るわ。殺し屋としての腕はいいけど、あなたには狡猾さが足りないもの

original: The sealed letter you delivered to me was mysteriously unsealed upon its arrival. I can only assume you've read its contents. Sloppy...
string: 届けられた封書は、不思議な事に封が開かれていた。あなたが内容を読んだとしか思えない。手抜かりね…

original: But moving on to business. As you probably already know from reading the letter... you're going to a wedding.
string: まあ用件に戻りましょう。手紙を読んだのならもう知っているでしょうけど…　あなたには結婚式に出てもらうわ

original: He was. Here's a letter of credit.
string: ああ、これが信用状だ

original: Splendid. Then we're ready to begin. Or, more specifically, you're ready to begin. After all, you're the one the Night Mother spoke to.
string: すばらしいわ。これなら始めてもよさそうね。あなたにやってもらうわ。何といっても、夜母が話をしたのはあなただから

original: Now then. I hope you have something nice to wear. Because you're going to a wedding.
string: ところで、何かいい服は持ってる？　結婚式に行くんですからね

original: He was. Here's a letter of credit.
string: ああ、これが信用状だ

original: Why is the Phial so important to you?
string: なぜその小瓶がそうも大事なんだ？

original: I have spent my entire life searching for it.
string: 私は生涯をかけて探してきた

original: It brought me all the way to these frozen reaches from the warm embrace of Summerset Isle.
string: そのためにはるばるこの極寒の岬へと暖かなサマーセット島からはるばる旅してきた

original: Entire years spent in libraries. Seeking out tiny villages with local legends that contain but a whisper of a hint of the Phial.
string: 何年も図書館を巡ってきた。言い伝えの残る小さな村々を訪ねては、小瓶の在処を示す頼りない手掛かりを集めてきた

original: I even named my shop after it, hoping that it might attract anyone who had heard of it.
string: 店の名前すらそこから名付けた。ウワサを耳にした事のある者がきてくれるのではと願ってな

original: And now it's within my grasp... but the Eight, it seems, have chosen me for their amusement.
string: そしてようやく手に入れはしたが…　八大神はどうやら私をもてあそんでいるようだ

original: ... for in my current condition, I'll never be able to lay my hands on it.
string: …現状から考えて、もはや手にする事はかなうまい

original: What is the White Phial?
string: 白き小瓶とは何だ？

original: A legendary bottle, forged in the days when Skyrim was just starting its turn to ice.
string: 伝説の瓶だ。スカイリムが氷に覆われはじめた時につくられた代物だ

original: A small container, made of the magically infused snow that first fell on the Throat of the World.
string: 小さな容器で、世界のノドに初めて降った魔法の雪でできている

original: It is said that the Phial will replenish whatever fluid is placed inside of it.
string: 小瓶はどんなものであれ中に入れた液体を補充するという

original: For an alchemist like myself, it is the most pure expression of my art. To create from nothingness is... poetry.
string: 私のような錬金術師には、錬金術のもっとも純粋な形だ。無からの創造とはまさに…　詩だ

original: If you tell me where it is, I can get it for you.
string: どこにあるか教えてくれたら、取ってこよう

original: You would do that? It's good to know there are some people out there who are willing to help an old man.
string: やってくれるのか？　老いぼれに手を貸してくれる人がいるとはうれしい事だ

original: It's buried with its maker, Curalmil, in a long forsaken cave to the west of here.
string: あれは製作者のクラルミルとともに埋葬されている。西にある見捨てられた洞窟の中だ

original: Curalmil was a crafty one, even in death. You would need the skills of a master alchemist to reach his resting place.
string: クラルミルは狡猾な男だった。死後もそれは変わらん。錬金術に練達していなければ奴の墓所にはたどりつけん

original: Luckily for you, I've already made the mixture. Here, take it.
string: ついているな、私がもう混合物を調合しておいた。さあ、持って行け

original: Please... don't dally. I've wasted enough time arguing with my useless assistant here.
string: 頼む…　急いでくれ。この役立たずの助手との口論で時間を無駄にしてしまった

original: Bah. If there was a tonic that could help me, I would have found it by now...
string: ふん。治してくれるトニックがあるならもう見つけている…

original: Actually, she's a vampire. She planned to enslave the town.
string: 彼女は吸血鬼なんだ。街そのものを支配しようと企んでいた

original: I assume you have proof? Can't go making accusations like that without proof.
string: 証拠はあるんだろうね。証拠もなしにそんな申し立てはできないよ

original: By the gods! I assume you have proof.
string: 信じられない！　証拠はつかんでるんでしょうね

original: Alva set the fire. She's the murderer.
string: アルバが火をつけた。彼女が殺人者だ

original: Alva? Didn't think she had it in her.
string: アルバ？　彼女が人殺しをするとは思えないね

original: So Alva did it to get Hroggar for herself? I should have suspected her.
string: アルバがフロガーを手に入れるために？　それは疑うべきだったわ

original: You want in there? Here's my spare key. Take whatever you want.
string: 入りたいの？　ほら、スペアキーよ。好きなものを取っておいで

original: Let's get up there before mother finds out what we're doing.
string: 私達がやっていることを母に悟られないうちに近づきましょう

original: Are you sure about this?
string: 大丈夫なのか？

original: I'm going with you whether you like it or not.
string: いやだと言っても一緒に行くからね

original: Why did you need a sacrifice?
string: なぜ生贄が必要なんだ？

original: The Initiation. My mother is going to become one of those things. I can't be a part of that.
string: 通過儀礼のためよ。母はああいうものになるつもりなの。私は関わりたくない

original: Gods, I can't run away from this. I have to stop her.
string: でも、逃げるなんてできないわ。彼女を止めなきゃ

original: Why did she need to die?
string: なぜ彼女は死ななければならなかったんだ？

original: We were supposed to find a sacrifice. Human sacrifice. I told her I couldn't do it and she attacked.
string: 生贄を見つけることになっていたのよ。人間の生贄をね。できないと言ったら、彼女が襲いかかってきたの

original: I've done horrible things living here, but never taken an innocent life. I couldn't just find some person for them to kill.
string: ここにいる間、ずいぶん酷い事もしてきたけれど…　罪のない人を殺したことはないわ。ただ殺すために誰か見つけるなんてできなかった

original: We've got all the miners we need, so I hope you're not here looking for work.
string: 鉱山労働者なら足りてるわ。仕事探しに来たんじゃないといいけど

original: Hjaalmarch isn't much, but it's a good start. I'll make a name for myself here, then maybe work my way up to someplace like Riften.
string: ハイヤルマーチには何もないけど、いい足掛かりになるわ。ここで功績を挙げれば、リフテンみたいな場所に行けるかも知れないでしょう

original: Finally, my leadership is being recognized.
string: やっと私の指導力が認められたようね

original: Nothing here but the mine. Probably best you keep moving.
string: ここには鉱山しかないの。先を急いだ方がいいと思うわ

original: Pactur and I, we make sure the miners aren't stealing, and that the ore makes it to Solitude.
string: パクトゥールと私で、鉱山労働者が盗みを働かず、鉱石が無事ソリチュードに届くようにしてるの

original: It's good that Sorli has finally been given some real authority.
string: やっとソルリにきちんとした権限が与えられて、よかった

original: I'll see to it that Sorli is safe now that she's running Morthal.
string: ソルリが元気でモーサルを管理しているか、確かめよう

original: We left Sirgar in charge back at Stonehills. I hope that wasn't a mistake.
string: ストーンヒルズは、シルガルに任せた。間違いでないといいんだが

original: Sorli and I are just here to make sure the mine is run proper.
string: ソルリと一緒に、鉱山をきちんと管理するのが仕事だ

original: Wouldn't ever have expected to wind up living in a place like this, but the money's good.
string: こんなところに暮らすなんて思ってもいなかったが、給料はいい

original: Don't bother the miners. They've got work to do.
string: 鉱山労働者に関わるな。忙しいんだ

original: I'm in charge now that my parents are in Morthal.
string: 両親は今モーサルだから、仕事を引き継いだんだ

original: I figured that I would run the mine someday. I just didn't figure that would mean now.
string: いつか鉱山を管理するようになる事は分かってた。だけど、それが何を意味するかは分かってなかった

original: Guess the Empire's going to need plenty of iron what with all the fighting. That'll be good for us, I suppose.
string: 帝国は戦争するのにたくさんの鉄が必要だと思うんだ。それって願ってもない事じゃないかな、たぶん

original: Talk to my parents if you need something.
string: なんならうちの両親と話してみろよ

original: My parents keep a close eye on the miners. They can't be trusted too much.
string: うちの両親はいつも鉱山労働者に目を光らせている。あまり信用できるような連中じゃないんでね

original: I hear there's been fighting in Skyrim. Rebellion, maybe. Wonder if our iron is being used for weapons.
string: スカイリムでは長いこと戦争しているって話だ。反乱かもな。ここの鉄が武器に使われているのかね

original: If you're here about the mine -- it's already got an owner, and she's not selling. If not, then please stay out of my workers' way.
string: 鉱山の件で来たなら、既に所有者がいるし、彼女は売らないよ。別に用がないなら、労働者の邪魔をしないでくれ

original: You get used to the cold after a while. The harder you work, the warmer you stay.
string: しばらくすると寒さには慣れる。一所懸命働けば働くほど、体は温まるからな

original: I spend every waking moment making sure the mine is put to good use.
string: 起きている間は、一秒たりとも無駄にしない。鉱山を有効活用するためにな

original: Bryling owns this mine. I wouldn't have much to live for if she hadn't offered me a job.
string: この鉱山はブライリングが所有してるものだ。彼女が仕事をくれなかったら、生活していけないだろうな

original: My job is my life. Whatever happened before doesn't matter.
string: 仕事が命だ。前に何が起こったかなんて、別に気にしないさ

original: I'm just here to work the mine. Nothing else matters anymore.
string: ここで自分の仕事をするだけ。他の事はもうどうだっていい

original: The outside world means little to us, and we'd like it to stay that way.
string: 私達にとって外の世界はほとんど関係ないの。今のままでいいと思っている

original: When you work hard enough, really get into a rhythm, everything else just fades away.
string: 一生懸命にやってリズムに乗れたら、他の事は色褪せてしまう

original: I'm just trying to make a living. I've no interest in trouble.
string: 暮らしを立てようとしてるだけだ。厄介事に興味はない

original: My business is my own. Why can't others see that?
string: 俺の商売は俺のものだ。なぜ皆、それが分からない？

original: The mine gives us purpose. Something many of us have wished for.
string: 鉱山は俺達に目的を与えてくれる。多くの者が望んでいた事だ

original: Stonehills' warmth is a welcome change in this cold, bleak land.
string: ストーンヒルズの暖かさは、この絶望の大地の寒さを忘れさせてくれる

original: Teeba-Ei the hatchling never imagined working a mine in this cold place. Greater things were dreamt of.
string: 幼いティーバ・エイは、この冷たい大地の鉱山で働かなければならなくなるなんて、夢にも思わなかった。もっと大きな夢を抱いていたのに

original: This is not where Teeba-Ei was meant to live out the rest of his days.
string: ここはティーバ・エイが一生を過ごすべき場所ではない

original: Morthal used to be a quiet place. But then, the world used to make sense.
string: モーサルは以前、静かな場所だった。その頃は、世界もまともだったんだ

original: You ask me, we'd be better off without that wizard in town.
string: あの魔導師が町にいない方がうまくやっていける

original: This isn't the time or place for magic, or whatever it is Falion does.
string: 今ここで必要なのは、魔法やら、ファリオンのやる事じゃない

original: I figure the guards could always use some help, so I keep my eyes open.
string: 衛兵はいつも人手を必要としているはずだ。だから、常に注意しているんだ

original: Been hoping they'd make me a guard, but not yet. Still, I'll help them out if I can.
string: 衛兵になりたいんだが、まだなれていない。でも、できるだけ力になりたい

original: The Jarl does little to protect us these days.
string: 首長は最近我々を守ってくれない

original: A new face! Such a welcome sight in dreary old Morthal. Welcome friend, welcome!
string: 新顔じゃないか！　陰気で古臭いモーサルにとって、なんてうれしい光景なのだ。ようこそ友よ、さあどうぞ

original: Don't fret over the gloom, there's nothing to fear! Old Lurbuk will brighten your spirits -- just lend him your ear!
string: 陰気さを心配するな、恐れる事は何にもない！　老いぼれルーブクがあなたの心に明かりを灯すだろう。ただ耳を傾ければいいだけさ！

original: The good people of Morthal have yet to embrace my talent.
string: モーサルの善良な民はまだ私の才能を受け入れていない

original: Try as you may, they won't say "good day," but will just walk away. Worry not, Morthal! Lurbuk is here to stay!
string: どんなに頑張っても彼らは“ご機嫌よう”なんて言うはずがない。だが、立ち去る事もない。心配するな、モーサル！　これからはルーブクの時代だ！

original: The fair Jonna does me a great courtesy by allowing me to entertain the guests of her noble establishment.
string: 美しいジョナはとても親切で、貴族階級の来客を接待させてくれるんだ

original: I, Lurbuk the Great, will win the hearts of the people of Morthal one day, mark my words!
string: この偉大なるルーブク、いつの日やモーサルの民の心をとらえようぞ。この言葉を胸に刻んでおけ！

original: Welcome to the Moorside. If you need anythin', I'll be 'round. Good to have a customer.
string: ムーアサイドへようこそ。何が用があれば言って下さい。お客様が来るのはうれしいですね

original: There ain't much to offer, but if you wanna place dry to spend the night, I'll rent you a room.
string: 大した物はありませんが、一晩お泊りでしたらお部屋を貸しますよ

original: Runnin' an inn weren't my plan. But Falion decided to move here, so I joined him.
string: 宿屋をやるつもりはなかったのです。でも、ファリオンがここへ住むと決めたので、一緒にやっています

original: Falion had his work to keep him busy, and I needed somethin' to do. So, here I am.
string: ファリオンは仕事で忙しいので、私も何かする事が必要でした。それでここにいるんです

original: I take what little business I can git. I'm grateful for anyone willin' to spend money here.
string: どんな細かい仕事でもやります。ここでお金を使ってくれる人なら、誰でも大歓迎です

original: Ignore the Orc. He pays, so I let him stay.
string: あのオークの事は気にしないで。お金はもらっていますから

original: I've tried to explain to Lurbuk that his "singin'" is gonna get his throat cut.
string: ルーブクには、彼の“歌”がいつか命取りになることを説明しようとしました

original: You'll want to be careful travelin' at night. The marsh is a dangerous place.
string: 夜に出歩くなら気をつけて下さい。沼地は危険ですよ

original: So, life has brought you to Morthal, and to me. What purpose this serves, we will no doubt see. Welcome.
string: モーサル、そして私のところへ来る定めだったんだね。それがどういう意味を持つかは今に分かるさ。よく来たね

original: Tamriel is full of wisdom and magic, if one is willing to look for it. Few have their eyes open.
string: 探す気があれば、タムリエルは知識と魔法の宝庫だ。目を開けている者はほとんどいないけどね

original: Dark times, indeed. I fear the worst for Morthal and my people.
string: まさに暗黒の時代だ。モーサルと私の民に最悪の事態が起こらねばよいが

original: I try and take comfort in knowing that when all is lost, there is much to be gained.
string: すべてを失えば、後は得るのみだと思って慰めにしているんだ

original: It is my hope that I will one day return to Hjaalmarch. But the Divines have not shown this to me.
string: いつかハイヤルマーチに戻りたいと思っているが、神々はそんな未来をお示しにはならない

original: I speak, and others hear. It is my hope that instead they listen.
string: 私が話をすれば、みんなが聞く。でもただ聞くだけでなく、しっかり耳を傾けてほしいんだ

original: In Morthal, there is little to rule. But there is much to teach. And so, I am Jarl.
string: モーサルには、支配すべきものなんか大してない。その代わり教えるべき事がたくさんある。だから、私が首長なのさ

original: All this talk of rebellion and strife. Too many are focused on what might be instead of what is. It tires me to talk about it.
string: こうした反乱や紛争に関する話はどれも、仮定の事柄ばかりで実態を取り上げていない。そういう話をするのはうんざりだ

original: There is too much to learn in the world, too much to know, to fight over "laws" that have no real purpose.
string: 本当は目的などない“法”を巡って戦うには、世の中には学ぶべき事、知るべき事があまりにも多すぎる

original: We're safe here now. But what of Morthal?
string: ここなら安全だ。しかしモーサルはどうした？

original: The Empire brought stability, assurance to the people of Morthal, even if they didn't appreciate it. Now what do they have?
string: 帝国がモーサルに安定と安心をもたらしたんだ。たとえ人々がそのことに感謝していないとしてもね。それが今じゃどうなっている？

original: I fear for what this change will do to my family.
string: この変革が家族にどう影響するのか、それが心配だ

original: If you've business with the Jarl, I'd ask that you speak to me first.
string: 首長と一緒に何かしているのなら、まずはこっちに話を通せ

original: I do what I can to see that Idgrod's time isn't wasted, and that she only has to deal with important matters.
string: イドグロッドの時間を無駄にしないために、俺ができることはする。彼女は重要な問題だけを扱っていればいい

original: Too many bother my wife with their petty problems, and then don't even understand the advice she gives them.
string: あまりに多くの人間が妻を些細な問題で困らせる。そして妻が助言を与えても、全然理解しちゃいないんだ

original: The only thing that matters to me is keeping my wife safe. I won't let anyone harm her.
string: 妻の安全、俺が気にかけているのはそれだけだ。誰にも妻を傷つけさせやしない

original: Morthal doesn't need any trouble. You keep your nose clean, understand?
string: モーサルでは、もめ事はごめんだ。おとなしくしていろよ、いいな？

original: My mind weighs heavy enough. Leave me to my food.
string: これ以上の考え事はいらない。おとなしく食わせてくれ

original: Leave Idgrod and her family alone. They've been through enough.
string: イドグロッドと家族にちょっかいを出すな。十分苦しんだんだ

original: This wasn't what I wanted. Not at all.
string: こんな結果は望んでいなかった

original: All that ever mattered was what was best for Morthal. Leaving it in Ulfric's hands... It's not right.
string: すべてはモーサルのためにやったことだ。ウルフリックの手に渡るとは…　許せない

original: I'm just here to protect the Jarl, not to chat.
string: 首長を助けるためにここにいる。話はいらない

original: Morthal has enough problems without you bothering me.
string: お前がいなくても、モーサルにはもう十分問題があるんだ

original: I'm under a lot of pressure. If you don't leave me alone, I won't be held responsible.
string: 色々と重圧がある。邪魔をされると、責任が果たせない

original: Please don't mind Joric. He's not mad, really he's not.
string: ジョリックのことは気にしないで。怒ってるわけじゃないの。本当よ

original: To be driven from our homes, to be forced here... this is the last thing that Joric needs.
string: 私達は家を追われて、ここに来た…　ジョリックがこんな目に遭う必要なんてないのにね

original: I don't... I haven't mother's gift, not quite, but I've seen things.
string: 私には…　母ほどの才能はないの。けど、見えるものはあるわ

original: Someday I'll be Jarl. Mother reminds me often. I hope I can help the people of Morthal the way she has.
string: いつか首長になるの。母さんにはしょっちゅうそう言われてる。モーサルの人々を母さんみたいに助けられればいいけど

original: It's difficult sometimes... To know whether what I see is real or not.
string: 大変な時もあるわ…　見ているものが現実か否かを区別するのがね

original: I keep hoping this is another vision, that it's not real. But it is, isn't it? We really have lost our home.
string: これが現実ではなく、預言であればと願い続けてるわ。でも現実なんでしょ？　本当に家を失ったのね

original: For now, looking after Joric is my job.
string: 今のところ、ジョリックの面倒を見るのが私の仕事よ

original: You're different, aren't you? Not like anyone else. Not in Morthal, or Skyrim.
string: 普通の人じゃないよね？　他の誰とも違う。モーサルやスカイリムの人でもない

original: I don't understand. Why can't we go home?
string: 分からない。どうして家に帰れないの？

original: I can't sleep here. The dreams are even worse than before.
string: ここじゃ眠れないよ。前よりも悪い夢を見るようになったんだ

original: I get lost sometimes. I'm not sure where I go, but I'm not... I'm not here.
string: 時々道に迷うんだ。どこに行くのかよく分からなくなって、でも、僕はここにいないんだ

original: Gorm thinks I'm mad. He doesn't say it, but I know he thinks it. Is he right?
string: ゴルムは僕がおかしくなったと思ってるんだ。口には出さないけど、僕には分かる。本当にそうなの？

original: My mother sees things. She doesn't know why, but she does. Only sometimes, she doesn't see me at all.
string: 母さんには幻が見えるんだ。理由は分からないらしいけどね。たまに僕のことが全然見えなくなることもある

original: It's Falion. He... He did it. I don't know what it was, but he did it.
string: ファリオンだよ。彼がやったんだ。何かは知らないけど、彼がやったんだよ

original: Keep your wits about you. Morthal's hardly a safe place.
string: 無茶なことはするな。モーサルは危険な場所だ

original: I'm just a poor man trying to make a living. I'd leave Morthal were it in my power.
string: ただ生活費を稼ぎたいだけだ。モーサルが支配下にあればな

original: This damned war has cost us... me... everything.
string: この忌々しい戦争で…　すべてを失った

original: My boy's to grow up without a mother? What life is that? It's not right, I tell you.
string: 息子は母親なしで生きていくんだ。ひどい話だ。信じられない

original: Hasn't been seen for a while. She just vanished without a trace.
string: しばらく見なかった。彼女は消えたんだ。手がかりもない

original: Some say the swamp took her. Part of me wishes it were that simple.
string: 泥沼にのまれたという話もある。それほど単純なら、まだいいんだが

original: Have you seen my mother? I'm still waiting for her to come home.
string: 母さんを見なかった？　まだ、帰ってこないんだ

original: Papa says that I shouldn't keep waiting. Why not? Mama has to come home some time.
string: パパが、いつまでも待っていちゃいけないって言うんだ。どうしてだめなの？　ママはいつか帰ってくるはずだよ

original: Who are the Stormcloaks, and why would mama want to spend time with them instead of me?
string: ストームクロークってどんな人達なの？　どうしてママは僕よりもその人達と一緒にいたいの？

original: I know you for what you are. This town's blood is ours. Leave it! Now we must return to our roles lest the sheep suspect the wolves.
string: ありのままのあなたを知っているわ。この町の血は私達のものよ。出て行って！　羊がオオカミを疑うといけないから、私達は役目に戻らないと

original: Well, aren't you the handsome one. You and I should spend some time together.
string: あら、ハンサムじゃない。私と楽しいひとときを過ごしましょうよ

original: Well, aren't you the pretty one. I bet all the men chase after you.
string: あら、かわいいじゃない。きっと男どもみんなに追いかけられるわよ

original: The people here work so hard, and they never allow themselves a moment of fun. It's such a pity. It won't last forever though.
string: ここの人達は働き者だから、自分達が楽しむことを許せないのよ。悲しいわね。でも永遠に続くわけじゃないから

original: These people are like cattle. All they do is work, sleep and eat.
string: この人達は小さな牛みたいなものよ。働いて、寝て、食べるだけ

original: Gathering plants, picking mushrooms, brewing potions. It all gets so dreary after a while. This town needs something exciting to happen.
string: 植物を採取したり、キノコを採ったり、薬を作ったり。どれもすぐに退屈になるわ。この町でも何か面白いことが起こればいいのに

original: Thank you for saving me from Alva. I was completely under her evil spell. I'll never forgive myself for what happened to Helgi and my wife.
string: アルバから救ってくれて感謝する。完全に彼女の悪しき呪文に取り込まれていたらしい。ヘルギと妻に起こった事について、決して自分を許す事はないだろう

original: I... I'm not one for talk. Try to keep to myself.
string: は…　話すのは苦手なんだ。他人とは関わらないようにしている

original: Alva's been good to me ever since... well, since the fire.
string: アルバはそれ以来よくしてくれた…　あの火事以降に

original: I just try and do my job, and not to think about what's happened. Try to find what happiness I can.
string: 自分は仕事をこなすだけだ。過去の事は考えないようにしている。これからの幸せを見つけるんだ

original: Ignore the talk of spirits and creatures and such. It's just superstition.
string: 霊魂や化け物の話なんてくだらない。ただの迷信だ

original: There's enough real troubles in the world without making new ones up.
string: わざわざ話を作らなくても、現実には問題が十分あふれている

original: You are new to Morthal. We have not spoken before. This is interesting.
string: モーサルでは見かけない顔だな。話した事もない。興味深いな

original: The changes in Morthal are of little consequence to me. So long as the laws are upheld, I do not care who does the upholding.
string: モーサルが変わっても俺には大した事じゃない。法が守られている限りは、誰が維持していようと関心はない

original: My talents are much needed here, in order to keep Morthal... safe.
string: 俺の能力は大いに必要とされてる。モーサルの安全を守るためにな

original: Morthal is a troubled place, and it is my duty to see it rest in peace.
string: モーサルは問題の多い場所でな。それを鎮めるのが俺の役目だ

original: Please remain indoors at night. It is dangerous to go outside.
string: 夜は屋内にいてくれ。外出するのは危険だ

original: Do you like magic? Falion says I'm good at learning. I like learning about magic.
string: 呪文は好き？　ファリオンが、私は覚えるのがうまいって言うの。呪文を覚えるのが好きなんだ

original: My mother and father died years ago. Falion takes care of me now.
string: お母さんとお父さんは何年も前に死んだわ。今はファリオンが面倒を見てくれているの

original: I asked Falion if someday I could learn from the mages in Winterhold, but he doesn't like that idea.
string: いつか、ウィンターホールドの魔術師から習えるかしらってファリオンに聞いたんだけど、反対されちゃった
