string: ハチミツ酒醸造所と関係があるのか？

original: Yes, actually. I'm partnered with Maven Black-Briar. I put up a chunk of the gold she needed to get the place off the ground.
string: ああ、そうだ。メイビン・ブラック・ブライアと提携している。彼女がこの場所を立ち上げるのに必要としていた資金を融通したんだ

original: We've been staggeringly successful so far. In fact, I'm almost surprised how quickly she's generated business for us.
string: 今のところは、よろめきながらもうまくいってる。実際、彼女がこんなに早く事業を生み出してくれた事に驚いてるよ

original: My name may not be on the label, but some of my blood, sweat and tears are in every drop. Uh, figuratively of course.
string: 名前こそラベルにないが、自分の血や汗、それに涙が一滴一滴に込められている。もちろん、ただの比喩だけどな

original: Are you at odds with them?
string: 両親と不仲なのか？

original: Don't mistake my political beliefs as a substitute for my family values. They're still my parents, and I love them dearly.
string: 政治的信念と家庭の価値をごちゃ混ぜにして考えないでくれ。両親には変わりない、とても愛している

original: I just think they've let my sister's death skew their outlook on Ulfric and what he really brings to the table with this war.
string: 両親は妹の死をきっかけに、ウルフリックと奴の戦争に対する考えに関する見方を歪めてしまったのだろう

original: I'm not so certain that Ulfric's intentions are as noble as they think. I think Ulfric cares about Ulfric and the rest is a smokescreen.
string: ウルフリックの意図する所が、両親の考えるほど高貴なものか疑わしい。ウルフリックは自分のことしか考えておらず、その他は見せかけにすぎないのではないだろうか？

original: I'd... appreciate if you kept my opinion between us. The last thing I want to do is have my parents "lose" another child.
string: 今の話は…　ここだけの秘密にしてもらえるとありがたい。両親がさらに子供を“失う”のだけは避けたいからな

original: Can you tell me about the wedding ring?
string: 結婚指輪について教えてほしい

original: Every Argonian wedding proposal band is supposed to have three flawless amethysts as part of their design.
string: 結婚を申し込む際、アルゴニアンの指輪にはキズの無いアメジストが3つ飾られてなきゃいけないんだ

original: Two of the gems, the ones on the outside, represent the couple to be married... one for the husband, one for the wife.
string: そのうちの2つは、指輪に左右対称に配置される。これは結婚する男女…　つまり夫と妻を象徴している

original: The amethyst in the center represents The Hist, the entity that all Argonians consider a sacred part of our lives.
string: 中央のアメジストは、すべてのアルゴニアンが尊い命の一部と考える存在、ヒストの木を象徴している

original: I... I... I don't know what to say. Such kindness is unheard of in these times.
string: な…　なん…　何とお礼を言っていいのか。今の時代に、こんな自己犠牲の精神をもった人がいるなんてな

original: Here. I want you to accept this as payment for your sacrifice and I... well, we both thank you.
string: ほら、お礼にこれを受け取ってほしい。それと…　その、2人とも本当に感謝しているよ

original: I've found those amethysts for you.
string: アメジストを持ってきた

original: I have them right here.
string: ここに持ってきた

original: Can't help you there.
string: 力にはなれない

original: I understand. Hopefully I'll be able to save my meager earnings up to buy them one day.
string: 気にしないでくれ。わずかな収入を貯めていけば、いつか買える日が来るだろうから

original: I could find those for you.
string: それを見つけてきてやろう

original: I was hoping you'd offer. I didn't think it was my place to ask such a favor of you. I thank you.
string: そう言ってくれるのを期待してたよ。こっちからお願いできる立場ではないからね。ありがとう

original: You mentioned you served special drinks?
string: 特別な飲み物を出していると言ったか？

original: Three in fact. They're my own recipe. Brought them over here from my days as a bartender in Gideon.
string: 実は、3つある。すべてオリジナルレシピだ。ギデオンでバーテンダーをやってた頃に考え出したものだ

original: First is the "Velvet Lechance" which is a mixture of blackberry, honey, spiced wine and a touch of nightshade... perfectly safe, I assure you.
string: まず最初は、“ベルベット・レカンス”。ブラックベリーと蜂蜜を加えて、スパイス入りワインと少量のベラドンナを効かせた一品だ…　大丈夫、飲んでも平気だよ

original: Second, we have the "White-Gold Tower" which is heavy cream with a layer of blended mead, lavender and dragon's tongue on top.
string: 2品目は、“ホワイトゴールド・タワー”。ブレンドしたハチミツ酒に濃厚なクリームをフロートして、ラベンダーとリュウノシタを添えた一品だ

original: Last, and only for the bravest of souls, we have the "Cliff Racer" which is Firebrand Wine, Cyrodiilic Brandy, Flin and Sujamma.
string: 最後は勇者のための一杯、“クリフ・レーサー”だ。ファイアブランド・ワインとサイロディーリック・ブランデー、そしてフリンとスジャンマを合わせた一品だ

original: I need you to cause a scene. Get everyone's attention for a few minutes.
string: 騒ぎを起こす必要がある。何分間か、皆の注意を引いておきたい

original: Is that all? My friend, you've come to the right person. You could say that causing a scene is somewhat of a specialty of mine.
string: それだけか？　ぴったりの相手に頼んだようだな。騒動を起こすのは得意なんだ

original: Stand back and behold my handiwork.
string: 後ろからしっかり見ててくれよ

original: Actually, there is something you could do for me.
string: 実は、やってもらいたい事がある

original: Wonderful! I can begin to repay your generosity immediately. Say on, friend.
string: いいとも！　その寛大さに報いる時だな。さあ、言ってくれ

original: Thanks. I'll let you know if I need anything.
string: 助かるよ。頼みたい事ができたら声をかけよう

original: Your wish is my command! As long as it doesn't involve much physical activity. I seem to be having trouble staying on my feet at the moment.
string: 何でも言ってくれよ！　体を使うこと以外なら、何でもいい。今は、立ってるのさえ辛いんだ

original: What is this madness? Rexus, help me!
string: イカれでもしたのか？　レクサス、助けろ！

original: Wait! That's not how this is supposed to work!
string: 待って！　なんでこうなっちゃうの！

original: What are you doing? I thought we were friends!
string: 何するの？　友達だと思ってたのに

original: You can't be serious.
string: 冗談だろう

original: What do you expect to find? My juggling balls? He he.
string: 何を探してるんだい？　私のお手玉とか？　ここにもうふたつあるよ、イヒヒ

original: Hey, that's my lint! Ha, Cicero is just joking. You can have it.
string: あ、それは私のあそこの毛だよ！　はは、シセロの冗談だ。それはあげるよ

original: If I had anything worth giving, I'd have offered it already.
string: もし私に何かあげられる物があれば、とっくに渡してるよ

original: Anything good in there?
string: 良い物は有ったかい？

original: See if they have any cheese. I'm getting a bit... peckish.
string: チーズを持ってるか見てくれないか。ちょっと…　小腹が空いたのだ

original: You're putting your hand... in my pocket? Have you gone complete cracked?
string: 俺のポケットに手を入れたな？　頭が完全にイカれちまったのか？

original: I've hardly anything worth pickpocketing...
string: スリをするほど価値のある物は何もないぞ…

original: This how you get your thrills? Feeling up an old man?
string: こんな事が楽しいのか？　老人に痴漢を働くのが？

original: I haven't been touched like that since I visited a certain brothel in the city of Sentinel...
string: そんな風に触られたのは、センチネルでその手の店を訪れて以来だな…

original: It would seem you're not the accomplished pickpocket you think you are...
string: プロのスリのつもりなんでしょうけど、素人にしか見えないわ…

original: What do you hope to find? Sweets and my dolly? Or maybe some of my spare Nightshade?
string: 何を探しているの？　お菓子とお人形？　それともうちで余ってるベラドンナかしら？

original: You're not actually... picking my pocket? Well, you've got guts. I'll give you that.
string: まさか…　私にスリを働こうとしているの？　いい度胸ね。それはあげるわ

original: It's... it's like watching an artist create a masterpiece.
string: まるで…　まるで芸術家が渾身の一作を創っているのを見ているようだ

original: And another soul for Sithis.
string: そしてシシスのための魂がもう一つ

original: You are an inspiration. Do you know that?
string: お前は理想像そのものだよ。知ってたかい？

original: Oooh. Time to kill?
string: おお。殺しの時間かな？

original: Finally!
string: やっとだ！

original: Ooh. That had to hurt.
string: おお、今のは痛そうだ

original: What? Why would the stranger attack innocent Cicero?
string: え？　何で見ず知らずの他人が罪なきシセロを襲うんだ？

original: Ow! What did I do?
string: いて！　私が何をしたっていうんだ？

original: What have I done, Listener? Has Cicero offended you?
string: 私が何をしたんだ、聞こえし者？　シセロは君を怒らせたのかい？

original: By Sithis, you will pay for that!
string: シシスの名において、これは高くつくわよ！

original: Why you insolent little bastard...
string: なぜお前のような無礼な奴が…

original: Is that... the best... you can do...
string: それで…　全力か…　大した事ないな…

original: Ow... It hurts when I laugh. He he...
string: いてて…　笑うと痛いや。へへ…

original: Have you... gone... completely... mad?
string: 一体…　どうしてしまった…　の…

original: This... this is... an outrage...
string: な…　なんという…　侮辱だ…

original: It will... take more than that... to stop me...
string: そ…　その程度では…　私は止められんぞ…

original: Ooh. What a fun trick. Teach me, teach me!
string: わお、面白い手品だね。教えて、教えてくれよ！

original: For someone called the "Listener," you do an awful lot of shouting...
string: ここだけの話、“聞こえし者”と呼ばれる割には、ずいぶんと叫んで回ってるよね…

original: That's my boy.
string: 俺の息子だ

original: I hate them.
string: あいつら嫌いだ

original: Because they don't care about you or I, cub. They think they're better than all of us, and that we can just be thrown away.
string: あいつらにとったら、お前や俺なんてどうでもいいからさ。自分達の方が優れていて、俺達なんて投げ捨てればいいと思ってる

original: Why did they do that? Why would they be so evil?
string: どうしてそんなことをしたの？　どうしたらそんなに悪くなれるの？

original: Eirid's a little girl who doesn't understand that they're responsible for destroying our home.
string: エイリッドはまだ小さいから、あいつらが俺達の家を破壊したことなんて理解はしていない

original: Eirid says the mages at the College are nice people, but you said they're bad.
string: エイリッドは大学の魔術師が良い人達だって言うんだけど、違うって言ったよね？

original: And it's clear money matters more to Dagur than honor.
string: それに、ダグールにとっては、名誉よりも金が大事なのは明らかだ

original: It's clear that memories are far too short.
string: すぐに忘れてしまうのは、明白ね

original: This is what it's come to. No one seems to care what they've done to our home.
string: これがその結果さ。俺達の家にあいつらが何をしたかなんて、誰も気にしていないようだ

original: That... wizard is still at the Inn. I can't believe Dagur allows him to stay there.
string: あのウィザードがまだ宿屋にいる。ダグールがあいつを泊らせているなんて信じられない

original: I'm sure you're right.
string: あなたは正しいわ

original: Not like this. Feels colder than usual. Bet it's those damned Mages.
string: こんな感じではない。いつもより寒く感じる。きっと忌々しい魔術師達の仕業だ

original: Aren't they all?
string: これで全部じゃないの？

original: Looks to be another cold day.
string: また今日も寒くなりそうだな

original: What is this place?
string: どんな場所なんだ？

original: Who is Mirabelle Ervine?
string: ミラベル・アーヴィンとは誰だ

original: She's the Master-Wizard here. Arch-Mage Aren may be in charge, but Mirabelle runs the place.
string: ここのマスターウィザードですよ。アークメイジのアレンが責任者ですが、実際に運営しているのはミラベルです

original: You'd do well to remember that.
string: 覚えておいた方が良いだろうな

original: Please, enjoy yourself!
string: どうか楽しんでね

original: DB05PlayerWhoIsTargetTopic1
string: DB05PlayerWhoIsTargetTopic1

original: Her name is Vittoria Vici. She oversees the East Empire Company's business holdings in Solitude.
string: ヴィットリア・ヴィキよ。東帝都社の事業をソリチュードで監督してる

original: The wedding is being held in that city, at the Temple of the Divines. Her death will cause an uproar, which is exactly what we want.
string: 結婚式はその街で催される予定よ、神々の聖堂でね。彼女の死は大混乱を招くでしょう。それこそこちらの狙いよ

original: Vici is likely to address her guests frequently, as is the wedding custom. Kill her when she does that, and I promise you a significant bonus.
string: ヴィキは招待客とひんぱんに話をするはずよ、結婚式の慣習に従ってね。その時が殺すチャンスよ。礼はたっぷりはずむわ、約束する

original: Now go. And give my best to the bride.
string: さあ、行きなさい。花嫁によろしく

original: Who's the target?
string: 目標は誰なんだ？

original: (Remain silent)
string: (黙っている)

original: Yes, the blushing bride now serves Sithis in the Void.
string: ああ、恥らう花嫁は虚無にてシシスに仕えている

original: Yes, the blushing bride now serves Sithis in the Void.
string: ああ、恥らう花嫁は虚無にてシシスに仕えている

original: Yes, the blushing bride now serves Sithis in the Void.
string: ああ、恥らう花嫁は虚無にてシシスに仕えている

original: DB05AstridBrideDeadResponse1
string: DB05AstridBrideDeadResponse1

original: She bled like a stuck pig.
string: 肥えた豚のように血を流した

original: She bled like a stuck pig.
string: 肥えた豚のように血を流した

original: Ha ha! The news is everywhere! Vittoria Vici, the Emperor's cousin, butchered at her own wedding! Well done!
string: ははは！　どこもこの話題で持ちきりよ！　皇帝の従姉妹、ヴィットリア・ヴィキが結婚式で殺されたってね。よくやったわ！

original: Let's see his eminence try to ignore this.
string: 彼らがこの事態をどう収束させるか、見ものだわ

original: (Remain silent)
string: (黙っている)

original: Oh, no need to be shy! My day is your day! Please - eat, drink, make merry! We're all friends here!
string: 恥ずかしがらないで。喜びは分かち合いましょうよ。ご自由に食べて、飲んで、楽しんでね！　みんな友達よ！

original: Ha ha ha ha! Yes, yes indeed! Hail the Imperial Legion! Hail the Stormcloaks! Hail Solitude and the Eight Divines!
string: あはは！　ええ、帝国軍ばんざい！　ストームクロークばんざい！　ソリチュードと八大神ばんざい！

original: On this glorious day, we honor everyone! Ha ha ha ha!
string: この輝かしき日に、皆さんの栄誉を称えます！　あはは！

original: Hail the Imperial Legion!
string: 帝国軍ばんざい！

original: Oh! Well, you tell your Stormcloak friends "hello" right back at them! This is a day of healing! Legion, Stormcloaks - all are welcome here!
string: まあ！　ストームクロークのお友達に“いらっしゃい”ってすぐに伝えて。今日はすばらしい日だわ。帝国軍もストームクロークの人も、みんな歓迎よ！

original: The Stormcloaks say hello!
string: ストームクロークです。こんにちは！

original: What an amazing day this has been. I hope you're enjoying the festivities. I'm... I'm just so overwhelmed. Such kindness... for me.
string: すばらしい一日だったわ。楽しんでいただけたかしら。胸が一杯なの…　私のためにこんなによくしてくれて…

original: Oh, Asgeir! My husband! My dear, sweet husband! Why would someone do this to you? Why? This was supposed to be the happiest day of my life!
string: ああ、アスゲールよ！　私の夫が！　私の夫が！　一体誰がこんなことを？　どうして？　人生で一番幸せでなくちゃいけない日なのに！

original: Please, enjoy the festivities! This is a day of peace and happiness, when Imperials and Stormcloaks join together, as equals!
string: お祭りを楽しんでね！　平和と幸せをお祝いしましょう。帝国軍とストームクロークが対等の立場で団結したの！

original: My wife is dead! Dead!
string: 妻が死んだ。死んでしまった！

original: Now now, fella. Let's not get too close to my new bride, eh?
string: さあさあ、みんな。新婦にあまり近づかないでくれ

original: Well aren't you a pretty thing? Should my new bride by worried? He he he he.
string: いや実に美しい！　新妻が穏やかでないかもな。へへへ

original: Make sure to get yourself something to drink.
string: 何か飲み物をもらうといい

original: You hungry? There's plenty of food. Eat up, now.
string: 空腹か？　食い物はたっぷりある。今のうちに食っとけ

original: What's going on? Why would somebody do that?
string: どうなっているの？　一体どうして、誰がこんなことをするの？

original: This wedding is boring. I wish they had jugglers.
string: この結婚式はたいくつだなあ。手品師でも呼べばいいのに

original: When my aunt got married, they had a cake that was three feet tall. I got really sick that day.
string: おばさんが結婚したとき、背よりも高いケーキを食べたんだ。あの日は本当に具合が悪くなったよ

original: I heard Vittoria Vici is the Emperor's cousin. I wish he came to the wedding. I never saw a real live Emperor before.
string: ヴィットリア・ヴィキは皇帝のいとこだって聞いたよ。結婚式に来てくれるといいなあ。まだ皇帝を生で見たことないんだ

original: By the gods, the blood! The blood!
string: ああ神様、血よ！　血だわ！

original: Vittoria did pretty well for herself, marrying that Asgeir. Not a bad looking fellow at all.
string: ヴィットリアは上手くやったわ、あのアスゲールという人と結婚して。結構ハンサムな人よね

original: I love weddings, don't you?
string: 結婚式は好きよ、みんなそうでしょ？

original: I just can't wait to be a bride someday. Someday...
string: いつか花嫁になる日が待ち遠しいわ。いつか…

original: I didn't do it! You saw! I didn't do it!
string: やってない！　見てただろ！　やってないよ！

original: Long as I stay out of the way, the guards don't seem to care about me being here.
string: 邪魔をしなけりゃ、衛兵は俺がここにいても気にしないみたいだ

original: I've eaten more in the last two hours than I have in the last two weeks.
string: この2時間で、2週間分以上はたべた

original: If I'm really lucky, I'll get to kiss the bride for good luck.
string: 運が良ければ、花嫁に幸運のキスを贈るチャンスがあるかもな

original: The Emperor's cousin is dead! This is a disaster!
string: 皇帝のいとこが死んだわ！　何て事でしょう！

original: By all the gods, the groom has been killed. At his own wedding! I can only think of my own husband...
string: なんてことなの…　結婚式で花婿が殺されるなんて！　夫のことを考えずにはいられないわ…

original: A marriage of both love and political advantage. A rare thing indeed.
string: 愛情と政治的利点の両方を満たす結婚。そんなのは稀ね

original: Oh, no no no... This is so wrong...
string: そ、そんな…　こんなのイカれてる

original: I'm so glad Vittoria and Asgeir chose a public reception. That way the entire city can share in their holy bond.
string: ヴィットリアとアスゲールが公共の披露宴を選んでくれて嬉しいよ。この方法だと、街の全員が2人の神聖な結婚を分かち合えるからな

original: Oh, did you miss the ceremony? It was rather quick, actually. The couple seemed more concerned with their reception.
string: 婚礼には出なかったのか？　実際、すぐ終わったよ。2人は披露宴が気がかりのようだったな

original: I just came to sing! This is a horror show!
string: 歌いに来ただけなのに。なんて怖ろしい！

original: If you want my opinion, I think they should have paid for an entire quartet. Plenty of bards at the College would have loved the opportunity.
string: 個人的な意見だけど、彼らは4人全員に報酬を出すべきだったわね。それだったら、大学の吟遊詩人達も喜んだでしょうに

original: Ahem. Mi mi mi mi. Pardon me. Just, um, warming up. Never know when I may be called upon for a ballad.
string: えへん。ミ、ミ、ミ、ミ。失礼。ちょっと、その、ウォーミングアップなんです。まさかバラードをリクエストされるとは思わなくて

original: My daughter! Dead! Noooooo!
string: 娘が死んだって？　そんな！

original: My nephew, the Emperor. Too busy to attend the wedding of his beloved cousin. We won't stand for this slight, I assure you.
string: 皇帝であるおいっ子は多忙を理由に、大事ないとこの結婚式にも出席しない。こんな侮辱はどうにも我慢ならないよ

original: What my daughter sees in that... barbarian, I'll never know.
string: 娘はあの…　蛮族のどこがいいんだか、全く分からないね

original: The thought of paying a dowry to that, that... Stormcloak turns my stomach.
string: 持参金をあの、あの…　ストームクロークに払わなきゃと思うと吐き気がするよ

original: It was the Empire killed her! I know it! They killed her so they can blame it on the Stormcloaks!
string: 彼女を殺したのは帝国だ！　ストームクロークに責任を押しつけられるようにな！

original: My son is dead! At his own wedding! Only those Imperial dogs would have dared do something like this! Damn them all to Oblivion!
string: 息子が死んだ！　あろうことか自分の結婚式で！　こんなことをするのは帝国にちがいない！　奴らをオブリビオンに放り込んでやる！

original: I still think my boy should have had a traditional Nord wedding. Outside, in the cool mountain air.
string: 伝統的なノルドの結婚式にすべきだったと、今でも思うよ。屋外で、冷たい山の空気の中でね

original: They say this marriage is the first step towards peace. Who in Shor's name wants peace? Pfft.
string: この結婚は、平和への第一歩だと聞いた。ショールの名において、平和を望む者は誰だ？　パッ

original: My boy, he always did have an eye for the pretty ones. That Vittoria ain't bad, for an Imperial.
string: あいつはいつも、可愛い子を追っかけていた。そのヴィットリアは、インペリアルにしては悪くない

original: By Ysmir, this is horrible! I never wanted the girl dead, I swear!
string: そんな、なんて事を！　あの子を死なせようなんて思ってなかった、本当よ！

original: Vittoria may be pretty, but does she have the right hips for the job? I want grandchildren, and lots of them.
string: ヴィットリアは美人かも知れないけど、ちゃんと役目を果たせる腰かしら。たくさん孫がほしいのよ

original: To think, my little boy is married. And to an Imperial. Oh, they grow up so fast.
string: 私のかわいい坊やが結婚よ。しかも帝国人と。本当に成長が早いわね

original: If my Asgeir is happy, then I'm happy. Really.
string: 私のアスゲールが幸せなら私も幸せ。本当よ

original: I never should have taken this job!
string: こんな仕事、引き受けるんじゃなかった！

original: Sorry, no time to talk. I need to keep playing.
string: すまんが、話してる時間はない。続けなきゃならないんだ

original: Let's see what Esbern has to say.
string: エズバーンの意見を聞きましょう

original: Amazing, eh? To be standing at the very entrance to Sky Haven Temple itself!
string: すごい事だと思わないか？　スカイ・ヘヴン聖堂の入り口に立っているのだぞ！

original: We must be getting close. We should proceed cautiously.
string: だいぶ近くまで来たはずだ。慎重に進もう

original: Are you sure this is the right way?
string: 本当にこっちの道で大丈夫か？

original: I've told you where Sky Haven Temple is. I'll trust you to get us there in one piece.
string: スカイ・ヘヴン聖堂の場所については教えたはずだ。そこまで無事に連れて行ってくれると信じているぞ

original: I must speak to Delphine at once. There's no time to lose.
string: すぐにデルフィンと話す必要がある。猶予はないんだ

original: So this is where Delphine has been hiding all these years? Hmm.
string: それで、ここがデルフィンの今までずっと隠れていた場所か？　ふーむ

original: Are we close? Thalmor spies could be anywhere.
string: もうすぐか？　サルモールの密偵がどこから現れてもおかしくないからな

original: I don't like being out in the open like this.
string: こんなふうに開けた場所にいるのは居心地が悪い

original: Did you hear that?
string: 聞こえたか？

original: Well, I guess that's good enough... let's be off...
string: まあ、これで大丈夫だろう…　さあ出発しようか…

original: One moment, I know, time is of the essence, but mustn't leave secrets for the Thalmor... there's one more I must bring...
string: 少しだけだから。時間が大切なのは分かっている。でも、サルモールに関する秘密をそこら辺に置いておくわけには…　あともうひとつ持っていくものが…

original: I'll need this... No, no, useless trash... where'd I put my annotated Anuad?
string: これは必要…　いや、違う、これはゴミだ…　注釈付きのアヌの記はどこに置いたかな？

original: Alduin's Wall was where the ancient Blades recorded all they knew of Alduin and his return. Part history, part prophecy.
string: アルドゥインの壁は、古代のブレイズがアルドゥインとその復活について知っている事すべてを記録した場所だ。一部は歴史的事実、また一部は預言となっている

original: Its location has been lost for centuries, but I've found it again. Not lost, you see, just forgotten.
string: その場所は長い間失われていたのだが、私は再び発見したのだ。失われていたのではない、ただ忘れ去られていただけだった

original: The Blades archives held so many secrets... I was only able to save a few scraps...
string: ブレイズの書庫には数々の秘密が保管されていた…　そのいくつかの抜粋だけ残しておく事ができた

original: Sky Haven Temple. An ancient Blades sanctuary, hidden deep in the crags of the Reach. That's where we'll find Alduin's Wall.
string: スカイ・ヘヴン聖堂、リーチの岩山の奥深くに隠された古代のブレイズの聖域だ。アルドゥインの壁はそこにある

original: Alduin's Wall... one of the lost secrets of the Blades. Where they recorded all they knew of Alduin and his return. Part history, part prophecy.
string: アルドゥインの壁はブレイズの失われた栄光のひとつだ。彼らそこにアルドゥインとその復活について知っている事すべてを記録した。一部は歴史的事実で、一部は預言だ

original: Its location has been lost for centuries, but I've found it again.
string: その場所は何世紀もの間失われていたが、私は再び発見した

original: Not lost, you see, just forgotten. The Blades archives held so many secrets... I was only able to save a few scraps...
string: 失われていたのではない、ただ忘れ去られていたのだ。ブレイズの書庫には数々の秘密が保管されていた…　そのいくつかの抜粋だけは守る事ができた

original: Right. Good thing they've already let you into their little cult. Not likely they'd help Esbern or me if we came calling.
string: そうね。彼らがあなたを仲間に招き入れてくれてよかったわ。エズバーンや私なら、いくら頼んでも助けてくれはしないでしょうから

original: We'll look around Sky Haven Temple and see what else the old Blades might have left for us. It's a better hideout than I could have hoped for.
string: スカイ・ヘヴン聖堂を見てくるわ。ブレイズの先達たちが私達に残したものを見ておきたいの。思っていたよりもいいアジトだわ

original: Talos guard you.
string: タロスがあなたをお守り下さいますように

original: This looks promising. Akaviri stonework, I think. Reminds me a bit of Cloud Ruler Temple.
string: 期待できそうね。これは多分アカヴィリの石細工ね。曇王の神殿を連想させるわね

original: I think we're getting close. Let's keep moving.
string: 近くまで来てるわ。先を急ぎましょう

original: Lead on to Sky Haven Temple.
string: スカイ・ヘヴン聖堂へと続いてる

original: We'll meet up near Karthspire.
string: カーススパイアーの近くで会うことになってるわ

original: Let's keep moving.
string: 先を急ぐぞ

original: Let's get this door open and see what we've got.
string: この扉を開けて、中に何があるのか見てみましょう

original: Alduin isn't getting any weaker while we stand around here gawping at the architecture.
string: ここに突っ立って建物を眺めていても、アルドゥインを倒せないわ

original: Let's pretend we haven't. What's Alduin's Wall and what does it have to do with stopping the dragons?
string: していないって事にしましょう。アルドゥインの壁って？　それがドラゴンを阻止することとどういう関係が？

original: Either of you?
string: 二人のどちらかが？

original: You mean... you don't mean to say you haven't heard of Alduin's Wall?
string: つまり…　アルドゥインの壁の事を知っているというのか？

original: Esbern. What are you getting at?
string: エズバーン、何がいいたいの？

original: A wise and foresighted policy, in the event.
string: 思慮深く先見の明のあるやり方だった

original: Despite the far-reaching fame of Alduin's Wall at the time - one of the wonders of the ancient world - its location was lost.
string: アルドゥインの壁の名声は当時広く広まったにもかかわらず、古代の世界の不思議のひとつであるその場所は見つからなかった

original: Shh!
string: 静かに！

original: This is where they built Alduin's Wall, to set down in stone all their accumulated dragonlore.
string: 彼らは集めたドラゴンの伝説を石に刻むためにアルドゥインの壁を建てた。それがここだ

original: A hedge against the forgetfulness of centuries.
string: 数世紀にわたる忘却との境界だ

original: Do you know what he's talking about?
string: 彼の話が分かるの？

original: You see, right here. Sky Haven Temple, constructed around one of the main Akaviri military camps in the Reach, during their conquest of Skyrim.
string: ここを見てごらん、アカヴィリのスカイ・ヘヴン聖堂だ。リーチにあるアカヴィリの主要野営地のひとつを囲むように建てられている。スカイリム征服の間にな

original: Ah! Here it is. Come, let me show you.
string: ああ！　ここだ。おいで、説明してあげよう

original: Esbern, what...
string: エズバーン、それは…

original: Give me... just a moment...
string: 少し時間をくれないか…

original: This changes everything, of course. There's no time to lose. We must locate...  let me show you. I know I had it here, somewhere...
string: もちろん、この事はすべてを変えてしまう。猶予はない。場所を特定しないと…　見せてあげよう。ここに持ってきている、どこにしまったかな…

original: Oh yes! Dragonborn! Indeed, yes.
string: ああ、そうだ！　ドラゴンボーンだ！　まさにそのとおりだ

original: Now then. I assume you know about...
string: それじゃ、あなたも知っているわよね…

original: This way.
string: こっちだ

original: Yeah, sure.
string: ああ

original: Orgnar, hold down the bar for a minute, will you?
string: オーグナー、少しの間バーを頼むわ

original: Well, then. You made it, safe and sound. Good. Come on, I have a place we can talk.
string: よかったわ、無事で。それじゃこっちへ。話せる場所があるわ

original: It's good to see you, too, Esbern. It's been too long, old friend. Too long.
string: 私もあなたに会えてうれしいわ、エズバーン。しばらくね。本当にしばらく

original: Delphine! I... it's good to see you. It's been... a long time.
string: デルフィン！　私は…　会えてうれしいよ。ずいぶん…　久しぶりだな

original: Isn't it amazing?
string: すごい事だと思わないか？

original: Just think. We're the first to set foot here in thousands of years.
string: 考えてみろ。我々が何千年ぶりに足を踏み入れるのだ

original: I can't wait to see what's inside!
string: 中を見るのが待ち切れない

original: Patience. Give me a moment and I'll explain everything.
string: まあ焦らずに。少し時間をくれるなら、すべてを教えよう

original: Then we have to stop him.
string: では、奴を止めないと

original: Agreed. He's taken everything the Guild has left, and to go after one of the last greatest heists is just an insult.
string: 同感だ。ギルドに残っていた物をすべて盗まれ、しかも最後に空前絶後の強奪をしていかれたとあっては、屈辱以外の何物でもないからな

original: I've spoken to Karliah, and made amends for how the Guild's treated her. Now she wishes to speak with both of us.
string: 俺はカーリアと話をして、彼女に対するギルドの扱いへの補償をした。今度は俺達二人に話したいそうだ

original: Quickly, we have no time to lose.
string: 早く行こう、時間が惜しい

original: He wasn't there, but I found these plans.
string: 奴はいなかったが、この計画書を見つけた

original: Shor's beard! He's going after the Eyes of the Falmer? That was Gallus's pet project.
string: ショールの髭にかけて！　ファルメルの目を追っているっていうのか？　あれはガルス秘蔵の計画だったんだ

original: If he gets his hands on them, you can be certain he'll be gone for good and set up for life.
string: もし奴があれを手に入れたら、それこそ完全に姿を消して生涯を安泰に過ごしていく事になっちまう

original: We've scoured the town and I've spoken to every contact we have left. No sign of Mercer.
string: 町中を捜し回って、我々に残っている情報源にも当たってみたが、メルセルの気配はない

original: Any luck on your end?
string: そっちはどうだ？

original: What's missing from the vault?
string: 金庫から何がなくなったんだ？

original: Better question would be "what did he leave."
string: むしろ“何を置いていったか”と聞くべきだろうな

original: Mercer took everything. Even all of our plans are gone.
string: メルセルの奴、何もかも持っていきやがったんだ。計画書もすべてな

original: Stabbed in the back. It's like the Dark Brotherhood all over again.
string: 驚かすなよ。闇の一党がまたそこら中にいるかのようだな

original: Can't talk long, got to keep my eyes open for Mercer.
string: 手短に頼む。メルセルに目を光らせないといけない

original: Hold your thoughts 'til after we untangle this mess.
string: ゴタゴタが解決するまで少し待ってくれ

original: If I see Frey, I'll pluck his eyes from his skull with my bare hands!
string: 今度フレイを見かけたら、この手で目ン玉ほじくり出してやる！

original: Need to stay focused in case Frey comes back, make it fast.
string: フレイが戻ってきた時に備えて気を散らしたくない。手短に頼むよ

original: We can talk after I find out what's going on.
string: 状況がはっきりしてから話をしようか

original: I'm relieved Brynjolf has an open mind or that could have gotten bloody.
string: ブリニョルフが話の分かる男でよかったわ。でなければ血を見る羽目になっていた

original: How can I help?
string: 何の用かしら？

original: The time for talk has passed. We must hurry.
string: おしゃべりは終わりよ。先を急がないと

original: Quickly, what is it?
string: 早くして、何なのよ？

original: I can't believe this is happening, lad.
string: こんな事になるなんて信じられんよ、小僧

original: I can't believe this is happening, lass.
string: こんな事になるなんて信じられんよ、小娘

original: Just take a step back and let me figure this out. Then we'll talk.
string: まずは一歩下がって、俺に考えさせてくれ。それから話そう

original: Can't talk.... I'm outta' here.
string: 話してる暇は…　ここから逃げないと

original: This is Mercer Frey's place and he don't like visitors. Now go away.
string: ここはメルセル・フレイの邸宅だ。彼は訪問者を好まない。すぐに立ち去れ

original: I dare Mercer to come back here! He sets one foot in the cistern and I'll cut it off!
string: メルセルが戻ってくるのは許さないわよ！　あいつが貯水池に片足でも踏み入れたら、足を切り落としてやる！

original: Look at that dark elf whore... strutting around like she's innocent. I'll cut her open from gullet to groin!
string: あのダークエルフの商売女を見てよ…　うぶなフリして、気取って歩いてる。上の穴から下の穴まで切り裂いてやる！

original: I never saw this coming, I thought we were just having a run of bad luck.
string: まさかこんな事になるとはな。ちょっと不運が続いただけだと思っていた

original: So it's true. You've turned traitor. I can't believe it.
string: 本当なんだな。裏切ったのか。信じられない

original: I hope he turns up soon... he needs to answer for his betrayal.
string: すぐに現れるといいが…　この裏切りの説明をしてもらわなきゃな

original: I won't rest until Mercer's dead. How could he murder Gallus and betray all of us like that?
string: メルセルが死ぬまで安心できない。ガルスを殺して、俺達全員を裏切るなんて真似がどうしてできるんだ？

original: If you don't have a good reason to be partnered with Karliah, you're dead.
string: カーリアの相棒に選ばれるとはよほどの理由があるんだろうな。さもなければ死ぬ事になるぞ

original: How can Karliah remain so calm when Mercer had her on the run for that long? Amazing.
string: メルセルに長らく逃亡生活に追いやられたってのに、どうしてカーリアはあんなに落ち着いていられるんだ？　感心するよ

original: They say that Karliah murdered Gallus, but I'm not so sure.
string: カーリアがガルスを殺したって噂だが、本当とは思えない

original: If I find Mercer first, I'm going to crush his skull with my bare hands!
string: メルセルを先に見つけたら、素手で頭を粉々にしてやる！

original: They're waiting for you in the cistern. No tricks.
string: 連中は貯水池で待っている。小細工は抜きだ

original: Punishment's too good for Mercer Frey. The only penalty for his betrayal is death.
string: メルセル・フレイには懲罰では手ぬるい。奴の裏切りに値するのは死のみだ

original: Vex is ready to tear you apart. I hope you have a good excuse for bringing Karliah here.
string: ヴェックスがお前を八つ裂きにしようと手ぐすね引いてるぞ。カーリアを連れてくる言い訳はちゃんと考えてあるんだろうな

original: There's no doubt Mercer will make for the borders of Skyrim. I hope you find him before he escapes our grasp.
string: 間違いなく、メルセルはスカイリムの国境へ向かっています。私達の手から逃れる前に見つけて下さい

original: I heard what happened and the Guild owes you thanks for bringing this to light.
string: 話は聞きました。事実を明らかにしてくれて、ギルドは感謝しますよ

original: I can't believe he emptied the vault. Right from under our noses.
string: あの男が金庫を空にしたなんて信じられない。俺達の目と鼻の先でだぞ

original: How dare you bring that Dunmer bitch here.
string: そのダンマーの雌豚を連れこむとはいい度胸じゃないか

original: Vex better leave a piece of Mercer for us. It's payback time.
string: ヴェックスには俺達の分を残しておいてもらわないとな。メルセルには貸しがあるんだ

original: What in blazes is going on? Are you working with Karliah?
string: 一体何がどうなってるんだ？　お前はカーリアの手先なのか？

original: Ah, yes. Of course. No, I don't need anything.
string: うん、もちろん。何も必要ないから

original: I'm here to help you with books, Nirya. That's all.
string: 本探しを手伝うのが私の仕事なだけだ、ニルヤ

original: Did she, perhaps, mention any dangerous research she might be working on? Anything that could get her in trouble?
string: 危険な調査に取り組んでいるとか言っていなかった？　トラブルに巻き込まれそうだとか？

original: Nirya...
string: ニルヤ…

original: I was wondering. Has Faralda been in recently? Borrowed any books that you can recall?
string: 気になっていたんだけど、最近ファラルダを見かけた？　本を借りていった覚えがある？

original: Can I help you with anything, Nirya?
string: 何かお困りか、ニルヤ？

original: What's that? Oh yes, yes. Thank you, I will.
string: これは何だ？　ああ、そうか。分かった、ありがとう

original: Ah. Well, then. Let me know if you need anything.
string: それでは、何か必要だったら言ってくれ

original: Hmm? Oh, no. No, not really. I... Actually, I've forgotten what I was looking for.
string: ん？　いや、いや、そういうわけでは。実は、何を探していたか忘れちまったんだ

original: Are you looking for any specific volumes, Drevis?
string: どの巻を探しているんだ、ドレビス？

original: Amazed isn't the right word. They might find this... offensive.
string: “仰天した”って言葉はしっくりこないな。たぶん、これは…　侮辱的だ

original: I bet your family would be amazed, right?
string: あなたの家族もきっと驚くでしょうね

original: I'm surprised that the College is allowed to excavate here.
string: 大学がここの発掘を許されたとは驚きだ

original: Can you believe we're here? Saarthal, of all places.
string: ここに来たなんて信じられる？　あのサールザルよ

original: My sweet Leanora, I will never let anything happen to us. I promise.
string: 愛しいレアノラ、決して悪い事は起こらない。約束するよ

original: I've already lost a family, and we're about to start a new one. I don't want that to happen again.
string: 家族を失い、今まさに新しい家族を築こうとしているの。もう二度と失いたくない

original: It brings me joy to hear that, but what possessed you to say that so suddenly?
string: そう言ってくれるのは嬉しいが、急にどういう風の吹きまわしだい？

original: My darling, you've made me the happiest woman in all Skyrim.
string: ダーリン、おかげでスカイリムでいちばん幸せな女になれたわ

original: Just worry about keeping the fields tended and let the Jarl worry about the war.
string: 畑を守ることだけを考えなさい。戦争のことは首長に任せて

original: I suppose so. I just fear they won't make it out here in time.
string: だろうな。ただ、彼らは間に合わないんじゃないかと、それが心配でね

original: It will have to do. Besides, if it came to blows, I'm sure the Snow-Shod's would come out here and assist us.
string: やらなきゃね。もし喧嘩になったら、スノー・ショッドが来て加勢してくれると思うわ

original: I'm not so sure the few guards they've assigned to the farm are enough.
string: 農場に配備した数人の衛兵で、果たして間に合うかどうか

original: Yes, thank you Arch-Mage.
string: はい、ありがとうございます、アークメイジ

original: Everything's under control, then? Right. Keep up the good work.
string: では、すべて順調か？　よろしい。その調子で頼むぞ

original: There were also two items requiring disciplinary action recently.
string: 懲罰処分が必要な案件も2つほどありましたね

original: I'm dealing with a few new research proposals, evaluating the results of three long-term projects, and keeping an eye on our new Apprentices.
string: 研究計画書を何本か処理しつつ、3つの長期プロジェクトの報告書を精査しながら、新入りの見習いの監督をしています

original: Is there anything new I should be aware of, Mirabelle?
string: ミラベル、何か聞いておかなきゃいけない事はないか？

original: Never. The College cannot become mired in local politics. What happens inside these walls is our worry. What happens outside is theirs.
string: 絶対にない。大学が地元の政治の泥沼にはまるような事があってはならない。この塀の中の出来事は我々の管轄、外は連中の管轄だ

original: Forgive me, but at what point does it become our concern?
string: 失礼ながら、どこがこちらに関わってくるのでしょう？

original: The same thing we've told them before, and the same thing we've told these Stormcloaks. It's not our concern.
string: 以前連中に言った事と同じ、ストームクロークに言った事とも同じだ。知ったこっちゃない

original: Sir, the Imperial Legion has again requested assistance. What shall I tell them?
string: 帝国軍からまた支援要請が来ております。返事はいかがいたしましょうか？

original: Ah, yes. True. Well, thank you.
string: ああ、確かに。そうか、礼を言う

original: Your schedule is always clear, Arch-Mage. I see to that.
string: いつもながら明瞭な計画ですね、アークメイジ。その件は承りました

original: Mirabelle, would you please make sure my schedule is clear for the next few days? I'm working on something important.
string: ミラベル、これから数日間、俺のスケジュールを空けといてくれないか。重要な仕事があるんだ

original: "Disappointed" is not the word I would choose, Colette. Excuse me.
string: 選ぶとしたら“落胆”という言葉ではないよ、コレット。では失礼

original: Oh, my dear Urag. You're trying so hard to help. I do hope you're not disappointed.
string: ああ、ウラッグ。一所懸命に助けてくれようとしているのね。あなたを落胆させないようにするわ

original: So, you don't need anything then.
string: じゃあ、別に何も必要ないわけだ

original: I'm positive whatever I require will be revealed to me on its own, in due time.
string: 私が必要とするものは何であれ、自ずから、やがて現れ出るに違いありません

original: Was there something specific you needed?
string: 何か特に必要なものがあったのか？

original: Don't fret, my fanged acquaintance. I shan't trouble you a bit.
string: 苛立たないで。私の牙のあるお友達。嫌な事はしないから

original: I... see.
string: なるほど…　ね

original: I only wish to escape the constant glaring of my "colleagues" and discover an opportunity for repose. Your Arcanaeum is so lovely and quiet...
string: 私はただ絶え間ない“同僚”達の怒りの視線を逃れて安息の機会を見つけたかっただけなのです。アルケイナエウムはなんて美しくて静か…

original: Did you need something, Colette?
string: 何かお探しで、コレット？

original: Ah, my dearest Urag! How are you today, my green-skinned friend?
string: あら、これはこれは、ウラッグ！　緑の肌のお友達、ご機嫌はいかが？

original: This is why I avoid being social.
string: これだから人と話すのは嫌なんだ

original: Oh! Well... I... I'm sorry. Yes, we have been working on something together.
string: あら！　ご、ごめん。そうね、一緒に取り組んできたんだものね

original: Calm down! Why are you over-reacting? I was going to ask if the two of you are collaborating on research!
string: 落ち着け！　なぜそんなに大げさに反応するんだ？　二人が共同研究でもしているのか尋ねようとしただけなのに！

original: What? Why, the audacity! How dare you imply such a thing!
string: ええっ？　なんて図々しい！　よくもそんな事が言えるわね！

original: You've been spending a fair bit of time with Sergius lately, I see.
string: 最近はずいぶんサルジアスと一緒にいるようだな

original: If you say so.
string: 分かった

original: Oh, no. Err, wouldn't do to say at all. Not, err, not now. Not at all. I have far too many things to do still.
string: 頼むよ。そんな事言わないでくれ。その、今じゃなくていいんだ。全然構わない。まだやる事は山のようにあるからな

original: Right. And what did you say the point of this little venture was?
string: なるほど。この小さな冒険の目的は何だと言っていたっけ？

original: Oh, that. Err, yes. It's... It's quite promising, I believe. Definitely on the right track. Results, err, results should be soon.
string: ああ、そうだ。ええと、そいつは有望だ。間違いなく大丈夫だろう。結果は、まあ、すぐに出るさ

original: So, Arniel. How's that little project of yours coming along? Any progress worth mentioning?
string: さて、アーニエル。計画はどうなってる？　報告すべき進展はあったか？

original: See that you do.
string: そのようだな

original: Ahh, hmm. Yes. I, err, I was unaware that I had forgotten that. I will, err, I mean I'll take care of that as soon as possible.
string: ああ、そうか。分かった。それは失念していた。できるだけ、その、早く対処する事にしよう

original: And that, my nervous little friend, has not happened. Would you care to comment on that, perhaps?
string: そして、気弱な友よ、それは起こらなかったんだ。どういう事か説明してほしいな

original: Really, Arniel? Because I seem to recall doing just that for you recently, at which point you assured me that you'd cover my expenses.
string: 本当か、アーニエル？　つい最近も同じ事をしてやったと思うが、その時に費用を負担してくれると約束してくれたはずだ

original: Yes, err, apologies for the intrusion. I was wondering, err, if you could possibly, ah, procure a few select items for me.
string: ああ、その、勝手にすまない。何と言うか…　いくつか品物を…　調達してきてはもらえないだろうか？

original: What is it?
string: 何なんだ？

original: Err, excuse me Enthir. Might I have a moment?
string: ああ、悪いんだがエンシル。少しいいか？

original: Yes, Arch-Mage. Thank you.
string: はい、アークメイジ。ありがとうございます

original: No, I don't think so. Respond to their request, and we'll leave it at that.
string: いや、そうは思わない。彼らの要求に応え、あとは放っておく

original: Should we consider investigating the matter?
string: 本件の調査を検討すべきでしょうか？

original: That hasn't changed, has it? Then just tell them again.
string: それは変わっていない。そうだろ？　ならば、もう1度言ってやればいい

original: That they had arrived, asked for information which was provided to them, and went on their way with no suggestion of further interaction.
string: 彼らはここを訪れ、情報を求め、情報の提供を受けて出発した。以降の対応に関する示唆はなかった、と

original: What did you tell them last time?
string: 前に彼らに何と言った？

original: Arch-Mage, the Synod have contacted us again, asking if we've any word on their researchers. What shall I tell them?
string: アークメイジ、サイノッドからまた問い合わせが入っております。調査団の消息について何か知らないか、との事です。返事はいかがいたしましょう？

original: Some fool is opening a museum in Dawnstar. They say he's paying people to collect artifacts from that old Mythic Dawn cult.
string: どこかの馬鹿が、ドーンスターに博物館を建てるつもりらしい。どうも人を雇って、例の“深遠の暁”ってカルト教団から秘宝を集めているそうだ

original: I wonder why they only stole Lucan's golden claw. I mean, we have plenty of things in the shop that are worth just as much coin.
string: なぜルーカンの金の爪だけを盗んだのかしら。だって、同じくらい価値のある物は店にいくらでもあるのに

original: Lucan found the claw about a year after he opened the store. He never quite explained where he got it. He's a tricky one.
string: あの爪は、ルーカンが店を開いて1年後くらいに見つけきたの。どこで手に入れたかは詳しく話そうとしなかった。用心深いのね

original: Those thieves must be mad, hiding out there. Those old crypts are filled with nothing but traps, trolls, and who knows what else!
string: あそこに潜んでいる盗賊どもはイカれてるに違いないわ。ああいう古い墓地はトラップやトロールであふれてるし、他にも何があるか分かったもんじゃないのよ！

original: Wh- no... I.... Oh, by the Eight, fine. But only to the edge of town!
string: ふう、いや…　八大神にかけて、よかった。だが、まだ町のはずれとは！

original: Oh really? Well I think your new helper here needs a guide.
string: 本当に？　ここにいる新人の助手には案内役が必要みたいね

original: Yes. So now you don't have to go, do you?
string: そうだ。これで行かなくてもよくなったのでは？

original: So this is your plan, Lucan?
string: ルーカン、これがあなたの計画なの？

original: Come on, father. There's nothing more to be said here.
string: なあ、親父。ここで言う事はもう何もないんだ

original: Face it, cow! Your stupid son is dead! He died a Stormcloak traitor. And you... you best keep your mouth shut before you suffer the same.
string: 現実をみろ！　お前の馬鹿息子は死んだ！　裏切り者のストームクローク一味として死んだ…　そしてお前は…　同じ運命をたどりたくなければ口を閉じておけ

original: "Holding him"? Why I've got him in my cellar. He's my prisoner.
string: “人質”？　あいつは監獄にぶちこんである。私の囚人だ

original: Do you believe this old hag?
string: このババアのいう事を信じるのか？

original: I will never accept his death! My son still lives. I feel it in my heart. So tell me, Battle-Borns, where is he? Where are you holding my Thorald?
string: 死んだなんて認めるもんか！　息子は生きてる。私には分かるんだ。教えなさい、バトル・ボーン、息子はどこ？　ソラルドをどこに拘束してる？

original: Your son chose his side, and he chose poorly. And now he's gone. Such is the way of war. The sooner you accept his loss, the better.
string: あんたの息子は奴につく事を選んだ。その過ちのせいで消えたが。それが戦争ってもんだ。息子が死んだ事を早く受け入れるんだな

original: Nothing? And what of my son? Hmm? What of Thorald? Is he nothing? So don't talk to me about suffering!
string: どうって事ない？　息子のどこが？　ええ？　ソラルドのどこが、どうって事ないって言うんだい？　苦しみについて偉そうに言わないでくれ

original: Foolish old woman! You know nothing! Nothing of our struggles, our suffering!
string: 愚かなババアめ！　何も分かっていない！　我らの苦労も、苦痛も分かっていない！

original: Well what are you going to do then, huh? Let's hear it!
string: それで、何をするつもりなの？　聞かせてもらいましょう！

original: We are done talking about this.
string: もう話は終わった

original: I helped the young lovers in Ivarstead.
string: イヴァルステッドで若い恋人達を助けた

original: How wonderful. Like the sea, their love roils and swells, but brings life and nourishment to all.
string: すばらしいわ。愛は海と同じようにうねり、波立つものだけど、生命力と心の栄養をもたらしてくれるの

original: It doesn't matter. I'm here. We're together now. And we will be forever.
string: 関係ない。ここにいる。今は一緒だ。そして永遠に離れない

original: I'm so confused. What's happening?
string: 混乱してるわ。何があったの？

original: But that battle isn't expected until tomorrow... Ruki, what's going on?
string: でもその戦いは明日まで始まらない…　ルキ、一体何が起こっている？

original: I had heard that Gjukar's men were wiped out. I came to find you.
string: グジュカールの男達が皆殺しにあったと聞いたの。あなたを探しに来たのよ

original: Of course I am. What brings you here?
string: もちろん。ここへは何のご用で？

original: Fenrig! You're alive!
string: フェンリグ！　生きていたのね！

original: Is Ulfric's armor done yet?
string: ウルフリックの鎧は完成したの？

original: Exactly.
string: その通りだ

original: Oh, right. That makes sense. Kind of a messy metal, anyway.
string: なるほど、そういう事ね。とにかく、厄介な金属ね

original: Don't even bother with that one. Leave it to the orcs.
string: そんなことに気を使うのはやめろ。オークに任せておけ

original: I think I've got a handle on it, but Orichalcum is confusing.
string: 何とかできたと思うけど、オリハルコンは難しいわ

original: Have you been learning your ores?
string: 鉱石のことを学んでいるのか？

original: Let me take you to Ruki.
string: ルキのところへ案内する

original: If she's come this far from home, it must be important. Lead on. I just need to report back to camp by sunrise.
string: 家からこんなに遠くまで来たなんて、重要な事に違いない。連れて行ってくれ。夜明け前に野営地に戻って報告すればいいだけだから

original: Why don't you like camping here?
string: なぜ、ここでの野営が気に入らないんだ？

original: Our fires are visible for miles. We're in a low valley. Sitting ducks.
string: 何キロも先からここの火が見えるからさ。低地の谷にいる。格好の標的だ

original: West, in the plains over the mountain.
string: 西の、山を越えた平原だ

original: We're expected to fight there tomorrow. Gjukar elected to camp here for the night. I don't like it, though.
string: あそこで明日、戦う事になっている。ここを今夜の野営地にしようとグジュカールが決めた。気にいらないがね

original: Your wife is looking for you.
string: お前の妻が探している

original: Ruki? Where is she?
string: ルキが？　どこにいるんだ？

original: Come, help me search for Fenrig.
string: こっちへ、フェンリグを探すのを手伝って

original: The last battle here was hundreds of years ago.
string: ここで最後に戦いが行われたのは100年前だった

original: Are you a fool? Look at the bodies around you. Even if you're blind, surely you smell the blood.
string: 何を言っているの？　周りの死体の山をごらんなさい。たとえ目が見えなくたって血のにおいで分かるわ

original: What are you doing?
string: 何をしてるんだ？

original: I'm searching for my Fenrig. He was marching with Gjukar's men, who they say were wiped out here.
string: フェンリグを探しているの。グジュカールの男達と一緒だったんだけど、彼らはここで皆殺しにされたようなの

original: I've turned over every body, though, and I can't find him.
string: すべての死体を確認したけれど、彼を見つける事ができないの

original: Please help me look. He has a bright red beard and hair.
string: お願い、探すのを手伝って。明るい赤毛の髭と髪をしてるわ

original: Well one of us has to do something!
string: 誰かがどうにかしないと！

original: Twilight guide your path.
string: 黄昏があなたを導くわ

original: May Azura's magic protect you.
string: アズラの魔法があなたを守りますように

original: This has all been foreseen, and we must play our parts.
string: これはすべて予言されていた事よ。自分の役目を果たさなきゃならないわ

original: No, I really don't. It'll be a while before I'm ready for that. I'll be on my way now.
string: 違う、そうじゃない。準備には時間がかかる。今向かっている

original: Well, if it works in the one case, why not the other? Don't you want to at least give it a try?
string: 一度は上手くいったのだから、また上手く行くかも知れないわ。とにかくやってみたら？

original: I didn't lose a lover, Viola, I lost my wife. It's not the same thing.
string: ヴィオラ、失ったのは恋人ではなく、妻だ。全然違うんだ

original: It was an old Nord proverb. It said, the best way to get over the loss of a lover is to find a new one.
string: 古いノルドの言葉にあるわ。恋人を失った痛手を乗り越える最上の方法は、新しい恋を見つける事だと

original: What did you hear?
string: 何が聞こえた？

original: Hello, captain! Can you spare a moment? I heard something the other day that I wanted to share with you.
string: こんにちは、キャプテン！　ちょっとお時間いいでしょうか？　お耳に入れておいた方が良い話を聞いたんです

original: I'm sure the guards have the matter well in hand. Now, if you'll excuse me.
string: 衛兵隊が問題をよく掌握しているはずだ。それでは、失礼する

original: You wouldn't think it from the racket that Cornerclub makes.
string: ラケットからじゃ、コーナークラブが作っているなんて思わないわ

original: Viola, dark elves sleep just like the rest of us.
string: ヴィオラ、ダークエルフも同じように眠るんだ

original: Do you think those dark elves had anything to do with the murders? The attacks all happened at night, after all.
string: 殺人にダークエルフ達が関係していると思う？　だってほら、襲撃はいつでも夜だったわけでしょ

original: Yes, I think that must be it. My wife hasn't been gone that long, after all. Ask me again on another day.
string: ああ、きっとそうだ。結局、妻が去ってからそれほど経っていない。また聞きに来てくれ

original: Oh, I see. Is it still too soon?
string: なるほど。まだ少し早すぎたかしら？

original: I've thought about it, but I'm not sure it's such a good idea.
string: そう思いもしたが、いい考えとは思えない

original: Have you thought about my invitation?
string: 招待の事、考えてくれました？

original: And now you've found me. Can I help you?
string: ついに見つかったか。何の用だ？

original: Captain Lonely-Gale! I've been looking for you everywhere!
string: ロンリー・ゲイル船長！　あちこち、さんざん探しましたよ！

original: I... well. Perhaps. But still! It's curious.
string: 私…　ひょっとして。でも、それでも面白いわ

original: Don't you think all your tramping around there investigating might have something to do with it?
string: 足をドスドス鳴らしながら調査していた事と、何か関係があるんじゃないのか？

original: Did you notice that the snow settles in a different direction near the murder sites?
string: あの殺人現場の周りでは、雪が違う方向に積もっているのに気がついた？

original: What is it now, Viola?
string: 何だ、ヴィオラ？

original: Captain, captain!
string: キャプテン、キャプテン！

original: Oh... yes. Now that you mention it, I think... sorry about that.
string: あ、そうだな。そういえば、確かに…　申し訳ない

original: Did you look behind the forge? I think I saw it there.
string: 鋳造器具の後ろを見た？　あそこで見たように思うの

original: Hammers don't have legs.
string: ハンマーに脚はついていない

original: I didn't touch it!
string: 触っていないわよ！

original: Blast, girl, I told you to leave my tools alone. You have yours and I have mine.
string: まったく、俺の道具には触るなって言っただろう。お前にはお前の、俺には俺の道具があるんだ

original: No.
string: 必要ない

original: Did you use my good hammer?
string: 俺のお気に入りのハンマーを使ったか？

original: This is the royal armor, lass. Maybe in a few years.
string: これが王室の鎧だよ。もしかすると数年後にはね

original: I did that engraved piece just last month!
string: この彫刻の部分は、先月できたばかりなの！

original: This is more delicate work than you're used to.
string: これはお前が慣れた仕事よりも、もっと細かい仕事だ

original: Can I help with it? Maybe just the cuirass?
string: 手伝いましょうか？　キュイラスだけでも

original: No, I want to take my time with it.
string: いや、これにはもっと時間をかけたい

original: Come to gawk at the Dark Elf?
string: ダークエルフがそんなに珍しいか？

original: Well look at us. Like two gray specks in the snow.
string: 見てみろよ。まるで雪景色に浮かぶふたつの黒いシミだ

original: I mean no offense. I am but a humble farmer. Not a... a great wanderer, like you.
string: 悪気はないんだ。俺はしがない農夫だよ。あんたみたいな…　たいした流れ者じゃない

original: If you beat up my sister Sissel, I won't tell.
string: 妹のシセルをひどい目にあわせるなら、教えてあげないわ

original: Are you new around here? You should go to the inn if you need a place to stay.
string: この辺りは初めて？　泊まる場所が必要なら、宿屋へ行った方がいいわ

original: Sissel thinks she's so special. No way she's more special than me.
string: シセルは自分のことを特別だと思ってる。私より特別なはずなんかないのに

original: I'm the older sister, by nearly five minutes. Sissel's barely worthy to walk in my shadow.
string: 私の方が5分くらいお姉さんなのよ。シセルは私の影で生きていくのがやっとなの

original: I wish I could be an adventurer like you, and go wherever I want.
string: あなたみたいに冒険して、行きたいところにいけたらいいなあ

original: I had a dream that there was a good dragon. He was old and gray, but he wasn't scary.
string: 良いドラゴンの夢を見たの。年をとって、白髪で、怖くないドラゴンだったわ

original: Most days, I do all I can to stay away from my sister and my father. The beating's the same from either one.
string: ほとんど毎日、自分の姉妹と父親から離れるためにできるだけのことをしているわ。どっちに叩かれても同じだもの

original: Some day soon I'll stop being afraid. Jouane is teaching me magic. He says I'm real good.
string: 近いうちに、怖がるのはやめるわ。ジュアンから呪文を教わっているんだけど、とても良いって言われるのよ

original: Do yourself a favor and don't have children. They're good for nothing at all.
string: いいか、子供は作るなよ。まったく何の役にも立ちやしない

original: I got enough troubles, so don't go adding to them.
string: すでに手一杯だ、問題を増やさないでくれ

original: I spend every day tending the fields, and what do my daughters do? Nothing! Complain and caterwaul! Sleep and eat! Useless!
string: 俺が毎日畑仕事に追われてる間、娘達は何をしてる？　まるで何もしてない！　文句を言っていがみ合い、眠って食べるだけだ！　役立たずどもめ！

original: Curse my good-for-nothing daughters! My wife was twice the woman they'll ever grow to be. She gave her life birthing them. What a waste.
string: 役立たずの娘達を呪うぞ！　どんなに成長しようと妻には到底及ばない。妻は出産のために命を落としたんだ。もったいない！

original: Did you have any luck talking to my father?
string: うまく父に話せましたか？

original: I hope you can change my father's mind. He can be a little stubborn.
string: あなたが父の気持ちを変えてくれたらと思います。父はちょっと頑固なんです

original: You look like you've seen your share of adventure. I envy you that. In fact, maybe you can help me with something.
string: たっぷり冒険をしてきたんでしょうね、うらやましい。実は、あなたなら僕を助けられるかも知れないんです

original: My father, Mralki, manages the inn. He used to be a soldier, but he left that life behind.
string: 父のムラルキは宿屋をやっています。かつては兵士でしたが、もうそれは過去の事だと

original: If you need a meal or a room, I've got both.
string: 食事や部屋が必要なら、どちらも提供しよう

original: I only take real coin here, no handouts and no bartering.
string: うちは現金しか受け付けないよ。施しはしないし、物々交換も駄目だ

original: That fool son of mine, Erik, wants to be an adventurer. He a good-natured lad, but he's got no idea how dangerous the world really is.
string: あの馬鹿息子のエリクが、冒険に出たいと言って聞かないんだ。気立ての良い子だが、この世界が実はどれほど危険か、まったく分かっちゃいない

original: Some folk here will tell you I'm sheltering my boy too much, but I ask you, isn't it a father's duty to keep his children safe?
string: 過保護だと言う者もいる。じゃあ聞くが、子供の身の安全を図るのが父親の務めじゃないのかね？

original: Name's Ennis. If you've got friends who do business in Whiterun, they might know me.
string: 名前はエニスだ。ホワイトランで商売をしてる知り合いがいるなら、そいつに聞いてみるといい

original: You talk to Reldith yet? She's like a mother to me.
string: レルディスとはもう話したかい？　母親みたいな存在なんだ

original: You here from the city? I visit Whiterun from time to time, mostly to make deals.
string: ホワイトランから来たって？　あの街には時々足を運ぶ。たいていは取引絡みだが

original: Reldith is the hardest-working farmer in Rorikstead, but I'm the one with a head for business.
string: レルディスはロリクステッドの農場で一番の働き者なんだが、俺には商売の方が向いてたんだな

original: Did you see those guards? Get out of line, and you'll have them to deal with.
string: あの衛兵隊を見た？　列から離れたら連中を相手する事になるわよ

original: We're honest, hardworking folk here, and we don't suffer beggars or thieves.
string: ここの人達はみんな正直で働き者よ。物乞いも泥棒もいないわ

original: City folk might look down on us, but what's wrong with farming? Everything we've got, we had to earn with our own sweat.
string: 都会の人は私達をばかにしているかも知れないけど、農業のどこがいけないの？　ものを手に入れるには、汗水流して働かなきゃ

original: You look like the adventurous sort. You should talk to Erik, the innkeeper's son. He could use your help.
string: 冒険好きなタイプみたいね。宿屋の息子のエリクに話しかけてみるといいわ。あなたなら力になれるわよ

original: If you've got some business in Rorikstead, you should start by speaking to Jouane.
string: ロリクステッドで用があるなら、まずはジュアンに話してみろ

original: Sorry, I don't mean to be rude but Jouane's the one who deals with people. I'm afraid I lost my charm years ago.
string: 失礼に聞こえたらすまんが、人を相手にするのはジュアンの役目だ。自分はもうこんなだからな

original: No offense intended, but I don't think we have anything to talk about.
string: 悪気はないんだが、別に話す事はないだろう

original: I was a different man, once -- strong, commanding, ah, and young. But the Great War was a long time ago.
string: 自分もかつてはこんなじゃなかった…　強く、威厳があり、若かった。大戦なんて大昔の話だな

original: If you're thinking of setting up to farm, you picked the right place.
string: もし農園を開きたいのなら、良い場所を選んだよ

original: Peace and prosperity are all the good folk of Rorikstead want in life.
string: ロリクステッドの善良な人々はただ平和と幸運な生活さえあればいいのだ

original: I'm sure it's hard to believe, but I was once a bold adventurer like you, ready to face any danger.
string: 信じてもらえないかも知れないが、かつてはお前のように勇敢な冒険家だったのだ

original: Have you spoken to Erik? His father won't let him go out and seek his fortune in the world. Maybe you can help.
string: エリクとは話したか？　彼の父親の命令でエリクはもう冒険に出ることが許されないのだ。お前ならエリクの父親を説得できるかも知れない

original: Do enjoy your time in Rorikstead. This close to the Reach, well, we are truly blessed to have such fertile ground.
string: ロリクステッドを楽しんで行ってくれ。リーチに近いのでね…　本当に肥えた土壌に恵まれて私達は幸せだ

original: You there! Wait a moment.
string: お前！　待て

original: Not sure, let's watch and find out.
string: 何だろう。様子を見るか

original: Is that the murderer?
string: 人殺しか？

original: Okay, I'll come quietly.
string: 分かった、従おう

original: You're smarter than you look.
string: 見た目より賢いようだな

original: I'd rather die than go to jail.
string: 監獄に行くぐらいなら死んでやる

original: Resisting arrest will mean your death.
string: 逮捕に抵抗すれば死ぬぞ

original: I'm not answering any questions.
string: 何も答えるつもりはない

original: Is that so? Well, perhaps a night in jail might loosen your tongue. Hmmm?
string: ほう。監獄で一晩過ごせば話す気になるんじゃないか？　どうだ？

original: Alright, you are now under arrest.
string: それでは、お前を逮捕する

original: Doesn't scare me.
string: 脅かしても無駄だ

original: I'm not sure what happened.
string: 何があったのかは知らない

original: Hmm... If you happen to recollect anything about the incident, you be sure to report to the captain of the guard.
string: そうか。事件について何か思い出したら、衛兵長まで必ず知らせてくれ

original: I've got my eye on you.
string: 見張っているからな

original: Then perhaps you care to explain why you are standing so close a dead body with your weapon drawn?
string: それじゃ、武器を手に持って死体のそばに立っている理由を、説明したくて仕方ないんじゃないか？

original: Hmmm... You can go, but you stay on your best behavior now.
string: そうか…　行っていいぞ。しかし、妙な行動はしない事だ

original: I've got my eye on you.
string: 見張っているからな

original: Don't know what else to say... I had nothing to do with this.
string: 何を話せと言うんだ… 何の関係ないのに

original: Is there a problem?
string: 何か問題があるのか？

original: You there. What do you know about this?
string: おい、これについて何を知っている？

original: If anyone saw anything, step forward. Otherwise, step away from the body!
string: 何か見た者は前に出ろ。見ていないのなら死体から離れるんだ

original: But...
string: でも…

original: Alright now. Everyone back away. Let the law handle this.
string: さあ、みんな下がれ。法の執行者に任せろ

original: Looks dead to me.
string: 死んでいるようだが

original: Is he... dead?
string: し…　死体？

original: Is she... dead?
string: し…　死体？

original: Oh no... what happened here?
string: なんて事だ…　一体ここで何が？

original: If anyone falls, it will be you.
string: つまずくのはお前だ

original: Then the die is cast, and once again my blade will taste Nightingale blood!
string: ならばもう話す事はない。この剣に再びナイチンゲールの血を味わせてやる！

original: The difference is I still have honor.
string: 違いは、こっちにまだ名誉が残っていることだ

original: It's clear you'll never see the Skeleton Key as I do... as an instrument of limitless wealth.
string: 不壊のピックに対する見解が違うようだな…　あれは無限の富をもたらす道具なんだぞ

original: Instead you've chosen to fall over your own foolish code.
string: なのにお前は自分のくだらない主義につまずきやがった

original: I don't believe you. Nocturnal guides me.
string: お前は信用できない。ノクターナルが導いてくれる

original: Then it appears the shadows shroud more than your presence... they blind your wisdom as well.
string: ならお前は影の中で自分を見失ってる…　そのせいで頭まで回らなくなってやがるんだ

original: Our actions have always been one in the same; both of us lie, cheat and steal to further our own end.
string: 俺達のやってる事は常に一緒なんだ。嘘つきで詐欺師で泥棒だ。人の事など構いやしないのさ

original: It's not about Nocturnal. This is personal.
string: ノクターナルとは関係ない。個人的な問題だ

original: Revenge is it? Have you learned nothing from your time with us?
string: 復讐のためか？　俺達と行動を共にしたくせに、何も学ばなかったのか？

original: When will you open your eyes and realize how little my actions differ from yours?  Both of us lie, cheat and steal to further our own end.
string: 早く目を覚ませ。そして気づくんだ。お前は俺の同類なんだよ。嘘つきで詐欺師で泥棒だ。人の事など構いやしないのさ

original: Give me the Key, Mercer.
string: 不壊のピックを渡せ、メルセル

original: What's Karliah been filling your head with? Tales of thieves with honor? Oaths rife with falsehoods and broken promises?
string: カーリアに何を吹き込まれたんだ？　名誉ある盗賊の物語か？　偽りに満ちた誓いの言葉と守られない約束の話か？

original: Nocturnal doesn't care about you, the Key or anything having to do with the Guild.
string: ノクターナルはお前の事などどうでもいいんだ。不壊のピックやギルドの事もな

original: TG08BMercerOutroBranchTopic
string: TG08BMercerOutroBranchTopic

original: When Brynjolf brought you before me I could feel a sudden shift in the wind.
string: ブリニョルフがお前を連れてきた時、急に風向きが変わったように感じた

original: And at that moment, I knew it would end with one of us at the end of a blade.
string: その瞬間に悟ったんだ。最後にはお互い剣を交える事になるんじゃないかってな

original: Why plant the ring on Brand-Shei?
string: なぜブラン・シェイに指輪を？

original: There's someone that wants to see him put out of business permanently. That's all you need to know.
string: 奴に仕事から手を引いてほしい連中がいるんだ。それも永久にな。知る必要があるのはそこまでだ

original: Now, you tell me when you're ready and we'll get started.
string: じゃあ用意ができたら、始めようか

original: There's someone that wants to see him put out of business permanently. That's all you need to know.
string: 奴に仕事から手を引いてほしい連中がいるんだ。それも永久にな。知る必要があるのはそこまでだ

original: I'll be out in the market all day, from eight in the morning until eight in the evening.
string: 俺は朝8時から夜8時まで、街の広場に一日中出ている

original: Meet me then if you've still got the stomach for it.
string: やる気があるなら、そこで会おう

original: Force of habit, I guess.
string: つい癖でやってしまった

original: I see... and this "force of habit," does it also compel you to murder?
string: そうか…　その“癖”で誰かを殺したりしないだろうな？

original: But don't underestimate the Stormcloaks. Many are Legion veterans. They may be traitors, but they know how to fight.
string: ストームクロークを見くびらないでね。帝国軍の古参兵も大勢いるの。彼らは確かに裏切り者かも知れないけど、戦い方は知ってるわ

original: Let's show these rebels what real soldiers look like.
string: 反逆者に本物の軍人の姿を見せてやるわ

original: Consider it done.
string: 任せてくれ

original: Good. If you need any details on your marks, I'll be here. Now get going.
string: よし。標的についての詳細が必要になったら、俺はここに居る。行って来い

original: How did you want me to handle it?
string: どんなやり方でやればいい？

original: Honestly, the debt is secondary here. What's more important is that you get the message across that we aren't to be ignored.
string: 正直言うと、借金はこの際あまり重要じゃない。大事なのは、俺達が無下にされるべき存在ではないというメッセージを広める事だ

original: A word of warning though... I don't want any of them killed. Bad for business.
string: 一つだけ忠告してやろう…　誰も殺さないで貰いたい。こっちの商売がやり難くなる

original: There's just one more target before we strike out at the Emperor.
string: 皇帝を襲う前に、もうひとり別の標的がいるわ

original: Have you by chance heard of the "Gourmet"? Read his cookbook? It's become quite a phenomenon.
string: “美食家”について聞いた事はあるかしら？　彼のレシピ本を読んだ事は？　ものすごい人気よ

original: The Gourmet is scheduled to cook for the Emperor at a special dinner. You'll kill him, steal his Writ of Passage, and assume the roll of master chef.
string: この美食家は皇帝の晩餐で腕をふるう事になっているわ。彼を殺して通行証を盗み、料理長のふりをするのよ

original: Festus has been spearheading this part of the assassination plan. He's close to uncovering the identity of the Gourmet. You should report to him.
string: フェスタスが暗殺計画のこの部分の指揮を執っているわ。この美食家の正体を暴こうとしているところよ。彼のところへ行って

original: Right. So what's my next task?
string: 分かった。次の任務はなんだ？

original: Deadbeats? What'd they do?
string: 踏み倒し？ 何のつもりだ？

original: They owe our organization some serious coin and they've decided not to pay.
string: 奴らは俺達の組織から膨大な額を借りてるんだが、それを払わないと決めたらしい

original: I want you to explain to them the error of their ways.
string: お前にはこの方針が間違ってるって事を奴らに説明しに行って貰いたいんだ

original: Sounds good. Who are they?
string: 問題ない。彼らの名前は？

original: Keerava, Bersi Honey-Hand and Haelga.
string: キーラバ、ベルシ・ハニー・ハンド、そしてヘルガだ

original: Do this right, and I can promise you a permanent place in our organization.
string: しっかりやってくれれば、仲間の正式な一員として認めよう

original: Will I get a cut?
string: 分け前は出るのか？

original: Of course you'll get a cut. We take care of our own.
string: もちろん、お前にも分け前は出るよ。俺達は身内の面倒をちゃんと見るからな

original: Now if you need any details on your marks, I'll be here. Get going.
string: 標的についての詳細が必要になったら、俺はここに居る。さあ行って来い

original: You have no business in our stronghold, outlander.
string: 我々の要塞に用はないはずだぞ、よそ者

original: Malacath blesses this land for the Orcs. And the Orcs alone.
string: マラキャスはこの土地をオークに授けて下さった。オークだけに、だ

original: We won't kill you, outlander, but we don't want you here.
string: 殺しはしない。だがよそ者がここにいるのは気に入らんな

original: Most of my kin are in the longhouse. Come back during the day if you wish to trade.
string: 一族の多くは長屋にいる。取引したいなら昼のうちに戻って来い

original: It's late outlander. Come back in the morning if you need to spend coin.
string: もう夜だぞ、よそ者。金を使いたいならまた朝に来い

original: We only trade during the day, outlander. At night, most rest in the longhouse.
string: 我々は昼間しか取引をしない。夜はほとんど皆が長屋で休んでいる

original: I'm here to mine, outlander. So unless you want to dig, get out.
string: 私は採掘のためにここにいるのだ。掘る気がないなら出て行け

original: I have metal to dig.
string: 金属を採掘するのだ

original: Malacath has given me the task to mine. Good ore brings strength to our people.
string: マラキャスから採掘の任務を賜っているのだ。良い鉱石は一族に力をもたらす

original: Every Orc learns the heavy labor of mining. All spend years in the caves.
string: オークは誰でも採掘の重労働を経験する。皆が何年も洞窟で過ごすのだ

original: The mines are hard, but Malacath rewards those who rise to the challenge.
string: 採掘はきつい仕事だが、マラキャスは困難に立ち向かう者へと報いて下さる

original: This is High Hrothgar, our temple, sanctuary, and home. We ask that you respect our solitude while you are here.
string: ここはハイ・フロスガー、我らの寺院であり、聖域、そして家だ。ここにいる間は我らの平穏を尊重して頂きたい

original: Your training proceeds well, Dragonborn.
string: 鍛錬はうまくいっているようだな、ドラゴンボーンよ

original: What do you need, Dragonborn?
string: 何がほしいの、ドラゴンボーン？

original: What is it?
string: 何なんだ？

original: Do you need something?
string: 何か用？

original: Eh? Did you say something?
string: 何だって？　何か言ったか？

original: You'll have to speak up. I'm a little deaf in my right ear.
string: 大きな声で話してくれ。右耳があまり聞こえなくてな

original: Yes? What is it?
string: ああ？　何だ？

original: Did you need something?
string: 何か用か？

original: Drem Yol Lok. Greetings.
string: ドレム、ヨル、ロク。よく来たな

original: Speak. I will listen.
string: 話せ。聞こう

original: Dovahkiin.
string: ドヴァーキン

original: Ah! You made it! Good to see you, my friend. I'll never forget how you saved my life from those Thalmor maniacs.
string: おお！　無事だったか！　会えて嬉しいよ。サルモールの石頭どもから命を救ってくれた恩は、一生忘れないからな

original: So you made it out. Good for you. Don't expect me to thank you. I still remember what you did to me.

string: よかった。たっぷり苦しんで、私の痛みを思い知ればいいのよ

original: (Invisible Continues Linked to Self)
string: (見えないまま、自身にリンクする)

original: Let's see here...
string: ちょっと待ってくれよ…

original: Yeah, got this note.
string: ああ、これだ

original: I have a letter here from Quintus Navale in Windhelm. He said it was urgent.
string: ウィンドヘルムのクインタス・ナバレからの手紙だ。緊急だそうだ

original: I've got a letter and a lot of gold. Something about it being your inheritance? Oh, and... sorry for your loss.
string: 手紙を1通とゴールドをたんまり受け取った。相続に関する事かな？　ああ…　相続分を減らしてしまったんなら悪いね

original: A letter... not sure who from. He wouldn't say. Just that he was a friend of yours.
string: 手紙…　差出人は知らない。言わなかったんだ。ただ、友達だって

original: I have a letter here for you.
string: 手紙だ

original: A note from someone named Calcelmo, in Markarth.
string: マルカルスのカルセルモとかいう人からの手紙だ

original: It's from... Falk Firebeard at the Blue Palace? You've got friends in high places.
string: 差出人は…　ブルー・パレスのファルク・ファイアビアード？　立派な知り合いがいるんだな

original: There's a new museum opening up in Dawnstar. The owner is asking me to hand out invitations to travelers.
string: ドーンスターに新しい博物館が開くんだ。館主に頼まれて、旅人に招待状を渡してるんだよ

original: Looks like that's it. Got to go.
string: これで良しと。じゃあ行くよ

original: Do you have anything for me?
string: 何か用か？

original: I've been looking for you. Got something I'm supposed to deliver - your hands only.
string: ずっと探してたんだ。あんたに直接届けるものがあってね

original: Nope, sorry. Nothing.
string: いいや。ないよ

original: Then we'd best get started.
string: なら急いだ方がいい

original: Brynjolf is needed back at the Thieves Guild to keep order while you're away.
string: ブリニョルフには盗賊ギルドに帰ってもらわないと。留守の間、代わりに仕切る人が要るでしょ

original: And I... I can't bear to face Nocturnal after my failure to protect the Key.
string: それに…　鍵を守りとおせなかった女が、どの面下げてノクターナルに会えるというの

original: I'm afraid you'll have to face the end of your journey alone.
string: 悪いけど、旅の終点にはひとりで行ってもらうしかないわ

original: I take it you never used the Pilgrim's Path.
string: その巡礼の道を通ったことがないような口ぶりだな

original: It wasn't created for the Nightingales. It was created to test those who wished to serve Nocturnal in other ways.
string: ナイチンゲールのために造られた物じゃないから。あれはノクターナルに別の方法で仕えたいと願う者を試すために造られたの

original: As a consequence, I have no knowledge of what you'll be facing.
string: 要するに、何が待ち受けているか、まったく分からないってわけ

original: Sounds like it will be a simple task.
string: 簡単な仕事に聞こえるが

original: I'm afraid it's not that simple.
string: ところが話はそう簡単じゃない

original: When the Skeleton Key was stolen from the Twilight Sepulcher, our access to the inner sanctum was removed.
string: 不壊のピックが黄昏の墓所から盗まれた時に、最奥聖域への通路は断たれてしまった

original: The only way to bring it back will be through the Pilgrim's Path.
string: 持ち帰るには“巡礼の道”を通るより他ないわ

original: TG08BKarliahOutroBranchTopic
string: TG08BKarliahOutroBranchTopic

original: I can't believe it's over. Twenty-five years in exile and just like that, it's done.
string: 信じられない…　これで終わったのね。25年間の流浪がまさかこんな風に…　幕を閉じたなんて

original: All that remains is to ensure the safe return of the Skeleton Key.
string: 後は不壊のピックを無事に持ち帰るだけよ

original: Maybe they're so scared of you they ran away.
string: お前を怖がってみんな逃げちまう

original: I don't like it. What are they waiting for?
string: 気に入らないな。あいつらは何を待っているんだ？

original: No, but I know they're out there. No other way they can come. Now shut it or you'll ruin our ambush.
string: いいえ、でも近くにいるのは分かってるわ。他に道はないもの。さあ黙って。でないと待ち伏せが失敗するわ

original: You hear anything?
string: 何か聞こえたか？

original: Today, they take away your faith. But what of tomorrow? What then? Do the elves take your homes? Your businesses? Your children? Your very lives?
string: 今日、奴らはタロスの信仰を奪った。しかし、明日はどうだ？　その時は？　エルフにあなたの家、仕事を奪わせるか？　子供達は？　あなたの命は？

original: The very idea is inconceivable to our Elven overlords! Sharing the heavens with us? With man? Ha! They can barely tolerate our presence on earth!
string: まさにこの考えがエルフの大君主には想像も及ばないことなのだ！　天国を我々と分け合う？　人間と？　はん！　彼らは我々が地上にいることさえほとんど我慢できないのに！

original: And there it is, friends! The ugly truth! We are the children of man! Talos is the true god of man! Ascended from flesh, to rule the realm of spirit!
string: そして見よ、友よ！　この醜い真実！　俺達は人間の子供である！　タロスは人間の真なる神である！　人間から昇華し、霊魂の領域を支配した！

original: Aye, love. Love! Even as man, great Talos cherished us. For he saw in us, in each of us, the future of Skyrim! The future of Tamriel!
string: ああ、愛。愛！　人間としてさえ、タロスは我々を大事にしてくださった。彼が我々一人ひとりの中に、スカイリムの未来を見ていたから！　タムリエルの未来を！

original: "I breathe now, in royalty, and reshape this land which is mine. I do this for you, Red Legions, for I love you."
string: “私は今王位について呼吸し、私のものとなったこの土地を新たに作る。私はこれをレッド・レギオン、あなたのために行う、あなたを愛しているから”

original: But you were once man! Aye! And as man, you said, "Let me show you the power of Talos Stormcrown, born of the North, where my breath is long winter."
string: しかし、あなたはかつて人間であった！　そうだ！　人間としてあなたは言った、“北の大地に生れしストームクラウンのタロスの力を見るが良い、我が息が長き冬となる”

original: And deserve our praise you do, for we are one! Ere you ascended and the Eight became Nine, you walked among us, great Talos, not as god, but as man!
string: そして称賛に価する。なぜなら我々は一つだからだ！　タロスが昇華し八大神が九大神になる前、タロスは我々と共に歩まれた、偉大なタロス、神としてではなく、人間として！

original: We are but maggots, writhing in the filth of our own corruption! While you have ascended from the dung of mortality, and now walk among the stars!
string: 我々は自らの腐敗の中でもだえ苦しむウジ虫にすぎない！　しかしあなたは定命の者から昇華し、いまや星の間を歩いておられる！

original: Terrible and powerful Talos! We, your unworthy servants, give praise! For only through your grace and benevolence may we truly reach enlightenment!
string: 恐ろしく強力なタロス！　無価値な下僕である我々は称賛する！　あなたの慈悲と善意によってのみ、我々は真の悟りに到達できる！

original: Talos the mighty! Talos the unerring! Talos the unassailable! To you we give praise!
string: 無敵のタロス！　的確なタロス！　難攻不落のタロス！　あなたを称賛する！

original: Tomorrow. I'll let you know tomorrow.
string: 明日ね。明日になったら教えてあげる

original: Come on now, we discussed that. I wouldn't be traveling all of Skyrim. It'd just to Whiterun and back, that's it.
string: おいおい、そのことは話し合ったじゃないか。何もスカイリム中を旅しようっていうんじゃない。ホワイトランに行って帰ってくるだけさ

original: Oh, I don't know. Yes, we'd make more money, but I don't like the idea of you traveling alone out there with the war and talk of dragons.
string: 分からないわ。そりゃ、もっと稼ぎたいけど、あなたが一人で戦地を旅するのは心配よ。ドラゴンもいるんだし

original: Have you given my idea any more thought? You said you'd let me know yesterday, and that obviously didn't happen.
string: 考えてくれたかい？　昨日返事をくれるはずだったのに、まだ何も聞いてないぞ

original: That dark elf wants to go on ahead, let him. Better than us risking our necks.
string: あのダークエルフ、先に行きたがってるぜ。好きにさせろ。俺達の首を危険にさらすよりはマシだ

original: So we're just supposed to sit here while Arvel runs off with that golden claw?
string: アーヴェルが金の爪を持って逃げてる間、ここでただ待ってるってわけ？

original: No. Not again. Help!
string: ま、またかよ。助けてくれ！

original: MS13AlrvelHelp03BranchTopic
string: MS13AlrvelHelp03BranchTopic

original: Hold on. You may know something important.
string: 待て。何か大事なことを知ってるのでは？

original: I damn well hope so. If it helps you twist them up, I'm glad to help.
string: だったらいいけどな。奴らを懲らしめる役に立つなら、喜んで協力するとも

original: They're after some old guy named Esbern. Something to do with dragons, I gathered it from listening to them talk when they thought I was out.
string: 連中はエズバーンとかいう老人を追ってるんだ。奴らが話してるのをこっそり聞いたが、どうやらドラゴンが絡んでるらしい

original: I've seen a guy in Riften who they seem to think is him.
string: リフテンで、彼とおぼしき男を見たことがある

original: Not much to go on -- I don't even know where he lives, or his name. But they seemed pretty excited about it.
string: それくらいしか分からない。その男の名前も、どこに住んでるかも知らない。だが、連中はかなり色めき立っているように見えたな

original: That's it. Now, let's get out of here.
string: 今ので全部だよ。さあ、ここから出よう

original: You go ahead. I'm not done here.
string: 自分はここでまだやることがある

original: No problem. Thanks for springing me. I owe you. Look me up in Riften if you make it out.
string: 分かった。逃がしてくれて感謝する。借りができたな。無事に出れたら、リフテンに訪ねてきてくれ

original: I guess you know what you're doing. I've got to find a way out of here.
string: 何をするのかは聞かないさ。じゃあ、俺は出口を探すとしよう

original: Sounds good, I'll follow you.
string: いいだろう。ついて行こう

original: Whatever you want. But let's go, now.
string: 好きにしろ。さあ行くぞ

original: If you like. But we need to find a way to unlock that trap door.
string: ご自由に。だが、あの落とし戸をどうにかして開けないとな

original: You've been very cooperative. Thanks.
string: ずいぶんと助かった。ありがとう

original: Why don't you just kill me already.
string: さっさと殺しちまえばどうだ？

original: No time to explain. Let's get out of here. (Free him)
string: 説明してる時間はない。ここから逃げよう(解放する)

original: Yeah, sure, okay.
string: ああ、そうだな。よし分かった

original: Come on, this way. I've seen the guards use it to get rid of bodies. It must lead somewhere.
string: 衛兵が死体を片づけるのに使ってたんだ。どこかに通じてるに違いない

original: I'd like to hear it all one more time.
string: もう一度すべて聞かせてほしい

original: Fine. Whatever you want. Can't you just kill me and get it over with?
string: なんなりと。だがいっそ、さっさと殺したらどうだ？

original: There's this old man. I've seen him around Riften. I don't know where he lives. I don't know his name.
string: その老人ならリフテンの近くで見たことがある。でも、住んでる場所は知らないし、名前も分からない

original: Yes, he matches the description of this Esbern guy you're looking for. Maybe it's him. Maybe it isn't.
string: 確かに、あんたが探してるエズバーンって男の人相と一致する。たぶんそうかも知れないし、違うかも知れない

original: That's all I know, okay?
string: 知ってることは全部話したろ？

original: I'm not here to torture you.
string: 拷問しに来たわけじゃない

original: What? Who... what do you want then?
string: 何だって？　じゃあ…　一体何の用だ？

original: I need to talk to you.
string: 話を聞きたい

original: I told you, I don't know anything else about it.
string: 言ったろ？　その件についちゃ、他には何も知らない

original: You fool, why should I share the treasure with anyone?
string: 馬鹿な奴め、何で宝を分け合わなきゃならない？

original: The way out is clear. Good luck.
string: 出口は大丈夫だ。気をつけて

original: Thank you. When I find my daughter, it will be thanks to you.
string: ありがとう。娘をみつけることができたら、あなたのおかげだわ

original: Coven? What do you mean?
string: 魔術結社？ どういうことだ？

original: Bashnag's circle of mages. We - well "they" live here. They made it pretty clear that I'm no longer welcome.
string: バシュナグの魔術師集団。私達…　いえ“彼ら”はここに住んでるの。私はもう仲間じゃないと宣言されてしまったけど

original: These are no dainty college mages. Bashnag has the skill of a magister and the mind of a warlord. This is a dangerous bunch.
string: お堅い大学の魔術師とはまったく違うわ。バシュナグは魔法修士に並ぶスキルを持った軍閥の長よ。とても危険な連中

original: They're good company if you want to study necromancy in peace, though.
string: とはいえ、平和に死霊術を学びたいのであればなかなか面白い人達よ

original: Tell me more about the Coven.
string: 魔術結社について詳しく教えてほしい

original: Bashnag is dead.
string: バシュナグは死んだよ

original: He is? I'm not sure how to feel about that.  Perhaps it's for the better.
string: そうなのですか？　なんと言って良いのか分からないわ。いい方向に向かうのかもしれませんね

original: Why were you in Riften?
string: なぜリフテンにいたんだ？

original: My daughter was sent to the orphanage there when I stood accused of illegal necromancy. I had no choice. Run or die.
string: 娘はあそこの孤児院に送られてしまったの。私は違法な死霊術をした罪に問われて、逃げるか死ぬかしかなくなってしまった

original: I joined with Bashnag then, but I thought of Savela every day. So I snuck off, hoping to find and steal away with her.
string: それでバシュナグの仲間になったんだけど、サヴェラのことを忘れたことはなかった。だから娘を連れ出して逃げようと、こっそり抜け出したの

original: Only, she was gone. Shipped away to another orphanage, or adopted, or... I didn't know what else to do, so I came back, hoping nobody noticed I left.
string: それなのに、娘はいなかった。他の孤児院に送られたか、養子になったか、それとも…　途方に暮れて戻ってくるしかなかったわ。抜け出したことを気づかれてなければよいと願って

original: Why aren't you part of the coven anymore?
string: なぜ今は魔術結社の一員じゃないんだ？

original: I left for a few days in Riften. When I came back Bashnag accused me of trying to sell him out to the Thalmor. I was cursed and chased off.
string: リフテンに行くために抜け出したの。戻って来たら、バシュナグをサルモールに売ろうとしただろうと疑われて。呪いをかけられて追放されたの

original: You're a necromancer?
string: あなたは死霊術師なのか？

original: I am, and I don't want to hear your moral judgments about it, either. I wouldn't have had to study in secret in the old days.
string: そうよ。道徳的な見解とやらを聞くつもりはないわ。昔なら人目を忍んで学ばなくても良かったはずのことよ

original: It isn't safe. Wait here.
string: まだ危険だ。ここで待ってろ

original: Please, let me know if it seems safe to leave.
string: お願い。出発しても大丈夫そうなら教えて

original: Can you make it out of here?
string: ここから出られそうか？

original: Bashnag cursed me. I can't cast a spell to save my life right now. I'll have to wait until the way out is safe.
string: バシュナグに呪いをかけられたの。今は自分を守る呪文も使えない。逃げ道が安全になるまで動けないわ

original: Why are you down here?
string: どうしてここに？

original: Thanks for getting me out of that. Bashnag's coven chased me out and left me for dead down here. Nobody lasts too long with the spiders.
string: 助けてくれてありがとう。バシュナグの魔術結社の連中に追い込まれて、もう死んだも同然だと見捨てられたの。クモの群れの中では誰も長くは持たないわ

original: Please, will you help me get out of here? If the coast is clear, I'll make a break for it.
string: お願い、ここから出る手助けをしてくれない？　危険が去ったようなら、急いでここから逃げ出すから

original: I'm too weak right now. Between the spiders and the coven, I'd be dead before escaping the cave.
string: 身体がひどく弱っているの。あちらにはクモ、こちらには魔術結社。洞窟から逃げる前に死んじゃうわ

original: How are you holding up?
string: 大丈夫か？

original: I'm feeling better, but Bashnag's curse won't wear off for weeks.
string: だいぶ楽になったけど、バシュナグの呪いはまだしばらくは解けない

original: How are you holding up?
string: 大丈夫か？

original: I won't be myself for some time. I just need to get out of here and recover.
string: 落ちつくには時間がかかるわ。とにかくここから出て、元気にならないと

original: How are you holding up?
string: 大丈夫か？

original: Of course! I undersand completely. You just put us in a room, and I'll do all the talking. No worries at all.
string: もちろんだ！　十分理解してる。部屋に案内してくれればいい。話す方は任せろ。心配無用だ

original: I'll consider it. Many of the people I deal with are... secretive. You know how it is.
string: 考えてみるわ。私が会ってる人って大体…　口が固いのよ。分かるでしょ

original: Well, I'll want to meet them next time they're around. Maybe you can give an introduction.
string: その、今度その人達が来たら、せひ会ってみたいな。紹介してくれるか？

original: Oh, just a matter of finding the right suppliers.
string: ちゃんとした仕入れ先を見つければいいだけよ

original: You know. Where do you get your goods? I am always amazed at how you manage to sell things so cheaply.
string: どこで品物を手に入れるんだ？　あまりにもお安く売るから、いつも驚いてるんだ

original: My... my what, now?
string: え…　私のなんですって？

original: Niranye, I just have to know -- what is your secret?
string: ニラナイ、どうしても知りたいんだ。どんな秘密がある？

original: Sorry, my scaly friend, you've come to the wrong place. Around here we don't ignore what's happening in the world.
string: 悪いが、間違った場所に来てしまったようだな。この辺りでは、世界で何が起こっているかを無視したりしないんだ

original: If it's all the same to you, Scouts-Many-Marshes prefers to eat and drink in peace.
string: 差し支えなければ、湿地帯の斥候に静かに食事をさせてやってほしい

original: Eight septims for breaking your back, and then you live in squalor. How much is your dignity worth?
string: 必死に頑張ってはした金をもらい、みすぼらしい暮らしをしている。お前の尊厳とやらの値段はいくらなんだ？

original: Eight septims per day, plus lodging.
string: 寝床が付いて、日給8ゴールドだ

original: How much?
string: いくらだ？

original: That's really none of your business...
string: お前にはまったく関係のない事だ…

original: How much do they pay you per day?
string: 1日いくらもらっているんだ？

original: Just you wait and see.
string: じきに分かるさ

original: Oh, I doubt that very much. Who would load their ships, then?
string: いや、そうは思わない。誰が奴らの船に荷を積み込むと思う？

original: Look around you. Don't you know what their little war is about? They want all non-Nords out of Skyrim. That means you and me.
string: よく見回してみろ。この戦争の目的が分からないのか？　奴らはノルド以外をスカイリムから追い出したいんだ。つまり、お前と俺をな

original: I think that's just their way. The Nords don't like anybody who's not a Nord, but they're not bad people, deep down.
string: ノルドはそういう連中だ。自分達以外の種族が嫌いなんだ。でも、根はそんなに悪い連中じゃない

original: Why do you even need to ask? They treat your people as bad as they do mine.
string: なぜそんな事を聞く必要がある？　お前らも連中にはひどい仕打ちを受けてるじゃないか

original: Why do the Nords bother you so much, Ambarys?
string: どうしてノルドはそんなに冷たく当たるんだ？　アムバリス

original: Either pour another drink or keep moving, Ambarys.
string: もう一杯注いでくれるか、立ち止まらないで。アムバリス

original: Touchy. Maybe some Dunmer lives in you yet.
string: 面倒だな。まだダンマー魂とやらがお前の中に生きてるらしい

original: What do you want from me? I work for them ok? We're not friends. They pay me, and I get the job done. That's it.
string: 何がほしいの？　ただ働いているだけなの。友達なんかじゃないわ。給料をもらって、仕事をしてる。それだけなのよ

original: What's new with the Cruel-Seas, Suvaris? Have they given you one of those helmets with the horns on them yet?
string: スヴァリス、クルーエル・シーに最近変わった事は？　もうあの角つき兜を連中からもらったか？

original: Here's what's going to happen. I'm going to pretend I didn't hear that, and you're going to leave me alone. Deal?
string: ここで何かが起きようとしてるわ。聞かなかった事にするから、ひとりにして。いい？

original: Fine, then. I guess some Dunmer are content to be their pets.
string: いいだろう。ダンマーは奴らのペットでいる事に満足してるらしい

original: Look, Ambarys, I just came here for a drink. I don't need any trouble.
string: いい、ただ飲み物を求めて来ただけなの。面倒は起こしたくないの

original: Don't you ever find it demeaning, working for that Nord family?
string: あのノルドのために働けだなんて、無理な要求だと思わないのか？

original: I... I'm sorry, dear, I've got some other customers. I'll be back around in a minute.
string: 悪いわね、他にもお客さんがいるの。すぐに戻ってくるから

original: What about being loyal to his wife?
string: 妻への忠実はどうしたんでしょう？

original: I know, dear. He's a busy man, though, and loyal to the Stormcloaks.
string: 分かっているわ。ただ、忙しい人だし、ストームクロークに忠実だからね

original: I just don't know what to do anymore. He's hardly ever in the temple. I see him at breakfast, and that's it.
string: どうしたらいいのか、もう分かりません。彼は聖堂にほとんどいないんです。朝食の時に会うっきりです

original: Here, let me get you some mead. This one's on me.
string: さあ、ほら、ハチミツ酒をどうぞ。これは私のおごりよ

original: It's been better, I'll be honest with you.
string: 正直言って、あまり良くありません

original: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. Is everything all right?
string: おやまあ、それは残念な事でしたね。大丈夫ですか？

original: Don't bother. I don't have much chance of seeing my husband these days. He's always up in the palace with Ulfric.
string: お構いなく。最近はほとんど夫に会ってないんです。夫はいつもウルフリックと宮殿にいるんです

original: Oh, Jora. Good to see you. I was wondering if you might ask Lortheim something for me.
string: まあ、ジョラ。会えて良かった。ローセイムに聞いてくれるよう頼みたい事があるのよ

original: Think nothing of it.
string: そんなことは考えないように

original: Oh, thank the gods you're in Windhelm, Calixto!
