string: こいつがストームクロークをやっつけたって？　そんな。ずっと昔に死んでるはずなのに

original: What in the nine holds is that?
string: 一体何なんだ？

original: Be careful men. There's bound to be more up ahead.
string: 気をつけて。この先にまだ大勢いるはずよ

original: Don't give them a chance to warn the others!
string: 仲間に警告するチャンスを与えるな！

original: If there's more gold where that came from, I'm in.
string: より収益が上がるなら、入ろう

original: That's the spirit! Larceny's in your blood... the telltale sign of a practiced thief.
string: その意気だ！　窃盗はお前の天賦だな…　熟達した盗賊の証さ

original: I think you'll do more than just fit in around here.
string: お前なら、ここに馴染むどころの話じゃなくなりそうだな

original: Don't know why I bothered. This place is a mess.
string: 何でわざわざ来たんだか。酷いところだ

original: If you were expecting a palace, then maybe you're not cut out for this line of work. Our methods involve secrecy and discretion.
string: もし宮殿みたいな場所を思い描いていたなら、この仕事には向いていないのかもな。俺達のやり方には秘密と慎重さが必要なんだ

original: Now... if you're done bellyaching like a child, how about handling a few deadbeats for me?
string: さて…　痛がる子供みたいに駄々をこねるのが終わったら、借金を踏み倒した連中を何とかしてもらえないか？

original: I almost got killed!
string: もう少しで死ぬところだった！

original: No risk, no reward. That's the way it goes, so you better get used to it.
string: 危険あっての報酬だ。それが事の運び方ってもんだよ、早く慣れるんだな

original: Now... if you're done bellyaching like a child, how about handling a few deadbeats for me?
string: さて…　痛がる子供みたいに駄々をこねるのが終わったら、借金を踏み倒した連中を何とかしてもらえないか？

original: If you're looking for a challenge, you've come to the right place.
string: 試練を求めてんのなら、いいところに来たな

original: A few drinks, a few laughs and a contest. What could be better?
string: 少し飲んで、少し笑って、勝負する。最高だろ？

original: Maybe you just aren't up to the challenge...
string: 挑戦する気はねえようだな…

original: What's happening?
string: 何が起こった？

original: You made it!
string: よく来てくれた！

original: We need to get inside. Follow me!
string: 中に入らなければ。ついて来い！

original: Come on! We need to get inside before that dragon comes back!
string: 来るんだ！　あのドラゴンが戻ってくる前に中へ入れ！

original: The path to Paarthurnax lies through this gate. I will show you how to open the way.
string: この門の先にパーサーナックスへの道がある。道を開ける方法を示そう

original: Enough of your dire predictions! We will talk about this another time.
string: お前の悲観的な予測はたくさんだ！　またの機会に聞こう

original: If we win. This war is going to drag on for years. I can feel it. We need to prepare for a long struggle ahead.
string: もしも勝てばの話です。戦争は何年も続くでしょう。そんな気がします。この先の長い戦いに備える必要があります

original: You're right. Why dilute the glory with too many souls fighting over it? We'll drive out the Empire and be celebrated as heroes when we win.
string: もっともだ。多くの者が勝ち取った栄光に水をさしてどうする？　勝てば帝国を駆逐した英雄として崇められるのだ

original: With respect, Jarl. You can't ask everyone to throw themselves against trained Legionnaires. Let's leave the fighting to the Stormcloaks.
string: 恐れながら首長。訓練された帝国軍の兵士を前に、身を投げ出せと命じる事はできません。ここはストームクロークに任せましょう

original: We are poised for glory, Jod. The Empire will never take Dawnstar while every last man, woman, and child here draws breathe!
string: 勝利は間近だぞ、ジョッド。帝国は決してドーンスターを占領できん。この地にひとりでも男、女、そして子供が生きている限りはな！

original: I don't want to talk about it.
string: そのことはもう話したくない

original: You don't want to talk about it, or you don't know?
string: 話したくないのか？　それとも分からないのか？

original: I don't want to talk about it.
string: そのことはもう話したくない

original: What is this feud you have with your wife? What started this?
string: なぜ奥さんと険悪になってる？　一体何が原因だ？

original: Never. Not until we turn this mine around, drive Beitild out of business, and force her to apologize to me for everything she's done!
string: 絶対に。この鉱山を建て直し、ベイティルドをつぶし、彼女がこれまでの事をすべて謝罪するまでは！

original: If you don't mind me saying, Leigelf. You're working too hard. Go home.
string: 気を悪くしないでほしいんだがね、レイゲルフ。君は働き過ぎだ。家に帰りたまえ

original: I'll, uh, just take that as a compliment.
string: それじゃ、誉め言葉と受け取っておくよ

original: It's good to hear you say that. I wish my wife was as simple as you.
string: それを聞いて安心した。女房もそれくらい単純だといいのに

original: Where else would I go? Dawnstar is my home and working here is my job.
string: どこへ行けと？　ドーンスターは故郷だし、ここで働くのが自分の仕事だ

original: Thank you for sticking by me.
string: ここまでありがとう

original: Uh, yes ma'am.
string: 分かりました、お嬢さん

original: You'll shut your mouth and get back to work, or you won't be a miner or a soldier by the day's end. Hear me?
string: おしゃべりはやめて作業に戻りなさい。でないと、結局は鉱山労働者にも兵士にもなれませんよ。聞いてますか？

original: Pride of the what? This isn't the Legion, boss. We're miners, not soldiers.
string: 何のプライドだ？　ここは帝国軍とは違う。兵隊じゃねえ、鉱山労働者なんだ

original: Work hard, now! The pride of Iron-Breaker Mine is on the line.
string: しっかり働いて！　アイアンブレーカー鉱山の誇りがかかっているんですよ

original: Drafted into a war, how could my life get worse?
string: 戦争に駆り出されたら、人生はどう悪くなるんだ？

original: No he isn't! He's the enemy, and we are going to crush him.
string: いいえ！　彼は敵です。踏みつぶしてやります

original: We're at war with Leigelf? Isn't he your husband?
string: レイゲルフとの戦争中？　あんたの旦那だろ？

original: Keep at it. We need to work twice as hard now that fat-headed Leigelf has declared war!
string: しっかり働きなさい。ばかなレイゲルフが戦争を始めたせいで、前の二倍も働かないといけないんですから！

original: I... well, let me think about it.
string: あの…　考えさせてくれ

original: Your people's war, I mean. The Nords. What kind of life would we be giving our little one if we stayed here?
string: 戦争はあなた達ノルドが起こしたのよ。ここに残っていたら、子供にどんな生活をさせることになると思う？

original: War of mine? It's not my war, Seren!
string: 私の戦争？　これは私の戦争ではない、セレン！

original: I'm just worried about raising a child in the middle of this war of yours.
string: あなた達が戦争をやっているせいで、子育てが心配よ

original: Hammerfell? I'm not against the idea, but why?
string: ハンマーフェル？　反対はしないが、なぜだ？

original: Rustleif, I've been wondering. Maybe after the baby is born, we should move to Hammerfell.
string: ラストリーフ、考えていたんだけど、赤ちゃんが生まれたらハンマーフェルに引っ越しましょうよ

original: Not hot enough. Does your Skyrim ever get warm, husband?
string: 暖かいとは言えないわ。だいたい、スカイリムが暑くなる事ってあるの？

original: The forge is hot today.
string: 今日は鍛冶場が熱い

original: So much for old soldiers settling down to a life of luxury, eh?
string: 贅沢な暮らしに身を落ち着ける話は、これくらいにしておく？

original: Of course. I would have it no other way.
string: もちろんだ。それ以外にはない

original: With you by my side, is that right Horik?
string: そばにはあなたが。そうよね、ホリック？

original: No. If we must fight, we will, and you will lead us to victory. As you always have.
string: 違います。戦えと言われれば戦います。あなたが勝利に導いてほしい。これまでと同じように

original: I'm fine, Horik. I just... are you worried about this war?
string: 大丈夫よ、ホリック。ただ…　あなたは、この戦争のことを心配してるの？

original: Are you all right? You seem tired.
string: 大丈夫か？　疲れてるな

original: You weren't. There's just not much to it.
string: そうじゃない。何もないだけだ

original: I see. You're a good soldier, Horik. I'm sorry for intruding.
string: 分かったわ。ホリック、あなたは優秀な軍人よ。邪魔立てして悪かったわ

original: No. Can't say there was. My parents died when I was young. You and the Legion have been my only family since.
string: 違う。そうじゃない。両親は、自分が若い頃に死んだ。お前と帝国軍以外に、家族を持った事はない

original: What about your family? There must have been someone waiting for you back at the farm. Wondering if you were ever coming home?
string: 私の家族が何よ？　農場であなたを待ってる人がいるんでしょう。もう帰らないかも知れないって心配してるんじゃない？

original: What's to say? I was born on a farm, joined the Legion when I came of age, and I've served you ever since.
string: よくある話だぞ？　農場で生まれて、年齢が達した時に帝国軍に参加して、それからずっとだ

original: You never talk much about yourself, do you Horik? I swear, these past 30 years you've been at my side, and I think I barely know you.
string: 自分のことはあまり話さないのね、ホリック。この30年そばにいてくれてるけど、あなたのことはほとんど知らないような気がするわ

original: Sorry, lass... I've got important things to do. We'll speak another time.
string: すまんな、小娘…　大事な用がある。また別の機会に話そう

original: Sorry, lad... I've got important things to do. We'll speak another time.
string: すまんな、小僧…　大事な用がある。また別の機会に話そう

original: I'm busy right now, lass. We can talk later.
string: 今忙しいんだ、小娘。また後で話そう

original: I'm busy right now, lad. We can talk later.
string: 今忙しいんだ、小僧。また後で話そう

original: Always a pleasure, boss. What can I do for you?
string: いつでも喜んで、ボス。どうしようか？

original: Pull up a seat and have a drink.
string: 席について一杯飲め

original: Ah, you're back.
string: おお、戻って来たか

original: Something troublin' ya? I'll listen.
string: 困っているなら相談に乗ろう

original: So, what can I do for ya today?
string: ところで、今日はどういう用件だ？

original: Still have quite a good bit of jobs available if you're looking for some extra coin.
string: もう少し小遣いを稼ぎたいなら、おいしい仕事はまだたくさんある

original: Need some gold? I may have some work for you.
string: ゴールドが必要か？　ぴったりの仕事があるかも知れない

original: Looking for work?
string: 仕事を探してるのか？

original: Got lots of jobs available. Interested?
string: 仕事は選り取りみどりだ。興味はあるか？

original: So, you're the one Brynjolf's been jabberin' about. Been waitin' to have a word with you.
string: それでは、ブリニョルフが騒いでいたのはお前の事か。話をするのを待っていた

original: I think you better listen to Mercer and Brynjolf first. We can talk later.
string: まずはメルセルとブリニョルフの話を聞くべきだ。話はそれからだ

original: Talk to me again if you prove yourself to Brynjolf.
string: ブリニョルフに自分の実力を証明してから話しに来てくれ

original: Come back later and I may have some work for you.
string: また後で来てくれ。その時なら仕事があるかも知れない

original: I think Brynjolf can give you all the information you need.
string: ブリニョルフが必要な情報をすべて教えてくれるだろう

original: Yeah?
string: ああ？

original: I'm listenin'.
string: 話を聞こう

original: Looking to fix your armor?
string: 鎧を修理してほしいのか？

original: Can I interest you in anything? Some fine armor perhaps?
string: 何か興味を持った物があったかな？　上質の鎧なんてどうだ？

original: Be glad to repair any damage to your Guild armor.
string: そのギルドの鎧に修復が必要なら、喜んで直すよ

original: So, name your poison! Ha ha ha. Oh, I never get tired of that one!
string: さあ、自分の毒を当ててみろ！　ハハハ。ああ、いつやっても面白いな

original: Need some sort of toxin for a special occasion? That's where I come in.
string: 大事な時のために毒はいるだろう？　そこで私の出番となるわけだ

original: I sell all sorts of poisons for almost every occasion.
string: どんな時にもピッタリなあらゆる毒を売っている

original: Looking for the best smith in Skyrim? You found it.
string: スカイリムで最高の鍛冶屋は、目の前にいるぞ

original: They don't call me the Ember-Master for nothing. What do you need?
string: エンバー・マスターって呼び名は伊達じゃない。何がいるんだ？

original: Need your weapon repaired? Or could I interest you in a new one?
string: 武器を修復したいのか？　それとも新しいのがほしいのか？

original: I've got all sorts of weapons for the discerning marksman. What can I get you?
string: 射手の力量に合わせて、あらゆる種類の武器を取り揃えてるよ。何をお求めかな？

original: If you're in the market for the finest bows money can buy, you're talking to the right person.
string: 金で手に入る最高の弓を探してるなら、お役に立つよ

original: Skilled, lethal and good-looking. Yep, it's a curse.
string: 腕が立ち、危険で、見た目もいい。ああ、これは呪いだな

original: Hey, let's talk a second.
string: なあ、ちょっと話さないか

original: You're making waves around here. I like that. If you ever want to talk about anything, you let me know.
string: このへんで騒ぎを起こしてるんだな。気に入った。話したいことがあったら、何でも言ってくれ

original: Hey, how's it going. Need pickpocket training?
string: よお、元気か。スリのワザを知りたくないか？

original: If you need pickpocket training, just let me know.
string: スリの訓練をしたかったら、言ってくれ

original: If you want to be a master pickpocket like me, I can get you there.
string: お前もスリの名人になりたかったら、教えてやるよ

original: If you wondering why they call me Vipir the Fleet, watch me outrun the town guard sometime.
string: 早業のバイパーって呼び名の理由を知りたかったら、町の衛兵を追い越すところを見てろ

original: I've been a part of this Guild for as long as Mercer has been Guild Master.
string: メルセルがギルドマスターになってから、ずっとこのギルドの一員だ

original: I might not be as big as some of my fellow Nords, but in a fight they can barely lay a hand on me.
string: 他のノルドよりも小さいかも知れないが、戦いになったら誰にだって楽勝だ

original: My specialty is pickpocketing. All I need is a rich mark, a moon-lit sky and I'm in my element.
string: 得意技はスリだ。金持ちの標的と、月明かりがあれば、本領を発揮できる

original: I wouldn't mind teaching the ways of the pickpocket... if the gold was right.
string: スリのやり方を教えてやってもいいぞ…　十分に金さえ払えばな

original: I miss the glory days of this place. We had more coin stacked in the vaults than we even knew what to do with.
string: ここの栄光の時代が懐かしい。貯蔵庫から金があふれて、使い道に困ったものだ

original: Come here a second.
string: ちょっとこっちに来てくれ

original: A lot of people are beginning to get impressed with you here. Me included. Just wanted to let you know.
string: 大勢の者達が感心しているぞ。自分も含めてな。ただ、それを知らせたかったんだ

original: Interest you in some marksman training?
string: 射撃訓練に興味を持ったか？

original: If you need marksman training, and you've got the coin... I'm ready to teach you.
string: 射撃訓練がしたくて金もあるなら…　いつでも教えるよ

original: What's on your mind?
string: 何だ？

original: Of course you can buy me a drink... you didn't need to say a word, but I heard you loud and clear.
string: もちろん、あんたのおごりでいい…　何も言わなくてよかったのに、はっきりと聞こえたよ

original: Ugh. The wine in Skyrim tastes like urine compared to the fine vintages we had in Valenwood.
string: うげ。スカイリムのワインはヴァレンウッドの高級ビンテージワインに比べると、小便のような味がする

original: I don't miss home one bit. I'm glad to leave that life behind me.
string: 故郷はこれっぽっちも恋しくない。あそこの暮らしを捨てて清々している

original: I'd much rather earn a living liberating others of their coin this way than spending my days as a carpenter like my father.
string: 父のように大工として暮らすより、他人の金を拝借して生計を立てる方がずっといい

original: It's not hard to fit in and make friends when you have the coin to make it happen.
string: 金さえあれば、仲間に溶け込んで友達を作るのも難しくない

original: I don't bother with silly pickpocketing jobs when I can make far more at the gambling table.
string: 賭博で大金を稼げるってのに、バカげたスリなどやってられるか

original: Let's talk for moment.
string: ちょっと話しましょう

original: Look, if I was a little harsh before, I just wanted you to know it's because you were new. Know what I mean?
string: ねえ、前に厳しくしたかも知れないけど、新人だったから覚えて欲しかっただけよ。分かるでしょ？

original: Well, hey there. What can Sapphire do for you?
string: あら、あなた。サファイアはお役に立てるかしら？

original: Back from a job, huh? Hope it went well.
string: 仕事帰りかしら？　うまくいった？

original: Want to talk? Go ahead.
string: 話したい？　さあどうぞ

original: They call me Sapphire because I love to steal them.
string: サファイアって呼ばれているのは、あれを盗むのが好きだからよ

original: Don't get me wrong, I'll steal any gem that isn't nailed down. But there's something about those blue stones that gets my blood boiling.
string: 間違えないでね。持ち運べる宝石なら何でも盗むわよ。でもあの青い石には、血を沸き立たせる何かがあるの

original: When people ask my real name, know what I tell them? Don't ask.
string: 本当の名前を聞かれたときに、なんて答えるか知ってる？　聞かないで

original: Sure I might have some dirt in my past, but that's just ancient history.
string: もちろん、過去の汚点ぐらいあるわよ。でも昔の話

original: I'm a deadeye marksman, lethal with a blade and dangerous in bed. And it only gets better from there.
string: 弓の名手で、死を招く剣の使い手、ベッドでも危険よ。そしてここからはもっと良い話

original: Last time someone cheated me, I cut off their hand. Still have it actually.
string: この前私をだました奴は、手を切り取ってやったの。それ、まだ持っているわ

original: Wanted to say something to you.
string: お前に言いたい事があったんだ

original: I think you're all right. In fact, I'm kind of impressed how well you're doing around here. Just keep it between us, okay?
string: お前は大丈夫そうだ。むしろ、最近の活躍に感心してるよ。ここだけの話だぞ、いいな？

original: Yeah, you need something?
string: うん、何か必要かい？

original: What's going on?
string: 元気か？

original: Sure, we can talk a minute.
string: ああ、ちょっと話そう

original: I've seen a lot of thieves come and go, but I've never seen anyone as good as me.
string: 大勢の盗賊が現れては消えるのを見てきたが、自分ほどの奴には会った事がない

original: I could crack the lock on any house blindfolded before you even got your picks out of your pocket.
string: 目隠しされた状態でも、ポケットからピックを出すより早く、どんな家の錠前も破る事ができる

original: Been in the Guild a long time... joined right after Brynjolf. Not interested in leadership though, that's more his kind of thing.
string: 長い間、ギルドに入っていた…　ブリニョルフのすぐ後からだ。だが地位には興味がなくてな、どちらかというと奴向きの話だった

original: I don't care if Vex was chosen as a Guild Third over me, she deserved it.
string: 私を飛び越えて、ヴェックスがギルドの三位に選ばれた時も気にならなかった。彼女にはその資格があったからな

original: I kind of like watching things from where I am. Making money is all I care about.
string: 今の立場から物事を見るのが好きだ。金もうけにしか興味がないしな

original: Hey, I want to talk to you... now.
string: おい、お前に話がある…　今すぐにだ

original: You're pretty tough, I respect that. Bringing in a lot of coin for the Guild, making us look good too. Let me know if you need anything, okay?
string: お前は本当に根性があるよな。尊敬するよ。このギルドに大量の金をもたらしてくれるし、評判も上げている。何か必要な物があれば言ってくれよ

original: Need something?
string: 何か用か？

original: You want to talk to me? Okay.
string: 話がしたいのか？　いいぞ

original: Yeah, I guess I have a minute. What do you want?
string: ああ、時間ならあるしな。何の用だ？

original: I'm the heavy hitter around here. When someone needs pushing around, I'm the one they send in.
string: 俺は腕っぷしの強さで知られてる。誰か叩きのめしたい奴がいたら、俺が送られるってわけだ

original: Used to run with a bandit clan in The Pale. Turns out I didn't like them and they didn't like me, so we parted ways.
string: 前はペイルで山賊団と一緒に行動してたんだ。だけど、お互い気に入らなくて、今は別々だけどな

original: Brynjolf pulled me in a few years ago. Said the Guild was lacking some muscle, so I joined up.
string: 数年前、ブリニョルフに引き抜かれたんだ。ギルドが軟弱になってきてる、と言われてな。それで一員になったわけだ

original: I've busted heads for Maven Black-Briar when she wants to keep her name out of it. Pays good, so why not?
string: メイビン・ブラック・ブライアが自分の名前を出したくない時は、俺が代わりに動いている。金払いはいい。それで十分だろ？

original: I leave all that sneaking around nonsense to everyone else; believe me, when I'm coming for you... you'll know it.
string: コソコソ誰かをつけ回すのは、俺のやり方じゃない。本当さ、俺に狙われたら…　すぐに分かるだろうからな

original: Got a minute? Wanted to say something.
string: 時間はあるか？　言っておきたい事がある

original: I've never seen anyone with skills like yours. I just wanted to let you know that if you need anything, you can talk to me.
string: お前のように優れた者は初めてだ。何か必要な物があれば、訪ねてきてくれ

original: Hey, good to see you!
string: やあ、会えて嬉しいよ！

original: Something I can help with or do you just want to talk?
string: 何か手助けできる事はあるか？　それとも話をしたいだけか？

original: My brother in crime... what'd you need?
string: 罪を犯し者が…　何の用だ？

original: My sister in crime. What'd you need?
string: 罪を犯し者が…　何の用だ？

original: Name's Rune. Yeah, rune... just like you're thinking.
string: 名前はルーン。そう、ルーンだ…　想像通りだよ

original: Have no idea what my birth name really is, and I frankly don't care.
string: 生まれた時の本当の名前は分からないが、正直、どうでもいいんだ

original: Being brought up by a poor family, I had to learn how to steal if I wanted to make ends meet.
string: 貧乏な家庭で育ったため、生きてくために盗みも覚えざるを得なかった

original: Brynjolf actually caught me trying to pick his pocket in the market. If he was anyone else I would have gotten away with it.
string: 実は、市場でブリニョルフからスリを働こうとしてバレてしまったんだ。彼じゃなかったら、気づかれなかったろうにな

original: I'm glad Brynjolf decided to let me join. Been trying to make some coin for him ever since.
string: ブリニョルフが仲間に加えてくれると知って嬉しかった。それ以来、彼のために金を稼いでいる

original: Hmph, so you're the one everyone's falling over.
string: ふむ、皆が噂しているのはお前の事か

original: I don't know, you don't look so impressive to me. I mean, you're no Gray Fox, but you must be doing something right.
string: さて、そう大した人物には見えないがな。つまり、グレイフォックスではないが、正しい行いをしているという事か

original: I'm busy, is this important?
string: 忙しいんだ、大事な用件か？

original: Are you bothering me for a reason?
string: 何か理由があって邪魔をしているんだろうな？

original: Oh, this should be good.
string: おお、これはいいな

original: We haven't met.
string: まだ会ってない

original: Name's Garthar. Remember it, because you're going to hear a lot about me.
string: 名前はガーサーだ。噂はよく耳にするはずだから、覚えておけ

original: Still learning the ropes, but I'll get the hang of it.
string: まだコツを覚えているところだが、すぐに慣れるさ

original: Been doing a few jobs for Vex... how about you?
string: ヴェックスの仕事をいくつかこなしてきた…　あんたは？

original: Did you want something?
string: 何かほしかったのか？

original: Our Guild Master graces me with a visit. What can I do for you?
string: ギルドマスターのご来臨を賜り光栄、ってね。何の用だい？

original: Steal anything worth talking about?
string: 何かまともなもんは盗めたか？

original: Back with good news I trust.
string: 吉報を待ってる

original: Well? You done or what?
string: で？　やったのか、どうなんだ？

original: Out with it. Time is money.
string: さっさと言いなよ。盗賊いわく、時は金なりってね

original: So, feeling loose? How about you run a job for me.
string: 手持ちぶさた？　なら仕事を頼まれてくれるか？

original: Need a few spare septims? I got the cure right here.
string: 金欠か？　いい治療法を教えてやるよ

original: I have work if you've got the backbone.
string: 骨のある奴にしか任せられない仕事があるんだ

original: Ready for some work or you just going to wander around all day?
string: 仕事をする気はあるか？　それとも一日中その辺をぶらぶらしてるつもりかよ？

original: So, you're the new recruit everyone's been talking about, eh? I guess it's about time we talked.
string: じゃ、皆が言ってた新入りってのはあんたか…　そうだろ？　あたしらが話をする頃合いという事だな

original: After you talk to Brynjolf and Mercer, come back and see me.
string: ブリニョルフとメルセルに会ってから戻ってきなよ

original: I have no business with you.
string: あんたに用はないね

original: I'm busy. Don't you have something to do?
string: あたしは忙しいんだ。あんた他にやる事ないのか？

original: I'm not here to hold your hand. Figure this one out for yourself.
string: 手取り足取り教えてやるつもりはないよ。それぐらい自分で考えな

original: You need advice? Talk to Brynjolf... I got better things to do.
string: 助言がほしいのか？　ブリニョルフにでも聞いてくれ…　あたしは他にやる事があるんだ

original: I have no business with you.
string: あんたに用はないね

original: Whatever you're selling, I'm not buying.
string: 何を持ってこようが、買うつもりはないぞ

original: Don't you have better things to do than disturb me?
string: 人の邪魔をする以外にやる事はないのか？

original: This better be important, I'm quite busy.
string: 大事な用だろうな、こっちは忙しいんだ

original: I'd had Eorlund forge this for Thorald. It was to be a present for his return. I suppose he can't have it now.
string: ソラルドのためにと、これをエオルンドに作らせた。戻ってきたら、あげるつもりだったんだ。でも今あの子には渡せないね

original: Why don't you take it? We can always make another for the day when this war ends and Thorald can come home.
string: あんたが受け取ってくれないかい？　この戦争が終わってソラルドが帰ってきたら、いつだってまた作れるんだ

original: With Eorlund gone, I'm afraid I can't offer you much in the way of thanks. But please, take this. It's the least I can do.
string: エオルンドがいなくなったから、大したお礼はできないけど、これを受け取っておくれ。せめてもの気持ちだ

original: He said to tell you to "suffer the winter's cold wind."
string: 彼はこう言っていた「冬の寒気に耐えるものが…」

original: "...for it bears aloft next summer's seeds." That's my boy.
string: “…夏に空高く種を飛ばす”。ああ、あの子だ

original: So it's true, then. For now, it's enough to know that he's alive. I can find peace in that.
string: 本当なんだね。とにかく無事だと分かっただけでもよかった。ほっとしたよ

original: Thank you, dear friend. You've given me back my son.
string: 心から感謝するよ。あんたは息子を取り戻してくれた

original: I'm afraid he's not here. He didn't think it was safe to return.
string: いや、ここにはいない。戻るのは危険だと思っていたようだ

original: What? After all this, I can't even see him?
string: 何だって？　ここまで来て、会えないのかい？

original: How... How do I know you're telling me the truth, and not just what I want to hear?
string: じゃあどうしてあんたの話が事実だと分かるんだい？　何か証拠でもあるのかい？

original: Thorald is safe.
string: ソラルドは無事だ

original: Is he? You've saved him?! I must see him at once!
string: 本当に？　あんたが救ってくれたのかい？　すぐに会わなきゃ！

original: Well, it's a winding road up the mountain just ahead. You'll know you're in the right place once you spot the old watchtower.
string: ええと、この先の山道は曲がりくねっているわ。古い監視塔が見えたら、その道であってるはずよ

original: Once you get to the tower, head north. Bleak Falls Barrow should be just around the corner further up.
string: 塔に着いたら、北に向かって。ブリーク・フォール墓地は、さらに進んで角を曲がった所よ

original: How much farther do I have to walk?
string: まだ遠いのか？

original: This is the bridge out of town. The path up the mountain to the northwest leads to Bleak Falls Barrow.
string: 町の外につながる橋よ。北西方向に山を登ると、ブリーク・フォール墓地に着くわ

original: I guess I should get back to my brother. He'll throw a fit if I take too long. Such a child....
string: 私は兄弟の所に戻った方がよさそうね。待たされると腹を立てるの。ほんと子供なんだから…

original: Where are we now?
string: 今どこにいる？

original: Oh, never mind.
string: ああ、気にしないで

original: Why would they be looking at me? Are they upset about the service?
string: 奴らはどうしてこっちを見る？　サービスが気に入らないのか？

original: It'll do you good! Maybe you could visit Irgnir or Fruki on your way out? I've seen them looking at you when they come in for drinks....
string: いい事があるはずよ！　途中でイルグニールやフルーキを訪ねてみたら？　あの人達、飲みに来た時に父さんを見てたわ…

original: Why would I do that? There's work to be done here.
string: なぜそんなことを？　ここに仕事があるのに

original: I was wondering, father. Maybe you should take a day off and head into town. I could watch the inn while you're away.
string: 父さん、考えがあるの。1日休んで、町に行ってみたら？　その間、宿の事は任せておいて

original: I'm sorry. I just don't feel up to entertaining anyone just now.
string: すまないね。今は誰かを楽しませようって気になれないんだ

original: I'm sure she would want you to be happy, father. Entertaining the guests and drinking and making your lewd jokes like before.
string: 母さんも、父さんには幸せになってもらいたいはずよ。以前のようにお客を楽しませて、お酒を飲んで、品のない冗談を言ったりして

original: No, Karita. I don't think I could.
string: いや、カリタ。無理だろうな

original: Father, do you want to talk? About mother?
string: 父さん、話がしたいの？　母さんの事？

original: Thank you, Madena. I appreciate your assistance.
string: ありがとう、マデナ。手伝ってくれて助かるわ

original: I, well, no of course not. I would be glad to help.
string: いえ、めっそうもない。喜んでお手伝いしますとも

original: Actually, I was just wondering if you could make sure people are tended to if they get hurt. I'm sure you wouldn't object to that.
string: 実は、負傷した人々が確実に手当てを受けられるようにしてもらいたいの。あなたなら異論はないと思うけど

original: If this is about battle magic, forget it. I've told every Jarl I've served under that I won't....
string: 戦闘魔法の話なら結構です。今まで仕えた首長全員に言いました、私はもう…

original: Madena, I was wondering if you could help me with something. Your magic would be invaluable.
string: マデナ、よかったら手を貸してもらえないかしら。あなたの魔法が必要なの

original: Still suspicious of me. Well, don't say I never offered.
string: まだ疑っているようですが、とにかく提案はしましたからね

original: I said I'm fine, Madena. I won't have some court mage fixing me up like some magical experiment.
string: マデナ、大丈夫だと言っただろう。王宮魔術師の治療はいらない。実験材料にされるのは嫌だ

original: I know old men sometimes have pains in their legs when they rise from bed. I know a few spells that could help.
string: 年をとると時々、ベッドから起きる時に足が痛むものですよ。いい呪文を知っていますよ

original: I'm fine, Madena.
string: 大丈夫だ、マデナ

original: I've seen you walking with a bit of pain sometimes, Horik.
string: 痛そうに歩いているのを見ましたよ、ホリック

original: Well, at the first sign of battle I'll be comfortably sitting in my room, waiting for it to end, so don't you worry.
string: 戦いの兆しがあっても、私は部屋でくつろぎながら終わるのを待っていますよ。心配はいりません

original: So you say. We'll see if that's true when the Stormcloaks make their move.
string: だろうな。ストームクロークが動いたら、それが本当かどうか確かめよう

original: I'll tell you the same thing I told Skald. I'm here to help the people of Dawnstar, not play politics. Point your suspicions of treachery elsewhere.
string: スカルドにも言いましたが、私はドーンスターの人々を助けに来たんです。政略のためではありません。背信の疑いならよそへ向けて下さい

original: I want you to know I don't trust you, Madena. And I'll be watching you.
string: お前を信用していないんだ、マデナ。監視しているからな

original: Yes, Legate.
string: ええ、特使

original: Oh, don't be such an old stick, Horik. I was joking. I can do that, you know. Redo the battle plans. I'll look over them later.
string: 古臭いこと言わないで、ホリック。ただの冗談よ。ちゃんとやれるったら。戦術を練り直して。後で目を通すから

original: I'm sorry, Legate. I didn't want to imply anything about your ability to lead. You're a hero to the Empire, and I....
string: 特使、すまない。指揮する能力について何か言ったわけじゃないんだ。帝国にとってあなたは英雄だ。そして、私に…

original: Maybe you're right. I guess the battles I won yesterday won't win today's wars.
string: そうかも知れないわ。昨日までどれほど戦いを制しても、今日の戦争に勝てるとは限らないわ

original: Considering how the Great War ended, I think we need to be cautious about what we rely on.
string: 大戦の終わり方を考えて、どっちに肩入れするか慎重にならないとな

original: I don't think that's needed, Horik. It's the same strategy we used for every major defense during the Great War. It'll serve just as well now.
string: それは必要ないと思うわ、ホリック。大戦の時、大規模な防衛に使った戦略と同じよ。今回もまた役に立つはずだわ

original: We should go over our strategy again in case the Stormcloaks attack.
string: ストームクロークの攻撃に備えて、戦術を見直しておくべきだろう

original: Shor's bones, I hope you're right.
string: ショールの骨にかけて、そう願うわ

original: Yes, Legate. No one is getting through us.
string: ああ、特使。誰もここを突破できない

original: Keep the guard alert. I want to make sure no townspeople get hurt if there's trouble.
string: 衛兵に警戒を怠らせないで。何か起きても、住民に被害を出すわけにはいかないの

original: Brings back memories. Do you have any orders for me, Legate?
string: 昔を思い出すな。特使、何か命令はないか？

original: Just like old times, huh Horik? You and me fighting in a war over some forsaken scrap of land.
string: 前みたいにね、ホリック？　神に見放された土地をめぐって戦うのよ

original: I don't think so, Madena. There will be no deserters in this hold, and that's final.
string: そうはいかん、マデナ。この要塞を脱走するものは許さん。絶対にな

original: Yes, that's exactly what I'm asking. I'm not a Nord, I'm a Breton, and I have no wish to fight this war.
string: その事を言っているんです。私はノルドではなくブレトンです。この戦いに参加する意思はありません

original: You wish to leave now? In Skyrim's moment of triumph, just before we cast off the yoke of Imperial rule?
string: 立ち去りたいだと？　スカイリムの勝利の瞬間に、帝国の支配というくびきを振り払う直前にか？

original: Skald, I've been meaning to ask you for a leave of absence. I wish to return to High Rock until this war is over.
string: スカルド、私は休暇を頂くつもりです。戦争が終わるまでハイロックへ戻りたいのです

original: Fine, but this isn't over Madena. We'll talk again.
string: いいだろう、話は終わりではないぞ、マデナ。また話そう

original: When I came here, my only duties were to cure crop diseases and occasionally light a bonfire on holidays. I didn't sign up to kill.
string: ここに来た時の任務は、作物の病気を治す事と、祝日にかがり火を灯す事だけでした。人殺しに来たんじゃありません

original: What good is a court mage if she refuses to fight? Where's your sense of duty?
string: 戦いを拒否する王宮魔術師がなんの役に立つ？　お前には忠誠心がないのか？

original: I told you before, Skald, I have no interest in taking sides in this war. I've no desire to be killed.
string: スカルド、この戦争ではどちら側にもつく気はないと言ったでしょう。殺されるのはごめんです

original: Madena, can we count on your spells to assist us in this war? The Empire is bound to bring their battlemages against us.
string: マデナ。お前の魔法で戦を助けてくれると信じていいか？　帝国は必ずや魔闘士を差し向けてくる

original: Uh, yes sir. That's me. The oafish servant.
string: ええ、そうです。間抜けな召使いとは私のことです

original: A servant? Enlisting in the Stormcloaks? Ah, Bulfrek, that's why I like having you about. You're always good for a laugh.
string: 召使いが？　ストームクロークに入隊するだと？　ううむ、バルフレック。だからお前をそばにおいておきたいんだ。お前はいつも笑わせてくれる

original: Well, I was thinking sir, with the war going on and all. Maybe, I could enlist? Fight the Imperials?
string: 実は、戦火がやまぬなか考えたのですが、私も出征し、帝国軍と戦うわけにはいかないでしょうか？

original: You, have a request of me, Bulfrek? This should be interesting.
string: お前に願いがあるだと。バルフレック？　こいつは面白い

original: Skald, if you don't mind sir, I have a request.
string: スカルド、恐れながらお願いの儀が

original: Exactly, Bulfrek. You always know your place.
string: そのとおりだ。バルフレック。身分をわきまえているな

original: Yes, my Jarl. We could hardly waste anyone else's precious time on such a tedious task.
string: はい、族長。そのようなつまらぬ仕事のために、誰かの貴重な時間を費やすわけにはいきません

original: Bulfrek, I have an order of swords and armor from the local blacksmith coming here. I need every piece polished to a fine shine.
string: バルフレック、鍛冶屋に注文しておいた剣と鎧が届けられる。全部ピカピカに磨いておけ

original: I won't have you rob our soldiers of their chance to drive out the Empire. I'm done discussing this, Jod.
string: 兵士達が帝国を追い出すチャンスを奪わせはしない。この話は終わりだ、ジョッド

original: Glory is meaningless if they have no home to return to. I urge you to lower our commitments to the front until I'm sure we're safe.
string: 戻る家がなければ、勝利になど何の意味もありません。安全が確保されるまで前線の兵を下げるべきです

original: Nonsense. The best place for our men is driving the Imperials back. I will ensure that men from Dawnstar get every opportunity for glory.
string: バカバカしい。私の部下に適した役割は帝国軍を撃退する事だ。ドーンスターの男達には、栄光を手にする機会を与えてやる

original: You keep pledging more and more of our guard to the frontlines. The way this is going, we won't be able to defend our own borders.
string: 衛兵を次々と前線に投じておいでですが、このままでは我々の国境を守る事ができなくなります

original: Safety? Don't I have you to handle the town's safety? What is this about, Jod?
string: 治安だと？　町の治安はお前に任せてるはずだぞ？　どういう事だ、ジョッド？

original: My Jarl, I have concerns about the safety of Dawnstar.
string: 首長、ドーンスターの安全にも不安があります

original: Please, you can't leave me in here! If you let me out I can show you where they hide their best treasure.
string: 頼む、置き去りにしないでくれ！　ここから連れ出してくれたら、奴らが財宝を隠してる場所を教えてやる

original: One of those things has the key to this cage. If you get me out of here I'll help you slaughter the rest of those crows.
string: 奴らのどれかがこの檻の鍵を持ってる。ここから出してくれたら、残りのカラスどもを片づけるのに手を貸そう

original: Please! Help me get out of this cage. I don't know why those things locked me up and I don't want to wait around to find out.
string: 頼む！　この檻から出るのに手を貸してくれ。なぜ閉じ込められたか分からんが、今すぐ出たいんだ

original: Hey! Over here! Get me out of here!
string: おい！　こっちだ！　ここから出してくれ！

original: Hey you! Let me out! I can help!
string: おいあんた！　ここから出してくれ！　力になるぞ！

original: The bastards... somehow they managed to kill Skjor.
string: あいつら…　汚い手でスコールを殺したのよ

original: Yours was not an easy transformation. But you're still alive, so congratulations.
string: 大変な変身だったわね。でも死ななかったんだから良かったじゃない

original: We even have a celebration planned for you.
string: あなたのために、お祝いも用意してあるのよ

original: Actually... on second thought, I'll just kill you!
string: あいにく…　気が変わったんだ。あんたを殺してやろうってな！

original: Now that we've got that out of the way, I'll take everything you have... or your life.
string: さて、これで邪魔されることもない。あんたの身ぐるみを剥がすとするか…　それとも命をもらおうか

original: I'm glad they didn't find my lucky dagger. It's time to gut these rotten birds. Lead the way!
string: 幸運のダガーが無事でよかったよ。これであの腐れ鳥公どもをさばいてやる。先導してくれ！

original: Do you need help?
string: 手を貸そうか？

original: Not now! It's time to get back at these crows.
string: 今はいい！　それより、このカラスどもに礼をしないとな

original: (Sharedinfo)
string: (共有情報)

original: No! Don't leave me here! I beg you to let me out!
string: 待て！　置いてかないでくれ！　ここから出してくれ！

original: Please! I'll pay you. I'll give you whatever you want. Just don't leave me here!
string: 後生だ！　金は払う。ほしいものは何でもやる。見捨てないでくれ！

original: Hurry! Get me out of here!
string: 早く！　ここから出してくれ！

original: Use the key to open the door! We have to be quick!
string: 鍵を使って扉をあけるんだ！　急がないと！

original: If I wanted to hear a tall tale, I'll read a children's storybook. Get some better stories, Vipir.
string: そんな夢のような話が聞きたかったら、子供向けの本でも読めばいい。もっといい話を持ってこいよ、バイパー

original: Well, if you don't want to hear it, that's your loss.
string: まあ、聞きたくないなら、損をするのはそっちだから

original: Is this your tale of single-handedly fighting off a pack of trolls or my favorite... where you bedded four women on the same night?
string: トロールの集団を1人で退治したというお前の武勇伝か？　それとも、お前が一晩で4人の女と寝たっていう…　俺のお気に入りの部分か？

original: So, the ending of my tale I began earlier...
string: で、前に話し始めたお話の最後だがな…

original: You just better hope this one isn't another waste of my coin.
string: 今回こそゴールドが無駄にならない事を祈ってろ

original: I don't understand it either. They were a sure thing, I swear.
string: こっちだって分からない。確かだったんだ。本当だって

original: I hope this deal goes through. I'm putting quite a bit of coin on the line... and the last two you set up fell through.
string: 取引が成立する事を願うよ。かなりのゴールドを賭けてるからな… 最近のお前の計画は、2回続けて失敗してるしな

original: All right. I have everything you asked for all ready to go.
string: いいだろう。頼まれたものはすべて用意してある

original: No, and I'm not about to either. I value my life you know... you may want to remember that for yourself.
string: いいえ。そしてする気もないわ。命を大切にしているの…　自分のために心に留めておいた方が良いわ

original: What about Mercer? Have you asked him?
string: メルセルはどうなんだ？　聞いてみたか？

original: If he does, he isn't telling me a thing. I've asked, but all I get from him are more questions.
string: もしそうなら、彼からは何も聞いてないわ。質問したけど、もっとたくさん質問されただけだった

original: You seem to be a bit closer to Brynjolf than the rest of us. Is he giving you any idea why this place seems to be falling apart?
string: 他の者達よりもブリニョルフと少しは親しいようだな。ここが崩壊していく理由を何か言っていなかったか？

original: No, but I know that you're going to turn up missing if you keep up this kind of talk.
string: いいえ。でもこんな話を続けていたなら、あなたも行方不明になるわよ

original: You stupid cow. You don't know what you're missing.
string: 馬鹿な奴だな。自分が見逃しているものの価値も知らないで

original: Vipir "the Fleet." The only man who's foolish enough to name himself after his bedroom prowess.
string: “早業”バイパーね。ベッドの上の武勇伝を二つ名にする馬鹿は、あの男だけよ

original: So, Sapphire. Can I do anything for you, or more to the point... to you?
string: で、サファイア。何かできることは？　お前に対して…　個人的にね

original: This place is getting worse and worse.
string: ここの状況は悪くなる一方だ

original: She said that she barely had enough coin to cover it and I should come back later. Can you imagine that?
string: 彼女が言うには、コインがぎりぎりだからまた後で来いだと。信じられるか？

original: I think I know, but go ahead.
string: 分かっているが、好きにしろ

original: I tried to fence some goods to Tonilia, and you know what she told me?
string: トニリアに商品を売ろうとしたらさ、彼女、なんて言ったと思う？

original: I'll keep that in mind.
string: 心に留めておくよ

original: Hey, I still have a contact in Valenwood that may have some work for us. You're welcome to join me.
string: ヴァレンウッドにまだツテがあるんだ。そこで仕事をもらえるかも知れない。喜んで迎え入れるよ

original: Yeah, I know what you mean. If things don't start getting better soon, I may look for work elsewhere.
string: ああ、言いたいことは分かるよ。すぐに事態が好転しないなら、どこか別のところで仕事を探し始めるかもな

original: What in the name of Oblivion is going on in this place?
string: 一体全体、この場所で何が起こっているんだ？

original: I think if Brynjolf catches wind of it, he'll boot you right out of here... so drop it already!
string: ブリニョルフが聞きつけたら、追い出されるだろうな…　やめておけ！

original: Well, yes! Please!
string: ああ、そうだ！　お願いだ！

original: Your idea to start a brothel, right? Do you want me to tell you exactly what I think?
string: 女を売る商売を始める事についてか？　俺がどう思ってるか聞きたいか？

original: Hold a moment, Rune. What did you think about my idea?
string: ちょっと待て、ルーン。俺の考えをどう思う？

original: Brynjolf, something stinks around here and it's more than just the Ratway. We all know it. The question is, what's Mercer going to do about it?
string: ブリニョルフ、こりゃ何かがにおうね。ラットウェイだけの話じゃない。みんな分かってるはずさ。問題は、メルセルがそれにどう関わってるかって事

original: Well, I see your wounds have healed but your pride still needs some time.
string: 身体の傷は治っているが、誇りの方はまだ少し時間がかかりそうだな

original: Pretty angry actually. I can't believe I botched the Goldenglow job. That should have been like stealing a sweetroll from a baby.
string: 実際かなりむかついてるよ。このあたしがゴールデングロウの仕事をしくじったなんてさ。あんなの、赤子の手からスイートロールを盗むぐらいちょろいはずだったんだ

original: How are you feeling, Vex?
string: 調子はどうだ、ヴェックス

original: Mercer is being Mercer. If he has a plan to get us out of this rut, then he isn't sharing it with me.
string: メルセルは相変わらずだ。この窮地から抜け出す計画があるんだとしても、俺には何一つ伝わってない

original: Well, what the hell is Mercer going to do about this mess? Have you even talked to him?
string: ああーくそ、メルセルの奴、この窮地をどうしてくれるんだ？　あんたは話をしてないのか？

original: Thank you, Vex. You've always been the most reliable one in the Guild.
string: ありがとうよ、ヴェックス。ギルドでは相変わらずお前が一番信頼できる

original: I've picked up some new clients and did a few jobs on my own, but I'm not sure if that will cover our expenses.
string: 何人か新しい依頼人を見つけて、あたし自身いくつか仕事をしたが、それでも出費を賄いきれるかどうか…

original: Oh my... umm, you won't let Mercer hear about this will you? Ahem.
string: 何という…　ううむ。この話をメルセルの耳に入れるつもりはないな？　ふん

original: You idiot. He said "firs" not "furs." It was a damn logging caravan!
string: ど阿呆ー！　奴は“ホウセキ”じゃなくて“ホオノキ”と言ったんだ。あれは材木商人のキャラバンだったんだよ！

original: That's impossible. I distinctly heard that lout in the tavern say it was a full shipment of furs. They should be worth a fortune.
string: そんなはずはない。酒場の酔っぱらいが全部毛皮の積み荷だと言っていたのをはっきりと聞いた。相当な価値になるはずだ

original: Delvin, that last shipment we heisted on the Cyrodiil frontier was worthless!
string: デルビン、シロディール国境でこないだ盗んだ荷、ありゃ無価値なガラクタだったよ！

original: When you're in your grave and I'm standing over it. Now get out of my way!
string: あんたがくたばったら墓参りにいってやるよ。だからそこをどきな！

original: Oh, really? Well then... how can I make that happen?
string: なんと、本当か？　それなら…　どうやって実行する？

original: Absolutely.
string: もちろんだ

original: So, what do you think, my dear? Could a beautiful woman like you ever see yourself with an old codger like me?
string: ところでどう思う？　君のような美人が、私のような偏屈な老いぼれと一緒にいるのを見た事があったか？

original: You're an idiot.
string: お前は馬鹿だな

original: So is it true, bandits get... you know, real friendly with the wildlife?
string: つまりこうか、山賊は…　そうだな、野生生物と本当に仲良くなるのか？

original: Yeah, what of it?
string: ああ、それがどうした？

original: So, Thrynn, you were a bandit, huh?
string: つまり、スリン、お前は山賊だったのか？

original: I will, I will...
string: はいはい、分かった分かった…

original: You tell this sorry bunch of thieves that they need to put down their flagons and get to work if they want to keep their status!
string: もし今の地位を保ちたかったら、酒瓶を置いて働きやがれと、その情けねえ盗賊共に伝えとけ！

original: If I told you that, I'd be lying. We haven't had a bite in weeks. Our clients are starting to get angry.
string: もしそう言うとしたら嘘になる。もう一週間もエサがかかっていない。客はご機嫌ななめになってきているし

original: Delvin, please tell me you have good news.
string: デルビン、頼むからいい知らせだと言ってくれ

original: I'll speak to the Jarl and see what I can do. Just keep them at bay a little longer.
string: 首長と話をして策を練ろう。もう少しだけ奴らを食い止めておいてくれ

original: Normally I'd agree, but we've already lost so many contacts across Skyrim. If we lose the ones in Riften, we may as well close up shop.
string: 普段なら同意するところだが、スカイリム中ですでに何人もの取引先を失っている。もしリフテンも失っちまったら、俺達はもう失業同然だ

original: There's no need to be concerned. We've been through more difficult times than this.
string: 心配するほどでもない。こんなのは序の口だ。もっとやばい橋だって渡ってきたからな

original: I think we need to prepare for the worst. The coffers are dwindling and I can barely keep our contacts happy.
string: 最悪の事態を覚悟しないといけないかも知れん。俺達の資金は減りつつあり、取引先もやっとこさ満足させている状態だ

original: Two reasons. He's rich and because we need every sword we can get right now.
string: 理由は2つ。奴が金持ちなのと、使える戦い手はできるだけほしいからだ

original: Remind me why we even bother to allow him to be a part of the Guild.
string: なぜ奴をわざわざギルドの一員にする必要があるのか、教えてくれ

original: Yes, I know. That last job was my fault. I obviously thought Niruin was ready, but I was wrong.
string: ああ、分かっている。あの最近の仕事は俺がしくじったせいだ。ニルインなら楽勝だと思っていたんだが、その判断が誤っていた

original: Do we have anyone reliable to send out there? I don't want to look the fool again in front of her, Brynjolf.
string: 誰か送り込むとしたら、適任者はいるか？　もう彼女の前で恥はかきたくないんだ、ブリニョルフ

original: Maven has been nagging us about her request. Any thoughts?
string: メイビンが彼女の要請についてしつこく訊いてきている。誰か考えのある奴は？

original: Yes, I'm afraid you're right. Such a shame...
string: 残念だがお前は正しいよ。まったく…

original: I have. I think we may have to turn this one over to the Dark Brotherhood.
string: ああ。どうやらこいつは闇の一党にでも引き渡さないといけないようだな

original: I trust you've applied the appropriate pressure in order to change their mind?
string: あいつらを心変わりさせるのに、ちゃんと圧力はかけたんだろう？

original: Sorry Mercer, they no longer wish to be involved in our operation.
string: すまないなメルセル、もう俺達の作戦には関わりたくないとよ

original: Brynjolf, have you had a chance to speak to our contact in Whiterun?
string: ブリニョルフ、ホワイトランにいる仲間と話したか？

original: Thank you so much for taking care of those thieves. The Riverwood Trader is back to the way it used to be!
string: 盗賊を始末してくれてありがとう。これでリバーウッド・トレーダーは以前と同じだ

original: Thanks for bringing the claw back.
string: 爪を取り戻してくれてありがとう

original: It means so much to us to have the claw back where it belongs. Thank you!
string: この爪があるべき場所に戻るのは、私達にとってとても大切な事なの。ありがとう！

original: Thanks for bringing the claw back.
string: 爪を取り戻してくれてありがとう

original: Let me guess - you have some "business" to discuss...
string: 当ててみましょうか…　“仕事”の相談があるんでしょう…

original: You do realize there's only one way this can end.
string: これを終わらせる方法は1つしかないでしょう

original: And how may Ma'randru-jo assist you, hmm?
string: それで、このマランドゥル・ジョーになんのご用かな？

original: Purchase something or leave. Those are your options.
string: 何か買うか、それとも立ち去るか。それはあんた次第さ

original: By the gods! What are you doing here?
string: 一体こんなところで何をしているんだ？

original: The power of Mzinchaleft is mine! Begone from here!
string: ムジンチャレフトの力は私のものだ！　ここから立ち去れ！

original: Gah!
string: うっ！

original: Nargh!
string: ぬあーっ！

original: Unf!
string: うぐっ！

original: Grrh!
string: ぐあっ！

original: Nnh!
string: フン！

original: Not quite good enough, are you?
string: 大した腕じゃないな

original: Close...
string: おっと…

original: You'll need to do better than that.
string: その程度の腕か？

original: Easily blocked!
string: こんなの楽勝だ！

original: Oho! Not so fast!
string: はっ！　鈍いな！

original: Keep digging! Ugh... If Lu'ah Al-Skaven can raise an army of Draugr, then why do I have to babysit them?
string: 掘り続けろ！　うう…　ルア・アル・スカベンがドラウグル軍を召集できるなら、奴らの面倒は見なくてもいいだろう？

original: They burned his body before I could raise him... it should have been returned to me...
string: 彼を蘇らせる前に体を焼かれてしまった…　私の手に戻されるべき体が…

original: Is the line for my next performance starting already? Come on, don't be shy. Plenty of room for everyone.
string: 私の次の演技のセリフはもう始まったかい？　さあ、恥ずかしがらないで。場所は十分広いのだから

original: I'm in the mood to ssssiiiiinnnggg! What about you, friend? Care to join me?
string: 歌いたい気分だなあ！　友よ、あなたはどうだい？　一緒にどうだい？

original: Well now. What have we here? A lost little lamb?
string: さてと。ここでは何が振る舞われるのかな？　迷える子羊か？

original: You really don't want to be loitering here, stranger.
string: こんな所でうろついていない方がいいぞ

original: No, I haven't seen him since the dragon showed up.
string: いや、ドラゴンが現れて以来彼を見ていない

original: No, I haven't seen him since the dragon showed up.
string: いや、ドラゴンが現れて以来彼を見ていない

original: I hate those damn things. Too many eyes, you know?
string: こういうのは嫌いだ。目が多すぎるだろ？

original: What next, giant snakes?
string: 次は何だ、大蛇か？

original: Yes, yes. What is it? We're all very busy here...
string: はい、何だって？　皆とても忙しいんだが…

original: By the love of the Nine, what is it with you sycophants and hangers on? The jarl is busy! And so am I, for that matter.
string: 九大神の慈愛に誓って、一体何だというんだ？　このおべっか使いめ！　首長は忙しいんだ！　この私もな

original: Hrm. You go find your own wreck. This one's mine.
string: ふん、別の難破船を探しな。これは俺のだ

original: Go away! This is my wreck! Mine!
string: 来るな！　こいつは俺の難破船だ！　分かったか！

original: You're making me... nervous. Is there something you need?
string: 何だか…　いらいらするな。何が望みなんだ？

original: I find your presence... unnerving. Please depart.
string: そこにいられると…　不安になるんだ。行ってくれ

original: You fighter types are always underfoot. You want me to clean? Then scat!
string: あんた達戦士は邪魔ばっかりしてくれるよ。掃除してほしいのかい？　なら、あっちへ行きな！

original: I really must get back to my duties. This fort isn't going to clean itself.
string: 仕事に戻らないと。この砦は勝手にきれいになってはくれないんだよ

original: I'm really not in the mood. State your business, or take your leave.
string: そういう気分じゃないの。用事を言うか、帰ってちょうだい

original: I'm busy, and you're bothering me. So go away.
string: 忙しいのに、迷惑ですわ。早く帰ってちょうだい

original: Who are you? What do you want?
string: 誰だ？　何の用だ？

original: Please, just... just leave me be!
string: 頼むから…　放っといてくれ！

original: Why are you here? Get away from me!
string: 何でここにいる？　今すぐ立ち去れ！

original: By the gods! Somebody help me!
string: そんな！　誰か助けてくれ！

original: Oh, I see. Well, I'm sorry to have troubled you about it.
string: ああ、分かったよ。面倒をかけてすまなかった

original: Just... know that your efforts are appreciated.
string: ただ…　努力はありがたいと思ってる

original: I'm not looking for special treatment, Aval. All I did was talk to Ulfric.
string: 特別待遇を望んでるんじゃないんだ、アヴァル。俺はただ、ウルフリックと話をしただけだ

original: For all I know, he's already forgotten the conversation. I wouldn't get your hopes up.
string: おそらく、この会話のことはすでに忘れてしまったみたいだな。あまり期待しない方がいい

original: But I insist. and with good reason.
string: だが譲れん。正当な理由もある

original: Malthyr told me that you've been speaking to Ulfric about our situation. He said you're going to help us.
string: マルシルによれば、お前はウルフリックと我々の状況について話をしたとか。お前が我々に手を貸してくれるらしいな

original: So few Nords have ever offered to help us, a discount is the least I can do.
string: これまで手を差し伸べてくるノルドはほとんどいなかった。自分にできるのは割引きくらいのものだ

original: That's not necessary. I'll pay the same price as anyone else.
string: それは不要だ。みんなと同じ金額を払うよ

original: Friend Brunwulf, how good to see you!
string: ブランウルフ、会えて嬉しいよ！

original: If you see anything you like, just let me know and I'll glad offer you a discount.
string: 気に行ったものがあれば何なりと言ってくれ。喜んで安くするよ

original: So serious! (Laughter)
string: まったく！

original: What is it Ulfric's always saying... "On my honor as a Nord, I swear it." (Laughter).
string: ウルフリックがいつも言っているでしょう、“ノルドの名誉にかけて、これを誓います”ってね

original: Just promise me when you get some more in, I'll have the first crack at them.
string: もっと手に入ったら、真っ先に私に回すと約束してくれ

original: You know, I'm not sure. My husband's been tending to the vines, so I'll have to ask him.
string: さあ、どうかしら。夫がブドウ畑の世話をしているから、聞いてみなくちゃ

original: Is that new batch of tomatoes ready for sale yet, Hillevi?
string: それはもう売り物にできるトマトなのかな、ヒレヴィ？

original: You're such a wet blanket, captain. Can't a girl have a little fun from time to time?
string: 興ざめね、キャプテン。女の子なんだもの、たまにちょっと楽しむくらいいいでしょ？

original: If that business proposition includes smuggling, forget it.
string: その話に密輸入が関係してくるなら、忘れるんだ

original: The sailors I know are plenty good at finding trouble without any help from you.
string: 知り合いの船乗り達は、問題を起こすのが得意だぞ。お前の助けがなくてもな

original: I was wondering if you still had many associates in the shipping profession.
string: 船舶関係にまだ知り合いが大勢いるのかなと思って

original: I have a business proposition for any sailors who might be looking to make a few extra septims.
string: もうちょっと稼ぎたいっていう船乗りには、いい仕事があるんだけど

original: A pleasure to see you as well, Niranye. What can I do for you?
string: こちらこそ会えて嬉しいよ、ニラナイ。何か用かい？

original: Captain Lonely-Gale, it's always a pleasure to see you.
string: ロンリー・ゲイル船長、お会いできて本当にうれしいわ

original: In fact, I'm glad you're here. There's something I'd like to ask you.
string: ここに来てくれてよかった。聞きたい事があるの

original: Oh, I see. Yes, yes of course I'll take a look. Just bring them by whenever it's convenient for you.
string: そうか。もちろんだ、見てみよう。いつでも都合のいい時に持ってきてくれ

original: I have some things that belonged to my daughter, Friga. She... she won't be needing them any more.
string: 娘のフリガの持ち物を持っているの。娘にはもう…　必要ないから

original: Yes, that's right. Whether or not I'm interested depends on what you've got, of course.
string: ああ、その通りだ。気に入るかどうかは、持ち込まれる品次第だ

original: I understand you purchase used goods, as well as sell them?
string: 中古品を買い取っているのは知ってるけど、売ってもいるの？

original: The eyes of the law are everywhere these days.
string: 最近じゃあ、法の目が厳しい

original: The guards are looking for a killer, but who knows what else they might turn up? Good day.
string: 衛兵が殺人犯を探してるが、それだけが目的だとどうして言い切れる？　それじゃあな

original: Not that I'd know anything about it, of course, but it seems to me that the last thing a thieves' guild would want is to draw attention to itself.
string: 盗賊ギルドは絶対に目立ちたくないんじゃないかな。もちろん、私は何も知らないんだけどね

original: It's a bad time to be a criminal, what with these murders going on.
string: 殺人があったんだ。今は犯罪者になるのはまずい

original: In fact, thieves have been known to kill, if there's a profit in it. This war's been hard on all of us.
string: 実際、盗賊達は利益のためなら殺しもすると思われている。この戦争は皆にとって厳しいものだ

original: One should never pay too much attention to rumors, Torbjorn.
string: 噂をあまり気にしちゃだめよ、トールビョルン

original: You have piqued my curiosity, however. Please, do continue.
string: でも、好奇心を刺激されたわ。先を続けて

original: I've been meaning to speak to you, Niranye. Rumor is, you've got ties to the Thieves' Guild.
string: ニラナイ、話がしたいと思ってたんだ。噂じゃ、盗賊ギルドに入ったそうだな

original: You've done more than enough already. You've been a good friend in a time of need, and we won't forget that.
string: 既に十分してもらった。必要な時に友人でいてくれたんだ。それを忘れることはねえ

original: I'm sorry I lost myself for a moment there. I just need some time to get over the loss.
string: 自分を見失ってすまなかった。失われた事実を乗り越えるまで、少し時間が必要なだけだ

original: I... I'm so sorry, Torbjorn. You must be suffering terribly. I wish there was some way I could help.
string: トールビョルン…　ごめんなさい。どんなにつらかったことか。何か力になれることがあればいいのに…

original: My little Friga loved to cook, but she was terrible at it. Then one day, out of nowhere, she made the most amazing leek soup.
string: かわいいフリガは、料理が好きだったが、腕はひどかった。それがある日突然、素晴らしい味のリーキスープを作った

original: She watched while we ate it, and when she saw how much we loved it, she was... so proud...
string: おいしそうに食べる姿を見て、彼女はとても…　誇らしげだった…

original: It was my pleasure, Torbjorn. I enjoy cooking, and after what you and Tova have been through, it was the least I could do.
string: どういたしまして、トールビョルン。料理は好きだし、あなたとトヴァの気持ちを思えば、私にできるのはこれぐらいよ

original: I wanted to thank you again for the mince pie you sent over. It was delicious.
string: ミンスパイを送ってくれてありがとう。とてもうまかった

original: We accept the risks that come with our faith, but I'll keep your offer in mind. Thank you, Niranye.
string: 信念に伴う危険は承知の上です。でも、申し出は覚えておきます。ありがとう、ニラナイ

original: Well, let's just say that I know some people who are experts at helping others disappear when they need to.
string: 姿をくらましたい人の手助けが得意な人を知っている、とだけ言っておくわ

original: They are discreet and thorough, though not inexpensive. I hope you'll keep that in mind, should the worst come to pass.
string: 秘密は守るし、仕事は完璧。だけど、安くないわよ。それだけは覚えておいて。いざって時もあるからね

original: I doubt Ulfric would let Thalmor into Windhelm without a fight. But please, do continue. How would you help us?
string: 戦わずに、ウルフリックがサルモールをウィンドヘルムに入らせるでしょうか。でも教えて下さい、何ができますか？

original: Well, I've heard awful stories about these Thalmor, and how they're rounding up everyone who still worships Talos.
string: サルモールの事は、ひどい話を聞いたことがあるわ。まだタロスを崇拝している人達を一網打尽にするやり方とかも

original: The interrogations are quite merciless, from what I've heard.
string: ひどい尋問をするそうよ

original: I fear for you and your husband, should the Thamlor come here. But perhaps there's a way I can help.
string: サルモールがここに来たら、あなたもご主人も危ないわ。でも、なんとか助けてあげられると思う

original: Is that so? And what were you thinking, exactly?
string: 本当に？　具体的にはどんな考えだったんですか？

original: Hello, Jora. I'm glad to see you. In fact, I was just thinking about you and your husband.
string: こんにちは、ジョラ。お会いできてうれしいわ。じつはね、あなたとご主人の事を考えていたところだったの

original: I'll be sure to stress your urgency. It seems like every farmer in Skyrim is short on supplies these days.
string: 事は急を要する。最近、スカイリムの農民は誰もが物資不足で困っているようだ

original: Tell him I'll pay double the normal price. We've been getting by with one broken pitchfork, but it's falling apart.
string: 彼に相場の倍払うと伝えてくれ。ずっと壊れた熊手ひとつでしのいできたんだが、とうとう限界らしい

original: Revyn put the word out to his suppliers but with the war on, tools are scarce. Both sides have been snapping them up.
string: レヴィンが取引業者に口を利いたのだが、戦争で道具類が不足している。敵も味方も買い漁っているらしい

original: Did you have any luck tracking own some more pitchforks?
string: どうだ、別の熊手を手に入れられそうかね？

original: I'll be sure to tell her.
string: 必ず伝えます

original: We've got another dozen ripening on the vine. They should be ready in a few days.
string: 熟れ頃なのが蔓にもう1ダースなってる。あと2、3日で摘めるようになるだろう

original: Well enough, I suppose. Nilsine bought up most of the tomatoes, and was asking if we could get more.
string: 十分だと思います。ニルシンがほとんどのトマトを育てて、もっと取れるかどうか聞いていました

original: How's business today?
string: 調子はどうだい？

original: Here's your <Alias=QuestItem>.
string: さあ、 <Alias=QuestItem> だ

original: Thank you so much. Here. Let me show you a thing or two about not attracting attention to yourself.
string: 本当にありがとう。では、相手に気配を悟られないコツをお教えしよう

original: This should come in handy. Here. Let me show you a few tricks I've learned about buttering up royalty.
string: こいつは役に立ちそうだ。それじゃ、お偉いさん達にゴマをするコツをいくつか教えてやるよ

original: Here's Nelacar's staff.
string: さあ、ネラカーの杖だ

original: What's this? Some kind of code? "Need as much iron ore as you can dig up...."
string: なんだこりゃ？　暗号かなにかか？　“掘り出せるだけの鉄の鉱石がいる…”

original: He's not spying, but it's clear the Empire is making Lod smith up more swords and armor for them.
string: スパイをしてたわけじゃないが、帝国がロッドに剣と鎧を増産させている事は確かだ

original: Good work. Take this.
string: よくやった。受け取ってくれ

original: Here's Lod's letter.
string: ロッドの手紙だ

original: Forget it.
string: あきらめてくれ

original: Hist spit on you.
string: この人でなしめ

original: Daedra take you, then.
string: なら、デイドラにやられちまえ

original: Milk drinker.
string: 腰抜けめ

original: I'll get it for you.
string: 手に入れてこよう

original: Thank you. I'll be waiting for that bottle.
string: ありがとう。心待ちにしてるよ

original: Thanks. I'll be waiting for it.
string: ありがとう。待っているぞ

original: Good.
string: よし

original: It will be done.
string: 任せろ

original: Are you all right?
string: 大丈夫か？

original: No. I'm not. I feel like my scales are clawing into me. Maybe you could help an old Argonian out?
string: いや、ちとまずい。鱗が体に食い込んでくるような気分だ。この老いぼれを助けてはくれないか？

original: I heard some of the sailors talking about how they stashed a bottle of Double-Distilled Skooma in the Gnisis Cornerclub. I just need a taste.
string: グニシス・コーナークラブの中に再蒸留したスクゥーマを隠していると、船乗りが話しているのを耳にした。それを味わってみたい

original: Me? Nothing. And I hope to keep it that way. The Jarl is convinced I have some connection with the College, so he goes easy on me.
string: 別に何も。ずっとこのままだと助かるんだけどな。大学にコネがあると首長に思われてるんだ。だから大目に見てくれてるってわけさ

original: Maybe you'd like to help me keep up appearances? Old Nelacar has a mage's staff in his room in the Frozen Hearth.
string: できたら、このまま体裁を保つ手伝いをしてくれないか？　フローズン・ハースにあるネラカー翁の部屋に魔術師の杖があるんだ

original: It'd be good to have that staff in case the Jarl starts wondering if I actually have a real connection to the College.
string: 本当に大学にコネがあるのか首長が疑い出した時に、あの杖を持っていれば何かと役に立ちそうだからね

original: What do you do around here?
string: どんな仕事をしているんだ？

original: Not against me. Against all of Falkreath. Those Imperial bastards are spying on every one of us.
string: 私に対してではない。ファルクリース全体に対してだ。帝国のイヌどもが我々ひとりひとりを見張っているのだ

original: Last night I saw Lod the blacksmith writing a letter. Probably sending word to Solitude and General Tullius.
string: 昨日の晩、鍛冶屋のロッドが手紙を書いているのを見かけた。たぶんソリチュードとテュリウス将軍に報告してるんだろう

original: Are you loyal to Skyrim? Break into Lod's house and get that letter.
string: お前はスカイリムの味方か？　ロッドの家に忍び込んで手紙を取ってこい

original: You say there's a plot against you?
string: お前に対する計画があると言ったか？

original: By the Hist, if I don't get something soon, I don't know how I'll get through the week.
string: 何てこった、今すぐ何か食わないと。1週間乗り切れるか分からないぞ

original: This is Markarth, traveler. Safest city in the Reach.
string: ここはマルカルスだ、旅の人。リーチでどこよりも安全な街だ

original: You here to see the Jarl? No sudden moves, understand?
string: 首長に会いに来た？　変な真似はするなよ、いいな？

original: Whole dwarven city underneath the keep. Nchuand-Zel. Best steer clear if you don't want a Steam Centurion carving you up.
string: 砦の下には、ドワーフの都市ヌチュアンド・ゼルがある。スチーム・センチュリオンに切り刻まれたくなかったら近づかないように

original: Listener. I am your only salvation. Come. Embrace me.
string: 聞こえし者よ。私こそがあなたの唯一の救済となりましょう。さあ、私を抱擁なさい

original: You've got that right. Only a matter of time before we're roasted alive. Come on!
string: そのとおり。急がないと生きたまま丸焼きにされそうだ。行くぞ！

original: We need to get out of here!
string: 脱出しなければ！

original: Considering most of us are now dead, I assumed as much.
string: そのようだな、ほとんどが死んだよ

original: And before you ask, no - I don't think it was you. Well, maybe I did, but you saving my sorry hide just now sort of erased any doubts.
string: 聞かれる前に言っておくが、お前が黒幕だとは思っていない。少しはそう考えてもいたが、たった今助けてもらってその疑念は消えた

original: So thanks.
string: だから、礼を言おう

original: The Emperor... it was all a trap. Someone set us up.
string: 皇帝… あれは罠だった。誰かにはめられたんだ

original: Watch out for pressure plates here.
string: ここの圧力板に気をつけていて

original: The door up ahead will be locked. Klotha, one of the hagravens, will have the key on her.
string: この先のドアは鍵がかかっているはず。鍵はハグレイヴンのひとりクローサが持っているわ

original: I'll let you live. This time.
string: 見逃そう。今回はな

original: I'll spare you - for now.
string: 見逃してやる。今はな

original: All right, you've had enough.
string: いいさ、もう十分だ

original: You're not worth it.
string: お前には何の価値もない

original: I didn't think you had the stomach for it.
string: 食べられるとは思わなかった

original: Point that somewhere else!
string: そんなものはしまえ！

original: Don't do that, it's mean!
string: やめて、意地悪！

original: You have a death wish?
string: 死にたいのか？

original: Careful there!
string: 気をつけろ！

original: That's a dangerous game you're playing.
string: 危険な遊びをしていると分かっているのか？

original: Woah... watch it!
string: おい！　危ないだろ！？

original: I suggest you aim elsewhere.
string: 狙うなら別のものにしな

original: Please! Don't shoot!
string: お願い！　撃たないで！

original: Hmm? What're you doing?
string: ん？　何をしている？

original: Now that's just rude.
string: 野蛮な行為だな

original: You're not going to shoot, right?
string: 撃たないよな？　な？

original: There's no need for that.
string: そんな事するなよ…

original: Don't be a fool.
string: バカなことをするな！

original: I need to learn the Dragonrend Shout. Can you teach me?
string: ドラゴンレンドのシャウトについて知りたい。教えてくれないか？

original: Drem. Patience. There are formalities which must be observed, at the first meeting of two of the dov.
string: ドレム。待て。ドヴ同士が最初に出会ったときには、守らねばならぬ儀礼というものがある

original: I think you already know who I am.
string: こちらのことも、すでに知っているんじゃないのか？

original: Yes. Vahzah. You speak true, Dovahkiin. Forgive me.
string: うむ。ヴァーザー。その通りだ、ドヴァーキン。許してくれ

original: It has been long since I held tinvaak with a stranger. I gave in to the temptation to prolong our speech.
string: 他所から来た者とティンヴァークしたのは久方ぶりなのだ。つい長話の誘惑に負けてしまった

original: You're the master of the Greybeards?
string: あなたがグレイビアードのマスターか？

original: They see me as master. Wuth. Onik. Old and wise. It is true I am old...
string: 彼らはそう思っている。ウス。オニック。年老いて博識だと。確かに年老いてはいるがな…

original: I wasn't expecting you to be a dragon.
string: あなたがドラゴンだとは思わなかった

original: I am as my father Akatosh made me. As are you... Dovahkiin.
string: 父、アカトシュが私をこう作ったのだ。お前が…　ドヴァーキンであるようにな

original: So. You have made your way here, to me. No easy task for a joor... mortal. Even for one of Dovah Sos. Dragonblood.
string: なるほど。私に会いに来たのか。ジョール…　定命の者にとって容易い道ではなかったろう。お前がドヴァー、ソス、竜の血脈を持つ者であっても

original: What would you ask of me?
string: 私に何を望むのだ？

original: Not until introductions are complete. Zin. Heyv. Test your Thu'um against mine, Dovahkiin!
string: 紹介が終わるまでは駄目だ。ジン、ヘイヴ。お前のスゥームを試してやろう、ドヴァーキン！

original: Drem Yol Lok. Greetings, wunduniik. I am Paarthurnax.
string: ドレム、ヨル、ロク。良く来た、ウンドゥニーク。私はパーサーナックスだ

original: Who are you? What brings you to my strunmah... my mountain?
string: お前は何者だ？　なぜ我がストルンマー…　我が山を訪れた？

original: You are bold, wunduniik. You dare enter a Dovah's home without permission.
string: 大胆なものだな、ウンドゥニーク。ドヴァーの家に許可なく立ち入るとは

original: Keep moving, stay focused on your goal, and you will reach the summit.
string: 止まらず、己の目標に心を定めていれば、山頂に辿り着けるだろう

original: At least the Blades aren't keeping secrets from me.
string: 少なくともブレイズはこっちに秘密を持っていない

original: Do not be so sure about that. Beware - the Blades may claim to serve the Dragonborn, but they do not. They never have.
string: それをあまり信用しない方が良い。気をつけよ、ブレイズはドラゴンボーンに仕えると言うが、それは違う。彼らが仕えたことなど今までにない

original: As for me, I kept from you only what you were not yet ready to know. Are still not ready to know, as your question reveals.
string: 私は、お前がまだ知るべきでない事を隠していただけに過ぎない。そして今の問いが示すとおり、今も知るべきでない事だ

original: They have always sought to turn the Dragonborn from the path of wisdom.
string: 彼らは常にドラゴンボーンを智の道から遠ざけようとしてきた

original: Have you learned nothing from us? Would you simply be a tool in the hands of the Blades, to be used for their own purposes?
string: お前は我々から何も学んでいないのか？　ブレイズの手にある只の道具として、彼らの目的のために使われたいか？

original: I have nothing to hide. The Blades helped me find out about it.
string: 隠すことは何もない。ブレイズが発見を手伝ってくれた

original: Who I stand with is my business.
string: 誰を支持するかは自分で決める

original: If you wish to stand alone, so be it. If you wish for our help, you'll answer my question.
string: もし独りで立つのが望みであれば、それも良いだろう。だが我々の助けが欲しければ、私の問いに答えよ

original: The Dragonrend Shout is evil. Would you cure one evil with another?
string: ドラゴンレンド・シャウトは悪なる物だ。一つの悪を別の悪で治癒するのか？

original: The Blades! Of course. They specialize in meddling in matters they barely understand. Their reckless arrogance knows no bounds.
string: ブレイズか！　なるほど、殆ど理解できていない物事に首を突っ込むのが得意だからな。彼らの無謀な傲慢は底が知れぬ

original: Tell me. Why do you come here, volaan? Why do you intrude on my meditation?
string: 答えろ。なぜここに来た、ヴォラーン？　なぜ瞑想の邪魔をする？

original: The Blades were born of dragon-hating crusaders. They still carry that legacy although they may not remember from whence it came.
string: ブレイズはドラゴンを嫌う聖戦士として創設された。彼らは自分達の出自を覚えていないようだが、その伝統は残っている

original: They carried out a genocide of dragons when they first came to Tamriel, and now they will do it again, with your help.
string: 初めてタムリエルへ来た時、彼らはドラゴン達の虐殺を行った。今度はお前の手助けにより、再び行おうとしている

original: It was created by those who had lived under the unimaginable cruelty of Alduin's Dragon Cult.
string: 彼らはアルドゥインの竜教団による、想像を絶した残虐な統治の下で生きていた者達によって組織されたのだ

original: Their whole lives were consumed with hatred for dragons, and they poured all their anger and hatred into this Shout.
string: 彼らの人生のすべてはドラゴンへの憎しみに呑まれ、己の怒りをシャウトへの憎しみへと向けたのだ

original: When you learn a Shout, you take it into your very being. In a sense, you become the Shout.
string: シャウトを学ぶ時、そのシャウトは己の存在に取り込まれる。シャウトそのものに成る、とも言えるだろう

original: In order to learn and use this Shout, you will be taking this evil into yourself.
string: シャウトを学んで扱うには、その悪をも己の身に取り込む事になる

original: Your kind - joorre - mortals - created it as a weapon against the dov... the dragons.
string: お前と同じジョーレ、定命の者がドヴ…　ドラゴンを倒す武器としてこれを作ったのだ

original: Our hadrimme, our minds cannot even... comprehend its concepts.
string: 我らのハドリッメ…　心では、その概念すら理解できない

original: Trust your instincts, Dovahkiin. Your blood will show you the way.
string: 己の直感を信じろ、ドヴァーキン。その血が道を示してくれる

original: The dragons are terrorizing Skyrim. Don't you think they need to be stopped?
string: ドラゴンはスカイリムを苦しめている。ドラゴンを止めるべきだとは思わないのか？

original: That may be what you are here for, Dragonborn.
string: それがお前がここにいる理由なのかもしれぬな、ドラゴンボーンよ

original: But stopping Alduin is one thing. Helping you wipe out dragons again is quite another.
string: だがアルドゥインを止める事と、ドラゴンを滅ぼす手伝いをする事は、違う

original: Dragons are part of the natural order of the world. The Blades thought to change the order to suit themselves, by wiping out the dragons.
string: ドラゴンはこの世の自然の掟の一片だ。ブレイズはドラゴンを滅ぼす事で、その掟を自分達に合った形に変えられると考えたようだ

original: But again, we see that the natural order will be restored, one way or another.
string: しかし自然の掟が何かしらの方法で元に戻るのは、見ての通りだろう

original: Perhaps we would have dragon allies against Alduin if the ancient Blades had not acted so arrogantly.
string: もし古代のブレイズが傲慢に振舞わなければ、アルドゥインに対してドラゴンを味方に付ける事もできたかもしれんな

original: Why do you hate the Blades?
string: なぜブレイズを憎んでいる？

original: What do you have against the Blades?
string: ブレイズの何が気に入らないんだ？

original: Not hate. Distrust and fear. The Blades have always sought to turn the Dragonborn away from the path of wisdom.
string: 憎んではいない。あるのは不信と恐怖だ。ブレイズは常にドラゴンボーンを智の道から遠ざけようとしてきた

original: Is there another way to defeat Alduin?
string: アルドゥインを倒す他の方法は？

original: Perhaps not. But this Shout was used once before, was it not? And here we are again.
string: ないかもしれん。しかし、このシャウトは以前に一度使ったのではないか？　だから今こうしているのだ

original: Have you considered that Alduin was not meant to be defeated?
string: アルドゥインが破られる運命には無かったと考えたことはないか？

original: Those who overthrew him in ancient times only postponed the day of reckoning, they did not stop it.
string: 太古の時代に彼を打倒した者達も、裁きの日の到来を遅らせただけだ。止めたわけではない

original: If the world is meant to end, so be it. Let it end and be reborn.
string: もし世界が終わるのであれば、それも良いだろう。終わらせて再生させればいい

original: What's so bad about the Dragonrend Shout?
string: ドラゴンレンドのシャウトが悪名高い理由は？

original: Watch it!
string: 危ない！

original: Ouch! Hey!
string: ああ！　ちょっと！

original: Hey!
string: さあ！

original: Oh.
string: ああ

original: What the?
string: 何だ？

original: Whoops.
string: おっと！

original: Mind yourself.
string: 気をつけろよ

original: What's the hurry?
string: 何を急いでる？

original: Oaf.
string: グズ

original: Woah!
string: ワーオ！

original: Excuse me.
string: ごめんよ

original: Uh, sorry.
string: あ、すまない

original: Mind the way.
string: 気をつけて歩け

original: Careful!
string: 気をつけろ！

original: Why live alone on a mountain if you love conversation?
string: 会話が好きなら、なんで山の中に独りでいるんだ？

original: Evenaar bahlok. There are many hungers it is better to deny than to feed.
string: エヴェナール、バーロク。食らうよりも我慢した方が好ましい渇きも多い

original: Dreh ni nahkip. Discipline against the lesser aids in qahnaar... denial of the greater.
string: ドレー、ニ、ナーキプ。弱者に対する自制心が、クァーナール…　強者の拒絶に繋がる

original: Hmm. Esbern or Arngeir might have some idea.
string: エズバーンかアーンゲールには案があるかもしれない

original: The Lorekeeper at the College of Winterhold might know.
string: ウィンターホールド大学にいる語り部なら、知っているかもしれない

original: Do you know where I can find an Elder Scroll?
string: どこに行けば星霜の書が見つかるか知らないか？

original: Krosis. No. I know little of what has passed below in the long years I have lived here.
string: クロシス。いや。この地に住み始めて以来の長き間に何があったか、ほとんど知らないのだ

original: You are likely better informed than I.
string: おそらくお前の方がよく知っているだろう

original: You mean you were there?
string: つまり、あなたもそこにいたのか？

original: Yes. There were a few of us that rebelled against Alduin's thur... his tyranny. We aided the humans in his overthrow.
string: そうだ。我らの中にもアルドゥインのスール…　圧政に対抗した者達がいた。人間が立ち向かうのに力を貸したのだ

original: But they did not trust us. Ni ov. Their inner councils were kept hidden from us.
string: しかし、彼らは我々を信じなかった。ニ、オヴ。彼らの最奥議会は、我らの目から隠された

original: I was far from here on the day of Alduin's downfall. But all dov felt the... sundering of Time itself.
string: アルドゥインが倒された時にはここから遠く離れた地にいた。だがすべてのドヴが感じていた…　時間からの孤立を

original: How could an Elder Scroll cast Alduin through time?
string: 星霜の書はどうやってアルドゥインを時間の彼方へ飛ばしたんだ？

original: Vomindok. I do not know. Perhaps in the very doing they erased the knowing of it from Time itself.
string: ヴォミンドック。分からない。おそらくそれを使うことで、時の中からそれにまつわる記憶を消すのだろう

original: The dov are children of Akatosh. Thus we are specially... attuned to the flow of Time. Perhaps also uniquely vulnerable.
string: ドヴはアカトシュの子供達だ。ゆえに我々は特に…　時の流れに同調している。おそらく、それが弱点でもあるのだろう

original: I warned them against such a rash action. Even I could not foresee its consequences. Nust ni hon. They would not listen.
string: 彼らには、早まった行動を取らぬよう忠告した。それが何をもたらすのか、私にも分からなかったからだ。ヌスト、ニ、ホン。だが誰も耳を貸さなかった

original: How does any of this help me?
string: そんな物がどう役に立つんだ？

original: Tiid krent. Time was... shattered here because of what the ancient Nords did to Alduin.
string: ティード、クレント。古代ノルドがアルドゥインにしたことによって、ここでは時が…　砕けてしまった

original: If you brought that Kel, that Elder Scroll back here... to the Tiid-Ahraan, the Time-Wound...
string: ここはティード・アーラーン…　時の傷跡だ。もしあのケル、あの星霜の書さえ持ち帰れば…

original: With the Elder Scroll that was used to break Time, you may be able to... cast yourself back. To the other end of the break.
string: 時を壊すために使われた星霜の書を用いることで…　お前を過去に遡らせることができるかもしれん。壊れた時間の彼岸にな

original: You could learn Dragonrend from those who created it.
string: ドラゴンレンドは、生みだした者達から習うがよかろう

original: Using the Dragonrend Shout, right?
string: ドラゴンレンドのシャウトを使っていたんだな？

original: Yes and no. Viik nuz ni kron. Alduin was not truly defeated, either. If he was, you would not be here today, seeking to... defeat him.
string: それだけではない。ヴィーク、ヌズ、ニ、クロン。アルドゥインも完全に敗れたわけではない。そうであれば、お前がここに来ることもなかった

original: The Nords of those days used the Dragonrend Shout to cripple Alduin. But this was not enough. Ok mulaag unslaad.
string: 当時のノルドが使ったドラゴンレンド・シャウトは、アルドゥインの動きを封じた。だが十分ではなかった。オク、ムラーグ、ウンスラード

original: It was the Kel - the Elder Scroll. They used it to... cast him adrift on the currents of Time.
string: ケル、星霜の書。彼らはそれを用いて…　奴が時の流れを彷徨うように仕向けたのだ

original: You said you were going to answer my question.
string: 質問に答えてくれると言っただろう

original: Drem. Patience. I am answering, in my way.
string: ドレム。待て。今答えているところだ

original: I never thought about it.
string: 考えてもみなかった

string: ビー・アンド・バルブへようこそ、特別なお飲み物もご用意してあります。どうぞ、お申しつけ下さい

original: Is there something I do for you?
string: 何かできる事はあるか？

original: Be brief Imperial, there's only so long I can stand being downwind of your stench.
string: 帝国軍よ、すぐに終わりだ。お前達の悪臭に耐えるのは、もうたくさんだ

original: Ah! A fellow Nord! I trust you're bringing the fight to the Empire.
string: ああ！　仲間のノルドか！　帝国に戦いを挑むんだろうな

original: If your allegiance lies with the Empire, we haven't much to discuss.
string: 帝国に忠誠を誓っているなら、特に話すことはない

original: Hm. You're not from around here. Imperial spy perhaps?
string: ほう、よそ者だな。インペリアルのスパイなのか？

original: How can a humble servant of Talos help you today?
string: タロスの忠実なるしもべに、何か手伝えることは？

original: Talos bless you, my child.
string: 我が子よ、タロスの祝福を

original: Blessings of Talos upon you.
string: タロスの祝福がありますように

original: Blessings upon you, traveler.
string: あなたに祝福を、旅の人

original: Sorry, I'm afraid I can't help you much right now... I'm currently in mourning.
string: すまないが、今はお役に立てない…　喪に服しているところなんだ

original: You've caught me at a bad time. I've lost someone dear to me.
string: 今は間が悪い。大切な者を亡くしたばかりなんだ

original: Yes? What is it?
string: ああ？　何だ？

original: I'm the brewmaster around here. What did you want?
string: ここらで醸造所の監督をしているんだ。何か用か？

original: I'm quite busy. Need something or can I get back to work?
string: 実に忙しくてね。何かほしいのか？　でなきゃ仕事に戻っていいか？

original: Yeah? What do you want? If this is about the meadery, we can talk later.
string: ああ？　何の用だ？　ハチミツ酒醸造所に関する事なら、後にしてくれ

original: Welcome! Allow me to recommend the Black-Briar Mead... the purest brew in all of Skyrim!
string: いらっしゃい！　スカイリムでもとびきり純粋な醸造酒、ブラック・ブライアのハチミツ酒がお勧めだよ！

original: We serve only the best here... Black-Briar Mead. May I get one for you?
string: 当店で扱ってるのは最高級品…　ブラック・ブライアのハチミツ酒だけだよ。おひとついかが？

original: I'm off work at the Black-Briar Meadery. I'll be back there in the morning.
string: ブラック・ブライアのハチミツ酒醸造所で仕事を終えた所なんだ。また明朝には戻るよ

original: Hey, don't look at me that way! Who are you to judge me?
string: ちょっと、そんな風に見ないでよ！　値踏みしようなんて、何様のつもり？

original: So what if I have a problem? I know how to deal with it!
string: 悩んでいたら、どうだっていうの？　解決法くらい知ってるわよ！

original: Maramal thinks he's so smart; tells me that Mara will cleanse the filth from my blood. Ha! What does he know?
string: マラマルは自分の事をすごく賢いと思ってて、マーラが汚れを血から取り除いてくれるって言うのよ。ハッ！　彼に何が分かるっていうのかしら

original: My n'wah of a father thought he could pull my strings... "continue the Hlaalu tradition." Bah! I left all that nonsense behind.
string: クソ親父は、影から操れるって考えてたのよ…　“フラールの伝統を存続させろ”だって。フン！　あんな無意味なもの、まとめて置いてきてやったわよ

original: If Indaryn finds out, he'll have me thrown out of the Meadery for certain. So don't breathe a word of it to him. Not a word!
string: インダルインに見つかったら、絶対に醸造所を追い出されるわ。これは秘密よ。ひと言も口にしちゃだめだからね！

original: Oh what am I going do? I can barely afford to stay at the Bunkhouse.
string: まあ、どうしましょう。宿舎に泊るのがやっとだっていうのに

original: I'm going to stop. That's what I'm going to do! Then everyone will see that I'm not as useless as they think.
string: 止めるわ。それがやりたかったの。そうすれば、みんなが思ってるような役立たずじゃないって分かってもらえるはずよ

original: A Dreth never forgets a traitor. You'll pay for this!
string: ドレス家の者は決して裏切り者を忘れない。必ず報いを受けさせてやる！

original: Wilhelm was pleased with the delivery, well done.
string: ウィルヘルムは届け物に満足したようだ。よくやってくれた

original: I believe you have a delivery to make.
string: 届ける物があるはずじゃないか？

original: You look like you could use a drink. What do you say to some cheap mead?
string: 酒は嫌いじゃないだろう？　安いハチミツ酒なんかどうだ？

original: I'm selling the best mead in town for cheap. Interested?
string: 町一番のハチミツ酒を安く売っているんだ。興味あるのか？

original: Well met. I don't think they're hiring anyone at the moment, so if you're looking for work, you're out of luck.
string: よお。今のところ求人はないようだ。仕事探しにツキはないようだぜ

original: The trees... they're beautiful here. Reminds me of autumn at home.
string: 木か…　美しいなあ。ふるさとの秋を思い出すよ

original: The fall forest makes me miss my childhood; playing among the towering trees in Valenwood and living with my brethren.
string: 秋の森を見るとガキの頃が懐かしくなるよ。ヴァレンウッドの大木のまわりで遊び回った。仲間と暮らしてたんだ

original: Seeing the sorry state of this city almost makes me regret my decision to leave my home when my apprenticeship completed.
string: この街の惨状を見てると、修行が終わってふるさとを離れたことが悔やまれるよ

original: I was fortunate enough to be guided by one of Silvenar's master armorers until he passed.
string: シルヴェナールの鍛冶職人のマスターのところで、彼が死ぬまで勉強できたのは本当に幸運だった

original: On his deathbed, my master urged me to take over his business but I decided against it. I chose to wander Tamriel instead.
string: 死の間際、マスターに仕事を継ぐように頼まれた。だけど、断ったんだ。それよりタムリエルに来たのさ

original: Now here I am, working for this dreary city's Fishery. I sometimes wonder why I don't just move on.
string: そんなわけで、今はこの陰気な街の鮮魚店で働いてる。なぜここに留まっているのか自分でも時々不思議に思うよ

original: Hello. Welcome to the Pawned Prawn.
string: プローン質屋へようこそ

original: If there's anything you need, I'd be glad to help you.
string: 何か必要な時は、お手伝いしますわ

original: My husband Bersi will be the death of me. He spends too much time worrying about Riften and not enough about himself.
string: 夫ベルシが私の悩みの種なのです。リフテンの心配ばかりして、自分自身の事は全くおろそかにしているんですから

original: All the crime and corruption in Riften is really getting to him... and now that we hear rumors about the dragons, he's been very depressed.
string: リフテンの犯罪や汚職がこたえているようで…　それに加えてドラゴンの噂でしょう。すっかり気が滅入っているんです

original: Bersi's afraid that someone's making a move to take the Pawned Prawn from us. I think he's being paranoid.
string: ベルシは、誰かにプローン質屋が乗っ取られるんじゃないかと思っています。ノイローゼ気味なんですよ

original: We both own the Pawned Prawn together, but he's singlehandedly kept the place running despite all our problems.
string: プローン質屋は私達二人の店です。でも、たくさん問題があるにも関わらず、彼が一人で店を運営してるんですよ

original: I just care about my husband so much and I hate to see him in this state.
string: 私は夫のことが本当に心配で、こんな状態の夫を見るのが辛いんです

original: Welcome to the Pawned Prawn. What can I do for you?
string: プローン質屋へようこそ。何かご用かな？

original: I have all sorts of interesting items for sale. Have you looked around?
string: あらゆる種類の面白いものを売っている。もう見たかい？

original: Pickings may be a bit slim today, but if you see anything you like I'll make you a good deal.
string: 採集量は減ってきているが、気にいったものがあったら、安くしておくよ

original: If you're looking for anything to sell for a fair price, I run the Pawned Prawn over by the market.
string: 正当な値段で買い物がしたいなら、市場のところでプローン質屋を経営している

original: I presume you're bothering me for a good reason?
string: 私を煩わすからにはよほどの訳があるのでしょうね？

original: What in the name of Oblivion do you want?
string: 一体、何が望みなのです？

original: I don't have time for idle chit-chat. What is it?
string: くだらない世間話につきあう時間はないのです。用件は？

original: The throne suits me, don't you think?
string: 私には玉座が似合うと思いませんか？

original: My title is just a formality. I've always been in charge around here.
string: 肩書は単なる形式上のものです。どのみちこの辺りは昔から私が仕切っていますから

original: Jarl Maven Black-Briar. Has a pleasant sound to it, wouldn't you say?
string: 首長メイビン・ブラック・ブライア…　耳に心地よい響きだとは思いませんか？

original: Fancy yourself the adventuring type, eh? It's just as well, I doubt your combat prowess would prove valuable in a real battle anyway.
string: 自分が冒険者に向いていると自負しているのか？　いずれにしろ、お前の腕前が実践で役に立つとは到底思えない

original: I was trained by some of the finest warriors in all Skyrim to wield a blade as if it was an extension of my own arm.
string: 剣を自分の腕の一部として扱う術を、スカイリムで最も優れた戦士に訓練してもらったんだ

original: My mother spares no expense where I'm concerned. I'm heir to the family fortune after all.
string: 母は私に対して金を惜しまない。いずれにせよ、私が一族の財産を引き継ぐ事になる

original: Once I'm in charge I have bigger aspirations than just Skyrim. I plan to bring Black-Briar Mead to all of Tamriel.
string: 任されたからには、スカイリムに留まらない、大きな展望がある。ブラック・ブライアのハチミツ酒をタムリエル全土に広める計画だ

original: My children, Sibbi and Ingun, are being groomed to run the family business one day as well.
string: 我が子であるシビとインガンも、一族の事業を将来引き継ぐための教育を受けている

original: Sibbi will prove to be a fine leader one day, but Ingun... that girl has her mind somewhere other than business.
string: いつかシビは立派な指導者になるだろう。しかしインガンは…　あの子は事業に関心を持っていない。別の興味があるんだ

original: Maven's disappointed that Ingun's heart isn't in the family business, but she says "Ingun still has her uses." Not sure what that means.
string: メイビンは、インガンが一族の事業に関心を持たない事を残念がっている。しかし、“インガンには他の役目がある”と言う。一体何だろうか？

original: I'm Riften's appointed Steward. How can I help you?
string: 私がリフテンの執政だ。何のご用かな？

original: Steward Hemming Black-Briar at your service.
string: 執政のヘミング・ブラック・ブライアが話を伺おう

original: Well, if it isn't my little problem-solver.
string: おや、誰かと思ったら問題解決人じゃないか

original: Well, well. Aren't you a sight for sore eyes. I've always got time for lovely ladies.
string: これはこれは。まさに目の保養だな。美しい女性のためなら、いつでも時間を割くぜ

original: Have you come to gawk at me or is this a social call?
string: ポカンと見つめるために来たのか、それとも友人として会いに来たのか？

original: Ah finally, someone besides the stupid guards to talk to.
string: ああ、ついに間抜けな衛兵以外に話し相手ができた

original: My experiments continue to go well thanks to you. How can I return the favor?
string: あなたのおかげで実験はうまくいってるわ。どうお礼をしたらいいかしら？

original: Any luck gathering those ingredients?
string: 材料集めの成果はあった？

original: Hm? Sorry, just thinking about my experiments.
string: え？　ごめんなさい、実験の事を考えていたの

original: My mind is on my experiments today. What did you need?
string: 今日は実験に集中しているの。何のご用だったかしら？

original: What was it you wanted?
string: 何の用だったかしら？

original: Welcome back to the temple, messenger.
string: ようこそまた聖堂に

original: Blessings of Mara upon you!
string: マーラの祝福を！

original: How may I help you, my son?
string: 若いの、何かお探しかな？

original: How may I help you, my daughter?
string: 娘さん、何かお探しで？

original: Lady Mara's messenger returns. What can I help you with, my child?
string: 聖女マーラの使いが戻ってくる。どんなご用かしら？

original: Has the Warmth of Mara been given to Riften?
string: マーラのぬくもりはリフテンに与えられたの？

original: Lady Mara bids you welcome to Her Benevolence.
string: 聖女マーラはあなたに慈悲をかけて下さるわ

original: What is it you seek, my child?
string: 何を探しているの？

original: Visiting Riften? All are welcome at the Temple of Mara.
string: リフテンに向かうの？　マーラの聖堂に行けば歓迎されるわ

original: Please to meet you, I'm a priestess at the Temple of Mara.
string: お会いできてうれしいわ。私がマーラの聖堂の司祭です

original: Thanks again for the delivery to Markarth. What can I do for you?
