string: パーロック、ジョーレ！　ヒン、カー、フェン、コス、ボナール

original: Zu'u Alduin, zok sahrot do naan ko Lein.
string: ズーウ、アルドゥイン、ゾック、サーロット、ド、ナーン、コ、レイン

original: Nust wo ni qiilaan fen kos duaan.
string: ヌスト、ウォ、ニ、キーラーン、フェン、コス、ドゥアーン

original: Dovahkiin, hin kah fen kos bonaar.
string: ドヴァーキン、ヒン、カー、フェン、コス、ボナール

original: Zu'u lost kriaan hi ont, nu hin sille fen nahkip suleyki.
string: ズーウ、ロスト、クリアーン、ハイ、オント、ヌ、ヒン、シレ、フェン、ナーキプ、スレイキ

original: Zu'u ni faas gaaffesejul.
string: ズーウ、ニ、ファース、ガーッフェセジュル

original: Dovahkiin, you should not have come here. Nu hin sil dii.
string: ドヴァーキン、お前はここに来るべきではなかった。ヌ、ヒン、シル、ディー

original: I have already defeated your friends once. Beyn. I do not fear them.
string: お前の仲間を既に一度倒している。ベイン。恐れなどない

original: You are persistent, Dovahkiin. Pruzah ol aar. A fine slave you would have made.
string: 懲りない奴だ、ドヴァーキン。プルザー、オル、アール。良いしもべを持ったな

original: My teeth to your neck, Dovahkiin!
string: その首に喰らいついてやる、ドヴァーキン！

original: Face me, then! Zu'u Alduin!
string: では立ち向え！　ズーウ、アルドゥイン！

original: Again, together! Alduin is strong!
string: 共にもう一度だ！　アルドゥインは強い！

original: Again, as one! The World-Eater fears us!
string: もう一度、共にだ！　世界を喰らう者は脅えている！

original: We can shatter his power if we Shout together!
string: 共に叫べば、奴の力を打ち砕けよう！

original: Again!
string: もう一度！

original: We must clear this confounding mist.
string: この人を惑わす霧をどうにかしなければ

original: Alduin will hide in this lightless mist until we Shout together, and shatter his power.
string: 我々が共に叫んでアルドゥインの力を粉砕しなければ、奴はこの光なき霧に隠れたままだ

original: We must Shout together these shadows to dispel.
string: この影を打ち払うには、共に叫ばなければならない

original: We're ready, Dragonborn, our wrath to unleash.
string: 準備はできたぞ、ドラゴンボーン、怒りを解き放つ時が来た

original: Everyone, inside. Now!
string: 中に入れ！

original: By the gods...
string: そんな…

original: Dragon!
string: ドラゴンだ！

original: There's no time. We have to make sure Winterhold is safe.
string: 時間がない。ウィンターホールドの安全を確認しないと

original: We'll go with you, but when this is all over I want an explanation.
string: 一緒に行きます。でもこれが終わったら、説明して下さいね

original: We'll go with you, but when this is all over I want an explanation.
string: 一緒に行きます。でもこれが終わったら、説明して下さいね

original: I'll go with you, but when this is all over I want an explanation.
string: 一緒に行きます。でもこれが終わったら、説明して下さいね

original: I'll go with you, but when things are back to normal I want an explanation.
string: 一緒に行こう。だが落ち着いたら説明してもらうからな

original: Something went wrong. Winterhold may be in danger. Can you help?
string: まずいことになった。ウィンターホールドが危ない。手を貸してくれないか？

original: It 'may be' in danger? Take a look. I don't think there's much question.
string: 危険かも知れないって？　見て。疑問の余地なんかないわ

original: Let's get down there. We have to do something.
string: 行きましょう。何かしなくちゃ

original: That's certainly an understatement. I've never seen anything like this!
string: 随分控え目な言い草だな。俺はこんなの見た事ないぞ！

original: Well, I suppose we can't just stand here. We'd better do something.
string: とにかく、ただここに突っ立ってるわけにはいかないな。何かしなくちゃな

original: What's going on? What happened in there?
string: どうなっている？　あそこで何が起こっている？

original: What's going on? What happened in there?
string: どうなっている？　あそこで何が起こっている？

original: What does the Guild get if I do that?
string: それをやったらギルドはどうなるんだ？

original: Since I know losing the farm's payments will harm the Guild, I intend to make a substantial contribution for compensation.
string: 農園からの上納金を失うのはギルドにとって痛手でしょうから、埋め合わせに相応の寄付をするつもりです

original: I take care of my friends.
string: 友人の面倒はしっかりと見ますよ

original: What would convince you that we're on your side?
string: 我々があなたの味方だと、どうすれば納得してもらえるんだ？

original: If you were to bring me the deed to Goldenglow Estate, so I was the full owner, that would be a step in the right direction.
string: もし本当にゴールデングロウ農園の権利書を持ってきてくれるのでしたら、私は完全な所有者として、正しい方向への一歩を踏み出せます

original: You don't believe us?
string: 我々を信じていないのか？

original: When you've been doing business like I have for decades, you quickly discover that the only person you can trust is yourself.
string: こういう商売を何十年もやっていれば分かる事ですが、結局のところ信頼できるのは自分だけですよ

original: What do you mean "supposed"?
string: “はず”とはどういう意味だ？

original: Having Goldenglow kept in line by the Thieves Guild has kept the honey flowing with minimal cost.
string: ハチミツがごく安価に出回っているのはゴールデングロウを盗賊ギルドが管理しているおかげなのです

original: Now, mysteriously, some sort of anonymous adversary shows up and takes the Estate out of my hands.
string: なのに、どこからともなく得体の知れぬ謎の商売敵が現れて農園を取り上げようとしています

original: Mercer wants me to discover Goldenglow's buyer.
string: メルセルはゴールデングロウの仕入れ人を探しているらしい

original: Yes, we spoke at length while you were in Whiterun dealing with our meadery situation.
string: ええ、お前がホワイトランに行っている間に、ハチミツ酒醸造所をどうするか細々と話し合いました

original: I hope for all your sakes you find out who's behind this supposed "plot."
string: これが“陰謀”だとすれば裏にいるのが誰なのか、どんな手を使っても調べてもらいたいのです

original: So how do I get him to talk?
string: じゃあ、どうやって情報を引き出す？

original: You're going to have to buy him off; it's the only way to get his attention.
string: 奴に金を渡さねばならん。気を引くにはそうするしかない

original: If that fails, follow him and see what he's up to. If I know Gulum-Ei, he's in way over his head and you'll be able to use it as leverage.
string: それが巧くいかなければ、後をつけて何を企んでいるか突き止めろ。ガラム・エイが俺の知っている通りの男なら、奴にとってこの件は荷が重すぎる。それも取引材料にできるはずだ

original: Seems all our eggs were in one basket.
string: どうも、すべての希望がこれにかかっているようだ

original: Look, in case you hadn't noticed, these aren't the glory days of the Guild.
string: なあ、もし気づいてないなら教えてやるが、今はもうギルドの時代じゃないんだぜ

original: We've lost more clients in the last decade than I'd care to count, but Maven's stuck with us through throughout the entire ordeal.
string: ここ10年間で嫌というほど客を失ったよ。でもその苦しい時期の間、メイビンはずっと味方でいてくれたんだ

original: I'll be damned if I'm going to lose her to... well, to whatever they are.
string: 彼女を奪われるなんて、ありえないね…　誰の手にも渡したくない

original: And Honningbrew?
string: ハニングブルーは？

original: Let's not kid ourselves. Black-Briar Mead is swill. The only thing keeping it successful is Maven.
string: 現実を直視しようか。ブラック・ブライアのハチミツ酒はドブ水だよ。あれが成功しているのは、メイビンがいるからだ

original: Word on the street was that Honningbrew tasted better, cost less and Sabjorn didn't shove it down everyone's throat.
string: ホニングブリューは味もよくてコストも安い。それにサビョルンはそいつをみんなに無理やり飲ませたりしない…　それが街の声だった

original: If Sabjorn ever managed to push Maven off her pedestal, we'd all be in trouble.
string: もしサビョルンがメイビンの地位をおとしめる事に成功したら、そいつは困りものじゃないか

original: How is all this affecting the Guild?
string: これはギルドにどんな影響があったんだ？

original: Goldenglow Estate provided a huge payout for us before Aringoth locked us out.
string: アリンゴスから閉め出しを食らうまで、ゴールデングロウ農園は金の成る木だったんだ

original: Maven looked the other way as long as the honey kept flowing and we kept him in line.
string: ハチミツが採れてアリンゴスが大人しくしている限り、メイビンは見て見ぬふりをしていた

original: I found the same marking at Honningbrew Meadery.
string: 同じシンボルをホニングブリュー醸造所でも見た

original: It would seem our adversary is attempting to take us apart indirectly by angering Maven Black-Briar. Very clever.
string: メイビン・ブラック・ブライアを怒らせて、敵は間接的にこっちを仲間割れさせようとしているようだ。賢いやり方だよ

original: It's really dead, then?
string: 本当に死んでしまったのか？

original: I never would have believed it, if I hadn't seen it with my own eyes...
string: この目で確かめてなかったら、信じなかっただろうな…

original: It may be dead now, but... where did it come from?
string: もう死んでしまったようだが…　どこから来たんだ？

original: In all my years, I've never seen such a thing...
string: 今まで生きてきて、こんな光景を見たのは初めてだ…

original: Something's happening...
string: 何かが起こっている…

original: What manner of magic is this?
string: これは何の魔法だ？

original: Look out! Don't get too close!
string: 危ない！　そばに寄るな！

original: It's like the ancient legends. Dragonborn...
string: まるで古代神話に出てくるドラゴンボーンだ…

original: It can't be... You... You took its very soul...
string: まさか…　その魂を吸いとったのか？

original: By the gods... I don't even know what to say...
string: ああ…　頭の中が真っ白だ…

original: Hey... is someone watching me?
string: おい…　誰か見てるのか？

original: I swear, if I'm being followed...
string: 何か、誰かにつけられている気が…

original: I swear I feel like I'm being watched.
string: 誰かの視線を感じて仕方がない

original: If this keeps up, I'm headed back to the Winking Skeever.
string: この調子なら、ウィンキング・スキーヴァーに帰っちまうぞ

original: I don't have time to chase shadows, I've got better things to do.
string: 影と追いかけっこしてる暇はない。やらなければならない事があるんだ

original: Must be my imagination.
string: 目の錯覚か

original: Damn ears... playing tricks on me again. Can't stand this sea air!
string: クソ、またか…　また空耳だ。この海風には我慢できない！

original: Following me, huh? You're not very good at this are you?
string: つけてたのか？　尾行するのは得意じゃないだろ？

original: You may as well give up, I see you there.
string: 観念した方がいいぞ。そこにいるのは分かっている

original: You're trailing me? I knew I heard something.
string: 追跡していたのはお前か？　やっぱり何か聞えたと思ったんだ

original: Ha! I knew it was you all along.
string: はっ！　最初からお前だって分かってたんだ

original: Who's there?
string: そこにいるのは誰だ？

original: Is someone following me?
string: 誰かつけてきてるのか？

original: I've never been more sure about anything in my entire life. Someone like Grelod doesn't deserve to live one more day. She's a monster.
string: 今まで生きてきて、こんなに本気になった事はないよ。グレロッドみたいな奴はもう1日だって生きてちゃいけないんだ。あいつは怪物なんだよ

original: Are you sure about this, boy? Murdering this woman?
string: 本気か、坊や？ 本気でその女を殺すのか？

original: She got sick, last winter, when the snows came. And she just... she never got better. Not all year. One night she fell asleep and...  never woke up.
string: 去年の冬、雪が降った頃に病気になったんだ。それからずっと…　よくならなくて。1年もしないうちに、ある晩眠ったまま…　ずっと起きてくれなかった

original: So now I'm all alone. And the Jarl said I had to go to Honorhall Orphanage. It's not fair!
string: それで僕はひとりぼっちだ。首長はオナーホール孤児院に行けって。こんなのひどいよ！

original: Tell me about your mother. What happened?
string: 母親のことを教えてくれ。何があった？

original: Your weird experiments are over, wizard.
string: お前の薄気味悪い実験も今日で終わりだ、ウィザードめ

original: Your corpse will feed my spiders for weeks. Now die, you fool!
string: お前の死体は蜘蛛達のエサにしてやる。さあ死ね、愚か者め！

original: What? Who are you? How did you get this far?
string: 何だ？　お前は誰だ？　どうやってこんな所まで？

original: Please hurry. To be honest, I'm kind of lonely here. As much as I hated getting sent to Honorhall, I really miss my friends there...
string: お願いだから急いでよ。本当はここにいるのが寂しいんだ。オナーホール孤児院に送られるのはいやだけど、あそこにいる友達には会いたいんだよ…

original: You've taken up enough of my time. Now leave.
string: これ以上相手してる暇はないんだ。帰っておくれ

original: Think you can intimidate me? In my own orphanage? Ha! Not bloody likely.
string: 私の孤児院で私を脅せると思ってるのかい？　ハッ！　とんでもない

original: You assist all you like. And get roasted for your trouble. I'll guard the exit.
string: 好きなだけ手を貸すがいい。丸焼けになるだろうがな。俺は出口を守る

original: Arcturus took some men deeper in, wanted to be sure. We should maybe... assist them.
string: 念のために、アークチュラスが深くまで人員を送り込んだんだ。もしかすると…　手を貸すべきだったのかも

original: Suppose not. But what's taking the others so long? The sooner we get out of here, the better. Smoke's getting bad. This place'll be raging soon.
string: そうは思わない。だが、他の者は何をそんなにモタモタしている？　早くここから出られればそれに越した事はない。煙は広がるばかりだ。今にひどい事になる

original: Dunno. One of these corpses. Does it matter?
string: 知らんな。ただの死体だ。それがどうかしたか？

original: Which one was the rat?
string: 裏切り者はどっちだ？

original: Thank you again for resolving my... problem.
string: もう一度お礼を言わせて。私の…　問題を解決してくれて

original: Ah, hello there, traveler. Come to the Nightgate for food or lodging?
string: やあ、旅人。ナイトゲートでほしいのは食糧か？　宿か？

original: Need a room? Or maybe just some mead?
string: 泊まりたいのか？　それとも食糧か？

original: Something I can get for ya?
string: 何かほしいのか？

original: I can't help you, friend. Talk to Hadring, the Innkeeper.
string: 助けにはなれない、友よ。宿の主人のハドリングに会うといい

original: I value my privacy. So if you don't mind?
string: プライバシーを大切にしているものでね。差し支えなければ、それで構わないか？

original: I really don't mean to be rude, friend, but I'm not feeling particularly sociable...
string: 気分を害するつもりは本当にない、友よ。だが特に人とおしゃべりする気分ではなくてね…

original: Hadring got himself another customer, eh?
string: ハドリングがまた客をつかまえたって？

original: The beds and beer are both lousy, you ask me.
string: ベッドもビールもひどいもんだと思う

original: What do you want?
string: 何の用だ？

original: You did? Really?
string: あなたが？　本当に？

original: This is the best news I've ever gotten!
string: こんなにうれしい知らせは初めてだよ！

original: I mean, I knew the Dark Brotherhood was good... just not that good! You killed the old hag before I even asked!
string: 闇の一党はいい人達だって分かってた。それだけじゃない。僕が頼む前にあのくそばばあを殺してくれたんだ！

original: Oh, and please, take this as payment. It's an old family heirloom, supposed to be pretty valuable. It should fetch you a nice price. Thank you again!
string: これを代金だと思って受け取ってよ。うちの家宝なんだ。かなり価値があるみたい。きっといい値段がつくよ。本当にありがとう！

original: Grelod? As it turns out... I already killed her.
string: グレロッド？ なんと言うか… もう殺したよ

original: What do you want? You have no business being in here.
string: 何の用？　ここに来てもしょうがないでしょ

original: All right. I'll take care of it.
string: 分かった。任せておいて

original: I'll handle it. No need to blow things out of proportion.
string: 私が何とかする。騒ぎ立てる必要なんてないわ

original: Please, just let me handle it. It's not a problem.
string: お願い、やらせて。大した問題じゃないの

original: Okay, okay. I'll deal with it.
string: 分かった。やっておくわ

original: Samuel is getting to be a problem. Fancies himself something of a "leader" to the other children. Put an end to the nonsense, or I will.
string: サミュエルは悩みの種だ。子供達のリーダー気取りでいる。こんなおふざけは何としてもやめさせなきゃ

original: Hroar's crying is keeping me up at night. I'll give you one chance to talk the tears out of him, or he's getting the belt.
string: ロアーの夜泣きで眠れやしない。泣きやむよう言い聞かせる機会を1度だけやろう。それでも泣き止まないなら、あの子はお仕置きだよ

original: I can't abide Samuel's constant talk of his parents. "They're coming for me." "This is only temporary." The boy must accept his fate.
string: サミュエルは両親の話ばかりして困るよ。“もうすぐ迎えに来るんだ”“一時的に預けられただけだ”ってさ。もう現実を受け入れなきゃ

original: Seven septims are missing from my purse. I know it was Runa. You get those coins back, or by Stendarr, I'll see her rot in the dungeon.
string: 私の財布から7ゴールドなくなった。ルナの仕業に決まってる。お前かステンダールが取り戻してきな。ルナはダンジョン行きだよ

original: This place is filthy. I've a mind to cancel all town privileges unless those brats start pulling their weight.
string: ここは汚れ放題だ。あのガキどもがそれ相応の仕事をしなけりゃ、町の特権をすべて剥奪してやる

original: The stores are running low. We'll need to water down the milk again. Besides, don't want the little darlings getting fat.
string: 食料の蓄えが底をつきそうだ。またミルクを水で薄めなきゃ。どうせガキどもを太らせたくないし

original: We haven't had an adoption in months. At this rate, we'll be stuck with these brats forever. We need to get the word out. A sale, if need be.
string: もう何ヶ月も養子縁組がないままだ。この調子じゃ、一生あのガキどもの面倒を見させられる。必要なら、売りに出すしかない

original: Yes, Grelod?
string: うん、グレロッド

original: Constance!
string: コンスタンス！

original: Who are you?
string: お前は誰だ？

original: I am Tsun, shield-thane to Shor.
string: 我こそはツン、ショールの“盾の従士”

original: The Whalebone Bridge he bade me guard and winnow all those souls whose heroic end sent them here, to Shor's lofty hall
string: 彼の命によりこの鯨骨の橋を守り、勇敢なる死によってこの場に辿りついたすべての魂を選り分けて

original: where welcome, well-earned, awaits those I judge fit to join that fellowship of honor.
string: 栄誉ある一員に加わる価値を勝ち取ったその力を、認められた魂を待ち受けるショールの高き間へと導く者

original: Come on! You know you want what's in that chest. Just walk toward it!
string: さあ！　宝箱の中のものがほしいんだろ。歩み寄れ！

original: Just walk toward the chest! Gravity will do the rest.
string: 宝箱に向かって歩け！　あとは引力に任せろ

original: I know you're up there. Go get the treasure. Doesn't it look pretty?
string: そこにいるのは分かってる。宝物を取ってこい。美しいだろ？

original: Oh, and I wasn't entirely truthful before. This is actually going to hurt a lot. You see, you have to be dead in order for the spell to take hold.
string: ああ、それからこの前は正直に言わなかったが、実際はかなり痛いはずだ。なぜなら、呪文を効かせるためには死ななければならない

original: Ah...Here it is. Now, if you'd be so kind as to stand still this will be much easier for me to do.
string: ああ…　ここだ。さて、じっと立っていてもらえると、かなりやりやすくなるんだが

original: Hhhmmm...maybe I put it over here.
string: ふーむ…　ここに置いたかも知れない

original: It's got to be somewhere around here! Now where did I put it?
string: この辺にあるはずだ！　さて、どこに置いたかな

original: Oh, and don't mind my assistant here. He may have seen better days, but he's still more help to me dead than he was alive.
string: ああ、それから助手の事は気にするな。落ちぶれてはいるが、生前より死んでからの方が役に立っている

original: Don't worry though. It'll be relatively painless...relatively.
string: だが心配するな。痛みは比較的少ないはずだ…　比較的な

original: Alright, let's see if we have something here to end this as quickly as possible.
string: よし、手早く終わらせるためのものが手に入ったか見てみよう

original: Ooooh...yes...yes. You've fallen for my trap! Greed makes a great lure. Odd you didn't die from the fall though. Most do.
string: おお…　そうだ…　そうだ。罠にかかったな！　欲深さは最高のおとりになる。だが落ちても死なないのは妙だな。大抵は命を落とすが

original: You're obviously a thief. I kill thieves. (Intimidate)
string: どう見ても盗賊だな。盗賊は殺すことにしている(威圧)

original: All right, calm down, no need to for that. I'll let you in right away, just need to get the gate unlocked.
string: 分かったよ、落ち着け。その必要はない。すぐに入れてやるから、まずその門の鍵を開けさせてくれ

original: I think you'd be a little smarter than that.
string: もう少し賢いと思ったんだが

original: Like anyone would even notice, in all this mess.
string: この混乱の中で誰でも気づくようにな

original: Don't sound so disappointed. You wouldn't be allowed to take it even if there was.
string: そんなにがっかりしないで。本当にあったとしても、持ってくわけにはいかないんだし

original: There's no gold, nothing shiny at all.
string: 黄金どころか、金目のものは何もない

original: I'm not sure what I was expecting, but this isn't it.
string: 何を期待してたのかはうまく言えないけど、こんなんじゃないわ

original: I just don't know that it's right for us to be in here like this, picking through the ruins .
string: こんな風にここに入って、廃墟を調べ回ることが正しいのかどうか分からないんだ

original: You seem uncomfortable being here.
string: あなた、居心地悪そうね

original: That doesn't begin to describe it.
string: そんなんじゃないんだ

original: This is a little creepy.
string: 少しゾッとするわね

original: I think, given the state of Skyrim, some might disagree.
string: スカイリムの土地を与えられることには反対する者もいるだろうな

original: Oh, right. That whole thing with the elves. Well, it all worked out in the end, didn't it?
string: ああ、そうとも。エルフとの事全部さ。まあ、結局は何もかも丸くおさまったじゃないか

original: Not excited, no. Some very bad things happened here.
string: わくわくするなんてとんでもない。ここで起こったのはとてもひどい事さ

original: Are you excited to see what's in there? This is important to you Nords, isn't it?
string: 中に何があるか、そんなに知りたいのか？　これはお前達ノルドにとって重要な事なんだな？

original: Don't get any ideas. We're here on official business, remember?
string: 誤解しないで。ここには公務で来ているの

original: I'm betting bodies. Lots and lots of bodies. And maybe some valuables...
string: 死体さ。累々たる屍だよ。それにおそらく金目のものが少々…

original: It's thousands of years old. Who knows what we might find?
string: 何千年もの歴史があるわ。何が見つかったって不思議じゃないでしょ？

original: What do you think we'll find in there?
string: 中で何が見つかると思うんだ？

original: Why in the world would this be sealed off? What is this place?
string: 一体なぜこの場所が封鎖されているのだ。ここは一体何なのか…

original: Well, this is highly unusual. And very interesting.
string: これは、とても珍しい…　そして、実に面白い

original: This is an exciting opportunity for us. To be able to study such an early civilization, and the magics they used...
string: これは実に素晴らしい、早期の文明と使われていた魔法について学べる機会だ

original: Sacked by the elves in the infamous "Night of Tears," not much is known about what happened to Saarthal.
string: エルフ達によるかの有名な略奪“涙の夜”　が起こったこと以外、サールザルで何があったのかは知られていない

original: As some of you may know, Saarthal was one of the earliest Nord settlements in Skyrim. It was also the largest.
string: 知っている者もいるだろうが、サールザルはノルドがスカイリムに定住した一番初めの土地の一つで、最大の移住地だった

original: I found this amulet. It might be important.
string: このアミュレットを見つけた。貴重なものかも知れない

original: You found what?
string: 何を見つけたって？

original: Hmm. Well now. Yes, this might actually be something interesting. You'd better show that to Tolfdir right away.
string: うーむ、どれどれ。実際、とても興味深い品だ。トルフディルにすぐ見せた方がいいだろう

original: You found what?
string: 何を見つけたって？

original: Hmm. Well now. This is all very fascinating, but I don't recall asking to you to touch anything in here.
string: ふーむ。よし。かなりいい物だが、ここの物に触っていいと言った覚えはないぞ

original: I suppose you'd better show that to Tolfdir nonetheless. And please, ask before tampering with anything else.
string: とはいえ、トルフディルに見せた方がいいだろう。それから、頼むから他の物をいじる時はまず声をかけてくれ

original: Kill her?
string: 彼女を殺す？

original: I've thought this through, and it's the only way. She's too far gone, too corrupted by the Hags. At least in death she can be free again.
string: さんざん考えたけれど、他に方法はないの。彼女は連中にそそのかされて、一線を越えてしまった。少なくとも死ねば自由になれる

original: Enough. Let's go.
string: もういいわ。行きましょう

original: What's the plan?
string: 何か考えは？

original: I'll present you as the sacrifice. Just play along. While mother begins the ritual, I'll strike. Then, together we can... we can kill her.
string: あなたを生贄として紹介するから、それらしくふるまって。母が儀式を始めたら私が襲いかかる。2人でやれば…　彼女を殺せるわ

original: All right. Mother is just outside this door. I have a plan.
string: いいわね。母はこのドアのすぐ向こうにいる。私に考えがあるの

original: I'm sorry.
string: すまない

original: Don't be sorry for me. I just - if I would have known it would come to this. Mother...
string: 謝ったりしないで。ただ…　こんな事になると分かっていたら。お母さん…

original: About your mother...
string: あなたの母について聞きたい…

original: You've decided to help?
string: 手伝ってくれるの？

original: Do I make myself clear?
string: 言っている意味は分かるな？

original: Don't know. Creepy fella, black robe. Couldn't see his face. Paid me a pretty sum to get that into your hands, though.
string: 分からない。黒装束の薄気味悪い奴だ。顔は見えなかった。これをあんたに渡すのと引き換えに、報酬を弾んでくれたけどな

original: From who?
string: 誰から？

original: What's the plan?
string: 何か考えは？

original: Well, here we are. We think.
string: さて、着いたわ。たぶんね

original: Their leader is a battle-mage named Haldyn.
string: 彼らのリーダーは、ハルディンという魔闘士だ

original: Haldyn? I've heard of the man, but never guess he'd join up with some pirates.
string: ハルディン？　名前は知ってたけど、まさか海賊の仲間になるとはね

original: This could be even more dangerous than I thought. Head to the ships. We'll plan the assault on the way.
string: 思ったより危険かも知れないわ。船に乗ってちょうだい。途中で襲撃の計画を練りましょう

original: I know where the Blood Horkers are.
string: ブラッド・ホーカースの居場所を知っている

original: Finally, someone around here that can get things done.
string: ついにあの問題を片付けてくれる人が、この界隈に現れたってわけね

original: Since we're short on soldiers you'll be coming with us, too. No arguments.
string: 兵士が足りないから一緒に来て。質問はなしよ

original: Anything else you want to say?
string: 他に言いたい事は？

original: Sorry isn't good enough, Orthus. There's a lot of gold at stake here, and sniveling isn't going to get it back.
string: 謝ってもだめよ、オルサス。大金がかかっているし、泣いても取り戻せないわ

original: Adelaisa, I'm sorry.
string: アデライサ、すまない

original: Who is Haldyn?
string: ハルディンとは誰だ？

original: Our secret ingredient, if you will.
string: 例えて言えば、俺達の“隠し味”ってとこだな

original: A battle-mage of fearsome cunning.
string: 恐ろしく悪賢い魔闘士だ

original: Runs the Blood Horkers, and makes sure the battles end right-side up.
string: ブラッド・ホーカースを仕切り、戦いを必ず有利に終わらせる

original: Lots of gold to be had plundering ships.
string: 船にはずいぶんと金が入ったろう

original: Aye, the war keeps the Empire and the locals too busy to worry about us. Haldyn calls it "our golden age."
string: そうさ、帝国も住民も戦争で忙しすぎて、海賊を気にしている余裕がない。ハルディンは“黄金時代”と呼んでるよ

original: Oh, we've got other things in mind for our mouths, sweetie.
string: ああ、別のが頭に浮かんできたんだ

original: Just... leave me alone! I've brought your mead, now drink it and shut your filthy mouths.
string: いいから…　放っておいて！　ハチミツ酒を持ってきた。それを飲んで、汚い口を塞ぐといいわ

original: Come now, dearie, surely we aren't all that bad.
string: さあおいで、愛しい人、俺達はそれほど悪くないぞ

original: You beasts are the worst.
string: 最低のケダモノね

original: Both of you wait here for a moment.
string: ここで待っていてくれ

original: We're right behind you.
string: ついて行くわ

original: Let's go.
string: 行こう

original: Lead on, we're ready.
string: 先導してちょうだい、準備はできてる

original: Let's go.
string: 行こう

original: We're with you.
string: つきあうわよ

original: Let's go.
string: 行こう

original: Will do. Don't stray too far away or else we'll come after you.
string: 分かった。あまり遠くに行くようなら、勝手についていくからね

original: No problem, but if you get too far away, we're going to catch up.
string: いいわよ、でもあまり遠くに行くようなら、後を追わせてもらうわ

original: All right, but don't wander ahead too far or else we'll be forced to come find you.
string: 了解、でもあまり遠くに行って探す手間をかけさせないでね

original: Here's an order from General Tullius himself.
string: テュリウス将軍直々の命令を届けに来た

original: What?
string: 何？

original: Well... This seems to be in order. Very well, follow me.
string: ふむ…　確かにそのようだ。いいだろう、ついてこい

original: I need a prisoner released from Northwatch Keep.
string: ノースウォッチ砦から囚人を釈放したい

original: The Thalmor? Do you have any idea what you're asking?
string: サルモールの事か？　自分が何を言っているのか分かってるのか？

original: I'm sorry, that's just not possible. It would cause far too many problems.
string: 悪いが、それは無理だ。そんな事をしたら大問題だ

original: The Thalmor? Do you have any idea what you're asking?
string: サルモールの事か？　自分が何を言っているのか分かってるのか？

original: I can only imagine the headaches this is going to cause...
string: そんな事をしたらまた頭痛の種が増えるだけだが…

original: Here, take this. Assuming they even honor it, you should be able to get your prisoner out.
string: ほら、これを持って行け。連中がそれに敬意を表するなら、囚人を出す事もできるはずだ

original: I'm here for Thorald Gray-Mane
string: ソラルド・グレイ・メーンに会いに来た

original: Are you joking?
string: 何かの冗談か？

original: Even if we had a prisoner by that name, the only way he'd be released is by order of the Imperial Legion.
string: そういう名の囚人がいたとしても、帝国軍からの命令がなければ拘束を解く事はできない

original: Now I suggest you turn around and go back the way you came.
string: さあ、おとなしく立ち去って帰るがいい

original: Are you joking?
string: 何かの冗談か？

original: Even if we had a prisoner by that name, the only way he'd be released is by order of the Imperial Legion.
string: そういう名の囚人がいたとしても、帝国軍からの命令がなければ拘束を解く事はできない

original: Now I suggest you turn around and go back the way you came.
string: さあ、おとなしく立ち去って帰るがいい

original: Look, I'm getting out of here. Normally, spiders make my skin crawl, but magic spiders? Blech.
string: おい、もうここを出るぞ。ただでさえクモは苦手なのに、魔法をかけられてるんだぞ？　ゾッとするね

original: What was going on with that spider?
string: そのスパイダーに何が起こったんだ？

original: I don't know, but this place is full of them. Every one I've encountered has been enchanted or the like.
string: さあね。だが、ここには奴らがうようよしてる。どれも魔法か何かをかけられてるんだ

original: Does it matter? You're warm, dry... and still very much alive. That's more than can be said for old Grelod. Hmm?
string: それは重要かしら？　こうして安全な場所で…　生き延びる事ができている。グレロッドについて言える事は以上よ、違う？

original: What? Where am I? Who are you?
string: 何だ？ ここはどこだ！？ あなたは誰だ？

original: Sleep well?
string: よく眠れた？

original: The anticipation is killing me. Can you figure out who has the contract? Which one will you choose?
string: 気になって仕方ないわ。誰の仕事？　あなたはどれを選ぶつもり？

original: How long has Yamarz been cursed?
string: ヤマーズが呪われてから、どれくらいになるんだ？

original: Almost ever since he became leader of the tribe.
string: 一族の長となって間もない頃から、ずっとだ

original: He killed Shagrol in combat, which none of us thought possible. But the winner is made Chief. That is how it is done.
string: 彼は決闘の末にシャグロルを殺した。誰もそんな事はできないと思っていたのに。しかし勝った者が族長になる。そのとおりになったのだ

original: Is there a key for this cage?
string: この檻の鍵はどこにある？

original: No, it's the levers in the center there. Just make sure you don't pull the wrong one. Please, hurry. I don't like being in here!
string: いや、そこの真ん中にレバーがある。違うのを引かないでくれよ。頼むから急いでくれ。早くここから出たいんだ！

original: Why are you in this cage?
string: なぜ檻に入れられている？

original: They threw me in here until they were ready to use me in one of their experiments.
string: 俺を実験に使う準備ができるまで、ここに放り込んでおく事にしたらしい

original: This wasn't supposed to happen. I thought they wanted my help, not to use me as a test subject!
string: こんなはずじゃなかったんだ。奴らに協力しようと思っただけなのに！　実験台としてじゃなくな！

original: I'm here to rescue you and recover the books you stole.
string: お前を助けに来た。盗んだ本は返してもらうぞ

original: See? I knew Aren wouldn't leave me in here!
string: ほら見ろ！　やっぱりアレンは俺を見捨ててなかったんだ！

original: Hurry and get me out of this cage before they come for me!
string: 奴らが来る前に急いで俺を檻から出してくれ！

original: I've located Grimsever.
string: グリムセバーを見つけた

original: When you told me of your intent to join the Thieves Guild, I honestly didn't think we'd have much to speak about ever again.
string: 盗賊ギルドに入るつもりだと聞いた時は、正直また話をする事があるなんて思わなかったわ

original: Yet here you are with my weapon that you could have easily sold or kept for yourself.
string: でも私の武器を、売る事も持ち去る事もできたのに持ってきてくれた

original: Forgive me for my hasty opinion of you, I see that I was wrong and that there's much I can learn from you.
string: あなたを見くびっていた事を許して。私が間違っていたわ。あなたから学ぶ事がたくさんありそう

original: If you'd permit me, I'd be honored to accompany you in your travels for a time.
string: もし差し支えなければ、しばらく同行させてもらえたら光栄よ

original: Astonishing. To think you actually were able to reach it and yet return to tell the tale.
string: 驚きだわ。本当にたどり着いたうえに、途方もない土産話を持って戻ってくるなんて

original: Rarely in my travels have I encountered those who possess skills equal to your own.
string: 長いこと旅もしたけれど、あなたと並ぶぐらい技量を持った人にはめったに出会わなかった

original: I see I still have much to learn. If you'd permit me, I'd be honored to accompany you in your travels for a time.
string: まだまだ学ぶ事はたくさんあるのね。もし差し支えなければ、しばらく同行させてもらえると光栄なのだけど

original: "Honor" is a coward's tool.
string: “名誉”など臆病者の言い訳だ

original: An astute observation.
string: 優れた洞察力だ

original: Skyrim is a beautiful and harsh mistress, but her people cling to such a petty notion of honor.
string: スカイリムは美しく無慈悲な女王だが、その民は名誉という哀れな概念にしがみついている

original: (Invisible Continue)
string: (見えないまま)

original: My previous champion displeases me.
string: 前の勇者は我の勘に障るのだ

original: It is time he is replaced - in the traditional fashion.
string: そろそろ替えどきだな。いつものやり方で

original: Impressive.
string: 実に素晴らしい

original: Well, it was. Sadly, this forge is dying and I've used the last of my fire salts. If I can't feed it soon, it may grow cold.
string: ああ、前はそうだった。残念な事に、炎の塩鉱石を使い果たしたから鍛冶炉がヤバいんだ。すぐに入れないと炉が冷えちまう

original: You seem quite proud of your work.
string: 自分の仕事に誇りを持ってるようだな

original: Smithing's been in my blood for generations. I owe my success to my forefathers and their recipe for flame.
string: 代々鍛冶屋をやってるんだ。うまくやってるとしたら、それは先祖と、先祖が伝えてくれた火加減のおかげだよ

original: The secret is my forge. It consumes fire salts, a strange mineral that burns as hot as Red Mountain lava.
string: 秘密は鍛冶炉だ。炎の塩鉱石を使う。そいつはレッドマウンテンの溶岩と同じくらい熱く燃える不思議な鉱石だ

original: No, no! This can't be happening!
string: だめだ！　こんなはずはない！

original: The sealed letter will explain everything that needs to be done. The amulet is quite valuable - you can use it to pay for any and all expenses.
string: やるべき事はすべて、封をした手紙に説明されている。そのアミュレットも相当な値打ち物だ。それを使ってすべての出費を賄ってくれ

original: How did you meet Keerava?
string: キーラバにどうやって会った？

original: I met her when I wandered into Riften a few years ago. Been smitten with her ever since. In fact, I'm thinking of asking her to marry me.
string: 数年前、リフテンに立ち寄った時に出会ったんだ。それ以来、彼女に首ったけでね。実は、結婚を申し込もうと考えている

original: In Black Marsh, tradition dictates we present a potential mate a unique wedding ring to represent our future bond.
string: ブラック・マーシュでは伝統的に、絆を誓い合う印として、相手にいっぷう変わった結婚指輪を贈るんだ

original: I already have the gold band, but all I need are three flawless amethysts to complete the setting.
string: 金の指輪は既にあるんだけど、結婚指輪を完成させるためには、キズの無いアメジストが3つ必要なんだよ

original: I've given away all the missives.
string: すべての文書を届けてきた

original: Oh, splendid! Just splendid! Mara smiles upon us this day.
string: まあ素晴らしい！　マーラは私達にほほえみかけて下さるわ

original: Allow me to give you her gift... a true blessing to aid you in times of need. Despair not, her warmth will protect you always!
string: 彼女からの贈り物よ…　困った時にあなたを助けてくれる真の祝福なの。絶望しないでね。彼女のぬくもりがいつもあなたを守ってくれるわ！

original: How do I get to Whiterun from here?
string: ホワイトランにはどうやって行くんだ？

original: Just head north - you can't miss it. It's the capital of Whiterun Hold.
string: 北に向かえばいい。すぐに分かるよ。ホワイトラン要塞の首都だから

original: Jarl Balgruuf still hasn't declared for one side or the other, so at least you won't run into any Imperials along the way.
string: バルグルーフ首長はまだどっちの側につくか宣言していない。だから少なくとも、道中で帝国軍に出くわすことはないだろう

original: Cross the river and then head north. You'll see Whiterun on its hill as you pass the falls.
string: 川を渡って北へ向かって。滝を過ぎると丘の上にホワイトランが見えるわ

original: We escaped from the Imperials together.
string: 一緒に帝国軍から逃げてきたんだ

original: You did? We heard that Ulfric was captured...
string: 本当に？　ウルフリックが捕まったと聞いたけど…

original: ... no, sorry, but in times like these I can't just take the word of a stranger who wanders into town claiming to be my brother's friend.
string: 悪いけど、こんな時代よ。兄弟の友達だと言って町に来たよそ者の言葉を真に受ける事はできないの

original: He's a friend. He promised you could help.
string: 彼は友人だ。お前が助けてくれると約束してくれた

original: Do you have any supplies I could take?
string: 使っていい物資はあるか？

original: Of course. Take what you need.
string: もちろん。必要な物を使ってくれ

original: Of course. Here's a key to the house. Stay as long as you like. If there's anything else you need, just let me know.
string: いいわ。これが家の鍵よ。好きなだけいてちょうだい。何か必要な物があったら言ってね

original: But what's this all about? What are you two doing here?
string: でも、どういう事なの？　あなた達ここで何してるの？

original: Of course. Take what you need.
string: もちろん。必要な物を使ってくれ

original: But what's this all about? What are you two doing here?
string: でも、どういう事なの？　あなた達ここで何してるの？

original: Ralof? How do you know him?
string: レイロフ？　なぜ彼を知ってるの？

original: Ralof said you could help me out.
string: あなたなら手伝ってくれるとレイロフに聞いた

original: Like I said, I'm glad to help in any way I can. Help yourself to whatever you need, within reason.
string: もう言ったが、喜んでお前に手を貸そう。常識の範囲内なら何でも自由にしていい

original: Ralof said you could help me out.
string: あなたなら手伝ってくれるとレイロフに聞いた

original: Here, sister. Blessings of Mara upon you.
string: これをどうぞ。マーラの恵みがありますように！

original: Mara only helps those who can afford her tithes. This is nonsense.
string: マーラは税を納める事のできる人しか助けてくれないわ。そんなのたわ言よ

original: Oh, how kind! Thank you.
string: ご親切に、ありがとうございます！

original: Excellent, I needed some more kindling for my kitchen hearth.
string: ちょうどよかった、台所の焚きつけがもう少しほしいと思っていたところですよ

original: Whatever you're peddling, I'm not buying.
string: 何を売り歩いてるか知らないけど、買わないわよ

original: Are you serious? You're as crazy as Maramal.
string: 冗談でしょ？　あなたマラマルみたいにイカれてるわよ

original: Look, the only religion I believe in is the good old septim. Everything else is just a waste.
string: いい？　私が信じてるのはゴールドだけ。あとはみんなクズよ

original: Ugh. Get this awful paper away from me, by Talos!
string: うう、そんな汚らわしい紙を近づけないで！

original: Oh, a new pamphlet from Dinya? I'll be glad to read it. Thanks.
string: あら、ディンヤから新しいパンフレット？　読んでみるわね。ありがとう

original: Huh? Oh. Sure, whatever. I prefer Dibella's teachings myself.
string: は？　なんでもいいわよ。どちらかというと、ディベラの信者なんですけどね

original: Thank you. Umm, blessings upon you too.
string: ありがとう。あなたにも祝福がありますように

original: I wouldn't even clean my tail with this trash.
string: そんなんじゃ尻尾さえきれいにならないわ

original: Unless Mara wishes to come down and help me with these urchins, I don't really give a damn about her blessings.
string: マーラがあの悪ガキどもの扱いに手を貸してくれないなら、彼女の祝福なんかどうでもいいわ

original: Thank you. I'll share this with Aerin.
string: ありがとう。これはアエリンと分けるわ

original: Hmmm. Never read anything from the temple before. I suppose there wouldn't be any harm in reading it.
string: ふむ。これまで聖堂から何かを読み取った事はないけど、読んでも害にはならないだろうね

original: Here, brother. Blessings of Mara upon you.
string: これをどうぞ。マーラの恵みがありますように！

original: What's this nonsense? Bah.
string: この茶番は何だ？　ふん

original: I'll read it. Thank you.
string: 読ませてもらうよ。ありがとう

original: I don't have time for this nonsense.
string: そんな戯言につきあっている時間はない

original: Seems like a noble cause, I'll look it over.
string: 立派な大義があるようだな。見ておくよ

original: If only more people would read this, things might be better in Riften.
string: これをもっと多くの人が読んでくれたら、リフテンの状況ももっとましだろうに

original: I don't understand how paper will help the dregs of this city, but suit yourself.
string: 紙きれで街のクズをどう救うつもりか知らないが、ご自由に

original: Do you take me for a fool? Get this drivel away from me!
string: 馬鹿にしてるのか？　こんなくだらないもの、持ち帰ってくれ！

original: Thank you. Blessings of Mara upon you as well.
string: ありがとう。マーラの祝福があらんことを

original: Interesting. I'll look it over. Thanks.
string: これは興味深い。じっくり見させてもらうよ。ありがとう

original: I hold my own beliefs, but thanks anyway.
string: 改宗するつもりはないけど、とにかくありがとう

original: Mara this and Mara that. Where is she when hundreds of Stormcloaks are dying for no good reason, eh?
string: マーラ、マーラってうるさいな。何百人ものストームクロークが大義もなく死にかけている時に、彼女はどこにいるんだよ、あん？

original: Not really my usual read, but I'll give it a try.
string: いつも読んでるのとはタイプが違うが、読んでみるよ

original: Mara can't help me. No one can.
string: マーラには救えなどしない。誰一人としてな

original: Oh, interesting. I'll read it this evening.
string: これは興味深い。今晩にでも読ませてもらおう

original: I have no desire to seek religion.
string: 信仰を求めてるわけじゃないの

original: I visit the temple sometimes, but perhaps not often enough. Thanks for bringing this to me.
string: 聖堂にはたまに行くけど、十分じゃないかもな。これには感謝するよ

original: Thank you for the blessing, I'll put this to good use.
string: ありがとう。有効に使わせてもらうよ

original: Oh, well thank you. I'll try and read this if I can.
string: おお、ありがとう。できたら読んでみるよ

original: Are you out of your mind?
string: お前、正気か？

original: I think I have some more of these padding my mattress.
string: これがあれば、マットレスを厚くできそうだ

original: I have no time for Marla or Mara or whatever her name is... there's work to be done!
string: マーラだかマラーだか知らんがそんな暇はない…　なすべき事があるのだ！

original: Had only Mara saved that poor animal...
string: マーラが哀れな生き物を救ってくれますように…

original: I'll give it a try, thanks very much.
string: 試してみるよ。本当にありがとう

original: Where did he acquire the knowledge to use it?
string: どこで彼は使う知識を得たんだ？

original: Ironically, I pointed him in the same direction I pointed you. To Markarth and Calcelmo.
string: 皮肉な話だが、今と同じ方向を彼に指し示した。マルカルスとカルセルモの方へな

original: I'm only hoping whatever means he used to learn the language will still be available to you.
string: 彼が言葉を習得するために使った手段が、まだ得られる事を願うばかりだ

original: Why did Gallus scribe his journal in Falmer?
string: なぜガルスはファルメルの記録を残した？

original: Besides the fact that there are only a handful of people in Tamriel that even recognize the language?
string: タムリエルには、あの言葉を知る者がわずかしかいないというのに？

original: I'm fairly certain he was planning some sort of a heist that involved a deep understanding of the Falmer language.
string: ファルメル語への深い理解を要する、何らかの襲撃を計画していたことははっきりしている

original: Sadly, we never had the opportunity to speak about the details.
string: 残念ながら、詳しい話をするチャンスがなかった

original: How did you meet him?
string: どうやって彼と会ったんだ？

original: Ah yes, quite an amusing anecdote actually. I caught him trying to break into my laboratory.
string: ああ、それが何とも愉快な話でな。研究所に押し入ろうとしているところを捕まえたんだ

original: I was about to show him the error of his ways when he made a curiously astute comment about my research notes.
string: 彼の誤った行動について説教しようとしたところ、私の調査書を見て妙に鋭い意見を言ってな

original: I was astounded and in turn it lead to a conversation. Who'd have imagined it would lead to such a strong friendship?
string: 私はびっくりして、そこから会話が始まった。あれほど強い友情が生まれるなんて誰が思っただろう？

original: He was an academic yet he chose a different path. Why?
string: 彼は学識があっても危険な道を選んだ。なぜだ？

original: Well, for the thrill of course.
string: それはもちろん、スリルを味わうためさ

original: He was quite clear that he felt more in his element climbing through a window rather than hunched over a dusty tome.
string: ホコリっぽい書に顔をうずめているより、窓をよじ登って侵入したりする方が性に合うそうだ。明快だったな

original: What can you tell me about Gallus?
string: ガルスについて教えてくれるか？

original: He was a dear friend of mine and a surprisingly astute pupil of academia... I was devastated when he was killed.
string: 親しい友人であり、驚くほど明敏な学び手だった…　亡くなった時は悲嘆に暮れたよ

original: I suppose that risk always coexisted with his line of work, I just never thought his luck would run out.
string: 職業柄、その危険と常に隣り合わせだったのだろうが、まさか運が尽きるとは思ってもいなかった

original: Remember, speak only to Enthir. Trust no one else.
string: 忘れないで、話していいのはエンシルだけよ。他は誰も信用しちゃだめ

original: If you have further need of me, you can find me in the College.
string: また必要になったら、大学を訪ねてくれ

original: Calcelmo is stubborn as a mule. Be careful when you speak to him.
string: カルセルモはものすごく頑固だ。話す時は気をつけて

original: Be careful.
string: 気をつけろ

original: I hope you enjoy touring the museum. Just don't touch anything.
string: この博物館の見学を楽しんでいただけたかな？　ただ、何にも触らないように

original: Oh, be certain to purchase my Falmer translation tome when it's completed!
string: ファルメル翻訳書が完成したら、忘れずに買うように！

original: Now, stand aside, there's work to be done.
string: さあ、どいてくれ。やらなければならないことがある

original: Try not to disturb me in the future, I'm in the midst of groundbreaking research!
string: これからは私の邪魔をしないように。前例のない研究の真っ只中だ

original: Can't you come with me to Winterhold?
string: 一緒にウィンターホールドに行かないか？

original: I'm afraid not. There are preparations to make and Gallus's remains to lay to rest.
string: だめよ。あいにく色々とやるべき準備があるし、ガルスの遺体も葬ってあげないと

original: I promise to join you there as soon as I can.
string: 約束するわ。なるべく早く追いつくから

original: I'll be right back.
string: すぐ戻るよ

original: I certainly hope so. I don't know how long we can keep this up.
string: 心からそう祈ります。いつまでもちこたえられるか分かりませんから

original: At least tell me where you're going, so we can send someone after you if you don't come back.
string: 行き先だけは教えていって下さい、戻ってこなかった時に、他の者をやれるように

original: Why me?
string: なぜ自分に？

original: I've got to stay here, to see if we can get to Ancano and stop this. I need someone I can trust to do it.
string: 私はここを動けません、アンカノに働きかけてこの事態を止められるか、やってみなければなりませんから。だから信用できる人に任せたいんです

original: Besides, you're the one having all of these visions, aren't you?
string: それに、あなたはこの顛末を予言した当人ではありませんか

original: Winterhold is safe for now.
string: ウィンターホールドはもう安全だ

original: Wish I could say the same for us.
string: こちらも大丈夫と言えたらいいんですが

original: Tolfdir and I can try and keep this contained. You need to get your hands on the Staff of Magnus. Now.
string: トルフディルと私で食い止めてみます。その間にマグナスの杖をお願いします。行って下さい

original: It's coming loose. I can feel it.
string: ゆるくなってきたぞ。感触で分かる

original: Don't stop. Keep cutting.
string: 止まるな。切り続けろ

original: That's it. Keep hacking at it.
string: いいぞ。そのまま斬りつけ続けろ

original: I'll distribute them.
string: 届けてこよう

original: Oh my, how wonderful! Lady Mara will be so pleased!
string: まあ、なんてすばらしいんでしょう！　聖女マーラはさぞお喜びになるわ！

original: Here you are. Now make sure you give out every single one, we can't afford to let even one lost soul stray from Her warmth.
string: はい、これが書状ね。ひとり残らず配ってちょうだい。たったひとりでも彼女のぬくもりからはずすわけにはいかないの

original: Does the temple need any additional assistance?
string: 聖堂のために、他にできることはないか？

original: Riften is drowning in a sea of sin and wickedness and it's my personal mission to let everyone know that the warmth of Mara can see them through.
string: リフテンは罪と悪徳の海に沈みかけているわ。マーラのぬくもりは人の心を見通す力がある、人々にそう教えるのが私の使命なの

original: All I need is a messenger to bring Her words to these poor souls by distributing these missives.
string: この書状を配って、心の貧しき人々に彼女の言葉をもたらすメッセンジャーを探しているのよ

original: I have deathbell for you.
string: デスベルを持ってきた

original: Good, my experiments are at a critical stage and these are just what I need to finish. Here's some coin for all the trouble.
string: よかった。ちょうど実験の大事な所でこれが仕上げに必要だったの。これは手間をかけたお礼よ

original: I have nightshade for you.
string: ベラドンナを持ってきた

original: Perfect. This is just what I needed. Here's some gold for your time.
string: 完璧ね。ちょうど必要だったの。これは手間をかけた分のお礼よ

original: I have nirnroot for you.
string: ニルンルートを持ってきた

original: Ah yes, excellent samples. Thank you. This coin should compensate you for all the bother.
string: 素晴らしい材料だわ。ありがとう。このお金を手間賃として受け取って

original: He gave me this keg to deliver.
string: この樽を配達するように頼まれた

original: That fetcher! I gave him the same keg just this morning and told him to store it in the cellars.
string: あの野郎！　今朝これと同じ樽を渡して、貯蔵室に入れとくように言ったばかりなんだ

original: Oh, he'll rot in prison for this one I promise you. As soon as Maven finds out, it's all over for him.
string: こんな事しやがって、牢屋で朽ち果てちまえばいいんだ。メイビンに知れたら、奴は終わりだな

original: Here, take this as a bit of a reward for nabbing our little thief.
string: コソ泥を教えてくれた事へのちょっとばかしのお礼だ。受け取ってくれ

original: Did you know Romlyn is skimming from the meadery?
string: 知ってるか？ ロムリンはハチミツ酒醸造所から酒をくすねている

original: Aye, I suspected as much but I've never been able to catch that little sneak with proof.
string: なんと！　疑ってはいたんだが、あのコソ泥の尻尾をつかめずにいたんだ

original: Thieves and temples. It just doesn't add up.
string: 盗賊と聖堂か。妙な組み合わせだな

original: I felt the same way when Gallus first revealed these things to me.
string: ガルスから初めて聞かされた時には私も同じ感想を抱いたものよ

original: I think given time, you'll understand what I mean.
string: いずれ時が経てば、あなたにも分かるわ

original: Very well, we do it your way for now.
string: 分かった。とりあえず、やり方は任せる

original: I'll make for Riften and scout the situation; see if I can discover what Mercer's up to. When you're ready, meet me at the Ragged Flagon.
string: 先にリフテンへ行って様子を探ってくるわ。メルセルが何を企んでるのか調べてみる。そちらの準備ができしだい、ラグド・フラゴンで落ちあいましょう

original: In the meantime, I wanted you to have this. It belonged to Gallus, but given the circumstances I think he'd approve.
string: とりあえず、これはあなたが持っていて。ガルスの物だったんだけど、状況が状況だから彼もきっと許してくれる

original: Why does it require that type of protection?
string: なぜそこまで守る必要があるんだ？

original: Everything that represents Nocturnal's influence is contained within the walls of the Sepulcher.
string: ノクターナルの力を表すすべてがその墓所に収められているからよ

original: Now it seems Mercer's broken his oath with Nocturnal and defiled the very thing he swore to protect.
string: メルセルはノクターナルへの誓約を破り、守ると約束した当の場所を荒らした事になるわけ

original: Gallus's journal mentioned the "Twilight Sepulcher."
string: ガルスの日記には“黄昏の墓所”について書かれていた

original: You've come this far, so I see no harm in concealing it any longer.
string: そこまで知っているのなら、もう隠しだてしても仕方ないわね

original: The Twilight Sepulcher is the temple to Nocturnal. It's what the Nightingales are sworn to protect with their lives.
string: “黄昏の墓所”はノクターナルの聖堂よ。ナイチンゲールは皆、命に代えてもそこを守る誓いを立てている

original: We must hasten to Riften before Mercer can do any more damage to the Guild.
string: メルセルがこれ以上ギルドに害を加えないうちに、リフテンへ戻らないと

original: I have a delivery from Romlyn.
string: ロムリンから届け物がある

original: All right, pipe down. You want the whole blessed place to hear you?
string: 分かった、声を落としてくれ。この神聖な場所全体に聞かれたいのか？

original: The arrangement called for a trade. I hope you'll find this suitable.
string: この話は取引だったな。これで納得してくれるといいが

original: What kind of delivery?
string: 配達の内容は？

original: I need someone to take this small keg of Black-Briar Mead to Wilhelm at the Vilemyr Inn in Ivarstead.
string: ブラック・ブライアのハチミツ酒が入ったこの小さな樽を、イヴァルステッドの宿屋ヴァイルマイヤーにいるウィルヘルムに届けてほしいんだ

original: Drop it off and he'll trade you something for the delivery. Keep it as payment for the legwork.
string: これを運んでくれたら、ウィルヘルムが配達の品と引き換えにある物をくれる。仕事の報酬としてそれを受け取ってくれていい

original: Oh, and if you bump into Indaryn from the meadery, keep your mouth shut. He'd rat us out in a second.
string: それと、もし醸造所のインダルインに偶然会ってしまっても、何も言うなよ。あいつはすぐに密告するからな

original: You're selling cheap mead?
string: 安いハチミツ酒を売っているのか？

original: No, no friend. You've got it all wrong. I'm not selling cheap mead. I'm selling good mead for cheap... Black-Briar Mead.
string: いやいや。勘違いしてもらっちゃ困るよ。安いハチミツ酒など売ってない。質のいいハチミツ酒を安く売ってるんだ…　ブラック・ブライアのハチミツ酒をね

original: I sell cases of it for half of what the inns and taverns pay through the Meadery.
string: 宿屋や酒場が醸造所から買う半分の値段で売っているんだ

original: All I need is someone to deliver it for me. If anyone saw me leave Riften, they'd get suspicious.
string: ただ、酒を配達してくれる人手が必要でね。リフテンを離れるのを誰かに見られて、怪しまれたくないからな

original: She's made her way east into Morrowind.
string: 彼女は東のモロウウィンドへ向かっている

original: So, the whore thinks the Black-Briar reach ends at the border of Skyrim, eh? She'll soon discover her mistake.
string: つまり、あのふしだら女はブラック・ブライアの勢力が、スカイリムの境界で途切れると思ってるんだな？　すぐ間違いに気づくことになるぜ

original: She's in Ivarstead using the name Lynly.
string: 彼女はイヴァルステッドに、リンリーと言う名前で暮らしている

original: Ivarstead? So close to Riften? She's an even bigger fool than I thought.
string: イヴァルステッド？　リフテンのすぐ近くに？　思ったより間抜けな女だな

original: I have some information about Svidi.
string: スヴィディの情報がある

original: Good, good. Just point me in the right direction and I'll do the rest.
string: すばらしい。正確な方向を示してくれれば、あとは自分でやる

original: You have nothing to fear from me. (Persuade)
string: 怖がることはない(説得)

original: I'm sorry, I don't know what you're talking about.
string: ごめんなさい、何の話か分からないわ

original: Your real name is Svidi, isn't it?
string: あなたの本当の名前は、スヴィディだな？

original: No, I'm sorry. You must have me mistaken for someone else. I've never even heard that name before.
string: いいえ、申し訳ないけど誰かと勘違いしてるわ。そんな名前聞いた事もない

original: So you got arrested for his murder?
string: で、殺人により逮捕されたのか？

original: Exactly! And now I have to stare at these bars for eight months. Can you believe it?
string: そのとおり！　そして8ヶ月も鉄格子を見つめる羽目になったんだ。信じられるか？

original: I was about to let that wench marry into the richest family in Riften, and this is how she repays me.
string: リフテンで一番裕福な家に嫁がせてやろうとしたのに、あの小娘め、とんだ恩返しだ

original: I'd do anything to have that whore's head on a platter. All I need to know is where she is.
string: あのふしだらな女の首を取るためなら何だってする。居場所さえ分かればな

original: Why are you in jail?
string: なぜ牢獄に？

original: Look, we all have our flaws; mine is that women can't get enough of me.
string: いいか、誰にでも欠点はある。俺の場合は、女にもてすぎることだ

original: So I had this little affair going on while I was betrothed to a beautiful girl named Svidi.
string: スヴィディという美しい娘と婚約中に、ちょっとだけ浮気していた

original: Well, she finds out and she tells her brother, Wulfur. Then her brother attacks me with a knife... I mean, I had to defend myself!
string: 彼女はそれに気づいて、兄弟のウルファーに伝えた。そして奴はナイフで俺を襲ってきた…　だから自分の身を守らねばならなかった！

original: I've killed Nimhe.
string: ニムヒを倒した

original: You have my gratitude. That spider had been interfering with my excavations for months.
string: 感謝する。あの毒蜘蛛は何ヶ月もの間発掘の邪魔をしていた

original: As promised, here's the key to the Dwemer Museum. Mind the displays. Some of them are quite fragile.
string: 約束どおり、お礼としてドゥーマー博物館の鍵をやろう。壊れやすいから、展示物にはくれぐれも触れないように…

original: Not interested.
string: 興味はない

original: Oh, very well. Probably safest that way.
string: まあ、よい。それが一番だ

original: That spider is as good as dead.
string: その蜘蛛はもう死んだようなものだ

original: Enthusiasm. Good. Here's the key to the dig site.
string: 熱心だな、いいだろう。これが発掘現場へ行ける鍵だ

original: (Invisible Continue)
string: (見えないまま)

original: I'll let you in if you agree to something for me. There's a giant spider in Nchuand-Zel. My workers call her "Nimhe," the poisoned one.
string: お前がひとつ約束するというのならここに入れてやろう。ヌチュアンド・ゼルというところに作業員達が“ニムヒ”と呼ぶ大きな毒蜘蛛がいる

original: If you deal with Nimhe, I'll let you into both the excavation site and my Dwemer Museum. What do you say?
string: もしニムヒを始末してくれるのなら、発掘現場とドゥーマー博物館に入れてやろう。どうだ？

original: I'd like to see the excavation site.
string: 発掘現場を見たい

original: Correct. It's a private place where I can catalog my research. Occasionally, the Jarl will come in and have questions, but that's thankfully rare.
string: その通り。調査したものをまとめるのに使っている。時々首長が質問をしにくることもあるが、幸いなことにそんなことは稀だ

original: A guard said you own the Dwemer Museum.
string: 衛兵はドゥーマー博物館を所有していると言っていた

original: Persistent aren't you? Oh, very well. Who am I to stand in the way of curiosity?
string: あきらめないのだな。まあ、よいだろう。誰が好奇心を止められるというのだ

original: Dwemer Museum?
string: ドゥーマー博物館？

original: It means "Dwarven Museum." Lost race of people that built the city.
string: “ドワーフの博物館”と言う意味だ。都市を造った、失われた種族だ

original: You want to know more? Ask Calcelmo. He's usually in front of the ruins, just down the tunnel.
string: もっと知りたいか？　カルセルモに聞け。彼は遺跡の前にいる。トンネルの先だ

original: Who's the court wizard?
string: 王宮魔術師は誰だ？

original: Calcelmo. He's the Jarl's magical advisor, but he spends most of his time studying the ruins.

original: He's here and he hasn't seen us yet. Brynjolf, watch the door.
string: いたわ、まだこちらには気づいてない。ブリニョルフ、扉を見張って

original: The <Alias=Beast> is dead.
string: <Alias=Beast> は死んだ

original: Good work. A simple job, but it keeps the coin rolling in. Here's your share.
string: 上出来よ。単純な仕事だけど、安定した収入になるわ。さあ、あなたの分よ

original: I'm sure that the owner of that place is relieved. They certainly came through with the coin.
string: 持ち主もほっとしてるはずね。お返しにゴールドをくれるに違いないわ

original: Well done. Here's your gold.
string: 見事だわ。これがあなたのゴールドよ

original: How do I fit in?
string: 何をすればいい？

original: You're going to happen by and lend poor old Sabjorn a helping hand.
string: お前は偶然にも、気の毒なサビョルンに手を貸す事になる

original: He's going to give you the poison to use on the pests, but you're also going to dump it into the brewing vat.
string: 奴から害虫用の毒を渡され、お前はそれを醸造用の大樽に捨てるんだ

original: Go. Out. Before I change my mind.
string: 気が変わらないうちに、とっとと消えて

original: I can't help you right now.
string: まだ助けることはできない

original: What? Why? But... you must have said something to Erikur! You lied to him and now here I am! You're a heartless monster!
string: どうして？　まさか…　エリクールに何を言ったの？　エリクールに嘘をついて、私をこんな目にあわせたのね！　人でなし！

original: No... please, you have to help me! You don't understand what they do to people here!
string: いやよ、お願い…　助けて！　ここにいる人々がどんな扱いを受けるか、知らないんだわ！

original: Come on, you'd better get out of here. (Free her)
string: さあ、ここから出よう(彼女を自由にする)

original: Oh... thank you. I don't understand what's happening. I can't stay here. What will I do now?
string: ああ…　ありがとう。何が起こったのか分からない。ここにはいられないわ。どうしたらいいの？

original: What did you tell him? Why did you do this to me?
string: 彼に何を言ったの？　なぜ私にこんなことを？

original: You've got to help me! Please!
string: 助けて！　お願い！

original: I don't know where I'll go. Somewhere far away from here.
string: どこへ行くのか、自分でも分からない。ここから遠く離れたどこかへ…

original: Maybe this is a way out?
string: ここから脱出できるかも？

original: Maybe one of the guards had a key?
string: 衛兵が鍵を持っているかも？

original: There's got to be some way out of here!
string: 逃げ道が必ずあるはず！

original: What did you tell him? Why did you do this to me?
string: 彼に何を言ったの？　なぜ私にこんなことを？

original: You must be new. We don't talk to each other here.
string: 見ない顔だな。ここではまだ話したことがないだろう？

original: You here to see Rulindil, too, eh? None of my business of course.
string: あんたもルリンディルに会いに来たんだろ？　もちろん、俺にはどうでもいい事だが

original: Push off, will you?
string: あっちへ行ってくれないか

original: I'm looking for a Khajiit... might be a Thalmor spy.
string: カジートを探している… サルモールの密偵かも知れない

original: Ah. You must mean that one over there. He's not one of us.
string: ああ。あそこにいる奴の事だな。あいつは仲間なんかじゃない

original: Thalmor filth, eh? Giving all Khajiit a bad name.
string: サルモールの屑の？　カジートの面汚しめ

original: I'd rather not take that job.
string: その仕事は受けたくない

original: I'll take care of it.
string: 任せてくれ

original: It seems that predators have taken up residence and have been attacking farmers and travelers.
string: 肉食獣が居座って、農民や旅行者を攻撃してるらしいわ

original: Someone's got to head out there and take care of the beasts.
string: 誰かが行って、野獣どもを何とかしなくちゃ

original: I'm looking for work.
string: 仕事を探してるんだ

original: The Jarl of the Reach has asked for our help.
string: リーチの首長が助けを求めてるわ

original: The Jarl of Haafingar has asked for our help.
string: ハーフィンガルの首長が助けを求めてるわ

original: The Jarl of Hjaalmarch has asked for our help.
string: ハイヤルマーチの首長が助けを求めてるわ

original: The Jarl of Falkreath has asked for our help.
string: ファルクリースの首長が助けを求めてるわ

original: The Jarl of Whiterun has asked for our help.
string: ホワイトランの首長が助けを求めてるわ

original: The Jarl of the Pale has asked for our help.
string: ペイルの首長が助けを求めてるわ

original: The Jarl of the Rift has asked for our help.
string: リフトの首長が助けを求めてるわ

original: The Jarl of Eastmarch has asked for our help.
string: イーストマーチの首長が助けを求めてるわ

original: The Jarl of Winterhold has asked for our help.
string: ウィンターホールドの首長が助けを求めてるわ

original: One of the Jarls has asked for our help.
string: 首長のひとりが助けを求めてるわ

original: Must have taken a fortune to get started.
string: 開業するにはずいぶんと金がかかっただろう

original: Well... yes. I mean, all of the gold didn't come from me. I have a silent partner that helped with the finances.
string: ああ…　まあな。金を全部出資したわけじゃない。匿名の出資者の援助を受けた

original: You mentioned someone named Mallus?
string: マラスというのは誰だ？

original: Mallus is the best deal I've ever made. Lent him a bit of gold some time ago I knew he'd never be able to pay back.
string: マラスは過去一番の儲けもんだ。いつだったか金を少しだけ貸したんだが、絶対に返せないと分かっていた

original: Nothing like free labor to make operating costs cheaper.
string: 運営費を安く上げようと思ったら、ただ働きさせるのが一番だ

original: Is something wrong?
string: 何かあったのか？

original: Are you kidding me? Look at this place.
string: 何だって？　この場所の有り様を見てみろ

original: I'm supposed to be holding a tasting of the new Honningbrew Reserve for the Captain of the Guard.
string: 衛兵長のために、ホニングブリュー・リザーブの新酒の試飲会を開く予定なんだ

original: If he sees the meadery in this state, I'll be ruined.
string: ハチミツ酒醸造所のこの有り様を見られたら、もうお終いだ

original: Why bother poisoning the nest for Sabjorn?
string: なぜサビョルンのためにわざわざ巣に毒を？

original: Once Sabjorn is out of the way, Maven has plans for this place. One way or another, we don't want the pests coming back.
string: サビョルンが片づいたら、メイビンはこの場所を獲得する計画だ。いずれにせよ、害虫が戻ってきては困る

original: Consider it just more of the dirty work. I did my part getting them in there, now you need to clear them out.
string: さらなる汚れ仕事だと思え。俺は中に送り込んで役目を果たした。今度はお前が一掃する番だ

original: Remember to put in a good word with Maven for me.
string: メイビンに俺の事をよく言っておいてくれよ

original: I love it when a plan comes together.
string: 計画どおりうまくいくのは最高だ

original: Remember, Sabjorn will be needing a helping hand. Make it look good.
string: 覚えておけ、サビョルンは助けを必要とするだろう。うまくやれ

original: Good luck. I'll be here if you need me.
string: 幸運を祈る。必要なら、いつでも来てくれ

original: Suit yourself.
string: 勝手にしろ

original: Please hurry. The Captain of the Guard isn't patient when it comes to tasting time.
string: 急いでくれ。試飲となると衛兵長はせっかちになるんだ

original: Now I've got to clean up this mess.
string: この惨状をどうにか片付けなきゃならない

original: Remember, you don't get paid until they're all dead.
string: いいか、奴らを全員始末するまで報酬は払わないぞ

original: One more time in case I wasn't clear. You butcher this job and you'll be sorry.
string: まだ分からないようですからもう一度だけ言いましょうか。お前はこの仕事をだいなしにしておきながら、謝るだけで済ませようとしているのです

original: How do I get to the brewing vats?
string: 醸造用の大だるへはどうやって行けばいい？

original: Both of the buildings are connected by tunnels made by the pests infesting the meadery.
string: 両方の建物は、ハチミツ酒醸造所にはびこる害虫が作った穴でつながってる

original: There's an entrance to it in the basement storeroom of the warehouse that used to be boarded over.
string: 倉庫の地下の物置部屋に、板張りされた入り口がある

original: I've already removed the boards so the meadery would get infested. That's where you should start.
string: ハチミツ酒醸造所に害虫をはびこらせるため、すでに板は取り外してある。そこから入れ

original: Why are you doing all this?
string: どうしてこんなことを？

original: I made the mistake of borrowing coin from Sabjorn. He's allowing me to pay it back, but he's working my fingers to the bone!
string: サビョルンから金を借りたのは失敗だった。返済させてもらってるが、身を粉にするほど働かされてる！

original: He treats me like a slave... I have to do every nasty, dirty job in the meadery.
string: まるで奴隷のような扱いさ…　ハチミツ酒醸造所のありとあらゆる不快で汚い仕事をやらされてる

original: I've cleared the beast's lair.
string: 獣の巣を一掃してきた

original: Good work. The mindless cretins didn't stand a chance.
string: 上出来よ。あの獣どもも運が悪かったわね

original: Not bad, not bad. The intensity of the hunt is special, isn't it?
string: 悪くないわね。狩りの緊張感って特別でしょ？

original: Good to hear. Have your share of the pay.
string: それを聞いて安心したわ。さあ、報酬の分け前よ
