original: Me? I'm Maul. I watch the streets for 'em. If you need dirt on anythin', I'm your guy... but it'll cost you.
string: 俺？　俺はモールだ。通りを見張ってる。何か聞きたいなら役に立つが、金は払ってもらうぞ

original: I'm not scared of you.
string: 脅しても無駄だ

original: That's the wrong answer.
string: 後悔するなよ

original: Last thing the Black-Briars need around here is some troublemaker tryin' to steal a piece of the action.
string: ブラック・ブライアが一番嫌がるのは、面倒を起こす奴が利権をかすめ取ろうとする事だ

original: What's it to you?
string: そっちはどういう関係だ？

original: Don't say something you'll regret.
string: 発言には注意することだ

original: Last thing the Black-Briars need is some loudmouth tryin' to meddle in their affairs.
string: ブラック・ブライアが一番嫌がるのは、余計な事を言う奴が自分達の仕事に干渉してくることだ

original: Just passing through.
string: ただの通りすがりだ

original: Yeah? Well, I got news for you; there's nothing to see here.
string: そうか？　おい、教えてやろう。ここには見るべきものなんて何もない

original: Last thing the Black-Briars need is some stranger stickin' their nose where it doesn't belong.
string: ブラック・ブライアが一番嫌がるのは、得体の知れない奴が関係ないのに首を突っ込んでくることだ

original: I don't know you. You in Riften lookin' for trouble?
string: あんた、一体誰だ？　リフテンで揉め事でも起こす気か？

original: Hey, you. Get over here, I want to talk to you.
string: おい。こっちに来い。お前に話がある

original: This is a shame.
string: 何とも情けない

original: Always sad when someone has to die.
string: いつの日も人が亡くなるのは悲しいものだ

original: Another one. Terrible.
string: まただわ。ひどい…

original: Large diagonal cut from left shoulder...
string: 左肩から斜めに大きな切れ目が…

original: Good!
string: よし！

original: All right, let's give this a try. Ready your ward...
string: オーケー、いっちょやってみるか。よし行くぞ…

original: I'll have to do that some other time.
string: それはまた今度にしよう

original: As you wish.
string: 好きにしろ

original: It will be my honor.
string: 光栄です

original: As you were, then.
string: では、頼むぞ！

original: I'll pass on this one, then.
string: これは断らせてくれ

original: I don't blame you.
string: 分かった

original: They live here too, my Jarl. That's what I'm telling you.
string: だから、彼らもここに住んでいるのだ…　首長

original: It doesn't matter if they're in the city. We fight them where they live, we won't have to fight them here.
string: 街の中なら問題ない。奴らの居場所で戦っているんだ。ここで戦う必要はない

original: It's not that simple, Igmund. There are reports of Forsworn here in the city.
string: そんなに簡単な話ではない、イグマンド。フォースウォーンがこの街に潜伏したとの噂がある

original: The only thing we need to discuss is how many men it'll take to flush them out of the hills.
string: 話し合うべき事はひとつだけ、奴らを丘から追い出すのに必要な兵の数だ

original: My Jarl, we need to discuss the Forsworn.
string: 首長、フォースウォーンについて話し合いが必要だ

original: I'd like to purchase a home in your city.
string: この街に家を買いたい

original: I don't know you, and I don't sell what precious property we have to outsiders.
string: お前はよそ者だ。大事な土地をよそ者に売るつもりはない

original: But if you're willing to work, and you prove to be reliable, I might deem you worthy to live here. My steward will handle things from there.
string: だが、仕事をして、信頼できると分かったら、ここに住む事を認めるかも知れない。後は執政に話をしろ

original: Nothing to say. Fine, but I'm watching you.
string: 答えない気ね。いいわ、目を離さないから

original: I was looking to purchase a house in Markarth.
string: マルカルスで家を探していた

original: I'm looking for work.
string: 仕事を探してるんだ

original: I'm a traveler. I have questions.
string: 旅人だ。質問がある

original: Very well, you may approach the Mournful Throne, but watch your words.
string: いいでしょう、嘆きの玉座への接近を許可するわ。ただし、言葉には気をつけなさい

original: You. Who are you to approach the Jarl of Markarth?
string: あなた。マルカルスの首長に何かご用？

original: So you're from Daggerfall, then?
string: では、ダガーフォールの出身なのか？

original: Yes. The finest court in all of High Rock. You think politics here are something? Well, we Bretons invented politics.
string: そうだ。ハイロック随一の宮廷だ。ここの政治が　すごいって？　政治を作り出したのは我らブレトンさ

original: That is where I learned to cook, and where I belong. Not here, with all these dogs.
string: 料理もそこで学び、心も常にそこにある。イヌどもばかりのここじゃない

original: Please, leave me alone. I need to be by myself.
string: 放っといてくれ。1人になりたいんだ

original: I... I have some thinking to do. Thank you for this.
string: 少し…　考えたい事があるんだ。ありがとう

original: By the Eight. She's dead, isn't she? And it's all my fault.
string: そんな！　彼女は死んだ、そうだろ？　すべて俺のせいだ

original: Did she really run off and do this? For me?
string: 彼女は本当に逃げて、そんな事を？　俺のために？

original: This... This is really from her, isn't it?
string: これは…　本当に彼女のものか？

original: It's a letter from Isabelle. You should read it.
string: イサベルからの手紙だ。読んでみろ

original: A what?
string: 何だと？

original: Don't you go pulling my leg. Give it here.
string: からかってるんじゃないだろうな。読ませてくれ

original: I have something for you.
string: 渡したい物がある

original: Unless it's gold for another round of drinks, I don't wanna hear it.
string: もう1杯飲める金じゃねえなら、興味ねえな

original: I spoke with Vex about Isabelle.
string: イサベラについてベックスと話をした

original: Huh?
string: んん？

original: Ha. Sure you did. Dagur put you up to this?
string: そうか。これはダグールの差し金か？

original: It don't matter now. None of it does. Just leave me be.
string: まあ、どうでもいい。関係ないことだ。放っといてくれ

original: I understand you knew Isabelle Rolaine.
string: イサベル・ロレインと知り合いだったようだな

original: What?
string: 何？

original: Don't you... Don't you say that name to me.
string: その名前を…　口にするな

original: Don't you dare. Ever.
string: 絶対にだ。いいな

original: Where did you say Isabelle Rolaine was?
string: イサベル・ロレインはどこにいると？

original: Like I told you, last time I saw her she was headed for Hobs Fall Cave. No idea what happened to her.
string: 何度も言わせないで。ホブスフォール洞窟の方に行くのを見たのが最後よ。何があったかなんて知るもんか

original: So you do know her.
string: 彼女を知ってるようだな

original: She came through a while ago, wanted to know where she could get her hands on something valuable. Anything, really.
string: うちにやってきたのは最近だ。何でもいいから、金目の物がありそうなのはどこかって聞かれてさ

original: I told her it was a bad idea, that she wasn't cut out for what'd be necessary, but she wouldn't hear it.
string: 考え直しなよ、あんたこの稼業には向いてないって…　そう忠告してやったけど、聞く耳を持ちやしなかった

original: So I gave her some advice, pointed her towards Hobs Fall Cave and that was that.
string: しょうがないからホブスフォール洞窟の方を指して少々入れ知恵してやったら、それっきりだね

original: Someone named Ranmir is looking for her.
string: ランミアという者が彼女を探している

original: Not him again.
string: またあいつか

original: He came nosing around Riften a while back, making a lot of noise about me. He was... persuaded to leave before he found me.
string: しばらく前にあたしの事をがちゃがちゃ言いながらリフテン界隈を嗅ぎ回ってた奴だ。確か…　あたしに会う前に消えるよう説得されたはずなんだが

original: Funny, I'd have thought she would've gone back to him by now.
string: 滑稽だね、てっきりあの娘と元のさやに収まったもんだとばかり思ってたよ

original: I'm just trying to find her.
string: 彼女を探してるだけだ

original: Well, ain't gonna find her here. Haven't seen her in a while.
string: そうかい、んじゃここにはいない。しばらくツラも見てないよ

original: Do you know Isabelle Rolaine?
string: イサベル・ロレインを知ってるか？

original: Who's asking?
string: そういうあんたは何者だ？

original: Do you know where I could find Isabelle Rolaine?
string: イサベル・ロレインがどこにいるか知らないか？

original: I don't, I'm afraid. Ranmir didn't talk much about her after she'd left.
string: あいにく見当もつかない。失踪以来、ランミルは彼女のことをあまり話さないんだ

original: He seemed convinced that she'd run off with someone named Vex. That's all I remember.
string: 彼女がヴェックスとか言う奴と駆け落ちしたって思い込んでるみたいだ。それぐらいしか手がかりはないな

original: What can be done about it now?
string: さて、何をすればいい？

original: I'm not sure. I hoped that maybe if she could be found, if he had some sort of explanation, that maybe he could put himself back together.
string: はっきりとは言えないが、もし彼女の居所が分かって、この件になんらかの説明がつけば、彼も立ち直れるんじゃないかと思うんだ

original: I'm in no position to go searching for her, but perhaps you could.
string: 自分で探しに行くわけにもいかなくてね。引き受けてもらえるか？

original: So what happened to him?
string: 彼に何があったんだ？

original: See, Ranmir was involved with a pretty young woman named Isabelle Rolaine. The two of them were very happy together, I thought.
string: ランミルはイサベル・ロレインという若く美しい女性と恋仲だったんだ。2人はとても幸せそうに見えたよ

original: One day, she just disappeared. Ranmir was convinced she'd run off with someone else, leaving him behind.
string: ところがある日、彼女はいなくなってしまった。ランミルは彼女が自分を捨て、誰かと駆け落ちしたと思い込んだんだ

original: He turned to drinking, and what's left of him is what you see here every day.
string: やがて酒に溺れるようになり、今じゃ毎日あの体たらくさ

original: What's this got to do with me?
string: それが自分と何の関係がある？

original: Well, I'm getting to that. Just let me explain.
string: まあそう焦らないで。とにかく説明させてくれ

original: What did he used to be like?
string: 昔はどんな人物だったと？

original: Oh, he was a different person. Happy, outgoing... Like anyone who's in love.
string: そりゃあ、まるで別人だよ。幸せそうで、人付き合いがよくて…　恋に落ちてる者は皆そうだろう？

original: Sorry, not interested.
string: 悪いが、興味ない

original: Ah. Well, some other time, perhaps.
string: そうか。じゃあまた今度な

original: Don't get me wrong, I don't have a problem with him being here all the time. He mostly keeps to himself, and so far he's been able to pay.
string: 誤解しないでほしい。彼が四六時中ここにいるのは別に構わないんだ。たいていふさぎ込んでるだけだし、今のところ払いもきちんとしてるしね

original: I just hate to see what's happened to him. He hasn't always been like this, you know. Drunk, I mean.
string: あんな様子を見てるのが辛いんだ。前はあんなじゃなかったからね。つまり、酒に溺れてはいなかったってことさ

original: What can I do for you?
string: 何を手伝えばいい？

original: It's about Ranmir.
string: ランミルのことなんだ

original: Oh, I'm so glad you changed your mind.
string: ありがたい。考え直してくれたんだな

original: It's about Ranmir.
string: ランミルのことなんだ

original: You said something needing help?
string: 手を貸してほしいと言っていたな？

original: Anything around here that needs doing?
string: ここらで何か手を貸してほしい事は？

original: Well, not exactly.
string: いや、間に合ってるよ

original: Listen, we're friends, right?
string: なあ、我々は友達だろう？

original: I wondered if I could ask a favor of you.
string: ひとつ頼まれてくれないかと思ってね

original: Did you reconsider? Will you talk to my father?
string: 気が変わりましたか？　父に話してもらえます？

original: You should probably stick to farming.
string: おそらく農業を続けた方がいいだろう

original: Well, if you change your mind, I'd still like your help.
string: あの、もしあなたの気が変わったら、僕は大歓迎ですから

original: You decided to become a mercenary?
string: 傭兵になると決めたのか？

original: Seemed like the best way to see the world and make some coin.
string: この目で世界を見て金を稼ぐには一番いいと思ったんだ

original: Sure I'm a little green, but what I lack in experience, I make up for in courage.
string: 未熟なのは分かってるけど、経験が足りない部分は勇気で埋め合わせするさ

original: I haven't spoken to him yet.
string: まだ話していない

original: Can't blame you for having better things to do than help some farmer you don't know.
string: あなたを責めたりはしませんよ。よく知らない農民を助けるよりも大事な用があるくらいで

original: Your father changed his mind.
string: 君の父上は考え直してくれたよ

original: I can't thank you enough, friend. I'll hope you'll come back to Rorikstead soon and pay me a visit.
string: 感謝してもしきれません、友よ。近いうちにまたロリクステッドに来て、僕を訪ねて下さいね

original: Maybe we can swap stories about our adventures over a mug of ale at the inn!
string: 宿屋でエールを飲みながら、互いの冒険の話でもしましょう

original: Remind me - what am I supposed to do?
string: 確認だが、何をすることになっている？

original: Where am I headed again?
string: どこへ行けばいいんだったか？

original: Remind me - what am I supposed to do?
string: 確認だが、何をすることになっている？

original: Where am I headed again?
string: どこへ行けばいいんだったか？

original: Remind me - what am I supposed to do?
string: 確認だが、何をすることになっている？

original: I did, and I will. It's just tougher than I thought.
string: そうしたし、これからもそうするわ。ただ思ったより大変ね

original: You assured me that you could find it, however.
string: だが見つけられると断言したじゃないか

original: Not yet. You know you're asking for some pretty strange stuff, don't you? It's not easy to find.
string: まだよ。自分がどんなに変わった物を頼んでるか分かってる？　簡単には見つからないのよ

original: Have you gotten the items I requested from you?
string: 要求した物品は確保したのか？

original: I'm fully aware of the terms of our... arrangement.
string: 条件は百も承知だ。俺達の…　取り決めのな

original: Well, you know the drill. You don't see it here, it's gonna cost you extra for me to get it.
string: やり方は分かってるわね。ここで見なきゃ、手に入れるには余分に払う事になるのよ

original: Perhaps, perhaps. I'm not quite sure what I need.
string: 多分、多分だ。何が必要なのかよく分からない

original: You looking for anything in particular this time?
string: 今回は特に何か探しているの？

original: Yeah, well I don't see anything.
string: ああ、何も見えないわ

original: I certainly hope so, otherwise I'm wasting my time.
string: そう願っているわ。でなきゃ時間の無駄だもの

original: You got anything in here worth buying?
string: 何か買う価値のあるものはあるの？

original: Don't sass me, little girl.
string: 口答えしないの、お譲ちゃん

original: Always looking on the bright side, aren't you.
string: いつも物事の前向きに考えているのね

original: Same as ever. Trying to keep from freezing to death, trying to keep food on the table.
string: 今までと同じよ。凍え死なないように、食卓から食べ物を切らさないように生きているだけ

original: How are you today, Thaena?
string: タエナ、調子はどう？

original: So, only the poor or the sick live here?
string: ここには、金のない者や病気の者が住んでいるのか？

original: That's right. Welcome to Markarth, traveler. Thank the Divines you can choose to live somewhere else.
string: その通り。マルカルスへようこそ、旅人さん。別の場所に住める事を神々に感謝するといい

original: So where do you work?
string: どこで働いているんだ？

original: Arnleif and Sons Trading Company. I'm a porter. Just some muscle hired to move heavy packages.
string: アーンリーフ・アンド・サンズ貿易会社の運搬人をしている。重い荷物を運ぶ力仕事だ

original: But we don't get any shipments in. Forsworn attack every caravan. So all I do is sit here and drink.
string: だが、荷が入ってこない。フォースウォーンがキャラバンを手当たり次第に襲っている。酒でも飲むしかねえんだ

original: Come, Rikke. There's still much to be done.
string: さあ、リッケ。まだまだやる事が山積みだぞ

original: We couldn't have done this without you. The Empire glories in your accomplishments...
string: お前なしではこんな事を成し遂げるのは無理だったな。帝国は成功を誇りに思う

original: I pray you're right, Legate.
string: 特使、君が正しい事を祈るよ

original: In the meantime, we'll continue to root them out and put them to the sword.
string: とりあえず、奴らをひとり残らず根絶する努力を続けよう

original: There's bound to be resistance. There are many Stormcloak camps tucked away in the hills.
string: すんなりとはいかないでしょうね。丘にはストームクロークの野営地がいくつもあるの

original: They'll no doubt strike whenever and wherever they can.
string: 時と場所を選ばず、容赦なく襲いかかってくるに決まってるわ

original: But without Ulfric to inflame their passions, they'll settle down and return to their homes eventually.
string: 奴らの感情を煽るウルフリックさえいなければ、やがて気を落ち着けて故郷に戻っていくはずよ

original: I hope we haven't just created a martyr.
string: 殉教者を作り出したのでなければよいが

original: It wasn't so bad.
string: 悪くなかったわ

original: I hate giving speeches.
string: 演説は嫌いだ

original: I am proud of all of you.
string: お前達皆の事を誇りに思う

original: All hail the Emperor. All hail his Legionnaires!
string: 皇帝万歳！　帝国軍の兵士万歳！

original: In appreciation for your exemplary service, I am doubling your pay and compensation to the widows of your fallen comrades.
string: 素晴らしい働きぶりに感謝して、給与と戦死者の遺族に対する補償金を2倍にするぞ

original: We are turning the city over to Brunwulf Free-Winter, an honorable and faithful man.
string: 我々は街をブランウルフ・フリー・ウィンターに引き渡す。彼は高潔で信頼できる男だ

original: Many of you will be staying in Windhelm to aid the Jarl in restoring order and stamping out any embers of rebellion that may still smolder here.
string: 多くはウィンドヘルムにとどまり、秩序の回復とまだここでくすぶっている反乱軍残党のせん滅を目指して、首長に協力するのだ

original: His head will be sent to Cyrodiil where it will adorn a spike on the walls of the Imperial City.
string: 奴の首はシロディールに送られ、帝都の壁を飾るだろう

original: Let this day be a final warning to all who would still call themselves Stormcloaks.
string: まだ自分達をストームクロークと呼びたがる連中がいたら、今日を最後の警告にしよう

original: The rebellion is over. Ulfric Stormcloak is dead.
string: 反乱は終わりだ。ウルフリック・ストームクロークは死んだ

original: Attention! General Tullius has an announcement!
string: 気をつけ！　テュリウス将軍よりお話がある！

original: The Legion will be staying here for quite some time. I don't expect there to be any further violence.
string: 帝国軍はしばらくここにとどまる。もう暴力沙汰は起こらないだろう

original: Brunwulf. Yes, I've sent men to protect him and bring him here.
string: ブランウルフ。そう、彼を守って連れ戻すために、部下を送ったわ

original: Windhelm will need a government quickly if we are to prevent more violence.
string: これ以上の暴力を防ぐには、ウィンドヘルムに今すぐ政府が必要よ

original: Well, the men will be expecting some kind of speech.
string: 部下達は演説のようなものを期待するだろう

original: And we'll need to hand the city over to that Free-Winter fellow.
string: そして、我々はあのフリー・ウィンターとかいう奴に街を引き渡す

original: Nothing.
string: 何でもないわ

original: Just saying goodbye.
string: お別れを言ってるだけよ

original: What was that, Legate?
string: 何だね、特使？

original: Talos be with you...
string: タロスのご加護を…

original: It'll make for a better song.
string: 見事な詩歌が生まれるであろう

original: Let the Dragonborn be the one to do it.
string: それはドラゴンボーンに任せることにする

original: Right. Well?
string: 分かった。それで？

original: Sovngarde... sir.
string: ソブンガルデ…

original: Well Ulfric, you can't escape from me this time.
string: ウルフリック、今回は逃がさんぞ

original: Any last requests before I send you to... to wherever you people go when you die.
string: 最後に何か要求はあるか？　それを聞いたらお前を…　お前のような連中が死んだら行く場所に送ってやるよ

original: Well? What are we waiting for?
string: どうした？　何をためらっている？

original: Enough!
string: もういいだろう！

original: You are traitors and will die traitors' deaths. Stand down and face public execution, or advance and face summary execution by my hands.
string: 貴様らは裏切り者だ。そして裏切り者にふさわしい死に方をするのだ。降伏して公開処刑を受けろ。進軍するなら私の手による簡易処刑を覚悟しろよ

original: It matters little to me. Either way I'll be sending your heads back to Cyrodiil.
string: 私はどっちでもいいぞ。どちらにしろ貴様らの首はシロディールに送り返す事になるからな

original: No... But I belong to her.
string: いや…　だが、我が心は彼女の元にある

original: Skyrim doesn't belong to you, Ulfric.
string: スカイリムは渡さないわ、ウルフリック

original: I'll never surrender Skyrim into the hands of a corrupt and dying Empire.
string: 堕落し、死に瀕した帝国などに、スカイリムを決して明け渡したりはせぬ

original: Step aside Galmar. We're here to accept Ulfric's surrender.
string: 下がって、ガルマル。私達はウルフリックの降伏を受け入れるために来たのよ

original: Not while I'm still breathing, it's not.
string: 私が生きている限り、それはない

original: Ulfric Stormcloak!
string: ウルフリック・ストームクローク！

original: You are guilty of insurrection, murder of Imperial citizens, the assassination of King Torygg, and high treason against the Empire.
string: 反乱、帝国市民の殺害、トリグ王の暗殺、帝国に対する大逆。これが貴様にかけられた罪状だ

original: It's over.
string: 観念しろ

original: Already done, sir.
string: 済んでいます

original: Secure the door.
string: 扉を確保しろ

original: I've purchased Honeyside.
string: ハニーサイドを買った

original: Then allow me to officially welcome you to Riften. You'll make a fine addition to our city.
string: それでは、あなたを正式にリフテンに迎えます。これであなたも街の住民よ

original: All that remains now is to bestow the title upon you.
string: あとは、地位を授けるだけだわ

original: Hmm? What's this about?
string: ん？　何の話？

original: Oh, yes. Of course... the whole thane thing. I'd forgotten. If you're ready then, can we get this out of the way?
string: ああ、そうそう。従士の件だったわね。忘れてたわ。準備ができているのなら、早くやってしまいましょう

original: I would be honored to accept.
string: 喜んで引き受けよう

original: You've already taken all the necessary steps in becoming eligible for the title.
string: 名誉ある地位に就くための手順は、すでに済んだと思っていいわ

original: Therefore all that remains is to bestow it upon you.
string: つまり、あとは地位を授けるだけよ

original: You damn well better.
string: 賢明な判断ですね

original: I've checked with my court and apparently you're fully eligible... there's nothing standing in the way of presenting you the title.
string: 侍臣達にも諮ってみたのですが、お前は候補者として十分に適格だという意見でした…　これで推薦にあたって何ら障害はなくなったわけです

original: Before I can present you with the title, there's but a single requirement you must fulfill.
string: あなたに肩書を与える前に、条件を1つだけ満たしてもらいたいの

original: A Thane of Riften is expected to maintain permanent residence within the city walls.
string: リフテンの従士は、街の壁の内側に永住する事になってるの

original: My steward has such a home available to you for purchase. I think you'll find the accommodations to be most pleasing.
string: そういう場所に建っている家を、あなたが買えるように執政が用意しているわ。住み心地なら、ことのほか満足してもらえるはずよ

original: When the house is yours, return to me and I will present you the title.
string: 家を手に入れたら戻ってきて。地位はその時に授けるわ

original: Not so fast, there's a matter of residence to be discussed.
string: そう慌ててはなりませんよ、まだ住居の問題が残っているのですから

original: In order to have the title bestowed upon you, you need to purchase a house within Riften.
string: 件の称号を受ける者は、リフテンに家を構えなければならない決まりなのです

original: And by the Eight, aren't you fortunate that my steward has just the place for you to buy.
string: 8時までは幸い、うちの執政が手頃な値段の物件をとりおいてくれています

original: After the place is yours, come back to me and we'll deal with the rest of the nonsense.
string: 家を手に入れたら戻ってくるのです、残りの段取りを片づけてしまいますから

original: What are you doing here? You're supposed to be meeting Malborn in Solitude.
string: ここで何をしてるの？　ソリチュードでマルボーンと会う約束でしょう

original: Not here. I told you to meet me in Riverwood.
string: ここじゃないわ。リバーウッドで会うと言ったでしょう

original: As soon as you distract the guards, I'll open the door.
string: 衛兵の気を逸らせてくれ。そしたらすぐに扉を開ける

original: What can I get for you, sir?
string: 何をお持ちしましょうか？

original: What can I get for you, ma'am?
string: 何をお持ちしましょうか？

original: Yes? What do you need?
string: はい？　何をご所望で？

original: Thank you.
string: ありがとう

original: I should be the one thanking you. You've solved more problems in the short time you've been here then anyone in my court has their entire careers.
string: お礼を言うのはこっちの方よ。ここに来てからの短い間に、部下が生涯をかけてもできないくらい多くの問題を解決してくれたわ

original: You've been a beacon of hope in these dark times for my people and I will never forget it.
string: この苦しい時に人々の希望の灯となってくれた事は、決して忘れないわ

original: Therefore, by my authority as Jarl, I pronounce you Thane of Riften and award you all of the benefits befitting your station. Congratulations.
string: だから、首長の権限でリフテンの従士になったと公式に宣言して、その立場にふさわしい恩恵をすべて授けるわ。おめでとう

original: I expect that you'll distance yourself from the affairs of state. In other words, keep your nose out of my business and we'll do just fine.
string: ただし政務とは距離を置いてもらいます。つまり私の仕事に首を突っ込みさえしなければ、お互いにうまくやっていける、という事です

original: Just remember that you're only a part of my court, this doesn't make you one of the family.
string: 私の廷臣になっただけで、一族に加われるわけではない点をくれぐれも忘れないように

original: I guess all that's left is to bestow the title. What were those words again?
string: さて残るは就任式だけ…　と、まただ、つい忘れてしまいますね…

original: Doesn't matter... the title is yours. I henceforth name you Thane of Riften. Don't disappoint me.
string: いえ何でありません…　称号はお前のものです。今これより、お前を“リフテンの従士”に任命します。期待に背かぬよう精励するのですよ

original: I've purchased Honeyside.
string: ハニーサイドを買った

original: Regarding what, my lady?
string: 何に関してですか、閣下？

original: Much like Mjoll, you've become champion of our hold; helping people with their difficulties and providing assistance for their needs.
string: 困ってる人々を助けて、求めがあれば手を貸して…　あなたはもう要塞の英雄よ。まるでムジョルのようだわ

original: As the Jarl of Riften, I feel it's my duty to honor your selfless behavior by honoring you with the title Thane of Riften.
string: リフテンの首長として、あなたの献身的な行いに対しては相応の地位によって報いるのが義務でしょうね

original: Oh don't pretend to be modest. I'm talking about your new role as champion. Apparently, you've taken my people under your wing.
string: 謙遜するふりなどよしなさい。話というのは、英雄というお前の新しい役割についてです。どうやら、私の民を庇護下に置いているようですね

original: If you think you can steal my throne by winning the hearts of the people, that's where you're wrong. Keep that in mind.
string: 民衆の心をつかめば、私に取って代われると思っているのなら、それは間違いです。よく覚えておくのですよ

original: However, since it wouldn't behoove me to make you disappear, I'd rather have you on my side as Thane of Riften.
string: とはいえ、お前を消してしまうよりは、リフテンの従士として傍に仕えてもらいたいと考えています

original: Is there anything I can help Riften with?
string: リフテンのために何か手伝えることはあるか？

original: Ah, there you are. I was wondering when you'd visit us again.
string: ああ、来たのね。いつ戻ってきてくれるかと思ってたわ

original: I've been informed by my steward that you've made quite an impression in the Rift; several of our citizens have expressed their admiration.
string: リフトで素晴らしい実績を残したそうね。何人かの市民から賞賛の声が届いていると、執政から報告があったわ

original: So, I've been hearing your name in court quite a bit lately.
string: お前の名を耳にするようになったのはかなり最近の事です

original: I've been informed by my steward that you've made quite an impression in the Rift; the people won't stop blathering about you.
string: 執政から聞きましたが、リフトではなかなかの評判になっているそうですね。皆、お前の噂はいくらでも喋りたがるようです

original: I think I've said enough. Now leave me alone.
string: もう十分話したはずよ。放っておいてちょうだい

original: Be careful, Niluva is a bit... aggressive when she's cornered.
string: 気をつけて。ニルヴァは追い詰められると…　ちょっと攻撃的になるから

original: I told you everything I know. What else did you want?
string: 知っている事はすべて話したわ。他に何を望むの？

original: You looking for something?
string: 何か探してるの？

original: I thank you for your help, my friend.
string: 助けてくれて本当にありがとう

original: The Cragslane operation has been stopped.
string: クラッグスレインで行われていた活動は阻止した

original: Well done! Your continued efforts have been of great benefit to the people of Riften.
string: よくやってくれたわ！　あなたの努力は、リフテンの人々に大きな利益を与えてくれた

original: Allow me to present you with this compensation for your selfless efforts.
string: その献身的な行いに対して、相応の対価を授けましょう

original: I'll send my men to secure any of the remaining goods you left behind. We can't have that substance falling into the wrong hands now, can we?
string: うちの者を行かせて、残してきた物はすべて回収させます。あのような物質が誤った者の手に渡ってはいけません、そうでしょう？

original: Here, this should suffice as your cut of the... or rather, a reward for your actions. Now, if you'll excuse me...
string: さあ、お前の分け前…　いえ、働きの報酬としてはこれで十分でしょう。さて、私はそろそろ失礼…

original: On second thought, maybe we'll fight later.
string: よく考えてみたが、戦うのはあとにしよう

original: Suit yourself. I'm always here.
string: 好きにしろ。いつでもここにいるからな

original: Let's fight! (Brawl)
string: 戦ってやる！(殴り合い)

original: Here we go!
string: 行くぞ！

original: How about a rematch?
string: もう一戦しないか？

original: Sure, I don't mind taking some more of your gold.
string: もちろんいいぞ、もっと金を巻き上げてやる

original: Just let me know when you're ready.
string: 準備ができたら言ってくれ

original: I'll fight you again, but not until you have the gold to back up your bet.
string: 再戦は受けるが、賭け金を貯めてからだな

original: How about another time?
string: またにしないか？

original: I don't blame you. If I were in your shoes, I'd chicken out too.
string: まあ、仕方がない。あんたの立場だったら、俺だってビビって逃げるよ

original: Well, offer still stands if you ever want to have a go.
string: じゃあ、その気になったらいつでも来い

original: Sure, I'll match your bet! (Brawl)
string: いいだろう、賭けに乗ろう！(殴り合い)

original: All right, remember... this is a clean fight. No weapons, no tricks. And none of those fancy magic spells, either.
string: ようし、いいか…　ズルはなしだぞ。武器や卑怯な手は使わない。もちろん、魔法もだ

original: Here we go!
string: 行くぞ！

original: Well come back when you earn some more so I can take it from you!
string: もうちょっと金を稼いでからまた来いよ。全部もらってやるからさ！

original: I bet you're wrong.
string: それはどうかな

original: Oh! Sounds like I've got a challenger.
string: おお！　挑戦するつもりか？

original: Tell you what. How about a friendly wager, just between us. I bet you my entire purse of septims I can beat you in a fistfight.
string: よし、じゃあ友好的な賭けと行こうじゃないか。殴り合いで俺が勝つ方に全財産を賭けるぜ

original: You match the bet and we fight until one of us gives in.
string: 賭けに乗れよ、どっちかが降参するまでやろうじゃないか

original: Must be dangerous living outside the walls.
string: 壁の外に住むのはかなり危険なのでは？

original: Bah, I'm not afraid of anything out here. Walls are just a weakling's hiding spot.
string: フン、恐れる事など何もないさ。壁なんてのは弱虫の隠れる場所だよ

original: Now me, I'm no weakling. In fact, I bet I've got the strongest arms in all of Skyrim.
string: 俺は弱虫じゃない。実際、スカイリムで最も屈強なのは俺に違いないだろう

original: I'm the Thane of Riften.
string: リフテンの従士なんだが

original: Forgive me milord, I didn't recognize you! Please proceed.
string: これは失礼、気づきませんでした！　どうぞ

original: Forgive me milady, I didn't recognize you! Please proceed.
string: これは失礼、気づきませんでした！　どうぞ

original: Sorry, I'll leave.
string: すまない。出て行こう

original: Bloody tourists.
string: ふざけた観光客だな

original: Can I pass now? (<BribeCost> gold)
string: これで通れるか？(<BribeCost> ゴールド)

original: Sure, that'll do just fine. Go on ahead.
string: もちろん構わない。先へ進め

original: That's just insulting. Not even a proper bribe?
string: 侮辱だな。相場の賄賂もないのか？

original: It's fine, I'm allowed to be here. (Persuade)
string: いや、許可は得ている(説得)

original: Oh, my mistake then. Sorry, you can go on ahead.
string: そうか、それは悪かった。先へ進んでいいぞ

original: Sure, and I'm Queen Barenziah. Now tell me another one.
string: そうか、それが通るなら私はバレンジア女王だ。別の手を試してみるんだな

original: Hey, you're not supposed to be down here. Official business only.
string: おい、ここへ入ってくるな。正式な用事の場合だけだ

original: What are you doing down here?
string: ここで何をしている？

original: Ignore me all you want, you still aren't getting in.
string: 無視しても同じだ、中には入れないぞ

original: Does this finally mean peace?
string: ついに平和が訪れるのか？

original: The fiercest of the remaining rebels will continue to harass us, but by in large, the people here desire peace.
string: 反乱者の残党の中でも、強硬派は我々を困らせるだろう。だがほとんどの者達は平和を望んでいる

original: What I'm not so sure about is the peace we've made with the Thalmor. But we'll keep that between the two of us, alright?
string: 不安なのは、サルモールと結んだ平和協定の事だ。だがその件は2人の秘密にしておこう。いいな？

original: Now that Ulfric is dead, will there be peace?
string: ウルフリックは死んだ。平和が訪れるのか？

original: There are those who still call themselves Stormcloaks, who continue to fight us, and bring misery to the people... but they are few in number.
string: いまだに自らをストームクロークと呼び、戦い続け、人々に悲劇をもたらす者達がいるわ…　決して多くはないけど

original: The ordinary citizen will be happy to get back to life as normal, to have their families return home.
string: 元の生活を取り戻して、家族を故郷に帰すことができれば、普通の市民なら喜ぶでしょう

original: And they should enjoy it while they can... I suspect all of Tamriel will again be called to arms in the not too distant future.
string: 今のうちに平和を楽しんでおくべきね…　そう遠くない未来、タムリエルの人々は、再び戦いに巻き込まれるのだから

original: Now that Ulfric is dead, will there be peace?
string: ウルフリックは死んだ。平和が訪れるのか？

original: There will be peace for a time, during which we must rebuild Skyrim into the land it once was. Strong. Self-reliant. The center of mankind.
string: しばらくは平和だろう。その間にスカイリムを再建し、かつての姿を取り戻さねばならぬ。力強く、独立心に溢れる、人類の中核たる姿を

original: Because getting rid of the Empire was only half the problem.
string: 帝国の排除は問題の半分を解決したに過ぎない

original: Soon, the elves will again seek to rule the world. We must ready ourselves to fight them.
string: エルフどもはすぐにまた世界の支配を望むであろう。戦いに備えておかねばならない

original: For it will be Skyrim that shall lead Tamriel in those dark days, when the fate of the world is finally determined.
string: なぜなら、世界の命運が決する時、暗黒の時代にあるタムリエルを導くのはスカイリムであるべきだからだ

original: Now that we've defeated the Imperials, will there be peace?
string: 帝国を倒した。これで平和は来るのだろうか？

original: Peace? When has any Nord ever known peace? Skyrim breeds warriors. It's who we are, it's in our blood.
string: 平和だと？　いつ、いかなるノルドが平和の味を知ったと言うのか。スカイリムは戦士の産土。それこそは我らの本質であり、血統なのだ

original: And that's as it should be. In the darkest days ahead, it'll be us Nords who lead the fight against the elves.
string: また、そうであるべきだ。来る暗黒の日々において、エルフとの戦いを率いるは、我らノルドに他ならないのだから

original: It's only a matter of time before their pointy ears start itching to rule the world again.
string: 奴らの尖った耳が世界の支配を求めてうずきはじめるのも時間の問題だ

original: It'll be Skyrim that leads the charge. Mark my words. And that time around, mankind will either succeed once and for all or die trying.
string: 心して聞け。変革の先頭に立つのはスカイリムである。その時、人類は是が非でも決定的な勝利を掴まねばならない

original: Now that we've defeated the Imperials, will there be peace?
string: 帝国を倒した。これで平和は来るのだろうか？

original: What's next for you?
string: これからどうするんだ？

original: No, I suspect Skyrim to be my home for many years.
string: いや。スカイリムには長く落ち着くことになりそうだ

original: Can't say I'll ever get used to the damn cold, or understand these Nords... but, I've come to respect them.
string: 寒さに慣れる事はなさそうだし、ノルド達の事も理解できそうにないが…　それなりの敬意は表しているよ

original: The harshness of Skyrim has a way of carving a man down to his true self.
string: スカイリムの厳しい環境は、自分を磨いて真価を発揮させてくれる

original: Will you return to Cyrodiil now?
string: シロディールに戻るのか？

original: The General's put me in charge of assisting the new governments.
string: 将軍から、新政府に力を貸すように命じられたの

original: I may understand things here in Skyrim better than the General, but I'm a soldier at heart, not a politician. But I'll do my best.
string: スカイリムについては将軍よりよく知ってるけど、私は根っからの軍人で、政治家じゃない。でもとにかくやってみるわ

original: This is the land of my birth, the land that shaped me. I'm proud to have any part in making it strong again.
string: ここは自分が生まれ育った土地よ。国を立て直す手助けができることを誇りに思うわ

original: What's next for the accomplished Legate Rikke?
string: リッケ特使、これからどうするんだ？

original: No, not yet. We'll wait for the Moot to name me High King. It'll be better for all that way.
string: いや、まだだ。ムートが私を上級王に叙するまで待とう。その方が何かと都合がよい

original: But, that doesn't mean I won't start acting like it. There's much to do. The new Jarls need help building armies, and enforcing their right to rule.
string: だからと言って王の仕事をしないわけではないぞ。すべきことは山積みだ。新たな首長が兵を育て、支配権を強化するための助けを必要としている

original: The Empire may try to reclaim Skyrim, and I need everyone ready for that. Though the biggest threat, of course, is the elves.
string: 帝国はスカイリムを取り戻そうとするだろう。皆にはその時に備えてもらわねば。だが、もちろん最大の脅威はエルフだ

original: So, do I call you High King now?
string: では、もう上級王と呼んだ方がいいか？

original: Heh. Ulfric's put me in charge of keeping an eye on the new Jarls. You know, make sure they're generally following orders.
string: 新しい首長達の監視を、ウルフリックに任されたんだ。連中がちゃんと命令に従うようにな

original: Can't say I'm looking forward to that. But, I'll also be training men and women for their new armies.
string: それが楽しい仕事かどうかは分からない。だが他に、新しい軍のための人材を鍛える仕事もある

original: The Empire might send over a few Legionnaires to make sure we're serious, and of course, we'll be taking the fight to the elves soon enough.
string: 帝国はこちらの様子を探るために、軍を送り込んでくるかも知れない。もちろん、エルフ達との戦いも、すぐに始めるつもりでいる

original: We'll need trained, disciplined and creative warriors ready for all that.
string: そのためには、訓練された優秀な戦士達を育てなければならないのだ

original: What's next for the mighty Galmar Stone-Fist?
string: 石拳のガルマル。この後はどうする？

original: Is there anything further I can do...?
string: 他に何かできることは？

original: Ulfric is dead and his army destroyed. There's not much more I could ask of you. The gods, however, I suspect, may have plans for you elsewhere.
string: ウルフリックは死に奴の軍隊は壊滅した。頼む事はもうあまりない。でも、神々がどこかで計画を練っているかも知れないな

original: That said, Stormcloak true believers are still operating out of hidden military camps in the hills. If you encounter any on you travels, kill them.
string: そうは言ったが、ストームクローク達は丘陵地帯の秘密基地を根城に今でも活動中だ。旅の途中で奴らに出会ったら、殺せ

original: With luck, they'll soon lose heart and return to their homes and families. If not, we'll be forced to put them all to the sword.
string: 連中が怖気づいて故郷の家族のもとへ戻ってくれたら幸運だ。そうでなければ、全員斬り殺す羽目になるがな

original: Is there anything further I can do for the Legion?
string: 帝国軍のために、何かできることはあるか？

original: The Legion's work is far from finished, but you are free to roam. I suspect you'll be of greater good to Skyrim out there, in the world.
string: 帝国軍の仕事はまだまだ終わってないけど、歩き回るのは自由よ。あなたは、スカイリムにとって大きな存在になる気がするの

original: If while you're out there, you stumble into any Stormcloak military camps, I expect you to destroy them. I've reports they are hiding in the hills.
string: 外にいる間に、もしストームクローク軍の野営地を見つけたら壊滅させてほしいの。丘のどこかに潜伏してるって報告があるわ

original: Is there anything further I can do for the Legion?
string: 帝国軍のために、何かできることはあるか？

original: True sons and daughters of Skyrim reign in every city, we've crippled the Imperial Legion, and cut off its head by killing General Tullius himself.
string: 真なるスカイリムの民がすべての街を統治している。我らは帝国軍の手足を削いだばかりか、テュリウス将軍をも倒し、その首は地に落ちた

original: What more could I ask of you? No, you're free to roam. I suspect the gods have needs for you elsewhere.
string: この上何を頼めよう？　さあ、自由に旅を続けるがいい。またどこか別の地で神々が貴公を必要とされるであろう

original: That said, some of the Legion's staunchest men have organized themselves, and are operating out of hidden military camps in the wilderness.
string: とはいえ、帝国の中でも忠義に厚い者は部隊を編成し、荒地で密かに野営地を設けているようだ

original: If you come across any Imperials in your travels, I expect you'll know what to do.
string: 旅の途中で帝国の人間に出会ったときは…　すべきことは分かっておろう？

original: Is there anything further I can do for the cause?
string: 大義のために、これ以上できることはあるか？

original: No. I trust you'll do more good out there in the world, wherever you damn well please to go. You're a true son of Skyrim. You'll know what to do.
string: もはやない。お前ならきっと、行く先々の人達の助けになってやれるはずだ。真なるスカイリムの息子として、やるべき事をやればよかろう

original: To begin with, killing any Legionnaire you find out in the wilderness. I've reports they've hidden military camps out there.
string: まずは、荒野に隠れている帝国軍を皆殺しにするんだ。奴らの野営地が隠されているという報告があった

original: Is there anything further I can do for the cause?
string: 大義のために、これ以上できることはあるか？

original: No. I trust you'll do more good out there in the world, wherever you damn well please to go. You're a true daughter of Skyrim and'll know what to do.
string: もはやない。お前ならきっと、行く先々の人達の助けになってやれるはずだ。真なるスカイリムの娘として、やるべき事をやればよかろう

original: To begin with, killing any Legionnaire you find out in the wilderness. I've reports they've hidden military camps out there out there.
string: まずは、荒野に隠れている帝国軍を皆殺しにするんだ。奴らの野営地が隠されているという報告があった

original: Is there anything further I can do for the cause?
string: 大義のために、これ以上できることはあるか？

original: I'm ready. I made my peace with the gods long ago.
string: 準備はいいぞ。神様とはずっと前に平和協定を結んでいる

original: What are you waiting for? Do it!
string: 何をぐずぐずしてるんだ？　やれ！

original: With me, you kill Skyrim's last hope. Mark my words. You'll all be serving elven masters soon. And know then, that I would have stopped them.
string: 心して聞け。私が死ねばスカイリムの希望も死ぬ。すぐに貴様ら全員がエルフの主人に仕える事になるぞ。その時は思い知るがいい…　私だけが奴らを止められた、と

original: By the gods, stop toying with me and do it!
string: ええい、弄ぶつもりか。すべきことをなせ！

original: Oh my. That...
string: あらまあ。それは…

original: You... you go first.
string: 先に…　先に行きなさいよ

original: I'm looking for work.
string: 仕事を探してるんだ

original: What've you been staring at your feet this whole time? You see that big city up ahead of you? Markarth?
string: いつまで自分の足を眺めているつもりだ？　向こうに大きな都市があるのが見えないか？　マルカルスだぞ

original: Head over there, unless you feel like helping my wife pick crops. And then 50 years later you'll wake up and still be here.
string: マルカルスに行け、家内の刈り入れを手伝いたいというなら話は別だ。だが50年後に目覚めた時、お前はまだここにいる事になるぞ

original: Have you lived here long?
string: ここには長く住んでいるのか？

original: What kind of question is that? Look at me! Is this a young man's face?
string: くだらない事を聞くな。見てみろ！　これが若者の顔に見えるか？

original: I've been here 50 years, and nothing is going to move me off my land.
string: もう50年もここに住んでいる。何があってもここから出て行く気はない

original: As part of your initiation, Master Einarth will allow you to tap into his understanding of "Ro."
string: 入門の儀式の一環として、アイナース師が彼の持つ“ロー”の知識を授ける

original: Well, that is how the rest of us learn Shouts. As Dragonborn, you can absorb a slain dragon's life force and knowledge directly.
string: まあ、それは我らがシャウトを学ぶ方法だ。ドラゴンボーンならば、倒したドラゴンから直接その生命力と知識を吸収できるだろう

original: But learning a Word of Power is only the first step... you must unlock its meaning through constant practice in order to use it in a Shout.
string: だが力の言葉について学ぶ事はまだ最初の一歩に過ぎない。それをシャウトとして使うには、まず絶え間ない鍛錬を通してその意味を探らねばならん

original: All Shouts are made up of three Words of Power. As you master each Word, your Shout will become progressively stronger.
string: すべてのシャウトは3つの力の言葉で形作られている。言葉を一つずつ習得していけば、お前のシャウトも順に強くなっていく

original: Ro means "Balance" in the dragon tongue. Combine it with Fus - "Force" - to focus your Thu'um more sharply.
string: ローとは竜の言葉で“均衡”を意味する。これをファス――“力”――と合わせる事で、より鋭くスゥームを研ぎ澄ませる

original: What's all this about the Forsworn?
string: フォースウォーンとはどういうことだ？

original: Seems Kolskeggr Mine got hit by Forsworn. Those madmen get more bold every season.
string: コルスケッガー鉱山がどうやらフォースウォーンに襲われたようだ。あのイカれた奴らはだんだん図太くなりやがる

original: Pavo and Gat are the only survivors. I'll be sending word to the Jarl about this, but I don't know when help will come.
string: 生き残ったのはパボとガットだけだ。この件について首長に伝言するつもりだが、いつ助けが来るかは分からない

original: Was. Forsworn came in the night. Killed everyone. Gat and I are the only ones who escaped.

string: そこで詳しく話す

original: You wanted to see me?
string: 探していたのか？

original: Yes, I have something special for you.
string: ああ、お前にピッタリの仕事を用意した

original: But it's not for everyone to hear. Meet me in the Underforge tonight.
string: しかし、他の連中には聞かれたくない。今夜、アンダーフォージで会おう

original: We will speak more.
string: そこで詳しく話す

original: Skjor was looking for you before. Talk to him before doing anything else.
string: スコールが探してたぞ。先に話をしてみるといい

original: Sorry, Miss Temba.
string: すみません、ミス・テンバ

original: Sigh. Everyone isn't as short as you are... what good are these boards to someone of the proper height!?
string: はあ。みんながあなたほど背が低いわけじゃないのよ…　普通の背丈の人に、この板が何の役に立つの？

original: I'm so sorry Miss Temba. Perhaps if you would have been more specific...
string: すいません、ミス・テンバ。あなたがもう少しはっきりしていさえすれば、おそらくは…

original: Gwilin! I told you to cut those boards at twice arm length! My arm's length. Not yours.
string: グウィリン！　あの板、私の腕の二倍の長さに切れと言ったのよ。あなたの腕じゃなくて

original: When I want your opinion, I'll ask for it. Otherwise, mind your business.
string: 意見がほしい時は聞きます。それ以外の時は黙っていて下さい

original: I hardly think the bears are clever enough to hold a grudge against you, Miss Temba.
string: クマにあなたを恨むだけの知恵があったとは驚きですよ、ミス・テンバ

original: Another batch of logs completely ruined. I swear, these bears have it out for me.
string: また丸太が一山だめになりました。あのクマども、とことんまでやる気ですよ

original: "Our" business?
string: “俺達の”仕事？

original: As I remember things, it was you that showed up at my doorstep looking for a job and a place to live. Try and remember that.
string: 考えてみれば、仕事と住む場所を探して訪ねてきたのはあんただったな。思い出してみろよ

original: Look, I'm merely suggesting a few things that could expand our business.
string: いいか、単に商売を拡大できる提案を少ししたいだけだ

original: I'm becoming sick to death of your ideas. Not one of them has paid off since you moved in.
string: あんたの考える事には死ぬほどうんざりなんだ。あんたが来てから、まったくうまくいってない

original: If you have a moment, I've come up with a few ideas I wanted to share.
string: 少しいいかな？　いくつか思いついた計画を話しておきたい

original: That's none of your business and I appreciate if you wouldn't mention it again.
string: 余計なお世話だ。二度とその事は口にしないでほしい

original: Come on, everyone in town knows that you spend more time with Fastred than fishing in the river.
string: おいおい、川で釣りをしてるより、ファストレッドと過ごす時間の方が長いって皆が話してるぞ

original: Blood from a stone, Klimmek. I've been out there every morning. They just aren't biting.
string: クリメク、とても無理だ。毎朝あそこに行っているが、話に乗ってこない

original: We're behind again. I need you to catch another two bushels by week's end if I'm to make another delivery.
string: また遅れてるぞ。次の配達をするには、週末までに2ブッシェル用意してもらわないといけない

original: Yes, mother.
string: はい、母さん

original: I know your sights are set beyond this town, but for now, while you're under our roof, I need you to pitch in a little more.
string: あなたはこの町よりもずっと遠くを見ているんでしょうけど、私の家にいる間は、もう少し協力してほしいわ

original: I help, I do the chores. What else would you have me do?
string: 手伝いをして、雑用をする。他に、何をしてほしいの？

original: I need you to pitch in a little more around here, dear.
string: もう少し手伝ってくれると助かるんだけど

original: And if she decides to leave Ivarstead, what then? No, no... I can't bear the thought.
string: そしてもし彼女がイヴァルステッドを離れたら？　いや…　考えるだけでも耐えられない

original: You're hardly throwing her to the wolves. She just wants to see the world... just like I did when I was her age.
string: 彼女を見捨てられるわけがない。私もあの年齢の頃はそうだった、世界を知りたいだけなんだから…

original: She's our only child, Boti. Am I to throw her to the wolves?
string: 彼女は私達の一粒種だ、ボティ。それを狼の群れに放り出せと？

original: You have to let Fastred follow her heart. You can't tell her what to do.
string: ファストレッドの好きなようにさせてあげて。指図するのはやめて

original: I know what you said, but I only wanted to speak to him for a moment.
string: 言いたい事は分かるけれど、少し彼と話したかっただけなの

original: Wilhelm said he saw you speaking to one of the pilgrims on the 7,000 Steps. I told you that I didn't want you to go up there.
string: ウィルヘルムから聞いたが、七千階段で巡礼者のひとりと話していたそうだな。あそこには行かないように言ったはずだぞ

original: What is it now?
string: 今度は何だ？

original: Fastred, I wanted to talk with you.
string: ファストレッド、話がある

original: There's much more to worry about in life then a bit of a temper, my friend.
string: 友よ、人生にはもっと大切なことがある。まあ、落ち着け

original: Perhaps, but abuse is abuse. I don't think I could stand it.
string: そうかもしれんが、虐待は虐待だ。俺なら我慢できそうにない

original: If you'll pardon the expression, she's far more bark than bite.
string: 言っちゃなんだけど、かみつくんじゃなくて、ひどく吠えるんだ

original: I heard Temba yelling at you yesterday. Why do you let her treat you like that?
string: 昨日、テンバがお前に叫んでるのを聞いたよ。どうしてあんな扱いを受けて平気なんだ？

original: You're sweet. I'm just not ready for that sort of thing right now. I'm sorry.
string: 優しいのね。ただ、今はそういう気持ちになれないの。ごめんなさい

original: Perhaps when you're finished here this evening, we could...
string: もし今夜時間が空いたら、よければ一緒に…

original: Thank you Klimmek. That's too kind.
string: ありがとうクリメク。とっても親切なのね

original: I thought you played wonderfully last night.
string: 昨夜はうまくやったみたいだな

original: I know, but I don't want to let them down. I guess I better start thinking about it soon.
string: だが皆を失望させたくない。今すぐよく考えるべきだろう

original: Take your time then. It isn't as though the Greybeards are going to complain.
string: じゃあゆっくりするといい。グレイビアードが文句を言いだすってことでもないんだから

original: I wish I didn't have to. It's quite a difficult climb.
string: その必要がなければいいが。これは一筋縄ではいかない

original: You heading up to High Hrothgar soon, Klimmek?
string: もうすぐハイ・フロスガーに向かうんだろう、クリメク？

original: Perhaps one day, but not today.
string: たぶん、いつか。でも今日じゃない

original: Klimmek is doing just fine. You should follow your heart.
string: クリメクは申し分なくやってくれてる。お前は自分の気持ちに従うべきだ

original: No. I'll tell you, Wilhelm, if I could sweep her away from here tomorrow I'd do it, but Klimmek still has so much to learn.
string: いや。ウィルヘルム、彼女を明日にでもここから追い払えるならやるが、クリメクにはまだ学ぶべき事がたくさんある

original: Have you spoken to Fastred yet?
string: ファストレッドとはもう話したか？

original: See that you don't. I promised to keep you safe and I'm not going to break my word.
string: そうならないようにしろ。君の安全を守ると約束しただろう、俺は約束を破るようなことはしない

original: I'm sorry. I was curious... I didn't believe the stories. I won't go over there ever again.
string: ごめんなさい。好奇心でつい…　話を信じていなかったの。もうあそこへは行かないわ

original: That thing's evil, Lynly! I told you to keep away from there!
string: まったく、リンリー！　ここには近づくなと言っただろう！

original: I think I saw it again. That... ghost. It was over by the barrows.
string: あの幽霊をまた見てみたい。墓地の近くで

original: All right, Wilhlem. I suppose it's the least I can do for you.
string: ウィルヘルム、分かったわ。私があなたにできるのはこのくらいね

original: I think you play beautifully. It would be a shame if you stopped.
string: 見事な演奏だ。演奏を止めてしまったら残念だよ

original: What's the point? I'm not very good, and it's only for the same few people every night.
string: 何を言いたいの？　私はあまり上手じゃないの、それに毎晩限られた数の同じ人達だけ

original: I think you should continue with your performances.
string: ぜひとも演奏を続けるべきだと思うよ

original: Anything you can tell me about High Hrothgar?
string: ハイ・フロスガーについて何か教えてくれないか？

original: The Greybeards are a solitary lot. I don't think they've ever ventured outside their monastery.
string: グレイビアードは孤立した地区だ。これまで修道院の外に出たことはないんじゃないかな

original: We get the occasional pilgrim passing through here on their way to the summit, but almost all of them have returned disappointed.
string: 時折、山頂を目指す巡礼者がここを通りすぎることがある。ほとんどすべての人ががっかりした様子で戻ってくるよ

original: I've been to the monastery many times, but I've never even laid eyes on one of the Greybeards. Not that I'd care to.
string: あそこには何度も行ったが、グレイビアードの連中は一度も見た事がない。気にしてなかっただけかも知れないがな

original: Being masters of the Thu'um, they could kill you by uttering a single word.
string: スゥームを極めると、一言つぶやくだけで相手を殺せるらしい

original: Well, not that they would. They seem peaceful, but I wouldn't want to provoke them.
string: まあ、そんな事はしないだろうがな。連中は平和的に見える。だが、刺激はしない方がいい

original: Klimmek brings food supplies up to them once every few weeks when the weather permits it.
string: 天気が良ければ数週間に1度、クリメクが彼らに食料を届けている

original: Other than that, they seem like a quiet lot. Don't really know too much about them.
string: 他には特に変わった事はない。実はあまりよく知らないしな

original: It's frightening living below their monastery.
string: あの修道院の下での暮らしは、恐ろしいです

original: Sometimes I swear I can hear strange noises rolling down from up there. It sounds like thunder, but there's never any rain.
string: 時々、上から奇妙な音が聞こえてくるんです。雨が降ってもいないのに、雷鳴のような音が…

original: What do you make of that?
string: 一体、何だと思います？

original: The Greybeards stay away from me, and I stay away from them. Suits me just fine.
string: グレイビアードとは、お互いに避け合っています。それでいいんです

original: Always thought it was odd that there's a layer of thick clouds covering the peak of the mountain above the monastery.
string: 修道院の上にそびえる山の頂に厚い雲が立ち込めてるのは妙だなって、いつも思ってたんだ

original: Not sure what's up there, but I bet the Greybeards know.
string: あそこに何があるのかは知らない。グレイビアードなら知ってるだろう

original: They call the path to the monastery the 7,000 Steps. Can you imagine?
string: 修道院に通じる道は七千階段と呼ばれてるんだ。想像できるかい？

original: I'm not certain if I could even make it to the top without collapsing from exhaustion.
string: 疲労困憊してぶっ倒れずに、上までたどり着くのは難しいだろうな

original: The Greybeards are a strange bunch.
string: グレイビアードは、変わった連中よ

original: I heard they live their entire life without uttering a single word; can you even imagine?
string: 生涯にわたって、一言も声を発する事がないと聞いたわ。想像できる？

original: I've always fancied a journey up the 7,000 Steps to the monastery.
string: 修道院への七千階段を上りたくて、いつも空想しているわ

original: Anything to break the boredom of living in this town. I envy you.
string: この町に暮らす退屈がまぎれるなら、何でもいいの。あなたがうらやましい

original: Welcome to the Bards College. I am the headmaster here. How may I help you?
string: 吟遊詩人の大学へようこそ。私が校長だ。ご用件は？

original: I have faith that you'll return with King Olaf's Verse.
string: オラフ王の詩歌をきっと持ち帰ると信じているぞ

original: Ah, you have returned. How goes the task I gave you?
string: ああ、戻ってきたのか。与えた課題はどうなったかな？

original: I still don't know if rewriting the verse is going to work.
string: 詩歌の書き直しが役に立つのか、今でも分からない

original: I do hope the court likes the verse. I think we've done an excellent job of recreating it.
string: 宮廷が詩歌を気に入ってくれる事を願う。とてもうまく書き直したからな

original: We should have the festival soon.
string: そろそろ祭を開くべきだ

original: Good to meet a prospective Bard.
string: 未来の吟遊詩人に会えてうれしいよ

original: Get the coat. Then we'll talk.
string: 宮廷で話をしよう

original: Nice to meet the person who went to King Olaf's Tomb.
string: オラフ王の墓を見たのか。会えて光栄だ

original: That sounds acceptable.
string: いいだろう

original: Then I think we're done talking.
string: それなら話は終わったな

original: You don't own the horse you already sold to Letrush?
string: レットラッシュに売った馬を持っていないのか？

original: That is correct. You see, Frost belongs to the Black-Briar estate. Technically everything in the estate is owned by my mother, Maven.
string: そう、そのとおりだ。あのな、フロストはブラック・ブライア農園の持ち物だ。厳密にはすべて、俺の母メイビンが所有している

original: My plan was to take the horse from our lodge and deliver it to Letrush at the stables. Obviously, that didn't exactly work out as I'd planned...
string: 馬をロッジから連れ出し、馬屋でレットラッシュに引き渡す計画だった。見てのとおり、計画どおりにはいかなくてな…

original: Still, I don't want to cross Letrush. Tell you what. Steal the horse and deliver it, and you can have the second half of the payment.
string: そうは言っても、レットラッシュを怒らせたくない。こうしたらどうだ。馬を盗んで引き渡せば、お前に報酬の残り半分をやる

original: I was sent by Louis Letrush.
string: ルイス・レットラッシュに送り込まれた

original: Ah, and let me guess. He wants his horse. Well, that's going to be a bit of a problem. You see, I don't really outright "own" Frost...
string: なるほど、当ててみよう。奴は自分の馬がほしいんだな。さて、それはちょっとした問題だぞ。俺はフロストを完全に“所有”しているわけじゃない…

original: Why is Sibbi in jail?
string: なぜシビは投獄されている？

original: No idea, but whatever he did it must have angered Maven. No guard would lock up a Black-Briar without the old lady's permission.
string: 分からん。だが、きっとメイビンを怒らせたんだろう。彼女の許可なしにブラック・ブライアの者を収監する衛兵はいないだろうからな

original: Silence, prisoner!
string: 黙れ、囚人！

original: Gaaaaah!!!
string: ぐわあああ！

original: What else do you want from me? I've already told you everything. Listen, if you let me go I can take you to Riften, show you where-
string: これ以上どうしろと？　もう洗いざらい話したんだ。なあ、自由にしてくれたらリフテンまで案内するよ。実はそこに…

original: That will be all for now. I must say I continue to be disappointed in your lack of cooperation. I hope next time you will do better.
string: 今のところ、それで全部だ。その非協力的な態度には相変わらず失望している。次はもっと協力した方がいいぞ

original: Like I said, I don't know! I've seen him down in the Ratway. Maybe he lives down there, but I don't know for sure.
string: 言った通り、知らないんだ！　ラットウェイで見かけただけだ。あそこに住んでるのかも知れないが、確かなことは分からない

original: And where can we find this nameless old man?
string: それで、その名もない老人はどこにいるんだ？

original: You know the rules. Just answer the questions.
string: どうすればいいか分かってるな？　質問に答えればいいんだ

original: Ahhhh!
string: ああああ！

original: I don't know his name. Like I've told already a hundred-
string: 名前は知らない。もう何度も言った通り…

original: And his name is...?
string: それで奴の名前は…？

original: There's an old man. He lives in Riften.
string: リフテンに住んでる年寄りがいるんだ

original: He could be this Esbern you're looking for, but I don't know. He's old and seemed kind of crazy. That's all I know.
string: 彼があんたの探してるエズバーンかも知れないが、断言はできない。彼は老人で、ちょっとイカれて見える。知っているのはそれだけだ

original: No, wait! I was just... catching my breath... why wouldn't I tell you again? I don't even know anything...
string: いや、待ってくれ！　ちょっと…　ひと休みしてただけさ…　さっきも言ったろう？　何も知らないんだ…

original: If you persist in this stubbornness I'll have...
string: そこまで頑なになるというのなら、こちらも…

original: Start at the beginning, as usual.
string: いつものように最初から始めよう

original: Noooooo!!!
string: やめてくれえええ！

original: You know the rules.
string: どうすればいいか分かってるな？

original: No... for pity's sake... I've already told you everything...
string: やめてくれ…　頼む…　もう洗いざらい話したんだ…

original: Let's begin again.
string: もう一度最初からだ

original: Silence. You know the rules. Do not speak unless spoken to. Master Rulindil will ask the questions.
string: 静かに。規則は分かってるだろ。話しかけられた時以外は喋らない。ルリンディル師がこれから質問をする

original: Stop. Please. I don't know anything else. Don't you think I'd have told you already?
string: よせ。頼む。他には何も知らないんだ。もう全部話したじゃないか

original: I promise. Just a joke I want to play on someone. (Persuade)
string: 信じてくれ。誰かをからかう遊びのようなものだ(説得)

original: Hmm. Very well. I'm putting my reputation on the line for you.
string: ふむ。いいだろう。お前のために我が名誉を賭そう

original: This is neither the time nor place for such things. I'm surprised you would ask it of me.
string: 状況をわきまえてくれ。そんな事を言ってる場合ではない

original: Never mind.
string: 気にするな

original: Don't presume upon our friendship. My first loyalty is to the Thalmor, as you well know.
string: あまり我々の信頼関係を過信するな。知っての通り、自分が一番の忠誠を誓っているのはサルモールだ

original: Yes, that's probably for the best. I really shouldn't risk getting on Elenwen's bad side.
string: そうね、かえってよかったのかも知れない。エレンウェンを怒らせるような真似はできないの

original: Yes, this probably isn't really the place for your little jokes.
string: ええ、ここはちょっとした冷やかしのために来るような場所ではないでしょうからね

original: Thank you. I knew you'd understand.
string: ありがとう。分かってくれると思っていたよ

original: I'll try to forget you ever asked.
string: 頼まれなかった事にするよ

original: What brings you to this party?
string: なぜこのパーティーに来たんだ？

original: There are those in the Empire who would wish to evade their obligations to help root out the Talos heresy.
string: 帝国には異端のタロスを一掃するという責務を望まない連中がいる

original: Fortunately, those most opposed to the Emperor's wise policy have now branded themselves traitors as well as heretics.
string: 幸運にも、皇帝の賢明なる方策に異を唱えた多くの者は、異端の者らと同様に裏切り者の烙印を押されている

original: I am here to remind the ruling classes of Skyrim that their loyalty to the Emperor requires cooperation with the Thalmor.
string: 皇帝への忠誠を示すにはサルモールとの協力が不可欠だと、スカイリムの支配階級に今一度知らしめに来たというわけだ

original: You have asked for my help. I am providing it.
string: 助けを求めてきたなら、力を貸すまでだ

original: The degeneracy of the Empire is on display here in this room.
string: この部屋で起きている事が帝国の衰退を象徴しているな

original: It's only a matter of time before your whole rotten Empire collapses of its own decay. No offense.
string: 腐った帝国全体が、いずれ崩れ落ちるのはもはや時間の問題だ。おっと、他意はないぞ

original: None of these people cares a whit about the religious aspects of this war. Another sign of the degeneracy of your Empire.
string: ここにいる連中の誰一人として、この戦争の宗教的な側面なんて気にかけちゃいないのに。帝国の衰退の兆候がここにもあるな

original: At least Ulfric's men are willing to fight for their principles, barbaric as they may be.
string: 少なくともウルフリックの部下どもは、自分達の主義に基づいて戦う意志がある。野蛮ではあるがな

original: It's a necessary part of my job to mix with the upper classes of Skyrim, such as they are.
string: スカイリムのお偉方に顔を覚えてもらう事も仕事の一環なんだ。連中のようなね

original: What brings you to this party?
string: なぜこのパーティーに来たんだ？

original: To maintain relationships.
string: 顔つなぎ、といったところですよ

original: By the way, I don't know who you are, but unless you want me to blow your cover, I'd advise that you avoid me for the rest of the party.
string: 時に、お前が何者か知りませんが、正体をばらされたくなければ、パーティーが終わるまで私には近づかない方が身のためですよ

original: I'm doing as you asked. Not for nothing, I hope?
string: 言うとおりにしてあげましょう。ですが、まさか見返りなしとは言いませんね？

original: I don't recall seeing you at one of these before. And I know everyone who's anyone in Skyrim.
string: この辺りでは見ない顔ですね。スカイリムで名の知れた者は、ひととおり把握しているつもりでしたが

original: That's General Tullius himself. He can't stand Elenwen, but she insists that he attend these parties. Just to piss him off, no doubt.
string: テュリウス将軍閣下ですよ。エレンウェンを毛嫌いしているのですが、どうしても来てほしいと言われて折れたものと。エレンウェンなりの嫌がらせでしょうね

original: See that disgusting drunk over there? A high-ranking official in the East Empire Company, believe it or not.
string: あちらの悪趣味な酔っ払いが見えますか？　東帝都社の高官ですよ、信じようと信じまいと

original: But... I rather thought that if I were to help, I might... Well, I might be allowed to return to the College.

string: (黙っている)

original: You would expect any less from the Listener?
string: 聞こえし者なら、当然のことだろう？

original: All I've ever wanted to do is serve this Sanctuary.
string: この聖域で仕える事が長年の夢だった

original: So I gathered. It seems a certain Orc has disappeared. Which means you not only killed the Gourmet, but disposed of the body as well.
string: らしいな。あるオークが行方不明になったそうだ。つまりお前は美食家を始末しただけでなく、死体も始末したということだ

original: You've got the Writ of Passage too, I see. Splendid, splendid...
string: 通行証も手に入れたな。よくやった、よくやった…

original: Ah, and word has come in from Markarth that the keep's cook has met an untimely demise.
string: ああ、そしてマルカルスからきた風の便りによると要塞のコックが早すぎる死を迎えたそうだ

original: You performed your duties to the letter.
string: お前は忠実に任務を果たしたわけだ

original: Dead.
string: 死んだ

original: Right, which we had already established. And you managed to hide the body as well? Good.
string: そう、それは我々もすでに知っている。で死体も処理できたんだな？　よろしい

original: You've got the Writ of Passage too, I see. So there's that. And Anton Virane has suffered an untimely fate, as well. Good.
string: 通行証も手に入れたか、なるほど。これもよし。さらにアントン・ヴィレインは非業の最期を迎えたわけだ。よろしい

original: Well, looks like you completed the contract as directed. Finally. A little sloppy, but, well... done is done.
string: ふむ、どうやらお前は指示通りに任務をこなしたようだ。ようやくな。手際の悪さは残るが、まあ…　殺しは殺しだ

original: Here's your gold, with a little extra for hiding the body. Now go see Astrid. The final stage of the contract has come. The Emperor must fall.
string: さあ報酬だ。少ないが死体を隠したことへのボーナスも上乗せしてある。さあ、アストリッドに会え。仕事の最終段階がきた。皇帝を葬るのだ

original: Dead.
string: 死んだ

original: Good. And his Writ of Passage?
string: よし。で通行証は？

original: Oh wait, let me guess - you don't have them.
string: 待てよ、ひょっとして…　持ってないんだろう

original: Fool! Amateur! Without those papers you'll never be able to present yourself as the Gourmet! Off with you! Back to the body to retrieve them!
string: 愚か者！　素人が！　あの書類がなければ美食家になりすませないではないか！　失せろ！　死体から奪ってこい！

original: Dead.
string: 死んだ

original: Good, good. And you've got the Writ of Passage too, I see, so that's done.
string: よし、よし。通行証を手に入れたな。なるほど、これはよしとしよう

original: But why? Why, pray tell, have I received word that Anton Virane is still walking around Markarth, hale and healthy as the day he was born?
string: ではなぜだ？　どういうことか、教えてくれ。アントン・ヴィレインがいまだにマルカルスを歩き回っているというウワサを聞いたぞ。生まれたときそのままに元気で健康だという

original: Back to Markarth with you! Virane must be silenced! He's a potential witness, you witless dagger jabber!
string: マルカルスに戻れ！　ヴィレインを黙らせるのだ！　ヤツは目撃者かも知れないのだ。ナイフを振り回すだけの愚か者が！

original: Dead.
string: 死んだ

original: Good, good. And you've got the Writ of Passage, too, I see. So there's that.
string: よしよし。通行証も手に入れているな。それはよしとしよう

original: I've also received word from Markarth. It would seem Anton Virane has suffered an untimely fate, as well. Good.
string: マルカルスからのウワサを聞いた。アントン・ヴィレインは不慮の死を迎えたらしいな。これも良しだ

original: But unfortunately, that inn is abuzz with the news of somebody killing one of their guests! What, hiding the body was too much for you to handle?
string: だが惜しむらくは、宿屋では客が殺された話で持ちきりだ！　死体を片付けるのはお前には手に余るとでも言うのか？

original: Bah! Useless. Here's your gold. Now go see Astrid. The time to move against the Emperor has finally come. Sithis help us all.
string: フン！　役たたずめ。ほら報酬だ。アストリッドのところへ行け。皇帝に矛を向けるときがついにきた。シシスよ我らにご加護を

original: Dead.
string: 死んだ

original: Remember, the Markarth Keep. That's where you'll find Anton Virane. Probably cooking up all of the Gourmet's recipes, passing them off as his own.
string: いいか、マルカルス砦だ。アントン・ヴィレインはそこにいる。美食家のあらゆるレシピを作っている事だろう。自分のレシピと偽ってな

original: All you've got to do is find and kill one lousy chef. The clock is ticking...
string: お前がすべきはまずいシェフを見つけて始末するだけだ。時間がないぞ

original: So, the prodigal murderer returns. And the Gourmet?
string: フン、放蕩暗殺者のお帰りか。で、美食家は？

original: Ah, you're back. Ready to try again, are we? Let's start from the top. You were sent to kill the Gourmet. And he is...
string: おお、戻ってきたか。次の準備はできてるな？　もう1度おさらいだ。お前は美食家を始末する命を受けた。でヤツは…

original: On second thought, I'll walk.
string: いや、やっぱり歩こう

original: Suit yourself.
string: 勝手にしろ

original: Don't blame me if your feet get sore.
string: 足が痛くなっても知らないぞ

original: Then stop wastin' my time.
string: 人の時間を無駄にするんじゃない

original: Off with ya then. I've got work to do.
string: それならどいてくれないか。仕事の邪魔だ

original: Didn't think you had the coin for it anyway.
string: どのみち、金など持ってやしないと思ったよ

original: Then off with ya. I've got better things to do.
string: じゃ、帰って。他にもっとましな用事があるから

original: Should have known you'd be a cheap one.
string: 金を出し惜しみするとはな

original: Then what are you wasting my time for?
string: なんだよ、人の時間を無駄にして

original: Walkin' never hurt nobody. If you change your mind, I'll be here.
string: まあ歩くのも悪かないよ。気が変わったらまたおいで

original: Oh. Was it something I said? I can't afford to lower the price, but come back if you change your mind.
string: 何か気に障る事でも言ったか？　値引きする余裕はないけど、気が変わったらまた来てよ

original: Here's my offer... (<Global=Horsecost> gold)
string: これでどうだ…(<Global=Horsecost> ゴールド)

original: You've got a deal. It's the one with the saddle.
string: それで手を打とう。その鞍のついているやつだよ

original: Then come back when you've got that much.
string: じゃあ、それだけ手に入れたら戻ってこい

original: That'll do. She's all saddled up for you.
string: 売った。ちゃんと鞍は付けてあるぞ

original: When you get it, she's yours.
string: 金を持ってきな。そしたら譲ってやろう

original: Sounds fair. She's yours. Like I said, she's all saddled.
string: いいだろう。この牝馬はお前のものだ。持っていけ

original: When you got that much, we'll talk.
string: もし金が手に入ったら、戻ってくるんだな

original: Fair enough. You can have her. She's the one with the saddle.
string: 結構。これでこいつはあんたの物だ。鞍もついてるよ

original: Didn't think you had the coin.
string: 金が足りないみたいだな

original: That's your best offer? I suppose so. She's the one with the saddle.
string: それが最高額か？　まあいい。鞍はついてるぞ

original: If you had it, you'd be riding and we wouldn't be talking.
string: それだけあれば、乗って帰れるぞ。何も文句はない

original: That much? I mean, of course. If that's all you've got.
string: そんなに？　ええ、本気よ。稼いだのがそれで全部ならね

original: I'd sell her for that, but you ain't got it.
string: 彼女にはその値段で売るけど、あなたにはだめよ

original: Sold. She's all yours. She's already saddled up.
string: 売った。こいつはあんたの物だ。鞍もついてるよ

original: That would work, except you ain't got.
string: これじゃ足りんな

original: Wish everyone haggled like you. She's all yours.
string: みんなあんたみたいに交渉上手だったらな。連れて行ってくれ

original: Too bad you don't have that much. Guess you'll have to walk.
string: 残念だがそんなに持ってないだろう。歩いた方がいいよ

original: Good enough for me. It's the one with the saddle.
string: それだけ貰えりゃ十分だ。鞍はおまけしとくよ

original: That would be a fair price. When you've got it, come see me.
string: いいだろう。金ができたら来てくれ

original: Wow! Didn't think I could get that for her. I mean, sure!
string: へえ！　まさかそんなにもらえるとは！　もちろんいいよ！

original: Looks like you're a little short on coin though. Sorry.
string: ちょっと足りないみたいだね。悪いな

original: Can I buy a horse?
string: 馬を売ってくれないか？

original: Suppose so. Got one all saddled if you've got the coin.
string: いいだろう。ゴールドがあるなら、鞍のついているやつを持って行け

original: Not today. Sold my last one. Pretty sure I sold it to you.
string: 今日はダメだ。最後の一頭が売れたんだ。確か売った相手はお前だったはずだが

original: Yeah, I got one for sale.
string: ああ、1頭売りに出してるよ

original: You could if I had one. Sold my last available horse to someone that looked an awful lot like you.
string: あいにく売り切れでね。最後の1頭を買ってったのは、あんたに恐ろしくよく似た御仁だったな

original: Got one all saddled and ready to go. What are you willing to pay?
string: 用意の出来ている馬がいるぞ。いくら払える？

original: If I had one. Sold my last one to you a bit ago.
string: もし馬が残っていたらな…　さっき最後のを売り払ってしまったところだ

original: Reckon you can. How much you willing to pay?
string: お前しだいだ。いくら出せる？

original: Nope. Sold my last one to some stranger.
string: 無理だ。さっき最後の1頭を売っちまった

original: It's for sale, if you've got the coin.
string: 金さえあれば、売ってやろう

original: Not right now. You bought my last one.
string: 今は無理だ。前に買ったのが最後の馬だったからな

original: That one with the saddle? How much are you offering?
string: 鞍をつけたあの馬？　いくら出す？

original: Can't help you. They're all spoken for.
string: 悪いけど、あれはみんな欲しがっているのよ

original: Don't mind if you do. What's your price?
string: ああ。いくら出せる？

original: If I had one you could. They're all spoken for.
string: 残念だが、全部売約済みだ

original: I've got one all saddled up for you! What do you figure she's worth?
string: 今すぐ乗れるのがあるよ！　いくらだと思う？

original: Wish I did, but some outlander bought my last one.
string: 売りたいけど、よそ者に最後のを売ったんだ

original: That's what I'm here for. What are you offering?
string: そのためにここにいるんだ。いくら出すね？

original: Don't have any that are for sale right now.
string: 今は売りものの馬を切らしててね

original: Yes! Yes, you can. She's all saddled up and everything.
string: ああ！　もちろん。鞍や何もかもみんなついてる

original: Not today. You should have come by earlier. Wait, didn't I sell me last one to you?
string: 今日は駄目だ。もっと早く来ないと。待てよ、最後のを買った人じゃないか？

original: I have your frost salts.
string: 氷の塩鉱石を持ってきた

original: Well, well, you actually did what you said you were going to do. I'm impressed.
string: 驚いた、あなたはやるって言った事を本当にやったのね。感激だわ

original: Here, let me teach you a thing or two about Alteration magic. It's the least I can do.
string: じゃあ、変性の魔法について1つ2つ教えさせてもらうわ。これくらいの事しかできないから

original: Sorry to hear that.
string: 災難だったな

original: It's not any of your bother, so I don't see what you're apologizing for.
string: あなたには関係ない事でしょ。何で謝るのか分からないわ

original: I could find those frost salts for you.
string: 氷の塩鉱石を探してこよう

original: If you want to go to the trouble, feel free. I suppose I could offer you a bit of free Alteration training when you get back.
string: わざわざ行ってくれるっていうのなら、戻ってきた時に、ちょっとした変性の訓練をタダでしてあげてもいいわ

original: What do you do in Kynesgrove?
string: カイネの森で何をするんだ？

original: Nosy one, huh? I was a mage back in Morrowind. I lend my talents to the mines here, helping them keep the tunnels safe.
string: 詮索好きなのね。モロウウィンドにいたころは魔術師だったわ。才能をこの鉱山に役立てているの。トンネルを安全に保つためにね

original: By Azura, it gets hot in there. I use Frost Salts for a potion to keep the heat bearable, but I'm out.
string: アズラにかけて、暑くなってきてるわ。氷の塩鉱石を薬にして耐えてるけど、もう足りないわ

original: Yes. I'm sure he's doing well there.
string: ええ、彼はきっとあそこでうまくやっているわ

original: Last time you said he was fighting for the Empire.
string: この前、帝国のために戦っているって言ってたよね

original: He's off fighting the war, dear. For the Stormcloaks.
string: 戦争へ行ったのよ。ストームクロークのためにね

original: Mama, where did papa go?
string: ママ、パパはどこへ行ったの？

original: I did. Those mead stains are always tricky.
string: 僕だよ。ハチミツ酒のシミはやっかいなんだよね

original: Did you clean the linens, yet?
string: シーツはもう洗った？

original: I'd like to collect my earnings.
string: 報酬をもらいたい

original: Here's your pay. It's never enough for what we do, but war gives us warriors its own kind of benefits, doesn't it?
string: 報酬はこれだ。我々の仕事にしては少ない額だが、戦闘で鍛えられる事自体が戦士にとっては報酬と言えるからな。だろう？

original: Are you sure? It's rightfully yours, but this money could go to getting better weapons and armor, and making repairs to the settlements we control.
string: それでよいのか？　間違いなくお前の金だが、良質な武具を揃えたり入植地の復興に回すこともできるのだぞ

original: Are you all right?
string: 大丈夫か？

original: I saw guards dragging bodies over here. Might be a way out.
string: 衛兵が死体を引きずっていくのを見たんだ。たぶんそっちが出口だ

original: We've got to get out of here.
string: ここから出ないと

original: You saved my life. I won't forget it. Look me up if you're ever in Riften.
string: あんたは命の恩人だ。この恩は忘れないよ。リフテンに来たら訪ねてきてくれ

original: You didn't have to help me, so... thanks.
string: なんの義理もないのに助けてくれて…　恩に着るよ

original: Are you all right?
string: 大丈夫か？

original: Now the Thalmor will be hunting me for the rest of my life. I hope it was worth it.
string: これでサルモールに一生狙われ続けるだろうな。それだけの価値があったならいいが…

original: I should have known this would end badly. I can't believe I let Delphine talk me into this.
string: こんな結果になる事を予期しておくべきだった。デルフィンに言いくるめられるとは、なんて様だ

original: Let's get out of here, for pity's sake!
string: 何という事だ！　急いで逃げるぞ！

original: Trust me, we have nothing to say to one another.
string: 信じてくれ、お互い何も言うことはない

original: Use your Unrelenting Force shout to strike the targets as they appear.
string: 目標が現れ次第、揺るぎ無き力を使って打ち倒せ

original: Please, sir, leave me alone!
string: お願い、構わないで下さい！

original: Don't you dare walk away from me, you slut! Do you know who I am?
string: 逃げるな、女め！　誰だか分かってるのか？

original: No, I'm sorry, but I can't go anywhere with you. I won't. Please, I must get back to my duties.
string: 申し訳ありませんが、あなたについて行く事はできません。任務に戻らなくては

original: Oh, I don't think so. I think I understand perfectly. Don't worry, my dear, I will make any necessary excuses to your employer.
string: おっと、それは違うな。全部分かってるつもりだ。心配するな、雇い主には何とか言っておく

original: Oh, don't worry. I'll let you make it up to me. Now, where can we go for a little privacy, hmm?
string: 心配するな。埋め合わせをさせてやろう。さてと、人目につかない場所はあるか？　ん？

original: What? I'm sorry, sir, but you must have misunderstood. I'm not permitted to leave the party.
string: ええ？　恐縮ですが、誤解されているようです。晩餐会から立ち去る事は許されていません

original: I'm sorry, sir. I didn't mean to give you the wrong impression earlier. I meant no disrespect.
string: 申し訳ありません。無礼な態度をとるつもりではありませんでした。決して軽視したわけでは…

original: Hello, my dear. I got your message. Where shall we go?
string: やあ。伝言を受け取ったぞ。どこへ行こうか？

original: So. You think you can toy with me, is that it? No, my dear. I have my heart set on you, and I always get what I want.
string: なるほど。もてあそぼうってか？　そうは行かないぞ。お前がほしい。そしてほしいものは必ず手に入れる

original: Yes. She said she can sneak you up to her quarters right now.
string: ああ。部屋に招待できると言っていた

original: Haha. I knew it! No woman yet born has been able to resist my charms for long. Thank you, my friend. I owe you one.
string: はは、やっぱりな！　俺の魅力にいつまでも抗える女など一人としていないんだ。ありがとう、友よ。借りができたな

original: Not yet. These things can't be rushed.
string: まだだ。こういうことはゆっくりやらないと

original: Ha. Don't toy with me. I may just have to seize my opportunity with both hands, ha ha ha. But we'll play it your way for now.
string: おい、俺をからかうなよ。チャンスは両手でしっかりつかまないとな、はっはっは。まあ今のところは、お前のやり方に従おう

original: Don't worry. She's all yours.
string: 心配するな。彼女はお前に夢中だ

original: Ha. We'll see. I do have my eye on her, but she seemed a bit cold when I spoke to her earlier. Maybe just playing hard to get, eh?
string: さあ、どうだろうな。確かに目をつけてはいるが、この前話した時は少し冷たい感じだったぞ。もしかしたら、その気のないふりをしてただけか？

original: Maybe I can talk to her for you. See if she's interested.
string: 代わりに彼女と話そう。興味があるかどうか確かめてみる

original: Really? Yes, maybe that would be just the thing. She seemed to be playing hard to get when I spoke to her earlier.
string: 本当に？　そうだ、それがいいかも知れない。この前話した時は、その気のないふりをしていたからな

original: Go on. See what she says. Now you've gone and gotten my hopes up again.
string: やってみてくれ。彼女が何と言うか見ものだ。お前のせいで、また期待が膨らんだじゃないか

original: I saw you eyeing that serving girl.
string: 給仕の娘を狙っているようだな

original: Mmm, yes... Brelas, is that the one? I hope you're not thinking of cutting me out, are you? Haha.
string: うーん、まあな…　ブレラスだっけ？　俺を締め出そうとか考えてないだろうな？　あはは

original: I'm warning you, when I get my heart set on something I'm not easily put off.
string: 言っておくが、俺は一度心を決めたら簡単にはあきらめないぜ

original: What brings you to this party?
string: なぜこのパーティーに来たんだ？

original: You must be new to Skyrim, or you'd already know who I am. I have a stake in most anything of importance in Solitude.
string: スカイリムに来たばかりのようだな。そうでなければ俺を知らないはずがない。ソリチュードで重要とされるもののほとんどに出資しているからな

original: I feel that it's time to put aside the grievances of the past, and let peace and prosperity flourish between the Empire and the Aldmeri Dominion.
string: 過去の不満は忘れ、帝国とアルドメリ自治領の間に平和と繁栄がもたらされる時が来たと感じている

original: I try to do my little part. Besides, just between you and me, it's making me pots of money, hahaha.
string: 俺はわずかながら、その手助けをしているつもりだ。それにここだけの話だが、ガッポリもうけさせてもらってるよ。ハッハッハ

original: Have you talked to Brelas yet? I'm not a patient man, you know.
string: ブレラスとは、もう話したのか？　俺は気長な男じゃないぞ、知ってるだろ

original: Did you see that serving girl? I hear elf women are insatiable...
string: あの給仕の娘を見たか？　ふむ、エルフの女どもはどん欲だと聞いてるぞ…

original: For the man who knows how to make money, war can be a most profitable venture.
string: 金もうけの仕方を知っている男にとって、戦争は最高にもうかる事業だ

original: The Great War is long past. It's time the Empire and the Aldmeri Dominion put aside their differences. Prosperity is good for everyone.
string: 大戦は遠い過去の出来事だ。帝国とアルドメリ自治領にとっては、不和を乗り越える潮時だ。繁栄は誰にとっても良い事だ

original: Elenwen always throws quite a party. I never miss one if I can help it.
string: エレンウェンは、いつも最高のパーティーを開く。できる限り、出席するようにしているよ

original: Yes, sir.
string: ええ！

original: Oh... not at the moment. Maybe later. Don't go far.
string: おっと…　今はダメだ。また後でな。遠くに行くなよ

original: Um, thank you. Sir. Was there anything else I can do for you?
string: ありがとうございます。他にご用はありませんか？

original: No, no, that's not what I'm interested in right now.
string: いやいや、今はそんな事には興味がない

original: I just wanted to get a better look at you. I like what I see, my dear.
string: お前をもっとよく見たかっただけだ。気に入ったぞ

original: And believe me, I don't say that to everyone. I'm very discriminating when it comes to the female form.
string: 信じてくれ、誰にでも言うわけじゃない。女の外見に関しては、すごくうるさいんだ

original: Uh, Brelas, sir. Did you need a drink? Something to eat?
string: ブレラスです。飲み物か食べ物をお探しですか？

original: You there! Serving girl! What's your name, dear?
string: そこのお前！　給仕の娘！　何という名だ？

original: There's a likely-looking filly. Even if she is an elf.
string: 魅力的なおてんば娘だ。エルフだとしてもな

original: That fellow over there asked me to talk to you...
string: 向こうのお仲間に、あなたと話すよう言われた

original: Ugh. Erikur, right? He was talking to me earlier. I could tell what he was after.
string: ああ、エリクールね。さっき私に話しかけてきた。彼の狙いは分かっているわ

original: I hate working these parties. Some of the guests are nice, but there's always a few like Erikur.
string: こういうパーティーは大嫌いよ。いい客もいるけど、エリクールみたいな奴も必ずいるんだから

original: Please tell him to leave me alone. Politely. I'm sure you'll have better luck getting through to him than I would.
string: 私にかまうなと言っておいて。礼儀正しくね。私が言うよりあなたが言う方がうまく通じると思うわ

original: I hope you're enjoying yourself, sir.
string: 楽しんでいただけたなら幸いです

original: I hope you're enjoying yourself, ma'am.
string: 楽しんでいただけたなら幸いです

original: What can I get for you?
string: 何にしましょう？

original: I trust that this is just the begining of a long and mutually beneficial relationship.
string: 長きにわたり互いに有益となるよい関係の始まりとなればうれしいですわ

original: I'm so glad you could attend today.
string: お越しいただいてうれしいですわ

original: I hope you're enjoying yourself.
string: お楽しみいただいていますか

original: Please, help yourself to more wine.
string: どうぞ、ワインを召し上がって下さい

original: The hospitality of the Thalmor Embassy is at your service.
string: サルモール大使館が皆様を歓迎いたします

original: Well, I'm glad that little unpleasantness is over.
string: やれやれ、不快な出来事が終わってよかった

original: Yes, Madame Ambassador.
string: はい、大使夫人

original: Sir, you must tell her! You don't know what they'll do to me! Please!
string: 彼女に言って下さい！　あなたは、彼らが何をするか知らないんです。お願いです！

original: Mistress Elenwen, it's not true! I did nothing!
string: エレンウェン様、違います！　私は何もしていません！

original: No!
string: やめろ！

original: Well. Whatever the truth of it, I'm sure a few words with Master Rulindil will have a salutary effect. Take her downstairs.
string: 真実がどうであろうと、ルリンディル師と言葉を交わすことが有益な影響を及ぼすことは確かね。彼女を下へ連れてきて

original: Is that so, Erikur? And you with such delicate sensibilities. It must have been most upsetting.
string: そうなの、エリクール？　繊細なあなたですもの、それは動揺したでしょうね

original: I demand that you have this wench removed from my presence at once!
string: この女を今すぐ目の前から連れ去れ！

original: Elenwen! This servant girl has been throwing herself at me in a most disgusting manner.
string: エレンウェン！　この給仕の娘がひどく不愉快なやり方で気を引こうとするんだ

original: Now you're going to be sorry you crossed me.
string: 怒らせた事を後悔させてやる

original: Any suggestions as to how I find them?
string: どうやって奴らを見つけるか、何か手がかりはないか？

original: I heard one of them was just arrested trying to sneak into the city. If he's locked up in the jail, perhaps you can get it out of him.
string: 街に忍び込もうとして、捕まった者がいると聞きました。監獄に入れられているなら、その者から聞き出せるかもしれません

original: Please, I know I'm asking you to do something difficult, maybe even dangerous. I just don't know who else I can trust.
string: お願いします。困難で危険なことをお願いしているのは分かっています。でも、他に誰も頼れる人がいないんです

original: You've seen them? Then waste no time, head there at once!
string: 連中を見かけたのですか？　では、すぐに向かって下さい！

original: The longer they're around, the more danger I'm in! Please, kill Kematu and end this nightmare for me!
string: 時間がたてばたつほど、どんどん危険になります！　お願いです、ケマツを殺して私の悪夢を終わらせて下さい！

original: I've run across these Alik'r before. I know where they're hiding.
string: 前にもアリクルと出くわしたことがある。奴らの隠れ場所も知っている

original: If you're getting involved in this, that'd be where you start looking.
string: この件に関わるというなら、その点から始めるんだな

original: Why is this suddenly so important, anyway?
string: それにしても、なぜ突然これが重要視される？

original: Last I heard he intended to pass through Eastmarch on his way here.
string: 最後に聞いたところでは、イーストマーチを通ってくる予定だという話だった

original: Last I'd heard, he was crossing the border from Morrowind into The Rift.
string: 最後に聞いたところでは、モロウウィンドの境界を越えてリフトに入るという話だった

original: Where's the courier?
string: 配達人はどこに？

original: I don't know. Are you not listening at all?
string: 分からない。話を聞いてるのか？

original: It was a simple task, so I didn't keep close tabs on it like I do with the dangerous stuff.
string: 簡単な仕事だったから、危険なものを扱う時のようには注意を払っていなかったんだ

original: What is it Arniel wanted you to get?
string: アーニエルは何を入手させたかったんだ？

original: I don't know. He never told me.
string: 知らない。決して教えてくれなかった

original: He made most of the arrangements himself, he just needed it transported from Morrowind. That's what I agreed to help with.
string: 彼は自分でほとんど手配をしていて、あとはモロウウィンドから運ぶだけだった。それを引き受けたのさ

original: If I'd known it was so important to him, I'd have charged him more.
string: そんなに重要なものだと分かっていたら、もっと高く請求したのに

original: Didn't you tell Enthir this was valuable?
string: エンシルに貴重な物だと言わなかったのか？

original: Have you lost your mind?
string: 気は確かか？

original: Think, please, just for a moment, about what he would do if he knew its true value.
string: 考えてもみろ。こいつの本当の価値を知ったら、奴はどうすると思う？

original: Do you really believe he would honor our agreement, or go running off to the highest bidder?
string: 奴が約束を守ると本当に思うか？　もっと金を払う連中に横流しするに決まっている

original: Please, you must set this right. I'm begging you.
string: 頼むから何とかしてくれ。この通りだ

original: What is this thing that's so important?
string: これのどこがそんなに重要なんだ？

original: It... It's very valuable. Critical to my work, and one-of-a-kind. That's all I care to say for now.
string: それは…　それはとても貴重な物だ。研究を完成させるのに欠かせない、唯一無二の代物なんだ。今はそれしか言えないな

original: It can't be lost. It just can't! It's irreplaceable, do you understand?
string: あれを失うわけにはいかない。絶対にな！　替えは効かないんだ、分かるだろう？

original: Without it, I cannot finish my work. All these years, so much time, so much energy...
string: あれがないと研究が完成しないんだ。何年も、長い時間と大変な労力をかけてきたのに…

original: You must find it! It cannot end this way! Not after I've worked so hard!
string: 必ず見つけてきてくれ！　ここまでやってきたのに、ここで終わるわけにいかない！

original: The courier never arrived with it.
string: 配達人は持ってきていない

original: He has some simple-minded courier delivering it?
string: 奴はアレをそんな愚かしい者に運ばせたというのか？

original: It left Morrowind, but never arrived here.
string: モロウウィンドは出たが、ここには着いていない

original: No, no no no. This can't be happening.
string: いやいやいや、そんな事はあり得ない

original: Enthir really doesn't have whatever it is you asked him for.
string: エンシルは頼まれた物を本当に持っていないらしい

original: What?
string: 何？

original: I... I don't understand. Where is it?
string: ど…　どういうことだ。一体どこにある？

original: You're not listening to me. I don't have it.
string: 話を聞いていないな。私は持っていないのだ

original: I set up the whole deal. A courier was supposed to be bringing it from Morrowind. He never arrived.
string: 取引のお膳立てをしたのは私だ。配達人がモロウウィンドから運んでくる予定だったが、結局来なかった

original: Okay? The deal was already done, the thing just never showed up. I can't help that!
string: いいか？　取引は成立していたが、品物が届かなかったんだ。それじゃどうしようもない！

original: I'm not running any more errands for you.
string: お前の使い走りはもうごめんだ

original: Did I ask you to? Did you hear me say that?
string: 誰が頼んだ？　私が頼んだことか？

original: What sort of "payment" do you expect this time?
