original: Their souls are trapped in Oblivion all the same, and here I stay.
string: 彼らの魂はみな等しくオブリビオンに囚われているが、私はここにいる

original: Where did you come from?
string: お前はどこから来たんだ？

original: Where am I? You! Out with it, then.
string: ここはどこだ！？　貴様！　答えるのだ！

original: Ah, here's the blushing bride now. Let's begin the ceremony.
string: ああ、恥らう花嫁が現れた。儀式を始めよう

original: Ah, here's the proud groom now. Let's begin the ceremony.
string: ああ、誇らしげな花婿が来た。式を始めよう

original: Stop the wedding! I can't go through with this.
string: 結婚式を中止してくれ！ やっぱり無理だ

original: You're just going to walk away from your betrothal? Get out of the temple.
string: 婚礼を破棄するつもりか？　早々に聖堂から立ち去られよ

original: I do. Now and forever.
string: 未来永劫に誓います

original: Under the authority of Mara, the Divine of Love, I declare this couple to be wed.
string: 愛の神マーラの名において、2人の婚姻をここに認める

original: I present the two of you with these matching rings, blessed by Mara's divine grace. May they protect each of you in your new life together.
string: 2人には、マーラの神聖なる愛の祝福を受けた揃いの指輪を授けよう。2人の新たな生活において互いを護ってくれるであろう

original: Do you agree to be bound together, in love, now and forever?
string: 未来永劫、愛し続ける事を誓うか？

original: I made a mistake. I want to go ahead with the ceremony.
string: 間違いを犯してしまった。結婚式を進めたい

original: "Forgiveness is the heart of Mara's blessings." Very well. We shall re-arrange your wedding.
string: “寛容はマーラの祝福の真髄”だ。よろしい、お前の婚礼をやり直そう

original: Tomorrow. Same time as before.
string: 明日、前と同じ時刻に

original: Well I think your betrothed might feel otherwise. The two of you will need to work this out before the temple will marry you.
string: 婚約者は違った考えを持っているのでは？　聖堂で2人の婚礼を行う前によく相談されるがいい

original: It's our wedding day. I feel like all of Skyrim is focused on just the two of us.
string: 今日は結婚式だ。スカイリム全体が、俺達二人を見つめてるみたいだ

original: This is a fine wedding. And to think, it's for us.
string: 素晴らしい結婚式だ。我々のための

original: This ceremony is so different from an Orc marriage. Less blood.
string: オークの結婚の儀式とはずいぶん違うな。血生臭さがない

original: I never would have dreamed I would be getting married in the Temple of Mara.
string: マーラの聖堂で結婚式を挙げるなんて夢にも思わなかった

original: Weddings always make me cry. What am I supposed to do now that I'm the one getting married?
string: 結婚式じゃ、いつも涙が出ちまう。今や自分が結婚するなんて、どうすりゃいいんだ？

original: It's a simple ceremony, but it'll do. You're here. That's enough.
string: 簡単な式で十分。お前がいれば、それでいい

original: Who would have thought I would be getting married?
string: 自分が結婚するなんて想像もできなかった

original: How could you? Just go.
string: よくもまあ。どこかに行ってくれ

original: I don't want to see you ever again.
string: もう二度と会いたくない

original: Get away from me. Liar!
string: 近づくな、この嘘つきめ！

original: You should leave. Now.
string: 消え失せろ

original: Get out. Leave me alone!
string: 出ていけ。放っといてくれ！

original: You're abandoning me? Me? I never want to see you ever again.
string: 俺を捨てるのか？　もう二度と、顔も見たくないな

original: Get out of my sight.
string: 消え失せろ

original: Get out.
string: 出て行け

original: Congratulations on your wedding. I'm so happy for both of you.
string: 結婚おめでとう。二人の門出を祝福するよ

original: Just leave.
string: 出て行ってくれ

original: And so ends the Dark Brotherhood, once and for all. About bloody time.
string: 闇の一党はこれでお終いだ。潮時だよ

original: Anyway, I can smell the smoke. They've already set the place alight.
string: とにかく、煙の臭いがするんだ。奴ら、火を付けやがった

original: If they were easy to kill, don't you think we would have done it years ago? If our men aren't out in a few minutes, they're dead, trust me.
string: 簡単に殺せるなら、もうずっと昔に殺していたはずだろ？　すぐ外に逃げなけりゃ死んじまう。本当さ

original: What's the bloody hold up in there? How long can it take to run through a few scraggly assassins?
string: 何を手間取ってるんだ？　むさ苦しい暗殺者のひとりや二人、とっとと巻いてしまえ

original: This had better be worth all the trouble.
string: 手間を掛けた甲斐があるといいんだが

original: Few outsiders earn the right to enter our strongholds. Speak with more respect, or we might forget your gifts.
string: この要塞へ入場する権利を得たよそ者は一握りだ。口を慎め。贈り物をなかった事にするぞ

original: Feel free to trade with our smiths for Orc weapons and armor. Train with my warriors, or purchase poisons from the wise woman.
string: オークの武器や防具ならいつでも我らの鍛冶屋が取引しよう。戦士と訓練するか、それとも毒を購入するか

original: I'm honored.
string: 光栄だ

original: Feel free to trade with our smiths for Orc weapons and armor. Train with my warriors, or purchase poisons from the wise woman.
string: オークの武器や防具ならいつでも我らの鍛冶屋が取引しよう。戦士と訓練するか、それとも毒を購入するか

original: Welcome to our stronghold, Blood-Kin.
string: ようこそ我らの要塞へ、親族よ

original: I don't believe it. You found the Forgemaster's Fingers. You've impressed me, outlander. No one else has returned from this task before.
string: 信じられん。鍛冶の巨匠の指を見つけてきたとは。やるじゃないか、よそ者よ。その依頼を受けて戻ってきた者は、今まで誰もいなかったんだ

original: By the Code of Malacath, I name you Blood-Kin to the Orcs. Let it be known among the strongholds that you are family, now.
string: マラキャスの掟により、そなたをオークの親族に指定する。さあ、お前が家族の一員だと要塞中に知らせよう

original: What are you doing here, outlander? We don't deal with your kind.
string: よそ者、ここで何をしている？　お前らのような連中とは取引しないぞ

original: This is our stronghold. Leave.
string: ここは我々の要塞だ。立ち去れ

original: Outsiders. Nothing but trouble.
string: よそ者か。ろくな事はないな

original: Malacath blesses us with this land. It's not for your kind.
string: この土地は我々がマラキャスから授かったものだ。お前達のものではない

original: This stronghold is for the Orcs. Leave. Now.
string: ここはオークのための要塞だ。さっさと立ち去れ

original: We don't know you, and we don't want you here.
string: どこの誰とも知れない者がいるのは気に入らんな

original: Leave, outlander.
string: 立ち去れ、よそ者よ

original: You've no right to be here. This place is for Orcs. And Orcs alone.
string: お前にここにいる権利はない。ここはオークのための土地だ。オークだけのな

original: Outlanders should learn to not wander where they don't belong.
string: よそ者なら、他人の土地に足を踏み入れぬよう気をつける事だな

original: Why do we need to be cautious?
string: なぜ気をつけねばならないんだ？

original: The original Companions. Their finest warriors rest with Ysgramor. You'll have to prove yourselves to them.
string: 彼らは同胞団の最初のメンバーだ。最も優れた戦士達がイスグラモルとともに眠っている。彼らに実力を示さなければならない

original: It's not that you're intruding. I'd wager they've actually expected us.
string: これは侵入じゃない。実際、向こうも俺達が来ることは分かっていたはずだ

original: They just want to be sure that you're worthy. Be ready for an honorable battle.
string: ただ、君にそれだけの価値があるのか確かめたいだけだろう。名誉ある戦いに備えるんだな

original: I'll do it.
string: いざゆかん

original: Who will start?
string: 誰が始める？

original: Well I'll be damned. We heard you were dead. Motierre's in the back room, if you've got business.
string: もうお終いだ。お前は死んだと聞いていたのに。モティエールは後ろの部屋にいる。用があるのだろう？

original: Please, make haste. The Emperor's ship won't stayed moored forever. We won't get a chance like this again.
string: 頼む、急いでくれ。皇帝の船は永久に停泊しているわけではない。こんな機会は二度とないのだ

original: I'll admit, I'm having trouble coming to terms with all of this. I'll just follow Nazir's lead.
string: こういうこととなると苦労するのよ。分かった、ナジルの指示に従うわ

original: I was hoping you'd say that.
string: それを言ってくれたらって思ってた

original: Babette, my girl - pack your things. We're moving.
string: バベットよ、荷物をまとめるんだ。行くぞ

original: Hmph. All right, then. Go. Go, my Listener. Find out what that slimy bastard Motierre has to say, then send the Emperor to Sithis.
string: ふむ。いいだろう。行くぞ、行こうぞ、聞こえし者よ。あの卑怯なモティエールが何とほざくか聞いてから、皇帝をシシスのもとへ送ろうではないか

original: Ah, but when you're done, there's no use returning here, is there? I was thinking... the Dawnstar Sanctuary. We could make a proper home there.
string: だが仕事が終わっても、ここに戻って来る必要はない。そうだろう？　考えていたんだが…　ドーンスターの聖域を我々の家にするというのはどうだろう

original: Listen, when you're finished with this Emperor business, meet Babette and me there. I'll find some way to move the Night Mother. Don't worry. Now go!
string: いいか、皇帝の件が片付いたら、私とバベットとそこで落ち合おう。夜母を動かす方法は考えておくから、心配無用だ。それでは、行くぞ！

original: And come back with a barrel full of gold, hmm?
string: それと、ゴールドをたんまり持って帰ってきてくれよ、な？

original: Our Family lives on, Nazir. You have to trust me.
string: ナジル、一党はまだ滅びていない。自分に任せてくれ

original: Amaund Motierre? But that would mean...
string: アマウンド・モティエール？　だがそれは…

original: I must speak with Amaund Motierre once more.
string: もう一度アマウンド・モティエールと話さねばならない

original: What? Well - what did she say?
string: 何だって？　それは…　彼女は何と言った？

original: Not exactly. The Night Mother has spoken to me again.
string: 少し違う。夜母が再び話して来た

original: By Sithis, what a mess. I guess this is the end.
string: シシスにかけて、ひどい有り様だ。これで終わりのようだな

original: You just worry about fulfilling the contract. I'll take care of things on this end.
string: 任務の遂行だけに集中してくれ。こっちの事は私が面倒を見る

original: Who are you?
string: お前は誰だ？

original: Derkeethus, from Darkwater Crossing.
string: デルキーサスだ。ダークウォーター・クロッシングから来た

original: Should have known better than to swim all the way to the falls.
string: 滝まで延々と泳いでくるなんて、我ながら馬鹿な真似をしたものだ

original: Please, get me out of here!
string: 頼む、ここから連れ出してくれ！

original: Laelette! She's dead!
string: ラレッテ！　死んでる！

original: Ysmir's beard! She's...she's a vampire!
string: イスミールの髭にかけて！　か、彼女は…　吸血鬼だ！

original: Die rebel!
string: 反逆者に死を！

original: Send Ulfric my regards!
string: ウルフリックによろしくな！

original: You call yourself a warrior?
string: それで戦士のつもりか？

original: For the Emperor!
string: 皇帝のために！

original: For the glory of the Empire!
string: 帝国の栄光のために！

original: Die dog!
string: イヌめ、死ね！

original: A pox on the Empire!
string: 帝国に呪いあれ！

original: I'll water the ground with your blood.
string: お前の血で大地を濡らしてやる

original: For the sons of Skyrim!
string: スカイリムの民のために！

original: Talos smite you!
string: タロスの罰をくらえ！

original: We're almost through!
string: あと少しだ！

original: They're at the gate!
string: 門のところにいる！

original: We're through! Keep at them!
string: 抜けた！　この調子だ！

original: They're in! Don't let them gain further ground!
string: 奴らが入った！　これ以上進ませるな！

original: Keep it together! There's not many of us left!
string: しっかりしろ！　残った者は多くない！

original: This is hopeless! Retreat!
string: お手上げだ！　撤退する！

original: Yeaaaah! Come on, we can take them!
string: いいぞ！　これなら勝てる！

original: Here they come!
string: 来た！

original: That's it! We're pushing them back!
string: この調子だ！　押しているぞ！

original: Fall back, fall back! Regroup and fall back!
string: 下がれ、下がるんだ！　集合して後退！

original: We've got them pinned in! It's only a matter of time now. Keep fighting!
string: 押さえ込んだ！　あとは時間の問題だ。手を緩めるな！

original: This is it! Hold at all costs! Don't give them any more ground!
string: 正念場だ！　全力で阻止しろ！　これ以上進ませるな！

original: Someone take out that mage!
string: 誰かあの魔術師を倒せ！

original: Someone put an arrow in that damn wizard!
string: あのいまいましいウィザードを矢で狙え！

original: Take out their archers!
string: 敵の射手を倒せ！

original: Archers!
string: 射手だ！

original: Over by that bridge!
string: あの橋のところだ！

original: Along the fence, do you see them?
string: 柵沿いだ。見えるか？

original: They got archers over there by the fence!
string: あっちに射手がいる。柵のそばだ！

original: Wizard! Hiding over there by that fence!
string: ウィザードだ！　あっちの柵の近くに隠れてる！

original: They're over there, next to that house!
string: 向こうだ！　あの家の横！

original: By that rock over there. See 'em?
string: あの岩の近くだ。見えるか？

original: They're hiding over by those stables!
string: 向こうの馬屋のそばに隠れてる！

original: Up in that tower! Quick!
string: 塔の中だ！　早く！

original: Archer in that tower!
string: 塔の中に射手が！

original: Mage up there! In the tower!
string: 魔術師は上だ！　塔の中！

original: Over by the tree!
string: あっちの木のそばだ！

original: They're up on that wall.
string: 奴らは壁の上だ

original: They got archers up along the wall!
string: 壁沿いに射手がいる！

original: Look! Up on the wall. A wizard!
string: 見ろ！　壁の上にウィザードが！

original: Look sharp. There they are. In the window!
string: 気をつけろ。奴らは窓の辺りにいる！

original: Archers. Behind those windows!
string: 射手だ。窓の向こう側！

original: They've got a mage hiding in that window up there!
string: あの窓のところに魔術師が隠れてる！

original: Alva is a vampire!
string: アルバは吸血鬼だ！

original: So you were right. Go tell the Jarl. Hurry!
string: じゃあ、お前の言うことは正しかったわけだな。首長に伝えろ。早く！

original: Now, I am afraid I must leave you. We will continue to watch over you, and guide you as best we can.
string: 悪いがここでお別れだ。引き続き、導き役として最大限の力を尽くそう

original: It is within you to succeed. Never forget that.
string: 上手くいくかは自分次第だ。それを忘れるな

original: What happens now?
string: これからどうするんだ？

original: Where can I find this Augur?
string: 予言者はどこに行けば見つけられる？

original: I... I am unsure. He is somewhere within the College. Surely one of your colleagues must know his location.
string: さあ…　確かな事は分からない。大学内のどこかにいるはずだ。お前の仲間の誰かが居場所を知っているはずだ

original: I am sorry I cannot provide you with further help, but this conversation requires a great deal of effort on my part.
string: すまないが、それ以上の事は教えられない。こうして話をしただけでも多大な労力を費やしたんだ

original: Who is the Augur of Dunlain?
string: ダンレインの予言者とは何者だ？

original: He was once a student here at the College. Now he is... something different.
string: かつてはこの大学の学徒だったんだ。今は…　どうも変わってしまった

original: Why should I trust you or your Order?
string: なぜお前を、その会を信用しなきゃならない？

original: I presume you refer to Ancano's distaste for the Psijic Order?
string: アンカノがサイジック会を嫌っている事が気になるのか？

original: The Thalmor see our Order as a threat because we have power, and we will not allow them to control us.
string: サルモールは我が会を脅威と見なしている。我々が力を持っているからだ。こちらとしても、連中に従うつもりはない

original: I assure you that we mean you no harm.
string: だからといって、決してお前に危害を加えるつもりはない

original: I fear I have already overstepped the bounds of my Order, but I will offer this: seek out the Augur of Dunlain here in your College.
string: 既に会の一員としての一線を踏み越えてしまっているかも知れない。だが、頼みがある。この大学内でダンレインの予言者を探し出してほしい

original: His perception may be more coherent than ours.
string: 彼の見識は、我々のものに近いだろう

original: I'll help, but I don't know what to do.
string: 手を貸そう。しかし、何をすればいい？

original: Unfortunately, the future is as obscured to us as it is to you. The overwhelming power of the Eye makes it difficult for us to see.
string: 残念ながら、お前と同様に我々にも未来ははっきりと見えていない。あの目が持つ強大な力のせいだ

original: What do you expect from me, then?
string: それで、何をしてほしいと？

original: We believe the your efforts should be directed towards dealing with the aftermath, but we cannot predict what that will be.
string: お前には事後の収拾に力を注いでもらわねばならないと考えている。だが、何が起こるかは想像もつかない

original: So what exactly is the problem?
string: それで、一体何が問題なんだ？

original: As you may have learned, this object... The Eye... is immensely powerful.
string: すでに分かっているとは思うが、あの目は…　強大な力を持っている

original: This world is not ready for it. If it remains here, it will be misused.
string: この世界はアレを使いこなす準備ができていない。ここに置いておけば、悪用されるだろう

original: Indeed, many in the Order believe it has already... Rather, something will happen soon, something that cannot be avoided.
string: 事実、会の多くの者は既に…　いや、まもなく何かが起きると考えている。避ける事のできない何かが

original: You must understand, the Psijic Order does not typically... intervene directly in events.
string: サイジック会は通常…　問題には直接介入しない。それは理解してほしい

original: My presence here will be seen as an affront to some within the Order, and as soon as we have finished, I will be leaving your College.
string: 自分がここにいる事を、会の一部の者は反逆行為とみなすだろう。そのため、成すべき事を終えたら、すぐに大学を離れるつもりだ

original: I'm all too aware that my arrival has aroused suspicion, especially in Ancano, your Thalmor associate.
string: ここに来た事で疑念を生んでしまった事は十分承知している。特にお前のサルモールの仲間、アンカノにとっては

original: Nevertheless, my Order will not act directly. You must take it upon yourself to do so.
string: それでも、会が直接行動を取る事はない。つまり、お前が何とかしなければならないという事だ

original: What does this have to do with me?
string: それが自分とどんな関係が？

original: You set this chain of events in motion at Saarthal.
string: お前がサールザルでこの一連の問題を引き起こしたのだ

original: If this is dangerous, then why don't you do something about it?
string: 危険だというなら、何か手を打ったらどうだ？

original: I'm afraid it's not that simple.
string: ところが話はそう簡単じゃない

original: What did you do?
string: 何をした？

original: I've given us a chance to speak privately, but I'm afraid I can't do this for long. We must be brief.
string: ようやく内密に話せる機会を得られたな。しかし、あまり長くは話せない。手短かに済まそう

original: The situation here at your College is of dire importance, and attempts to contact you as we have previously have failed.
string: 大学は現在、非常に切迫した状態にある。お前に接触を試みようとしていたのだが、これまではそれが叶わずにいた

original: I believe it is due to the very source of our concern. This object... The Eye of Magnus as your people have taken to calling it.
string: その原因は、我々が抱えている問題の根源でもある。いわゆる…　“マグナスの目”と呼ばれている物だ

original: The energy coming from it has prevented us from reaching you with the visions you have already seen.
string: アレから放出されているエネルギーは、我々がお前に接触を図る障害となっていた。お前が既に見たあの幻のせいだ

original: The longer it remains here, the more dangerous the situation becomes. And so I have come here personally to tell you it must be dealt with.
string: アレがここに長く留まるほど、それだけ状況は危険になっていく。だからこそ、何か手を打たなければならないと自ら伝えに来たんだ

original: What do you want with me?
string: 何が望みだ？

original: I merely wish to talk to you.
string: 単に話をしてみたかっただけだ

original: Please do not be alarmed. I mean you no harm.
string: どうか警戒しないでほしい。危害を加える気は一切ない

original: Aren't you just an advisor here?
string: ここでは単なる顧問じゃないのか？

original: Technically, that is true. But I still report to the Aldmeri Dominion, and I cannot ignore this situation.
string: 名目上はそうなるな。だが私もアルドメリ自治領に報告を行う立場にある。この状況を見過ごすわけにはいかないのだ

original: Don't worry, you can return to your petty squabbles and meaningless 'research' as soon as this matter is resolved.
string: 心配しなくてもいい、この一件が片付いたら、くだらん仕事と意味のない研究に戻ってくれてかまわん

original: Why are you so concerned about this?
string: なぜこの件にそれほどの興味を？

original: I'll be the one asking the questions.
string: 質問をしているのは私だ

original: All you need to know is that the Psijic Order is a rogue organization, believing themselves to be above the law.
string: 奴らサイジック会のことは、自らの事を法律を超越した存在だと考えている、無法の集団とでも思ってくれればいい

original: They have clashed with the Aldmeri Dominion before, and I have no intention of allowing that to happen here.
string: 過去にはアルドメリ自治領と衝突した事もある。ここでそんな事を起こさせるつもりはない

original: Paarthurnax is dead.
string: パーサーナックスは死んだ

original: This is how you repay our trust? Paarthurnax's trust?
string: これが我らの、パーサーナックスの信頼に対するお前の報い方だというのか？

original: His noble spirit... the wisdom of ages... his deep understanding of our existence... all gone, and for what?
string: 彼の偉大なる心…　時代の英知…　我らが存在への深き理解…　それらは何のために消えた？

original: A mindless vendetta urged on you by a cabal of Akaviri barbarians!
string: アカヴィリの蛮族に唆された、意味のない復讐のためとは！

original: Begone, before even my philosophy is tested beyond the breaking point. We are men of peace, and you are not.
string: 我が哲学による忍耐が限界を超える前に、立ち去れ。我らは平和を信ずる者。お前は違う

original: My oath binds me, Dragonborn. Until Paarthurnax is dead, you aren't welcome here.
string: 誓いを破るわけにはいかないの、ドラゴンボーン。パーサーナックスが死ぬまで、あなたをここに招き入れるわけにはいかないわ

original: Do the right thing. Paarthurnax deserves to die.
string: やるべきことをして。パーサーナックスは死んで当然よ

original: We have nothing to talk about until Paarthurnax is dead.
string: パーサーナックスが死ぬまで、私達から言うことはないわ

original: You shouldn't be here, unless you've decided to bring Paarthurnax to justice.
string: パーサーナックスを裁くと決断しない限り、お前はここにいてはいけない

original: What further business do you have with us?
string: 我らに他の用があるのか？

original: You have made your choice, Dragonborn. You are not welcome here.
string: お前が選択したのだ、ドラゴンボーンよ。お前はここでは歓迎されん

original: Speak, and then begone.
string: 話せ、そして去れ

original: Don't worry, I'm not going to kill Paarthurnax.
string: 心配するな。パーサーナックスを殺したりはしない

original: Kynareth has placed the Voice of wisdom within you, Dragonborn. All you need do is learn to listen to it, and your path will be clear.
string: キナレスはお前の内に英知の声を授けたようだ、ドラゴンボーンよ。お前がその声を聞きさえすれば、お前の道は開けよう

original: I haven't decided what to do yet.
string: 本当に殺すべきか決めかねている

original: You're learning, Dragonborn. Doing nothing can be the wisest choice, although strangely often the most difficult.
string: お前も学んでいるようだな、ドラゴンボーンよ。時には何もしない事が最善の選択であり、不思議と最も難しい事でもあるのだ

original: I trust that you will make the right choice, in the end. Listen to the Voice that Kynareth has placed within you, and your path will be clear.
string: お前が最後に正しい選択をするのだと信じよう。キナレスより与えられた声を聞いていれば、お前の道は開けよう

original: He still needs to pay for his crimes.
string: 彼は罪を償わねばならない

original: The same could be said for any of us, could it not? Are you so guiltless as to stand in judgment upon Paarthurnax?
string: ならばそれはこの場の誰でも同じだろう？　お前はパーサーナックスを裁けるほど罪なき者なのか？

original: Listen to your inner Voice before acting. Do not allow the Blades to bully you into doing something you will later regret.
string: 行動より先に、己の内なる声を聞け。のちに後悔するような事を、ブレイズに無理やりさせられぬようにせよ

original: After all, repentance is something you deny to Paarthurnax by meting out your so-called justice.
string: パーサーナックスは後悔もできなかったのだから。お前が正義とやらを実行したおかげでな

original: I need the Elder Scroll the ancients used. Do you know where to find it?
string: 古代に用いられた星霜の書が必要だ。どこで見つかるか分かるか？

original: We have never concerned ourselves with the Scrolls. The gods themselves would rightly fear to tamper with such things.
string: 我々がその書を気にした事はない。当の神々でさえそれに手を加える事には恐れを覚えるのだ

original: As for where to find it... such blasphemies have always been the stock in trade of the mages of Winterhold.
string: 見つけられそうな場所となれば…　そのような書は、ウィンターホールドの魔術師達がいつも商売道具として持っている類のもの

original: They may be able to tell you something about the Elder Scroll you seek.
string: 彼らであれば星霜の書について何か教えられるかもしれん

original: No, but he told me how to find out.
string: いや、彼は探し方を教えてくれた

original: So be it. If he believes it is necessary for you to learn this... we will bow to his wisdom.
string: それも良かろう。もしお前が学ぶ事が必要だと彼が信じるならば…　我々も彼の判断に従おう

original: I talked to Paarthurnax.
string: パーサーナックスと話した

original: So... you spoke to Paarthurnax. The dragonblood burns bright within you.
string: そうか…　パーサーナックスと話したのだな。竜の血脈がお前の中で眩しく燃えているぞ

original: Did he tell you what you wanted to know? Did he teach you the Dragonrend Shout?
string: お前の知りたかった事について何か答えてくれたか？　ドラゴンレンド・シャウトについては教えて貰えたか？

original: Is it true what they said? Was he Alduin's ally?
string: それは本当なのか？ 彼がアルドゥインの味方だったと？

original: The Blades want me to kill Paarthurnax.
string: ブレイズはパーサーナックスを殺させたいようだ

original: Now you see why I've warned you against them! Bloodthirsty barbarians!
string: だからあの連中に気をつけろと言ったのだ！　あの血に飢えた蛮族共め！

original: The Blades said that Paarthurnax used to be Alduin's ally.
string: ブレイズの話では、パーサーナックスはかつてアルドゥインの仲間だったらしい

original: Speak, if you have aught to say worth the listening.
string: 聞く価値のある話ならば言うがいい

original: By the gods... you! But it can't be. You're dead. You... Yeaaaahhhh!
string: まさか…　お前か！　しかし、そんなはずはない。死んだはずだ。お前は…　うおおおおお！

original: You know, I like it here. We should have moved to Dawnstar ages ago.
string: 分かるでしょ、この場所が好きなの。本当はもっとずっと昔にドーンスターに移り住むべきだった

original: I can't wait to see what the future brings.
string: これから何が起こるか、楽しみで待ちきれないわ

original: I'll follow you till I'm dust in the breeze. You do realize that?
string: 風に舞うほこりになるまでついて行くよ。分かるかな？

original: This place is already starting to feel like home. Must be all the bloodstains.
string: ここは早くも家のようになっている。血痕があちこちにあるせいか

original: Is there anything more revolting than spiders? Too many legs...
string: クモほど気味の悪いものが他にあるか？　あんなに脚がいっぱいあって…

original: What? How did you get this far?
string: 何？　どうやってここに？

original: What? No! Get back in your cage!
string: なに！？　ダメだ！　檻に戻れ！

original: Give me just a moment, and I'll have this open.
string: 少し待っていてくれ、すぐに開けるから

original: I know! I know! Just shut up and let me look, okay?
string: 分かってる！　分かってる！　もう黙って確認させてくれ、いいか？

original: You'd better find that chest that fell off the boat or Gulum-Ei will have your hide!
string: 船から落ちた箱を探した方がいいわ。でないとガラム・エイからひどい目に遭わされるわよ！

original: Petra? She's already dead.
string: ペトラ？ 彼女はもう死んでるよ

original: What? That flower-chewer's died? Then let me out. My tower!
string: 何だって？　あの花噛み女が死んだって？　ならここから出してよ！　塔が！

original: Press only middle button! Clever trick, yes? Nobody ever thinks of the middle.
string: 真ん中のボタンだけを押すんだ！　いい考えだろ？　誰も真ん中なんて思わないしね

original: Yes, kind morsel. Let us go up, and mind Melka on the way.
string: ああ、親切な獲物さ。それじゃ上に行って、途中でメルカの世話をしなきゃね

original: What will you do now?
string: これからどうするんだ？

original: Live in my tower, roost in my home. Mix pretty poisons and collect shiny eyeballs, yes.
string: またあの塔に住んで、家で寝て。綺麗な毒を調合して、ピカピカの目玉を集めてとかさ、うん

original: You... must not see many Orcs around here.
string: ここらではオークは珍しいんだろうな

original: Why would I release you?
string: なんでお前を自由にしなきゃいけないんだ？

original: Because you are such a very nice Orc?
string: あんたがとても親切なオークだから…　とか？

original: What? I'm no Breton.
string: ん？ ブレトンなんかじゃないぞ！

original: Oh. Yes. You all look the same.
string: ああ、そうだね。お前達はみんな同じに見えるよ

original: Hey, I'm not a Breton!
string: ブレトンじゃない！

original: What do I get if I free you?
string: 自由にしたら何かくれるのか？

original: Ah, I have a pretty staff. Help me find Petra, wring her neck, pluck her eyes. Take my prize staff, I just want my tower back!
string: ああ、いい杖を持ってるんだ。ペトラの首を捩じ切って目をえぐり出すのを手伝っておくれ。杖はやるからさ。あの塔が戻ればいいんだ！

original: Why would I release you?
string: なんでお前を自由にしなきゃいけないんだ？

original: Because, because you are such a nice Breton, yes!
string: それはほら、あんたがとっても親切なブレトンだからさ、そうだろ！

original: What are you doing here?
string: ここで何をしてるんだ？

original: Petra! Evil Petra put me here, stole my tower. Hate her, chew her bones! Let me out, kind, kind meat.
string: ペトラだよ！　ペトラに塔を取られて閉じ込められたんだ。まったく骨を噛んでやりたいよ！　ここから出してよ、そこの親切なお馬鹿さん

original: We go up, yes? Always up.
string: 上に行くんだろう？　いつも上さ

original: Such a kind nibble you are.
string: 親切な獲物だね、あんたは

original: You, meat! Come, come.
string: お前か！　こっちだよ

original: Don't leave poor Melka to die.
string: メルカを見捨てないでおくれ

original: Petra! Petra! Curse her eyes!
string: ペトラ、ペトラ！　忌々しい目だ！

original: Do you like my pretty tower?
string: どうだい、この塔は？

original: What, seriously? Come on, I thought that was funny!
string: 何、本気か？　何だよ、笑えると思ったのに！

original: Oh my... that's the worst one yet. How about we stop talking and keep our eyes open like Gulum-Ei said?
string: こいつは…　最悪だな。おしゃべりはやめて、ガラム・エイが言うように用心しとこうじゃないか

original: He didn't want to hit the bar like the rest! Ha ha ha!
string: 奴は他の連中のようには一杯やりたくないとさ。ハハハ！

original: Locked. Damn! One of the hags nearby will have the key. You'll have to take it from here. I'll keep watch here - unless you can pick the lock.
string: 鍵がかかってる！　近くにいるハグレイヴンの1人が鍵を持ってるはず。後は任せたわ。私はここで警戒してる。あなたが鍵開けをできれば別だけど

original: What now?
string: 次はどうする？

original: Hagraven up ahead. Pull the lever when you're ready and we'll take her.
string: ハグレイヴンはこの先よ。用意できたらレバーを引いて。彼女を連れて行きましょう

original: What now?
string: 次はどうする？

original: He's a half-decent farmer. Ask him to teach you to farm!
string: 彼はかなりまともな農民よ。農作業のやり方を教えてもらうといいわ！

original: But mama...
string: でもママ…

original: I don't want to hear another word about what you're learning from the elf! It's high time you learned to be a Nord, too!
string: あなたがエルフから何を教わってるかなんて、もう一言だって聞きたくないの！　ノルドとは何かを学ぶべきよ！

original: And Meieran thinks that we should go there.
string: でメイエランは行くべきだと思ってるの

original: I think I like the lake here just a little more.
string: この湖が少し好きになった気がするよ

original: To see the fires!
string: 炎を見に！

original: I've been in Skyrim my whole life. Why would I want to leave?
string: 生まれてこの方、ずっとスカイリムにいるんだ。ここを離れたいなんて考えると思うか？

original: Do you ever want to go to Morrowind, Sondas?
string: モロウウィンドに行きたいと思ったことある？　ソンダス

original: I'll have to take your word on that one, my dear.
string: この件に関しては、その言葉を信用しなければならないな

original: That it was black and gross and nobody wanted to live there anymore.
string: 黒くて、気持ち悪くて、誰も住みたくないようなところだって

original: Oh? What about it?
string: うん？　何の事だ？

original: Sondas, I've heard about Morrowind.
string: ソンダス、モロウウィンドのことを聞いたわ

original: Thanks! I'm out!
string: ありがとう！　出られたよ！

original: Be careful... we're certain to find more of the awakened within.
string: 気をつけろよ…　目覚めた者がまだ中にいるはずだ

original: It's just up here.
string: このちょうど上だ

original: I've spent the last few decades living in regret and seeking redemption from Mara. And by Her Benevolence, I will right my wrongs.
string: この数十年、後悔の念に苛まれながら、マーラからの贖罪を求めて過ごしてきた。マーラの博愛の力によって、今こそ自らの過ちを正す時だ

original: I knew it! You're a liar!
string: やはりな！ この嘘つきめ！

original: And what would you have me say? Sorry for following the misguided teachings of a mad Divine? Sorry for stealing memories from children?
string: 何を言わせたいんだ？　イカれた神の誤った教えに従ってすまないとでも？　それとも、記憶を盗んだ子供達への謝罪か？

original: Do you realize when the orcs attacked, I was only concerned with myself? I fled... and left my brothers and sisters behind to die.
string: オークに襲われた時、自分の身の安全しか考えなかった事は分かるだろう？　ひとりで逃げ出したんだ。他の兄弟達を見殺しにしてな

original: You should have told me the truth.
string: 本当の事を話すべきだった

original: Yes, you're right. I should have, but I didn't know what to say.
string: 確かにその通りだ。話すべきだったが、何と説明すべきか分からなかったんだ

original: When the orcs raided the temple, I fled. I left my brothers and sisters behind to die.
string: 聖堂がオークに襲われた時、自分は逃げ出したんだ。他の兄弟達を見殺しにしてな

original: Behold the Skull of Corruption, the source of Dawnstar's woes.
string: ドーンスターの災いの源、堕落のドクロにおののくがいい

original: We must reach the inner sanctum and destroy it. Come, there's no time to lose.
string: 最奥聖域に向かい、アレを破壊しなければならない。行くぞ、時間がない

original: Now I can show you the source of the nightmares. Over here.
string: 悪夢の根源を見せてやろう。こっちだ

original: I'll send word to the strongholds to let you in as one of our own.
string: お前を一族の一員として迎え入れるよう、要塞に知らせよう

original: Give him a chance to speak. He's trying to help us.
string: しゃべらせてやれ。手を貸してくれるらしい

original: It's out of my hands.
string: こちらの手に余るな

original: Then go back to your boss and tell him what I've already told him so many times, I lose count.
string: それならボスのところに戻って、これまで何度となく繰り返し言ったように、返す気はないと伝えて

original: His request is denied... I'm not paying him any more gold. This madness has to end.
string: 彼の要求は受けつけない。1ゴールドだって払うもんですか。こんな馬鹿げた事は終わりにしなきゃ

original: I think you know what it is.
string: 意味は分かっているはずだな

original: You're gouging me for what little coin I make and you can't even protect yourselves? Ridiculous!
string: 俺が稼いだゴールドをむしっていながら、自分らの身さえ守れないだって？　ばかばかしい！

original: Then you'll pay in more than just coin. (Brawl)
string: ならば、金貨以上のものを支払わせてやる(殴り合い)

original: Ha! We'll see about that!
string: あはは！　それはどうでしょうね！

original: Are you ready to pay Brynjolf what you owe?
string: ブリニョルフから借りた金を返してもらおうか？

original: No, and I never will. Now get out of my inn!
string: 返す気なんかないわ。さあここから出てって

original: I have a delivery from Bothela.
string: ボテラから届け物がある

original: Oh... yes... um... thank you. Here you go. Some gold for your assistance and your, discretion.
string: おお、それはそれは…　手助けと思慮に感謝する。さあ、謝礼を受け取ってくれ

original: I don't have time right now.
string: 今は忙しいんだ

original: Pity.
string: 残念だね

original: I'll make sure he gets it.
string: 確かに届けよう

original: Thank you.
string: ありがとう

original: The "Hag's Cure." That's a unique name.
string: “ハグズキュア”か。変わった名前だね

original: Comes with living to a ripe old age, people start thinking there's something magical about you. Then, the insults.
string: ここまで長生きすると、周りの人間は魔女か何かじゃないのかと考え出すんだ。冗談じゃないよ

original: Still, a little knowledge of plants and potions can get you by. Not that anyone likes to admit buying things from you.
string: まあ、植物や薬の知識があれば、それなりに長生きできるもんさ。でも、あんたから買う気はないよ

original: See? I even have a little potion for the Steward. Mind handing it over to him? Just say it should solve that problem he has.
string: いいかい。ここに執政のための薬もあるから、彼に届けておくれ。これで症状がよくなるはずだと伝えるんだよ

original: We will now see how you learn a completely new Shout.
string: それではまったく新しいシャウトを学べるか、見てみよう

original: I see that you have already begun to learn the Whirlwind Sprint Shout.
string: どうやら、もう旋風の疾走のシャウトを覚え始めたようだな

original: Master Borri will teach you "Wuld," which means "Whirlwind."
string: ボッリ師が“旋風”を意味する“ウルド”を教えてくれる

original: Master Borri will teach you "Nah" - "Fury" - the second word of Whirlwind Sprint.
string: ボッリ師が旋風の疾走の2つ目の言葉、“怒り”を意味する“ナア”を教えてくれる

original: Master Borri will teach you "Kest" - "Tempest"- the third word of Whirlwind Sprint.
string: ボッリ師が旋風の疾走の3つ目の言葉、“嵐”を意味する“ケスト”を教えてくれる

original: Master Wulfgar will now gift you with his knowledge of "Dah."
string: ウルフガー師が“ダー”の力を授けてくれよう

original: With all three words together, this Shout is much more powerful. Use it wisely.
string: 3つの言葉すべてを合わせて、シャウトはさらに強くなった。慎重に使うように

original: You are ready to learn the final word of Unrelenting Force, "Dah," which means "Push."
string: 揺るぎ無き力の最後の言葉を覚える時が来た。“ダー”、“押す”という意味だ

original: You worry too much, brother. Victory will be ours.
string: 心配しすぎだ、同志よ。勝てるさ

original: The battle below goes ill. If Alduin does not rise to our challenge, I fear all may be lost.
string: 下の戦況は不利だ。アルドゥインが動かなければすべてが無駄になるかも知れん

original: What else is there?
string: 残りはどこだ？

original: Have you no thought beyond the blooding of your blade?
string: その刃を血で染める他、何か策はないのか？

original: Hakon! A glorious day, is it not!
string: ハコン！　素晴らしい日だとは思わないか！

original: This library used to be filled with arcane volumes. Now look at it; almost everything's been burned.
string: この図書館にはかつて、難解な書物があふれていた。それが今やどうだ、ほとんどが焼き払われてしまった

original: I hope the tome we need is still intact.
string: 探している書物がまだ無事だといいのだが

original: For Skyrim!
string: スカイリムのために！

original: Daar sul thur se Alduin vokrii. Today Alduin's lordship will be restored.
string: ダー、スル、スール、セ、アルドゥイン、ヴォクリー。アルドゥインの支配が今日復活する

original: But I honor your courage. Krif voth ahkrin. Die now, in vain.
string: しかしその勇気は讃えよう。クリフ、ヴォス、アークリン。虚しく死んでゆけ

original: You're probably right.
string: たぶんその通りね

original: I wouldn't worry about that. He's a good elf. I trust him.
string: それについては心配していない。奴はいいエルフだ。信用している

original: I'm just worried about what he's teaching her.
string: 彼が何を教えているのか心配なの

original: She hardly mentions anything else.
string: 彼女は他の事をめったに口にしない

original: Sondas, does Hrefna ever mention Meieran to you?
string: ソンダス、今までレフナからメイエランの話を聞いた事は？

original: Well, I'll try to be a good influence, then.
string: ああ、それなら、なるべくいい影響を与えられるようにするよ

original: Well, I know she thinks the world of you.
string: 彼女はあなたが好きなようね

original: Oh, it's no trouble. She's a smart little girl. Might talk your ear off, but she's fun.
string: ああ、別に厄介じゃない。あの子は賢いからね。一方的にしゃべるかも知れないが、楽しい子さ

original: Thanks for looking after Hrefna.
string: レフナの世話をしてくれてありがとう

original: You should. I miss you.
string: あなたがいなくて寂しいわ

original: I guess I should join you more often.
string: あんたともっと一緒にやりたいな

original: Not when there's so much to see!
string: 見るべきものがたくさんある時は別よ！

original: Ever think about spending more time around town?
string: もっと町で時間を過ごしたいと思った事はないか？

original: No need to get snippy.
string: 怒ることないでしょう

original: So you can be helpful sometimes.
string: たまには役に立てるってわけだ

original: It's at the south end near that loose rockpile.
string: 南の端よ、あの岩が積み重なっている所のそば

original: Sweetheart, did you move my pickaxe?
string: なあ、俺のつるはしを動かしたか？

original: I still do. I just like to have food waiting for me when I come home.
string: 今もそうだ。家に帰ってくるとすぐに飯が出てくるのがいい

original: You used to love finding new places.
string: 新しい場所を見つけるのが好きだったものね

original: And I found a new deposit of amber. Would have been nice to have some help pulling it out.
string: 琥珀の埋まってる場所を新しく見つけたんだ。掘り出すのを手伝ってくれると助かるよ

original: Verner, you should have come out with me yesterday. I found the most amazing tree growing right out of a cave.
string: ヴェルネル、昨日は一緒に来たらよかったのに。洞窟にとてもすごい木が生えているのを見つけたのよ

original: Come to gawk at the monster?
string: 化け物を見物しにきたのか？

original: I have your silver mold.
string: 銀の金型を持ってきた

original: You've more than proven that the Thieves Guild is back on its feet in our city and earned every bit of your reward.
string: これで盗賊ギルドがこの街に戻ってきたいい宣伝になったはずだ。それに、報酬も全部渡そう

original: Tell Delvin that he can count on me to provide the influence around here with the right people when he needs it.
string: デルビンには、この辺りで適切な人材を動かしてほしかったら、いつでも力になると伝えてくれ

original: If you're ever looking to sell any illegally obtained merchandise, I'd also provide my services as a fence. It's the least I can do.
string: 不法に入手した物品を売りたいなら、こちらで買い取ってやる事もできる。そのくらいはお安いご用だ

original: No time to lose then.
string: なら、すぐに取り掛かろう

original: Yes, indeed. The only thing I can tell you is that the mold was taken to the bandit's hideout... a small cottage called Pinewatch.
string: ああ、そうしてくれ。今言えるのは、金型は山賊の隠れ家に運ばれたらしいって事だけだ…　パインウォッチという村がそれだ

original: I'm not sure how many men they have inside, but I trust that won't be an issue for you. Good luck.
string: そこに何人いるかは分からないが、あんたにとっては問題じゃないだろう。頼んだぞ

original: Send a thief to steal back what was stolen.
string: 盗賊を送り込んで盗まれた物を奪い返すと？

original: Exactly.
string: その通りだ

original: Look, this mold is irreplaceable. I'll pay you well for its return and I can also prove to be quite a valuable ally to the Thieves Guild.
string: この金型は替えがきかないんだ。取り返してくれたら報酬は弾む。それに、自分が盗賊ギルドに役立つことだってできる

original: Why do you need the Guild's help for that?
string: それになぜギルドの助けが必要なんだ？

original: Look, I talked to the Jarl, the Steward, the Housecarl... everyone. They all told me their resources were spread too thin right now.
string: いいかい、首長、執政、私兵など、いろんな方面に話はしたんだ。だが、どこからも今は人手が足りないと言われてしまった

original: Word on the street says that the Thieves Guild is coming back into its own in Markarth so I figured...
string: 街の噂で、盗賊ギルドがマルカルスに戻ってくると知って、それでもしかしたらと…

original: Just start from the beginning.
string: 最初から話してくれ

original: Several months ago I ordered a special silver mold from some artisans in Valenwood by way of a Khajiit Caravan.
string: 数ヶ月前、カジート・キャラバンを介してヴァレンウッドの職人に特別な銀の金型を発注したんだ

original: Well, it never arrived. Later I found out that it was robbed by a group of bandits led by someone named Rigel Strong-Arm.
string: だが、品物は一向に着かなかった。後で分かったんだが、リゲル・ストロング・アームが率いる山賊どもに盗まれたらしい

original: Delvin Mallory sent me.
string: デルビン・マロリーに頼まれて来た

original: Oh thank goodness! I wasn't sure where else to turn...
string: そいつは助かった！　他に頼る相手もいなくて…

original: Remember now? (<BribeCost> gold)
string: これで思い出したか？(<BribeCost> ゴールド)

original: Well, can't say exactly where the mold is, but something does spring to mind.
string: どこに金型があるかはっきりしないが、思い当たる事がある

original: It seems there's this strange button on the wall opposite the fireplace in my house. Always wondered what it was for.
string: 我が家の暖炉とは反対側の壁に、おかしなボタンがあるようなんだ。いつも何だろうと不思議に思っていた

original: Think I'm going to head out now. Take a long vacation from woodcutting, you know? Good luck.
string: これから出かけるんだ。きこりの仕事は当分休みってわけだ。分かるだろ？　幸運を祈る

original: Come on, what are trying to do? Insult me?
string: 一体、何の真似だ？　侮辱する気か？

original: I see. I must have the wrong place.
string: 分かった。場所を間違えたらしい

original: No harm done. Tell this Endon fellow I hope he finds what he's looking for.
string: 悪く思うな。エンドンとやらに探し物が見つかるよう祈ってると伝えてくれ

original: Tell me where it is, or else.
string: どこにあるか言え。さもないと

original: So that's how it's going to be, huh? Fine. Take your best shot!
string: そうくるわけか？　いいだろう、やってみやがれ！

original: I never said it was a silver mold.
string: 銀の金型だなんて一言も口にしてない

original: Well uh, Endon is a silversmith in Markarth, so I just assumed...
string: つまり、エンドンはマルカルスの銀細工師だから、その、てっきり…

original: I'm looking for Endon's mold.
string: エンドンの金型を探している

original: I thought I was clear when I said I didn't know.
string: はっきり知らないと言ったはずだ

original: Let's try again. Where is the silver mold?
string: もう一度聞く。銀の金型はどこにある？

original: Endon's mold? I'm afraid you have the wrong place, my friend. You'll find no silversmiths here.
string: エンドンの金型？　なら、来る場所を間違えてるよ。ここには銀細工師はいない

original: I assure you, I have nothing of value. I'm nothing but a poor woodcutter just trying to make ends meet.
string: いいか、価値のある物は何も持ってやしない。やっとこさ食っていける貧しい木こりにすぎないのさ

original: I don't have time for that.
string: そんな暇はない

original: Very well.
string: 結構ですよ

original: It would be an honor.
string: 光栄なことだ

original: On your way, then.
string: では行け

original: I can't do that right now.
string: 今はできない

original: Disappointing.
string: 残念だ

original: Who are you? Where are you from?
string: 誰だ？ どこから来た？

original: You don't remember me, Hjalti? Two campaigns we served together. You saved my life time and time again.
string: ヒャルティ、俺を覚えていないのか？　作戦で2度、一緒だったろ。何度も命を救われた

original: An old sword? That's a fool's errand.
string: そんな大昔の剣は探しても無駄だろう

original: I cannot go into battle without a sword, Hjalti.
string: ヒャルティ、剣を持たずに戦闘には行けない

original: I'll find your sword.
string: 剣を持ってこよう

original: I long to taste battle again.
string: また戦闘の味を楽しみたくてたまらない

original: You're awfully... mature for your age.
string: その年にしてはずいぶん… ませているな

original: Watch your tongue, stranger. We don't take backtalk in this inn.
string: 言葉に気をつけなよ、よそ者さん。この宿じゃ口答えは認められないよ

original: Then you leave me no choice!
string: ならば、もはや選択の余地はない！

original: Enough of your lies!
string: 嘘はもうたくさんだ！

original: I can't allow you to destroy the Skull, Priest of Mara.
string: ドクロを破壊させはしないぞ、マーラの司祭め

original: No. I... I was scared. I wasn't ready to sleep.
string: 違う。ただ…　怖かった。眠る覚悟がなかったんだ

original: You're a traitor. You left us to die and then ran before the Miasma took you.
string: 裏切り者め。俺達を見殺しにし、ミアズマの影響を受ける前に逃げ出しやがった

original: I no longer use that name. I'm Erandur, Priest of Mara.
string: もうその名前は名乗っていない。今の名はエランドゥル、マーラの司祭だ

original: No thanks to you, Casimir.
string: 礼は言わないぞ、カシミール

original: Veren... Thorek... you're alive!
string: ヴェーレン…　ソレク…　生きていたのか！

original: Wait...
string: 待て…

original: It's time. The Skull must be destroyed.
string: 時が来た。ドクロを破壊しなければ

original: If you'll stand back, I'll perform the ritual granted to me by Lady Mara.
string: 後ろに下がってくれ。聖女マーラから許可を与えられた儀式をこれより執り行う

original: Maybe they were right. Don't destroy the staff.
string: おそらく彼らは正しい。ドクロを破壊すべきではない

original: No! You mustn't listen to them. They speak only lies and deception.
string: ダメだ！　奴らの事を信じてはいけない。嘘とデタラメしか言わない連中だぞ

original: Had we aided them in releasing the Skull, they would use it to wreak havoc across Skyrim. They... they had to die.
string: もしドクロを解放するのに手を貸していたら、奴らはスカイリムを壊滅させる目的で利用していただろう。奴らは…　死ななければならない

original: They were trying to kill us.
string: 彼らに殺されそうになった

original: And had they succeeded, Dawnstar's fate would be sealed. You have a unique way of looking at things, my friend.
string: そうなっていたら、ドーンスターの命運は閉ざされていただろう。なかなか面白い物の見方をするんだな

original: We had no choice.
string: 選択の余地はなかった

original: Yes. You're right. If they needed to die so that Dawnstar could live, then it was worth the price.
string: そう、その通りだ。連中が死ぬ事でドーンスターの人々が生き延びられるのなら、それは見合った代償だろう

original: To feed my power when I come for you in Sovngarde!
string: ソブンガルデで再会した暁には、お前の力をいただくぞ！

original: Nivahriin joorre! What have you done? What twisted Words have you created?! Tahrodiis Paarthurnax! My teeth to his neck!
string: ニヴァーリーン、ジョーレ！　何をした？　何という“言葉”を作り出したのだ！？　ターロディース、パーサーナックス！　首に喰らいついてやる！

original: What does a housecarl do?
string: 私兵は何をするんだ？

original: As my Thane, I'm sworn to your service. I'll guard you, and all you own, with my life.
string: 従士に仕えることを誓う。すべての力と命をもって守ろう

original: The others do not speak. Their Voices are too powerful for you to withstand.
string: 他の者は喋らぬ。彼らの声はお前が耐えられない程強いのだ

original: dunYngvildWizardAttack
string: dunYngvildWizardAttack

original: What? An intruder? Attack, my lovelies!
string: 何？　侵入者か？　かかれ！

original: Ah, another plaything for my collection.
string: ああ、またおもちゃのコレクションが増えるな

original: What's happening? No! Leave me alone!
string: 何事だ？　やめろ！　放っておいてくれ！

original: dunYngvildWizardNormaltoCombat
string: dunYngvildWizardNormaltoCombat

original: Lure it into the trap! I'm counting on you!
string: あの罠に誘い込むんだ！　お前ならできる！

original: Do whatever you're going to do before it kills us all!
string: 皆殺しにされる前に何とかしてくれ！

original: My men are ready. Now it's up to you.
string: 部下の用意は整った。あとはお前次第だ

original: Come, my men stand ready on the great porch.
string: さあ、部下はグレート・ポーチで配置についている

original: Let's do this. Summon this dragon of yours.
string: さあ、やろう。お前のドラゴンを呼び出すのだ

original: Get it into the trap before it kills us all!
string: 全員やられる前に、ワナに追い込むのよ！

original: Let's get this over with.
string: 終わりにしよう

original: This was your crazy idea, huh?
string: お前の馬鹿な考えだろう？

original: You better know what you're doing.
string: 自分が何をしてるか分かっているのか？

original: I don't know how you talked the Jarl into this.
string: 首長をどう説得するつもりなんだ

original: Let's get this over with.
string: 終わりにしよう

original: This is getting ridiculous. If we can't get this open soon, the boss will have our heads.
string: 馬鹿げた状況になってきたな。ここを今すぐ開けられなかったら、俺達の首はボスに落とされるぜ

original: Take cover!
string: 隠れろ！

original: Get back! Get back! We need to trap it, not kill it!
string: 戻れ！　戻れ！　捕まえるだけだ、殺すんじゃない！

original: Fine. I'll set you free if you promise to take me to Skuldafn.
string: 分かった。スクルダフンに連れて行ってくれるなら、解放しよう

original: I've planted the contraband on the Dainty Sload.
string: 密輸品をデインティ・スロードに置いてきた

original: Yes, I know. In fact, by now, Captain Volf should be on his way to the prisons.
string: ああ、知ってる。ヴォルフ船長は今頃、監獄に向かっているはずだ

original: Our contract is complete. Here's a token of my gratitude for your efforts.
string: 仕事は終わった。これはお前の努力に対する感謝の印だ

original: Oh, convey my compliments to Delvin for me. Tell him I'll be happy to reopen whatever doors he needs in Solitude.
string: おっと、デルビンによろしくな。必要なら、ソリチュードでどんな店も喜んで再開すると伝えてくれ

original: Consider it done.
string: 任せてくれ

original: Captain Volf is ashore right now and I want the authorities waiting for him when he gets back.
string: ヴォルフ船長は今、下船している。奴が戻った時、役人が待ち構えていればいい

original: Now get going... I don't want to see your face until the job's done.
string: もう行ってくれ…　仕事が終わるまで顔を見せるなよ

original: What sort of contraband?
string: どんな密輸品だ？

original: You'll need to get your hands on some Balmora Blue from Sabine Nyette down by the docks. She's the first mate on another ship, the Red Wave.
string: 港のサビーヌ・ニエットからバルモラ・ブルーを手に入れてくれ。レッドウェーブという船の一等航海士だ

original: Once you get your hands on it, I want you to plant it in Captain Volf's footlocker. I'll take care of the rest.
string: 手に入れたら、それをヴォルフ船長の手荷物に入れてくれ。あとは俺がやる

original: I assume this is where I enter the picture.
string: そこで、出番な訳だな

original: I need you to help me show him the error of his ways by sneaking on board the Sload and planting some contraband.
string: 奴に過ちを気づかせるため、スロードにこっそり乗船し、密輸品を置いてきてほしい

original: Nothing raises my ire more than having an agreement broken. It's bad for business and it wastes time.
string: 約束を破られるほど、いら立たしい事はない。商売に悪影響を及ぼすし、時間も無駄になる

original: Captain Volf of the Dainty Sload has decided to test my patience on this matter by neglecting to honor a trade agreement we had established.
string: デインティ・スロードのヴォルフ船長は合意済みの貿易協定を無視し、私の忍耐力を試そうとしている

original: Let's just get to work.
string: 仕事にかかろう

original: That's more like it.
string: それがいいだろう

original: That's why he sent me.
string: だから自分が送られて来た

original: Hmph. That remains to be seen.
string: ふん、それはまだ分からないな

original: Delvin Mallory said you have work for me.
string: デルビン・マロリーに仕事があると言われて来た

original: It's about time you got here.
string: やっと来たか

original: I'm not accustomed to dealing with people who are unreliable. That's why I asked Delvin to send me his best.
string: 信用できない者と取引する習慣はない。だからデルビンに最も優秀な者をよこすよう頼んだんだ

original: Everything's been done. Arn should be safe.
string: すべて終わった。アーンは安全だ

original: Arn? Never heard of him.
string: アーンだと？　そんな奴は知らんな

original: I guess that means you're finished. Here's your payment.
string: どうやら仕事を果たしたようだ。報酬を受け取れ

original: Tell Delvin that he has my support and all the weight it carries in Whiterun from now on. I think he'll be quite pleased.
string: デルビンに伝えてくれ。私があいつを支え、これからホワイトランでの事は面倒をみるとな。きっと喜ぶだろう

original: Any information on the prison registry?
string: 牢獄名簿についての情報はあるか？

original: It's a well-known fact that the steward keeps all of the records on Whiterun's prisoners in a large book.
string: ホワイトランの囚人の記録はすべて執政が大きな本に書きつけている。間違いはない

original: My sources tell me you can find that book in a study in his quarters.
string: 情報提供者によると、本は執政の住まいの書斎にあるそうだ

original: Change Arn's entry in the book to anything you want and they'll be forced to let him go after he serves a few weeks.
string: アーンの記録を適当に書き換えておけ。そうすれば数週間の服役の後、アーンを釈放せざるをえなくなる

original: Where's the letter being kept?
string: 手配書はどこに保管されている？

original: I have eyes within Dragonsreach. They tell me that all correspondence from other holds are sent to the Jarl's private chambers.
string: ドラゴンズリーチに情報提供者がいる。その報告によると、他の要塞からの連絡はすべて首長個人の部屋に送られるといっている

original: Sounds easy.
string: 簡単そうだ

original: If it was easy, I would have hired a local thug instead of a professional.
string: 簡単だったらプロではなく、そこらへんのゴロツキを雇っている

original: You see both of these items are kept inside Dragonsreach, and they don't allow visitors inside the Jarl's or the Steward's chambers.
string: いいか、物はふたつともドラゴンズリーチの内部に保管されている。そして外部の人間は首長や執政の部屋には入れん

original: One more thing. If you get caught, I can't afford to be connected to you. Remember that before you do anything stupid.
string: もうひとつ。お前が捕まっても巻き添えにされるわけにはいかん。馬鹿な真似をするまえに思い出せよ

original: Solitude? Then why am I here in Whiterun?
string: ソリチュード？ じゃあ、何故ホワイトランにいるんだ？

original: The city guard in Solitude is seeking Arn for a serious crime. When he fled here, he was arrested for drunken behavior. Can you imagine?
string: ソリチュード市警隊はアーンを重罪で追っている。ここに逃げ込んだはいいが、酔って騒いで逮捕されたんだ。信じられるか？

original: Fortunately, his identity isn't known to the authorities in Whiterun, so there's still a chance to save him.
string: 幸いにも、ホワイトランの当局にはあいつの素性が割れていない。つまり、まだ奴を救うチャンスがある

original: So what's the job?
string: で、仕事は？

original: The job is two-fold. First, steal a letter that was sent from Solitude warning Whiterun's guard to be on the lookout for Arn.
string: 仕事は2段構えだ。まず、ソリチュードからホワイトランの衛兵に送られたアーンに関する手配書を盗むのだ

original: The second is to change Arn's name in the prison registry to his new identity.
string: 次に入所者名簿にあるアーンの名前を別の名前に書き換えるのだ

original: All right. Just point me to the prisons.
string: 分かった。牢獄に案内してくれ

original: Hold a moment. This is more than a simple prison break. I want to have Arn's name stricken from the record books permanently.
string: ちょっと待て。これは単純な脱獄とは違うんだ。アーンの名を記録から永遠に抹消するんだ

original: I'm setting him up with a new identity. It's the only way to throw the guard permanently off his trail.
string: あいつには新しい身分を用意した。衛兵の追求を振り切るにはそれしかない

original: Calm down. Who's Arn?
string: 落ち着け。アーンとは誰だ？

original: A close friend of mine. We fought together on the battlefield for many years until old age got the better of us.
string: 私の親友だ。何年も一緒に戦ってきたのだ、年に勝てなくなるまでな

original: Now it's up to me to save him one more time... this time from the executioner's block in Solitude.
string: あいつの命は再び私にかかっている…　今度はソリチュードの処刑台から救いだすのだ

original: Delvin Mallory sent me.
string: デルビン・マロリーに頼まれて来た

original: You're here! And not a moment too soon. If anything should happen to Arn, there'll be hell to pay.
string: 来たな！　しかも時間どおりだ。アーンの身に何かあったらただではおかん

original: Who are you? Where's Gavros?
string: 誰だ？　ガヴロスはどこだ？

original: What the...
string: それは…

original: I'd almost given up hope. Let me get the door...
string: ほとんど希望を失くしかけていたんだ。さあ、扉を…

original: G...Gavros? Is that you?
string: ガ…　ガヴロス？　お前なのか？

original: I know. That's why I need to find him.
string: ああ。だから彼を探さねばならない

original: Yes, yes. We must think. He must have some means of travelling to and from Sovngarde. But no tale tells where that might be.
string: 分かっている。考えなくてはならない。ソブンガルデまで往復する方法を見つける必要があるのだが、どの話にも記されていないのだ

original: The Jarl's palace in Whiterun? Ah, yes... the old story about King Olaf's pet dragon. Ingenious!
string: ホワイトランの首長の宮殿に？　ほう、なるほど…　オラフ王のかわいがっていたドラゴンについての古い話か。実に巧妙だ！

original: Don't worry. I have a plan. I'm going to trap a dragon in Dragonsreach.
string: 心配するな。計画がある。ドラゴンをドラゴンズリーチで罠にかけよう

original: So if I could lure a dragon into Dragonsreach...
string: では、ドラゴンをドラゴンズリーチへ誘い込めれば…

original: You could trap him there, exactly.
string: 間違いなく、そこに罠をかけられるだろう

original: I thought there weren't any dragons until Alduin came back.
string: アルドゥインが戻るまで、ドラゴンはどこにもいなかったと思うが

original: Oh, this was thousands of years ago, before the Akaviri crusaders cleansed Skyrim of dragons.
string: ああ、これは何千年も前、アカヴィリの聖戦士がスカイリムからドラゴンを駆逐する以前の事だ

original: Skyrim's mountains were still infested with dragons. One of the early Nord kings caught a dragon and kept it in Dragonsreach.
string: スカイリムの山々には、なおもドラゴンが出没していた。初期のノルドの王のひとりはドラゴンを捕まえ、ドラゴンズリーチに閉じ込めたというわけだ

original: What's the Jarl's palace have to do with this?
string: これが首長の宮殿と何の関係がある？

original: Well, you see, the palace - Dragonsreach - was originally built to hold a captive dragon. Hence its name.
string: つまりこの宮殿、ドラゴンズリーチは、もともと捕らえたドラゴンを閉じ込めて置くために建てられたのだ。それが宮殿の名前の由来にもなっている

original: You mean Dragonsreach?
string: ドラゴンズリーチのことか？

original: Yes, exactly! Most people don't know that it was originally built to hold a captive dragon - hence its name.
string: そのとおり！　名前の由来どおり、もともとは捕らえたドラゴンを閉じ込めて置くために建てられた。その事はあまり知られていないがな

original: His dragon allies must know where this portal is...
string: ドラゴンの仲間はこの転移門について知っているはずだ…

original: Very true! Hmm. I wonder... do you know the Jarl's palace in Whiterun?
string: 確かにそうだ！　どうだろう…　ホワイトランの首長の宮殿がどこか知っているか？

original: I defeated Alduin, but he escaped. I need to find him.
string: アルドゥインを追い詰めたが逃げられてしまった。奴を見つけなければ

original: He must have returned to Sovngarde to feed on the souls of the dead.
string: 死者の魂を喰らうため、ソブンガルデへ戻ったに違いない

original: If you don't find him soon, he'll return, stronger than ever!
string: すぐに見つけなければ、奴は、かつてないほど強くなって戻ってきてしまう！

original: I'm still amazed that your plan worked.
string: お前の作戦がうまくいって、よかった

original: You'll be the toast of Whiterun for this!
string: ホワイトランに狙われるぞ！

original: No one can doubt that you truly are Dragonborn.
string: お前は間違いなくドラゴンボーンだ

original: We're ready, Dragonborn. Just say the word.
string: ドラゴンボーン、準備はできた。命令をくれ

original: You're getting pretty good at this dragon-fighting business.
string: ドラゴンとの戦闘に関しては腕を上げつつあるようね

original: I don't know how you talked the Jarl into this plan of yours.
string: どうやって首長を言いくるめて、自分の計画に乗せたのかしらね

original: My job is to keep the Jarl safe, despite his best efforts.
string: 私の仕事は首長を守る事よ。彼がどんなに力を尽くそうとね

original: I can't believe that worked!
string: うまくいくなんて信じられん！

original: Something to tell the grandkids, eh?
string: 孫の代まで語り継げるな

original: I can't believe I'm still alive.
string: まだ生きてるのが不思議だ

original: I have Fjotli's Locket.
string: フョトリのロケットを持ってきた

original: It pains me to see this locket... to be reminded of  Fjotli once more, but I'm glad it's back where it belongs.
string: このロケットを見るのは辛い。またフョトリのことを思い出してしまうからね。だが、これが手元に帰ったのは何よりだ

original: Tell Delvin that if he still desires to have my support for the Thieves Guild in Windhelm, he's got it.
string: デルビンに伝えてくれ。もしまだ盗賊ギルドがウィンドヘルムでこちらの協力を必要としているなら、手を貸すにやぶさかでないと

original: Deal. Where do I begin?
string: 交渉成立だ。どこから始めればいい？

original: The only name I have is Niranye. Has a house right here in Windhelm. That's where you should begin looking.
string: 手がかりはニラナイという名だけだ。ここウィンドヘルムに家を構えている。まずはそこから当たってみるべきだろうな

original: It's something they took from Fjotli, I assume.
string: それは奴らがフョトリから奪った物か？

original: Exactly. One of the pieces stolen from her was a silver locket, a Cruel-Sea family heirloom. I want it back.
string: その通りだ。盗まれた娘の遺品の中には銀ロケットがあった。クルーエル・シー家に代々伝わる家宝でね。それを取り戻したい

original: What exactly do you need me to do then?
string: つまり、何をすればいい？

original: Well, like I told Delvin, I think we can help each other. You recover what I'm looking for and take out a rival Guild in the process.
string: デルビンにも話した通り、我々は助け合えるはずだ。探している物を回収してもらいたい。そのついでに、君は商売敵のギルドを排除すればいい

original: What happened to him?
string: 彼に何が起こった？

original: Let's just say I'm a firm believer in an eye for an eye and leave it at that.
string: 私は“目には目を”の思想を堅く信奉しているとだけ言っておこう

original: He fancied himself a thief in some sort of a new Guild forming around here. Gave me some valuable information before... well, you know.
string: 奴はこの辺りに新しくできかかっている、一種のギルドに所属する盗賊だと公言していた。以前、奴から有益な情報をもらったこともある…　まあ、分かると思うが

original: I assure you it wasn't anyone from the Guild.
string: これはギルドの者の仕業ではない

original: No need to explain, I'm well aware of your Guild's methods.
string: 言うまでもない。あんたらギルドのやり口とは違うからな

original: It took me weeks, but I finally tracked down the killer. A bloody Altmer at that. Can you imagine?
string: 何週間もかかったが、ついに犯人を突きとめた。あのアルトマーだよ。想像できるかね？

original: Delvin Mallory said you had a job for me.
string: 頼みたい仕事があるとデルビン・マロリーから聞いた

original: My daughter Fjotli... she was murdered a few months ago. Left her laying on the ground in a pool of her own blood.
string: 娘のフョトリが…　数ヶ月前に殺されてしまったんだ。娘は自分の血の海に横たわっていたよ

original: I assume they were after her valuables... she always wore far too much jewelry in public. When I told her it'd be the death of her, I never thought...
string: 物盗りの犯行だと思う。娘はいつも宝石類をじゃらじゃら身に着けていた。今に危ない目に遭うぞと叱ってやったが、まさかこんな事になるとは…

original: Tread lightly in the Hall. We don't know what's in there.
string: 広間にはこっそり踏み込むぞ。何があるか分からないんだから

original: Arkay keeps the cycle. He watches us in life and death.
string: アーケイが輪廻を維持している。生も死もすべてを見ているんだ

original: Arkay will guard our eternal rest. His servants shall protect the dead from harm.
string: 永遠の眠りはアーケイによって守られる。彼のしもべが死者に危害が及ばないようにしてくれるのさ

original: Protect us, Arkay, from the foul and unclean who seek to disturb the dead's rest.
string: アーケイよ、死者の眠りを妨げる卑怯で汚い奴らから、どうか守りたまえ

original: Let us sleep, sweet Arkay, by your side. Let no harm come to us.
string: 愛するアーケイよ、どうかお側で眠らせたまえ。あらゆる災難を遠ざけたまえ

original: I feel the hunger inside of you. Gnawing at you. You see the dead and your mouth grows wet. Your stomach growls.
string: あなたの中の飢餓を感じます。苛む飢餓。死人を見ると唾を飲み込んでしまう。

original: Not many would walk blindly into a crypt, smelling of steel and blood, but not fear.
string: 墓地を彷徨って鉄と血の臭いを嗅ぎ、しかし恐怖を覚えない者はまれです

original: You've returned. What happened in the Hall of the Dead?
string: 戻ったか。死者の間で何があったんだ？

original: Find out what's happening in the Hall of the Dead. Arkay will watch over you.
string: 死者の間で何が起こってるのか探ってみよう。きっと、アーケイが見守ってくれる

original: If it's about the Hall of the Dead, no, you can't go in there.
string: 死者の間の事なら、中には入れないぞ

original: I will be waiting at Reachcliff.
string: リーチクリフ洞窟で待っています

original: Say hello to Verulus for me.
string: ヴェルラスによろしく伝えて下さい

original: Namira covets your ugliness.
string: ナミラは、あなたの醜さを待ち望んでいます

original: Blessed are the forgotten. The wretched.
string: 祝福されるのは忘れ去られた者達。哀れな者たち

original: The dead exist to feed the living.
string: 死者は生者を満たすためにあるのです

original: Don't worry, the Eight are watching over us. I hope.
string: 心配するな。八大神が見守ってくれるさ。たぶん

original: Careful here, there's a trick to this. Trick is to not bleed to death. Ah, and there's a lever, too.
string: ここは気をつけなよ。コツがあるんだ。死ぬほどの血は流さなきゃいいんだ。ああ、そこにレバーもある

original: Who enters? Will nobody save poor Melka?
string: 誰？　誰もメルカを助けてくれないのかい？

original: All right, you've swayed me. So what can I do?
string: いいだろう、気が変わった。何をすればいい？

original: Look, I... I...
string: じ、自分は…

original: You're right. You're right. Feller might be nutters, might not. But fact is, he needs help. I turn him away, what kind of man am I, hmm?
string: その通りだな。フェラーが変わり者だろうが何だろうが、助けを必要としている。それを無下にしていいはずがあろうか！

original: Look, um... Thanks. And I'm sorry for my unneighborly reaction. If you talk to Cicero, you be sure and tell him I'll be down to help soon.
string: さて…　礼を言わせてくれ。これまでの態度は謝罪しよう。シセロに会ったら、すぐに行くと伝えてくれ

original: You know you should help him. (Persuade)
string: 助けるべきだと分かっているはずだ(説得)

original: Look out! The prisoners are loose!
string: 気をつけて！　囚人が逃亡したわ！

original: Dovahkiin. You have tasted the Voice of the Greybeards, and passed through unscathed. High Hrothgar is open to you.
string: ドヴァーキンよ。グレイビアードの声を試し、無傷で通った。ハイ・フロスガーはお前のために門を開こう

original: Thank you.
string: ありがとう

original: There's no need to thank me. What you did was for the people of Dawnstar.
string: 礼など言う必要はない。お前のおかげでドーンスターの人々が救われたんだ

original: If anyone should be thanked, it should be you.
string: 感謝されるべき者がいるとすれば、それはお前自身だよ

original: I'd constructed a meager shrine to Mara in the antechamber where we entered.
string: 我々が入ってきた控えの間に、マーラを祀る小さな祠を建てたんだ

original: My intention was to spend the rest of my years here, burying the past and praying for forgiveness.
string: 余生をずっとここで過ごし、過去を葬り去り、許しを求めて祈り続けるつもりだった

original: But instead, I wish to offer my services to you. If you ever wish to journey with me, I'll be here.
string: しかし今は、お前の力になりたいと願っている。もし共に旅をしたいと思うなら、いつでも来てほしい

original: How about some compensation?
string: 謝礼はどうなる？

original: Being a humble servant of Mara, I have little in the way of gold or coin, but perhaps I can offer you something better... companionship.
string: マーラの忠実なるしもべとして、金貨の類はあまり持ち合わせていない。しかし、もっと素晴らしいものを提供できるかも知れない…　仲間になる事だ

original: So we're done, then?
string: これで終わりか？

original: Yes. The Skull has been destroyed and Dawnstar is safe.
string: ああ。ドクロは破壊した。これでドーンスターは安全だ

original: Are you going to be all right?
string: 大丈夫そうか？

original: In time, I believe I will.
string: 時が経てばおそらくは

original: Forgive me if I don't appear relieved... this temple has taken its toll on me.
string: 辛い表情に見えたら許してほしい…　この聖堂のせいなんだ

original: First, an incantation to remove the barrier.
string: まずは、この障壁を取り除く呪文を唱える

original: Come. You, too. We can escape through the tunnels.
string: 来い。お前もだ。穴を通って脱出できる

original: Fine. Let's go.
string: 分かった、行こう

original: I assume everyone's gone ahead of us as planned. I just swept through the castle, no one's here.
string: 予定どおり、全員が先に行ったのよ。ざっと城を見てきたけれど、誰もいなかったわ

original: Now. We really must be going, sir.
string: さあ、もう行きましょう

original: And my children?
string: 子供達は？

original: As soon as we can muster our forces, we'll be back.
string: 兵が集まりしだい、戻って来るといいわ

original: That's the battle you need to fight. Not this. This will be suicide. And to what end?
string: それがあなたの戦い。これは違うわ。こんなの、ただの自殺行為よ。どうにもならないわ

original: Not without a fight it isn't!
string: 戦わずしてそれはない！

original: It's time to leave.
string: そろそろ行かなければ

original: What are you doing here?
string: ここで何をしてるんだ？

original: I am on official business of the Grand Council of the Synod. That's all you need to know.
string: サイノッドの大議会の公務に携わっている。それ以上の事は言えない

original: I might well ask the same of you, running around by yourself in this dangerous place.
string: 同じ質問を返そう。こんな危ない場所をひとりでうろつき、一体何をしてる？

original: What's this about a crystal?
string: クリスタルについて聞きたい

original: It didn't work the first time. I tried to tell Gavros, but he wouldn't listen. "No, it won't be too cold" he said.
string: 最初は思い通りにいかなかった。ガヴロスにも言おうとしたが、聞く耳持たずだ。“いや、そんなに寒くなるわけがない”とか言ってたな

original: Well, I was right, wasn't I? Focused completely wrong by the time we got here! The cold had warped it!
string: だが、正しいのはこっちだったろ？　ここにたどり着くまでは、見当違いの所に焦点を当てていた。寒さで歪んじまったんだ！

original: Gavros had to cart it all the way back to Cyrodiil. Left the rest of us here to fend off the damnable Falmer.
string: ガヴロスはシロディールまでそいつを持ち帰らなきゃならなかった。残された俺達は、あの忌々しいファルメルをどうにかしなきゃならない

original: I came here looking for the Synod.
string: サイノッドを探しにここへ来た

original: And just why would you be doing that?
string: 何だってそんなことを？

original: Oh, it doesn't matter now. Gavros is never coming back, and he was supposed to have the crystal. Without that, we're lost.
string: ああ、そんなことは今はどうでもいい。ガヴロスは戻ってこない。クリスタルを持ってたのはあいつだ。あれがなきゃどうにもならない

original: It's all been for nothing.
string: 全部水の泡だ

original: So congratulations, whoever you are, you've found the Synod. Just me, alone, surrounded by angry machines and angrier Falmer.
string: あんたが誰かは知らないが、よかったな。あんたはサイノッドを見つけたんだ。俺だけが、怒った機械とさらに怒ったファルメルに取り囲まれるってわけだ

original: Your friend Gavros is dead.
string: お友達のガヴロスは死んだ

original: It was the Falmer, wasn't it? Curse them! They've ruined everything!
string: ファルメルの仕業だな？　呪われちまえ！　奴らのせいで何もかもメチャクチャだ！

original: If Gavros is gone, there's no hope. He was supposed to return with the crystal... Without that, all our efforts are wasted.
string: ガヴロスが死んだなら、もう望みはない。クリスタルを持って帰ってくるはずだったんだからな…　あれがなきゃ、今までの努力は全部無駄だ

original: And you. If you're here for treasure, or wisdom, or anything, I'm afraid you've wasted your time.
string: それにあんたもだ。宝やら知恵やらを狙って来たんなら、悪いが時間の無駄さ

original: Who are you?
string: お前は誰だ？

original: What are you doing here? What've you done with Gavros?
string: ここで何をしてる？　ガヴロスはどうした？

original: They were trying to perform some sort of experiment, I think.
string: 彼らは何らかの実験をしようとしていたようだ

original: I can't imagine what that might be, but if it's safe, you might see if they were successful.
string: どんなものだったのか想像もつきませんが、安全な事だとすれば、成功したかどうかを見に行ってはどうでしょうか

original: You could get some useful information about whatever they were up to. Sounds like it won't be of use to them now, anyway.
string: そこから目的を推測する手がかりがつかめるかも知れません。どのみち彼らにはもう用はなさそうですし

original: I found notes about a crystal, and the Oculory in Mzulft.
string: ムズルフトのオキュロリーで、クリスタルに関するメモを見つけた

original: Hmm. I can't say I've any idea what they were up to. Have you found this observatory?
string: うーん。何に使う物だったのでしょうか、ちょっとすぐには見当がつきませんね。観測所とやらは見つけましたか？

original: You might be able to learn something from it. Keep looking, but be careful.
string: そこから何か分かるかも知れません。調査を続けて下さい、気をつけて

original: I found the Synod in Mzulft. They're dead.
string: ムズルフトでサイノッドを見つけた。全員死んでいたよ

original: Really?
string: 本気か？

original: Well, I do recall warning them it might not be the safest of locations. I hope this doesn't become a problem for us.
string: ああ、そういえば彼らに、そこは必ずしも安全な場所とはいえないと注意しておいたのですよね。厄介な事態にならなければいいんですが

original: Were you able to learn anything?
string: 何か分かった事はありますか？

original: I've been away from Solitude for as long as I can. But if you decide to finish these bandits off, you'll be rewarded for your efforts.
string: もう長い事、ソリチュードには戻っていない。だが、もし山賊を始末してくれるなら、しかるべき報酬を与えようじゃないか

original: Looks like Deeja won't be bothering us again.
string: これで二度とディージャに手を焼かされることもない

original: Good riddance.
string: いい厄介払いができた

original: I'll take care of it.
string: 俺に任せておけ

original: Deeja will need to be locked up.
string: ディージャは閉じ込めておくべきだ

original: I dealt with the rest of the bandits.
string: 残りの無法者は片付けた

original: It's appreciated. The captains around here will have one less thing to worry about. Here's your reward.
string: ありがたいな。このあたりの隊長達の心配の種が減った。これが報酬だ

original: First you murder my sister, then you massacre my men!
string: まず我が姉妹を殺し、次に部下を虐殺したのか！

original: You've betrayed me, murdered my sister and massacred my men!
string: 裏切ったのか…　我が姉妹を、部下を皆殺しにしたのか！

original: Let's take them out.
string: では、片付けよう

original: With pleasure.
string: 喜んで

original: Just you?
string: 1人か？

original: We're stretched thin in Solitude, and I don't expect these bandits to be much challenge. Are you ready?
string: ソリチュードでは他にも色々あるんだ。奴らは大した敵じゃないだろう。準備はいいか？

original: Who are you?
string: お前は誰だ？

original: I'm Captain Aldis. I'm here to help you take down these bandits.
string: アルディスだ。あの山賊達を始末する手助けに来た

original: Who are you?
string: お前は誰だ？

original: You're the one Mazzaka described to me.
string: マッザカが話していたのはお前だな

original: My brother told me you were coming. I'm supposed to give you what you've earned.
string: あなたが来るって兄弟が教えてくれたわ。あなたに報酬を渡さなきゃね

original: You are exactly what I was looking for.
string: ずっとお前さんを探していたよ

original: Probably got drunk and fell into the lake. Who cares.
string: 酔っ払って湖に落ちたんだろう。かまうもんか

original: Have you seen Refnir? I told him to check out the well drain, but he never reported back.
string: レフニールを見たか？　排水の状態を調べに行かせたんだが、報告がないんだ

original: Sure. Then you wake up in the morning with your purse empty and your gear stolen. No thanks.
string: ああ。それで朝目覚めたら財布は空で、持ち物はすべて盗まれてるってわけか。ゴメンだね

original: Did you get a look at that thief that they sent to break into the place? What I wouldn't give for a night with her.
string: 盗賊を見たか？　あそこに押し入るために送られた奴らだ。彼女と一晩を過ごせるならなんだってくれてやるのに

original: Aringoth said as soon as the deed goes through, we're done here. Then we'll head south and look for more work. Deal?
string: アリンゴスは、権利書がすんなり行き次第、ここでの用は済むと言ってた。そしたら仕事を探しに南に向かう。いいか？

original: Agh... so bored! Only one fight in the last few weeks? This is gonna' drive me crazy.
string: ああ…　退屈だ！　数週間で戦闘はたったの一度。おかしくなりそうだ

original: No idea. Maybe he got tired of getting stung by these damn bees.
string: さあな。忌々しい蜂に刺されるのが嫌になったんだろうよ

original: So why did he sell this place? I mean look at it. This is how to live.
string: じゃあ、なんでここを売ったんだ。見てみろ。これこそが生活ってもんじゃないか

original: You're telling me. Playing nursemaid to a bunch of bees and drinking mead all day beats dying on some battlefield.
string: 百も承知だ。ミツバチの世話をして、日がな一日ハチミツ酒をくらっていれば戦場で死ぬ事なんて忘れるさ

original: I can't believe how lucky we got landing this job. It's a far cry from working for the Stormcloaks.
string: この仕事につけるとは何て幸運なんだ！　ストームクロークでの仕事とは雲泥の差だ

original: If they do, we'll send them crying back to their boss again.
string: 奴らがその気だってんなら、またボスのところに泣き帰る羽目にしてやる

original: Keep your eyes open, they'll try to hit us again... I just know it.
string: 油断するな、奴らはまた襲ってくるはずだ…　そうに決まってる

original: What makes you think I won't? (Persuade)
string: そう思う根拠は何だ？(説得)

original: Fine. Take it!
string: いいだろう。持っていけ！

original: Once the new owner finds out I gave in, I'm as good as dead anyway.
string: 言いなりになった事を新たな持ち主に知られたら、どのみち死んだも同然だ

original: I don't believe you. That's not your way.
string: 無駄だ。そんなのお前のやり方じゃない

original: I just want the key to your safe.
string: 金庫の鍵を渡してほしい

original: I can't. If I do, I may as well cut my own throat.
string: それはできない。自分で自分の首をかき切るようなものだ

original: Worthless mercenaries.
string: 使えない傭兵どもめ

original: I didn't think Maven or Mercer would allow me to get away with this, but I had little choice.
string: メイビンやメルセルが許してくれるとは思っていなかったが、選択の余地はなかったんだ

original: Why not level the entire estate?
string: なぜ農園全体を破壊しないんだ？

original: I'll give you one good reason. Maven Black-Briar.
string: 一つ納得できる理由をやろう。メイビン・ブラック・ブライアだよ

original: Burn all the hives and she'd have to import honey for Black-Briar Meadery which would cut into her profits.
string: 巣をすべて燃やせば、ブラック・ブライアのハチミツ酒醸造所で使うハチミツを他で手に入れなければならなくなり、利益が減る事になるんだ

original: No idea.
string: 分からない

original: Blast. Well, I'll check my sources and speak to Mercer.
string: そう都合よくはいかねえな。じゃあ俺の情報源に当たって、メルセルと話してみよう

original: But for now, you're off to speak to Maven Black-Briar. She asked for you by name.
string: だが今のお前の仕事は、メイビン・ブラック・ブライアと話しに行く事だ。彼女直々のご指名だぞ

original: So, what did you think about the deed?
string: 取引についてはどう思う？

original: Aringoth sold Goldenglow? What's that idiot thinking?
string: アリンゴスがゴールデングロウを売っただと？　あの馬鹿め、何を考えている？

original: He has no idea the extent of Maven's fury when she's been cut out of a deal, but I'm certain he'll find out.
string: 取引から外されたと知った時のメイビンの怒りがどれほどのものになるか、奴には分からんのだろうな。まあ、近い内に知る事になるだろうが

original: If only this parchment had the buyer's name instead of this odd symbol. Any idea what that might be?
string: この羊皮紙に書かれているのが、変な記号じゃなくて買主の名前だったならいいんだが。この記号の意味は分かるか？

original: Yeah. Right.
string: うん、そうなの

original: Nice try, blossom, but I'm not a knight, I'm a mercenary. The answer's still no. Besides, your mother would miss you too much.
string: 惜しかったな。だが自分は騎士ではない、単なる傭兵だ。答えはNO。それに、お前の母親がとても淋しがる

original: Every knight needs a squire. I could help you with your sword, things like that.
string: 騎士には必ず従者が必要よ。剣のこととか、力になれると思うわ

original: When I go away, I go to war. That's no place for a little girl.
string: 俺が出て行く時は、戦争に行く時だ。若い娘の出る幕じゃない

original: Papa, the next time you go away, I want to come with you.
string: パパ、次に出かけるときは、私も一緒に連れて行って

original: Not now, Braith.
string: ブレイス、今はだめよ！

original: But...
string: でも…

original: Not now, Braith.
string: ブレイス、今はだめよ！

original: Mother? Can I talk to you?
string: お母さん？　今話せる？

original: Not now, Braith. Go... go ask your father.
string: ブレイス、今はだめ…　お父さんに聞いてきなさい

original: I wanted to ask you something. It's about a boy...
string: ちょっとお願いがあって。ある男の子のことなんだけど…

original: What?
string: 何？

original: Mother?
string: お母さん？

original: Listen, Braith... Why don't you talk to your mother about this, okay? There's a good girl.
string: いいかブレイス…　母と話してみたらどうだ？　そう、いい娘だ

original: I wish your mother were still alive. She could answer you much better. Let me think on it and we'll talk later.
string: お前の母が生きていればなあ。きっとうまく答えてくれただろうに。少し考えさせてくれ。また後で話そう

original: Well, there's this boy, and...
string: ええと、この男の子がいてね、それで…

original: Hmm? What about?
string: ん？　何の事だ？

original: Papa, I want to talk to you...
string: パパ、お話があるの…

original: Hmph. Damn you for being right.
string: ふむ。クソ、お前の言うとおりだ

original: Old man, without me, you would have withered away a long time ago.
string: なあ、あんたは俺がいなけりゃとっくの昔に萎びてたぞ

original: My mistake. A manservant wouldn't let me starve or freeze. I let you live here, and now I'm two steps closer to the grave.
string: いや違うな。召使いなら私にひもじい思いも寒い思いもさせない。お前をここに住まわせたおかげで、私は墓場に2歩近づいた

original: Oho! Manservant? Is that what I am now?
string: おお！　従者？　それが今の俺？

original: Well if my layabout manservant fed me more, that wouldn't be a problem.
string: うちのものぐさな召使いがもっと飯を作ってくれたら問題はないんだがな

original: That's just you getting skinnier every day, old man. You're losing your padding. You need to eat more.
string: 日に日に痩せ細ってきてるのはそっちじゃないか。もっと食べないと

original: There's a chill in the air. Ysmir's beard, it gets colder in here every day.
string: 空気が冷える。イスミールの髭にかけて、日に日に寒くなっていくな

original: Hmm. So I haven't. All right, I'll buy the ingredients tomorrow and we can have it for dinner.
string: いや、ないな。よし、明日材料を買ってこよう。それを夕食にするんだ

original: Mutton.
string: 羊肉だ

original: Which, the mutton or the vegetable?
string: 羊肉？　それとも野菜？

original: You ain't made me that stew in a long time.
string: 長い事このシチューを作ってくれなかったな

original: Then you're on.
string: ではやるぞ

original: Probably.
string: たぶんな

original: You going to lose horribly, and then say you let me win?
string: こっぴどく負けておいて、勝ちを譲ったというのか？

original: Fancy a game of Iron Hearts later?
string: 後で“鉄の心臓”ゲームをやらないか？

original: Don't talk about my father like that, Jon. And the answer's still no.
string: 父さんのことをそんなふうに言わないで、ジョン。それに、答えは変わらないわ

original: But tomorrow. Definitely.
string: でも明日には。約束する

original: Don't say that out loud. Not here. And the answer's still no.
string: こんな所で、そんな大きな声を出さないで。答えは変わらないわ

original: But tomorrow. Definitely.
string: でも明日には。約束する

original: That's your imagination running wild. Nobody knows how we feel about each other.
string: それは想像をちょっとたくましくしすぎだ。俺達がお互いをどう思ってるかなんて誰も知らないさ

original: I can't. Not tonight. I need to go home. I swear, my father is starting to suspect something.
string: 無理よ。今夜はダメ。家に帰らないと。父さんが疑い始めてるの

original: I can't. Not tonight. I need to go home. I swear, my family is starting to suspect something.
string: 無理よ。今夜はダメ。家に帰らないと。家族が疑い始めてるの

original: I want to see you when you're done working.
string: 仕事が終わったら会いたい

original: Harlot.
string: 遊女め

original: Tsk. You've uncovered my master plan. Now I suppose you'll never leave.
string: あら、計画がバレてしまったようね。もう、ここから出す訳にいかないわ

original: You mean you won't forget about me the moment I'm out of sight? Get yourself a nice old rich husband, have sixteen babies?
string: 俺の姿が見えなくなると、すぐに忘れるわけじゃないってことか？　優しくて金持ちの旦那を捕まえたり、16人の赤ちゃんを産んだり？

original: Oh Jon, stop dallying. You know you have to go. It's why Mara put you on this earth.
string: もうジョン、ふざけるのはやめて。もういく時間でしょ？　そのためにマーラはあなたを地上に遣わしたのよ

original: You think a few miles can truly keep us apart?
string: ほんの少し離れるだけなのに、もう会えなくなると思っているの？

original: No, not yet. But I will. I just haven't... gotten around to it yet.
string: いや、まだだ。でもこれからやるさ。ちょっと…　そんな暇がなかったんだ

original: So have you spoken to that man from the Bards College?
string: 吟遊詩人の大学から来たっていう男の人とは話したの？

original: It's all true, I swear it. You can hear it when it's done. I'll just need a year or two smooth the rough edges.
string: 全部本当のことだ。仕上がったら聞かせてあげるよ。ただ、でこぼこな感じをなくして滑らかに流れるようにするため、一、二年必要なんだ

original: A ballad? Oh, now I know you're joking with me.
string: バラード？　分かった、からかっているんでしょ？

original: Well, that's where I started. But it turned into something of a ballad.
string: それが開始地点だったのさ。しかし、バラードに姿を変えたんだ

original: Why Jon Battle-Born. You're writing me a song? Does it somehow involve blood, or beheadings, or the honor of my forebears?
string: まあ、ジョン・バトル・ボーン。私のために曲を？　血だとか首を切るとか、祖先を称えるとかって内容の？

original: So I'm, uh... writing a song for you...
string: だから、その…　お前に歌を書いてるんだ…

original: That's what I thought. Now get out of my way, baby. I got things to do.
string: 思ったとおりね。そこをどいて。やらなきゃならないことがあるの

original: Well, no... I... I mean...
string: ええと、いや…　つまりその…

original: Oh no? So you're gonna fight back if I punch you? Huh? You're gonna hit a girl?
string: あらいやなの？　じゃあもし私が殴ったら、やり返すのね？　ふーん？　女の子を叩くのね？

original: You... You're wrong! You can't hurt me anymore...
string: ち…　違う！　もうやられないぞ…

original: Don't make me laugh, baby Battle-Born. You'll be afraid of me till the day I kill you.
string: 笑わせないで、“バトル・ボーン”の赤ちゃん。私に殺されるまでずっとビクビク過ごすことになるわよ

original: Braith. I.... I've come to tell you that I'm not afraid of you anymore.
string: ブレイス。僕…　もう君なんか怖くないって言いにきたんだ

original: Ten septims tomorrow, baby Battle-Born. Or I'm gonna bloody your nose and your lip.
string: 明日なら10ゴールドよ、バトル・ボーンさん。でないと鼻と口から血が出ることになるわよ

original: No! Please! I really don't have any money, Braith! I'll give you ten septims tomorrow. Just don't hit me.
string: やめて！　お願い！　本当に持ってないんだよ、ブレイス！　明日10ゴールド渡すから。叩かないで

original: You'd better give me five septims, right now, or I'm going to bloody your nose...
string: 今すぐ5ゴールドちょうだい。じゃないと鼻血を出すことになるわよ…

original: I... I don't have any money.
string: え、お金持ってないよ

original: Battle-Born! Give me your money!
string: バトル・ボーン！　お金を渡しなさい！

original: Just go away!
string: あっちへ行って！

original: What are you gonna do if I don't? Huh? Gonna cry to your papa?
string: なら何をするつもり？　え？　パパに泣きつくの？

original: Leave me alone, Braith...
string: 放っておいてよ、ブレイス…

original: Oh look, it's little baby Battle-Born.
string: ほら見て、小さい“バトル・ボーン”の赤ちゃんよ

original: If it'll put your mind at ease, then I agree. But not now, all right? We need the business from the stand.
string: それで気分が落ち着くなら、構わない。でも、今じゃなくていいか？　商売をしなきゃならないからな

original: Might be worth riding out to Solitude, see if a messenger ship's come in.
string: ソリチュードまで行く価値はあるんじゃないかな。使いの船が入港したかどうか確かめてみよう

original: Don't worry, brother. I'm sure he's fine. We've waited longer before receiving a letter.
string: 心配無用だ。彼なら大丈夫。手紙を受け取るまで長いこと待ったんだ

original: It's been two months, and no word from father.
string: 2ヶ月も経つのに、父さんからはなんの連絡もない

original: Good. I'll do the same. We've still got plenty of shafts from that Riverwood shipment.
string: よし。同じようにやってみよう。リバーウッドの積み荷から手に入れた矢はまだたっぷりある

original: All right. I'll fletch some more when I get the time.
string: 分かった。時間がある時にもっと作っておこう

original: Our stock of arrows is running a bit low.
string: 残りの矢がちょっとばかり少なくなってきた

original: At least the Nords don't shirk their responsibilities.
string: 少なくともノルドは責任逃れをしたりしない

original: Congratulations, brother. You've been living in Skyrim so long, you've become a Nord.
string: おめでとう。お前は長いことスカイリムで暮らしてきた。お前はノルドになるんだよ

original: Nonsense. That's just an excuse for you to avoid working, and "commune with the greenwood like our fathers of old" and blah blah.
string: バカげている。そんなの働かないで“祖先達のように緑林と心を通わせる”とか何とかって事の口実にすぎない

original: Why not? Business has been terrible. Most folk would rather hunt their own meat than buy ours.
string: どうして？　景気はどん底のままだ。肉を買うくらいなら狩りに出る方がいいと思ってる奴はたくさんいる

original: Three weeks? You're mad! You can't keep the stand closed for that long!
string: 3週間？　気は確かか！　そんなに長い間、露店を閉めておけないよ

original: That was three days. I'm thinking more like three weeks.
string: 3日だ。3週間にも思えたけどな

original: Again? You just had an "extended hunt" last month. To the Pine Forest, wasn't it.
string: またか？　先月も“狩り遠征”をしたばかりじゃないか。確かパイン・フォレストだったよな

original: I've been thinking of hunting out beyond the boundaries of Whiterun hold.
string: ホワイトラン要塞の境界線の向こうに狩りに出ようかと思ってるんだ

original: Lookin' forward to it.
string: 楽しみにしている

original: Excellent. I'll send the proper letters, then, and have some fresh horses delivered straightaway.
string: そいつは結構だ。それじゃあ、すぐに手紙を送って、新しい馬を何頭か届けさせよう

original: Aye, mum. That we will. Mares, stallions, donkeys - I don't think it matters. Pretty sure I can sell any steeds we get.
string: 分かった、母さん。そうするよ。雌馬に種馬にロバ…　それはどうでもいいんじゃないかな。手に入れた馬ならどんな馬でも売れると思う

original: Why thank you for that most colorful assessment, Skulvar.
string: 本当に色々な意見をありがとう、スカルヴァー

original: So we'll be needing fresh horses, then?
string: じゃあ、新しい馬が必要になるんだね

original: Aye, that it has. Trust me, mum - once you've killed a man from a horse, you'll never want to fight on the ground again. Ain't no goin' back.
string: ああ、持ってるよ。なあ、信じてくれ母さん。いったん馬に乗って人を殺したら、二度と地面で戦いたいとは思わなくなる。戻れなくなるんだ

original: Indeed.
string: そのようだ

original: I do hate to admit it, but if nothing else, all the fighting lately has been a complete blessing to this business.
string: 悪い気はするけど、ここ最近の戦争のおかげでだいぶ儲かっているよ

original: Ha! Four more geldings sold. Sound like good news to you?
string: ハハ！　また4頭、去勢馬が売れたぞ。良い話だろ？

original: Everyone is this city is so on edge. I could use some good news, Skulvar.
string: この街の誰もがイラついている。何かいいニュースはないかい、スカルヴァー？

original: You've got the heart of Mara herself, you know that? Thank you, Carlotta. Thank you.
string: マラの心を持っているのだな。ありがとう、カルロッタ。ありがとう

original: Look, come back tomorrow, okay? If I have anything left that's not sold or spoiled, you can have it.
string: それじゃ、明日またいらっしゃい。いいわね？　もし売れ残りがあればあげるから

original: No, no! Don't do that. No need to do that. I'm going. See? I'm leaving. No guards, please.
