string: 衛兵がその女から聞き出せた情報はただ、奇妙な実験の話と日記に走り書きをするアロンディルのことだけだった

original: Do you know anything about Arondil?
string: アロンディルについて何か知っていることは？

original: Only rumors. He used to have a home in Dawnstar until they burned it down.
string: 噂だけなら。かつてはドーンスターに家があったらしい。あいにくその家は全焼したそうだが

original: The people say he was doing unspeakable experiments on reanimation... rituals only a necromancer would perform.
string: どうやら、口にするのも恐ろしい蘇りの…　儀式の実験をしていたらしい。死霊術師しか行わないようなやつをな

original: After he made for Yngvild, he was never heard from again.
string: ユングビルドに移った後、消息を絶ったんだ

original: I think you're in luck.
string: 幸運なようだな

original: I can't believe it. You have them already?
string: 信じられない。すでに持っていたのか？

original: Here, take this. This should cover your end of the work nicely.
string: ほら、受け取ってくれ。これで十分、君の働きに値するだろう

original: It's a good start, but you need all four of the volumes or the set isn't complete.
string: これは幸先がいい。しかし、4巻全部を揃えなければ。そうしないと一式完成しないからな

original: Why don't you head back out to Yngvild and find the rest?
string: ユングビルドに戻って、残りを探しに行ったらどうだ？

original: I'm not into books.
string: 本は苦手なんだが

original: Yeah, but you're into gold. Let me know if you change your mind. I'm not going anywhere.
string: ああ、でもゴールドには興味があるだろう。気が変わったら言ってくれ。ここにいるから

original: I'll get them for you.
string: 手に入れてこよう

original: Then we have a deal.
string: 取引成立だな

original: In his later years, Andoril moved into some ice caves known as Yngvild. He prefered the solitude in which to perform his, um... experiments.
string: 晩年、アンドリルはユングビルドとかいう氷の洞窟に移り住んだ。独りを好み、そこでその…　実験をしていたんだ

original: What kind of books are they?
string: どんな種類の本だ？

original: I'm told they're the ravings of a madman... a wizard named Arondil and his peculiar cravings.
string: イカれた男のたわごとだとか言ってたな…　アロンディルという名のウィザードとそいつの奇妙な渇望だそうだ

original: It's said to be spread across four volumes and very hard to come by. My client is offering quite a reward for them, which I'd split with you.
string: 全部で4巻あり、非常に手に入れにくいものらしい。客は結構な報酬を出すと言っているから、山分けするぞ

original: Anything you need done around here?
string: 何かこの辺りで仕事はないか？

original: Now that you mention it, there is.
string: そう言われたらある

original: I have a buyer with, shall we say, a very odd taste in literature looking for some particular books.
string: 客がいるんだが、何というか、文学にかなり妙な嗜好を持っててね。ちょっと変わった本を探しているんだ

original: Yes, and just like weeds, they're nothin' but trouble.
string: そうだ、雑草と同じでろくでもない

original: Those little girls of yours are growing like weeds, Lemkil.
string: お前のかわいい子供達は雑草のように成長してるな、レムキル

original: True enough, but there's nothing wrong with a little adventure now and then. Not much excitement in working the soil every day.
string: そのとおりだけど、時々ちょっとした冒険をするくらい悪くはないだろ。毎日土いじりで、たいした楽しみはないんだ

original: Ah, there's nothing like fresh air and honest labor to bolster the spirit.
string: ああ、新鮮な空気とまっとうな労働ほど、魂の洗濯になるものはないな

original: So far, things are going well. Let's just hope the weather holds.
string: 今のところ順調よ。天気が続きますように

original: Are you making good progress with the planting?
string: 種まきはうまく進んでいるか？

original: I'm trying something new, offering discounts for bulk purchases. So far, that seems to be working.
string: ものは試しで、まとめ買いをする客には値引きすることにしたんだ。これまでのところ、成果は上々だ

original: I hear your crops sold well at the market. Well done, Ennis.
string: 収穫物が市場でたくさん売れたらしいな。でかしたぞ、エニス

original: We don't need your charity, Breton. If my girls deserve something nice, it'll be their father who buys it.
string: お前の施しは受けないぞ、ブレトン。娘達にすてきな何かを贈る時は、父親が買ってやるものさ

original: Good day, Lemkil. I saw some nice dresses for your little girls while I was in Whiterun. I'd be happy to purchase them, if you like.
string: こんにちは、レムキル。ホワイトランでお嬢さんに似合いそうな素敵な服を見たよ。良かったら、買って来よう

original: Thanks for the offer, Jouane, but I'm saving up for a new sword.
string: 申し出をありがとう、ジュアン。でも新しい剣のために貯金してるんだ

original: Anything I can pick up for you on my next trip into the city, Erik?
string: エリック、次に街へ行く時に買ってほしいものがあったら言ってくれ

original: How thoughtful! I'll come take a look after supper.
string: まあ、気が利くわね！　夕食後に見に来るわ

original: I picked up a set of fine silver brushes in the city, Reldith. I thought you might be interested.
string: レルディス、街でとても素敵な銀のブラシを買って来た。もしかしたら、気に入るかとな？

original: Glad to hear all my hard work has paid off. Maybe we'll fetch a better price for our crops next time we're in the city.
string: 一生懸命収穫した甲斐があったよ。たぶん今度街に出てくる時には、もっといい値で売れるだろう

original: The last time I was in Whiterun, the tradesmen were talking about you. It seems your reputation as a businessman is growing.
string: 前回私がホワイトランにいたときは商人達がお前のことを話していた。実業家として名が知られているようだな

original: I hereby grant you permission to purchase property in my city. Talk to my steward if you're interested.
string: この街に住む権利を与えよう。興味があるなら、執政に話してくれ

original: And take this. A gift from the Jarl's personal stores.
string: そして、これも受け取ってくれ。首長の個人的な持ち物を贈ろう

original: Don't worry about me. I'll do it.
string: 心配するな。やってやる

original: Divines watch over you.
string: 神のご加護を

original: I've brought you <Alias=QuestItem>.
string: <Alias=QuestItem> を持って来た

original: You've honored my father's memory in more ways than I have words to say.
string: 父の思い出を救ってくれた事への感謝は、言葉では言い表せない

original: Do you have any more work for me?
string: 他に仕事はないか？

original: I do. A personal matter. My father died trying to negotiate with the Forsworn, back when that was possible.
string: あるぞ。個人的な事だ。父は、フォースウォーンとの交渉を試みて死んだ。まだ可能性はあった頃にな

original: They took his shield to those Hagraven beasts they consort with. I need you to bring it home where it belongs.
string: 父の盾は奪われ、彼らの仲間であるハグレイヴンの野獣の手に渡ってしまった。盾を取り戻して、あるべき場所に戻したい

original: I warn you, it's dangerous work. No man of mine has ever faced a Hagraven and lived. I'll understand if you decline.
string: 言っておくが、危険な仕事だ。仲間の中で、ハグレイヴンと戦って生き延びた者はいない。断っても構わないぞ

original: I've helped your people.
string: あなたの人々を助けてきた

original: Then by my right as Jarl, I name you Thane of Falkreath. Congratulations.
string: ならば、首長の権限によりファルクリースの従士に任命しよう。おめでとう

original: I grant you this weapon from my armory to serve as your badge of office.
string: お前の地位を示す記章となる、この武器を授ける

original: I'll also notify my guards of your new title. Wouldn't want them to think you're part of the common rabble, now.
string: それに、新しい肩書を衛兵に知らせよう。今から、ただの庶民ではないからな

original: Is there anything else you need, my Jarl?
string: 他に用件はありますか、首長？

original: I've helped your people.
string: あなたの人々を助けてきた

original: Then by my right as Jarl, I name you Thane of Winterhold.
string: それでは首長の権限において、お前をウィンターホールドの従士に任命する。おめでとう

original: I grant you this weapon from the armory to serve as your badge of office.
string: 役職を示す記章となるよう、この武器を授けよう

original: I'll also notify the guards of your new title. Wouldn't want them to think you're part of the common rabble, now.
string: 衛兵にも、新たな肩書のことを知らせておこう。取るに足らぬ者だと思われたくはないだろう

original: Anything else you need, my Jarl?
string: 首長、他に何かご要望は？

original: I've helped your people.
string: あなたの人々を助けてきた

original: Then by my right as Jarl, I name you Thane of the Pale. Congratulations.
string: 首長の権限に基づき、ペイルの従士の名を授ける。おめでとう

original: I grant you this weapon from my armory to serve as your badge of office.
string: お前の地位を示す記章となる、この武器を授ける

original: I'll also notify my guards of your new title. Wouldn't want them to think you're part of the common rabble, now.
string: それに、新しい肩書を衛兵に知らせよう。今から、ただの庶民ではないからな

original: Anything else you need, my Jarl?
string: 首長、他に何かご要望は？

original: I've helped your people.
string: あなたの人々を助けてきた

original: Then by my right as Jarl, I name you Thane of Hjaalmarch. Congratulations.
string: 首長の権限に基づき、ハイヤルマーチの従士の名を授けるわ。おめでとう

original: I grant you this weapon from my armory to serve as your badge of office.
string: お前の地位を示す記章となる、この武器を授ける

original: I'll also notify my guards of your new title. Wouldn't want them to think you're part of the common rabble, now.
string: それに、新しい肩書を衛兵に知らせよう。今から、ただの庶民ではないからな

original: Anything else you need, my Jarl?
string: 首長、他に何かご要望は？

original: Why is this buried so far within Saarthal?
string: なぜこのような物がサールザルの深部に埋められているのだ

original: I never imagined we'd find something like this.
string: このような物を発見するなどと、夢にも思ったことはなかった…

original: Well now... would you look at that.
string: さあ…　あれを見よ

original: Please. Not now. You'll know when I'm ready to discuss the issue.
string: お願い、今はやめて。その事を話せる時が来たら知らせるから

original: Have you seen Astrid? She needs to speak with you. It seemed urgent. Come talk to me afterward.
string: アストリッドに会ったか？　話がしたいそうだ。急を要するみたいだから、私との話は後にしよう

original: On this day... I go to Sovngarde.
string: 今日…　俺はソブンガルデに行く

original: Such is our way! Such is the ancient custom of Skyrim, and all Nords!
string: それが俺達のやり方だ！　それがスカイリムの、そしてノルド全員の古代の慣習だ！

original: There was no murder! Ulfric challenged Torygg. He beat the High King in fair combat.
string: 殺人ではない！　ウルフリックはトリグに挑んだ。彼は公平な戦いで上級王を負かした

original: By opening that gate for Ulfric you betrayed the people of Solitude.
string: ウルフリックのためにあの門を開いた事は、ソリチュードの民への裏切りだ

original: Roggvir. You helped Ulfric Stormcloak escape this city after he murdered High King Torygg.
string: ロッグヴィル。お前はこの街で上級王トリグを殺害したウルフリック・ストームクロークの逃亡を助けた

original: Let me know if there's anything else you need.
string: 他に何か必要なものがあったら何なりと

original: I'll show you to your room. Right this way.
string: お部屋へご案内します。こちらへどうぞ

original: Ah! I've heard of this Shouting, but never seen it. Fascinating...
string: ああ！　このシャウトについては聞いた事があるが、まだ見た事はない。とても興味深い…

original: I've read the dragon language, but to hear it spoken is most interesting.
string: ドラゴン語は読んだ事があるが、耳で聞くのが一番興味深い

original: This skill should prove very useful, Dragonborn. Fighting fire with fire, as the saying goes.
string: その能力はかなり役に立つはずだ、ドラゴンボーンよ。毒には毒をもって制す、ことわざが言うようにな

original: The dragons will surely fear your Voice.
string: ドラゴンは必ず、お前の“声”を恐れるだろう

original: Ah... the power of the dragon is yours! There can be no doubt that you are the Dragonborn of prophecy.
string: ああ…　ドラゴンの力はお前のものだ！　お前が、預言にあるドラゴンボーンであるのは間違いない

original: Alduin cannot ignore this for long.
string: アルドゥインも長い間無視はするまい

original: We've got to bring it down!
string: あれを落とさないとな

original: Don't let it get too close!
string: あまり近づけないで！

original: We've got to ground that bastard!
string: あいつを地面まで下ろして！

original: Come on! This is our best chance!
string: 早く！　絶好のチャンスよ！

original: Attack while it's landed!
string: 地面にいる間に攻撃して！

original: Now it's my turn, you son of a bitch.
string: 私の番よ、食らいなさい！

original: For the Blades!
string: ブレイズのために！

original: Let's get this over with.
string: 終わりにしよう

original: Come on. What are you waiting for?
string: 早く。何を待っているの？

original: You're not afraid of me, are you?
string: 私が怖いなんてことないわよね？

original: Lorkhan's eyes, you're an ugly one, aren't you?
string: まあまあ、本当に醜い奴ね

original: Remember Cloud Ruler Temple!
string: 曇王の神殿での事は忘れない！

original: Did you think the Blades had been destroyed?
string: ブレイズは全滅したとでも思ったの？

original: Now it's your turn, Thalmor bitch.
string: あなたの番よ、サルモールのろくでなし

original: The Blades will never be defeated, Thalmor dog.
string: ブレイズは決して倒れないわ、サルモールのイヌめ

original: I could use a hand here.
string: 手を貸して

original: I'm not afraid of you.
string: お前など怖くないわ

original: For the Blades!
string: ブレイズのために！

original: I wasn't looking for trouble.
string: 厄介事に巻き込まれるつもりはなかったのに

original: I gave up this kind of thing a long time ago.
string: こういう事はずっと前に卒業したんだ

original: You can still run. It's not too late.
string: まだ走れるぞ。諦めるのはまだ早い

original: You've brought this on yourself.
string: 自業自得だ

original: Thalmor dog! Death is too good for you.
string: サルモールのイヌめ！　お前は死にも値しない

original: You'll die knowing it was the Blades that sent you to Oblivion.
string: お前をオブリビオンへ送ったのはブレイズだと知りながら死ね

original: You're starting to make me angry.
string: だんだん腹が立ってきた

original: I'm in a bit of trouble here.
string: ここで少しばかり困っているんだ

original: I need some help with this one!
string: これを手伝ってほしい！

original: You should not have meddled in the Thalmor's affairs.
string: サルモールの件に首を突っ込むべきではなかったな

original: The Thalmor's memory is long.
string: サルモールは忘れない

original: Esbern cannot elude us, fool.
string: 愚かな。エズバーンが逃げられるはずがない

original: I shall sing of thee in Sovngarde!
string: ソブンガルデで汝を歌わん！

original: Feel the bite of my axe!
string: 我が斧を喰らえ！

original: It is glorious to battle once again in Tamriel!
string: またタムリエルで戦えるとは光栄！

original: Feel the thunder of my voice!
string: この声に宿る雷鳴を受けい！

original: You will die for the glory of the Dragonborn!
string: ドラゴンボーンの栄光のために死ね！

original: You are not worthy of Sovngarde!
string: ソブンガルデから失せろ！

original: For the Dragonborn!
string: ドラゴンボーンのために！

original: For Sovngarde!
string: ソブンガルデのために！

original: My sword will taste of your blood!
string: この剣でお前を斬る！

original: I'd rather not do that.
string: やりたくない

original: This work isn't for everyone. Maybe you're more cut out for those snowberries up in Winterhold.
string: 誰にでもできる仕事じゃないからな。ウィンターホールドの馬鹿みたいな仕事の方が向いてるんじゃないか？

original: This isn't an order of cowards. I'll find someone more agreeable, I'm sure.
string: 臆病者に用はない。もっと頼りになる奴がいるだろうからな

original: I don't want that job.
string: その仕事はやりたくないな

original: Fine, I'll get someone else to take care of it.
string: いいわ、他の誰かにやらせるから

original: I'll take care of it.
string: 任せてくれ

original: Of course you will.
string: そう言うと思ったわ

original: Is it true that the Companions are werewolves?
string: 仲間がウェアウルフだと言うのは本当か？

original: I see you've been allowed to know some secrets before your appointed time. No matter. Yes, it's true.
string: その秘密を知るのはちょっと時期尚早だが、まあいい。おっしゃるとおりだ

original: Not every Companion, though. Only members of the Circle all share the blood of the beast.
string: だが全員ではない。獣の血が流れているのはサークルのメンバーだけだ

original: Some take to it more than others.
string: その血を気に入ってるメンバーも中にはいるよ

original: Shor's bones... how did they find this place?
string: ショールの骨にかけて…　ここをどうやって見つけたんだ？

original: Be careful around the burial stones. I don't want to haul you back to Jorrvaskr on my back.
string: 墓石の周りでは注意しろ。ジョルバスクルまでおぶって行くのはゴメンだ

original: Looks like someone's been digging here. And recently.
string: ここをほり返した奴がいるみたいだ。それもつい最近ね

original: Tread lightly.
string: 足音を立てるな

original: You've already turned down a job that I had for you.
string: やってもらいたかった仕事を断っただろう

original: Work needs doing, and if you're not up to it, maybe you're not cut out to be a Companion.
string: やるべき仕事に向いてないなら、“同胞団”にふさわしくないってことかも知れないな

original: Be cautious. Beasts are not nearly as predictable as men. Give the thing a quick death.
string: 用心しなさい。獣は人間みたいに予測できないわ。ひと思いに殺すのよ

original: Good. I knew that we could count on you. It's simply a beast, but be cautious. The beasts of Skyrim are made of sterner stuff than most.
string: 見事ね。思ったとおり、頼りになるわ。相手はただの獣だけど、用心して。スカイリムの獣は他と比べてかなり獰猛よ

original: I knew we could count on you. Get it taken care of right away. Nobody wants an animal left roaming around in their place.
string: やっぱり頼りになるわね。さっさと始末してきてちょうだい。誰だって、家の周りに動物がうろついてたら嫌でしょう

original: You're not afraid, are you? Of animals? Come back when you find your spine.
string: まさか怖いの？　動物が？　勇気が出たら戻って来るといいわ

original: Unfortunate, but someone else will take care of it.
string: 不運なことだ。でも誰かが始末しないとな

original: I see. Well, should you change your mind, the contract will be available for a while.
string: 分かった。気が変わるかも知れないから、契約はしばらく保留にしておこう

original: All right, so here you are. Looks like the others are eager to meet you.
string: よし、あんたはここの一員だ。他の連中もあんたに会いたがってる

original: Come to me or Aela if you're looking for work.
string: 仕事がほしければ俺かアエラに会いに来るといい

original: Once you've made a bit of a name for yourself, Skjor and Vilkas might have things for you to do.
string: 名前を売ればスコールやヴィルカスからも仕事が回ってくるかも知れない

original: Good luck. Welcome to the Companions.
string: 頑張れよ。同胞団はあんたを歓迎する

original: The quarters are up here. Just pick a bed and fall in it when you're tired.
string: 部屋はここだ。疲れてるんならベッドで休んでくれ

original: Tilma will keep the place clean. She always has.
string: ティルマがいつも部屋を掃除してくれる

original: Nice to have a new face around. It gets boring here sometimes.
string: 新顔は歓迎だよ。たまに退屈するからな

original: I hope we keep you. This can be a rough life.
string: ずっといてくれる事を願うよ。辛い人生になるかも知れないからな

original: Skjor and Aela like to tease me, but they are good people.
string: スコールとアエラにはよくからかわれるが、いい連中だよ

original: They challenge us to be our best.
string: 彼らは常に最善を尽くすよう求めてくる

original: New blood? Oh, I remember you. Come on, follow me.
string: 新顔か？　ああ、お前は覚えてるぞ。さあ、ついて来いよ

original: New blood? Oh, hello. I'm Farkas. Come, follow me.
string: 新顔か？　よく来たな。ファルカスだ。ついて来いよ

original: Of course we did, icebrain.
string: 当たり前でしょう、お馬鹿さんね

original: Show this new blood where the rest of the whelps sleep.
string: この新人に、他の若造達の寝場所を見せてやって

original: Did you call me?
string: 呼んだか？

original: Farkas!
string: ファルカス！

original: Here, let's have Farkas show you where you'll be resting your head.
string: ほら、ひと休みする場所をファルカスに見せてもらいましょう

original: I would kill him before he drew his sword.
string: あいつが剣を抜く前に殺してやる

original: Woah, ease up there. We're rough, but there's no need to kill a Shield-Brother over a dispute.
string: まあ落ち着きなさい。幾らなんでも、言い争いの末に盾の兄弟を殺すなんてやり過ぎよ

original: I like your fire, though. You'll make a fierce Companion. Let us hunt together sometime.
string: その野心は気に入ったわ。凶暴な同胞団になりそうね。いつか一緒に狩りに行きましょう

original: I don't care for boasting.
string: 自慢話は好きじゃない

original: Ah, a man of action.
string: ああ、行動で示すのね

original: Ah, a woman who lets her actions speak for her. I knew there was something I liked about you.
string: ああ、行動で示すタイプなのよね。そういうところが好きだったのよ

original: There you are. I had wondered where you got to.
string: 見つけたわ。どこに行ったかと思ってたのよ

original: Do you think you could handle Vilkas in a real fight?
string: 本気で戦ったらヴィルカスを倒せると思う？

original: Don't let Vilkas catch you saying that.
string: ヴィルカスの前ではそんなことを口にするな

original: Ah, yes. I heard you gave him quite a thrashing.
string: ええ。派手にぶちのめしたって聞いたわよ

original: You know this one? I saw him training in the yard with Vilkas.
string: こいつを知ってるだろ？　ヴィルカスと鍛錬をやっていた奴さ

original: You know this one? I saw her training in the yard with Vilkas.
string: 話したろ、こいつがヴィルカスの言ってた小娘だよ

original: I told you, this is the whelp that Vilkas mentioned.
string: 話したろ、こいつがヴィルカスが言ってた若造だよ

original: I have your shield.
string: あなたの盾を持ってきた

original: Ah, good. I've been waiting for this. Good to see you made it up here.
string: よかった。これをずっと待ってたのよ。よく来てくれたわね

original: Ah, good. I've been waiting for this. Wait... I remember you. So the old man thinks you've got some heart, I guess.
string: ああ、よかった。これを待ってたのよ。あら…　見たことある顔だわ。さてはあのじいさん、あなたが関心を持ったと思っているのね

original: Ah, good. I've been waiting for this. Are you new here?
string: よかった。これをずっと待ってたのよ。あなた、初めて見る顔ね？

original: I'm happy to lend a hand.
string: 喜んで手を貸そう

original: That's a good man.
string: いい奴だな

original: Well done.
string: よくやった

original: Didn't you just tell me not to be a servant?
string: ただの召使いではないと言わなかったか？

original: This isn't a command. Just decency. Help out an old blacksmith. I've got to get back to my work.
string: これは命令じゃない。礼儀だ。年寄りの鍛冶屋を助けろ。こっちの仕事に戻る

original: I'll need to be going.
string: 行かないと

original: I have a favor to ask.
string: 頼みたい事がある

original: Someone has to be in charge, though.
string: 誰かがやらなければならないのだろう

original: Well, I'm not sure how they've managed it, but they have. No leaders since Ysgramor.
string: まあ、方法は分からないが、とにかく彼らは指揮を執っていた。イスグラモル以来、指導者がいないのだ

original: Kodlak is the Harbinger, and he's a sort of advisor for the whole group, but every man is his own. Every woman, her own.
string: コドラクは導き手で、全体の相談役のようだ。だが、男も女も頼り切らず、自立している

original: I'm just doing what I'm asked.
string: 頼まれたことをそのままやった

original: That attitude would get you far, if you were some stuffy merchant or a Jarl's footstool.
string: その態度は役に立つぞ。つまらない商人か、首長の踏み台になるにはな

original: Around here, you'll want to learn to live your own life. Remember, nobody rules anybody in the Companions.
string: このあたりでは、自立した生き方が学べる。忘れるな、“同胞団”では誰の指図も受ける事はない

original: Are you a Companion?
string: あんたも同胞団の一員なのか？

original: Not actually a Companion myself, but none of them know how to work a forge properly, and I'm honored to serve them.
string: 自分は“同胞団”じゃないが、彼らは炉の正しい使い方を知らないんだ。手を貸せて光栄だよ

original: My name is Eorlund Gray-Mane. I work the Skyforge. Best steel in all of Skyrim. All of Tamriel.
string: エオルンド・グレイ・メーンだ。スカイフォージを動かしている。スカイリムとタムリエルで最高の鋼だ

original: Does Vilkas always send newcomers on errands?
string: ヴィルカスはいつも新人を使いに出すのか？

original: Oh, don't worry too much about it. They were all whelps once. They just might not like to talk about it.
string: おい、あまり気にするな。みんな昔は若造だった。その話をしたくないだけだろう

original: And don't always just do what you're told. Nobody rules anybody in the Companions.
string: 言われた事だけをやるのはやめろ。“同胞団”では誰の指図も受ける事はない

original: Vilkas sent me with his sword.
string: ヴィルカスに言われて彼の剣を届けに来た

original: I'm guessing you're the newcomer then?
string: という事は、新入りだな？

original: How was that?
string: どうだ？

original: Not bad. Next time won't be so easy.
string: 悪くない。次はもう少し手ごわいぞ

original: Now that's impressive. You're mightier than you look.
string: ほう、たいしたもんだな。見かけより力はあるらしい

original: What do you think this is? We don't do battle with magic around here, new blood. Now come at me.
string: 何だと思ってるんだ？　この辺では魔法を使って戦うことはないぞ、新米。さあ、かかってこい

original: Come on now, fight your own battles.
string: さあこい、自分なりの戦い方でやってみろ

original: So you're supposed to train me?
string: では、鍛えてくれるのか？

original: Not here. Out in the yard. Come on.
string: ここでではない。ついて来い。庭に行くぞ

original: The old man said to have a look at you, so let's do this.
string: あの老人からお前の力を見るよう言われている。さあ、やろうじゃないか

original: Just have a few swings at me so I can see your form. Don't worry, I can take it.
string: 俺に向かってちょっと攻撃してみろ。腕を見てやる。心配するな、ちゃんと受け止めるから

original: I have much to learn.
string: 学ぶことは多い

original: That's the spirit. Vilkas, here, will get started on that.
string: よい心がけだ。それなら、ここにいるヴィルカスが面倒を見てくれよう

original: You dare question my skill?
string: 腕を疑うのか？

original: Calm down there, whelp. Don't feel like you need to show off for our sake.
string: 落ち着け、そうカッカするな。力があるかどうかは、こっちで判断しよう

original: Vilkas, here, will be the one testing your mettle.
string: ここにいるヴィルカスが君の試験官となる

original: I can handle myself.
string: 自分のことは自分でやれる

original: That may be so. This is Vilkas. He will test your arm.
string: そうかも知れないな。こいつはヴィルカス。君の腕前を試してくれる

original: Oh you're back. Do you still think you could stand as a Companion?
string: おや、戻ってきたね。“同胞団”になる自信はまだあるかな？

original: Of course. How are you in a battle, boy?
string: もちろん、戦いは得意なんだろう？　ひよっこ

original: Of course. How are you in a battle, girl?
string: もちろん、戦いは得意なんだろう？　お嬢さん

original: And their arm.
string: それと武器だ

original: Sometimes the famous come to us. Sometimes men and women come to us to seek their fame. It makes no difference.
string: 名のある者達が我々を訪ねてくる事もある。名声を求めて訪ねてくる者もいる。どちらでも同じ事だ

original: What matters is their heart.
string: 要は心が大事なのだよ

original: Apologies. But perhaps this isn't the time. I've never even heard of this outsider.
string: すまない。だがおそらく今はその時ではない。そのよそ者の話さえ聞いたことがない

original: I am nobody's master, Vilkas. And last I checked, we had some empty beds in Jorrvaskr for those with a fire burning in their hearts.
string: 私は誰の主人でもないのだ、ヴィルカスよ。この前見た時は、ジョルバスクルにベッドの空きがあったはずだ。心に炎を燃やす者なら、あそこで眠る資格があろう

original: Master, you're not truly considering accepting him?
string: マスター、本当に彼を受け入れることを考えていないのか？

original: Master, you're not truly considering accepting her?
string: マスター、本当に彼女を受け入れることを考えていないのか？

original: I would like to join the Companions.
string: 仲間に加わりたい

original: Would you now? Here, let me have a look at you.
string: 今すぐに？　ふむ、ちょっと顔を見せてもらえるかな

original: Hm. Yes, perhaps. A certain strength of spirit.
string: うむ、悪くない。なかなか根性がありそうじゃないか

original: Leave that to me.
string: そいつは任せてくれ

original: You have my brother and I, obviously. But I don't know if the rest will go along quite so easily.
string: 俺と兄弟は見ての通り、お前の味方だ。だが他の者達が簡単に賛成するかどうかは分からないぞ

original: We all do. It is our burden to bear. But we can overcome.
string: 我々は皆そうだ。確かに荷が重いかもしれんが、乗り越える事ができる

original: But I still hear the call of the blood.
string: だが、その血の呼ぶ声が今も聞こえるんだ

original: Spread out and look for survivors. We need to know what we're dealing with.
string: 散開して生存者を捜して。まずは何と戦っているのかを知る必要があるわ

original: No signs of any dragon right now, but it sure looks like he's been here.
string: 今のところ、ドラゴンの残した形跡は見当たらないわ。でも、ここにいたのは確かみたいね

original: But the old tales tell of the Dragonborn who could kill dragons and steal their power. You must be one!
string: だが、古い物語によれば、ドラゴンボーンはドラゴンを殺し、その力を奪えるらしい。お前がそうに違いない！

original: There weren't any dragons then, idiot. They're just coming back now for the first time in... forever.
string: 馬鹿め、今までドラゴンはいなかった。奴らが戻ってきたのは、これが…　初めてだ

original: I never heard of Tiber Septim killing any dragons.
string: タイバー・セプティムがドラゴンを殺したなんて聞いていない

original: That's right! My grandfather used to tell stories about the Dragonborn.
string: その通りだ！　我が祖父が、ドラゴンボーンの物語を話してくれた

original: Dragonborn? What are you talking about?
string: ドラゴンボーン？　何の話だ？

original: What's happening?!
string: 何が起きている？

original: Everybody get back!
string: 全員下がって！

original: Look at that!
string: あれを見ろ！

original: I thought we were all dead for sure!
string: みんな死ぬかと思ったぞ！

original: We killed it! I can't believe it!
string: やったぞ！　信じられない！

original: Is it really dead?
string: 本当に死んでいるのか？

original: Damned good shooting, boys!
string: いい射ちっぷりよ、みんな！

original: Let's make sure that overgrown lizard is really dead.
string: 育ち過ぎのトカゲが本当に死んだかどうか、確かめましょう

original: Do not be afraid. Your Shout will not harm us.
string: 恐れなくてもいい。お前のシャウトが我らを傷つけることはない

original: Shout at us, and let us taste of your Voice.
string: 我らに叫べ、そしてお前の声を味わわせよ

original: Strike us with the power of your Voice.
string: 我らを声の力で打て

original: We'll meet back up at the Sanctuary! I'll be fine. Go!
string: 聖域で落ち合おう！　こっちは大丈夫だ。さあ、行け！

original: Astrid ordered me to keep an eye on you. Figured you could use a hand when the chaos erupted.
string: アストリッドにお前から目を離さないように命じられた。混乱に陥った際、お前に助けが必要だと考えたのだろう

original: I'll try and hold them off as best I can. You get back to the Sanctuary!
string: 私はできるだけ奴らをここで食い止める。お前は聖域に戻れ！

original: Veezara?
string: ヴィーザラ？

original: I guess we should have expected this response, hmm?
string: どうやら、相手の出方を予測しておくべきだったようだな？

original: I thank you all again for making this the best wedding a woman could ask for.
string: 皆さんのおかげで、女として望みうる最高の結婚式になりました。改めてお礼を言わせて下さい

original: You have all helped make this a truly extraordinary wedding. All of my dreams have come true. So thank you. Thank you all.
string: 皆さんのおかげで、本当にすばらしい結婚式になりました。夢がすべて叶いました。ありがとう。本当にありがとう

original: May you all be as happy in your lives as I know I will be in mine. Thank you again for everything.
string: みなさんどうかお幸せにね。私も幸せになります。何もかも本当にありがとう

original: Today, the problems of Skyrim are not my problems. Nor are they yours. Today we are joined in peace and happiness. So please, enjoy yourselves.
string: 今日は、スカイリムの問題は私にも、そして皆さんにも関係ありません。私達は平和に集い、幸せを分かち合っています。ですから、どうぞ心おきなく楽しんで下さいね

original: These days, it seems there is dread everywhere, whether it be war or dragon. But I beg you - here, today, put such fears aside. Enjoy yourselves!
string: 最近は戦争とかドラゴンとか、至る所で怖ろしい事が起きているようですが、今日はどうか不安を忘れて、楽しんで下さい

original: In this courtyard, there are no Stormcloaks. There are no Imperials. There are only people, come to celebrate a union of two souls. So make merry!
string: この中庭ではストームクロークも帝国軍もないわ。2つの魂の結びつきを祝いに来た人達だけ。だから楽しくやりましょう！

original: I just wanted to take this time to thank you all for being here. To thank you for sharing this wonderfully happy day with myself, and my new husband.
string: この場を借りて、皆さんにお礼を申し上げます。私達夫婦にとって幸せな今日という日を分かち合ってくださって本当にありがとうございます

original: Are you all enjoying yourselves? Please, eat, drink, and make merry on this most happy of days.
string: 楽しんで下さいね？　飲んで食べて、この最高に幸せな時間を陽気に過ごしましょう

original: My husband Aesgir and I thank you for coming to our reception. We thank you for sharing the love we have for each other.
string: 披露宴に来て下さって、夫エスジールと共にお礼を申し上げるわ。この愛をみなさんと分かち合えて本当にうれしいわ

original: Honored guests.
string: 来賓の方々

original: Good people of Solitude.
string: ソリチュードの善人達

original: Good friends and neighbors.
string: 良き友と良き隣人達よ

original: DialogueRiftenGoodbyes
string: DialogueRiftenGoodbyes

original: If there's nothing else, I really must ask you to leave.
string: 他に用がないなら、もう帰ってもらっていいかしら？

original: I really appreciate what you've done for me. I'll never forget it.
string: おかげで本当に助かったよ。この恩は一生忘れない

original: Anything you can find would be of great help. Good luck.
string: 見つけられる物は何であれ、大きな助けになるだろう。幸運を祈る

original: Keep your eyes to the road.
string: 道をよく見ていろよ

original: Thanks again for the ice wraith teeth.
string: 氷の生霊の歯を本当にありがとう

original: Be careful looking for those teeth... those little bastards are dangerous.
string: 歯を探す時は気をつけて。この小さな奴らは危険よ

original: Keep your belly full and your shoulders strong.
string: お腹をいっぱいにして、肩を鍛えなさい

original: Come back when you're ready to spend more gold... goodness knows I could use it.
string: ゴールドがたまったらまた来て下さい

original: Safe travels, landstrider.
string: 良い旅を

original: Good journey, marsh-friend.
string: 良い旅を

original: Return anytime. You're quite welcome here.
string: いつでも戻ってこい。大歓迎するよ

original: Remember, nothing but genuine fire salts will do... the forge knows the difference.
string: 忘れるなよ、本物の炎の塩鉱石じゃなきゃ駄目だ…　炉はごまかせない

original: If you need any more smithing work, come see me again.
string: 別の鍛造をしてほしいなら、また後で来てくれ

original: Thanks for your business.
string: まいどあり

original: It was nice to meet you.
string: 会えて良かったよ

original: Be careful out there... Riften can be dangerous.
string: 気をつけて…　リフテンにはあまり安全じゃないから

original: Door's over there. Why don't you use it?
string: ドアは向こうよ。それを使ったら？

original: Come back and see us again.
string: また会いに戻ってきてね

original: Just get out of here.
string: さっさと逃げるぞ

original: If you'll excuse me, I have other things to attend to.
string: 悪いが、他にやらなければならない事があるんでね

original: Imperial bastard.
string: 帝国軍の奴らめ

original: Farewell, kinsman.
string: またな、我が仲間よ

original: Support Ulfric or die trying. There's nothing in between.
string: ウルフリックを助けるか、挑んで死んでいけ。中間はない

original: Talos preserve you.
string: タロスのご加護がありますよう

original: Talos guide you.
string: タロスのお導きがありますように

original: Farewell.
string: それではまた

original: It's been good talking to you.
string: 話せてよかったよ

original: Good, now maybe I can get back to work.
string: よし、これで仕事に戻れるな

original: Well, that was important.
string: ああ、それは重要だな

original: Come back and see us again!
string: また会いに来てくれ！

original: Travel safe.
string: ご無事で

original: Remember to give at the temple.
string: 聖堂では寄付を忘れるなよ

original: Excuse me.
string: ごめんよ

original: When I find that bitch, I'm going to wring her little neck.
string: あのクソ女を見つけたら、首を絞めてやる

original: Visit me anytime. I'm not going anywhere soon.
string: いつでも来てくれ。しばらくはどこへも行かない

original: I believe we're done.
string: 話は終わったはずですよ

original: Out of my way.
string: おどきなさい

original: Don't forget to check your supply chest from time to time.
string: たまに補給庫を確認してみてね

original: My experiments can't be completed until you've brought me those ingredients. Do hurry.
string: あの材料を手に入れてきてくれるまで、実験が終わらないの。お願いだから急いで

original: Now was it two parts giant lichen or three? Hm...
string: これは2つに分かれた巨大地衣類、それとも3つ？　んんと…

original: You'd do well to remember who's really in charge around here.
string: ここら辺を本当に仕切っているのが誰だか覚えておいた方が身のためだぞ

original: You'd do well to remember who's in charge around here.
string: ここら辺を仕切っているのが誰だか覚えておいた方が身のためだぞ

original: May you return to Her Benevolence in safety.
string: 無事に戻られますように

original: You represent Mara now. Set an example for all.
string: あなたは今やマーラの代理よ。みんなの手本になってね

original: Good journey, my child!
string: いい旅となりますように！

original: I don't know why I bother.
string: 知ったこっちゃないわ

original: Try and get those marks without violence please. I don't want to be responsible for their deaths... or yours.
string: 暴力なしで、あの印を手に入れてきて。彼らや…　あなたの死の責任を感じたくないからね

original: Sure, leave. Not like you care anyway.
string: じゃあ、もう行って。あなたには関係ないものね

original: Remain vigilant and don't trust anyone.
string: 警戒を緩めず、誰も信用するな

original: You've been kind, I thank you.
string: 親切にしてくれて、ありがとう

original: Any healing potion will do. Please hurry.
string: 回復薬なら何でもいいわ。急いでちょうだい

original: What am I going to do?
string: どうしようかしら？

original: A Dreth never forgets a friend.
string: ドレス家の者は決して友を忘れない

original: Remember, keep this to yourself.
string: いいか、この事は秘密だぞ

original: Please, come back and speak to me anytime.
string: お願い、いつでも戻ってきて声をかけてね

original: Be cautious, the pilgrimage to the Shrine is not an easy one.
string: 用心してね。祠への巡礼の旅は楽じゃないから

original: I'd ask you maintain civility while you're here.
string: ここにいる間は礼儀を忘れないでもらいたいわ

original: Good journey to you.
string: 良い旅を

original: You're welcome in Riften as long as you continue to obey our laws.
string: リフテンの法律に従うのなら歓迎するわ

original: I'm keeping my eye on you.
string: 目を離さないからな

original: I have to remember... ward first, then summon.
string: 覚えておかなきゃ…　まずシールド魔法を、その次に召喚ね

original: Okay, now where did I put those spiders?
string: 分かった。で、このクモをどこに置けばいいの？

original: I see I still have much to learn. Lead on.
string: まだ学ぶ事がたくさんあるようね。さあ行って

original: Please be careful, I don't wish to be the reason for your death.
string: 気をつけてね。私のせいで死んでほしくないの

original: Just stay away from me and I'll forget we had this discussion.
string: 私に近づかないで。この話をした事も忘れるわ

original: Safe travels.
string: 良い旅を

original: Watch yourself around here, it isn't safe.
string: 用心しろよ。安全とは言えないからな

original: Yes, yes... goodbye.
string: ああ、はい…　さようなら

original: You didn't need to leave so soon.
string: そんなに早く去らなくてもよかったのに

original: Give Vex a kiss for me.
string: ヴェックスにキスを贈っておいてくれ

original: Be careful, the road to Shor's Stone could be dangerous.
string: 気をつけて。ショール・ストーンへの道は危険だからね

original: Don't forget us if you need supplies for your journey.
string: 旅に必要なものがあれば、私達を思い出すんだよ

original: Hurry up with it, we've got a merchant in the pit to take care of after we carve this thing up.
string: さっさとこれを切り分けて。坑道に商人を待たせているんだから

original: Gotta have a sharp axe to cut through all that fat...
string: 切れ味の鋭い斧が必要だな。それでこの余計な脂肪を全部…

original: Let's move out.
string: 行きましょう

original: Yeah!
string: おう！

original: We're so dead...
string: もう終わりだ…

original: Yeah!
string: おう！

original: We're with you!
string: 我々は味方だ！

original: No!
string: やめろ！

original: No, Housecarl!
string: よすんだ！

original: Shut up.
string: 黙れ

original: Now we're in for it.
string: マズい事になったな

original: What?
string: 何？

original: A dragon?
string: ドラゴン？

original: What brings you here?
string: どうしてここにいる？

original: What do you mean?
string: どういう意味だ？

original: Over the years I've heard things. Powerful magics lost to the ages, incredible spells that only the most skilled mages can master.
string: 長い間、色々なことを耳にしてきました。時の流れの中で失われた強力な魔法、最も高いスキルのある魔術師だけが修得できる恐るべき呪文…

original: This is the only thing I've ever found. I think it's better off in your hands.
string: 私が知っているのはそれだけです。あとはあなた自身の手で追い求めて下さい

original: What else is there to be learned about Destruction magic?
string: 破壊魔法について他に学ぶことはあるか？

original: I daresay you've learned all I can teach you.
string: 教えられる限りのことはすべて学んだと言えるでしょう

original: But... That doesn't mean there isn't more out there.
string: でも…　外の世界には、まだまだ学ぶことがあるはずです

original: No! Noooooooo!
string: 駄目だ！　やめろー！

original: The bride has been murdered! Somebody help!
string: 花嫁が殺された！　誰か助けて！

original: What treachery?
string: 謀反ですって？

original: Aaaaiiiiieeee!
string: あーーーー！

original: Vittoria! No!
string: ヴィットリア！　だめだ！

original: La la la, la la la, la la la, la la la la. La la la, la la la la la laaaaaahhhh...
string: ラララ、ラララ、ラララ、ララララ。ラララ、ラララ、ラララー…

original: La la la, do do do do do, dum de dum dum...
string: ラララ、ドゥドゥドゥドゥドゥ、ダンダダンダン…

original: Dum, di di dum, dum di dum, dum di di di di dum da da dum.
string: ダン、ディディダン、ダンディダン、ダンディディディダンダダン

original: Ba ba ba, bum ba, ba ba ba, bum ba, ba da da da, dum da da...
string: バババ、バンバ、バババ、バンバ、バダダダ、ダンダダ…

original: Dum, di di dum, dum di dum, dum di di di di dum da da dum.
string: ダン、ディディダン、ダンディダン、ダンディディディダンダダン

original: I would be fine if they didn't.  Have you seen their eyes? They don't have any! Gross.
string: 何もされないなら別に構わないのだが。奴らの目を見た事があるか？　何もないんだ！　気持ちが悪い

original: I hope one comes running up here so I can stab it right in the face.
string: ここまで駆け上って来てくれたら、顔を一突きしてやれるのにな

original: Yeah! It'll teach them to steal from us! One of them took my good helmet.
string: そう！　奴らは我々から盗む方法を学ぶのさ！　奴らの一員が私の良い兜を盗んだのだ

original: The boss is going to cut those creepy cave people to pieces!
string: ボスはこの気味悪い洞窟連中をばらばらに切り刻むつもりだ！

original: Something to report?
string: 変わったことはない？

original: The General and I have our disagreements, but he's the best hope for both the Empire and Skyrim.
string: 将軍と私は違う意見を持ってるのよ。でも彼は帝国とスカイリム双方にとって一番の望みよ

original: Many of my countrymen joined the rebels. They can't see the big picture. Skyrim needs the Empire as much as it needs us.
string: 故郷で大勢の人々が反乱に加わったわ。全体像が見えないの。私達と同じくらい、スカイリムには帝国が必要なのよ

original: Make it quick. I get enough delays from politicians.
string: 早くしてくれ。政治家達のせいで色々と遅れ気味なんだ

original: I trust this is something important?
string: これは重要な件なんだな？

original: There isn't someone less busy who can help you?
string: 誰かもっと暇な奴が相手をできないのか？

original: It's good we hold the Reach. Were the rebels to gain control, the silver mines would give them coin to hire more thugs and expand their violence.
string: リーチは保持しておくべきだ。反乱軍に奪われたら、奴らは銀の鉱山から資金を得る。そして戦力を増やしてもっと暴れ回るだろう

original: It was important we reclaimed the Reach. Letting Ulfric control the flow of silver was a mistake. One I'm glad we've finally corrected.
string: リーチを取り戻したのは重要だ。ウルフリックへの銀を与えたのは過ちだった。ようやく過ちを修正できたな

original: We need to stem the flow of silver to the rebellion. Until we retake the Reach, the Stormcloaks will plunder it's mines to fund further violence.
string: 反乱軍への銀の流れを止めなければ。リーチを奪還しないと、ストームクロークは鉱山を略奪し続けるだろう。それが奴らの暴力の資金源になる

original: Hjaalmarch is an important buffer zone between the rebel forces and the capital. Ulfric will try to break through at some point.
string: ハイヤルマーチは反乱軍と首都の間にある重要な緩衝地帯だ。ウルフリックはその破れ目を見つけて進軍を試みるだろう

original: Reclaiming Hjaalmarch lets me worry less about the rear guard, and push more men to the front. It was a mistake to let Ulfric control it for so long.
string: ハイヤルマーチを取り戻した。これで後衛をあまり心配しなくても良い。前線への兵士の増員も可能になった。長い間ウルフリックの手に渡しておいたのは過ちだったな

original: I'm losing my patience with this damn war. We must take Hjaalmarch back! The Stormcloaks will be beating upon the doors of the capital soon.
string: この戦いには堪忍袋の緒が切れそうだ。ハイヤルマーチを奪還するぞ！　ストームクロークはもうすぐ首都の扉を叩くところだ

original: Ulfric will want to take Whiterun from us. But we will hold fast. We can't give the rebellion free reign through the center of Skyrim.
string: ウルフリックは我々からホワイトランを奪うつもりだ。だがそうはさせない。スカイリムの中心で奴らの好き勝手にさせるわけにはいかん

original: I can't believe we lost Whiterun. The rebels have a great advantage in controlling the center now. We must take it back!
string: ホワイトランを失うなんて、信じられん。中心地の支配は、反乱軍に多大な利益をもたらす事になる。何としてでも取り返すぞ！

original: By holding onto Falkreath, we control access to the Reach, Whiterun, and the Rift. Ulfric will try for it soon. We'll be there to stop him.
string: ファルクリースを死守すれば、リーチ、ホワイトラン、そしてリフトへ自由に通行できる。ウルフリックは近いうちにファルクリースを狙ってくるだろう。その時は何としてでも奴を食い止めねばならん

original: By taking back Falkreath, we control access to the Reach, Whiterun, and the Rift. We should never have given it up.
string: ファルクリースを取り戻して、リーチ、ホワイトラン、そしてリフトへ自由に通行できるようになった。そもそもあそこは敵の手に渡すべきではなかったが

original: I fear losing Falkreath may give too much advantage to Ulfric. The rebels now control access to the Reach, Whiterun, and the Rift. I want it back.
string: ファルクリースを失って、状況はウルフリックにとって大きく有利になった。反乱軍は今やリーチ、ホワイトラン、そしてリフトへ自由に通行できるのだ。何としてでも奪還しなければ

original: Taking the Pale gives us another port in Dawnstar, and puts us within striking distance of Windhelm. That should make Ulfric a bit more cautious, eh?
string: ペイルを奪えばドーンスターの港も手に入る。そうすればウィンドヘルムも射程圏内だ。ウルフリックはゆっくり眠れなくなると思わんか？

original: Controlling the Pale gives Ulfric a port town and takes the pressure off of Windhelm. But it's only a matter of time before it's back in our hands.
string: ペイルを支配している限り、港町はウルフリックのものだ。ウィンドヘルムも安泰というわけだな。だが、我々がペイルを奪還するまでの話だ

original: Now that we have Winterhold, I can garrison some troops there until I'm ready to march on Windhelm.
string: ウィンターホールドを手に入れた。部隊を駐屯させるぞ。ウィンドヘルムへ進軍する日も近い

original: There's not much up there, but if we can regain Winterhold, our proximity to Windhelm should keep Ulfric wary and wasting troops garrisoned at home.
string: ウィンターホールドは資源に乏しい場所だが、あそこを奪還すればウィンドヘルムへの進軍も可能になる。ウルフリックの神経をすり減らして、兵士を本拠地に無駄使いさせられる

original: I almost can't believe it's over. The rebellion is squashed, Windhelm is free. I must admit, Ulfric put up a stronger fight than I was expecting.
string: もう終わりのようだな。反乱軍は壊滅状態だ。ウィンドヘルムは解放された。ウルフリックが思ったよりも手強かった事は認めるが

original: We will oust Ulfric from Windhelm soon enough. And when we do, I'll have his head on a plate.
string: ウルフリックをすぐにウィンドヘルムから追い出してやる。その時は奴の首を皿の上に乗せてやろう

original: Taking control of the Rift was a great victory. Ulfric must be rather nervous with us so close to his door step.
string: リフトの支配権を奪ったのは、大勝利と言っていいだろう。我々の存在を身近に感じて、ウルフリックの奴は気が気でないはずだ

original: We need the Rift. We need to regain control of it before we can march on Windhelm without worry about our rear guard.
string: 我が軍にはリフトが必要だ。リフトの支配権を奪い返せば、後ろを気にせずウィンドヘルムへ進軍できる

original: I almost can't believe it. The Empire has been defeated. The world bears witness to the power and righteousness of the sons and daughters of Skyrim.
string: にわかには信じられないが、帝国はついに敗れた。世界はスカイリムの民の正義と力の目撃者となるのだ

original: Soon enough we will march on Solitude. And on that day the heroes of Sovngarde will march with us, and the Empire will fall to its knees in fear.
string: すぐにソリチュードに入る。その日、ソブンガルデの英雄は我らとともにありて、帝国は恐怖に怯えながらその前に跪くのだ

original: Now that the Empire has been driven from the Reach we can put a stop to the raping of her silver mines. That silver belongs in Skyrim.
string: 今や帝国はリーチから一掃された。これで銀鉱山への略奪を止められる。かの地の銀はスカイリムが持つべきものだ

original: The Empire's ravenous hunger for Skyrim's silver makes them fierce. But rest assured, we'll win the Reach and wrest it from their greedy paws.
string: スカイリムの銀に対する飽くなき欲望が帝国を手ごわい相手にしている。だが案ずるな。我らはリーチを勝ち取り、奴らの欲深き手から引き剥がす

original: Tullius must be getting nervous. Taking Hjaalmarch we're practically in his backyard now. As soon as we're able, we'll march on Solitude.
string: すぐ側のハイヤルマーチがこちらの手中に入るところだ。テュリウスも気が気でないだろう。できるだけ早くソリチュードに入りたい

original: We should take Hjaalmarch. It'll be an important pressure point on the Imperials. We'd be within spitting distance of the capital.
string: ハイヤルマーチを奪えば、帝国に対する重要な突破口となろう。首都に手が届くところまで入り込める

original: We've driven the Imperials out of Whiterun. This is good. Very good. We now control the center. It's a powerful position. One I aim to keep.
string: ホワイトランから帝国勢を駆逐できた。実に上出来だ。今では我々が中心部を掌握した。この要所は守り抜かねばな

original: The Imperials have really dug into Whiterun. We'll wrest it from them soon enough. We must. Its central position is key.
string: 帝国はホワイトランに深く食い込んでいる。大陸中央の要衝だ、ただちに奪取せねばならん

original: I'm proud we liberated Falkreath from the Empire. In many ways it's the heart and soul of Skyrim. Not to mention its rather strategic position.
string: ファルクリースを帝国の手から解放できた。戦略的な位置は言うに及ばず、あらゆる意味でスカイリムの心髄と呼べる地だ

original: The Empire thinks it holds Falkreath from us. But the souls of Skyrim's bravest are buried there and will fill our hearts and strengthen our blades.
string: 帝国はファルクリースを守り通せると踏んでいる。だが、かの地に眠るスカイリムで最も勇敢な魂が、その思いが我らの心を満たし、刃の鋭さを増すのだ

original: Tullius has camps in the Pale, entertaining thoughts of battle. The Empire still underestimates the force of our cause. It will be their undoing.
string: テュリウスはペイルで野営し、戦いについて考えをめぐらせている。帝国はいまだ大義を奉ずる軍の力を低く見積もっているが、それが破滅の元だ

original: I'm glad we've finally restored the Pale. It was extremely foolish giving the Empire control of another port.
string: 最終的にペイルを回復できたのは何よりだ。帝国にさらなる港の支配権を与えるとは、度が過ぎた愚行だったな

original: I can't believe we let them take the Pale. Losing the port of Dawnstar is lessened only by the threat of Imperial forces being so close to Windhelm.
string: ペイルを取らせるなど考えられぬ。ドーンスターの港を失う痛手にまさるのは、ウィンドヘルムの間近に迫る帝国の脅威ぐらいのものだ

original: I'm not sure why Tullius is wasting his time trying to take Winterhold from us. But if he wants to throw his men away, I'll gladly accept that gift.
string: なぜテュリウスがウィンターホールドを奪おうとして無駄に時間を費やすのかは解せぬ。みすみす部下の命を捨てたいのなら、喜んで受け取ってやろう

original: I'm glad we've taken back Winterhold. While the Imperials were up there, important resources were tied up stiffening our northern border.
string: ウィンターホールドを取り戻せたのは何よりだ。帝国が留まっている間ずっと、重要な兵力をを北部境界付近でまとめて釘付けにされていたのだからな

original: I don't like Imperial troops holed up in Winterhold... such a close march to Windhelm. So I'm sending a campaign up there to take it back.
string: かくもウィンドヘルムの境界近く、ウィンターホールドに帝国兵が立てこもるのは望ましくない。奪還のために軍を動かすつもりだ

original: Damn Tullius. He's pocketed men in the Rift. It's dangerous having Imperials skulking about on the southern border of Eastmarch.
string: おのれテュリウス、リフトを我が物顔にしおって…　イーストマーチの南を帝国兵にこそこそかぎ回られるのは危険な状況だ

original: I'm glad we liberated the Rift. It was dangerous having Imperials skulking about on the southern border of Eastmarch.
string: リフトを解放できたのは何よりだ。イーストマーチの南境付近で帝国がこそこそかぎ回るのは危険だったからな

original: Losing the Rift gives Tullius easy access to the south of Eastmarch. Talos preserve us. We must take it back!
string: リフトを失い、テュリウスはたやすくイーストマーチ南方に出られる。タロスよ、我らを守りたまえ…　ここはなんとしても取り返さねば！

original: I'm promoting you to Quaestor.
string: 審問官に昇進だ

original: Take this blade, a symbol of your new station and responsibility. I'll keep an eye on your progress. The Empire rewards excellence, and so do I.
string: 新しい地位と責任の印として、この剣を与えよう。今後も進歩に注目しておく。帝国も私も優れた者には十分報いるからな

original: Battles are won by trained and disciplined men. Wars are won by talented and exceptional individuals.
string: 各戦闘で勝利をもたらすのは、十分訓練を積んだ兵士達だ。戦争の勝利をもたらすのは、神から才能を与えられた選ばれた者達だ

original: I'm raising you to Praefect. Take this blade, as a gift and symbol of your new rank. You've earned it.
string: 軍事長官へ昇進だ。この剣を与えよう。私からのプレゼントでもあり、新しい地位の印でもある。それを持つ資格があるからな

original: You've come a long way. I don't think we could do without you. I'm hereby raising you to Tribune. Congratulations.
string: 大活躍だったな。お前なしに勝利はありえなかった。護民官に昇進だ。おめでとう

original: Here, take this gift as a sign of the Empire's appreciation, and my own.
string: これを与えよう。私と帝国からの感謝の印だ

original: I have come to rely heavily upon you. It is only fitting that you join the upper echelon. I am hereby elevating you to the rank of Legate.
string: 素晴らしい貢献だったな。昇進がふさわしい。この場で特使に任命しよう

original: On behalf of the Empire, and myself, please accept this gift along with your new rank.
string: 私と帝国からの感謝の印として、新しい地位とこの贈り物を受け取ってくれ

original: Congratulations.
string: おめでとう

original: However, I'm disappointed to hear that you fled from the field of battle. We do not reward cowardice in the Legion. I expect better of you.
string: しかし、戦場から逃げたと聞いて失望している。臆病者には帝国軍から報酬は出ない。もっとましな奴だと思っていたがな

original: We'll call you Ice-Veins now, for the thick blood of our land has seeped into your heart.
string: 我らが故郷の濃い血がその胸の奥まで染み通っているようだ。今より貴公を氷血の士と呼ぼう

original: Here, take this. It's an Imperial officer's sword. A fitting weapon to use against our enemy.
string: さあ、この剣を取るがいい。帝国軍将校のものだ。我らが敵に対し振るうのにおあつらえの武器よ

original: Some brothers have taken to calling you Bone-Breaker, evidence of your ferocity and determination. A fitting name. So we shall all call you thus.
string: その勇猛さと決断力の証として、同志の間で貴公を骨砕きと呼ぶ向きがある。実にふさわしい名だ。我らもそれに習うことにしよう

original: The war demands so much from us, and we give all we have to it and to the people... but I've kept a little something to offer you in appreciation.
string: 戦争があまりにも多くを要求し、我らも持てるすべてを、戦いと人々に捧げている…　とはいえ、ささやかではあるが、報酬は別に用意しておいた

original: Please take this on behalf of all the brothers and sisters.
string: すべての兄弟姉妹に成り代わって、これを受け取ってほしい

original: And I need capable and loyal warriors close at hand. So I'd like to offer you a home in Windhelm. Speak with my steward who'll make the arrangements.
string: もう一つ、有能かつ忠実な戦士は手近において然るべきだ。そこでウィンドヘルムに家を提供したい。執政と話をすれば万事取り計らってくれよう

original: Multitudes of our enemies are buried in an avalanche of pain and retribution delivered by your hands. I shall call you Snow-Hammer now.
string: 無数の敵が、その手によってもたらされた苦痛と報復の雪崩の中に沈んでいった。今より凍てつく大鎚の名で呼ばせてもらおう

original: You show great passion for battle, and compassion for those we fight for. You are becoming indispensable to our cause.
string: 戦いへの情熱と守るべき者への深い慈愛、確かに見せてもらった。我らが大義になくてはならぬ存在になりつつある

original: We do what we do out of love for our brothers and sisters. Here, take this as a token of such love reciprocated.
string: 我らが兄弟姉妹への愛情によりて、ともになすべきことをなそうぞ。今は愛が報われた一つの証としてこれを受け取ってもらいたい

original: You've become a true hero of Skyrim. I number you among my kin. You shall now be known as Stormblade.
string: 今やスカイリムの真の英雄となった。これより我が一族の列に加え、嵐の刃の名で呼び習わすものとする

original: The love of the land and her people flows from your heart, even as death to her enemies flows from your hands.
string: その心は土地とそこに住む者への愛に満ち溢れ、その手は流れるように仇なす者の死をもたらすだろう

original: On behalf of the sons and daughters of Skyrim, on behalf of all that is righteous and true, take this token of our appreciation for your service.
string: スカイリムの民、及び正義と真実の代弁者すべてに成り代わり、以下の授与をもって我らが貢献に報いる証とするものである

original: But I'm disappointed to hear you ran away from the battle. The gods do not reward cowardice. Nor do I. I expect better from you.
string: だが、戦いから逃げ出したと聞いて失望したぞ。神々も私も臆病者に報いることはない。よりよい働きを期待する

original: We found this in the Jarl's treasury after we captured the city. I thought you should be the one to have it.
string: 街を占領した後、首長の宝庫にあるのを見つけたものだ。お前に渡しておこう

original: We found this in the Jarl's treasury after we captured the capital. I thought you should be the one to have it.
string: 首都を占領した後、首長の宝庫にあるのを見つけたものだ。お前に渡しておこう

original: Found this among the dead. Something tells me I should give it to you.
string: 死体から見つけたものだ。お前が持っておくといいだろう

original: Here. I want you to have this. Don't ask. Just take it.
string: これだ。何も言わずに受け取ってくれ

original: I've come to rely on you. There's something I want you to have. It was my father's. It would be my honor if you carried it.
string: お前を信頼する事としよう。受け取ってほしい物がある。父の物だった。持っててもらえると光栄だ

original: Just how long did you expect me to keep those people distracted? I had to let the whole plan fall through.
string: 俺がどれだけ長く奴らの気をそらしておけると思った？　計画はすべて台なしだ

original: Well, at least you didn't do anything stupid. Next time, when you're given a job, don't wander off or take your sweet time.
string: お前が馬鹿な事をしでかさなかったのはせめてもの救いだ。いいか、今度仕事をもらったら寄り道したりグズグズしたりするなよ

original: I guess I shouldn't be surprised. Nothing around here has been going well lately.
string: ここのところ何一つ上手くいかなかった事を考えたら、驚くほどの事じゃないのかもな

original: Are you daft? This isn't the Dark Brotherhood! We don't go around murdering anyone, ever. It just isn't how things are done.
string: 耳が遠くなったか？　ここは闇の一党じゃないんだ！　好き勝手に人を殺し回ったりなど絶対しない。それはやり方とは呼ばんぞ

original: I guess I shouldn't be surprised. Nothing around here has been going well lately.
string: ここのところ何一つ上手くいかなかった事を考えたら、驚くほどの事じゃないのかもな

original: I guess I expected too much from you.
string: どうやらお前には期待し過ぎたようだな

original: Looks like I chose the right person for the job.
string: どうやらこの仕事に最適の人間を選べたようだな

original: Now look what you've gotten yourself into. No worries. Just sit tight. I'll find the release.
string: 自分が何に巻き込まれたかよく見ておけ。心配するな、じっとしてろ。何とかしてみる

original: She's dead! On my watch! This won't stand!
string: 死んでる！　見張っていたのに！　まさか！

original: I'm just here to provide protection for his eminence's cousin. Please, enjoy yourself.
string: 猊下のいとこをお守りするためにここへ参った。どうか、お楽しみいただきたい

original: Having a good time?
string: 楽しんでるか？

original: Oh my, yes. I absolutely love weddings. I haven't found my special someone yet, but there's still hope. Vittoria is, well, getting up in years...
string: ええ、まあ。結婚式は大好きよ。私はまだ特別な人には出会っていないけど、望みは捨てないわ。ヴィットリアは、ええ、ずっと準備中ね…

original: Am I! Free food and wine, and nobody trying to throw me in the dungeon. I wish they did weddings here every day.
string: もちろんだとも！　ただで飲み食いしても、ダンジョンに入れられる事はない。毎日が結婚式だったらいいのに

original: Not really. It's just a bunch of elders standing around, looking important. I wish something exciting would happen.
string: そうでもないよ。大人達が大勢で偉そうに突っ立ってるだけさ。何か面白いことが起こればいいのに

original: Oh. Why... why certainly. I keep telling myself I'm not losing a son, I'm gaining an Imperial. Daughter. An Imperial daughter...
string: あら、ええ、そうね。私は息子を失うわけじゃないわ。帝国人を1人手に入れるの。娘よ、帝国人の娘をね

original: No, I'm not having a good time. My boy just married a gods-forsaken Imperial. Skyrim is full of eager Nord women, and he beds down with the enemy.
string: 楽しんでなんかないさ。息子がたった今神に見捨てられたインペリアルと結婚したんだ。スカイリムには、ノルドの女性がいくらでもいるのに、息子が敵と寝室をともにしているなんて

original: The best. Vittoria's a good woman. Any man should be so lucky. I know my father's not happy about me marrying an Imperial, but that's his problem.
string: 最高だ。ヴィットリアは素晴らしい女性だ。男なら誰もが幸運に感じるだろう。自分がインペリアルと結婚した事に父が不満なのは知っているが、そんなのは問題じゃない

original: Congratulations. Quite the day, hmm?
string: おめでとう。素晴らしい日だな

original: I most certainly am not. I've just lost my daughter to a Nord beast, and my nephew Titus is too busy playing Emperor to even show up.
string: 全然だね。娘はノルドのけだものに奪われるし、おいのタイタスは皇帝の役目を果たすのに大忙しで、顔を見せにも来ない

original: I am, thank you. I do so enjoy singing at weddings. It's just one of the many duties we at the Bards College are called upon to perform.
string: ええ、ありがとう。結婚式で歌うのはとても楽しいわ。歌うのも吟遊詩人の大学での任務のひとつなの

original: So far. I just hope things remain calm. Wine gets drunk, tempers flare. This may be a joyous celebration, but it's shadowed by a lot of animosity.
string: 今のところはね。この日常が続くといいのに。ワインに酔い、感情を爆発させる。喜びに満ちてるようでも、たくさんの憎悪が影を落としているのかもね

original: Oh, yes. Presiding over the union of two lovers is one of my greatest responsibilities. It helps that Asgeir and Vittoria truly care for each other.
string: もちろんだ。愛する2人の婚姻を主宰するのは重大な我が責務のひとつ。アスゲールとヴィットリアが互いに慈しみあっているのが救いだ

original: I always leave room for the main course, Eola.
string: メインディッシュの入る余地はいつも残してあるよ、エオラ

original: Not too full on bread and wine, I hope?
string: パンとワインだけでお腹が一杯になっていないと良いのですが

original: Thank you, Lisbet. It's been such a joy to dine with you all these years.
string: ありがとう、リスベット。ずっと一緒に食事が出来てとても嬉しいですよ

original: This is lovely, as always, Eola.
string: いつもながら素晴らしいわ、エオラ

original: I never miss a good meal.
string: ご馳走には目がないんだ

original: Thank you for coming to dinner, Hogni.
string: 夕食に来て頂いてありがとう、ホグニ

original: I always preferred the liver myself. My brother had such a juicy liver.
string: 肝臓が好きなのよ。私の兄弟の肝臓は肉汁たっぷりだったわ

original: The toes are my favorite part. I hope I get to take a few home with me.
string: 足の先が好物でね。少し持ち帰れるといいんだが

original: Either way, I came back with meat for the table.
string: どちらにせよ、テーブルに戻って食事の続きだ

original: That must have been quite a surprise.
string: さぞや驚きだったろう

original: My friend Marex. We were hunting, and I thought he was an elk.
string: 友達のマレックスだ。一緒に狩りをしていた。あれはヘラジカだったと思う

original: Of course they don't count!
string: もちろん数えちゃいないさ！

original: Do dogs count?
string: イヌは数に入るのか？

original: When was your first meal, Banning?
string: バニング、初めてはいつだったんだ？

original: I'm just glad we had this, now. I was almost getting ready to eat my servant and blame it on the Forsworn.
string: こいつがいて良かったわ。使用人を始末して、フォースウォーンのせいにするつもりだったから

original: Eola is a fine host. She really keeps the faithful together.
string: エオラはしっかりもてなしてくれる。支持者をきっちりまとめ上げている

original: It's so good to have everyone around the table again.
string: 食卓にまたみんなが揃うのはうれしいわね

original: You were at Namira's feast, weren't you?
string: あなたはナミラの宴にいただろう？

original: Shh. You mustn't speak about such things away from the shrine. Only you and your dinner guests can know.
string: しーっ。聖堂の外でそういう事を言ってはダメ。あなたとお客達だけの秘密よ

original: Better if we don't talk about that. As far as anyone's concerned, we all had dinner at a nice inn along the road, and nothing strange happened.
string: その話はやめておこう。皆が考える通り、街道沿いのしゃれた宿で皆が食事をした。そして、何もおかしな事は起きなかった

original: Don't go talking about that. Only the dinner guests can know.
string: そのことは口にするな。あの宴に出席した者だけの秘密だ

original: Wait. I know you.
string: まてよ。あなたを知っているぞ

original: Ah, yes. The courier. I guess you know my secret ingredient for that spiced beef, now.
string: ああ、配達人か。あのスパイスを振った牛肉に使用している秘密の材料がバレてしまったようだな

original: You buy a war dog from me? There's a reason why my hounds are so eager to bite into people.
string: 軍用犬を買うかい？　この犬達が人間にかみつきたがるのには理由があるんだ

original: That's right. You're the sellsword. Thank you again. It's so nice to have help with my husband gone. Shame what happened to him.
string: ご明察ね、いつぞやの傭兵さん。改めてお礼を言わせて。夫の件で手を貸してくれてありがとう。彼には可哀想なことになったけど

original: One of my customers? Did you know I inherited the store from my late husband? Shame what happened to him. He had such good taste.
string: うちのお客かしら。死んだ夫から店を受け継いだのよ、知ってた？　彼に起きた事は本当に残念。味わい深い人だったのに

original: "The bloodiest beef in the Reach!" Ha ha ha.
string: “リーチでいちばん血の滴る牛肉だ！”わっはっはっは

original: Praise to you, champion!
string: 誉れあれ、勝者よ！

original: Ah, the new disciple. I hear you have quite the appetite.
string: ああ、新入りか。なかなかの食欲だと聞いてるぞ

original: It's an honor, Keeper of the Ring.
string: 光栄です、指輪の番人よ

original: You've brought us quite the meal.
string: すばらしいご馳走を持ってきてくれたのですね

original: You were given Namira's ring? A great honor.
string: ナミラの指輪を与えられたのか？　大変な名誉だな

original: I remember my first feast. I envy you.
string: 最初の宴を思い出す。実に羨ましい

original: I'm so glad Eola invited you to dinner.
string: エオラがあなたを夕食に招いてくれてうれしいわ

original: Namira spoke to you? I knew this feast was going to be something.
string: ナミラと話したのか？　やはりこの宴はただの宴じゃ終わらなかったな

original: Now this is going to be a good feast.
string: すばらしい宴になりそうだな

original: You there. Are you here to kill me? Slay the mighty Logrolf while he sits tied and helpless?
string: おい、お前。私を殺しにきたのか？　縛られて無力な勇者ログロルフを殺そうってのか？

original: Do you need any help?
string: 何か力になれることは？

original: I was actually just about to head on inside. Be good to have someone watch my back.
string: 実は中に踏み込もうとしていたところなんだ。援護してもらえると助かる

original: Follow me, and keep your eyes open. Daedra are powerful creatures and tricksters. Never know what you'll find.
string: ついてきてくれ、警戒を怠るなよ。デイドラは手強い化け物で、人を惑わそうとする。何が起こるか分からないからな

original: No, I haven't.
string: いや、見たことない

original: Seems no one in this city has.
string: この街の誰も見たことがないらしい

original: Excuse me, but do you know anything about this house? Seen anyone enter or leave?
string: 失礼、この家について何か知っていることは？　誰かが出入りするのを見たとか？

original: It's abandoned and it's always been abandoned.
string: ここは見捨てられた。今もなお見捨てられている

original: I can't afford that right now.
string: 今はそんなに持っていない

original: On second thought, maybe I'll wait a bit longer to decide.
string: よく考えてみたが、もう少し決定に時間をかけたい

original: I'll take it.
string: それで構わない

original: I can't afford that right now.
string: 今はそんなに持っていない

original: On second thought, maybe I'll wait a bit longer to decide.
string: よく考えてみたが、もう少し決定に時間をかけたい

original: I'll take it.
string: それで構わない

original: I can't afford that right now.
string: 今はそんなに持っていない

original: On second thought, perhaps I'll wait a bit longer to decide.
string: よく考えてみたが、もう少し決定に時間をかけたい

original: I'll take it.
string: それで構わない

original: I would like to purchase a house in the city. (<Global=HPWindhelm> gold)
string: この街で家を買いたいんだ(<Global=HPWindhelm> ゴールド)

original: There is an empty home in the city, but there was some... unpleasantness recently. I'm afraid it's not available just yet.
string: 街に空き家はあるんだが、ちょっと…　最近良くない事件があったものでね。悪いが住むのはまだ無理だよ

original: I'd like to purchase a house in the city. (<Global=HPMarkarth> gold)
string: この街で家を買いたい(<Global=HPMarkarth> ゴールド)

original: I'd like to purchase a house in the city. (<Global=HPRiften> gold)
string: この街で家を買いたい(<Global=HPRiften> ゴールド)

original: I can't afford that right now.
string: 今はそんなに持っていない

original: On second thought, maybe I'll wait a bit longer to decide.
string: よく考えてみたが、もう少し決定に時間をかけたい

original: I'll take it.
string: それで構わない

original: I'd like to purchase a house in the city. (<Global=HPWhiterun> gold)
string: この街で家を買いたい(<Global=HPWhiterun> ゴールド)

original: I'll buy everything you've dug up.
string: 掘り出した物はすべて買い取ろう

original: I have ore to sell.
string: 鉱石を売りたい

original: I have corundum ore to sell.
string: 鋼玉の鉱石を売りたい

original: I have ebony ore to sell.
string: 黒檀の鉱石を売りたい

original: I have gold ore to sell.
string: 金鉱石を売りたい

original: I have iron ore to sell.
string: 鉄の鉱石を売りたい

original: I have malachite ore to sell.
string: クジャク石の鉱石を売りたい

original: I have moonstone ore to sell.
string: 月長石の鉱石を売りたい

original: I have orichalcum ore to sell.
string: オリハルコンの鉱石を売りたい

original: I have quicksilver ore to sell.
string: 水銀の鉱石を売りたい

original: I have silver ore to sell.
string: 銀の鉱石を売りたい

original: Mining is hard work, but we pay a fair price for any ore you dig up.
string: 鉱山労働はきついが、掘り出した鉱石には正当な額を払うぞ

original: Are you looking to work? The mines are nearby. You bring me ore, I'll give you coin.
string: 仕事を探しているのか？　近くに鉱山がある。鉱石を採ってくれば小遣いをやるぞ

original: I have wheat to sell.
string: 小麦を売りたい

original: We could always use help picking crops if you need a few extra coins.
string: 少し稼ぎたいなら、収穫の手伝いが手頃だよ

original: Well. You must have all those annoying gods on your side to have made it this far, whoever you are. Even I have to admit, that's pretty impressive.
string: なるほど、お前はうるさい神々を味方につけているようだな。誰だか知らんが、ここまでたどり着くとは大したものだ。認めてやろう

original: You had your chance to talk!
string: もう話す機会はやったぞ！

original: What is this? Have I been poisoned?
string: これは何だ？ 毒を盛られたのか？

original: In a sense, but no more poisoned than a fool after too much wine.
string: ある意味ではそうだ。だが、たんまり酒を飲んだ愚か者ほど毒を盛られてはいない

original: What do you want with me?
string: 何が望みだ？

original: I have watched you for some time, you know. The decisions you've made intrigue me, and I wonder if you are the proper agent for a task of mine.
string: しばらく見ていたのだ。お前が下したいくつかの決断は、なかなか興味深かった。仕事を任せてもいいと思えるほどに

original: What's going on?
string: 何が起こっている？

original: Breathe deep, mortal. I would have you hear me well, so let these vapors fill your lungs.
string: 定命の者よ、深く息を吸え。我が呼び声をよく聞くのだ。さあ、この煙でお前の肺を満たせ

original: You're going to make me a werewolf?
string: ウェアウルフにするつもりか？

original: Oh, no. Only the Circle have the beastblood. Prove your honor to be a Companion.
string: いや。ビーストブラッドを持つのはサークルの者だけだ。己の高潔さを仲間に示してみろ

original: "Eyes on the prey, not the horizon."
string: “地平ではなく、獲物を見よ”

original: No, only members of the Circle get this blessing. Right now we're just seeing if you're worth keeping around.
string: いいえ、サークルのメンバーしかこの恩恵は受けられない。今は、お前を生かしておく価値があるかどうか品定めしてるところだ

original: What was that?
string: あれは何だったんだ？

original: It's a blessing given to some of us. We can be like wild beasts. Fearsome.
string: 我々に与えられる祝福だ。野生の獣のように、恐ろしい存在になれる

original: Come on now, you're a sharp one. You must have heard of werewolves before.
string: しっかりしてよ。切れ者なんでしょう？　ウェアウルフのことは聞いたことがあるはずよ

original: It's a blessing given to the most honored of the Companions.
string: 同胞団の中で、最も栄誉ある者に与えられる恩恵のことよ

original: I'm... I'm sorry you had to see that.
string: あれを…　見せたのは悪かったわ

original: I hope I didn't scare you.
string: 怖がらせてしまったらすまない

original: The answer ain't gonna be any different the next time. Arrogant elven bastard.
string: 答えは次も同じだ。横柄なエルフ野郎が

original: Your lack of cooperation has been noted. We'll be back if we require further information. You won't get a second chance.
string: 非協力的なのはよく分かった。また聞きたい事があったら戻ってくるとしよう。次は気をつける事だ

original: You'd better clear out before someone gets hurt.
string: 誰かが怪我する前に立ち去れ

original: No. Not yet.
string: いや。まだだ

original: You're in the wrong place to be asking those kind of questions, pal.
string: そんな事をここで聞くのか？

original: Where is he? The one who was asking about the fugitive hiding in the Ratway?
string: 奴はどこだ？　ラットウェイに隠れているという逃亡者について嗅ぎ回っていた奴は？

original: Let's go
string: 行こう

original: I don't have time right now.
string: 今は忙しいんだ

original: Fine, but I've locked the door so don't think you're getting in there without me.
string: いいよ、でも扉の鍵を閉めたから、俺がいないとそこには入れないと思うけど

original: No offense, I mean I'm sure you aren't into any of that kind of stuff.
string: 悪く取らないでくれよ、君はこんな類の問題に首を突っ込んだことなんてないだろうから

original: My aunt went in after him, but she hasn't come out yet and I'm afraid to go in by myself.
string: 叔母があいつの後に続いて入っていったんだけど、まだ出てこないんだ。ひとりで入るのは怖くて

original: My aunt went in after him, but she hasn't come out yet and I don't think I can take him by myself.
string: 叔母があいつの後に続いて入っていったんだけど、まだ出てこないんだ。俺ひとりではあいつをやっつけられないと思うし

original: Who's in the tomb?
string: 墓にいるのは誰だ？

original: Vals Veran. My family has never really seen eye to eye with him and he has finally gone off the deep end.
string: ヴァルズ・ヴェランだ。俺の家族はこいつとはうまくいったためしがなくてね。そうしたらついに、前後の見境をなくしやがった

original: He's gone in to defile our family tomb by using our ancestors for his filthy dark elf necromancy.
string: けがらわしいダークエルフの死霊術のためにうちの祖先を使って、家族の墓を汚したんだ

original: Can you help me? He's in the tomb doing Gods know what with my dead relatives.
string: 手を貸してくれないか？　墓に入って、俺の亡くなった親族に対して訳の分からんことをやってる奴がいるんだ

original: I can't afford that right now.
string: 今はそんなに持っていない

original: On second thought, maybe I'll wait a bit longer to decide.
string: よく考えてみたが、もう少し決定に時間をかけたい

original: I'll take it.
string: それで構わない

original: I'd like to purchase a house in the city. (<Global=HPSolitude> gold)
string: この街で家を買いたい(<Global=HPSolitude> ゴールド)

original: It will keep it's hands to itself, yes?
string: 自分の心配をしてればいいのよ。でしょ？

original: Umm... are you in trouble? Is that why you're hiding like that?
string: ええと…　何か困ってる？　それでそんな風に隠れてるの？

original: I hope you're not planning on picking my pocket.
string: 何か盗むつもりじゃないですよね？

original: What? Why are you skulking about like that?
string: 何ですか？　なぜそんなふうにコソコソしているの？

original: Look at you, up to no good.
string: ちょっとあんた、よからぬ事を企んでるね

original: You remind me of the Shadowscales, from the old histories.
string: シャドウスケールに似ているな。まあ、遠い昔の話だ

original: Are you playing hide and seek?
string: かくれんぼをしているの？

original: I trust you aren't considering any... thievery.
string: 窃盗なんて…　まさか考えていないだろうな

original: You're not a thief trying to rob me, right?
string: 何かを盗もうってんじゃないだろうな？

original: You trying to hide? 'Cause I can see you plain as day.
string: 隠れたいのか？　丸見えだぞ

original: You're a bad sneak. You're not creeping up on anybody like that.
string: お前は忍び寄りが下手だな。そんな事では誰にも近寄れないぞ

original: You, my friend, need practice...
string: 友よ、練習が必要みたいだな…

original: Are you a member of the College, or did you just steal those robes from a real wizard?
string: 大学の人？　それとも本物のウィザードからその服を盗んできたの？

original: You must be one of those wizards. From the College in Winterhold.
string: あなた、ウィンターホールド大学から来たウィザードの一人でしょ

original: Wow! Look at that robe. Are you a wizard?
string: わあ！　かっこいいローブだね。ウィザードなの？

original: Those are College of Winterhold robes, aren't they?
string: それはウィンターホールド大学のローブだろ？

original: Fancy robes. You a wizard or somethin'?
string: いいローブだ。ウィザードなのか？

original: I like your robes. Are you a sorcerer? From the College?
string: いいローブだな。妖術師か？　大学から来たのかい？

original: dunRannveigQSTLOSTTOCOMBAT
string: dunRannveigQSTLOSTTOCOMBAT

original: dunRannveigQSTBLEEDOUT
string: dunRannveigQSTBLEEDOUT

original: dunRannveigQSTSHARED01
string: dunRannveigQSTSHARED01

original: I'm sorry! This isn't what I want!
string: すまない！　こんなはずじゃなかった！

original: I don't want to do this!
string: やりたくない！

original: I don't have any choice! I'm sorry!
string: 仕方がないんだ！　すまない！

original: Is someone there? Stay back! I don't want to attack you.
string: 誰かいるのか？　下がれ！　攻撃はしたくない

original: Stay away!
string: 近づくな！

original: Stay back or I'll be forced to attack you!
string: 近づくな！　さもないと攻撃するぞ！

original: No matter. Another one will be along any time now.
string: 構わないさ。そろそろ次の者が来るだろう

original: Well...that's disappointing. This one didn't survive the fall either.
string: やれやれ…　がっかりだな。この者も落下に耐えられなかったか

original: I'll meet you at Karthspire.
string: カーススパイアーで会おう

original: Very good. I'll trust you to get there in one piece. Don't be long.
string: よかろう。たどり着けたら、デルフィンと一緒にそこで待っている。だが遅れるな。アルドゥインは日増しに強くなっている

original: Your call. Might be safer to travel separately - attract less attention that way.
string: 分かったわ。別行動の方が安全かも知れない。目立ちにくいかも知れないわね

original: Don't worry, I'll get Esbern there in one piece. We'll wait for you near Karthspire. Good luck.
string: 心配しないで、無事にエズバーンを連れて行くわ。カーススパイアーの近くで待ってる。幸運を祈るわ

original: How do we find the entrance to Sky Haven Temple?
string: スカイ・ヘヴン聖堂の入り口はどう見つければいい？

original: The Akaviri blood seal can only be opened with the right kind of blood. Your blood, Dragonborn.
string: アカヴィリの血の印は、それに相応しい血によってのみ解かれる。つまりお前の血だ、ドラゴンボーンよ

original: We should be careful. There's no telling what traps and wards the ancient Blades may have set.
string: 警戒はすべきだ。古代のブレイズがどんな罠やシールドを設置しているか分からないからな

original: The entrance must be past the Forsworn camp. Look for a canyon or cave entrance into the Karthspire.
string: 入り口はフォースウォーンの野営地を過ぎたところに違いない。カーススパイアーに通じる峡谷か洞窟の入り口を探すのだ

original: Ah, yes. The entrance seems to be near what's now known as the Karthspire. We'll have to see what we find when we arrive.
string: ああ、そうだな。入り口は今ではカーススパイアーとして知られる場所の近くだと見られている。そこへ着いたら探してみよう

original: How do we get to Sky Haven Temple?
string: スカイ・ヘヴン聖堂にはどうやって入る？

original: I met your brother.
string: 兄弟に会った

original: Maul? Yeah. That jerk works for Maven Black-Briar now. Left me down here watching this garbage heap.
string: モールか？　ああ、アイツは今、メイビン・ブラック・ブライアのところで働いてるんだったな。このゴミ溜めの見える場所に俺を残して

original: I guess he's better at all that talking stuff anyway. I'd just mess everything up.
string: 奴は話が上手だったろう？　俺はめちゃくちゃにしてしまうがな

original: Forget I mentioned it.
string: 言った事は忘れてくれ

original: Already did.
string: もう忘れたよ

original: I think it's hilarious. You got a problem? (Intimidate)
string: バカバカしいと思っただけだ。何か問題があるか？ (威圧)

original: No, no. Sorry if I sounded so mean there. My brother always said I have a big mouth.
string: いやいや、意地悪く聞こえたなら謝る。兄弟にはいつもしゃべり過ぎと言われてたんだ

original: Here, have one on me.
string: ほら、俺のおごりだ

original: Yeah, my problem is I'm too tired to punch your face in.
string: 問題は、あんたの顔を殴るには疲れすぎちまったって事だ

original: No way. That name would scare anyone. (Persuade)
string: まさか。皆が恐れるだろう(説得)

original: Oh yeah? I think so too. You're pretty smart.
string: そうか？　確かにそうだな。あんたは頭がいい

original: Hey, here. Have one on the house.
string: ほら、店のおごりだよ

original: Good. Now shut up and get out of my face.
string: 結構。口を閉じてさっさと失せろ

original: Why do they call you Dirge?
string: なぜディルジと呼ばれている？

original: They call me Dirge, 'cause I'm the last thing you hear before they put you in the ground.
string: 死をいたむ歌という意味だ。オレの名は誰もが死ぬ前に聞く最後の言葉だからさ

original: Why? You think it's funny or something?
string: なぜだって？　何かおかしいか？

original: What, you still think it's funny?
string: まだおかしいとでも？

original: About your name...
string: 名前についてだが…

original: I already told you. They call me Dirge, 'cause I'm the last thing you hear before they put you in the ground.
string: もう話したろう。皆が俺を“ディルジ”と呼ぶのは、それが死ぬ前に聞く最後の言葉だからさ

original: Remind me, why do they call you Dirge?
string: 確認だが、なぜディルジと呼ばれている？

original: Any news involving the Dark Brotherhood?
string: 闇の一党について何か情報は？

original: The only thing I heard is a rumor that a boy named Aventus Aretino, in Windhelm, has been attempting to contact the Dark Brotherhood.
string: ウィンドヘルムのアベンタス・アレティノって名前の少年が、闇の一党に接触しようとしたって噂は聞いたな

original: He used to live here in Riften at the Orphanage on the other side of town but I think he ran away. Can't say I blame him.
string: そいつはリフテンの向こう側にある孤児院で暮らしてたんだが、逃げ出したらしい。まあ、気持ちは分かるよ

original: Old Nord sacrifice place. Be careful around here. Let's look for a way to open the bars.
string: ノルドがかつて犠牲になった場所だ。この辺では注意した方がいい。牢屋を開く方法を探そう

original: Ah, the ceremonial juncture. The old Nords used to do sacrifices here. Look around for a way to open those bars.
string: ああ、儀式用の接合点ね。昔のノルドはここで生贄を捧げたものよ。鉄格子を開ける方法を見つけてちょうだい

original: It comforts me to know that, Bolgeir.
string: それを知って安心したわ、ボルゲール

original: No disrespect toward the general, but sometimes I wonder if he's got your best interests at heart.
string: 将軍をけなすわけではないが、あなたの最優先の望みを理解しているか、時々心配になる

original: In any case he won't be turnin' me into no Imperial soldier. I know my place, and it's at your side.
string: どんな事があっても、帝国軍の兵士になる事はない。私はあなたの味方だ

original: I'm aware of that, Bolgeir, and I appreciate your dedication.
string: 気づいていたわ、ボルゲール。お前の献身には感謝している

original: However, if we lose the war, the guardsmen of Solitude will make little difference in the end.
string: ともあれ、戦争に負ければ、ソリチュードの衛兵隊もたいした違いをもたらさない

original: Told you that, did he?
string: 言っただろう、彼が？

original: I'm sworn to protect you, my Jarl, but I'm the last line of defense.
string: 首長、あなたを守ると誓ったが、私が最後の砦だ

original: The first line is the walls around this city and the men who patrol them.
string: 最初の守りは街を囲む壁と、見回りの者達だ

original: Men who, I might add, we're precious short on.
string: 言っておくが、人員はとても足りていない

original: Yes, I know. The general acted with my blessing.
string: ええ、分かっている。将軍は私の許可を得て行動していた

original: It is vital that we bring Ulfric to justice, but that cannot happen until his army of Stormcloaks is defeated utterly.
string: ウルフリックには必ずや裁きを受けさせなければならない。しかし、ストームクロークの軍を徹底的に叩くまで、それは不可能です

original: We lost another five guardsmen, my Jarl.
string: 首長、衛兵をまた5名失った

original: If General Tullius continues to conscript our men and send them off to battle, we'll have none left to protect the city.
string: テュリウス将軍が指揮を続けて、兵を戦地に送り込み続けたら、街を守る者がいなくなるだろう

original: Yes, my Jarl.
string: ああ、首長

original: Oh, very well. I can see there's no changing your stubborn Nord minds.
string: ええ、分かったわ。頑固なノルドの考え方は変わらないようですね

original: But when this war is won, I will have my parade!
string: しかし、この戦争に勝利したらパレードをするわ！

original: I must protest, my Jarl.
string: それには反対だ、首長

original: A parade would make you an easy target for a Stormcloak assassin. You're safer here in the palace.
string: パレードをすれば、ストームクロークの暗殺者に絶好の標的となる。宮殿にいた方が安全だ

original: What a... fine idea, my Jarl. However, I would suggest we wait until the war has ended.
string: 素晴らしい…　お考えです、首長。ですが、戦争が終わるまで待った方がいいのではないでしょうか

original: After all, the General needs his soldiers out in the field, fighting battles against the Stormcloaks.
string: 結局のところ、将軍にはストームクロークとの戦いのために、戦場に出る兵士が必要でしょうから

original: Steward, I have an idea that might help to bolster the morale of our people in this difficult time.
string: 執政よ、この困難な時期に人々の士気を鼓舞する方法を思いついたの

original: I think we shall have a grand parade, and let General Tullius march his troops from the Blue Palace to Castle Dour in all their finery.
string: ブルー・パレスからドール城まで豪華なパレードを行って、きれいに着飾ったテュリウス将軍と彼の部隊に行進してもらいましょう

original: I will make the arrangements, my Jarl.
string: 手配いたします、首長

original: There's no need for an apology, and you're right about the war.
string: 謝罪の必要はないし、戦争に関しては間違っていない

original: Perhaps this is a matter best discussed with with the general in person.
string: おそらくは、将軍と個人的に議論するのが一番いい

original: My apologies, Jarl Elisif. I was thinking only of the importance of the war effort.
string: 申し訳ない、エリシフ首長。戦争の重要性についてしか考えていなかった

original: General Tullius does not run this city, Thane Erikur. Or have you forgotten your oaths of fealty?
string: 従士エリクール、テュリウス将軍はこの街を支配していない。あるいは、忠義の誓いをお忘れになったか？

original: General Tullius will never allow that. He's ordered all surplus food to be given over for the war effort.
string: テュリウス将軍は絶対に許可しないだろう。余剰の食料はすべて戦争のために供出するよう命じている

original: A wise course of action, my Jarl. However, we have little food or water to spare.
string: 賢明な行動です、首長。ですが、我々にはほとんど食料も水も残されていません

original: Steward Falk, I have a task for you.
string: 執政ファルク、頼みたい事がある

original: I want to begin stockpiling food and water in the event we come under siege, and I would like you to oversee this work personally.
string: 包囲された場合に備えて、食料と水の備蓄を始めたい。お前に、その作業を個人的に監督してもらいます

original: Stop it, both of you. You're acting like children.
string: 二人ともやめて。子供みたいよ

original: I should very much like to see you try it, my dear steward.
string: ぜひともお試し頂きたいものですわ、執政さん

original: Hold your tongue, Wizard, or you're likely to lose it.
string: 黙ってろ、ウィザード。さもなければその舌を引っこ抜くぞ

original: Oh, I'm sorry, did I imply that you'd be meeting for purposes other than court business? You must forgive me.
string: あら、ごめんなさい。宮廷のお仕事以外でお目にかかるようなことを言ったかしら？　許して下さいね

original: I beg your pardon?
string: 何だと？

original: Oh, well done. Very subtle.
string: まあ、よくやったわね。ちょっと微妙だけど

original: Is it that time again already?
string: もうそんな時間なの？

original: Very well, let's meet this evening and make the arrangements.
string: いいわ。今夜会って、準備しましょう

original: It's nearly time to collect taxes on your properties here in the city, Bryling.
string: そろそろ、この街の所有地に対する税金を徴収する時期だ、ブライリング

original: We'll need to visit each home for an assessment.
string: 家々を訪ねて査定しなければ

original: Have faith, Bryling. When this war is over and Ulfric is dead, you'll see that you were jumping at shadows, and nothing more.
string: 信じるんだ、ブライリング。この戦争が終わってウルフリックが死ねば、君は疑心暗鬼に陥っているだけで、それ以上のことは何もないんだと分かるだろう

original: Yes, of course, but Ulfric's message is a powerful one. More of our people flock to his cause every day.
string: もちろんよ。でもウルフリックの言葉には力がある。彼の大義の下に結集する人が日に日に増えてるの

original: We don't have the luxury of hanging back to see who wins before choosing our friends, Bryling. You know this.
string: 友達を選ぶ前に、誰が勝つか一歩引いて見定めるような贅沢は許されていないんだ、ブライリング。知ってるだろう

original: And besides, no Nord with a shred of honor would consider it. We're no cowards.
string: それに、名誉のかけらでも持っているノルドなら、そんなことを考えることすらないだろう。俺達は臆病者ではない

original: You know that I support the Empire, as we all do. However, I fear General Tullius is underestimating the Stormcloaks.
string: 私も皆と同じ帝国支持派なのは知ってるわよね。でも、テュリウス将軍はストームクロークを見くびってるんじゃないかしら

original: Too often the general has lost good soldiers because he did not take Ulfric and his men seriously.
string: ウルフリックと部下達をなめてかかったせいで、将軍は優秀な兵士をことごとく失ったわ

original: If this continues, and the worst comes to pass, Solitude will pay the price. The Empire is headquartered here, after all.
string: こんなことが続いたら最悪の事態になるわ。代償を払うのはソリチュードよ。どのみち、帝国の本拠地はここなんだから

original: Speak your mind, Bryling. You're among friends here.
string: 意見を言ってみろ、ブライリング。ここにいるのはみんな友達なんだから

original: There's something that's been troubling me, Falk. I am hesitant to share it, but I feel that I must.
string: 困ってることがあるの、ファルク。言いたくないけど、言わなきゃいけないわ

original: The Jarl would be wise to remember that it is her thanes - and my profits - that are paying for this war.
string: 首長は覚えておいた方がいい。従士、そして私の収益が、戦費をまかなっているとな

original: We know full well about your investment in shipping ventures, Erikur.
string: 出荷事業に対する君の投資については十分承知しているよ、エリクール

original: I've also heard troubling rumors about dealings between you and the crew of that pirate ship, the Red Wave.
string: また、レッドウェーブという海賊船の乗組員と取引をしているという、ちょっと困った噂も耳にした

original: Thankfully, Jarl Elisif cares far less about your lost profits than she does about winning the war!
string: ありがたいことに、エリシフ首長は戦争に勝つことで頭がいっぱいで、君が失った利益などまったく気には留めていないがね！

original: Then let's increase the taxes on the farms and merchants. We can't afford to lose the loyalty of the ship captains.
string: それなら農場と商人への課税を増やそうじゃないか。船長達の忠誠を失うわけにはいかない

original: General Tullius needs more money for the war effort. We need the funds to arm and provision more troops.
string: テュリウス将軍はこの戦争のためにさらに資金を必要としている。より多くの軍隊に武器や食糧を供給するための資金が必要だ

original: I've heard the Empire plans to levy a tax on our trading ships. Falk, you've got to do something about this.
string: 帝国は俺達の貿易船に課税しようとしていると聞いた。ファルク、何とかしてくれ

original: If you really are Dragonborn, like out of the old tales, you ought to be able to Shout. Can you? Have you tried?
string: もしお前が古い物語にある本物のドラゴンボーンなら、シャウトを使えるはずだ。どうだ？　試した事はあるか？

original: Go ahead... try to Shout.
string: やってみろ…　シャウトするんだ

original: Have you tried to Shout?
string: シャウトを試した事はあるか？

original: They say the Dragonborn can Shout without any training. Like Talos himself...
string: ドラゴンボーンは、訓練なしでシャウトする事ができるそうだ。タロスのようにな…

original: Here's a dead dragon, and that's something I definitely understand. Now we know we can kill them.
string: ドラゴンが死んでるわ。これではっきりしたわね。奴らは殺す事ができるのよ

original: That was Shouting, what you just did! Must be. You really are Dragonborn, then...
string: たった今お前がやったのが、“シャウト”だ！　間違いない。お前は本物のドラゴンボーンのようだな…

original: But I don't need some mythical Dragonborn. Someone who can put down a dragon is more than enough for me.
string: でも、神話に出てくるドラゴンボーンは必要ないの。ドラゴンを倒せるような人は手に余るわ

original: Hmph. Some of you would be better off keeping quiet than flapping your gums on matters you don't know anything about.
string: フン。何も分からない事について話すより、離れておとなしくしてた方がいいわ

original: Come on, Irileth, tell us, do you believe in this Dragonborn business?
string: 頼むよ、イリレス、教えてくれ。ドラゴンボーンの話を信じるのか？

original: What do you say, Irileth? You're being awfully quiet.
