string: 盾の兄弟と並び立つには、まず自分の足だけで立つ事だ

original: I'm sending you to Serpentstone Island. If you survive, you pass. If you die, well, you weren't going to be much use to me anyway.
string: 蛇石の島で、生き残る事ができれば合格だ。できなければ用はない

original: What's at Serpentstone Island?
string: 蛇石の島には何がある？

original: It's where men have tested their mettle for ages.
string: 己の勇気を試す場所だ

original: There's a strange rock formation, built by the ancients. Something about that place attracts the Ice Wraiths.
string: 太古の人々によって造られた奇妙な岩が立ち並び、氷の生霊達がそこへ引き寄せられている

original: You kill an Ice Wraith out there, and I'll have all the proof I need about you.
string: 氷の生霊を倒せば、お前を認めてやろう

original: What kind of test?
string: どんな試練なんだ？

original: The kind men use to measure themselves.
string: 己の力を知るための試練だ

original: I can handle anything you throw at me.
string: どんな事でもやってのけるよ

original: That's what I like to hear.
string: いい心がけだ

original: So long as you can back up those words with steel.
string: その信念を忘れるなよ

original: I'm not sure you belong here, friend.
string: 本当にここの一員なのか？

original: Hmm. Helgen, eh? Ulfric told us quite the story. If you made it through all that, you're likely worth something to me.
string: ううむ。ヘルゲンか？　ウルフリックから話は聞いている。もし切り抜けたのならば、それなりに当てにできそうだな

original: Are you ready to for Serpentstone Island?
string: 蛇石の島に行く準備はできたか？

original: About that test...
string: 試練のことだが…

original: I'm always looking for able fighters. Not everyone can say they made it out of Helgen.
string: 有能な戦士は常に探している。誰もがヘルゲンを脱出できる訳ではないからな

original: Seems we're all branded villains these days...
string: かつては皆、札付きの悪党と扱われたものだ…

original: So long as your criminal past stays in the past, and you fight for me with honor and integrity, we'll welcome you into our ranks.
string: 罪深き過去を捨て、今より名誉と高潔さを保って我が方のために戦うがいい。我々はお前を歓迎しよう

original: Destined for the chopping block if I'm not mistaken.
string: どうも、いつも逃げ場がなくなるようだな

original: I was set free. I could've gone anywhere. I came here to fight the Empire.
string: 釈放されたので、どこへでも行ける。ここに来たのは帝国と戦うためだ

original: A fair point... Well, you've come to the right place, then. Speak with Galmar.
string: もっともなことだ…　なるほど、うってつけの場所に来たな。今からガルマルと話してくれ

original: I was at Helgen.
string: ヘルゲンにいた

original: Ahhh. Yes...
string: ああ、そういえば…

original: I believe we've already met.
string: 前に会ったことがある

original: Is that so...?
string: そうだったか…？

original: Ah yes, you were with us at Helgen.
string: ああ、ヘルゲンで一緒だったな

original: I remember you... You were at Helgen with us! Come to join the war? Speak with Galmar. He handles the new recruits.
string: 思い出したぞ…　確かヘルゲンにいたな！　戦争に加わるのか？　ならガルマルと話してくれ。新兵の担当だ

original: Only the foolish or the courageous approach a Jarl without summons...
string: 呼ばれてもいないのに首長へ近づくのは愚か者か勇者だけだぞ…

original: Do I know you?
string: どこかで会ったか？

original: As you can see, I have much that requires my attention. If you're inclined to gab, there are some nice prison guards you may like to meet...
string: 見てのとおり、目を配るべき事柄が無数にあってな。どうしてもおしゃべりがしたければ、親切な看守達が相手になってくれるぞ…

original: Aye. But in the meantime, we have a war to plan.
string: そうだ。だがその間に、戦争の準備を進める

original: I would gladly retire from the world were such a day to dawn.
string: 世界が夜明けの時を迎えたなら、喜んで身を引こう

original: Your words give voice to what we all feel, Ulfric. And that's why you will be High King.
string: ウルフリック、お前の言葉は皆の心に届いた。だからこそ、お前が上級王になるべきだ

original: But the day words are enough, will be the day when soldiers like us are no longer needed.
string: 我々のような戦士が必要なくなる日が来れば、その言葉だけで人々は救われるのだ

original: I fight so that all the fighting I've already done hasn't been for nothing.
string: 私は戦う。今までの戦いを無駄にしないために

original: I fight... because I must.
string: 私は戦う…　他に道なきがゆえに

original: I fight for we few who did come home, only to find our country full of strangers wearing familiar faces.
string: 私は戦う。故郷に帰れぬ者のために、親しげな顔をまとったよそ者が溢れる国を目の当たりにするしかなかった者のために

original: I fight for my people impoverished to pay the debts of an Empire too weak to rule them, yet brands them criminals for wanting to rule themselves!
string: 私は戦う。我が民を導く力も持たぬ帝国に、統治を求めた者に犯罪者の烙印を捺すような者達に対し、債務を払い、困窮させられた民のために

original: I fight for the men I've held in my arms, dying on foreign soil.
string: 私は戦う。我が手にすべてを委ね、異邦の地で倒れて行った人々のために

original: I fight for their wives and children, who's names I heard whispered in their last breaths.
string: 私は戦う。彼らの口より最後の吐息とともに漏れ聞こえた妻子の名のために

original: I'll die before elves dictate the fates of men. Are we not one in this?
string: エルフが人間の運命を支配する前に、死ぬつもりだ。皆もそうだろう？

original: Yes, but why do you fight? If not for me, what then?
string: ああ、しかしなぜお前は戦う？　私のためでないとしたら、何ゆえに？

original: I'd follow you into the depths of Oblivion, you know that.
string: オブリビオンの底までついて行くぞ

original: Well put, friend. Tell me, Galmar, why do you fight for me?
string: そうだな、友よ…　教えてくれガルマル、お前は何のために戦う？

original: How many of their sons and daughters follow your banner? We are their families.
string: 彼らの内の何人が、お前の旗についてきた？　我々は彼らの家族だ

original: They have families to think of.
string: 彼らには大切な家族がいるのだ

original: What's left of Skyrim to wager?
string: スカイリムの何を賭けるつもりだ？

original: We've been soldiers a long time. We know the price of freedom. The people are still weighing things in their hearts.
string: 長い間兵士をしていると自由の価値を思い知る。民はまだ心の中で天びんに掛けていよう

original: Then let them die with their false kings.
string: 虚偽の王に仕えたまま、死なせてやればいい

original: Many I fear still need convincing.
string: もっと多く、確たるものが必要だ

original: The people are behind you.
string: 民はお前の味方だ

original: Things hinge on Whiterun. If we can take the city without bloodshed all the better. But if not...
string: 事はホワイトランにて決する。もしも流血沙汰なしで街が手に入るなら万事よし。さもなくば…

original: We're ready when you are.
string: そちらの準備ができたら行ける

original: Torygg was merely a message to the other Jarls. Whoever we replace them with will need the support of our armies.
string: トリグの件は他の首長に向けた意思表示にすぎぬ。誰にすげ替えるにしても軍の支持が必要だ

original: I still say you should take them all out like you did Deadking Torygg.
string: 死んだトリグ王の時のように、奴らを皆殺しにすべきだ

original: Soon.
string: すぐにだ

original: So we're ready to start this war in earnest then?
string: 戦争を始める準備が本当にできているのか？

original: Taking his city and leaving him in disgrace would make a more powerful statement, don't you think?
string: 奴から街を取り上げ、惨めに捨て置くというのは、より強い態度の表明になるとは思わぬか？

original: If by message you mean shoving a sword through his gullet.
string: その伝言とやらは、喉に剣を突き立てる事か

original: You think I need to send Balgruuf a stronger message.
string: バルグルーフに対して強い態度を示す必要があると思うか…

original: You think I need to send Hrongar a stronger message.
string: フロンガルに対して強い態度を示す必要があると思うのか…

original: How long are you going to wait?
string: いつまで待つつもりだ？

original: He knows that. They all know that.
string: 彼…　いや、彼ら全員が知っている

original: If he's not with us, he's against us.
string: 仲間じゃないなら、敵とみなせ

original: Don't be so sure of that. We've intercepted couriers from Solitude. The Empire's putting a great deal of pressure on Whiterun.
string: 過信はよくない。我々はソリチュードのスパイを捕まえた。帝国はホワイトランに圧力をかけているようだ

original: He's a true Nord. He'll come around.
string: あの男は真のノルドだ。来るだろう

original: Balgruuf won't give us a straight answer.

original: There are no expectations. This College is a place to study and practice magic freely.

original: Hopefully any discoveries made in your pursuits will be shared with the members of the College first. That way we all benefit.

original: Now, if you'll please follow me, I'll show you the living quarters.
string: さて、一緒にいらしていただけますか、宿舎をご案内しましょう

original: While technically in charge of the College, the Arch-Mage's responsibilities often keep him occupied. Thus, I run the day-to-day operations.
string: 厳密には当大学の総責任者はアークメイジですが、重職ゆえに雑事に手が回らない事も多いので。そこで日常業務は私が処理しています

original: Farewell. Eyes open and walk with the shadows.
string: さようなら。眼を開き影とともに歩まん事を

string: ここで何かが起きたことを、どうやって知るんだ？

original: Should the need arise, a portal connects the Sepulcher and Nightingale Hall. Use it whenever you wish.

original: Where will you be from now on?
string: これからどこに行くんだ？

original: I've decided to make my home at Nightingale Hall. Since it's your home as well, I hope to see you and Brynjolf there.
string: ナイチンゲールの間に家を構える事にしたの。あなたが住む所だし、ブリニョルフにも会いたいからね

original: Of course, I may visit some of Skyrim's cities to "acquire" things from time to time. Can't afford to get rusty, now can we?
string: もちろん、たまにはスカイリムの街々を訪れてお土産を“いただいて”くるのもありよね。せっかくの腕が錆びついちゃもったいないじゃない？

original: They're a part of the darkness around us?
string: 彼は我々をとりまく闇になったのか？

original: Absolutely. When we say "walk with the shadows," we are asking those Nightingales who have passed on to protect us.
string: その通りよ。“影とともに歩まん事を”という挨拶は、故人となったナイチンゲール達の霊に加護を祈っているのよ

original: It's believed that they are literally what guides our uncanny luck... by placing their hands in ours.
string: 常識はずれな幸運に恵まれるのも、彼らのおかげだといわれているわ…　文字どおり手に手を添えて導いてくれているからだと

original: That's why the Ebonmere needed to be reopened. Without it, there's no way Nocturnal was able to allow them through.

original: So, he's gone?

original: No, not gone... he's become one with the shadows.
string: いいえ、死んだんじゃないわ…　影とひとつになったのよ

original: This is the greatest honor a Nightingale can possibly achieve. In death, he's become a part of that which we use to live.

original: Where did Gallus go?
string: ガルスはどこに行ったんだ？

original: Gallus's Oath has been paid. His actions have satisfied the terms.
string: 誓約の見返りを受けとったの。ガルスの義務は果たされた

original: Now his spirit becomes one with the Evergloam... the realm of perpetual twilight and the cradle of shadow.
string: 彼の霊魂はエバーグロームと一つになる…　終わりなき黄昏と影の揺籃の領界に

original: Goodbye, Karliah.
string: さらばだ、カーリア

original: Farewell, Gallus. Eyes open... walk with the shadows.
string: さようなら、ガルス。目を開き…　影とともに歩まん事を

original: When your debt to Nocturnal has been paid, we'll embrace once again.
string: お前がノクターナルへの借りを精算したら、もう一度抱き合おう

original: Will I ever see you again?
string: いつかまた逢えるかしら？

original: Nocturnal calls me to the Evergloam. My contract has been fulfilled.
string: ノクターナルにエバーグロームへと呼ばれている。契約は果たされたのだ

original: What will you do now, my love?
string: これからどうするの？　愛しい人

original: If it were not for the actions of this Nightingale, your fears would have come true. He honors us all.
string: このナイチンゲールの行動がなかったら、恐怖は現実のものとなっていただろう。彼は尊敬に値する

original: If it were not for the actions of this Nightingale, your fears would have come true. She honors us all.
string: このナイチンゲールの行動がなかったら、恐怖は現実のものとなっていただろう。彼女は尊敬に値する

original: I feared I would never see you again. I was afraid you'd become like the others.
string: もう二度と逢えないんじゃないかと思ってた。他のみんなと同じように

original: Gallus!
string: ガルス！

original: Karliah?
string: カーリア？

original: Yes, Nightingale, what is it?
string: あら、同志ナイチンゲール、どうしたの？

original: A moment, please.
string: ちょっと待ってて

original: I wish to speak to Karliah for the moment.
string: カーリアに少しでも話しかけられればな

original: Very good. Be sure to bring any more Sleeping Tree Sap you find to me.
string: 素晴らしいわ。もっと眠りの木の樹液を見つけたら持って来てね

original: Sorry to hear that.
string: 災難だったな

original: We will endure. We always have.
string: これからも我慢するわ。ずっと我慢してきたんだもの

original: Not your concern, anyway.
string: いずれにしろ、こっちの問題だ

original: I tracked it to a group of bandits nearby. But I'm no fool. I'd need the Whiterun guards or maybe hire the Companions to get it.
string: どうやら、この辺の山賊が持ってるらしい。だが、馬鹿な真似はしない。取り戻すには、ホワイトラン衛兵を呼ぶか、同胞団に頼むしかないだろう

original: I don't know why I'm saying this, but if you find it out in your travels, I'd be grateful to you.
string: こんなことを言うのもなんだが、旅の途中で見つけてくれたら恩に着る

original: Do you need help finding the sword?
string: 剣を見つける助けが必要なのか？

original: Shahvee would be in your debt, kind one.
string: シャーヴィーはあなたに感謝するわ

original: I could find your amulet for you.
string: アミュレットを探してこよう

original: My Saffir doesn't like that I've been spending so much time looking for my father's old sword.
string: 父の剣を探しているんだが、そればかりに時間をかけている事をサフィールは快く思っていない

original: He fed his entire family with the gold he made using that weapon. I'm not about to let it gather dust in some thief's trophy room.
string: 父はあの剣を振るって稼いだ金で家族全員を養ってくれた。その剣がどこかの盗賊の蔵でほこりを被るのを許す訳にはいかない

original: What were you two arguing about?
string: 2人で一体何の口論をしていたんだ？

original: We have not faired well outside our native Black Marsh, but we're determined to make the best of things.
string: 故郷のブラック・マーシュを出てから、私達は不当な扱いを受け続けてきたけど、それでも負けずにがんばろうと決めたの

original: I began praying to Zenithar, the god of wealth, to bring us some fortune, but thieves made off with my sacred amulet almost as soon as I bought it.
string: そこで富をもたらしてくれるよう、繁栄の神であるゼニタールに祈りを捧げる事にしたんだけど、買ったばかりの聖なるアミュレットが盗賊に盗まれてしまったの

original: Your people have bad luck?
string: 運が悪いのか？

original: Kitchen. (<Global=HDSolitudeKitchen> gold)
string: 台所用品(<Global=HDSolitudeKitchen> ゴールド)

original: Patio decorations. (<Global=HDSolitudePatio> gold)
string: 玄関の装飾(<Global=HDSolitudePatio> ゴールド)

original: Enchanting laboratory. (<Global=HDSolitudeEnchanting> gold)
string: 付呪器(<Global=HDSolitudeEnchanting> ゴールド)

original: Alchemy laboratory. (<Global=HDSolitudeAlchemy> gold)
string: 錬金器具(<Global=HDSolitudeAlchemy> ゴールド)

original: Living room. (<Global=HDSolitudeLiving> gold)
string: リビングルーム(<Global=HDSolitudeLiving> ゴールド)

original: Bedroom. (<Global=HDSolitudeBedroom> gold)
string: 寝室(<Global=HDSolitudeBedroom> ゴールド)

original: Never mind. I don't want to purchase any decorations right now.
string: やっぱりいい。今は装飾品を買うつもりはない

original: Your family? You've poisoned the Reach with your tainted silver for long enough, Thonar!
string: お前の家？　長い間、汚れた銀でリーチを汚染してきたな、ソーナー！

original: Madanach! Think you can escape my prison do you? You'll pay for what you've done to my family!
string: マダナック！　この監獄から脱獄できると思ってるのか？　我が一族への仕打ち、ただでは済まさんぞ！

original: The mine is rich, and so are we.
string: 鉱山は資源が豊富だし、おかげで我々も裕福でいられる

original: But I am cursed, it would seem, to live alone.
string: だが、どうやら私は孤独に生きるべく呪われているようだ

original: I've had several wives. But each dies sooner than the last.
string: これまで妻は何人かいたが、みな早く逝ってしまった

original: I was lucky to get children out of the ones I did.
string: 子宝に恵まれたのは幸運だったが

original: Everyone said it had run out, but I smashed down one wall and found the widest veins of ebony I'd ever seen.
string: 誰もがもう尽きたと言ったんだが、壁をたたき壊したら今まで見た事がないほど太い黒檀の鉱脈を見つけたんだ

original: So now we're rich and now I'm chief.
string: 今では我々は金持ちになり、私は族長になった

original: I think of Uglarz. An old friend. When we were little she ran to the woods to hunt, and never came back.
string: 幼馴染みのユグラーズの事を思い出した。子供の頃、彼女は狩りをしに森へ駆けていった。そして二度と戻ってはこなかった

original: If someone found her, she would make an excellent mate.
string: 誰かが彼女を見つけたら、彼女は素晴らしい仲間を得る事になるだろうな

original: Ha. Good luck to you, friend. She's not one who likes to be found.
string: まあ。幸運を祈っているよ、友よ。彼女は見つかる事を望んではいないからね

original: I am Uglarz, huntress of all.
string: 私はユグラーズ。万物の狩人だ

original: It was my home. But I left. The woods felt more alive, at least for a time.
string: 故郷だったけど、出てきてしまったよ。森はもっと生き生きして見えた…　少なくともあの頃はな

original: Mauhulakh. I remember him. Little, scrawny, fellow.
string: マウフラクか。覚えているよ。チビでガリガリの奴だ

original: Ha! Now that I would like to see. I may go back there some day.
string: ハッ！　それは見てみたいな。いつかあそこへ戻る事もあるかも知れない

original: Always thought that old mine had more to it. Just like Mauhulakh to smash his way to good fortune.
string: あの古い鉱山には何かあるとずっと思っていたよ。まさに幸運への道を突き進むマウフラクらしい

original: I'm going back to Narzulbur. Want to see how it's come.
string: ナルズルブールへ戻るよ。どうなるか見ものだしな

original: All right. So do you have one that I could use?
string: 持っているのか？

original: Ha!
string: はっ！

original: Who wrote the Elder Scrolls?
string: 星霜の書を書いたのは誰なんだ？

original: It would take a month to explain to you how that very question doesn't even make sense.
string: その質問がいかにおかしいかを説明するだけで1ヶ月はかかるだろう

original: The Scrolls exist here, with us, but also beyond and beneath. Before and after. They are bits of Divine made substance so we could know them.
string: その書はここに我々とともに存在するが、はるか上にも下にも、前にも後にもある。それらは物質の姿をした神の破片だ。我々が彼らを知るためのな

original: Sorry. Talking about the Scrolls, you usually end up in irritating and vague metaphors like that. Some people who study them devoutly go mad.
string: 失礼。星霜の書の事を話せば、このようにじれったくて雲をつかむような隠喩を聞かされる事になる。熱心にその書について学んだ結果、おかしくなってしまった者もいる

original: A price for what?
string: 何の代償だ？

original: The simplest way to put it is "knowledge," but there's nothing simple about an Elder Scroll.
string: 最も平たく言うなら“知識”だ。だがな、星霜の書はそう簡単に言い表せる代物ではない

original: It's a reflection of all possible futures and all possible pasts.
string: 書にはこれから起こりうる未来のすべてと、過去に起こったすべてが記されているのだ

original: Each reader sees different reflections through different lenses, and may come away with a very different reading.
string: 読む者はそれぞれが異なるレンズを通し、それぞれが異なるものを見る事になる。それゆえに様々な感想を持つ可能性もあるわけだ

original: But at the same time, all of it is true. Even the falsehoods. Especially the falsehoods.
string: しかし同時にそのすべては真実である。それが偽りでも、だ。偽りの上に立った真実とも言えるだろう

original: I need to find one and was told you could help.
string: 見つけなければならないんだ。助けて貰えると聞いてきた

original: I don't know who told you that, but I'll do what I can. What we do have are plenty of books.
string: 誰に言われたか知らないができる事はしよう。我々には膨大な書物がある

original: What about the Dragonborn?
string: ドラゴンボーンについては？

original: What about... wait. Are you? Were you the one the Greybeards were calling?
string: そうだなあ…　ちょっと待った。もしや、グレイビアード達が呼んでいたのはお前だったのか？

original: Do you at least have any information on them?
string: 少しでいいから情報はないのか？

original: Of course.
string: もちろんだ

original: Of course I do. Do you have one here?
string: もちろん。ここにあるのか？

original: You think that even if I did have one here, I would let you see it?
string: ここにあったとして、私が見せるとでも思っているのか？

original: It would be kept under the highest security. The greatest thief in the world wouldn't be able to lay a finger on it.
string: あったとしたら厳重な警備下で守られているはずだ。この地で最も腕利きの盗賊だって指一本触れられないだろう

original: Tell me more about the Elder Scrolls.
string: 星霜の書について、詳しく教えてくれ

original: I knew it. Everyone comes in here, expecting my help, but they don't even have the proper questions.
string: やはり。ここを訪ねる人は誰もが私の助けをあてにしてくるが、まともな質問すらできない

original: An Elder Scroll is an instrument of immense knowledge and power.
string: 星霜の書とは計り知れない知識と権力の道具だ

original: To read an Elder Scroll, a person must have the most rigorously trained mind, or else risk madness.
string: 中身を読むためには、最も厳格に訓練された精神を持たねばならない。さもなくば、おかしくなる恐れがあるから

original: Even so, the Divines usually take the reader's sight as a price.
string: たとえ訓練されていたとしても、その代償として神々は読む者の視力を奪う事が多い

original: I'm looking for an Elder Scroll.
string: 星霜の書を探している

original: And what do you plan to do with it? Do you even know what you're asking about, or are you just someone's errand boy?
string: 手に入れてどうするつもりだ？　今、自分が何を尋ねているか分かっているのか？　それとも誰かの使い走りをしているだけか？

original: And what do you plan to do with it? Do you even know what you're asking about, or are you just someone's errand girl?
string: 手に入れてどうするつもりだ？　今、自分が何を尋ねているか分かっているのか？　それとも誰かの使い走りをしているだけか？

original: What is an Elder Scroll?
string: 星霜の書とは何だ？

original: You look to your left, you see one way. You look to your right, you see another. But neither is any harder than the opposite.
string: 左を向くと道が見える。右を向くともうひとつの道が見える。どちらの道も厳しさに変わりはない

original: But the Elder Scrolls... they look left and right in the stream of time. The future and past are as one.
string: だが星霜の書は違う…　左と右を時間の流れの中に見る。未来と過去がひとつになるのだ

original: Sometimes they even look up. What do they see then? What if they dive in? Then the madness begins.
string: 時には上を見る事もある。すると見えるものは？　飛び込むとどうなる？　狂乱が始まるのだよ

original: Get up. Did it work?
string: おい、動けるか？

original: I... it's like waking up out of a dream.
string: まるで…　夢から覚めたみたいだ

original: I can breathe more deeply now. I can't smell your heart beating the way I used to. But my mind is... clear.
string: 今は深く息ができる。その心臓の鼓動は、かつての私とは違う。だが精神は…　澄んでいる

original: This is a great service you've done for me, Harbinger. I will not soon forget.
string: 素晴らしい働きをしてくれたな、導き手よ。忘れないぞ

original: Now... I'd like to spend some time communing with Ysgramor. My soul is clean now. Perhaps he'll still welcome me when my time comes.
string: さて…　しばらくイスグラモルとの語り合いで時間を過ごしたい。私の心はすみわたっている。おそらく、時が来たら受け入れてもらえるだろう

original: It's like relaxing into a warm mug of spiced mead. I'm losing aches I didn't know I had.
string: 熱いハチミツ酒の中でくつろいでるみたいな気分だ。気がつかなかった痛みまで消えていく

original: This is how a warrior should feel. Alive and aware. Not clouded with thoughts of the hunt.
string: これぞ戦士の感覚って奴だな。生きてる実感がする。狩りをするって考えに心が曇っていない

original: Thank you for your help. I'm going to stay in the tomb for a while. My shame kept me out before, but now I want to see it.
string: 助けてくれてありがとうよ。これからしばらく墓にいるとしよう。恥だと思って外にいたが、今はこの目で見てみたい

original: Is it over?
string: 終わったか？

original: Are you ok?
string: 大丈夫か？

original: I have it.
string: 手に入れた

original: Lead on, to Ysgramor and glory.
string: そのまま進め、イスグラモルと栄光に向かって

original: This is good. Could you show the way to the tomb again?
string: いいぞ。もう一度、墓まで案内してもらえるか？

original: Did you take the head?
string: 首を取ったか？

original: You still bear a head of the Glenmoril betrayers, yes? Then lead on, back to the Tomb of Ysgramor.
string: グレンモリルの裏切り者の首を今も持っているんだろう？　それなら、このまま進むんだ。イズグラモルの墓に戻れ

original: My soul is now prepared.
string: こっちは準備ができている

original: You still have one of the witch's heads. This is good.
string: まだ魔女の首のひとつを持っているな。悪くない

original: Let's go to the Tomb. We can do the cleansing there.
string: 墓に行こう。そこで浄化ができるはずだ

original: Aela said that the cleansing used a head from one of the witches of Glenmoril, yes?
string: アエラによると、浄化にはグレンモリルの魔女の首を使うらしいな？

original: A strange kind of ritual, but I won't mind killing those wretched things.
string: 変わった儀式だな。まあ、あの卑劣な奴らを殺す分には一向にかまわんが

original: Aela said we would need a Hagraven's head. I already have one of them, but she said it was a special kind.
string: アエラはハグレイヴンの首が必要だと言っていた。既にひとつは持っていたが、それは特別なものらしい

original: And that you knew where to get more. Let's go find one!
string: もっと手に入る場所があるのか。行って見つけよう！

original: I will help you cure yourself.
string: 治癒を手伝おう

original: I would be honored for you to accompany me, Harbinger.
string: 同行してくれるなら光栄だ、導き手よ

original: This is a personal matter, and I leave it to you.
string: 個人的な問題なら立ち入りはしない

original: Thank you, Harbinger.
string: ありがとう、導き手よ

original: What troubles you?
string: 何が問題なんだ？

original: Kodlak's final teaching. I think he was right about beastblood and Sovngarde.
string: コドラクの最後の教えさ。彼がビーストブラッドとソブンガルデについて言ってた事は正しかったと思う

original: I wish to cleanse myself that I might know glory in the afterlife.
string: 自分を浄化したいんだ。そうすれば死後の世界の栄光が分かるかも知れない

original: I think that maybe Kodlak was right. As a werewolf, I can't be a good Nord.
string: 今となってはコドラクが正しかったのかも知れないと思う。ウェアウルフになってしまった以上、俺は善きノルドとはいえない

original: I want to be clean, like he was, and go to Sovngarde when I finally die.
string: 清い体に戻りたいんだ、かつてのあの男のように。俺だって死後にはソブンガルデへ行きたいよ

original: Is there any work to be done?
string: 何かやるべき事はあるか？

original: There is always work for the Companions. But there is more personal task before me.
string: 同胞団がやるべき仕事は常にある。しかし、個人的にやるべき仕事があってな

original: Of course, there is always work. My mind is someplace else, though.
string: もちろん、仕事はいつでもある。だが、今はそれどころじゃない

original: Let's go.
string: 行こう

original: I'm going to stay a while. Rest among these bones. This creature honored us with its life, and I will honor it with my respect.
string: 少しここに残るよ。この骨と一緒に休む。この生物は命をもって我々に名誉を与えてくれた。俺は敬意をもってこれに名誉を与えるよ

original: You go if you want to. I've never seen bones this large, and want to make sure I remember them so I can tell the story right.
string: 先に行っていいぞ。こんなに大きな骨は見た事がない。後で正確に伝えられるよう、ちゃんと覚えておきたいんだ

original: Otherwise Vilkas will just say I was making it up.
string: さもないとヴィルカスに作り話だって言われるからな

original: Next time, try harder.
string: 次はしっかりやってくれ

original: I am sorry if I disappointed, Harbinger. Still, the battle was won.
string: がっかりさせたなら悪かったな、導き手よ。それでも戦いには勝ったんだ

original: I will train better for the future.
string: 次に備えてもっと鍛錬しておくよ

original: For the glory of the Companions! For Ysgramor!
string: 同胞団の栄光のために！　イスグラモルのために！

original: We bring honor to the Companions.
string: 同胞団に名誉をもたらそう

original: You fought well.
string: よく戦ったな

original: Thank you, Harbinger.
string: ありがとう、導き手よ

original: Now that was a battle!
string: すごい戦いだったな！

original: Maybe one day you'll see one yourself.
string: いつかその目で拝めるだろう

original: We don't all lead your life of grand adventure, Harbinger.
string: 誰もが壮大な冒険の人生を送ってるわけじゃないけどな

original: Not at this rate. I'll just go back to clubbing horkers and scaring the debtors.
string: この調子じゃ無理だな。さて、またホーカーを棒で殴って、債務者どもをビビらせるとするか

original: Let's go kill a dragon.
string: さあ、ドラゴンを殺しに行こう

original: Yes! I like the way you think. There are whispers of where we might find one, too.
string: そうだ！　そうこなくてはな。居場所についても、色々噂がある

original: They say he killed twelve of the Imperial Legion and shattered their bones with his breath.
string: どうやら、ドラゴンは帝国軍の兵士12人を殺して、一息でその骨を粉々にしたらしい

original: I think you and I are worth about a dozen soldiers each. We'll send that beast back where it came from.
string: 俺とお前はそれぞれ12人の兵士と同じくらいの力だろう。その獣を元の居場所に追い返してやろうじゃないか

original: Well, that's one way to find out if they're real. I even know where we might find one. Lead on!
string: まあ、それも奴らが実在するのか確かめるひとつの手だな。どこにいるかも分かってるわけだし…　じゃあ行くか！

original: Rumors and ramblings should be ignored.
string: 噂やデマの類は放っておけ

original: A sharp mind on you. We should find out for ourselves.
string: 賢い考え方だ。自分達で解明すべきかもな

original: That is the kind of thing Kodlak used to say. And he was right. But still, I'd like to see for myself.
string: コドラクも同じような事を言っていた。確かにその通りだ。だが、それでもこの目で見てみたい

original: Yes, they're real. I've seen them.
string: ああ、本当にいた。この目で見たんだ

original: I envy you. Facing such a beast in combat. Smelling its blood on the air. That is what songs are sung about, Shield-Brother.
string: うらやましいよ。そんな獣と対じするなんて。漂う血の匂いをかげるなんて。それこそ歌にうたわれている事だ、盾の兄弟よ

original: I envy you. Facing such a beast in combat. Smelling its blood on the air. That is what songs are sung about, Shield-Sister.
string: うらやましいよ。そんな獣と対じするなんて。漂う血の匂いをかげるなんて。それこそ歌にうたわれている事だ、盾の姉妹よ

original: You are a very brave man. But I already knew that.
string: あんたはとても勇敢な男だ。分かっていた事だけどな

original: You are a very brave woman. But I already knew that.
string: あんたはとても勇敢な女だ。分かっていた事だけどな

original: Is there any work to be done?
string: 何かやるべき事はあるか？

original: I've been hearing stories about dragons. That they're back. That they can eat the sun out of the sky and freeze a man where he stands.
string: 最近、ドラゴンの噂を耳にする。どうやら戻ってきたらしい。噂によるとドラゴンは、太陽を食らい、人を凍らせる事ができるらしい

original: Have you seen one in your travels?
string: 旅の途中でドラゴンに会った事はあるか？

original: Travelers have been coming to Whiterun. They tell stories about dragons.
string: ホワイトランには旅人がやってくる。そしてドラゴンの話をする

original: I've heard of them, but didn't think they were real. Have you ever seen one?
string: 聞いた事はあったが、本当とは思えなかった。実際に見た事はあるか？

original: I don't know what we do with it now. Maybe you can figure it out.
string: 今はどうしたらいいか分からないわ。あなたなら分かるかも知れないわね

original: Do you have it?
string: 持ってるの？

original: Let's find that Totem, Shield-Brother.
string: そのトーテムを見つけるわよ、同志

original: Let's find that Totem, Shield-Sister.
string: そのトーテムを見つけるわよ、同志

original: Hircine will bless us for finding his Totem.
string: トーテムを見つけたらハーシーンに感謝されるわ

original: The spirit of Skjor is with us on this errand. I feel him.
string: スコールの霊魂は我々と共にいるわ。彼を感じるもの

original: This is not the time for talk. Let's get to the Underforge and see what this can do.
string: おしゃべりはやめなさい。アンダーフォージに行って、できることをしましょう

original: Is this what we're looking for?
string: 探しているのはこれか？

original: That definitely matches the description of the totem from Skjor's old book. Let's get it to the Underforge.
string: スコールの古文書にある、トーテムの説明と完全に一致するわ。アンダーフォージに持って行きましょう

original: That's it! That's the second Totem. Quickly, let's put it back with the other one.
string: それよ！　それが2つ目のトーテムだわ。さあ、もう1つと一緒に元に戻しましょう

original: At last... the final Totem is ours. Let's go complete our set.
string: とうとう…　最後のトーテムが手に入ったわ。さあ、揃えてみましょう

original: Just shut up and keep out of sight.
string: 黙ってどこかへ消え失せろ

original: Hardly likely.
string: あり得ない

original: Understood.
string: 分かった

original: Should I say anything to him?
string: 何か喋る必要はないのか？

original: An axe?
string: 斧？

original: You should probably handle this yourself.
string: あなたなら1人でやれるはずだ

original: And here I figured you as one who enjoyed our special gifts.
string: あなたこそ、特別な才能を持っているはずだけど

original: I guess I was wrong.
string: 私が間違ってたみたいね

original: I'm glad you're here. I have a message I need delivered to the Jarl of Whiterun.
string: いてくれて良かった。実はホワイトランの首長に言伝がある

original: Deliver this axe to Balgruuf the Greater.
string: この斧を偉大なるバルグルーフに届けてもらいたい

original: I'm glad you're here. I have a message I need delivered to the Jarl of Whiterun.
string: いてくれて良かった。実はホワイトランの首長に言伝がある

original: Deliver this axe to Jarl Hrongar.
string: この斧をフロンガル首長に届けてもらいたい

original: You anticipate danger?
string: 危険だと思っているのか？

original: Aye. The Great Hunt killed old King Borgas. Gods only know with what profane arts those elves cursed his remains.
string: その通り。グレートハントがボルガス王を殺した。そしてかのエルフが王の亡骸に、どんな呪いをかけたかは想像もつかない

original: Curses notwithstanding, the tombs of kings are always full of traps to ward off grave robbers, are they not?
string: そういう類の呪いがかけられているにもかかわらず、墓を荒らす者は後を絶たない。そのため、墓には多くの罠が仕掛けられている

original: But nothing a band of Stormcloaks can't handle, I assure you.
string: けれどもストームクロークに不可能はない、私が保証しよう

original: How do you know the crown is in Korvanjund?
string: 王冠がコルバンヤンドにあるとどうやって知った？

original: It's true, the location of the crown was lost with King Borgas. After the Great Hunt killed him, while he was off on his damned Alessian campaigns.
string: 確かにボルガス王が死んでから、王冠の場所は分からないままだった。グレートハントが、アレッシアの戦争の間に王を殺した時から

original: But legend holds, his body was secretly returned to Skyrim and buried with the crown. Its exact whereabouts lost in the following Wars of Succession.
string: しかし、王冠の伝説は語り継がれた。そして王の遺体はスカイリムに戻され、王冠と一緒に埋葬された。しかし、後に続いた継承戦争で、その場所も分からなくなってしまった

original: Through sources that shall remain nameless, I've tracked down what I believe to be the final resting place of King Borgas - Korvanjund.
string: だが、情報の出所がいまだ不明とはいえ、ボルガス王の眠る場所はコルバンヤンドだという事を我々は突き止めた

original: If the crown exists, it will be there.
string: 王冠が存在しているなら、そこにあるはずだ

original: What's the Jagged Crown?
string: 尖った王冠とは何だ？

original: Have you not heard that ancient verse?
string: 言い伝えを聞いた事はないか？

original: "Maw unleashing razor  snow, Of dragons from the blue brought down, Births the walking winter's woe, The High King in his Jagged Crown."
string: “吹雪を吐き出す青きドラゴンを制し、ここに凍れる冬を往くは、尖った王冠を頂きし上級王なり”

original: Going way back to King Harald's time or even before, the High King always wore the Jagged Crown. It was the symbol of his might and power.
string: ハラルド王より前の時代、上級王は常に尖った王冠を被っていた。それは力と権力の象徴だった

original: The crown is made from the bones and teeth of ancient dragons, and it is said to contain a portion of the power of  every king who has worn it.
string: 王冠は古竜の骨と歯から作られていて、身に着けた王達の力がすべて宿っていると言われている

original: True or not, who would dare deny Ulfric's claim, when the legendary Jagged Crown sits upon his brow?
string: この話が本当かどうかは分からない。しかし、伝説の尖った王冠がウルフリックの頭上にある時、誰が彼の主張を否定しようか？

original: "...even to my lord as to my fellow brothers and sisters in arms."
string: 「同胞と共に、主君に忠誠を捧げる事を誓う」

original: "All hail the Stormcloaks, the true sons and daughters of Skyrim!"
string: “真のスカイリムの民、ストームクロークを称えよ！”

original: I'm ready to take the Oath.
string: 誓いを立てよう

original: That's the spirit. By swearing this oath you become one of us. A hero of the people. A true son of Skyrim. A Stormcloak. Repeat after me.
string: それでいい。誓いが終われば、我々の仲間となり、人々の英雄となる。真なるスカイリムの息子、ストームクロークと。今から教える誓いの言葉、繰り返すがよい

original: "I do swear my blood and honor to the service of Ulfric Stormcloak..."
string: “血と魂をウルフリック・ストームクロークに捧げる…”

original: That's the spirit. By swearing this oath you become one of us. A heroine of the people. A true daughter of Skyrim. A Stormcloak. Repeat after me.
string: それでいい。誓いが終われば、我々の仲間となり、人々の英雄となる。真なるスカイリムの娘ストームクロークと。今から教える誓いの言葉、繰り返すがよい

original: "I do swear my blood and honor to the service of Ulfric Stormcloak..."
string: “血と魂をウルフリック・ストームクロークに捧げる…”

original: I need to think it over.
string: 考えさせてくれ

original: Don't take too long figuring it out. Might mistake your hesitation for Imperial sympathies.
string: あまり考えすぎるな。ためらいは帝国に対する共感ともみなされるのだ

original: Come back when you're committed to the cause, or go join the Legion. They're taking anyone with a pulse these days.
string: 大義に加わる心の準備ができたら戻って来い。もしくは、帝国軍に入るんだな。最近は誰でもかき集めているようだ

original: Let's go.
string: 行こう

original: We hunt together.
string: 協力して狩るわよ

original: Isn't it enough that I want to fight Imperials?
string: 帝国と戦いたいだけでは十分ではないのか？

original: You can stick a sword through an Imperial any day you want. But that doesn't make you a Stormcloak.
string: 帝国はいつでも敵に回してくれていいが、それだけではストームクロークには入れない

original: We're not just fighting Imperials. We're fighting to restore Skyrim to her glory and give her the king she deserves.
string: 我々の目的は帝国と戦う事だけではない。スカイリムを復興し、スカイリムにふさわしい王を奉じるために戦っているんだ

original: Oath?
string: 誓い？

original: Before you're one of us, you must swear fealty to Jarl Ulfric Stormcloak, future High King of Skyrim.
string: スカイリム上級王となる、ウルフリック・ストームクローク首長への誓いだ

original: You must also pledge unswerving loyalty to your fellow Stormcloaks, to Skyrim and to her people.
string: それから、ストームクロークの仲間や、スカイリムの人々にも変わらぬ忠誠を誓うのだ

original: What? We've got nothing to talk about until you come back from Serpentstone Isle.
string: 何だ？　蛇石の島から生きて戻るまで、お前と話す事は何もない

original: You're alive. I owe Ulfric a drink. I have to admit, I didn't think we'd be seeing you again.
string: 生きていたか。賭けはウルフリックの勝ちのようだ。まさか生き残るとは思わなかった

original: I misjudged you. You're definitely Stormcloak material.
string: 誤解していたようだ。お前にはストームクロークになれる素質がある

original: It's time we made this official. You ready to take the Oath?
string: 仲間として認めよう。誓いを立てる準備はできているか？

original: You ready to take the Oath?
string: 誓いを立てる準備はできているか？

original: I believe Galmar gave you something to do. So go do it.
string: 行かないのか？　ガルマルが何か頼みたいようだが

original: You're alive! I'm impressed! Galmar had his doubts about you, but I knew you'd pull through. You should speak with him. He's going to need your help.
string: 生還したな。見事だ！　ガルマルは疑っていたが、やり遂げてくれると信じていたぞ。彼と話してくれ。お前の助けが必要になる

original: Speak with Galmar. You'll be going on a little errand with him.
string: ガルマルと話せば、ちょっとした使いを頼まれるだろう

original: It'll be there. You'll see.
string: そこにある。すぐに分かるさ

original: Fine. I'll send the Unblooded here with you.
string: よかろう。新人を同行させる

original: Fancy a crawl through a moldering dungeon to see if you can't stir up Galmar's Jagged Crown?
string: 崩れかかったダンジョンを這いずり回って、ガルマルの尖った王冠を引っかき回せぬと分かったらどうする？

original: When have I ever been false with you?
string: お前に嘘をついた事があったか？

original: You're certain you've found it?
string: 確かに見つけたのか？

original: It exists. And it'll be the symbol of the righteousness of our cause. Think about it.
string: 存在する。そして我々が正しい事を証明するシンボルになるはずだ

original: The Jagged Crown! It heralds back to a time before jarls and moots.
string: それが尖った王冠だ！　首長やムートより、さらに前の時代の物だ

original: Back to the time when a king was a king because his enemies fell before him, and his people rose because they loved him.
string: 王が敵を自分の前にひざまずかせ、人々から愛される、絶対的な権力を誇っていた頃のな

original: Skyrim needs that king. You will be that king, Ulfric. You must be.
string: スカイリムにも、そういった王が必要なのだ。そして、それはお前であるべきだよ、ウルフリック

original: If it even exists.
string: もし実在するのであればな

original: No, but this one...
string: いいや。しかしこれは…

original: A crown doesn't make a king.
string: 王冠が王を作るのではない

original: All the more reason then. The crown would legitimize your claim.
string: だからこそだ。王冠がお前の主張を証明してくれる

original: And damn the Moot!
string: それに、ムートどもめ！

original: We should risk letting those milkdrinkers put Thorryg's woman on the throne? She'll hand Skyrim over to the elves on a silver plate.
string: ガキどもがトリグの女を玉座に乗せる危険を冒せと言うのか？　彼女はスカイリムを銀の皿に載せてエルフに渡してしまうぞ

original: They demand the Moot.
string: 奴らはムートを要求する

original: Damn the Jarls.
string: 首長どもめ！

original: The Jarls are upset. They don't all support you.
string: 首長達は怒っている。全面的には支持しないだろう

original: Tell me again why we're wasting time and dwindling resources chasing a legend. We don't even know it exists!
string: なぜ我らが伝説などを追いかけて時間や資源を無駄にしているのか、教えてもらいたいな。実在すら定かではないのだぞ！

original: Want to come along?
string: 一緒に行きたい？

original: I had once heard Skjor and Kodlak talking about the Totems of Hircine.
string: スコールとコドラクが、トーテム・ハーシーンについて話してたのを聞いた事があるわ

original: Simple-looking objects that could channel the powers of the werewolf in new directions.
string: 見た目は何の変哲もない物だけど、ウェアウルフの力をかつてない方向へと導くアイテムよ

original: Once Kodlak began looking for his cure, I'd wager Skjor didn't bring it up again.
string: コドラクが自身の治療薬を探し始めた時点で、たぶんスコールはもう言わなかったのね

original: But I was going through his things and found a book I had never seen before. All about the Totems.
string: 彼の持ち物の中から、見たこともない本を見つけたの。トーテムに関する本よ

original: I've been talking to my sources around the holds, and think I may have heard where one of them lives.
string: 要塞の近くにいる情報筋から、奴らのひとりの居場所を聞いたような気がするわ

original: I think I've located another one of the Totems. Come with me, and we'll write ourselves into their history.
string: もうひとつのトーテムの場所が分かりそうだわ。一緒に来て。奴らの歴史に名を残してやるのよ

original: I've finally tracked down the last of the Totems, I think.
string: とうとう最後のトーテムを見つけた、と思うんだけど

original: The information wasn't easy to come by, but everyone has a price. And a pain threshold.
string: 簡単に手に入る情報じゃなかったけど、代償はつきものよ。耐えがたい痛みもね

original: Is there any work to be done?
string: 何かやるべき事はあるか？

original: Harbinger, I'd be honored if you joined me in my search.
string: 導き手よ、探し物を手伝ってくれるのなら光栄だわ

original: I retrieved the family's <Alias=Gewgaw>.
string: <Alias=Gewgaw> を回収した

original: Give it here. They've asked for the utmost discretion on this matter, so I'll make sure it gets to them.
string: 見せてみろ。今回の件に関してはできるだけ慎重に対処するよう頼まれている。必ず届けなければならない

original: Here's your share of their reward.
string: さあ、これが取り分だ

original: And it looks undamaged. They'll be pleased, I'm sure. And we're pleased with their money.
string: 傷はついていないようだな。先方も喜ぶだろう。こっちも金を稼げて大満足だ

original: Nice work with this one. You make us all proud.
string: よくやってくれた。おかげで鼻が高いよ

original: Let's have somebody else do that.
string: 他の者にやらせればいい

original: Can't say I blame you. I'll find someone to take care of it.
string: お前を責めたりはしない。誰か他の者に当たらせよう

original: Not the response I was hoping for, but suit yourself.
string: 別の答えを期待していたが、好きにすれば

original: I'll get it back.
string: 取り戻してこよう

original: Good, good. These aren't the most glorious jobs, but they pay well.
string: やってくれるか。最高に名誉ある仕事ってわけじゃないが、金払いはいい

original: Move quickly so we can have this over and done with.
string: では、さっさと終わらせてくれ

original: We're trusting you on this one. Bring honor to the Companions.
string: 期待しているぞ。同胞団に名誉をもたらしてくれ

original: I tell you this province is losing its grip. The bandits become more brazen every day.
string: この辺りはすっかり秩序を失っている。山賊が日々、幅を利かすようになってきた

original: Some don't even believe they exist, but the Falmer can be devious. Tunneling into homes, stealing off with valuables.
string: 中には山賊の存在を信じてない者もいるが、ファルメルは姑息な連中だ。家までトンネルを掘って、金目の物を盗んだりする

original: Those hill people who call themselves "the Forsworn" show no mercy.
string: 丘の上に住み、自らを“フォースウォーン”と呼ぶこの連中は情け容赦ない

original: Giants don't usually cause problems like this, but these ones are stirred up for some reason.
string: 巨人達は普段、こういった問題は起こさない。しかし、こいつらは何かの理由で気が立っているんだろう

original: The rumors say the culprits are vampires. I try not to listen to swaggle like that, but figured you should know.
string: 噂によれば、犯人は吸血鬼らしい。そんなたわごとを信じるつもりはないが、お前には知らせておくべきだろう

original: Of course, it's a group of wizards they're pointing their fingers at. Who knows what they want it for, but we want it back.
string: 当然ながら、これはウィザード達の仕業だという疑いがある。連中の目的は分からないが、とにかく取り戻すんだ

original: I'm looking for work.
string: 仕事を探してるんだ

original: We have a bit of a sensitive matter this time.
string: 今回は慎重に対処すべき問題がある

original: A wealthy family has... misplaced one of their heirlooms.
string: とある裕福な一家が、先祖伝来の宝を誤った場所に置いてしまったんだ

original: Just in time. I was worried I'd have to do this myself.
string: ちょうど良かった。自分で対処しなければならないのかと心配してたところだ

original: Some rich folk had a trinket stolen and they want us to get it back.
string: ある金持ちがちょっとした宝石を盗まれてね、我々に取り戻してほしいそうだ

original: That criminal won't be a problem anymore.
string: 悪党の件はもう問題ない

original: Bit by bit, we bring honor to this land. And you've brought honor to the Companions. More importantly, some gold.
string: 少しずつ、この地に誇りを取り戻す。そしてお前が同胞団に名誉をもたらすんだ。もちろん、ある程度の金もな

original: Another job well done. Your payment is secure, and you have my thanks.
string: 今回もよくやってくれた。報酬は満額支払おう。礼を言わせてくれ

original: I'd rather not get involved.
string: できれば関わりたくない

original: We choose our battles, and you've chosen yours. Someone else can take care of it.
string: 戦いは自ら選ぶものだ。当然お前もな。この仕事は他の奴にやってもらおう

original: I'll take care of it.
string: 任せてくれ

original: Be careful. This man is known to be dangerous.
string: 気をつけろ。そいつは危険な男として有名だからな

original: Be careful. This woman is known to be dangerous.
string: 気をつけろ。そいつは危険な女として有名だからな

original: At this point they don't care what happens to him and neither do I. Best to just kill him and be done with it.
string: 今となっては、連中もこっちとしても、その男がどうなろうが構わない。殺して終わらせてしまうのが一番だろう

original: At this point they don't care what happens to her and neither do I. Best to just kill her and be done with it.
string: 今となっては、連中もこっちとしても、その女がどうなろうが構わない。殺して終わらせてしまうのが一番だろう

original: One of them's escaped, and you're going to find that coward.
string: 奴らのひとりが逃げだした。その臆病者を見つけ出してくれ

original: I'm looking for work.
string: 仕事を探してるんだ

original: It sounds like Eastmarch is too busy with their war to keep their own prisoners in line.
string: イーストマーチは戦争で手一杯のため、囚人どもを抑え切れていないらしい

original: The braggarts in the Reach always claim that no prisoner escapes their mine.
string: リーチの自信過剰な連中は、囚人が鉱山から逃げ出すことは絶対にないと日頃から豪語している

original: What you don't hear about are the ones who break off from escorts on the way to Markarth.
string: しかし、マルカルスへ向かう途中に監視の隙をついて逃亡した連中がいるんだ

original: Haafingar seems to have trouble keeping their prisoners in line.
string: ハーフィンガルは囚人を抑え込むのに苦労しているようだ

original: I'm sorry to have to send you to Hjaalmarch. I can't stand the smell of it myself.
string: すまないが、ハイヤルマーチに向かってもらう。あそこの臭いはどうも耐えがたい

original: But it seems their criminals can't either and just want to get out.
string: 犯罪者どもも同じのようで、あそこから逃げだしたがっている

original: It seems that law-breakers in the Pale have no desire to stay there. I don't blame them.
string: ペイルの犯罪者どもはあそこにいたくないらしい。まあ当然だがな

original: The idiots in Falkreath still think the best place for prisoners is that hole in the ground.
string: ファルクリースの馬鹿どもは、囚人どもは地面の穴に入れておくのが一番だといまだに考えている

original: No surprise, but one of them's gotten out. Again.
string: まあ当然だろう。だが、囚人のひとりが再び逃げだしたらしい

original: The so-called prison in Riften leaks like one of their fishnets. This is what happens when you let thieves run your town.
string: リフテンのエセ刑務所は監視の目が緩い。盗賊どもに町を仕切らせたりするから、こういうことが起きるんだ

original: The prisoners just walk right out.
string: 囚人どもは普通に歩いて脱獄できる

original: One of the guards from Dragonsreach came to me, worried about a prisoner who's escaped.
string: ドラゴンズリーチから来た衛兵のひとりが、逃げだした囚人のことを心配していた

original: The Jarl has too much on his mind right now, we won't be troubling him with this.
string: 首長は様々な問題で頭を悩ましているため、この件では負担をかけたくない

original: The snowberries up in Winterhold have lowered themselves to ask for our help.
string: ウィンターホールドの連中がなりふり構わず助けてほしいと頼み込んできた

original: For some reason they just throw their lawbreakers out into the sea and think that ends the problem.
string: なぜか連中は囚人どもを海に投げ込み、それで問題が片付くと思っている

original: But every now and then, one swims back.
string: しかし時々、泳いで戻ってくる奴がいるらしい

original: Are you not coming?
string: 来ないのか？

original: Kodlak was right. I let vengeance rule my heart.
string: コドラクの言う通りだった。俺の心は復讐の念に支配されていた

original: I regret nothing of what we did at Driftshade. But I can't go any further with my mind fogged or my heart grieved.
string: ドリフトシェイドでしたことについては何も後悔していない。だが心が曇ったまま、悲嘆に暮れたままでこれ以上進む事はできない

original: Here, take them. (Give fragments)
string: さあ、受け取ってくれ(破片を渡す)

original: Careful with those. Don't want even more fragments, do we?
string: 慎重に扱ってくれ。かけらの数が増えたら困るだろう？

original: Of course, I have a small favor to ask of you.
string: ちょっと頼みたい事がある

original: There's another piece, that Kodlak always kept close to himself. Would you go to his chambers and bring it back for me?
string: コドラクが常に身に着けていたものだ。彼の部屋に行って、取り戻してきてくれないか？

original: I'm not sure I'm the best one to go through his things.
string: 彼のものを使っていいかどうかは分からないが

original: His spirit is departed. Members of the Circle, let us withdraw to the Underforge, to grieve our last together.
string: 彼の魂は旅立ったわ。サークルのメンバーよ、アンダーフォージに戻って追悼しましょう

original: I could help you if you like.
string: よかったら手伝うよ

original: Really? That would be a pleasant change.
string: 本当に？　それなら少しは楽になります

original: One of the ingredients I need to cultivate nirnroot are jazbay grapes... the acidic content of the juice is perfect for the soil.
string: ニルンルートの生育に必要な材料には、ジャズベイ・ブドウがあって…　果汁成分の酸が土作りにぴったりなんです

original: I need twenty of them for my current crop.
string: 今育てている分だけで、20個は必要ですね

original: You seem quite exhausted.
string: ひどく疲れているようだ

original: Is it that obvious? Sigh. I've got my hands full here.
string: 分かります？　はあ。もう手一杯なんです

original: Between the farm chores, cultivating my supply of nirnroot and keeping a tight rein on my sister Aduri, there's little time for rest.
string: 農場の用事をして、自分のためにニルンルートを育てて、アデュリをしっかり見張って…　もうそれだけで終わってしまいそう

original: How did you accomplish such a feat?
string: それだけのことを、どうやって成し遂げたんだ？

original: I had quite the mentor. He taught me everything he know about the nirnroot and its strange properties.
string: 私には素晴らしい先生がいました。ニルンルートのことやその不思議な性質について、知っていることをすべて教えてくれました

original: I haven't seen him in many years. I wonder what became of him...
string: もう何年も会っていません。彼はどうしているのか…

original: There's a lot of nirnroot around here.
string: この辺りには、ずいぶんニルンルートがあるんだな

original: Actually, I'm growing it if you hadn't noticed.
string: ええ、見てのとおり私が育てているんです

original: I'm the only person alive that can cultivate nirnroot from a seed to a fully grown plant.
string: 種から十分成長するまでニルンルートを育てることができるのは、この世で私だけです

original: Out of the way, meat.
string: どけ！

original: The Arcanaeum is located above the hall, and the Arch-Mage's quarters above that.
string: 広間の上はアルケイナエウムで、その上にアークメイジ居住区があります

original: What's your problem with Faralda?
string: ファラルダと何かあったのか？

original: My problem with her? She's the one who has a problem with me!
string: 何かあった？　何かしでかしたのは、私じゃなくて彼女の方よ！

original: She's threatened by me! By my skill as a wizard, by my elegance and posture, by my superior good looks!
string: 彼女は私に脅威を感じているんだわ！　ウィザードとしての腕や、気品と態度、そして抜群の美しさにね！

original: But she's not going to get the better of me, oh no. I won't let it get to me one bit. That's what she's after.
string: でも、私に勝つ事なんてできない。まさかね。そんなの絶対に許さないわ。だから狙ってくるってわけ

original: She's trying to undermine my confidence, make me doubt myself. Well it won't work, I tell you!
string: 私の自信を失わせて、不安に陥れようとしてるのよ。そんなの無駄だって言っておくけどね！

original: Well, all of the previous Apprentices have been accounted for, thanks to you.
string: さて、おかげで以前の見習い全員の消息が判明した

original: Here, why don't you take this. It was intended to be given to the best in their group as a reward for their hard work.
string: ほら、これを受け取るがいい。重労働の褒美として、グループの最優秀者に与える予定だったものだ

original: It's the least I can do for your help in putting this matter to rest.
string: この件に終止符を打つ手伝いをしてくれたせめてもの礼だ

original: Oh dear, I didn't mean to say it like that. That wasn't a joke, really.
string: ああ、そんな風に言うつもりはなかった。冗談ではないんだ。本当だ

original: I'm afraid Yisra didn't survive.
string: 残念ながら、イスラは命を落としたらしい

original: Gods, this is hers, isn't it?
string: なんと、これは彼女の物ではないか

original: She will certainly be missed.
string: 惜しい者を亡くした

original: I found Ilas-tei. Here's proof.
string: イラス・テイを見つけた。これが証拠だ

original: Oh dear.
string: なんという事だ

original: I had particularly high hopes for her. Once she'd overcome her difficulties, she could have been quite successful here.
string: 彼女には特に期待していたのに。苦手さえ克服すれば、ここでも大成していただろう

original: I found this. It's Rundi's, isn't it?
string: これを見つけた。ルンディの物では？

original: It certainly is. Was, I suppose.
string: 間違いない。確かにそれを持っていた

original: He would never have willingly parted with it. What a shame.
string: 自らこれを手放すはずがない。残念でならない

original: I found this. It belonged to Borvir.
string: これを見つけた。ボルビルの物だ

original: Yes, I recognize it.
string: ああ、見覚えがある

original: Well, I suppose I needn't wonder where he is anymore.
string: そうか、これで彼の居場所をあれこれ思い巡らす必要もなくなったな

original: Any word from the missing Apprentices?
string: 行方不明の見習い達から何か連絡は？

original: None. It's been long enough that honestly, I don't expect to hear from them.
string: 一切ない。既に相当の時間が経過してるから、正直、連絡があるとも思えない

original: No, and after what you've discovered I fear the worst for them.
string: いや。それに見つけてもらった物から判断するに、最悪の事態を危惧している

original: Any word from the rest of the missing Apprentices?
string: 他の行方不明の見習い達から何か連絡は？

original: As I recall, Yisra was trying to improve flame cloak spells to better work in Skyrim's harsh environment.
string: そういえば、スカイリムの過酷な環境でより効果が出るよう、イスラは火炎マントの呪文を改良しようとしていた

original: Ilas-tei was practicing Illusions spells. She was having trouble with the calm spells, I believe, but only ever worked with skeevers.
string: イラス・テイは幻惑の呪文を練習していた。鎮静の呪文に難があったみたいだが、スキーヴァー相手にしか効果がなかったようだ

original: And then there's Borvir and Rundi. Twins, though they rarely agreed on anything.
string: それからボルビルとルンディ。双子だが、いつも意見が衝突していた

original: Those two boys were obsessed with mead. Convinced they could concoct something to compete with Honningbrew.
string: あの2人の少年はハチミツ酒の事で頭がいっぱいだ。ホニングブリューに張り合えるものを作れると信じてやまなかった

original: Something about using frost magic to chill the mead for a certain period of time. I felt it was a waste, but the Arch-Mage let them proceed.
string: 凍結魔法を使って一定期間ハチミツ酒を冷やすとかなんとか。時間の無駄だと思っていたが、アークメイジは許可を出したらしい

original: How long have they been missing?
string: いつから行方不明になっている？

original: I hadn't really considered it in terms of time. I suppose it's been at least a month.
string: いつからなんて考えてもいなかったが、少なくとも1ヶ月は経っていると思う

original: Let me think... what were they working on?
string: ちょっと待てよ…　彼らが取り組んでいたのは何だったろう？

original: Where could they have gone?
string: 彼らはどこに消えたんだ？

original: I'm not sure. None of them were working on anything terribly dangerous.
string: 分からない。それほど危険な作業をしていた者などいなかった

original: You said something about missing Apprentices?
string: 行方不明の見習い達がいるとか？

original: Ah, that. Yes, the group prior to yours has disappeared entirely.
string: ああ、その事か。そうなんだ。1つ前のグループが丸々行方不明になっている

original: It's possible that there was less than the necessary amount of oversight. That's still being looked into.
string: もしかすると、監督不行届だったのかも知れない。現在も調査中だ

original: But we've had no contact with them for quite some time now.
string: とはいえ、もうかなりの期間連絡がない

original: Arniel wondered if perhaps they'd somehow managed to get themselves lost in the Outer Realms, but I think that's giving them too much credit.
string: アーニエルは彼らが外界で迷ってしまったのではと考えていたが、それは買いかぶりすぎだと思う

original: Have you ever met with the Psijic Order?
string: サイジック会に会ったことは？

original: Personally? No, not I. One of their number used to advise the Arch-Mage when I was but an Apprentice here.
string: 個人的にか？　いや、ない。そのうちの1人がアークメイジに助言を与えていた事がある。まだ見習いをしていた時の話だが

original: But that was a great many years ago, before all the members of the order were called back to the Isle of Artaeum, and it disappeared entirely.
string: しかし何年も前に、教団全員がアルテウム島に呼び戻される以前の事だ。その後、ぱったり姿を消してしまった

original: Why is the Psijic Order contacting me?
string: なぜサイジック会が接触してきたんだ？

original: I have no idea, but it's fascinating. Assuming it's true, of course.
string: 理由は分からないが、興味深いな。もちろん、本当ならばだが

original: The Isle of Artaeum disappeared over a hundred years ago, and no one has seen them since.
string: アルテウム島は百年以上前に消えてしまい、それから誰一人その姿を見たことはない

original: And yet now, suddenly, they have chosen to contact you? Why, it's intriguing!
string: そして今、突然彼らが接触してきた？　実に興味深い！

original: If nothing else, I'd take it as a compliment. The Psijics have only ever dealt with those they feel worthy.
string: 私だったら賛辞と受け止めるだろう。彼らは無意味に接触してきたりしないだろうから

original: What do you know about the Psijic Order?
string: サイジック会について何か知っているか？

original: No more than anyone else, I don't think.
string: 決して人より詳しいとはいえませんが、少しは

original: They're a very old order. Pre-dated the Imperial Mages Guild by quite a bit.
string: サイジック会はきわめて歴史の古い教団です。創立は帝国魔術師ギルドよりもかなり前まで遡ります

original: In fact, the Mages Guild was founded in opposition to the idea of the Psijic Order, that only an elite few should have control over magic.
string: そもそもの魔術師ギルドの結成された理由が、サイジック会の“魔法は少数の選良者だけに許される特権であるべきだ”という教義に反発しての事ですから

original: No one has seen or heard from them in over a hundred years now, though.
string: しかし、その活動の兆候が絶えてもう百年以上も経っていますね

original: What's so important about the Staff of Magnus?
string: マグナスの杖の何がそんなに重要なんだ？

original: I don't know. If the Augur suggested it, there must be a good reason for locating it.
string: 分からない。予言者が提案したならば、そこに相応の理由が何かあるはずだ

original: I'm afraid I don't see the connection, though.
string: しかし、どんな関係があると言うのだ？

original: I'm not certain what use it would be.
string: 何に使う物なのかよく分かりませんね

original: The Staff is said to be able to absorb great amounts of energy. Perhaps it can interact with the Eye in a way that nothing else can.
string: “杖”には莫大な魔力を蓄える能力があるといいます。もしかしたら“目”と特別な手段で接続できるのかも知れません

original: I don't know, not for sure.
string: 何だかは分からない

original: But perhaps the staff can absorb some of the energy coming out of the Eye, weaken it. Allow us to get close to Ancano.
string: もしかしたらその杖は目から出るエネルギーを吸収し、弱らせることができるのかも知れない。アンカノの近くに行って見よう

original: Glory to the Forsworn!
string: フォースウォーンに栄光あれ！

original: The Reach will be ours again.
string: リーチを再び我らの手に

original: Ah, my friend from Cidhna Mine. Hello.
string: おお、シドナ鉱山の友よ。やあ

original: This is where it will begin. A new uprising.
string: ここで始まるのだ。新たな反乱だ

original: We'll have our freedom. One day.
string: 自由を手に入れる。いつの日か

original: The Silver-Bloods pay their debts. You have my thanks.
string: シルバーブラッドは必ず恩に報いる。礼を言わせてくれ

original: Madanach has been found to be the true murderer of Markarth. On behalf the city, I apologize for your wrongful imprisonment.
string: マダナックは、マルカルスでの殺人事件の真犯人だった。街を代表して、冤罪で投獄した事を謝罪する

original: By killing Madanach you've freed Markarth from his hidden tyranny. On behalf of the city, I thank you.
string: マダナックが死んで、マルカルスは隠れた暴政から解放された。街を代表して、感謝する

original: Damn those Forsworn. Think they can kill people in my city? I'll have Madanach's head!
string: フォースウォーンどもめ。この街の人々を殺せると思うのか？　マダナックを始末してやる！

original: My brother tells me you've done us a service. Thank you.
string: 私の兄弟が言っていた。助けてくれたんだな。ありがとう

original: You. You aren't with the Forsworn, are you? People say they saw you when the prisoners escaped. So many dead.
string: あなたは、フォースウォーンの味方じゃないでしょうね？　囚人達が脱獄した時にあなたを見た人がいます。たくさんの人が死にました…

original: I heard about you being pardoned. What were the guards thinking, taking you in?
string: 釈放されたそうですね。あなたを連行するなんて、衛兵は何を考えていたんでしょう

original: Huh. Heard you broke out of Cidhna Mine with those Forsworn. Do you have any idea how many died?
string: ふん。フォースウォーンの連中を連れてシドナ鉱山から逃げてきたらしいな。何人死んだか分かってるのか？

original: Can't believe anyone was dumb enough to mistake you for a Forsworn agent.
string: あんたをフォースウォーンの手先と間違える馬鹿がいたとは、とても信じられん

original: Can't believe Madanach is on the loose again. I hope those rumors I'm hearing about your part in that are wrong.
string: マダナックがまた野放しになってるなんて。あなたが関わってたって噂があるけど、間違いだと願うわ

original: Everyone's been talking about you. The guards will have to answer for throwing an innocent person in Cidhna Mine.
string: みんなあなたの噂をしてる。無実の人をシドナ鉱山に放り込んだ事について、衛兵隊は申し開きをする事になるわ

original: Forsworn rampaging through the streets. As if business wasn't slow enough.
string: フォースウォーンが街で暴れ回っている。ただでさえ客が来ないってのに

original: Oh, it's you! Sorry to hear about your imprisonment. I'm sure the guards didn't mean to throw you in jail
string: おお、お前か！　投獄された件は気の毒だったな。衛兵もそのつもりはなかったに違いない

original: I saw you. With the Forsworn. By the old gods, that was something.
string: 見た顔だな。確かフォースウォーンと一緒だった。こいつはすごい事だぞ

original: I'll be damned. Someone who actually escaped Cidhna Mine. You're the talk of the Warrens.
string: こいつは驚いたな。シドナ鉱山を脱出した御仁だ。ウォーレンズじゃその話題で持ちきりだよ

original: You escaped Cidhna Mine? With Madanach? Everyone in the Warrens has been praising your name.
string: シドナ鉱山から逃げてきたのか？　マダナックと？　ウォーレンズの連中はみんなあんたの名前を讃えてる

original: What was it like? Cidhna Mine? We've all been talking about your escape. And being pardoned after. Amazing.
string: シドナ鉱山はどんな場所だ？　あんたの脱出劇について皆話してたんだ。その後に恩赦を受けたこととか。驚いたよ

original: So, where will you be now?
string: で、これからどうするんだ？

original: I'll be down here, trying to coordinate everything with Delvin and Vex; to make sure the coin keeps flowing... and no one skims!
string: 俺はゴールドが確実に入ってくるように、ここでデルビンとヴェックスで色々と調整しているよ。それと…　誰もピンハネしないようにせんとな！

original: If you still feel like doing some jobs, I'm sure Delvin and Vex have more than their fair share to give out.
string: まだ仕事をしたいと思ったら、デルビンとヴェックスならお前に回せるほどには仕事があるはずだ

original: Either way, it's been a pleasure, my friend. Here's to the future of the Guild. May it last another thousand years!
string: まあ何にしても。光栄だった、友よ。ギルドの未来に乾杯だ。以後千年の存続を願って！

original: It's been returned to the Sepulcher.
string: ピックは墓所に戻された

original: That's it then. After all of those years of helplessly watching the Guild decline.
string: ならば事は成ったな。ギルドが衰えていくのを、何もできずに何年も見続けたというのに

original: But enough of that... I'm confident that with you in charge, we'll soon have more gold than we could possibly spend.
string: だがそんな悔しみはもう十分だ…　お前が指揮していれば、使い切れないほどの金が舞い込んでくる事を確信している

original: I just wanted to give you a proper thank you for everything you've done.
string: 今までしてくれた事に、ちゃんと礼を言いたかったんだ

original: The Guild is back on its feet again and on its way to a prosperous future.
string: ギルドは再び立ち上がり、栄光ある未来へと進んでいる

original: What's become of the Skeleton Key?
string: 不壊のピックはどうなったんだ？

original: It's good to see you in one piece, lad!

original: It's good to see you in one piece, lass!

original: Olaf!

original: Arise, Olaf! My vengeance is at hand!

original: Insolent bard. Die!

original: I think I'll hang onto it.

original: I'm sorry, I've come too far to lose it now.
string: 悪いんだけど、ここまで来て失うわけにはいかないの

original: Here, take it.
string: さあ、どうぞ

original: Thank you so much, this scroll means a lot to my family. Take this for your trouble.
string: どうもありがとう。この巻物は私の一族にとって大きな意味があるものなの。これが手間賃よ

original: Can I have it?  It's worthless to you, but I can pay.
string: それをくれない？　あなたの役には立たないわよ。お金なら払うから

original: I've found this scroll.

original: You must have your hands full with the change in government.
string: 政権交代で忙しいに違いない

original: Well, it could be worse. The former steward, Proventus, kept very detailed records.
string: まあ、まだましな方さ。前の執政プロベンタスは実に詳細な記録を残していたからね

original: But yes, it's been a lot of work. Vignar doesn't want the change to disrupt the lives of his people. They've got enough to deal with already.
string: まあしかし、大変ではあったな。ヴィグナーは民の暮らしを混乱させるような変革を望まない。彼らは既に十分過ぎるほどの悩みを抱えているからね

original: Don't lecture me about treachery, whelp. You don't know the meaning of the word.
string: 裏切りについてお前の説教など聞きたくない。その言葉の意味すら知らないだろう

original: How many Nords died to save the Empire? And what was our reward?
string: 帝国を救うために何人のノルド人が死んだ？　その見返りはなんだ？

original: The worship of Talos outlawed, and now the Thalmor come to conduct their witch-hunts while the Empire stands idly by.
string: タロスの信仰は違法になり、サルモールが魔女狩りを始めたが帝国はただ傍観しているだけだ

original: What? Speak your meaning plainly, old man.
string: 何だって？　もっと分かりやすく話してくれよ

original: Bold words, Battle-Born. While you're meting out justice to traitors, are you going to deal with the Emperor, as well?
string: 大胆な言いぐさだな、バトル・ボーン。裏切り者に裁きを与えるよう、皇帝と取引でもするのか？

original: I've heard you Gray-Manes are collaborating with the Stormcloaks. If I see any such treachery, I'll deal with you myself.
string: あんたらグレイ・メーンがストームクロークに協力してるって聞いた。そんな裏切りをするなら、この手で始末してやる

original: I'll remember that when the Stormcloaks liberate the city. No amount of money will protect you then, Battle-Born.
string: ストームクロークが街を解放した時には思い出そう。その時にはお前がいくら金を積もうが身は守れないぞ、バトル・ボーン

original: You won't be laughing when the Thalmor come to root out Stormcloak sympathizers.
string: 笑ってはいられなくなるぞ。いずれサルモールがストームクロークの同調者を根こそぎにする

original: I've already put in a claim to the land and property you'll forfeit when you're found to be a collaborator.
string: お前が協力者だった事が判明した時、没収される土地と財産を貰えるように手を打っておいた

original: I'm surprised you had the wits to notice, Olfrid, what with your nose buried so far up the Emperor's backside.
string: よく気がついたな。そんなに賢いとは驚きだよ、オルフリッド。皇帝へごまをするのに忙しいのにな

original: Someone's been pilfering crops from my farm. If I find out it's one of your kin, I'll see the culprit rot in prison.
string: 何者かが農場から作物を盗んでいる。お前の一族の者が犯人だったら、監獄で朽ち果てさせてやる

original: Don't threaten me, boy. You're either a Nord who respects our traditions, or you're not.
string: 脅しはよせ、小僧。お前が伝統を重んじるノルドか、そうでないかのどちらかだ

original: If not, it isn't me you'll have to answer to, but the people of this city and this hold.
string: そうでないなら、お前が答えるべきはこの私ではない。この街の人々と要塞だ

original: I warn you, Gray-Mane, you are treading on dangerous ground.
string: 警告しておいてやる、グレイ・メーン。お前は危険なところを歩いている

original: Do your loyalties lie with the Thalmor, then?
string: お前はサルモールに忠誠を誓っているのだな？

original: I'm no happier about this than you are, but I don't want the see the Thalmor rounding up people in the streets and throwing them in prison.
string: 俺だってこんなことは嬉しくないさ。だがサルモールが街で人々を一斉検挙し、刑務所に放り込むなんて見たくないんだ

original: A law made at the tip of an Aldmeri sword, aye. A sword stained red with Nord blood.
string: アルドメリの剣によって作られた法だ。ああ。ノルドの血で真っ赤に染まった剣でな

original: Is this what our people fought and died for? To forsake our most beloved ancestor and divine?
string: こんな事のために我が民が命を賭けたのか？　何よりも大切にする祖先と神を放り出すためにか？

original: I won't say it again, Vignar - Talos worship is forbidden. It's the Empire's law, and we're still a part of the Empire.
string: 二度とは言わないぞ、ヴィグナー。タロス崇拝は禁じられている。これは帝国の法律であり、我々は今も帝国の一部なのだ

original: Will you restore the worship of Talos?
string: タロスの信仰を回復するのか？

original: Aye, with a certainty.
string: ああ、必ずな

original: It was Talos that helped us win back the city. I'm as sure of that as the sun rising in the morning.
string: タロスのおかげで街を奪還できたのだ。朝に日が昇るのと同じくらい確実な事だ

original: Might even build a new temple and put Heimskr in charge of it. Hah! I bet he'd like that.
string: 新しい聖堂を立て、ヘイムスカーに任せてもいい。ハ！　きっと奴も喜ぶだろう

original: What are your top priorities as the new Jarl?
string: 新しい首長として、最優先にすべきことは何だ？

original: Well, first an' foremost there's repairs to make an' wounds to heal. Folks are depending on us getting the city back in working order.
string: うむ、まず何より先に、直すべきものを直し、癒すべき傷を癒す。民衆は我らがこの街の機能を取り戻す事を期待している

original: Once things settle down, I'll be lookin' to recruit more guards for the city, then shore up our stores of food an' water.
string: 落ち着いたら、街の衛兵を増やし、商店に食料と水を配るつもりだ

original: The Empire might try an take the city back, or worse, we'll get a visit from a dragon. We've got to be ready for both.
string: 帝国は街を奪い返そうとするかも知れん。それどころかドラゴンに襲われるかも知れない。その両者に備えねばならん

original: Your clans used to be friends?
string: 二つの一族は以前は仲が良かったと？

original: Aye, we used to be fast friends, though it was long ago.

original: We were two of the city's oldest an' most-respected clans, an' we could trace our histories all the way back to Ysgramor's companions.
string: 我らはこの街で最古の、もっとも由緒正しき一族で、その歴史はイスグラモルの仲間にまでさかのぼる事ができる

original: But then Olfrid got rich an' decided he an his kin were too good for us simple, backwards Nord folk.
string: だがオルフリッドが成り上がると、その一族とともに我らを単細胞で泥臭いノルド人として見下し始めた

original: When the troubles began, he took the Empire's side. We haven't spoken much since then.

string: ライバルのバトル・ボーンについて教えてくれ

string: オルフリッド・バトル・ボーンは農業で財をなし、帝国貴族に急接近した

original: Now he's in the Emperor's pocket like the rest of 'em, with no regard for honor an' tradition.
string: いまやあいつは皇帝の飼い犬になりさがった。名誉と伝統を捨て去った奴らの一員だ

original: Tell me about the Gray-Manes.
